Extra special shout-out to Christina Lam who took care of us in the Mowry & Cotton Restuarant on premises. She is simply the best waitress I have ever dealt with. The perfect combination of warmth, thoughtfulness, humor and caring.

reviews.author: NYtravman
reviews.title: Desert 🌵 Oasis
reviews.text: Grounds and staff  were excellent.  Staff was helpful and knowledgeable about the resort and all activities.  The JG steakhouse was a wonderful dinner spot thanks to Jeff our waiter.  Golf course was well maintained.  4 hr round not the best but not the worst.  Pool complex well attended to.

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: The Staff make this resort stand apart.
reviews.text:
Had the opportunity to stay at this resort and found our experience to be five stars. The property is beautiful and well maintained but I do have to say that the staff at this hotel were what made the stay memorable. From the valet, check in (Daniel was perfect for his position), restaurant on and on.  In particular was our server Christine L. in Mowry and Cotton whom we had the pleasure of meeting. Her personality, experience and fine service prompted me to write this review to showcase what I mean as people can make or break a property.
Definitely will plan to be back.

reviews.author: Latria D
reviews.title: Girls Trip!
reviews.text: I would like to say from the very first day we arrived the resort was amazing! All of the staff was top notch including Christine from New York our server. Christine made the entire trip memorable with her personal and friendly attitude. Much needed vacation everything was magnificent keep up the great work!

reviews.author: rickhlosangeles_CA
reviews.title: Beautiful setting, beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Booked a Phoenician Suite and was thoroughly impressed.  Spacious and well decorated...even had two refrigerators and a small kitchen area.  Large patios opened from the living area and the separate bedroom.
Everybody was friendly and helpful, from the waiters to the bartenders to the valets, with any questions asked.  Steakhouse was amazing for dinner and food everywhere else was well executed (though expensive) and tasty.  Cabana service was well worth the price and my kids enjoyed being pampered there as well.  Will definitely return!

reviews.author: Sheryl M
reviews.title: Perfection in Scottsdale!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a fantastic resort in Scottsdale. It is well located in Scottsdale. Everything on the property is beautiful. The pools are great. They are perfect for adults and children. The staff is warm and friendly. Mowry and Cotton a nice place for breakfast. The resort followed all the proper Covid protocols which was reassuring.  This was my seventh stay there and I am looking forward to my eighth visit!

reviews.author: MichKMiller
reviews.title: Amazing weekend at the Phoenician
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful long weekend at the Phoenician.  From the moment we arrived with the valet crew and reception desk to our departure.  A special thanks to bartender Don who took great care of us, Christian from breakfast at Mowry and Cotton and to Ben from the spa for one of the best massages I’ve ever had.  The steakhouse was wonderful and we loved our view by the window.  

The rooms were great and we loved sitting out on the patio in the evenings. 

Pool service was a little slow, but Emily was also really great and attentive at the adult pool.  

We truly had a wonderful experience and can’t wait to return for another relaxing weekend at the Phoenician.

reviews.author: pauline
reviews.title: Awful waste of money
reviews.text: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY . The rooms are glorified.  Automatic 22 percent tip taken for any activity.  There was broken glass which I pierced my vein on , the celing leaked and there were huge roaches . Stay at motel 6 . At least the WiFi is free there

reviews.author: lorid212017
reviews.title: Absolutely spectacular
reviews.text: Upon arrival, my husband and I were upgraded (due to our Ambassador status) to a Casita suite on the ground floor with a fire pit on the patio (which we didn’t use due to 111 degree temperature). The suite was very large. There is a dining room table, with a large couch, a large tv and a fireplace in the salon area. There are two full bathrooms fully stocked. The master bedroom is very nice, and also large the entire room is very nicely appointed. Two bathtubs and two showers!! We walked from our Patio to the pool which was located right outside. In fact, there are three beautiful, huge pools to choose from.  The views are beautiful. We didn’t eat in the restaurants other than breakfast, which was nice. Housekeeping came everyday, but if you are looking for turn down service you have to ask for it. We loved this hotel and would definitely recommended it. We can’t wait to return!!!!

reviews.author: Curiosity792978
reviews.title: PRO TIP: Read This
reviews.text:
Never written a review on here before, mostly because I have never felt strongly enough one way or the other to go through the trouble. However, my fiancé and I had such a positive experience on our recent say at the Phoenician, I felt compelled to share with the class. Similar to other five diamond resorts, there is not a lot to complain about - sure you could nit-pick a few things here or there, but they more than make up for it with other luxury service and amenities. Namely, and the reason for me writing this review, the service we received at the pool by a saint named Gennaro.

If our stay at The Phoenician was a beautiful bonfire, Gennaro was gasoline. He took our trip to a whole other level. On our first day we had a cabana to celebrate a friends birthday and Gennaro showed up to take care of us. Before we even had our first round of drinks he had used his friendly and genuine personality to form personal connections with all of us. We thought, "maybe this was like, the red carpet package that comes with the cabana", or "maybe we were his only customers", but boy were we wrong. After meeting Gennaro, he looked out for us the next 4 days of our stay like we were family, and truly made us feel special. I'm not going to give away all his secrets online, but it was hard to leave.

If you are ever looking for a fail-safe way have a good time and feel like you are living your best life, call The Phoenician and tell them you want to book your stay when Gennaro is working. You won't regret it.

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Lovely experience, very few concerns
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Phoenician.  The staff was wonderful. I had a great time at the pool, Amari and Genaro were helpful and the food service was great.  The heat was intense, but my water glass and pitcher were always re-filled. The fact that there was no recycling at the pool bothered me a bit, as everyone was given multiple plastic cups.

reviews.author: larry m
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text:
Martin at the poolside was beyond excellent courteous polite and helpful. 

We are happy we chose this hotel and will definitely be back in the near future. 

Hotel staff was accommodating and assisted with all.

Overall a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: CJBecker61
reviews.title: Lovely property and spa destination in Scottsdale!
reviews.text:
For years I have heard of this property from friends and clients that have been going for years. The property is large and spread out, but access is very easy with golf carts that arrive when you request them. 
The spa is world renowned and "huge." The vibe is special and intended for a full day experience. The Canyon Suites with a spa focus vacation would not disappoint anyone wanting a special disconnect of pampering. 
Many restaurants to choose from, we tried The Tavern and Mowry & Cotton. There was retail sprinkled in as well, R&R is a fun store. 
The multiple pools were a highlight. High touch of ice water by the pool staff was very appreciated. 
Joanna Paulsel was a joy and her long history with the property put an impressive cap on the reputation and experience on my visit. There are many long time employees which says a lot for the owners and management.

reviews.author: Shannon E
reviews.title: Beautiful resort… no complaints.
reviews.text: This was our second stay at the Phoenician.  We were here 3 years ago before COVID and I was hesitant about this trip due to the lackluster reviews.  I’m happy to say our visit was perfect and this resort is as wonderful as I remembered it.  At check in we were offered an upgrade to a casita room which was a pleasant surprise.  The first night we ate dinner at J&G Steakhouse which was amazing.  My husband is still raving about the food and the campfire old fashioned!  It was HOT during our stay and we spent 3 days at the pools.  The pool staff deserves great praise for their consistent service and attention to the guests.  Our ice water pitcher was always full!  Just a beautiful resort with excellent service.  We will be back!

reviews.author: MilwaukeeCraig
reviews.title: Nice hotel - lots of construction- losing green space
reviews.text: Hotel is nice, quiet with a great pool. Unfortunately they are losing a lot of green space to construction. Used to be much nicer. The rooms themselves continue to be very roomy and comfortable. Rooms contain shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, body lotion, nail file, cotton swabs, makeup pads, cotton balls, robes, slippers, iron & board, safe, hair dryer, automatic nightlight in bathroom, coffee maker. Bathroom has shower, bath, clothesline, separate toilet enclosure.

reviews.author: Elishia G
reviews.title: Perfect Resort
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I have enjoyed visiting the Phoenician regularly for a couple of years and it is a truly beautiful establishment in all aspects. 
Every time we visit, we are provided with the most impeccable service by Deano at the main bar. He greets us warmly, provides entertaining conversation and is always attentive in serving us. 
In fact, the last time we visited the resort, my fiancé proposed, and Deano played a part in ensuring it all went smoothly!
Deano goes above and beyond to ensure that we always feel well looked after and it never goes unnoticed. We look forward to visiting again and seeing Deano on our next trip.

reviews.author: Jennifer C.
reviews.title: Great Service, Mediocre Property
reviews.text:
As an avid traveler (business and pleasure), finding those great properties that I can return to are things I look for, especially when trying new places. Underwhelmed and disappointed is the best way I can describe my stay at the Phoenician. 

I booked this property as a part of the American Express Fine Hotels and Resorts Program and was expecting a truly luxurious and relaxing experience. 

My disappointment started with my room. While the room was a decent size, the view was terrible - I overlooked the roof of the conference center and stared into other balconies.  

The pool area (multiple pools) was outdated with small pools, cracks in the stones in the pool, too many reserved areas (so you couldn’t sit in the good loungers and really this resort was not even close to halfway occupied). 

When eating breakfast at Mowry + Cotton, there were probably 9-10 birds circling and eating food off the table next to me. Not a single employee bothered to clear the table or address the situation, until I said something a second time. 

I ended up moving rooms to the Phoenician Suites and had a much better room, view and a nicer pool, however, I was charged an extra $300 to do so and by the time I moved had about 5 hours left in the day to try and enjoy before I fell asleep and checked out the next morning. 

Finally, the resort was supposed to credit me back the perks from my Fine Hotels and Resorts Program, and they did when I physically checked out, but then they went in and re-charged me and sent me a new receipt hours later. Very odd. 

I can’t recommend to stay here, and likely will not stay again. 

I visit Phoenix 6-8 times a year and was looking for a “home hotel,” but after this visit, I’d prefer to stay at the Doubletree on my next visit.

reviews.author: Brad S
reviews.title: Great Resort but don't expect much Sunday - Wednesday for your Kids
reviews.text: If I were traveling without children I would have increased my rating from 3 to 4 stars but unfortunately the main reason I booked the Phoenician was because I was traveling with my kids. Come to find out, the Phoenician puts on ZERO activities for kids (outside of the pool and game room which doesn't really count  - there is a waterslide where there is a 50% chance the employees are watching and not on their phones). No movie by the pool, games, kids center...nothing. Happy to pay that amazing $30 ish per day resort fee which in theory should cover all the wonderful kids activities since it isn't adjusted down Sunday - Thursday when there isn't anything. Looks like I'll be staying elsewhere when I return next year, probably the Fairmont.

reviews.author: G0ingn0w
reviews.title: Awesome resort and Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
Stayed at the resort for 3 nights in June with my sister and niece.  We were in town for a family event.   We booked thru Amex Platinum Fine Hotels and Resorts and got a Superior Room and sadly our view was the top of the roof.  

The resort has a lot to offer:
Convenient to the airport
Car for hire onsite thankfully because Ubers were almost non-existent and the wait times were ridiculous 
Valets are polite and extremely helpful; never waited long for car; handed out bottles of water; greeted us even if we were just walking by
Lots of nice towels and enough towel bars (my pet peeve)
Lots of outlets but you need to look for them on the side of the night table
Full length mirror in the closet
Vanity w/mirror outside the bathroom
Multiple Pools but we didn't get to try the adult only; staff at the pools were terrific; service was amazing; no problem getting chaise lounge chairs; provided ice water and replaced ice and water as it melted; food was good but not terribly kid friendly (no burgers and fries or chicken tenders); smoothies were delicious.
Spa was amazing but also kind of far and I wrote a separate review 
Gym/athletic center is fully equipped; large windows, water, towels aplenty, cubbies to put your stuff and the guy at the desk was really nice
Nice gift shops with nice helpful staff
Amex provided a credit we used for breakfast in the restaurant and everything was delicious; eggs prepared perfectly; avocado toast was yummy.

The not so great:
The front desk staff wasn't all that friendly; when we checked in and the next morning when we asked to change rooms; two different people and neither were particularly nice; this is the only reason I gave 4 stars and not 5. 
The resort is sprawling; gym is a good walk down a hill outside and I guess it seems far when it's over 100 degrees outside.

We would definitely stay here again.  I'd love to bring my husband out to play golf when it's not 100 degrees +.

reviews.author: Dach1978
reviews.title: Very disappointing weekend. Not 5 star
reviews.text:
This is the 3rd time we have stayed at this property and have normally enjoyed every visit without any issue.

However this visit was disappointing on a number of fronts. The hotel feels like it’s a little run down in places, with a lack of attention to detail for what you would expect from a 5 star resort. 

On our first day, my husband was in the adult people and had deal with a bunch of people back flipping into the pool, completely spoiling the quiet ambience at the adult pool. We came for peace and relaxation, not to listen to a bunch of guys acting like kids. To make matters worse one of the people creating the disturbance was also vaping pot (the hotel is supposed to be smoke free, and certainly didn’t expect to witness someone doing drugs.) Both issues had to be raised with staff. Given every pool is staffed, it shouldn’t take a complaint from a guest to put a stop to unreasonable behavior.

On our second day, we had to call 3 times to have our towels changed and room serviced. It took until 7:45pm that day to have the room serviced, again disappointing when you are trying to get ready for dinner and don’t have clean towels.

On the third day, my husband got hit in the head in the adults pool by a group who were throwing a heavy, wet nerf football. He was left with a bruise and a headache which really ruined the rest of our trip. The staff again did address the issue after the event, but less than an hour later when we we were walking for dinner, the same group had started playing with the ball again.l and staff did nothing about it.

Overall the hotel seems to be very short staffed and with very junior staff who don’t have the experience of what service in a 5 star hotel should reflect. You have to wait on hold to speak to anyone, or stand in lines for things like breakfast despite most of the tables being empty. 

When you are paying $3000 for a 5 star hotel, we really expected better. We come to Scottsdale every year, but will be reconsidering our choice of hotel  for the next visit as there are many other beautiful resorts to choose from.

I really hope the hotel gets its act together, as it’s a beautiful place, but really let it’s self and us down on this trip. Since it was my husbands 60th birthday trip, I was so upset that we didn’t get the experience we had hoped for.

reviews.author: boston1228
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text: Lovely resort.  We stayed for 4 nights after time in Sedona and the Grand Canyon.  I was happy that there were some healthier options for breakfast (Acai bowls) and at the pool (the grilled vegetable kabobs were great!).  We stayed on points and did receive an upgrade to a pool view which was nice as the resort was not extremely busy.  We used the gym once, it was large and fully equipped.  We also used the pickleball courts and bikes.  The $50 per night "resort fee" irks me and the fact that it includes use of the courts but you have to pay for your balls is also ridiculous.  They need to fix that.  Other than that we greatly enjoyed our stay. Another note:  children eat for half price off of the adult menu.  This was huge as my 10 year old generally eats an adult meal now.  Each meal the server "forgot" to charge us half price until we reminded him, so just be on the lookout for that.

reviews.author: Smallfry16
reviews.title: Luxury?
reviews.text:
As a Phoenician myself, my friends and I enjoy spa weekends at the many luxury resorts the valley has to offer. This was our first stay at The Phoenician Resort and Spa.

The Phoenician calls itself a “luxury” resort. That is a STRETCH.

The spa: 
Services prices are a bit higher than at many of the other luxury resorts in the area. The spa staff is incredible.  Extremely attentive, professional and kind. The spa itself is pretty basic. Nothing stood out other than the staff. The rooftop spa pool was very underwhelming. Not enough loungers or umbrellas. In my opinion, the services prices did not reflect the spa atmosphere or amenities. 

The Room:
There were three of us. We were given a  room in one of the casita buildings. For $600 a night, we were very disappointed. Two double beds (we expected 2 queens for that price). The room is cheaply decorated and pretty bare. The bathroom appeared to be recently renovated and was quite large. Personally, I’d rather have more space in the room and less in the bathroom. 
Side note… if you want to log into your Netflix, Hulu, etc, the process is a PROCESS.  You first have to pay $15 for 24 hours of WiFi (why isn’t this included at $600 a night?). Then there are a list of confusing prompts that you have to do from your phone to get your streaming services to work on the television. It was so confusing, I had to call the front desk. They had to dig out the lengthy instructions and read them to me. I mean, if it’s too complicated for your your staff, imagine how you’re guests feel. 

Overall, this was our least favorite spa weekend. It doesn’t hold a torch to the other resorts in the area, some of which are less expensive. Do yourself a favor and look around at some other resorts. If you’re looking for a stellar spa and resort experience, check out the Omni Montelucia a few minutes away.

reviews.author: mlemasters1
reviews.title: Beautiful locatio, helpful staff
reviews.text: I will say that some of our food and bar service was slower, but I know that covid and low staffing has more to do with it than the staff that was there. The pools are beautiful and the server (Emily) and pool attendants (Moises and Kayla)  were very helpful. We were able to check in early thanks to Andrew and our room was beautiful with a pool view even though it was a more standard room. Ate at Mowry and Cotton for breakfast, Rachael, was our server and did great. Then we also ate at the J&G Steakhouse with Suzan who was a knowledgeable server as well. The steakhouse has a beautiful view but was very pricey while the food did not seem as high end as the prices.

reviews.author: dcooper4250
reviews.title: My new favorite place to stay!!!
reviews.text: I’ll keep it short as there is too much good to say!!! The rooms were super clean and great. The resort is spectacular!! The views are amazing!! The golf is priceless!! The staff was amazing!! Extra special thanks to Monica at Mowry and Cotton. She was the best!! Super attentive, very personable, and nothing was out of reach. She even offered to walk to other bars to look for a drink we wanted with breakfast. Also, Rich who took care of us all day at the cabana was all the exact same things I said about Monica. This place comes very highly recommended by myself and the entire 14 people we went there with. Great job everyone!!! This was my second trip there in a month and a half. First trip was mostly business related. Which is why we came right back with all our friends!!! Worth the cost of admission!!!!!

reviews.author: Ken
reviews.title: Treated like Royalty
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying: after reading all of the mixed reviews recently, we were skeptical prior to arriving for our stay. But as it turns out, there was no need for concern at all, we were treated like royalty from the moment we stepped onto the property! 

Rebecca at the front desk was friendly and accommodating, not only granting our early-check in request, but also upgrading our room. Kevin, the bellman, then whisked us off to our room via golf cart and helped us get settled with our luggage, gave a brief tour of the room and overview of the property, and brought us ice. The room was spacious and clean, and as others have mentioned, the bathroom did show some signs of wear, but we weren't there for the room.

The pools were our first stop after arriving where Fernando quickly set us up with towels, umbrellas, and pitchers of ice water, and provided recommendations on local food and attractions. We never had an issue finding chairs at the pool. The food and drink service at the pools was impeccable for our entire stay - Nicole, Hannah P, Sarah R, and Samantha all took great care of us! (Special shout out to Nicole who, upon finding out we were on our honeymoon, worked with her manager to have a bottle of wine and chocolates sent to our room. She also went out of her way to check in on us at the pool throughout our stay, whether she was assigned to our area or not - we'd give her 10 stars out of 5 if we could!) We never had to wait more than a minute or two to put in our order, and the food and drinks were always delivered within 5 or 10 minutes. Those ladies were working all day in 110+ degree heat and you'd never know it based on the high level of service they provided. 

The food by the pool is a Mediterranean/Southwest fusion concept and everything we tried was delicious. In fact, we didn't have a bad meal on property our entire stay. All the restaurants were fantastic, but the standout was definitely J&G. It was quite busy when we went, but the service was perfect and the food was incredible. (The level 9 Wagyu filet special might be the best steak I've ever had.) Jeff, our server, was awesome - personable, funny, and very knowledgeable.

The only hiccup during our entire trip was when we booked the sedan service to take us to the airport - an amenity that was suggested when I called guest services, who took our information and said the car would pick us up at our casita - but at 5:45AM, no car showed up. When called again, guest services had no record of a booking for our car, and said the evening representative who had taken my reservation was bad at writing things down. They offered to try and find an available driver and said they would call me back - a call that never came. Luckily, we were able to find an Uber and made it to the airport in time for our flight. If using their sedan service, I would recommend booking it early in your stay, then confirming your reservation the day before you depart to be sure it is actually booked.

We could not find any sign of the negatives mentioned in many of the other reviews. I suspect the hotel may have had issues with staffing during and following the pandemic, but that seems to no longer be an issue. It is also important to note that June is not a very popular time to be in Scottsdale, especially during a week with record heat like the week we were there, so that may also contribute to the elevated level of service and relatively small number of guests around the property.

Overall, we both agree we would not hesitate to stay at the Phoenician again and we look forward to returning some day!

reviews.author: FlyOneWorld
reviews.title: The Insight You Need - Hits and Misses
reviews.text:
There are pros and cons with staying here. I endeavor to give the “must know” overview and insight. We stayed in June.

I also note that the same person gives the same canned response to TripAdvisor reviews so I doubt the property takes any of them seriously.

The Cons
1. Superior rooms literally have no view. Our room felt like a scene out of a prison. See photo
2. Your Marriott Bonvoy status is worth very little here. Platinum’s and up  will get a $30 breakfast credit. Booking via AMEX fine hotels and resorts will also be of limited utility at least in terms of an upgrade.

3. The front desk is dishonest when it comes to room availability. We were told no upgrades were available. However, our second room was not ready on time at 4 PM and suddenly all kinds of rooms were available if we were willing to move as we required connecting rooms. In short they lie to you.￼
4. While the rooms have new furnishings they did not get a complete renovation. The bathrooms are pretty dated. The balconies are pretty tired. The color scheme of gray only continues the prison motif that our view cast upon the room. They do not provide enough luggage racks.
5. Everything is very expensive this includes the resort fee, the valet parking fee, and most other amenities one might use. For example, I paid over $22 for a vodka martini. This of course is to be expected but some of it seems rather gratuitous.￼
6. Some rooms are remarkably far from the pool and the main hotel lobby.￼
7. No shade over the pools. Other hotels have more shade.
8. No turn down service which is pathetic
9. They have a goofy and inconsistent temperature taking policy for guests wishing to use the gym some people get checked and some do not the whole policy makes no sense and is irritating.

The Pros
1. Excluding the front desk staff, we found the staff to be excellent. From the valets, to the pool staff to the bartenders the staff really made a huge difference. Truly 5 star. Eliot and Sydney by the pool deserve a mention as does Paul at the bar. 
2. We found the service poolside to be excellent in contrast to other properties in the Scottsdale and Phoenix area. They are constantly refilling your ice water and asking you if you need anything. That is a welcome luxury.
3. The on property dining is very good. Mowry & Cotton was solid for dinner and breakfast. The steakhouse was outstanding. The poolside food was tasty. This is very good if you do not want to leave the hotel.
4. The lobby bar is inviting.￼
5. If you use the valet they park the car in the garage which helps with the summer heat.
6. We found the pools to be in good condition.￼
7. The property itself is quite beautiful.￼
8. Within a very short drive there are many excellent restaurants if you would like to leave the property.￼
9. As one of our rooms was not provided on time management did make a gesture that was appropriate to the situation and they did so proactively. That is commendable.

Suggestions￼

1. Consider paying for a better than superior room unless you like the prison yard view.￼
2. The gray color scheme of the room can feel oppressive. If you’re going to be in the room a lot keep that in mind.￼
3. There is a refrigerator in the room and if you need water I’d suggest you bring your own and in lieu of paying the hotel six dollars for a bottle of Fiji. They do provide two small bottles of water a day.
4. The summer heat becomes oppressive poolside as there’s no shade in any of the pool areas for most of the day except under your umbrella when on your chair. They should really endeavor to create shaded areas in the water. Thus, leaving the property in the afternoon just to get a little heat break it’s not a bad idea.

Overall this is a quality hotel but it needs a more thorough renovation of the rooms to be truly five star. The excellent staff, solid dining options, and overall appeal of the place are the positive attributes.

reviews.author: Stay580075
reviews.title: The perfect get away!
reviews.text:
Our family of four (two boys ages 14 and 17, and my husband and myself)  just got back from a relaxing week at the Phoenician.  Before we arrived, I received an email that there was some water damage in the casita we reserved and that we would be upgraded to the Presidential Suite.  I would like the thank the Phoenician staff again for making our trip so memorable and we are grateful for the upgrade.  The service was great, from check in all the way through check out.  The customer service was on par with the expectations of a luxury resort at every turn.  

I’d like to provide some information about the pools and chairs situation, since I didn’t know what we were going to see once we got there. The hotel was sold out for about three days, so we reserved cabanas for those days because I just didn’t have the energy to have to hunt for chairs (this was based off a prior review). Let me be clear that even with the hotel being sold out, there were plenty of chairs at all three pools,  I never saw anyone looking for a chair the entire week.  The attendants always made sure we  had  plenty of ice water and were constantly walking around to make sure everyone’s needs were being met. Even my 14 year old remarked on how good the service was at the pools!  

The food was good, maybe a bit pricey, but we were expecting to pay top dollar at the resort, so we were ready!  We ordered food at the pool,  visited the MarketPlace, had breakfast and dinner at Mowry and Cotton, and also ate at J and G twice. We placed an insta-cart order when we got there and had some groceries delivered so we’d have snacks on hand.  Two teen boys eat a LOT! Water is available all around the resort and water bottles in the rooms are replenished every day.  We did bring Yeti cups to keep our drinks cold poolside and they did help a lot. 

I’d also like to share that the security at the resort was subtle, but also effective. Prompt responses to groups who apparently were not staying at the resort did not go unnoticed and were very much appreciated! 

A little known secret about the resort is that they have private cars to take you wherever you need, and the pricing is comparable to taking an Uber.  It was just a nice added touch to our experience. 

I highly recommend this property!  Make sure you walk around the entire resort, there was so much to see. Don’t forget the cactus garden!  Enjoy!

reviews.author: SurfingDoc
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at The Phoenician for a relaxing end to a very adventurous trip in Arizona. He had stayed there several years ago for business, but we were both slightly concerned about the service these days given some of the latest reviews.

We’ve stayed in some great places over the years, and we can absolutely hold The Phoenician at the top of the list. Staff could not have been more helpful everywhere we went on the property. Everyone was kind and asked us if we needed anything at all - even one of the landscaping staff members!

We were able to check in early, to our surprise. The room was very modern and sleek - I have no idea why people are saying the rooms look dated. There was a pack of antiseptic wipes on the dresser for us to use, which was much appreciated. The room was very well-appointed with a refrigerator, Keurig (complete with cups with lids, thank you!), bottled water, robes, and slippers. There were plenty of receptacles and charging stations available. The bed was incredibly comfortable, but if you don’t like the softness of feather (or feather alternative) pillows, you’ll be disappointed, because that’s all there were. Our room had a lovely mountain view as we requested. The bathroom was very spacious and the towels were thick and absorbent.

We rented a cabana at the adult pool for the days we were there. I could not possibly say enough good things about Christine, our pool server. She was sweet, friendly, very attentive without being intrusive, and made our time so enjoyable! She is a gem. Kayla was also wonderful and kept our water pitcher cold and full. Staff is great about keeping children out of the adult pool area, which we appreciate.

We had room service and the food was perfect as well as the service. My husband’s French fries stayed crispy on the trip - not a small feat! The staff members we dealt with for room service were very kind and made sure we had everything we needed.

We had a fantastic breakfast at Mowry and Cotton. My husband said that his oatmeal was the best he’s ever had. My acai bowl and green juice were both very fresh and delicious. Sam, the host, was very helpful and nice, and our server, Rachael, was tremendous! She made sure we had everything we needed and checked in at just the right times.

We stopped in The Market a few times and service was just as friendly and wonderful there as it was elsewhere.

I won’t lie - I was looking for the problems that other reviewers have complained about, but I really couldn’t find them. The only reason I’m docking a star (really just half of a star) is because prior to arriving, it was exceedingly difficult to get a hold of someone by phone to make any changes to our reservation, ask questions, make cabana reservations, etc. I was on hold once for 15 minutes, which I think is excessive for a five-star resort. 

That issue aside, we could not have been more happy with our stay and have already discussed our next visit. Service was impeccable - we couldn’t find a thing to complain about. Well done.

reviews.author: Elia A
reviews.title: Personalized service
reviews.text: We stayed at The Phoenician for a week and enjoyed the full service this resort provides.  In particular, the Pool staff was friendly, helpful and attentive.  I wanted to give a special mention to Brad at the Pool.  Brad helped me find my Apple Watch which I misplaced and ended up in a large bin of towels.  Brad went out of his way to help me recover my watch and I am so grateful!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: 2019 visit
reviews.text: Dirty place. $1400 per night with layers of dirt on baseboards. Thin windows, gas leaf blowers in front of you during your breakfast of your terrace. Annoying loud music by the pool and restaurant. Three pools, no peace, nasty noisy music everywhere. Every 2 feet a speaker is installed. The gym play a huge TV loud volume for the attendance. Guests just have to suffer the noise. Breakfast food has no choice for gluten-free and vegan. Rooms are very dirty. Scorpions can cross under the door gap.

reviews.author: Taryn W
reviews.title: Not relaxing
reviews.text: I loved the place. Food was great, staff was friendly and helpful. But when I went to the pool to read/relax starting at 9:30 a.m., the music pulse-pounding music began. I was wearing noise-canceling headphones trying to listen to a podcast and could barely here it over the music. I came to this resort and spa to relax. Unfortunately it just wasn’t for me.

reviews.author: NC_mQk
reviews.title: Relaxing week away
reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed in a casita for a week and it was a great experience.  The grounds are beautiful and the 3 pools are great. We even did the water slide a few times. Made us feel like kids again. 

We ate many of our meals and drinks onsite at the Tavern and Mowry & Cotton. All meals were great and all staff great. Even splitting plates for us. Nice touch!  Also, had great drinks at the Thirsty Camel, J&G Steakhouse, and at the pool.  Also, recommend the fish tacos from the pool bar menu. 

Some staff that went and above and beyond for us were:
Daphne - pool attendant 
Pang - bartender at Tavern
Kevin - front desk
Jorge - Mowry & Cotton waiter

Definitely plan to return for some more relaxation sometime!

reviews.author: ColoChick_11
reviews.title: 5 star pricing for 1 star service
reviews.text:
Very disappointing due to terrible service.  The property itself is lovely, but the service was definitely lacking.  We arrived early and dropped our bags with the valet and went to eat lunch.  Lunch at the golf course restaurant was "ok" - wouldn't choose to eat there again.  Wandered around waiting for the call that our room was ready - nothing.  At 4pm, we went to the front desk and were told, "Oh, yes - your room is ready."  (Seriously - no call?) 
 Ninety minutes and two phone calls to finally get our luggage delivered to the room.  No housekeeping service (we were not told that there wouldn't be any and they were obviously cleaning other rooms with people staying in them.)   Called guest services and asked for a towel refresh at a minimum.  Four hours later - called again.  An hour after that we finally got towels.  Asked where we could get ice and was snootily told, "This is a 5 star hotel.  WE bring you the ice."  Great - no ice showed up for 90 minutes so my husband went to the bar to get some.  It finally arrived an hour AFTER that.  
The pool area was crowded (we went in April) and the service at the pool slow.  
We'll be staying elsewhere next time.

reviews.author: Shempgracie
reviews.title: Awful Customer Service - No One Answering The Phones
reviews.text:
Want to waste a couple of hours of your life? Try contacting this hotel to change something about your reservation.   The staff are certainly friendly, but they seem to be lacking the training or authority to make any changes to various aspects of your reservation.   Once you call, you are then transferred to another area that may or may not answer the phone.

You are a 5 start hotel.  Do better.

reviews.author: Monique L
reviews.title: DON’T BELIEVE THE HYPE
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I sure did. In March we visited the Scottsdale area for my birthday. I was disappointed that my husband, who is a Titanium Elite, booked the JW instead of the Phoenician. So we decided to come back in June and stay at the much desired resort. As soon as we reached the resort, I started to feel slightly disappointed, as I was expecting “a luxury collection resort”. Check in was the typical “I’m polite to keep my job” customer service, yet it was so blasé that my husband thought he should reiterate his Bonvoy status. As another reviewer stated, your status means nothing here, and that’s pretty important to Bonvoy members. That’s why we select Marriott properties!
So our room was suppose to be a pool view, but it’s really a view of the back of some building. I would have to look over yonder to see an umbrella, maybe a chair. 
In general, the room was/is okay (I’m still here), but definitely not what I had anticipated. Overall, the property is okay if you are not anticipating “a luxury collection resort”. I don’t recommend staying here, and if we weren't leaving today, we probably would have checked out, and returned to the JW.

reviews.author: J Schlosser
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY IN THE Casitas, do not waste your money on this property, overpriced and underwhellming
reviews.text: We celebrated my wife's 40th here.  We are AMBASSADOR with Marriott which doesn't mean squat here.  The room literally was on a street with people walking by and across from the golf course with every drunk golfer yelling as they wait for their uber.  Asked for different room as this WAS NOT WHAT WE BOOKED, we booked a firepit room as we had planned on celebrating with friends which went out the window with the patio from hell.  On top of it the property and room need updating in a bad way.  Christina at the front desk offered very little and said the property was 100% filled.   The service was mediocre, not what I would expect from this property and PRICE.  the same BS reason on service was given that bodies were missing was said to us multiple time as they were down workers as we waited and paid a premium for service that never surfaced.  Breakfast was a 45-60 minute wait each day.   The only saving grace was the cabana service by Rich, great guy and thankfully made my wife feel like a gem.  Golf course was terrible too, overpriced and 5 hour round.  I wish I had better experiences to report but I do not.  If they treat their best clients this way how do they treat everyone else? Never again.  Check out multiple other properties in the area if you ask me

reviews.author: Danica T
reviews.title: Gorgeous views, fabulous food, but not worth the expense of staying on site
reviews.text:
General: The food is excellent, but you'd be better off staying literally anywhere else and just visiting the restaurants. It's exorbitantly expensive, and they still charge you for something every time you turn around, and provide you the absolute bare minimum for a hotel stay (of any tier). The service would probably be great if they didn't overwork their employees and had more staff to take care of their guests. Oh, and don't think you can get in anywhere to eat or relax during your stay unless you've made reservations several days ahead of time. I have provided more detailed pros/cons below. You have been warned!

Negative:
-Room- My mother and I flew to AZ to aid in a family health issue, and because it was going to be a long and stressful visit, I thought I would treat my mother and myself to a stay at this luxurious resort (it was Mother's Day as well, after all). Because we would be spending all of our downtime during these 10 days at the resort, I wanted to make sure we had an absolutely spectacular view, as shown in the pictures on their website. Upon booking I emphasized this factor, and the concierge helped guide my room selection appropriately, although they recommended a follow up call before I flew out to verify the room selection. I called twice before arriving to verify, and each time was assured of the beautiful garden views we'd get to enjoy during our 10-day extended stay. I traveled for 16 hours to get there, and at the end of a long day, I arrived late in the evening for check in. Before even going to the room to get settled for the night, I again verified the room requirements with the concierge. He said he was unsure of the view of that room, but if we were unsatisfied with the space once we got there, he would happily move us. (This is laughable in retrospect). It took several minutes to get to our room, as it was the very last one at the end of the hotel, past many utility spaces and conference rooms.  It was probably a storage space that was later converted to a room. The room was spacious, but seemed unfinished (some items in the room were still extremely dirty (spilled makeup, and a few unknown substances), there was a garbage bag still in the room, and the beds looked as though they'd merely been made, not newly cleaned). I was so exhausted after traveling so long that I was willing to let these issues go so I could get to sleep. But then we opened the draperies to assess our "beautiful view" that we'd be gazing at for the next 10 days: it was the gravel rooftop, huge metal exhaust vents for the hotel, and their loading dock where utility vehicles and delivery men frequented! It was so ludacris it seemed to be a cruel joke. The bellhop asked about where to put our luggage, and I felt awful making him wait, but the concierge insisted we call if there were any issues with the view, and this was too much to overlook. However, after being on hold for almost 10 minutes, I finally got through to the concierge, only to find out that moving us to another room would be IMPOSSIBLE as they had every. single. room. booked out for the next several days. And this was not at limited capacity due to Covid restrictions, this was every single room being taken up on the entire property! About halfway through our stay they'd have a room open up elsewhere on the property, but until then we were stuck.  When we moved, we were glad to at least have a better view, but the second room was so cramped that you couldn't leave the room if either of the closets or the bathroom doors were open! Surely this is a fire hazard?! We also had an alarming cleanliness issue in the new room (the second day of our stay there we discovered someone had spilled popcorn in our room in the middle of the floor while we'd been out! There isn't even a microwave in the room, and this happened while we were gone during the day, so it was very alarming to find). The first day of our stay I bought a full sized Lysol container at the store and cleaned the room myself each day, wary of what happens when we are out of the space. I spent almost $10,000 on this trip for my mother (who'd I not been able to see in two years) and there were an alarming number of disappointments for a hotel of this caliber. 

-I realized upon hiking the grounds that the lovely views they show on the website of the gorgeous flowering trees, hillsides, or even the lovely cactus garden are not from the hotel at all, but rather small private houses they have on the grounds that you can rent. That would have been nice to know ahead of time when booking!
-A severe lack of service (people not returning with what they were sent to obtain, delivery office closed, finding out about the calendar of activities AFTER it was too late to do any of them)
-Reservations are a necessity (this would have been nice to know ahead of time). Don't expect a meal or a spa appointment whatsoever unless you've called several days ahead of time! We were "lucky" that we were staying so long (10 days) that we were able to make a couple appointments at the end of our visit. I heard many disappointed guests in line for the concierge who were only staying over the weekend and couldn't even get into the restaurant or get so much as their nails painted!
-Spa costs vs. poor quality massage. I have held memberships at multiple spas, and this one was not only the most expensive massage I'd ever received, but also of the poorest quality. Multiple times I had to ask for firmer pressure (not once was I asked if the pressure was okay), and several techniques were just silly or unproductive. Even the most novice massage therapists know to not rub someone's spinal column! Gah. It was an uncomfortable and awful experience that I anxiously awaited to end (which thankfully was brief, as your 1-hour massage includes a 10 minutes consultation on your areas to focus on (all my comments were ignored), 10 minutes of you "changing" even though you are merely in a robe at this point, and 10 minutes at the end of you changing back to your robe). So it was $200+ per person plus tip for about 30 minutes of an uncomfortable massage. If it wasn't for the other amenities (private rooftop pool access, steam rooms, hot tubs) and the absolutely exceptional service by the locker room attendants (WOW! They are incredible, detail-oriented, and they know what you need before you know you need it!) then it wouldn't even be worth going at all. 
-There were no perks or benefits to extended stay guests. People with short stays (one, two days) seemed to be treated extra well.
-Toiletry and room amenities on par with a motel. Here you got the standard "Shampoo/Conditioner/Body Wash/Lotion" but that was it! Hotels of similar quality provide their guests with everything from mouthwash to showercaps to lip balm and shoe buffing kits. Oh, and one bar of soap to last your entire stay, no matter how many people are in the room or how long you're staying, is just not acceptable. And we actually had to ask for more TP on more than one occasion (there was only the single roll in the room, and it was not replaced each day or an extra placed elsewhere. They only replaced it once it was literally gone).
-Fees for EVERYTHING. You pay $33 a day for valet (plus tip), on top of already being charged an additional $40 per day for "self parking" access. So even without going anywhere or even using your vehicle onsite, you are spending $73 dollars a day!!!  Also, even though you pay a $40 Resort Fee per day because you are staying at a resort with a variety of amenities, you still also have to PAY for many of those amenities (rental fee in golf putting green, spa, equipment rentals, etc.). Also, they don't even have enough of items to allow their guests to utilize them.  For example, when we were there, ever single room was sold out in the hotel, meaning that at capacity they had 1,200 guests, yet they only had 8 total bikes available for guests to utilize (and 2 of those are for children, and 2 have been broken for some time, so really ONLY 4 bikes available for their 1,200 guests to utilize). Ridiculous. 
-Service. Their main issue here seemed to be that several areas were understaffed. For example, it took more than an hour to get our drinks poolside (but the server was amazingly positive under the stress of trying to cover the entire adult pool deck by herself during peak hours on weekend with hundreds of guests to satisfy! I believe her name was Aspen and she was wonderful, though very taxed). Our group ended up going to the kitchen area ourselves to get drinks and food.  And when our group first sat down at the pool, some nice women next to us gave us a couple of their seats because every seat at the pool was taken and they were just waiting on their bill. It took an hour and a half for them to just get their receipt so they could leave! However, they were told *afterwards* that if they had just gotten up and left their bill would have been closed out and there would have been an automatic 20% gratuity added. That would have been good to know ahead of time!
-At their nicest restaurant I experienced the most passive aggressive restaurant service I've ever received. This was at P&G Steakhouse, the restaurant one "absolutely MUST visit while in Scottsdale" and yet during my 10-day stay I could only get into one possible night (and had to reschedule my Grand Canyon visit to do so). The food was incredible (we each ordered the 5 course tasting menu), but our server made snarky or outright rude comments at every interaction. He also completely ignored us when we asked for something as he walked past, or on one occasion, he got so frustrated/irritated that we asked him to repeat something (that was difficult to understand through the muffling of a face mask) that he stormed to the balcony outside where we watched him stare into the darkness for a few minutes to cool down. I don't know if this gentleman was going through anger management and needed to count to 10 or something, or was just having an especially difficult day, but we were more than pleasant and cheerful in all our interactions with him, which he met with sarcasm and criticism toward us. He was incredulous that we would put any items in "to go" boxes, and scolded us for ordering the tasting menu if we didn't think we were able to eat it all. I explained that I was treating my mom for Mother's Day, and that the tasting menu was the nicest item on the menu, so that it was meant to be a special occasion treat, even if we required To Go boxes. Then, when he sarcastically commented on packing up our desserts immediately rather than plating them, I uncomfortably laughed it off and informed him that the dessert was what we most looked forward to in the meal, and that we'd be eating it on-site. He seemed outraged that we "would eat dessert but take a steak To Go" and spoke angrily to himself as he went to retrieve the dessert course. It was an exhaustive, uncomfortable, and awkward exchange with him all evening, on what was to be the culmination of our visit.

Positive:
-The valet team was excellent and prompt in all interactions, no matter how early or late in the day.
-Exceptional service from much of the staff, with special shout-outs to concierge staff Kevin and Sarah, Tony the young bellhop, Aspen the pool attendant, the young ladies of the tennis gift shop, the entire reservations team, and all the spa front desk, gift shop, and locker room staff! Thank you for all that you do!
-The landscaping around the grounds was incredibly gorgeous.
-The food was absolutely outstanding! We made it a point to eat at every restaurant on the premises at some point, and were never disappointed. From J&G Steakhouse for more upscale fare, to The Tavern for delectable pub style meals, to fabulous meals at Mowery & Cotton, to exotic poolside iced drinks with quesadillas, to fancy coffee beverages at The Marketplace in the shopping area, the chefs of these areas took great care in presentation, flavor, and accompaniments. I could eat at all these locations for the rest of my life and be happy!

reviews.author: Elizabeth C
reviews.title: Much Deserved Moms Getaway/Girls Trip!
reviews.text:
My high school girlfriends & I took a girls trip to the Phoenician in March of 2020, we had a great time & a wonderful experience at The Phoenician. Little did we know Covid was about to happen, the world shut down the day we got home from that trip. We were feeling so lucky that we got that in (total last minute decision, we think it was fate) Fast forward the worst year imaginable, we decided when we were all vaccinated we’d go back! So that’s what we did. I have to also say, that on top of going through the worst year ever, we each homeschooled 2-3 children for a year. Yes, yes we did. But we’ve all been so discouraged by the lack of kindness, patience, generosity, etc.. in light of all that EVERYONE has been through since March 2020!
Here’s where it gets good: That all changed when we arrived at the Phoenician. We were very pleased with last year’s stay, but this was above & beyond.
From the moment we arrived, every single person, from the bellhop, front desk, housekeeping, had a smile on their face & a kind word. It instantly put all of us in the best mood ( we were already so excited just to be together) but it really made the whole weekend. Your staff is second to none.
Now, the shout-outs:
NOLAN & BRIAN (poolside) I don’t even know how to explain... Never without a smile, knew us by name! So attentive & so hardworking! Especially in that heat! We swear we never saw a bead of sweat on either one of them! They made our trip! In fact, we’re coming back next year, because of them!
OMAR: (towel/ H2O attendant) Give this kid a raise!
So kind, so attentive, knew our names, and definitely went above & beyond his duties! What a sweet kid & a hard worker! I run restaurants, I’d hire this kid in a hot minute.
AUSTIN: (Lobby Bar) Again, above & beyond. You are lucky to have this guy. He IS hospitality. Changed our experience for the better. So good at his job. I smell a promotion.
SIERRA: Waitress at the Tavern from Chicago.
Top Notch. She was what every waitress at a resort,
Should be. Absolutely perfect, fun, accommodating, and completely professional.
I’d steal her too. Just fantastic. 
TODD (Maintenence): We had a little shower issue, not a huge deal, but needed attention. They send up Todd. Not only did he fix it, but he could not have been nicer, or more thorough, and was just so polite & lovely. We could have kissed the guy. Another one I’d steal.😉
After all this positivity, I hate to share a negative,
But here goes... My friend & I went for a nightcap at the lobby bar, Guitar player was FANTASTIC! (Sat 5/22) but the bartender, wish I knew his name, disclosed to us, unsolicited, that he had no intention of getting vaccinated, and was a “Trumper all the way!” I believe everyone is entitled to their own political beliefs, I just don’t go there, especially on vacation, but it put a bad taste in our mouths & made us leave. Nothing to do with Trump! But a bartender at a 5 star resort, who has very happy people sitting at his bar, should go with a different approach. It’s not difficult to “schmooze” a couple moms gone wild from Chicago, having the time of their lives.
That being said, THANK YOU PHOENICIAN!
A truly wonderful experience, your staff & property are top notch! We have already booked for next year! Thank you, Thank you, Thank you!🙏

reviews.author: mabazz94
reviews.title: Amazing stay!!  No clue what the bad reviews are talking about!
reviews.text: My sister and I (we are both in our mid 20's) came here for a long weekend getaway and absolutely loved our experience here!!  The facility and grounds are BREATHTAKING.  The Phoenician spared no expense when it came to making this place beautiful.  I loved being able to chill in the pool and look up at Camelback mountain...it just doesn't get better than that!  It was exactly what I pictured a luxury desert spa to look like.  The hotel was spotless.  There was one morning when a few trashcans were spilling over from the night before (only reason why I gave 4 not 5 stars) but it was taken care of!  We stayed in a regular room, deluxe 1 king bed, and it was always clean.  The porch was incredible, I felt like if I reached my arm out I could touch Camelback.  The waiters and waitresses at the pool were so nice and VERY attentive despite the pool being pretty crowded on the weekend.  We never had to ask for a pitcher to be refilled!  The concierge was very helpful in helping us find places to eat and trails to hike.  Overall I could not have asked for a better experience!

reviews.author: michael
reviews.title: Jackhammering at 6am EVERY MORNING
reviews.text: The Phonecian advertises that they are a 5 star resort, so I booked a 5 night stay expecting a 5 star experience. Unfortunately, the hotel falls inline with 3 star hotels and the Phonecian hasn’t received a 5 star rating since 2015. Upon checking in, our front desk clerk gave us zero information on the hotels amenities and where to find them, and I also asked if the restaurant had room for us and we were told￼￼ NO they were fully committed. After check in I proceeded to the restaurant with my family to see for myself , and there was plenty of room and 3 of us enjoyed a $140.00 breakfast yum yum!  The next morning my 2 year old daughter stepped on a broken wine glass in the corridor directly outside of our door. After getting her taken care of, I immediately went to the front desk and told them what happened and was told “ we’re going to get it taken care of “ Upon our return to the room 3 hours later the glass was still on the floor outside of our room. The room itself is definitely NOT 5 star and had outdated furniture and there are visible drywall patches all over the place. The nightstands on both sides of the beds had several years worth of dust behind them and if you have allergies you can imagine what sleeping with your head 3 feet from this does for your sinuses. The hotel eventually took care of this after a few days and a missed scheduled cleaning where we left the room at a scheduled time to have it cleaned just to return hours later without it done. The pool bar service was terrible for the first 3 days, but after I complained this issue was taken care of. The biggest complaint I have is the fact the hotel did not inform anyone of the ongoing construction outside of our balcony door which is obviously unethical. Every morning we were awoken by heavy construction equipment jackhammering at 6am EVERY MORNING! I can’t tell you how dissatisfied and disappointed I am with this experience and knowing all the hard earned money I spent on it makes it that much worse. NEVER AGAIN!

reviews.author: jrwilliford
reviews.title: Save Your Money!
reviews.text: I am a lifetime Gold Marriott member. We stayed here for eight days starting on April 29th. Worst experience ever. The hotel has zero social distance at the pool. Everyone right on top of each other.   In addition we ran out of body wash and shampoo took over an hour for house keeping to show up. The people in the casitas next to us left room service items outside there door and they set there for three days!  Food reservations were impossible to get we took most of our meals outside. For the amount of money paid you are much better staying somewhere else. This is far from a luxury hotel!  We considered checking out early.

reviews.author: Cyn B
reviews.title: Don’t Believe the Description
reviews.text:
Here now. Booked a Casita in part because we like to be away from the bustle but also because the website promised parking outside of our unit. This is directly from the website:

“Casitas are opposite the main building, separated by The Phoenician Pools and Necklace lake, each offering doorstep parking.”

The “doorstep parking” is a lie. With 4 spaces for 28 units, good luck. The parking garage was a bit of a walk from our unit. To top it off, with this claim that isn’t true, they have the nerve to charge $20 a day to self park! Not acceptable.

As to the Casitas. The room is nice but the exterior appears to need some freshening. What surprised me were the small amenities. Tiny plastic cups, paper coffee cups, no cork screw. I’m accustomed to glassware, coffee mugs, etc in a high-end resort. They may be using Covid as an excuse for this, but if room service can bring glass and china I’m not sure why they can’t provide better utensils for the rooms.

reviews.author: Heidi V
reviews.title: Great place to celebrate my birthday
reviews.text: My friend and I chose to stay here for a girls/birthday weekend based off the beautiful pictures and great reviews. We were not disappointed!! Everything from the room(we stayed in a casita), pools, food, and service was wonderful!! I could not have asked for a better experience and will be back soon!!

reviews.author: Elena D
reviews.title: Wonderful Exprience
reviews.text:
This is my very first review on TA.  We travel frequently, while I rely on reviews of others, this is the first time I felt compelled to write one.   
The hotel is beautiful, the rooms are much more spacious than an average hotel room we have stayed at.  A room with two queen beds was large enough for a family of 4.  A bathroom was large too, plenty of room. 

We really liked the Food selections at all the restaurants on the property.  But if you’re interested in the Afternoon Tea or a Steak House meal, I strongly recommend making a reservation at least two weeks in advance.  The earlier the better.   

There are several pools.  There is a water slide which our 11yr old enjoyed very much.  The pool menu is also really good.  There are many choices for kids and adults.  Many specialty drinks and this particular hotel has a Sparkling Cuvée on their menu.  Good wine selection at all restaurants.  

Room service was prompt with a verity of food to order.

Grounds are beautiful, there is a Cactus Garden. The hotel offers hiking tours near the property,  the athletic club is very impressive.  

We frequent Ritz and Four Seasons during out travels.  The Phoenician did not disappoint.  We will be back for certain.

reviews.author: MjAndersson
reviews.title: In need of MAJOR remodel- not 5 stars! Not even close
reviews.text: I’m sure at some point this was a beautiful place, but it’s been decades. Just checked in and immediately checked out. It felt sooooo dated and old. It’s massive, long hallways only to get to a dated carpet stained wrinkled sheeted room. How could this possibly be 5 stars??  If felt like something between a Marriott courtyard & an old dated cruise ship. I immediately checked out & headed to the Santuary- soooo much better & no way these two hotels should be in the same catagory. Phoenician please retire- it’s time

reviews.author: 7477heatherk
reviews.title: The Phoenician Scottsdale Great but not Fabulous
reviews.text:
My husband and I vacationed here April 21-25, 2021. We had previously stayed here on vacation before several years ago and we were looking forward to returning.

Check-in:  we were able to check in early at 11:30 AM. The negative of the experience was having the registration person question our rate with our discount code since my husband is a lifetime elite platinum rewards member with Marriott. We had to go back the next day and correct the rate, which they had adjusted back up to the standard rack rate because he didn’t have his business cards with him since they were on the bag tags with the valet. That was an epic fail. 

The room: So, the rooms in the main buildings are better from a location perspective. However, the view from the fifth floor 5064 room was of a concrete roof and certainly not what we had in mind and why we stay with Marriott on business and pleasure. Epic fail # 2.

Dining: breakfast and lunch at Mowry & Cotton were better than average. They need to fix the weird break between breakfast and lunch where they “close” for 30 minutes. We said seat us now, we will order something and then wait the 30 minutes to order again. Reminded us of the stupid checkin fail. Thank goodness we don’t always comply with their plan and manage around a really stupid hour issue. Epic fail number 3.

J&G Steakhouse: This deserves a special section because it is still one of the best restaurants in all of Phoenix. Food, service, ambience, wine list and especially drinks from Abby at the bar were all amazing. My husband takes clients there regularly and is never disappointed. Our server Austin and the manager Patrick were consistently wonderful. Simply cannot say enough good things about this venue. Only suggestion would be to open up the bar at 4:30 PM for first seatings at 5 PM. We ate there three times on this trip.

Golf: The course was wonderful and this was our first time playing there. Front nine is much more wide-open and manicured than the back which is a bit crammed into the mountain side, but still very pretty. The rental clubs we had were great Callaway current top of the line clubs. Including my women’s left-hand set, which is tough to find. Food at the 19th hole Grill was very good and they did open at 6 AM with breakfast sandwiches. Staff at the course were exceptional and very accommodating and helpful. We went back to the practice range and putting three more times during our stay.

Pool area: One of the reasons we chose this property is they had one of the most spectacular swim up pool bars in the nation. That is until they tore it out a few years ago. They have three large pools to choose from with plenty of lounge chairs but it does get harder to find spots for four or more on on Saturday. Pool staff were attentive and helpful. However, they do need more servers and bar staff on the weekends. That said we simply got our drinks from the bar and enjoyed the very nice pools and had a great time with friends there.

Lobby bar area: The central gathering spot for the hotel is the lobby bar area which opens at 2 PM. They really need to change this to high noon. People are ready to drink at resorts starting at noon waiting to 2 o’clock when you’re on eastern time is very disappointing. Not a big ask, but would be a big plus for the resort. Very nice live entertainment on Thursday thru Saturday night.

Overall: they are obviously restarting up operations and have some customer service training to do. Especially for lifetime members of their rewards programs. Pay attention. That was the worst room we’ve had at a Marriott in the last 10 years. We have always been upgraded to really wonderful rooms and this was a huge disappointment.

reviews.author: Sam Petteway
reviews.title: The honest truth - I am not hard to please
reviews.text:
We arrived at 3:30pm coming from the east coast. A greeter welcomed us and took us to a check-in line. It appeared to be a busy time with only one of the three check-in desks manned. Twenty minutes later we had our room. The mini-fridge was warm so I attempted to call the front desk (but no one answered after a minutes or more of ringing). The room was nice - the view was fair, seeing the hotel rooms and a nice Phoenix horizon. Walking back down stairs, the front desk offered to replace the mini-fridge (and they did). We went to speak with the Concierge, however she was on the phone. After waiting several minutes with no eye contact, I walked away. We had dinner reservations at J&G's. We were seated in a busy area. Service was good. My wife and I  had planned to order the Tomahawk steak for two (but they were out). We got the wagyu filet. It was good but the pepper sauce over top was too powerful and the steak taste was only OK. It was a good meal although not memorable.  
We had planned to hike Camelback that first morning but the Cholla trail was closed. The location and proximity of the trail was one reason we selected the Phoenician. So we went to Old Town and rented scooters. The grounds of the hotel are exceptional. The cactus garden trail behind the hotel is spectacular. At night when sleeping the walls were thin (we had a chronic cougher in the adjoining room)  which interfered with a good nights rest. The foam mattresses are not my favorite and while comfortable initially, they retain body heat. I have slept much better elsewhere. The bathroom offered a soaking tub and a shower. Unfortunately the shower had very little water flow (even with an adjustable head). My wife and I each received two messages during our four night stay. The spa services were great! The spa pool was a disappointment in that while on top of a building, there is no view. It felt like we were boxed in at the spa pool. My wife had the best messages of her life. The other pools were nice. I appreciated the great pool side service and complementary water brought to every guest.

A beautiful facility in a perfect location. I don't know that I would stay there again. It was very good, but I did expect a little more.

reviews.author: hockeyplayer24
reviews.title: Very Nice Stay
reviews.text:
Stayed with wife and 2 young kids Mid April. First, I want to say thank you to Johanna Guzman. There was an issue with Marriott beforehand and she was proactive and we worked through the issue together and hooked us up with a Casita in the best location for a family with two young kids. 

The resort grounds are beautiful and the view of Camelback from the resort is stunning. 

Breakfast was very good at Mowry and Cotton with excellent service. 

The rooms are nice, not the nicest 5 star room I've ever stayed in, but nice and clean. Housekeeping was average but prompt. 

Pools are great, upper pool is biggest and seems to be the busiest, middle pool is adults only quiet, and the pool at the bottom is somewhere in the middle. We used the bottom pool 90% of the time being in the Casita. My 6 year old daughter LOVED the waterslide and made a few friends during her multiple trips up and down! Speaking of kids, this place is VERY kid friendly. 

The only thing I think Phoenician needs to improve on is cleanliness around the Pool area. The most important thing is GET NEW CUSHIONS!! Everyone of your loungers are stained. While you're doing this, get new towels as well. I know this is HUGE ask but those white and yellow striped things look like they have been though a laundry war. Some are stained and look like my carwash rags. 

Nonetheless, we loved our stay at your resort and would recommend you to all of our family and friends when they are in the area.

reviews.author: Arkansas B
reviews.title: Phoenician - Canyon Suites
reviews.text: Incredible 'coming out of COVID' vacation experience!! Words cannot describe the beauty of the property, the service we received and the overall experience of EVERY element here. They treated us like a King and Queen. Staff was simply incredible and bent over backwards to ensure we had an over the top experience. It started at check in with our Leader/Hostess, Amanda, she manages the front check-in area. Showed us to our room, explained ever single thing and made us feel at home from minute one. The concierge staff was simply incredible: Chase, Patrick, Brandon and I believe Steven - there are only 5 and they were ALL just incredible!!! Property is simply stunning. We ate, twice, at J & G Steakhouse, once at the bar because we just had to go back after our more formal dining room experience. Behind the bar were Abby and Robert (shoe guy!!!!)...just incredible service, attitude, knowledge.....they were the best! The only thing we would have done different is waited another two weeks to let the ending of spring break pass as it was a bit crowded and the pools were totally at capacity. Highly recommend staying in the Canyon Suites as opposed to the 'larger' property as Canyon has a much smaller and more intimate feel. Marriott, well done here! Thank you!

reviews.author: Bret B
reviews.title: Stole My $$$$
reviews.text:
I stayed at the resort from 03/18/21 - 03/23/21. I originally booked my stay through Orbitz. Despite paying for my stay 100% in advance months before our stay, at checkout, I was charged for my stay (+ incidentals) at checkout. I've called Orbitz and they provided me evidence that they paid Marriot for our stay and there is nothing they can do to assist further. I've spoken to Marriot corporate and they have acknowledged the problem. Apparently I'm not the only guest to experience this problem.

Despite regular assurances my money would be refunded, it's been almost 30 days (aka. a full credit card billing cycle) and I have yet to receive my refund.

I'm still waiting for my $5,126.06 to be refunded with no relief in sight.

The resort is beautiful, but their customer service, and sorry, their room service food quality, is worse than that of a Red Roof Inn. I wouldn't recommend staying here. I've never scene anyone so nonchalant and OK stealing $5,000.00 from a customer before. 

I guess... never trust these people with a debit card - LOL!

reviews.author: TravelingJodie
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectation in Every Way
reviews.text: We were debating between this hotel and another and ended up here.  I was a little unsure because there were some really mixed reviews.  We loved our stay and would choose to stay here again.  We were in a Casita room that was big enough for our family of four.  The bathroom was very large and we loved the big outdoor patio with chair and a dining table.  Parking was free outside the casita and if spaces were full, there was a free parking deck just around the corner.  The rooms were very modern.  We had lunch at the pool one day and the food was excellent.  We had breakfast at The 19th Hole one morning (food only ok, but nice setting) and also at the main restaurant (good).  We ate dinner at The Tavern one night, which was delicious.  The staff was very friendly by the pool.  We utilized our benefits from the resort credit and played tennis, pickle ball and, did yoga and borrowed the bikes.  Only complaint is that when housekeeping came in to make our beds and change our towels, they did not sweep the tiny bits of grass in our entry way.  Expect resort prices for everything and 20% gratuity added on everything.

reviews.author: jbritton78
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text: We had a fabulous time here! The entire property was immaculate. Everyone we encountered from pool staff, wait staff and concierge were incredibly friendly. We enjoyed the pool area a lot and although it got crowded people were spread out across the different pool areas comfortably. Our room was clean and spacious for four people. We loved it and can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: David Thielen
reviews.title: Incredible facilities, horrible service & food
reviews.text:
First off, the facilities are stunning. It’s a gorgeous building and beautiful views. The room we had was super nice with an awesome deck.

The people working here are all invariably nice.

On the negative side, the registration desk is completely incompetent. If they say they’ll do something for you, such as have your luggage sent up, assume you’ll need to call directly to have it happen.

And like all Marriot 5 star hotels, you need to call for ice and it takes over an hour to get it. (What moron came up with the stupid idea to not have ice machines on each floor?)

And the food here is awful. Everything is super overcooked and delivered lukewarm. McDonalds would be preferable to anything here.

I’ve generally found a Marriott hotel to be well run with decent food. This place is an exception to that.

reviews.author: MisstheDogs
reviews.title: Great -- with one major nit
reviews.text:
This is a terrific resort with excellent food and first-class service -- perfect for a family or adults-only vacation.  COVID protocols are enforced, which helps protect all guests.  The one nit concerns our room (details below).  

There are three large pools arranged in a tiered / terrace system.  The middle pool is adults only, which is nice for guests such as us who prefer it.  When the resort is crowded, you need to get out early to get a chair in the family pool areas -- chairs were available in the adults only section well into mid-morning.  The pools themselves are all large and never felt crowded even when every chair was filled.

Almost every person with whom we interacted was professional and friendly -- always greeting us with a warm "hello" and making us feel as it they were pleased we were there.  Even the gardeners would stop and say hi. Can't speak to the experiences of other recent reviewers other than to say that our experience in this area was very positive.

The wait staff in the restaurants is very professional (i.e., experienced servers).  Food was served promptly (but not rushed) at every meal and there are multiple options on site at all times of day and night.  The food isn't cheap but it's very good -- never had a bad meal.  Highly recommend the steak restaurant -- it's pricey but the food and service make it a worthwhile experience.   You're too far to walk to any food options so bring a car or be prepared to eat all your meals on site.

One plus is that all of the restaurants are open as is the spa.  The store that carries suntan lotion doesn't open until 9 am, so keep that in mind if you head out early and didn't bring lotion.  We did not golf or use the spa, so cannot comment on those.

The hotel strictly observes wearing of masks.  When some folks showed up at the restaurant without masks, the host gave them masks.  Social distancing is not enforced in the pool area but tables in the restaurants are well separated.  The resort seemed very clean.
