The one nit involves the casita room.  BEWARE that the pictures and description on the website of the room you actually book are NOT accurate.  For example, when you hear the word "balcony," you probably expect a railing and a room overlooking something.  Not here.  Our "balcony" room was ground floor with a fire pit.  I specifically did not book ground floor or fire pit but got them anyway -- and no balcony.

The picture of the room I selected showed a large sectional couch in the room.  Our room had no couch of any kind.  Instead, we had two very uncomfortable chairs -- they may look good but you wouldn't want to sit in them for more than 5 minutes.  And the room was MUCH smaller than it appeared on line.  

When I mentioned to the front desk person that the room were in didn't match the description of the one we'd booked (I still had the picture), the response was:  (1) "balcony" is the same thing as the ground floor, (2) the pictures on the website may not look anything like your actual room, and (3) the casita rooms are much smaller than the rooms in the main hotel [even though they are made to appear larger on the website].  In short, the front desk response was:  We don't care that our pictures and descriptions are inaccurate -- it's your fault for expecting them to be.  It was the one negative experience of our visit.

There is supposed to be free parking (included in room rate) directly in front of the building.  However, the number of places is woefully insufficient for the number of rooms.  Our lot was right across from the restaurant and spa and we saw people who weren't staying in the casitas parking there in order to be close to those amenities.  So the night we arrived we ended up having to park quite a distance away.  We moved our car the next day to an open space and never took it out again.  

The advantage of the casita rooms is that they are on the edge of the property and therefore quieter.  However, they are a bit of a hike to the main building (great if you're trying to work off the good food but not so good if you have mobility issues or forget something in your room).  They are also small, the interior furniture is useless and uncomfortable, and the decor somewhat dated.

If we return to Phoenix, we would absolutely stay at the Phoenician but would definitely choose another room category.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Masks when Arizona lifted mask mandate-bs
reviews.text:
I was Super disappointed that we had to wear mask when Arizona lifted mask mandate.  I’m a lifelong platinum Marriott member and I will never stay in a Marriott property again.  Don’t abandon half of your customer base.  Service has really slipped at the Phoenician.  The pool Service people didn’t care or hustle because they get 20% gratuity guaranteed.
Sad times.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: An Epic Desert Experience
reviews.text: My wife and I embarked on a voyage to Arizona in February of 2021 and stayed in a casita at the Phoenician.  From the moment of check in to the sad drive away, we truly had a top of the line experience.  The decor in the room is upscale and modern.  The restaurants each have their own specialty and satisfied our needs every mealtime, especially the steakhouse:) We are counting down the days until our next stay!

reviews.author: Scott M
reviews.title: Beautiful place.Terrible Service
reviews.text: If all you care about is looking at Camelback Mountain and a bunch of out dated Brass this is the place for you! The Employees all feel like you are pretty lucky to be there. Complete lack of Customer Service here. I’d literally book anywhere else but here if you appreciate service. There’s many many resorts within a few miles that do WORLDS Better service if that’s what you like

reviews.author: bigjoe950
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.text: Having never stayed in a resort before, I didn’t quite know what to expect. My wife had been to the Phoenician may 25 years earlier, and the one thing she remembered was that there was one gigantic pool. There are now five pools with one of them being adults only. This is where we spent most of our time outdoors. In our two days there we had every meal on site. Here’s a tip: we looked and looked for a good rate and finally found one that included breakfast. We had a $65 daily breakfast included, and each day we spent $58. I know, $65 for breakfast? It was quite good. The first night we ate at a steakhouse which was OK, but we get better here in Michigan. The second night we went to the same restaurant where we had breakfast. Again it was good but nothing spectacular. I recommend you stay in for breakfast and go out for your other meals. The resort was clean, and our room was updated. When you see the main building there’s no doubt it was built in the 60s or early 70s. For some reason I had a hard time getting past that, but after seeing it I got used to it. Every staff member we ran into was incredibly polite, especially our first day at the pool. One worker came up to us, took our towels, got us an umbrella, and set up towels up on our beach chairs. He was so incredibly friendly and even brought us a picture of ice water. I noticed everyone’s Ice water, including ours, was regularly refilled. You can go buy your own drinks at a close by bar, or someone walks by and you can order. Undoubtedly that costs more, but if you’re staying at the Phoenician you can afford it so we chose to just have someone bring them to us. The bed was comfortable, the shower was fantastic, and the bathroom was large. We sat outside on our small deck, if you will, and enjoyed the shade. I guess it comes down to it would you recommend someone to go there or not, and yes, go to the Phoenician. We would go back too.

reviews.author: Meghan P
reviews.title: During covid 19 this place is GROSS. Not clean at all
reviews.text:
I generally don't like to post bad reviews, but in this case, I feel people should know how disgusting this hotel is.
We looked at several hotels for my husband's 50th birthday week and chose the Phoenician. We thought with the amenities on the resort it would be a perfect family vacation. 
Upon checking in, we ran Into trouble with our key, we had to get a new key every time we left our room for 4 days.  The staff were condescending and rude.  Dinner reservations were impossible to get and the pools were overcrowded and there was zero social distancing. 
Our room had a broken toilet, broken lamps, stains on upholstered surfaces and my daughter's pillow case had blood stains on it. There was dust  everywhere proving their commitment to sanitization is merely on the posters and not something they actually do at the resort.  T
his is not sanitary during COVID 19.  We paid roughly $2000/ night for a suite with gross stains on surfaces and a purple hair in the bathtub. 
I strongly suggest you stay elsewhere.  It's not sanitary, it waaaay overpriced disgustingly dirty  and the customer service is  non existent.

reviews.author: 816FiveStarTaveler
reviews.title: Nothing compelling about this large factory hotel
reviews.text:
From a distance, we had high hopes for this property - beautiful with Camelback Mountain as the backdrop. The main lobby is grand but very dated, think 80s Dynasty/Jackie Collins-esque.  Our room wasn’t ready when we arrived at 1pm, nor was there an upgrade available despite our  Virtuouso reservation. Understandable, it’s a super busy weekend. So we went to the pool. Families jam-packed on what looked like hundreds of lounge chairs. Definitely no COVID here. Pools are small for the size of the resort even though there are numerous pools. We were lucky to get chairs, but there wasn’t an empty chair on our first pass. Overall feel is like an “all inclusive” in the Caribbean- nothing luxury or charming about this place in the least. Impossible to get service at the pool, but all servers are super nice and helpful when you walk up to the bar and order. One positive. 

We got into our room and it was pretty awful, ugly browns, overall beyond tired.  Again, this place is stuck in the 80s and needs a major face lift. Love the Byredo amenities, such a sharp contrast to the rooms and overall property as Byredo is chic, luxe and modern. The Phoenician is tired, a mass-market, non-distinct and soul-less place. 

Gym is great, the basketball court was a huge win for my 12yr old. Those two features were the highlight of our stay. 

I popped into the spa to see whether I wanted to book a treatment, but as you walk in through the massive brass (I think) doors (which are very cool and impressive) you walk into a giant marble lobby of chaos. I’ve been to hundreds of spas and this was by far the LEAST relaxing or inviting spa I’ve ever seen. There is no soothing music, the staff and even spa director are at the front desk stressing over the onslaught of guests, the stress is palpable. Staff is very friendly but you feel like you’re walking into a Nordstrom’s- busy, impersonal and masstige. 
That is basically what the overall resort is- masstige. Restaurants feel like big chains. Food is average, menus are uninventive (below average) - again, think a meal at a mall from some restaurant chain.

For the $, skip this place, overpriced mall-like mass offering.

reviews.author: Martin S
reviews.title: ONE OF THE BEST!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician has it all : Excellent rooms, great food, fantastic bars, beautiful pools, pristine golf courses, fantastic gym and exercise facilities, amazing grounds and facilities, top notch service.

No complaints at all - just praise for every aspect of our stay and this wonderful Place!  It was a treat.  It was an experience like very few can offer.

WE LOVED IT!!

reviews.author: Goducks92
reviews.title: Best stay anywhere
reviews.text: The Canyon Suites team is nothing short of amazing. I have told people to say here and we have not even left yet. Every detail goes into the friendless of this team. They did things that were not asked of them but they paid attention and could see what people wanted. I am simply amazed. Literally the whole team. I could name but thank you Jay, Steve, Sharon, Rafael and so many more.

reviews.author: AmyFK
reviews.title: Rough start, but overall a great stay
reviews.text:
We visited last week for spring break when the property seemed to be at full capacity. Although we had made the reservation in early December and reserved a deluxe room with 2 queen beds, we were told at check-in that they had no queen rooms available. So, we were put in a room with a king bed and a sofa bed. Since I have 2 teen girls who are taller than I am, we only book rooms that have 2 queen beds. We find sofa beds to be horribly uncomfortable, and this one was no exception. The only accommodation they offered at check-in was to waive the resort fee. We took the room because there were no other options, but this was a big disappointment. 

That night, we had to call to ask housekeeping to make up the sofa bed. There was no extra bedding in the room, even though they knew we would need the sofa bed. I finally asked to speak to a manager, and he quickly found a room with 2 queen beds that we could move into for the remainder of our stay. The new room was in a less expensive location, and he offered to further reduce the rate to compensate us for the inconvenience of moving during our stay. I felt like we were fairly treated and fully compensated for the problem with the room. It was unfortunate that the desk staff wasn't trained to deal better with the situation. I got the feeling they were out of practice in dealing with situations like this.

Other than this initial problem, we were extremely happy with our stay. The property was gorgeous, and every meal we had there was delicious. I would go back just to have the breakfasts at Mowry & Cotton! Some of the people who made our stay so memorable were Sharon (who took care of us when visiting our friends' cabana at the Canyon Suites), Christine (who made our day in the Phoenician cabana so wonderful), and Rachel (our phenomenal waitress at Mowery & Cotton).  

I got the feeling the hotel was not quite ready for the rush of a full spring break crowd. But they got enough right that we'll be back.

reviews.author: Jenna K
reviews.title: Not worth what you pay
reviews.text:
Note: I'm a current guest staying here & writing this 5 min into getting to my room & I would be giving 0 stars, but the property is gorgeous & half the employees were great/helpful.

I was SO excited to check in here, especially because we haven't traveled since COVID. We came to Arizona for a quick, weekend business trip. Driving in, first impressions were beautiful, huge property! Customer service upon checking in was awesome. We have been up since 4am traveling, so when our room was finally ready, we couldn't wait to get into it! Upon arrival to our room, I realized it was not what I booked. For some reason that was never explained, they changed my room without me knowing. I booked a Deluxe Casita w/ 1 King Bed & Garden View. I chose this specific room type because I brought my dog & it offered extra space unlike your typical hotel room. I also called not once, but twice to let them know I would be needing a pet friendly room & I was also told that I would be getting a ground floor unit. Now, I don't mind a different view or if I get stuck with an extra bed or even if the room wasn't ready yet. However, none of those things happened. Instead, I checked in, received my keys & got to my room which was not a Deluxe Casita, in fact it wasn't a casita at all. They downsized/changed me to a regular guest room. If I wouldn't have called to see what happened, I would have been charged for the Casita. Now I do want to mention AFTER I called to see if they would get me in the correct room I booked, they then offered a $75 off per night due to them not having a Casita available. So although I booked a Casita & called twice before, I still was not put in the correct unit. Very frustrating & honestly disappointing considering the price per night. If I wanted a hotel room I would have booked elsewhere, but we chose The Phoenician for the Casita's. Safe to say we won't be returning. So unfortunate considering how much we were looking forward to staying here.

reviews.author: Drjoneslove
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: We came here for spring break for a much needed getaway. The property is amazing and the service unparalleled! We stayed in an executive suite which was huge and had 3 balconies. There was plenty of room for our family of four with the pullout sofa and rollaway bed. The furniture was a little outdated and the bed not that comfortable so I am knocking off a star for that. Patio cushions were also dingy. Other then that, no complaints at all. We had breakfast through room service and while pricey was good. Went to the spa and enjoyed couples massages and loved the facilities. We did a lovely yoga walk around the beautiful property. Nice gym with Pelotons and bikes. We rode bikes to nearby Scottsdale waterfront and had lunch. Steakhouse was a good meal with great views. Definitely five star service and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: AlebelMercedes
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds , horrible front desk customer service
reviews.text:
I start by saying that I am a loyal Bonvoy member for over 12 years.

Beautiful property, and amazing grounds. My boyfriend and I enjoyed the spa services and restaurant by the pool. 

My only amenities concerns was the heated pool, it wasn’t heated so we could not enjoy it at night time. 

I expressed it was my birthday and didn’t receive any special attention. Unlike other Marriott resorts I’ve stayed. 

Another concern of mines was the communication of the front desk manager. I communicated with Ms. Rosie Guzman of our cancelled plans for one of the nights in our reservation, although she was very helpful and provided the waiver forms for processing I never heard back from her manager that was supposed to review the cancelation request for one of the nights I could not come due to COVID-19 related issues, it’s been since 2/13 that I communicated and I have yet to receive a response. It’s 3/6/21 today, and over $600 in charges for services not rendered. 

It’s my hopes that management reviews their protocol for communication with guests. Thank you.

Tips: get a room with pool view or golf course view because the resort view sucks

reviews.author: sumusabumom
reviews.title: 3 star masquerading as a luxury hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel is at best like a 3 star property. It's run down, has low end furniture, sub par service and cisco food in its shabby restaurants. Stayed 3 nights and the room was like a Holiday Inn room with scratchy towels, dirty /uneven flooring (see pic) and dingy overall with a terrible bathroom. The showers have constrictors in them so the water pressure is horrendously low. The hotel gym is a 5 minute walk on a street where cars wiz by, outside the main hotel in a separate building- who does that?!! And there was no one wiping the machines between users or even asking people to.

The whole place is old and tired. The service, especially front desk- with the exception of concierge Rebecca and our server Art- was indifferent and almost borderline rude. The food at the main restaurant was overpriced and below average in quality and taste.
If you are used to staying at luxury hotels, skip this one for sure. It's not luxury and not high end.

reviews.author: MsHellfire
reviews.title: I'm gonna go ahead and call it: Best Marriott Property in the US
reviews.text:
This was a truly pleasurable experience - thank you to the various members of staff who gave me a treat of a weekend.

Pre-stay: Calling the hotel for information was an area of opportunity.  8-10 minutes waiting for someone to respond - a real deterrent and not normal.

Check in: Much appreciation to the hotel for pre-assigning me an upgrade to an amazing suite.  Ryan was both professional and friendly

reviews.author: Lapsaroundtheglobe
reviews.title: Loved It!
reviews.text: Stayed at the Phoenician for the first time to celebrate my husband's 50th birthday, and loved it!  Beautiful, clean, quiet room with comfortable bed.  Enjoyed time by the adult only pool, and the serene beauty of surrounding desert views. The location was great, just a short drive to a variety of yummy restaurants.  Would definitely return again!

reviews.author: chestpain
reviews.title: Rejuvenating weekend
reviews.text:
This is our first vacation since COVID.  We both have had our vaccinations so ventured out to escape a brutal winter.  Although the hotel doesn't control the weather, we got very lucky to have an absolutely beautiful Saturday with blue skies and sunshine.  

Although we had considered staying at the FS, we are very pleased with our decision to stay at the Phoenician.  The setting, framed by Camelback mountain, is a visual feast.  The entry to the hotel and lobby cannot be captured in photos and must be seen first hand.  The hotel was packed and busy when we checked in but it was quick and easy.  We stayed in Room 1018.  It was impeccably clean, spacious with new furniture and most importantly comfortable bedding (pillows).  

The breakfast was great with friendly servers and an exceptional choices.  The quinoa bowel and caramelized grapefruit were a surprise taste sensation to the usual breakfast foods.  We did walking Yoga with Jennifer and saw the cactus garden which is incredibly unique not to mention the size and expanse of the resort.

The best part of the trip was the warm Arizona sun by the pool.  We had a cabana with a friendly, outgoing server who recommended some of the best pool food that we have had.  It is obvious that an extensive amount of time and expertise has been dedicated to ensuring the quality and variety of the food choices.

Our evening was spent at J&G steakhouse with a view of the city that was incredible.  Phoenix is lucky to have such an incredible ambassador as the Phoenician hotel.

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text:
The grounds themselves were impressive and beautiful but that's where the positive experience ended.  All in all, it's a nice property but the service was average/poor at best.  The room was just ok and in no way reflected the price per night.  Check in was clunky and the communication from the hotel rep was awful.  

Overall, it was painfully clear (and a consistent observation from other guests) that they were trying to save money by being light on staff.  The Pro Shop staff (employed by TROON) was dismissive and as my significant other stated after a brief encounter "extremely rude."   

Additionally, it took a long time to get service at the pool and even longer to actually get a drink once the order was made.  Again, we (and others) observed that it must have been due to less staff because the Hotel was trying to save money given revenue was negatively impacted by Covid.

Lastly, we had a fabulous dinner at a competing property and while dining there, saw a couple go to the hot tub on that particular property.  When my significant other and I decided to check out the hot tub at the Phoenician the next day (around 12:30pm), there was a sign saying it was closed due to Covid.   We just laughed.  The inconsistency was glaring and further confirmation that their staffing levels were cut to save money and therefore, certain amenities were not available.  

Again, the grounds were lovely but the overall experience in no way reflected the rates charged by the Phoenician and would encourage others to look at another property when traveling to Scottsdale.

reviews.author: TAMMY I
reviews.title: Just Good, not Great
reviews.text:
Some things about this resort are great and many things are average.

What was great- The Phoenician is a beautiful property, the grounds are well cared for.  Service and food  at Mowry & Cotton was excellent.   The golf course was also very beautiful and challenging .

The rest of our three day visit was very average and left us feeling like we had wasted our money.  I have never before been told "No" so many times at a 5 star resort. " No, that restaurant is closed, No, your golf clubs have not be found, No there are no openings for high tea, No the dry bar is closed, No there is no entertainment or events scheduled this week, No the trail entrance is closed."    I understand that weekdays in February is not peak time, but that is no excuse to not deliver on service and amenities when charging a luxury rate. The staff failed to recognize how inconvenient the closure of amenities are to the guest and offered us nothing but excuses.   A suggestion to management, when you close all restaurants but one, do not ask the guest if they have a reservation and then make them wait for a table because the dining room is full!

  The rooms looked tired and worn, lacking the kind of care and attention to detail you would expect for a luxury resosrt.  My spa experience was good, but again not special.  I had a massage that was very basic and disappointing for the price.  There was no management present during our stay and no opportunity to express our dissatisfaction.  Our stay was very disappointing, and I got the impression that the staff knew it and did not care.

reviews.author: saknieper
reviews.title: Heavenly Resort!!
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here from the 12/26/20 to 1/3/21.  This resort is the  best experience that we have had yet in Scottsdale.  Everything at this resort is top notch.  From the time you arrive till the time you leave, you are treated like royalty.  The attention to detail is second to none.  In this time of COVID, I  think that they did an awesome job in the protection of their patrons without impinging upon the overall experience.  I highly recommend this resort to anyone that is travelling to Scottsdale.  The food at all the restaurants is very good, and the service is impeccable. The amenities on this property are also great.  I used the gym daily, which is just as good as the one I am a member of at home. I am not a tennis player, but it looked as though the tennis facilities were awesome.  I am definitely a golfer, and for golf this place is a dream!  The practice facilities are as good as you will find anywhere!  As for the course, it is a great track, and in my opinion a tremendous value.  I have paid close to twice the green fees at other courses and not found them to be one iota better than the Phoenecian.  

In summary.....Great service, great amenities, great food, great drinks, great golf.... it's truly a heavenly stay!

reviews.author: Cparker1957
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text:
My husband surprised me with a return visit to The Phoenician for my birthday and Valentines. We had stayed here for a week over New Years of this year. The resort is fabulous, the staff so accommodating and the golf course is gorgeous and in great shape! We don’t have enough nice things to say about this hotel/resort! 
We had the pleasure of meeting Daniel Uhlry. He went above and beyond to make our stay here enjoyable! Our flights were canceled due to inclement weather in Texas! He assured us that we could stay & not have to change rooms! We had several opportunities to reach out to him & his response was timely and helpful! We were overwhelmed by his attention to detail! 
We had Valentines Dinner @ the J&G Steakhouse & I have to mention our waiter, Thomas! He was wonderful and so attentive! The food was delicious and the views were stunning! 
All of the staff we encountered were always cheerful and extended a greeting! 
Our only regret, we didn’t get to see Oana this visit! She was so sweet and friendly! Please let her know that we asked about her! 
The staff @ the Tavern was so friendly and helpful! Salvadore always greeted me by name! He knew exactly what I wanted every morning! 
We are heading home & we cannot wait for a return visit. 
I wholeheartedly recommend this resort! It is beautiful and you won’t be disappointed! 
C. Parker

reviews.author: nware1
reviews.title: Amazing Property/SubPar Service
reviews.text:
The property and grounds are amazing. Truly a step backward to days when architecture and design were not impeded by technology. 

From check-in to breakfast, many of the staff had the customer sevice of the DMV. They made it clear that they did not want to be working. Not all, there were a couple exceptions. But, this is not five star customer service that a Luxury Collection hotel should have. 

In addition, we have pipes making noises in our Casita, called the front desk to have it addressed, and it wasn’t fixed. So, we had the pleasure of falling asleep to whistling pipes...

I wouldn’t return unless the property made a commitment to have the service match the landscape and architecture. 

The General Manager should take notice. It is difficult to create a culture that truly is not in alignment with the environment.

reviews.author: Susie
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the  Phoenician.  On the third night there, there was a loud party going on next door, late at night, which woke me up....I knocked on the connecting door, to let them know, so they would hopefully quiet down, and they just got louder.  I went in the hall to knock on the door , to please ask them to quiet down, since I didn’t think they heard my original knock.  Yes, I should have called the front desk, my mistake!  To my surprise, a security guard came up within about 20 seconds, glaring at me.  Evidently, when I knocked the first time, the room next door called security on me!  Keep in mind, these were young men partying...I could be their mother, maybe even their grandmother.  I went back to my room and they did quiet down.  I got a call from the assistant manager the next morning.  He said he heard there had been a problem last night, and wanted to know if I wanted to change rooms?  I told him I would think about it and would get back with him.  I ended up going down to the front desk to talk with him.  I politely asked him, why he was asking me to move, instead of asking them to move?  He told me that the security guard agreed with the room next door, that I was the problem for knocking on their door.  He stated, since they were staying another night, he thought he’d offer to move me, so I wouldn’t have the same issue again.  By this time, I’m totally dumbfounded.  I told the manager, I’ve  been here three nights, and I’m staying one more, and no, I do not want to move out of my room into another one.  I suggested he talk with them and tell them, if they want to party tonight, they need to go somewhere else and walked away!  I was totally flabbergasted, by the assistant managers lack of support and understanding, and siding with the security guard.  The security guard knew they had several people in the room and we’re loud and had been partying.  Again, I should have called the front desk to complain, but I didn’t...my bad!  The way the Phoenician handled the situation was awful.  I travel to Arizona a lot and I can assure you I will never stay at the Phonecian again.
It was a very bad disappointing experience...bottom line...call the front desk to complain!  As you can tell, I’m still upset about it!

reviews.author: Kroll
reviews.title: Booking Dinners and Spa services
reviews.text: We haven’t stayed there yet but have already received amazing service. As reviews have mentioned to book meals before you arrive and services, we have. Valentines weekend wasn’t our choice, but as we were in town for a medical conference this location seemed the best option for the area. Open table is the preferred method for the restaurants and we were able to grab some of the few remaining for such a popular weekend. The spa you must call on the days they are open. I called on their open days but got the message service. Left a message hoping it wouldn’t take too long and Alice returned my call very soon after! I can’t wait to meet her! She helped me book services for me and my husband and gave me a great explanation of what the services were. Her suggestions on what services to book, which days based on their availability and the number of days we were staying, and even according to our dinner reservations so timing would work out perfect and suggested I could get ready there before one of our dinner nights. She seemed as excited as I was! The details she thought of and questions to ask were just so hospitality oriented. If this is your service before you set foot in the property, I am very much looking forward to our trip and stay!

reviews.author: Jaypowen
reviews.title: A wonderful place
reviews.text: I enjoyed my three days here. The pools and grounds are beautiful. The proximity to Camel back mountain is perfect for hikers. I ate at three of the restaurants and they were great. The gym is a great asset. The only problem is that many things close early. The gym closes at 6. Yes you read that correctly. 6pm ! Why? Insane when so many people work out at night. Also the marketplace/convenience store closes early also. I couldve really used a snack after 7. The surrounding area doesnt have much to walk to. If i visit Scottsdale again i may stay a little closer to the action

reviews.author: Chris32Teeth
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway During COVID-19
reviews.text:
Stayed here in mid-January 2021 (sadly during COVID times) for two days during the weekend. 
Check-in (4/5): We were able to check in early (around 1pm) and able to check in with little wait. We had booked a deluxe room in the main building and, as Marriot Gold, we were "upgraded" to a room with a garden view on the fourth floor. It wasn't much of an upgrade, but we still pleased with our check-in experience.

Parking (5/5): It was very easy to find a parking spot in the covered self-parking garage underneath the hotel. There is also valet parking, but it really isn't necessary as the garage entrance has an elevator that delivers you right into the lobby.

Room (5/5): The room was pristine. Television allowed us to stream music and was nicely sized (probably about 50''). Bed extremely comfortable. Nice balcony area overlooking Camelback Mountain with a table to enjoy a nice meal/room service at sunset. The room was exactly what I expected from a "luxury collection" hotel.

COVID-19 Protocols (3/5): Plenty of hand sanitizer adjacent to high-touch areas (elevators, etc). Most guests adhered to CDC guidelines (wearing a mask, 6 ft social distancing). Temperature check before entering the gym. Guests were less compliant in pool areas, but I think everyone was doing their best.

Fitness Center (5/5): The fitness center was incredible.  Two peloton bikes and plenty of weight lifting equipment. Nice view overlooking Scottsdale. Also, there was bike and tennis racket rental. Wasn't too busy on a Saturday afternoon and the large space of the center made it easier to socially distance. 

Pools (5/5): This is where the Phoenician really shined. There are 3-4 pools, a Jacuzzi (which was closed due to the pandemic), and a waterslide for the kids. The pools were nicely heated, open 24 HOURS and at night, had differently colored lights. 

We have stayed at several hotels in Phoenix/Scottsdale, but the Phoenician was in a class of its own. Will return when we are back in the area.

reviews.author: kgastro
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but desolate at night
reviews.text:
I just returned from a five night stay. The hotel is beautiful and clean. The grounds are pristine. The cactus garden in the back at the base of Camelback Mountain is well-maintained. The staff were all very nice. The outdoor pools were heated and the service was very good. The hot tubs however were all closed due to Covid. The only downside of staying here is that there is absolutely nothing to do in the evening after dinner except to walk around the resort. The resort is fairly isolated and there is nowhere to go within walking distance.It would’ve been nice to soak in a hot tub in the evening.  The game room was closed. Several times we tried to use the fitness center but this was also closed when we went.  We tried to use the bicycles one evening but these were also locked up. The nearby trailhead to Camelback is also closed  There is no place at all in the evening to get a quick snack or dessert. We ended up ordering one dish of ice cream from room service which cost over $20 with the delivery fee.
If you are coming here with children I would keep this in mind and bring some games to entertain them. Most of the rooms in the evening had on the TV which seems a shame in such a nice resort. An outdoor activity like a small mini golf course would’ve been nice.  We used the hotel contracted car service in the beginning which was expensive and slow but the local Uber drivers were very reliable.

reviews.author: OChome
reviews.title: Exceptional Resort, Exceptional Service
reviews.text: After having our Palm Desert vacation canceled (by the continued Covid lockdowns in California) we decided to fly to Arizona and stay at the Phoenician. What a beautifully maintained resort. We enjoyed a couples massage at the Spa, relaxing at the pool and even saw a couple get engaged on the balcony at the Thirsty Camel. The staff was phenomenal especially Christine at Mowry & Cotton. We were so impressed with her that we returned the next morning requesting her. The Phoenician was truly a breath of fresh air during these trying times. Thank you for being open and making us feel safe, we will return.

reviews.author: Kristen W
reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton
reviews.text: Great experience for breakfast- food, atmosphere, and service. Christine Lay is the absolute  best! She completely understands and  lives hospitality!!  The resort itself and its team members are making our experience unforgettable!!!!

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel & Great Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician for 5 days and I thought the resort was beautiful, very clean, and the service fantastic. They did a good job following Covid protocols. We felt very safe there.  The food at the restaurants were good, they were very accommodating to our kids, and the spa was excellent as well.  I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.title: Terrible Service and Cleanliness
reviews.text: My husband and I were visiting for our anniversary and we found feces on the side of the toilet and on the wall. We went to front desk and they said they would take care of it immediately and offered a $100 credit. We didn’t make a big deal of it and honestly, I thought we were way more understanding than most. We came back to our room 3 hours later and we’re hoping to enjoy our fire pit to find that it STILL had not been cleaned. We had to go up to the front desk and wait for them to get someone to clean it. They offered a round of drinks and another $100 credit. We were not offered another room except for a down grade, we had been traveling all day and wanted to go back to our room that we paid extra to enjoy the fire pit and did not get to use it that night due to delaying with the unclean toilet. We were told someone would call us the next day at 10 to discuss. No follow up, no apology. We asked our spa reservations to be canceled, I called the spa the next day and they weren’t canceled. I was thankful I double checked. This is terrible service for a Marriott and a hotel that claims they are a luxury hotel. To tout that they are doing extra cleaning for COVID-19, it didn’t appear they cleaned the handle on the toilet which is a high touch area. My advice, you have plenty of other options when visiting Phoenix/Scottsdale. Really disappointed. Thankfully, we decided to split out stay and the Four Seasons provided clean rooms and excellence customer service.

reviews.author: Bcapp298
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We stayed here for New Years Eve and a few days after. The hotel and grounds are beautiful and very well kept. The room was great and had a nice view of Camelback Mountain. The whole staff was always wearing a mask and super friendly/helpful. The restaurants were great, and the waitstaff was amazing. We had a great spa experience as well, they were taking temperatures prior to allowing you to get a service. Lastly the golf and tennis were both amazing. The course is in great condition.

reviews.author: mandssa
reviews.title: New Years Day
reviews.text: Stayed just 1 night. Hotel was 100% full. Lobby is stunning with many areas to sit and enjoy the gorgeous view. Family pool is a bit lower end than you would expect but the lunch there was exceptional (served bento box style). Room service dinner was awful though being 100% occupied during covid I’m sure they were overwhelmed. We had to wait 1.5hrs for the food which we were told when we placed the order. Gym is big and modern. The property is a fairly large campus, perfect for hosting events.

reviews.author: Geoffrey S
reviews.title: Garden view does not mean viewing the garden
reviews.text: We booked a garden view room and look at the golf center building.  The other side of our building does actually has a garden view. Marriott should disclose this information before I booked. I'm rather disappointed.

reviews.author: kathyhK9551WZ
reviews.title: Merry
reviews.text: I met Rebecca in the hallway and complimented the entire staff for excellent service. A few special mentions Matt at the Bell desk, Ryan at the Front Desk, Annie on the phone with customer service, Kamal with my room needs Bravo to one and all.

reviews.author: Dylan H
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Really nice stay this last weekend. Hotel and grounds were in immaculate shape and I felt the COVID protocols were adequate. The room was extremely clean and the room service staff was friendly and fast. I would recommend staying here if you are in the Phoenix area and I will most definitely be staying here again.

reviews.author: RedSeal2021
reviews.title: Pool area
reviews.text: Tabitha and Aspen!! Wow to superstars we encounter by the pool area so willing to engage with my wife and I! Very informative about the property and the area! Associates like this make a persons stay so much better!

reviews.author: Lorri A
reviews.title: Coffee and poolside needs improvement!
reviews.text:
Great resort. Staff was as expected for a Luxury Collection Resort. However, no coffee in the rooms, and the coffee in the restaurants was not drinkable. I've had better coffee at a gas station ( no exaggeration). 

The cabana that we rented had tears and the carpet was old. Everything else was very nice, but I definitely feel there is a lot more they could do to make the hotel a better place to vacation. We visited from Colorado- mainly to lay by the pool. They need more current music or upbeat classics if they are worried about music for all ages. It was like being at the pool listening to the elevator music all day. A couple people we spoke to were leaving early to move to other hotels for a more lively atmosphere. So, if you want a very quiet poolside day with elevator music.. you will love it. If not I wouldn't stay at this hotel for the pool.

reviews.author: Kristy B
reviews.title: Has the opportunity to be better
reviews.text:
I traveled over the Thanksgiving weekend so yes I expect the resort to be busier than normal and attention to details can be over looked. The concierge disappointed on several occasions. When I travel I rely on the concierge to help- that’s why they are there, right? This was my second visit to the Phoenician this year and in both visits the concierge disappointed. 

When I booked the room two months prior to Thanksgiving there was limited availability. So, I had to choose a resort view, which was fine because my last visit I had the Mountain View and the resort is so pretty. I thought that would be fine. Check the photo attached... it is a view of the driveway :/ 

Upkeep of the room was not what was expected for a luxury resort (photos attached). 

Restaurants and restaurant staff are wonderful. The nursery rhyme breakfast was fantastic. The petting zoo was a joy-filled surprise. Pool is absolutely beautiful, which is the resort view I thought I was getting!

reviews.author: michael d
reviews.title: Excellent stay - we will definitely be back!
reviews.text: My wife and I travel from NC to Scottsdale every year around Thanksgiving for a getaway before the holiday madness begins. We typically stay at the Az Biltmore (Lifetime Diamond Member at Hilton), which has been great over the years and very charming.  This year it was still closed due to Covid, so we thought we would try he Phoenician.  Boy, are we glad we did.  The property is pristine and very well kept.  And the service at every level was most outstanding.  Check-in, restaurant and pool staff, the spa, the bell hops...all are top top notch.  They also have a new gym which is super nice and pretty nice tennis facilities - - i think about 5 courts?  Golf course looked great, though i did not play.  Close enough to walk to Olde Town.  Short drive to Camelback mountain..which we did twice while we were there.  Highly recommend that for fitness enthusiasts.  All in all, we will be back to the Phoenician next year for sure.

reviews.author: MJDunn44
reviews.title: Perfect Holiday Stay
reviews.text: Family stay with our two teens for two nights over Thanksgiving, we had a nice 6th floor city view from our luxurious and comfortable room.  We especially enjoyed our Thanksgiving day cabana rental around the Mother of Pearl pool.  Rich did a fantastic job of making us feel special and attending to all our needs, many times without us asking!  Great way to balance Thanksgiving day parades and football on the cabana TV, along with being outdoors and enjoying the warm Scottsdale sun.  Also kudos to most of the friendly staff we encountered throughout the resort, particularly the valet parking staff.  I left my wallet in the car and quickly received a call to my room asking if it could be immediately delivered ...that’s great service!

reviews.author: airjo
reviews.title: Healthcare Worker Stay
reviews.text:
Thanks to the hotel for honoring healthcare workers during the pandemic so that it was affordable for us!!
We had heard wonderful things about this place and was looking forward to our stay, but there are a few things to know:
1. We had tried to make dining reservations prior to arriving and while we were there, but the line to the hotel was never answered by a live person, or when it was, we were told the wrong information. For example, we were told that their only restaurant that was open during our stay Mowry and Cotton did not offer take out. So we ate at the restaurant and they said they did offer take out. 
We also wanted to order pizza at the marketplace which was open from 4-8pm, but the front desk line said they were closed at 11am. 
2. Nursery Rhyme Breakfast- this was a buffet breakfast held in their ballroom. On the day we went, there was no petting zoo. So it was just an expensive breakfast that had the theme but nothing exciting for kids to do. We were expecting someone to tell nursery rhymes or music or something but there wasn’t. We don’t recommend this.

The pros: we want to give a shout out to Exceptional service from Gennaro for the pool side service who was attentive, accommodating and nice! He gets 10 stars!
Also Raul at Mowry and Cotton provided very good customer service to our table while also managing the bar! The two of them made our stay very nice!
Luis at Mowry and Cotton could lighten up and be nicer, then he might get more tips.

Overall, the hotel room was beautiful! Wish the spas would open. But we appreciate the opportunity to stay here at an affordable prices. Thank you for honoring healthcare workers!

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Physician
reviews.text:
Room sparsely appointed. Had to call 3-4 times daily to get room cleaned. Ordered breakfast one morning and the ONLY thing that was at least a little warm was the milk. The eggs that were ordered over medium well were runny - snotty cold. English muffins were cold and not toasted. All that for 24 dollars before a tip.
Most of the help was rude and took offense at any question . Won’t be back. 
Many many more complaints but my time is too valuable to waste. Do yourself a favor and don’t even CONSIDER the Phonecian as a possibility

reviews.author: giants7
reviews.title: Memorable and Meaningful
reviews.text:
The Phoenician  is truly a beautiful resort and rest assured IMMACULATE!  Heartfelt thanks to the staff for making our 10 day stay so memorable. ⭐️Erick Ekener, the front desk manager was attentive and very professional. He made sure that our accommodations were what we expected and they were perfect!  It was evident that he took a lot of pride in his work. We appreciate all that he did to make our stay so pleasant. ⭐️Lovely Lillie, the hostess at Mowry & Cotton had outstanding people skills and we looked forward to seeing her every morning. ⭐️Breakfast served by Christine Lam was always a treat. Because of her charm and efficiency, we would always leave the restaurant smiling. She could not have been nicer or more attentive. ⭐️Jordyn, who worked by the bar, located near the front desk - was always accommodating and extremely pleasant. The concierges- ⭐️Jamie and ⭐️Shannon were well informed and gave us great information . Hooray , for all ⭐️the gentlemen who tended to our car. They were the friendliest and most efficient valet staff that my husband and I ever encountered. 
These were just a few of the people that made us feel extremely welcomed and comfortable at the Phoenician.  
     There was so much to see and do on the premises!  The grounds were beautifully maintained. The golf course was in pristine condition. The walking paths were lovely to stroll through. The pools were enjoyable. Off premises , but not so far away , there are many wonderful golf courses and great restaurants. We even spent a day in Sedona. The Phoenician is situated in a perfect location - In fact, the Phoenician is Perfect!

reviews.author: Blair
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: We had such an amazing experience at The Phoenician! The property looks incredible and I loved what they did with the new renovation. We ate lunch at The Phoenician Tavern and was so impressed with the service. Our kids had a blast and so did we! Everyone we came into contact with was so sweet and professional...thank you all! We will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Jill
reviews.title: High Tea
reviews.text: Amazing as always!  Been doing this for 25 years! You will love this!  The service is impeccable! The live music and ambiance are so impressive and the food is the best I’ve ever had for a tea time and I’ve done high tea around the world.

reviews.author: Berling's Eldest
reviews.title: Lovely Resort that adheres to Covid safety protocols.
reviews.text: We visited the resort for a week in early November and enjoyed our stay.  The grounds and pools were lovely.  The resort is a five minute drive to old town Scottsdale.  We ate several good meals at Mowry and Cotton.  The staff is doing their best to adhere to Covid protocols.  Our room was sparkling clean and everyone wore a mask. Guests must also wear a mask when working out at the fitness center.  I didn't workout there because of this -- I just sweat too much in the mask to be comfortable.  It was also annoying not having the convenience of room service and that the steakhouse was closed, but none of the foregoing is management's fault.  Given the pandemic, we were just ecstatic to be able to enjoy a short vacation, so whatever measures need to be put into place for everyone's safety is fine with me.  We will be back.

reviews.author: Lindsay
reviews.title: Room without a view...
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel with gorgeous grounds. Pool staff and valet service were excellent. Good food on site, enjoyed several small plates at Mowry and Cotton and loved the shrimp at the Thirsty Camel. Rooms are beautiful and newly remodeled. 

The only reason I cannot give five stars was our first night. We paid extra to book a Grand Deluxe room specifically for the nice view. The website says the room class "overlooks either our relaxing shimmering pool or one of our lush golf courses." After a long day of traveling, we arrived to a view of the air conditioner and concrete (see pictures). The front desk could not move us until the next day. I asked how we could remedy the fact that I paid for a room with a view for 4 nights but was only receiving this for 3 nights. I was told this was a room with a golf course view (??) and if I wanted a different view then I should have requested it. No apology, no efforts to make up for this. For a luxury hotel and at that price point, it was a very disappointing way to arrive and unfortunately left us with a bad feeling for the rest of our stay.

reviews.author: OkieTraveler86
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - Perfect Location
reviews.text:
I am not sure where some of the hate comes from. I guess some people have unrealistic expectations. This is the nicest resort/hotel I have been to. Everything was first class, from the bellmen, to the front desk, to the restaurant and pool side servers. Sure it was annoying that the steakhouse was closed, and some of the restaurants had strange hours/limited menus, but that was expected during this COVID time. Cut them some slack, they are typically working with over 1,000 employees and they are currently running on half of that, so things are different. 

You cannot beat the location and the access to Downtown Scottsdale (for a $5 Uber ride) with some of the best restaurants in the entire city. Spa is amazing, tennis courts, pickleball courts, golf course, it was all beautiful and incredible. If I had only one complaint, it would be that the spa prices are pretty steep even for resort pricing. $200 for a 50- minute message plus a 20% tip built in is a bit over the top.  But I understand once the remodel was completed on the Spa they probably had to increase pricing. As far as customer service goes, it was above and beyond. Toward the end of our stay I asked the front desk to email me a statement of charges, I noticed somebody had charged $350 to our room from the lobby bar where we never even spent time at. I called the front desk, told them there must have been a mistake, they called me back in 5 min, told me how sorry they were, and it was immediately removed. Mistakes happen, it is how well they are handled that sets places apart, and this was handled VERY well.  Either way, my wife and I will definitely come back, and hopefully bring our kids next time. They do have a cool kids splash pad and slide for the little ones.

reviews.author: Elisa G
reviews.title: Their accounting system and service is horrible!
reviews.text: I paid for a dear friend who lost her husband to stay at the Phoenician for a night. I signed to authorize payment. I then called the next day to ask a question and the person, Bree, very nicely helped me and said the total charge for the room, including resort fees and taxes was $445.16--$49.02 less than originally anticipated. I asked if she was sure that was the total and she said absolutely. I later saw an additional pending charge for $113. I called and was told it would drop off. I confirmed the $445.16 was my correct total and was told yes, it was. Then, $49.02 showed up pending on my acct. I called and was told it would drop off. I talked with their supervisor, Andrew, and he confirmed. Today, the $49.02 was charged against my account. I called again. Rosie told me that she would have to look into it. Suddenly, it wasn't so definite. She talked with her supervisor and said that person would call me in twenty minutes to discuss. I said I didn't need another call--just email me confirmation that it's being credited back, as promised THREE TIMES. More than three hours later--no email. Appalling service and accounting. As an aside, my friend also has pending charges that don't match her records.

reviews.author: Mishka
reviews.title: lovely experience, sometimes misses the mark
reviews.text: for the price and the stars I expect excellence. this experience was an A-. room was dated and needed paint. service at first was lacking, i.e., waited over 45 minutes for our luggage to be delivered. that said, the beds are incredible with Frette sheets. the food was excellent. staff was gracious.

reviews.author: Lynda H
reviews.title: Far Exceeded Our Expectations!
reviews.text: I wanted to take my Daughter and Son-In-Law for a long weekend in the sun, and we chose this resort. From the moment Glen checked us in...we knew we made the right choice! The rooms were well-appointed and sterile, and Maria and her housekeeping team made sure we had all the amenities! Nolan, Claire and Daphne made sure we were hydrated and fed at one of 5 pools, and Christine at Mowry & Cotton was always so attentive and fun...and the food is delicious! I cannot wait to return...for a longer visit!

reviews.author: boludo8
reviews.title: Amazing service by Christine at Mowry & Cotton!!
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying at The Phoenician this past week on a business trip and the hotel and grounds were immaculate. We also had the pleasure of having Christine as our server for breakfast numerous times at Mowry & Cotton. The food was great but her service is what made it. She professional and polite and had a great table side manor. She remembered our names each time we came into eat and we felt safe and comfortable despite the pandemic that is going on. Request Christine as your server and she won’t disappoint!

reviews.author: Elanna and Tyler
reviews.title: Incredible stay at the Phoenician!
reviews.text:
We decided to continue with our honeymoon in Phoenix (instead of the Maldives) and were couldn’t be happier with our decision! 

Christine was our waitress at Mowry and Cotton and she was absolutely fantastic! She had our drinks and food out quickly and made sure everything tasted fantastic. The entire staff at the Phoenician has made us feel safe during this time! We received the best service of our life here and felt like royalty. This place is a MUST STAY.

reviews.author: Drew N
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Had breakfast at Mowry & Cotton this morning and Christine was amazing. She made our experience extra special dining with our 3 kids. The food was great and felt really comfortable at the resort amidst Covid. This was our 2nd meal at this restaurant at the Phoenician and we were impressed both times. Will come back for sure.

reviews.author: Jia Zelaya
reviews.title: Absolutely Delightful!!
reviews.text: I dined at Mowry Cotton and had the pleasure of meeting such a phenomenal person! Christine Lam was perfect. In spite of the crisis the world is going through, she kept us uplifted and transferred her positive energy unto us. She had us laughing and made our dining experience so much more pleasurable.Great personality!1 Exactly what we all could use right now. Service was on point 10/10.

reviews.author: Jia Z
reviews.title: Perfection!!!
reviews.text:
Let me start with!! WOW! I dined at Mawry Cotton and had the absolute pleasure of encountering some of the most polite,professional, fun, energetic servers, EVER! I had breakfast and Jeff Gascon, whom is a Manager went over and beyond to make sure my experience was pleasurable. He is a sweetheart and on top of it all!! Thank you Jeff!! I really enjoyed my time! 

Tiffany Zelaya

reviews.author: Nathan W
reviews.title: Excellent service and safe visit
reviews.text: Our server Christine at the Mowry and Cotton restaurant at the Phoenician Resort was absolutely amazing! She made us feel safe during our visit and experience and was very helpful. Thank you Christine!!

reviews.author: czginger
reviews.title: Ladies n Dolls luncheon
reviews.text: Christine was a friendly n prompt server. The food was fabulous. I had the Benedict n an Arizona Sun carrot juice. I highly recommend both. The view of the pool area was lovely. I will be back! Thank you.

reviews.author: NNUZZI
reviews.title: MOWRY & COTTON RESTAURANT
reviews.text: We are on our first morning of our stay and we visited the restaurant and the food was excellent. Our server was even better than the food. Her name was Christine Lam. Her conversation was blended in with her excellent service.

reviews.author: Paul G
reviews.title: Outstanding Service
reviews.text: Every morning we would eat at Mowry & Cotton and had excellent service from Christine that we would only sit in her section because she was to attentive to our needs and knew what we were thinking even before we did.  Her personality was such a pleasure and professional at the same time, that is probably why she has been there for over 15 years.  Definite will look up Christine when I return.

reviews.author: Eric Lasher
reviews.title: Mowry and cotton
reviews.text: Christine was fantastic! She answered any and all questions we had. She was great about taking our orders and suggesting the favorites! We felt very safe and really enjoyed our first experience here!!

reviews.author: Macey T
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Chriatine at Mowry&cotton was amazing! She went above and beyond for both of our services! Remembered our drinks and that we were here for a birthday! We will definitely be back to enjoy the sun and food!

reviews.author: Kayli McBride
reviews.title: Best Time Ever!
reviews.text:
We loved our stay. Despite everything going on with COVID, etc. we felt very safe and felt they used all the precautions while still making it a fun and relaxing vacation to remember. We will definitely be back!!

One person who made our stay so enjoyable was Christine at the Mowry + Cotton Restaurant. She was amazing and providing great service!

reviews.author: Jennifer Z
reviews.title: Friendly service and extremely clean
reviews.text: Christine, Alan, Aseel at Mowery and Cotton restaurant were phenomenal people and provided excellent service. Cannot wait to have another excuse to come back and visit. Food and service were second to none. Myron the bartender is a consummate professional and most welcoming.

reviews.author: Shay B
reviews.title: Moms 70th Birthday
reviews.text: My sister, mom and I planned a girls weekend for my moms 70th birthday to stay at the Phoenician. We arrived Saturday morning for a full spa day and were welcomed with champagne and strawberries by the pool. All the services in the spa were some of the best we have ever had and the spa itself is beautiful. The morning we left, we ate breakfast at Mowry &Cotton and had Christine as our server. I HIGHLY recommend requesting her. She is by far the best server I’ve ever had. She anticipated our needs before we even did. We never had to wait for anything and she was so friendly and fun to chat with. We told her it was my moms birthday and she brought out an absolutely delicious desert with a birthday candle for her to blow out. It was such a special weekend for all of us!

reviews.author: Kristie W
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience at the Phoenician!
reviews.text: The grounds and landscaping were gorgeous, pools clean, and all the employees were very friendly and appreciative of people being there. Everyone we met, Christine and Kyle @ Mowry & Cotton, Max @ Tavern, Reggie and Rich @ the pool, and tons of others that I wish I had written down all their names. They made our experience and vacation so relaxing and memorable.  Christine and everyone went out of their way.  All the restaurants were so delicious and very clean. In the midst of this virus time, they are doing everything to keep everyone happy and healthy. We will most certainly be back!

reviews.author: Delighted Customer
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
I just finished a 3 week stay at The Phoenician. I can't say enough good things about the hotel. In a time when even hotels like the Ritz-Carlton are drifting towards seedy, The Phoenician stands out as a shining star.
Incredible privacy, respect, courtesy, and everything is just easy.  Also, the rooms are huge, spotless andstaff readily available, but non-intrusive. 
I also frequented the restaurant often and found the servers and order takers to be amazing. Particularly Christine Lam stands out.  She has the patience of a saint and a steel trap for a mind and will remember your each and every whim and desire.

reviews.author: roberta24
reviews.title: Incredible!
reviews.text:
Everything at the Phoenician has been absolutely wonderful. The service is top notch, the rooms are comfortable and clean, the pools are beautiful and refreshing. 
We ate breakfast at Mowry and Cotton, a restaurant on the premises. Christine was the most helpful server we’ve ever had! Went above and beyond for every little thing. And we ate there several times, the food was delicious! I especially loved the brioche French toast and the egg white frittata. 
The pools were like paradise! So very clean, and just exactly what I wanted for some relaxation. Tabitha was especially helpful in getting us towels, drinks, umbrellas, and answering all our questions about nearby attractions. She inspired us to go climb Camelback mountain, and I’m so glad we did!
The men at the valet desk were amazing- they would literally run to go get our car and have it up front within seconds. They even had security turn on the lights for us to play some late night pickleball! 
I can’t emphasize enough how CLEAN every little thing is, I see people cleaning all over the place. Plus everyone wears masks, and there are hand sanitizing stations at every corner.
The gym was wonderful- so clean and modern. They even have 3 pelotons which was awesome. The gentleman working at the gym was helpful and friendly. We used a couple of their beach cruiser bikes and had a great time riding around.
I just wish I could’ve stayed longer and had time to use the spa! Hope I can come back again soon.

reviews.author: Halley S
reviews.title: Phoenician Scottsdale
reviews.text: Absolutely FABULOUS!  Christine at Mowry & Cotton is THE BEST!  She truly goes above and beyond to ensure you are well taken care of.  She made every breakfast an absolute treat.  Tabitha at the pool was extremely helpful and friendly as well.  She gave us fabulous tips on how to hike Camelback successfully.  LOVED our stay!

reviews.author: Filomena O
reviews.title: Super sweet
reviews.text: Christine was so sweet. Breakfast was great and delicious. The service from Christine was amazing, always smiling and went out of the way to make sure everything was perfect. We will be back for sure. Restaurant was super clean.

reviews.author: Han L
reviews.title: An excellent destination resort
reviews.text:
Mark and his team (a huge thank you shoutout to Moira) runs such a tight ship. We are from San Francisco, and we like to just fly into Scottsdale, check into this sanctuary, and spend the entire week without having to leave the place. Its excellent hardware aside, what hotels make this place shine is the excellent, dedicated team that runs this place like an absolute pro despite the challenging circumstances. We cannot wait to be back.  

P.S. Their bed is insanely comfortable!

reviews.author: Mirna
reviews.title: Vacation from Houston with my husband
reviews.text: Amazing hotel. I had traveled  around the world and my first time in Scottsdale, this is a excellent scape during this pandemic time. The guidelines by CDC are accomplished completely, making us feel safe and relax. Every staff is wearing  the mask, proper social distance used, the staff very very polite and all area is clean, perfect landscaped , the staff  accomplished all measure time make us feel in our home. In the pool area they classify the space appropriately to make us feel safe. The restaurants with excellent food, the rooms with all measure for COVID-19. I wish all in need to relax after this pandemic and lockdown for the COVID came here to relax feel safe and enjoy this wonderful place in our own country, in our back yard, Arizona. Thank you for your hospitality. We are here with a friends Mr and Mrs Tavarez and us, Mrs and Mr. Velasquez and we promise to come back soon. Ruben is one of the staff in the adult pool. Great and amazing, dedicated to his job, making all guess feel in our home. Thank you Ruben to make our vacation exceptional because alway he is willing to help.

reviews.author: Chanie S
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text:
Great service -special thanks to Lavender at front desk check in Labor Day hectic , Reuben at the pool went out of his way above and beyond in the Extreme 115 heat to make all comfortable 
COVID precautions followed even with crowds

reviews.author: The T Couple
reviews.title: Amazing, covid 19 safe and beautiful hotel
reviews.text: I am so impressed with the measures, guidelines and social distance applied in this gorgeous and impressive hotel. I have visited hundreds hotel around the world and this is the most beautiful and excellent staff we ever been. Thank you for care about the guess the way you do it. Your landscaping and well maintained room, gardens, commons area, restaurants and pool areas make us forgot the pandemic. Definitely we will be back soon. Christine as a waitress, Gabriel and Johanna at the front desk make the guess feel confident and a peace during this difficult time the world is having. Andres at the Thisty Camel go beyond of our expectations in attention, kindness and care during our time at the hotel. Ryan in the front desk always polite and ready to help at any question. As a American, worry for the COVID-19 recommend to Scape for couples day here at this paradise located in our own back yard, USA.

reviews.author: wpbkc
reviews.title: The Personal Touch!
reviews.text: This is, of course, the premier hotel in the Phoenix area.   But what also sets it apart is the personal touch offered by the staff.  Anthony at the bell stand could not have been more helpful, and greeted my wife and me by name every day.   You just can’t beat that.  This is the place!

reviews.author: TravelGalBT
reviews.title: Beautiful property, uninformed staff; no mask wearing
reviews.text: Was very excited to stay here - it was our first visit and were meeting my son and daughter-in-law.   Because we are titanium elite with Marriott they said we would get a special and upgraded room.   Room WAS nice but also the exact same room my son got and he's stayed at Marriott once or twice in his life.  Sort of irritating.   The grounds (pool, drive, golf course and view) were all amazing and all rooms were large.  My son's room had a water leak so they had to move after one night.  Our room had large black bugs that looked like roaches but I can't say for sure - - I told them at the desk and the girl sort of looked knowing and said after you check out we'll send someone up.   The shops were delightful and everyone there were nice and friendly.   Pool area was beautiful but they apparently never cleaned.  At 9am when we were there one morning there were drinks and half eaten food everywhere.  Very gross.   When it was clean it was gorgeous.   My biggest problem was there was so much wrong information given to us.    Front desk guy (Ryan) said there shouldn't be any reserved seating at the pool as the place was mostly empty.   Checked again the next day as the sign was still there.   Still told - NO there is not reserved seating.   That day was accosted at the pool by Shane who said we weren't allowed to sit by the pool as it was only for cabana people.  Not very friendly although he did say the people at the front desk were at fault.   Also not very helpful at the pool area - Sarah - who took over 45 minutes to get the drinks we ordered and then blamed it on us (she couldn't hear us - so why didn't she ask).     Rather than make a scene, we just left without our drinks.  A positive at the pool was Eddie - super nice and made us feel welcome.  Final issue - -  masks are mandatory indoors at all Marriotts and indoors in Phoenix.   I HATE them beyond all reason but wear them if I have to do so.   Huge signs everywhere in the hotel that you MUST wear a mask, but as our 5 day trip progressed, less and less people had them on.   I asked at the front desk and was told that "we are not the mask police" - - it was obvious from the bar on the Saturday night we were there that there was no social distancing, no masks, people all over each other.    If that's fine then I think they should just take down the mask signs and ignore it.    Either way even with all the issues the hotel is gorgeous and rooms are well furnished and comfortable.   A/C was a little warm but it was 111 degrees outside.   If you love golf and mountains, stay there!   We probably won't be back for quite a while but only because we love urban hotels.

reviews.author: Robert H
reviews.title: Lockdown Rescue
reviews.text:
Y’know.

Lockdown is not easy. And one of my boys and I escaped California to the Phoenician in Scottsdale. The wife saw an opportunity for one of us to indulge in playing some high quality soccer and the other to err... accompany him on the way. Look, I know my place. He did brilliantly - my job is to provide food and shelter. So, after one evening of great soccer, all I had to do was get Food to my boy. Well, Uber Eats let me down. But Brian at the Thirsty Camel sorted my boy out with an impromptu strawberry milkshake and a couple of orders of prawns. Alkyrie, too, has looked after me, even as the rest of the hotel is on semi-lockdown.

Look, it’s hard. You can’t have everything open. The Phoenician does it right with hand sanitizer everywhere and constant wiping down of surfaces. But in the end, you rely on your best people.

I’ll come back here in better times because they made the best of the worst of times.

reviews.author: 1LJ
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: Private Balconies, comfy beds, convenient parking, with a beautiful golf course, large gym area, ultra lux spa, and 8 pools to choose from that are open 24 hrs a day. It was the perfect getaway. I look forward to going back.

reviews.author: The_Travel_Family
reviews.title: Family Arizona Vacation
reviews.text:
I decided to book this hotel as I had stacks of Bonvoy points to use.

Firstly this hotel is very nice, however it is definitely not luxury.  

As others have said the rooms are great but nothing to shout about, very spacious and clean with a large balcony.

As I am a Bonvoy Titanium Elite member I got a breakfast voucher each morning to use at the Tavern, this deducted $37.95 off the bill which was great for me as I travelled with my family. Don’t forget about the 18% service charge. Service was always very good, staff were very attentive and prompt.

Pool areas were great, the kids area/slide was attractive to us for our young kids to use. We thought the towel staff lacked, as some days they laid towels for people and other days they didn’t, we never had our towels laid once during our 4 day stay. The complimentary bottled water/ice buckets was great.

We did not eat or drink by the pool, our breakfast was so big we didn’t need lunch and even though I can afford, it paying the sky-high prices just doesn’t make sense to me. $15-$20 per alcoholic drink plus 18% service charge is just not worth it.

There was a movie played one night (Lion King) in the pearl pool, where they have an inflatable movie screen on the water. We thought this was great so the kids could swim whilst watching the movie.

Be prepared to pay 18% service charge for everything.

$40 per night resort fee that does not benefit families with small children at all. The hotel should change this to include things for kids. For example, the bicycle rental only catered for adults as the bicycles were one size. Maybe include $$ towards food/drinks by the pool? Or include parking in the resort fee??

$20 for overnight parking but during my visit the parking barrier was always open so we never paid this as anyone could just drive in and park for free.

Check out downtown Scottsdale for some great eateries at very good prices.

Overall its a great hotel and the best location of Phoenix. I would recommend.

reviews.author: txgrl011
reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay, but expected a bit more in certain areas
reviews.text:
I'd actually give this hotel 3.5 stars if I could. 

The good:
-Property is beautiful with very spacious rooms
-Staff is really helpful -  I really want to acknowledge how amazing the pool staff was. They were friendly and quick, which is admirable considering they're working in 115 degree heat with masks on.
-The pool food is pretty good, as well as The Tavern and the drinks/staff at the lobby bar, Thirsty Camel.  (The other hotel restaurants were closed).
-Location is amazing

The bad:
-Considering much of our trip was spent lounging at the pool, we had some complaints with it. The music was awful and way too loud (and we are young and still like to have fun, so that's saying something). It was mostly bad Top 40 hits  (think Britney Spears), blaring so loud that no matter which pool we went to, it bothered us. You couldn't even focus on a book, and even putting in our airpods did not drown it out. This is not a party pool, so it was definitely odd that this was their choice of music. 
-The alcoholic beverages at the pool were SO weak. Unacceptable since they're charging you $15-22 for one drink. We tried two different margaritas and also a vodka drink, and seriously did not taste any alcohol. We gave up and saved our money.
-The rooms are bit outdated and could be a bit nicer for a luxury resort. It was very standard and nothing stood out about it. The bathroom could've been better stocked for having no housekeeping due to Covid, and also our towels had some stains on them.  The bathroom was huge but so HOT... no air conditioner vents in there and the air did not travel into the bathroom properly. 

Overall, I would only stay here again only if I had a really good rate.  We paid $250 a night, but I wouldn't want to pay more unless they could improve on some of these items.

reviews.author: Buxton2008
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text:
Everything about this resort is perfect. Service is with extreme respect and clear desire to please..
We traveled here even with Covid being a big issue in AZ but this resort did everything right to protect us but still offer us plenty of amenities and make sure we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Nicki F
reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: Fun time. I don’t know it forced me to leave a review that’s at least 200 characters but I came here for my 30th birthday with a few friends and it’s a good resort I’m glad I went! I think this is long enough.

reviews.author: BaronFunkhauser
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: After Covid cabin fever, we traveled to The Phoenician for a week to celebrate a friend's birthday. The location is perfect for dining or shopping in downtown Scottsdale. We had a gorgeous Camelback Mountain view, the staff is A+, and lying by the pool at night was magical.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.title: Not Going Back. So Crowded. No follow through. Pressure to Get Chairs, Meals.
reviews.text: Hotel is pretty. BUT, I went once, not a good experience. Then, gave it another try. More not good. Shoulder to shoulder for upscale but mediocre brunches, mad pre-dawn dash for pool chairs (good luck getting one), chaotic press for inclusion in oversubscribed activities. Not a resort for tranquil time away.

reviews.author: Joe H
reviews.title: Great Stay.
reviews.text:
I am a Ambassador Elite and spend majority of my life in a Marriott. I really have never seen a staff more engaged and friendly than what I witnessed this weekend. 

I especially want to recognize Heather at the Adult pool. Any company in America would be honored to have her as an employee. 111 degrees out and she is just go go go always with a huge smile. 

Hard hard worker, friendly, responsive, always addressed us by name. Just a pleasure to be around. Kept me in Perrier all day and my wife in skinny Mojitos. 

Also I think Brianna? Whoever was FRont desk Supervisor Friday afternoon. I had an issue with my room and she could not have tried harder to resolve it for me and make sure I was good. 

Thanks for the great weekend. Joe and Heather.

reviews.author: Jochen2
reviews.title: Pool cation with kids
reviews.text: Despite COVID scare we opted for a family pool cation at this one of our favorite resorts in Scottsdale. Having visited previously, this time one could feel the impact of the current pandemic: just reopened mid-June the 2 major restaurants are still closed, the only full service restaurant is currently the Tavern by the golf course, just a short walk from the pool area. The food there was really good, the staff very friendly and accommodating. The Market Place for coffee and snacks is open and a great place to go with the kids. Pools are fabulous, including the water slide for the little ones. The Spa reopened on July 2nd. The whole staff is doing a great job to follow all necessary guidelines to keep guests safe. With the main restaurants closed we resorted to a few dinners via delivery service with all the fabulous restaurants close by not a problem. We all had a good time and will come back for sure. Compliments to the management to keep the ship afloat!

reviews.author: Ed H
reviews.title: Luxury at a beautiful location at reduced cost
