reviews.text: We have fallen in love again with the Phoenician. The immaculate grounds and the warm, welcoming staff make this resort a top of the list choice for our family. Even with the COVID restrictions, the staff was always helpful, courteous, and welcoming. Under ground parking was great and the location of pools, restaurants was great.  We would definitely go back.

reviews.author: jasman79
reviews.title: Brief but lovely honeymoon!
reviews.text: The hotel took wonderful care of us on a brief honeymoon. Great upgrade to a suite with a fireplace outside. Thank you for the bottle of champagne! Service was great, restos really good. Really a beautiful hotel!

reviews.author: Herman H
reviews.title: A quick getaway to relax
reviews.text: This is our second stay with the Phoenician / Canyon Suites and I can't help but appreciate the exemplary service I received to help book a getaway for my wife and her friend. Chelsea and the Ambassador team, along with the front/back of house all were excellent in ensuring all aspects of our stay were taken care of.  We will definitely be back and it's so nice to see the consistency of the service and attention to detail. I commend the entire staff for their customer service and hospitality.

reviews.author: Shreder
reviews.title: 10 days in Phoenix
reviews.text: We just stayed that this resort for a few days.  We have nothing but praise to say about our entire visit.  The entire staff are very well trained, very friendly and go out of their way to please you.  The rooms are very clean and well appointed with comfortable beds.  Also, the pool area is extremely well manned and maintained.  The entire grounds are in perfect condition.  The rooms are pricey, but you will not be disappointed.  We are planning to return.  Enjoy!!!

reviews.author: jworkman67
reviews.title: A relaxing weekend
reviews.text: This was a great weekend we had booked a hotel had the chenge due to issues with thier cleaning. We decided to change to  the Phoenician and were pleasantly surprised by the service they will do what ever is needed to make you happy. The breakfast is wonderful and we highly recomend it. Ask a question about the hawk that is on site very intresting enjoyed talking to the man who trianed the bird. The front desk staff top notch! I would stay here again for sure. The property is beautiful and a plaeasure to walk around we do not play golf but enjoy the walking trials. thank you all so much for making our trip so enjoyable!

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and amenities, very friendly staff!
reviews.text: Stayed with my girlfriend for 3 nights in the beginning of March. The facilities are clean and beautiful and the staff was so helpful and nice! We had an absolutely amazing time. The concierge helped us coordinate a day trip to Sedona as well as spa appointments. We would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Lorie W
reviews.title: Did Not Disappoint
reviews.text: We spent two nights at the Phoenician in a casita.  It was so enjoyable!  The room was large with comfortable beds and nice furnishings.  The closet was spacious enough for our luggage and clothing.  The bathroom was large with two sinks and good lighting.  The shower was quick to get hot and had great water pressure.  The sinks took about 4 mins to get hot.  That's a long time to wait for hot water and a lot of wasted water.  Everyone from the concierge, to the valets, to housekeeping was friendly and helpful.  The grounds are lovely and well-maintained.  The location is great!  The Camelback mountain is beautiful and Old Town Scottsdale is just down the street.

reviews.author: Terry d
reviews.title: Golf
reviews.text: We have an Arizona Troon card and try to play all the Troon courses in the valley at least once every year. The Phoenician course while in very good shape was just ok. The front nine is basically flat and mostly not memorable. The back nine gets a bit more interesting. We paid the highest price of all Troon courses we played. If you are staying at the resort it is convenient but there are better options close by.

reviews.author: Brenda S
reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: Severs in all bar and restaurants awful except pool bar - went to steak house and lobby bar and waited an hour before asked if I wanted a drink or a second, not even crowded figure it out ...review is asking me to write so many letters to post  - lame

reviews.author: Tommy
reviews.title: Hiking Camelback
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is one those old school luxury resorts. The location is perfect ( at the bottom of Camelback) the grounds are impeccable and the amenities are excellent. From the golf course to the spa, tennis and new work out facilities the Phoenician is tough to beat. 
The Casitas lack drive up appeal and are a little dated but the beauty of the manicured landscaping and scenic view of the mountains make up for it!

reviews.author: Sally R
reviews.title: excellent stay with event
reviews.text:
The rooms are very large with every eminity.  Robes and slippers, every bath eccessory and the beds were very comfortable.  The bathroom was one of the largest I have ever been in, with even a vanity in the outside area of this over sized  bathroom!  
In addition to the large indoor space, the outdoor patio area is also a nice size, with a coach and table and chairs to enjoy the sunrises and sunsets.  The beauty of the lobby, restaurants and pool area was so appreciated.  A very good spa, one of the largest  gyms and my husband loved the golf course.

reviews.author: MikeCo55
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Stayed five nights, hotel is superb, pool areas are great, all with over the top service,would highly recommend.  On site dining choices are great as well, suggest the steakhouse which has a great view

reviews.author: OttawaCurler
reviews.title: Beautiful property and good service
reviews.text: Stayed for a few days on a conference.  While a very expensive place it sure is nice.  Staff was good and rooms were really nice.  The rooms looking out on the mountain do not get any sunshine but are very quiet.  Pool was pretty cold but it was late February.  Lots to do in the area.

reviews.author: Deb62013
reviews.title: Beautiful but not sure its Worth $$$
reviews.text:
Don’t Get me wrong hotel is beautiful. But it’s not class 1A service. There’s no concierge floor. Most of the staff is well trained however the concierge failed us twice. Shannon did not return emails about getting restaurant reservations which this time of year is difficult. Then when I checked in and spoke to Jamie  they still weren’t able to secure make reservations. I had a prior out of them but there was a tavern music on Saturday night.

Breakfast the service was slow but the worst part was the hostess. Agelia did not want to be there and she couldn’t even say good morning to us two mornings in a row.

Overall for the price not sure if you’re really getting here. The Marriott Camelback was just as nice

reviews.author: tammy j
reviews.title: When the wife gets to tag along on a business trip.
reviews.text:
This is my first experience with this resort.  The room was ok, the bathroom was beautiful! Beds were wonderful but small. We opted for a lower end room to get a queen but it was not a queen. 

The grounds were perfectly manicured!

The gym. Although state of the art, was a bit useless to my lifting style. 

Room service, although they called was 20 minutes late and cold. Flat bread pizza and a ceasar salad $60. Too expensive for the quality.

The pools!!! Everything from staff, to the cleanliness was top notch! I would go back just for the exceptional service. I picked my seat, and they laid out.my towels,  brought me an ice water pitcher and kept it full. 
Amanda, my wait staff at the pool, loved her!! She recommended the lamb gyro and it was perfect! Kudos to the chef!

I walked every single area of the resort the 2 days I was there.

Aside from the poor room service experience, and the small bed...the experience was perfect!

reviews.author: OakvilleGal
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort hotel
reviews.text: Here for a conference.  Beautiful property, excellent service and full luxury amenities.  Pool was too cold to swim in late February but beautiful nonetheless.  A bit isolated in that you had to Uber to get to restaurants and fashion square mall but for families with kids, it would be a nice - albeit pricey - getaway.

reviews.author: Michelle T
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience!
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Phoenician. The hotel has just undergone a major renovation, and everything felt new and fresh. My room had a beautiful view overlooking the pool and the mountains, and it was large and comfortable. The property has a huge workout facility and lots of tennis courts, although the complex is down the hill from the main hotel. There's an amazing spa, but both the spa and the golf clubhouse are a golf cart ride away from the main hotel buildings. We had a fantastic dinner at J&G Steakhouse on property. There's also a nice outdoor bar that was a great place to relax. Unfortunately, I was only there for one night for a business meeting, but I'd definitely like to go back when I could spend more time enjoying all the amenities the resort has to offer.

reviews.author: nikki1232008
reviews.title: Ok place to stay
reviews.text: We kept hearing all these wonderful things about this hotel and the resort itself is very nice and the staff was good but everything was overpriced and they charge for every little thing! At a resort this nice, I shouldn't have to pay $15 for wifi or to pay extra to use the fitness equipment. The spa was very nice and relaxing and the staff there were amazing. The views of Camelback were also very beautiful. Close to downtown Scottsdale.

reviews.author: ExcellenceWins
reviews.title: Expansive luxury. Lackluster service.
reviews.text: Walking the immense, perfectly manicured grounds, admiring the desert-influenced, contemporary architecture, and soaking-in the sumptuous, modern lobby, you’d never guess this beautiful property is now three-decades old. Clearly, the owners have invested in keeping it best-of-class in Scottsdale. The newish, stand-alone spa and fitness center is nothing less than amazing. Resort amenities abound at every turn, from the vast, multi-tiered pool levels, to nature highlights, to top-notch dining and entertainment. The rooms, particularly if you have a view (take note, many do not), are an oasis in the desert — large, well-appointed and sumptuously comfortable. Outstanding food and service is found in many onsite dining outlets, especially at JG on the top hotel floor (don’t miss the signature tater tots at their golf club bistro). Unfortunately, however, as too many other recent reviews have noted, the juxtaposition to an otherwise flawless hard product is in the service. Upon a weekday afternoon arrival, only one front desk agent is working, struggling with three non-functioning keycard machines, resulting in a 20-minute wait to check in... with only one person in line. When a supervisor does finally appear to reluctantly help, instead of apologizing for and expediting the guest experience, instead she then wants to argue with a repeat guest about a minuscule corporate discount on a $600/night room. An overnight shoeshine service is offered, but the receptionist says only if you have ‘black shoes.’ Housekeeping is hit or miss, but the exquisite, Le Belge dark chocolate and sea salt turndown amenity almost makes up for it. I’ve stayed at this hotel a dozen or so times over the years, despite what seem to be nagging service issues, but the service was such a turnoff this past trip it may merit exploring other options next time around. Hopefully management takes note of the service issues feedback being shared repeatedly here on TripAdvisor, since no post-stay survey is sent. The hotel itself is a jewel in the desert, but this Phoenician will rise much higher with a little more focus on delivering a service level that matches the otherwise wonderful surroundings.

reviews.author: Razor2009
reviews.title: Paradise in the dessert!
reviews.text: This is truly a first class resort in every way. The rooms, the service and all of the amenities are amazing. Step out of your room and you can touch Camelback. Hard to express how amazing a property this is.

reviews.author: JFL1964
reviews.title: Family Vacation with Adult Children
reviews.text: My family had a wonderful vacation at the Phoenician over New Years. The service was excellent, with Phoenician employees being kind and professional. Our rooms were very nice.  My wife and and college-age daughter have visited numerous spas across the country and found the Phoenician Spa to be the nicest. My son and I enjoyed the hotel's golf course.  The breakfast buffet was outstanding and our other meals at the hotel were also very good.  We intend to return.

reviews.author: Lauren S
reviews.title: Disappointed; Lack of Hospitality
reviews.text:
As a celebration of the birth of baby #6 of our group and reunion of life-long friends on opposite coasts, my best friend reserved a mom's night out stay on Saturday at the Phoenician. After a nice dinner and massages in the morning, the next day took a negative turn and resulted in us having to leave around 10am to pick up the kids and take our friend's dog to the emergency vet.  

Upon check-out, we asked if we could return another day, as we were planning to originally stay and enjoy the amenities for most of the afternoon.  A sweet voice named Monica greeted us from Concierge services and confirmed that the resort would offer us a day pass on Tuesday and that email confirmation would be sent.

When Tuesday arrived with no email receipt, we called the resort.  After being put on hold for nearly 30 minutes, we proceeded to be passed to multiple representatives all denying the day pass.  Eventually, a manger named Andrew confirmed Monica made a mistake.

Instead of offering ANY consolation for the resort's error, they proceeded to demand we rebook another night stay.  After 30 more minutes of explaining/crying from our new mom-of-3 friend, Andrew did not budge and condescendingly said to come to the hotel if we wanted to figure it out.

All three of our friends made the 45 min drive to find Andrew at the front desk.  In addition to the lack of eye contact or any mention of apologies and sympathy for the situation, he instead blankly asked for ID and form of payment.

As the wife of a Titanium Elite Marriott member who travels extensively for work, my friend was heartbroken that not only was her one day of rest taken away from us but that there nothing the resort offered to do to help for someone who has spent hundreds of thousands of dollars at this chain.

We're all disappointed in the Phoenician's management and can't wait to take our money to the Hilton brand from now on.

(Note, the pools staff including Hannah, Heather and Pam were fantastic and should receive five out of five stars!)

reviews.author: Jenn Robertson
reviews.title: Terrible customer service from the front desk/management
reviews.text:
The service is disgraceful. We had a family emergency and had to leave a day early from our stay. When we checked out, they said they would give us a day pass to come back and enjoy the missed day. We arrive back days later to get the day pass, and Andrew claims there is no recollection of this agreement and they won't offer that. He said that it was a mistake we were told that, yet he did NOTHING to fix the mistake.  Granted we have a titanium elite membership, have endless bookings with Marriott in the past 13 months alone. You think they'd at least fix their own mistake instead of just lying and not rectify the situation. Instead of trying to fix their mistake, they said the only way we can enjoy day amenities a is to BOOK AN ENTIRELY NEW ROOM WHEN WE ARENT EVEN STAYING OVERNIGHT.  It's unreal to me that this 'elite' of a resort has made zero effort to make customer service a priority.  Make eye contact next time Andrew and own up to the huge error on y'all part Instead of being a jerk and just not give a damn with a woman crying on the phone to you about her frustration.

On the total opposite end of the spectrum, Hannah who works the poolside service was PHENOMENAL. She was such a delight and attentive to us the entire day

reviews.author: N Radic
reviews.title: Go elsewhere: Management ignores complaints about employees
reviews.text: I contacted management three times about a rude and agressive employee at the spa who spoiled my experience there.  Three times I was promised a call back and  some sort of compensation for having my spa visit ruined.  No one ever called back during my five day stay.  My husband went to the front desk and asked management to call.  They never did.  This is an expensive hotel and we spent a considerable sum on four very expensive treatments.  Management made it patently clear they do not care about the wellbeing of their guests.  This spoiled our entire stay and is utterly unacceptable in an establishment that vaunts itself as a luxury haven of serenity. Service is essential to luxury and this hotel’s management failed to meet even a standard of mediocrity.  Frankly, given the amount of money we spent on our stay, their attitude is insulting.  Avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: DennisG50
reviews.title: beautiful spot!
reviews.text: Against Camelback Mountain it enjoys a prime location. And it is worthy of its locale. Large scale with several room options and plenty of restaurants  and shops to choose from. There is a large spa that we did not utilize. The fitness center was impressive. The staff was very friendly  and always helpful. One note.... if staying in the casitas (as we did) you might think about the stairs to the second floor units with luggage  but without assistance!

reviews.author: arbie88
reviews.title: Overall very nice
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice. The service is great. We went for business and our stay was paid for, but I am not sure it’s worth paying the rates that came up when we searched to add a day. 

I thought the bed was very comfortable, but not fond of the fluffy pillows. My husband did like the pillows though. We didn’t have the best view from our room either. The climate control would not let us turn the thermostat below 67 and we like it colder at night to sleep. I don’t think the room got close to 67, so we opened the sliding door at night. Our view was reception, so we heard morning car noise. 

Liked the view and the garden in the back near the mountain. Catering/food was excellent and the service was phenomenal.

reviews.author: CT K
reviews.title: Mediocre experience
reviews.text: Booked here for three days for a conference. The hotel is older but it’s been renovated. The meeting rooms were fine, But the service here is not very good. Walked into a meeting for the first 30 minutes and went out to get a bite for breakfast, they only left the breakfast sit for 30 minutes while we had four hours of meetings going. I was told by the staff they were removing the food. Later I ate at the steakhouse, they told us our party would be seated, despite half the restaurant being empty, it took them 45 minutes. The food was OK but nothing special for a steakhouse and expensive prices. Last, despite being a gold member, and my meetings not ending until two, they refused to extend the check out past 11. So don’t expect any special service or treatment while you are here even though your paying for it you will not get it.

reviews.author: AmyB
reviews.title: The Phoenician Spa
reviews.text: A visit to the Phoenician Spa is a must see and experience.  I had an amazing massage with Suzella, who was attentive to offering the right amount of pressure and technique that left me feeling so relaxed. I booked a facial with Andrea, whose calming voice and thorough knowledge of skin, leaves you feeling so pampered and with glowing skin! After enjoying all the spa amenities,  we had lunch on the rooftop deck, where we were promptly greeted and served by Diana, who was helpful and attentive.  Such an unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Scenic182553
reviews.title: Girls all tennis 50th birthday party week
reviews.text: Planned out bday party all tennis trip 2 months in advance contacted other resorts but picked the Phoenician. Arrived late Thursday night had already scheduled tennis drills for Friday through Sunday along with 2 hours of court time per day. Arrived Friday morning for scheduled drill and was told that the resort had a resort wide tennis tournament. The pro Ivan assured us that we would get court time and he did one drill with us and every other day left us waiting for his text or phone call. Ivan made no effort to make this better besides a free lunch. This was a very expensive trip for all with flights and room fee to not get any tennis in! I will never return to The Phoenician they have yet to make it right.

reviews.author: jacob p
reviews.title: A GEM
reviews.text:
Trying hard to maintain a 5 star feel. Room was clean, linen, very good, bathroom spacious with a double sink....shower should have a hand washer. Room location important, request fourth floor overlooking the pool (which also has a mountain vista. 
The even number rooms have an east/west span. Breakfast menu a bit limited, but the staff will accommodate virtually any reasonable request. Staff is very attentive and housekeeping, including turn down service, was timely and thorough. A worthy stay.

reviews.author: jessicamkravitz
reviews.title: Kind of Disappointing
reviews.text:
So the rooms in this hotel are nice but there is so much that feels dated and sad about this place.  Maybe it's the shiny brass handrails and tacky 80's chandeliers.  Perhaps it's the red peonies and bright green grass in the middle of the desert. Or the steakhouse serving giant veal chops. Or the golf.  Or the phone that didn't work in the room. Or the ubiquitous free water bottles (a hotel like this can go through half a million a year).  Or the fact that you can't take stairs from the lobby to your room, even if your room is just one floor away (I asked twice - "not possible" and "have to take an elevator".) In short, the world has changed, but this hotel hasn't.

Also, one of Phoenix's best hikes (Camelback Mt) is right behind the property but the closest you get to it is by being dropped off a half mile away and walking alongside the golf course.

reviews.author: Lenny
reviews.title: Wonderful Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: Slightly delayed celebration for my wife's birthday.  Only 35 minutes away from our home but our 2 night stay made us feel that we really got away for a much longer time.  Very impressive property; the grounds are gorgeous. well manicured and spotless.  Our casita room was perfect in many ways.  With beautiful AZ weather, the pools were full but not noisy and sufficient bar and food attendants to provide service.  Many thanks to Johanna Guzman who surprised us with a bottle of champagne and chocolates for the birthday girl and a welcoming bottle of wine. All employees we interacted with were very friendly and helpful.  My daughter is a Marriott employee on the east coast; we were very surprised to be able to get an employee Explore Rate with the nearby Phoenix Open. This property offers it all!

reviews.author: Diane P
reviews.title: Perfect weekend with an 18 month old.
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived we had perfect service at this very large resort.  Our adjoining casitas were lovely and well appointed.  We were traveling with our children and one grandchild.  The restaurants and all of the staff we came into contact with were amazing.  David at the pool and Christine in the breakfast dining room were so very helpful and kind.  The first night we went to the Steakhouse and walked in at closing time. They seated us anyway as we had a res. And then proceeded to assign us a waitress who had been there for a long while.  She was tops in every way but I can’t remember her name.  The food was out of this world.  Everything in this resort is first class except maybe the outdoor spaces around the casitas.  The rooms were a bit dark as well.  I would definitely stay here again with children.
.

reviews.author: NorthStar395733
reviews.title: Best Resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
This resort was fantastic.  The staff was very helpful and first rate.  The property looks fresh and recently renovated.  The steakhouse was so amazing we ate there twice.  
The pools are beautiful and large enough so you can find a quiet spot or be in the action.  The golf course is very nice with a great driving range.
I was very impressed and can’t wait to return.
I have read reviews comparing this to other resorts in the area.  Don’t believe them because this is the best!

reviews.author: MTVandend
reviews.title: Pretty, but pricey suite
reviews.text:
We came to Phoenix to meet up with family for Christmas, and chose to stay at The Phoenician because we'd heard that the big renovations were finally done.  The property is looking really good, golf course, main areas are updated. Given that we were literally having Christmas at the hotel, we booked a 1 bedroom King suite to ensure we had space for our group/family of 7 to gather.  The suite was a really great size, had everything we needed (including indoor fireplace, which was great, as it was so cold!). My senior parents had been able to get the room adjoining to ours, which was excellent.

Pros: 
The property is looking really good now that renos are complete. 
The size of the suite was great! (1200 sq ft, if I recall correctly)
The suite had a lovely private outdoor area with a fire table. We booked the fire table suite specifically so that we could sit outside and enjoy. Sadly, we were unable to use it even once, because it was so cold and rainy. Still, it looked lovely.

Cons: 
Since it was Christmas, they seemed to have only bare bones in terms of staff working at the hotel.  There always seemed to be long wait lines at both check in, and while waiting to get a table at the Mowry and Cotton restaurant, which was frustrating.

We were a group of 7, so I requested assistance from the Concierge a week or two prior to our arrival to assist with booking Christmas Eve dinner. She recommended a particular restaurant which I agreed to within 2 hours, yet she seemed to have taken so long to contact the restaurant on my behalf (days), that we were unable to get the reservation. It's not a huge deal, but I was let down. Although in fairness, I have to say that another restaurant she recommended (at which we were able to get a table) was quite good.

The suite was large and it was great, but it was incredibly pricey (over $1200/night!). After this stay, we moved to the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess, stayed in a slightly smaller, but similar suite (around 850 sq ft), and paid radically less! (around $400/night) That's a huge difference, when the suite "experience" felt  pretty much the same.

It was a bit off putting to be charged the daily resort fee when we were unable to use any of the resort amenities.  The temperatures during our entire stay were between 35-45 degrees (so cold!), and the pool and outdoor areas were all closed off. All outdoor areas, restaurants and pools were a virtual ghost town.  You can't blame the resort for the weather, but it left a bad taste to be charged this fee without any of the benefits.

Overall, it was a good stay. I would potentially come again to enjoy it when the weather is better? But, at half the price for a suite, there's a good chance that I would opt for the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess instead.

reviews.author: DGDC
reviews.title: Best of Everything
reviews.text: We love the Phoenician. The grounds are beautifully landscaped   The pool areas are spacious and comfortable, the staff is solicitous and the the lunch and snack offerings are delicious and served in sleek containers. The spa is excellent. Staff throughout the resort are helpful and friendly, the rooms are well appointed, and the views spectacular. In addition, the location is excellent for spending a day in old town Scottsdale or downtown Phoenix.  I highly recommend the Phoenician.

reviews.author: callmegypsy
reviews.title: Beautiful. Needed more than one night!
reviews.text: Everything right at your feet. Awesome fitness center. Easy walk to Camelback trail head thanks to the concierge tip. Although, they’ll have a bellhop drive you to edge of property if you’d like. Beautiful rooms. Great pools. Lovely golf course. Can’t wait to come back for an extended stay.

reviews.author: larissashorr
reviews.title: New Years weekend
reviews.text: Best service anyone could expect. From valet to check every person you encounter is exceptionally helpful. We were able to book a couples massage as this was our second stay. The Spa at the Phoenician is an absolute must see & experience. Hands down one of the best spa experiences in Arizona. An absolute must while staying at the Phoenician.

reviews.author: LoveToTravel
reviews.title: Very Festive Holiday Stay
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights at The Phoenician with our 3 adult children.  The hotel was absolutely decked out for the holidays (see pics) and the atmosphere was lively and fun.  Loved our Xmas Eve dinner at J&G Steakhouse.  Overall, a nice stay but we did have some trouble keeping the temperature in our room comfortable, and our kids had the same issue in their rooms.

reviews.author: sksanche
reviews.title: Nice business trip
reviews.text: At property for a quick business meeting. Room located at main building (not a villa). Upgraded room was very spacious with plenty of area to spread out with a large balcony over looking pool. Room felt updated along with large bathroom nicely appointed. The resort grounds looked amazing with golf, tennis, extremely large fitness club and spa. I did not get to enjoy any of these but from passing them by they looked very nice. For business the meeting room wasn’t too impressive but gave space, natural light was limited and furnishings were average. Staff all around were very pleasant and appeared to be attentive to any needs. I noticed every staff member I passed greeted me with at least a good morning/afternoon/evening and how are you?   Pools look expansive and plenty of space to enjoy.

reviews.author: Vincent202
reviews.title: Great property for great events
reviews.text: We stayed at this property for a corporate event. It is very well suited for these type of events. Nice, space rooms, good facilities, marvellous views (both sunrise and sunset). Unfortunately, my calendar didn't allow me to hike or explore the neighbourhood.

reviews.author: James L
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea Done Right
reviews.text: The all glass Wall supports a panoramic view of the mountains and valley.  The service is outstanding. What surprised us was the amount of sandwiches, pastries and desserts that were served. We had to take some of it home and we were not alone with small bags of fine pastries. The tea pots contain ample amounts of tea and if you want more, you may have another pot of tea. I enjoyed the gold tipped Assam tea as I like a hearty tea, but you could get a lighter tea in the selections. The attached picture was the third course in the tea. You are not rushed. The wait staff is attentive. The tip is included in the bill at 22%. Well worth the experience and service. In addition, valet parking is included with the tea. So relax and enjoy conversation and varied treats in a beautiful location.

reviews.author: heather s
reviews.title: Most wonderful property....
reviews.text: This property is the most beautiful resort I’ve ever been to.  From the grounds to the room to the food, everything was excellent!  I can’t say enough about the place and the employees were even better.  My family said, wow these employees must really be treated well here and love their job. They were always so happy and wanting to my our experience better if possible.  Will definitely return and suggest others make a visit if you want to be spoiled!

reviews.author: gb17292929921981
reviews.title: Top 3 best Marriott I’ve seen
reviews.text: Great service all around with beautiful rooms and has the best pool in Arizona. 10/10 would recommend for any occasion. The spa is newly renovated and very well put together. J&G steakhouse is always a good choice on property.

reviews.author: O6205MZlinda
reviews.title: You would think I was the queen of England
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about this resort. I have stayed in many hotels in the last 25 years, and this is the BEST. The staff was friendly and very efficient. The hotel itself was beautiful, restful and very clean. The  restaurants and bar had great and special food and the best drinks ! Excellent in every way.

reviews.author: Mitir P
reviews.title: short family trip before christmans
reviews.text: I took my family to scottsdale to spend a few days away from the cold in chicago and the hotel was wonderful.  They had several activities for our kids and we even used the hotel babysitting which worked great.  I would stay here again, you cant beat the location

reviews.author: drosen85
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort in a Beautiful Setting; But not Ideal for Marriott Elites
reviews.text:
I attended a company event in December where we had most of the property to ourselves. Overall, this is a fantastic property -- and probably even better when not part of a large group. The rooms are very nice -- I had a casita away from the main building. Very comfortable, beautiful bathrooms.

The food, both in the restaurants and even for the large group events was outstanding. The staff does a very good job with catering. Though my quiet breakfasts in the hotel restaurants were even better with great service and a beautiful outdoor view.

Only two concerns. One, as a Luxury Collection property I was surprised that there was no recognition of my Ambassador status with any nod to my loyalty. Also the points that I was offered for foregoing maid service for three days were not credited due to the fact that my room charge was on a central bill (though my Food and Bev charges were very high and billed to me). Finally in the dead of winter with zero guests sitting at the pool, I was told to leave certain areas of the pool as I sat down to read the paper. I understand that there are elite or paid areas at the pool during busy (and warm) times, but the rudeness of the pool staff was uncalled for.

Overall an absolutely beautiful property with excellent rooms. Hope to come back some time and receive the level of service that I'm sure they typically provide.

reviews.author: Roving282501
reviews.title: .  Check in Experience
reviews.text: Andrew at the front desk went above and beyond to make our stay fantastic. Our room overlooked the pools, fire pits.  He gave us an introduction to the property and we truly enjoyed lunch at the golf course, dinners in the steakhouse.  Very relaxing vacation!

reviews.author: DCWh0dat
reviews.title: Wonderful property
reviews.text:
They stay was great!  The staff took excellent care of us I want to shoutout to Jaime Smith, Kaylee, Whitney, Andrew and others... (I apologize, i can't remember their names...)    I/ we will definitely return.   

Extra shoutout to the hawk!  (If you've been, you would understand.)

reviews.author: CharlesAMIV
reviews.title: Industrial Strength Business Hotel
reviews.text:
This is a nice hotel. It's a big hotel. It looks like and, once you walk around a bit, you realize how big it is. My room was on the first floor and to get to it I went down three flights and walked a good ways. To get to the event rooms it means walk, up three floors, walk, down the escalator, and another good long walk. Nothing wrong with this at all, but if "cute", "quaint", or ''cozy" is what you're looking for, keep looking. The food - particularly the lamb tacos - were fantastic. Wow. 

I'm returning in March for another conference and will have a greater idea of what to expect. I'm bringing my wife this time - I think plopping by the pool and being cared for may be her thing.

reviews.author: bukagirl
reviews.title: Huge property
reviews.text:
A huge sprawling property, a beautiful golf course and gym, comfortable guest rooms, no coffee maker, great views of the mountains and a lovely cactus garden the pools are nice also. 
Beds are very comfortable, turn down service and safety deposit box in room.

reviews.author: ekhl
reviews.title: Terrible Value
reviews.text:
We knew going in this would be expensive but we wanted a great resort for our inter generational Thanksgiving break with our grandchildren ranging from 2-7. We have taken them repeatedly to Disney and Cancun resorts in the past but we will not make this mistaken again. Kids club is $95 per child per day. There’s nothing there. No activities just a room and it’s make your own fun. Parents are not allowed to accompany a timid child, even to get them acclimated. 
Many of the other kid activities at the resort carry a price tag but lucky us our kids could write something they were grateful for on a leaf and hang it on the grateful tree. It was COMPLIMENTARY!  Wow. That sums up our experience 
There’s a resort fee of $35 per room per day. It covers tennis (one hour and equipment per day), bicycles and internet. We were three rooms for five days so. $$$. Did the tennis pro even call us back when we inquired about court time and lessons for our grandchildren? Not once even after we left two messages. We’re there bikes for 7 year old? We were told, no. 
What hotels these days charge for internet? 
Value? None!  After complaining I was given a refund of the resort fee for my room only. All kids were in other rooms with their parents. None of us did any tennis or could go for a bike ride so it’s difficult to understand that logic but I couldn’t get anywhere with the management. 
Parking garage door never worked and we were always stalled going anywhere. 
One night they set up mini golf -three holes for the kids and s’mores. Those were the highlights
Kids menu was very nice and nicely presented. 
Those really the only compliments I can give.

reviews.author: Kent M
reviews.title: Over-the-top resort destination
reviews.text: I had a conference at the Phoenician for three days in November.  Our room was one of the basic ones as I was paying a low conference rate - it was still spacious and very nice.  The public areas around the various pools, the gardens, lobby, the cactus garden, etc. were all wonderful.  A true destination resort in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Bruce_and_Valerie
reviews.title: Not up to standard
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician for a weekend, but were disappointed it did not live up to the 5 star experience we expected . The rooms were dull, the common spaces looking worn, and the restaurants very pricey for what they delivered.
We would say the service was good to very good from the staff which helped
When you pay $1100 for two nights with parking and breakfast, you expect more, especially with so many other good choices in the Phoenix area.

reviews.author: Darrah F
reviews.title: Ultra Luxurious
reviews.text:
Everything about The Phoenician, from the divine spa to the cactus gardens is beautiful and well thought out. This is one resort that lives up to the price tag.

My only complaint, and it's not really a complaint, is that the kids Club here isn't as used as it should be. Hardly any kids were there when we were there in February. It is a beautiful space and very clean. The only reason we aren't going here again this Spring is because we prefer the Coyote Kids Club at the Pointe Hilton Squaw Peak. They do tons of arts and crafts with the kids there and they have outdoor space for the kids to play and let them swim and so forth. The kids Club at The Phoenician is more geared towards them playing video games vs. exploring the natural environment and playing outside.

The little breakfast place by the shops at The Phoenician is to die for. So delicious and healthy options as well. 

The golf course is immaculate and beyond compare.

As mentioned above, the Spa is to. die. for. and not to be missed. Y'all it has a rooftop pool! I only wish it wouldn't have been so cold when we visited. I would have spent all day in the pool. Don't forget you can go all day to spa if you make an appointment.

reviews.author: HaroldTGunther
reviews.title: Truly the best in Phoenix
reviews.text:
Went here on business a awhile back. Amazing establishment with beautiful lands. The staff is amazing and will comply to all requests. This place is held to a seriously high standard and it truly shows. 

I would recommend this resort it is without a doubt, worth the price. Which is something most Scottsdale hotels cannot say.

reviews.author: Amy W
reviews.title: Jacqueline W. at Mowry & Cotton was amazing.
reviews.text: Went with my family for a birthday dinner to Mowry & Cotton. Not only was the food incredible, but the service was amazing. Jacqueline was our server and she was on top of everything, very knowledgeable of the menu and chef, and was an absolute delight. We will definitely be back to dine here again. Thank you!

reviews.author: philblume
reviews.title: Lifetime Titanium Elite's Favorite Hotel
reviews.text: With more than 1,000 nights at Marriott properties, I'm the most picky of travelors having stayed at dozens of high end properties around the world and The Phoenician is my go to for great customer service, a top notch breakfast, and a beautiful setting of Scottsdale.   I've just finished a five night stay (on points for two rooms) and I am thrilled of my investment.  The spa is a nice place to relax each day and I find 45 minutes is sufficient if just using the sauna, steam room and jaccuzzi.   The very nice gym and spa are not connected to the hotel so it does mean an outside walk (Or ride) to each facility, so if its the dead of winter, dress warmly.   The golf grounds are immacuately maintained. Even housekeeping employees have smiles on their faces and actually mean it when they say hello.   I highly recommend the cactus garden at the back of the hotel for a 20 minute visit.   Just visit and see why this is my favorite property.

reviews.author: SCtraveler369
reviews.title: Beautiful landscaping, luxury rooms!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician in December.  The hotel was beautifully decorated for the holidays.  Our room was fantastic with a huge balcony overlooking the property.  The only drawback was the weather.  It was rainy and cold and we did not get to experience much of the property.  There is little to do inside the hotel as well other than eat.  The nightly entertainment in the lounge is first rate and the food at Mowry and Cotton is wonderful.

reviews.author: stp4dwf
reviews.title: Lovely Stay
reviews.text:
Just returned from a really nice 3 night stay.
Highly recommend a "fire table" casita (we had room 7108). It was great that we could park our car right in back of our room and that we had a lovely patio with a fire pit and grassy area.
Room was clean and spacious. The bathtub was HUGE!!!
The gym was large, clean and very well equipped. Beautiful tennis courts and pickle ball courts as well as a great golf course and driving range.
The spa was beautiful and we had great massages. Male and female locker room areas with  wet and dry saunas as well as jacuzzis.
2 small issues in our room- Took a long time for hot water to come to the faucets and whenever the heater came on there was an incessant clicking but no other complaints.
Housekeeping was great and included turn down service.
It was too cold to use the pool, but it looked great with a huge slide for kids.
It was great that our medium sized dog was welcomed with a healthy ($175) additional fee. She was able to join us each morning for breakfast on the patio at Mowry and Cotton and for one dinner there as well. 
Concierge was lovely and always offered dog treats and "poop" bags whenever they saw us!
Suggestions for the property-there is a lot of open lawn space which would be well-served by communal fire pits with seating for friends and families to gather (similar to Ojai Valley Inn). It would be fun to offer carts with someone selling the ingredients for s'mores (like they do at Palmetto Bluff) by the fire pits. There's so much more that could be done to offer a communal feel with all the open space. Perhaps even an enclosed dog park???!!!
All in all, a lovely visit.

reviews.author: Doug G
reviews.title: Phoenician Resort, Scottsdale AZ
reviews.text:
Fabulous facility, top notch service, beautiful scenery!
Several pools, excellent restaurants and a Championship golf course, all onsite!
Make sure to climb the beautiful Camelback Mountain which is directly behind the hotel.

reviews.author: northeasttraveler3
reviews.title: Magnificent resort - a luxurious stay!
reviews.text:
This is one of the nicest hotels I have ever stayed in. That's definitely what they're going for. As a Marriott Platinum member, I got upgraded to a suite that had to be 1500 square feet. It had 2 showers, 2 bidets, 2 tubs, 2 porches. 

Pros:
- Great amenities if you have time to use them
- Great room service menu
- Very nice staff including the valet and room service staff

Cons:
- The property needs better signage. I had trouble finding my room in the dark

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: Don’t waste your time
reviews.text:
When I book at a top tier hotel it’s because I expect to spend time on the property. There is very little on property to make it worth the stay, at least during the cooler months.
The dining on-property is poor and unimaginative. Specifically the casual options are poorly managed and staffed by folks who don’t really seem to care about your experience. You’re best to just sleep through breakfast; the options are sad. The food and beverage department needs overhauled. With so many talented chefs in town, it’s inexcusable to have such poor dining on property. 

I’m not normally one to partake in a spa, but my SO insisted, and it was the only bright spot of the stay.

reviews.author: willgracekentengland
reviews.title: Classy resort with excellent service and facilities
reviews.text:
We spent Christmas 2019 here with our son. Our casita below the pool complex, next to the golf club and within easy walking distance to the spa and fitness complex suited us completely, thanks to Ryan's efforts on our arrival. Our adjoining rooms were very comfortable with great bathrooms and we enjoyed our firepit on the patio, especially opening our gifts there on the evening of Christmas Day with a glass of champagne! The Christmas decorations were absolutely beautiful.
We ate excellent food at Maury and Cotton and the Tavern, where the service, as everywhere, was immaculate...thanks Dora, Rachel and Alex.
In spite of the cold weather we appreciated the warm swimming pools and hot tubs and 2 rounds of golf on the well groomed golf course, looked after by the cheery golf club staff. The tennis courts and the games room gave even more entertainment, we were only sorry not to have had more time to enjoy them.
The concierge staff are super efficient and seem to know EVERYTHING! Their advice on sightseeing, restaurants and answers to all our queries was detailed and accurate.. We also have to add our thanks to our lovely lady with the lights who welcomed us so cheerily every time we drove into the resort past her kiosk.
This was a fabulous stay, we would certainly return and would recommend it to anyone looking for a well run, comprehensive resort with fantastic service.

reviews.author: Linda L
reviews.title: Amazing desert resort
reviews.text:
The Phoenician Resort was an amazing place to visit in December. We participated in a Mother-Daughter trip to attend Christmas Camp created by Karen Shaler the second weekend in December. Temperatures were mild and there were beautiful decorations in the lobby and throughout the cactus garden. The events of the Christmas Camp were well organized. We enjoyed breakfast each morning at the Market Cafe and attended classes throughout the day and evening in beautifully decorated meeting rooms. The resort provided golf carts and drivers to help us get around the resort quickly - and to the restaurants in other buildings. 
The room in the main building was very comfortable - roomy, good beds, immaculately clean, and a beautiful view of the valley. 
There was music in the lobby on the weekend nights, many places to sit around firepits, and in the lobby there were lots of cozy sitting areas. All staff were very attentive...We will definitely come back to this resort in the future. 
We were especially impressed with the very attentive pool staff who brought us pitchers of water to drink as we relaxed by the pool.

reviews.author: Doughbuy
reviews.title: Bucket List Resort!
reviews.text:
The Phonecian, Luxury collection resort has been on my bucket list for a while. Located in Scottsdale Arizona, its a very exclusive luxurious resort with plenty of amenities, beautiful views, great dining, and amazing rooms. It will be about a 30 min drive from the airport, but not far from many places in Scottsdale if you do want to leave.

There's a guard shack to get in, though it can't be hard since ubers get in all the time. You drive to the end for reception, passing by a massive sports complex on the left (which I didn't get toenjoy but looked amazing). Reception is in a beautiful lobby overlooking the resort that compares closely to any Ritz, St. Regis, or other 5 star property. Think swanky furniture, mood lighting, and luxury touches. Check-in was quick and easy, and off I went to my Casitas suite (thank you suite night awards).

The suite was absolutely amazing with a kitchenette, dining table, living room with plenty of seating, 2 Full Baths (seriously, with 2 sets of soaking tubs and showers), and a humongous master bedroom thats bigger then most hotel rooms. Patios overlooking the pool complex completes the room. Frette slippers were just some of the finer touches you don't see even at most 5 star resorts. 

The pool complex was amazing as well, and since this was winter not crowded at all. If you're in the casitas you will have to walk through them to get to the main complex again (highly recommend dining at Mowry & Cotton)

This is not a cheap property, but worth every penny. Needs to be on everyones bucket list.

reviews.author: Boomertravelers_11
reviews.title: Poor for the price
reviews.text: We paid $400 a night for a room with a view of a wall and a steel beam. There was about a 2 foot sliver of open space through which we could see the balconies on the other side of the hotel. The room was comfortable, but nothing very warm or inviting unless you like off-white and grey. Staff were great and the place was quiet, but the room's heating unit was fairly loud.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We enjoyed every aspect of the Phoenician. Beautiful resort with great service. Room was very clean and spacious. The grounds are very tidy and beautiful! The fitness center was new and had a great variety of equipment to use. We would highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Jwellin
reviews.title: Anniversary dinner
reviews.text: Jacqueline is why we come back to Mowery and Cotton and have spent our last 2 anniversary’s at the Phoenician. She makes the dinner amazing and the time special. Many options in the valley, she’s special.

reviews.author: LocalTourist85
reviews.title: LUXURIOUS!
reviews.text: What an incredible getaway!  Gorgeous, well-kept grounds, stunning Christmas decorations, sparkling pools and fountains - an amazing desert oasis!  Our room was spacious and clean with a nice balcony.  The staff was extremely professional and helpful.  We opted for room service for breakfast each morning and we were never disappointed.  The food was delicious and creatively presented.  Although we weren't traveling with children, there was a really fun water park area that looked like it would be such a blast for kids!  Being kids at heart, we did enjoy the game room quite a bit with ping-pong, pool, and arcade games!  We also took advantage of the bicycles (included in the resort fee) and enjoyed riding around the resort.  Everything about our stay was wonderful!  I hope we can return someday!

reviews.author: Tagg R
reviews.title: Nice hotel but falls far short of luxury
reviews.text: We splurged to stay at what we had hoped would be a 5-star experience.  There is much to love—the new gym is amazing, staff friendly, and the hotel restaurants are good.  But when paying Phoenician prices my wife and I expected greatness.  There are just too many little things that are off in our opinion.  For example, the plug in our bathroom doesn’t work, which is annoying when trying to use a hair dryer.  The water in the shower took 8 minutes to get hot, which is both annoying as well as a terrible waste of water.  The tub is so shallow that no matter how full you try to fill it, most of your body can’t be submerged at the same time.  And when we were “upgraded” to a Mountain View suite for being Marriott Platinum, all we can see from the balcony is the hotel opposite us, unless we crane our necks to be able to catch a sliver of Camelback.  Overall, a nice hotel, but not so great attention to detail.

reviews.author: Simone T
reviews.title: Just outstanding
reviews.text:
Everything was awesome at the resort. From rooms to service everything. Most of the staff was helpful, pleasant and friendly except the guy who dropped our luggage in the room. 
Landscping and pools and restaurants are wonderful, food was good but more options would have been better. 
Golf course with views of camelback was gorgeous, cactus garden with Christmas lights just outstanding. 
Christine at the pool was super nice and attentive. 
Our 2 year old enjoyed all the kids activities. 
Only thing to improve is the clean the room and touch up the marks and stains. 
We were in casitas king by the spa. Away from lobby but not far.
Would be back if we plan to go to Arizona again.

reviews.author: Kim N
reviews.title: Mislead
reviews.text: Visited the Phoenician for a medical conference and was very disappointed by the pool manager Elijah’s disrespect to us ...we were able to sit by the pool and relax for several hours IN FACT MY HUSBAND SAT BY THE POOL THE ENTIRE TIME I was attending the conference. After the conference I met my husband by the pool and we ordered food and a few drinks.  After we paid and tipped the help generously we waited for our food to be brought to us as the server offered. The next thing we knew he came to our seats and said that his manager had asked us to leave since we did not have a room and the pool area was for guests only. I explained that I was a guest (Paying several hundreds of dollars over 3 days for a MER conference) He said that he made a mistake taking our order since we did not have a room.  He also told us that it was okay last week for a group attending a-conference so he thought it was okay but his manager said it is against policy. They told us we were allowed to attend other restaurants on site but not the pool area it was not an amenity that was included. We asked for a refund for our food and we were told it had already went through. We asked if we could eat by the pool and they said no and packed it up for us to take out. We have attended conferences all over the world and I have never been treated with such disrespect. We are very disappointed in the managers decision and we feel we were targeted. Please note that the server was very kind and was doing his job. If the concern was corporate policy they need to review and realize this policy. These conferences bring in thousands of dollars and they need to appreciate the attendees.  The manager acted as a glorified pool boy and the staff suffered due to not allowing the conference attendees to spend there money on site.

reviews.author: SNOWBALL
reviews.title: Wife and I Anniversary
reviews.text: I stayed years ago on business. This was our first time here together celebrating our anniversary.  We arrived and were greeted promptly and were upgraded to a very nice room with Mountain View.  We were surprised by a lovely fruit basket from the manager.   This resort is over the top.   It  is ultimate in luxury .  Every person we encountered was wonderful and professional.  The pools and the grounds are spectacular.  The food fantastic.  The shops also had a wide array of items for both men and women.  Also they have a Harris Hawk on premise to keep pesky birds away.  Highly recommend staying here   You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Andy J
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Thank you for a wonderful stay . I attended a conference at the resort and the standard of service was out of this world . The rooms are lovely with amazing views . The conference breakfast ( most important meal of the day ) was lovely and set me up for a good hard day of work. The venue for the dinner on the last night around the fort was out of this world and the food was amazing . 
 
I also played a few rounds of the golf and the course is amazing really well looked after and lovely . 

Thank you so so much for a lovely stay and I wish your staff and management a wonderful Xmas

reviews.author: Joel H
reviews.title: Amazing spa day on 39th Anniversary celebration
reviews.text: My wife and I could not have picked a more perfect place to celebrate with amazing massages by Dawn and Suzanne and a facial by Lacey Columb. The place is so beautiful and well run you feel like you are being swept away from the check in to your first glass of wine by the pool. I heard they will be ranked 5 stars by Forbes soon and I can place my vote to ensure that. We will be back for more!

reviews.author: Traveling Gal
reviews.title: Loved the Hotel Overall
reviews.text:
It is family-friendly. My family was in a different part of the hotel, and I was in room 6061. I do not recommend that room, poor location. Especially if you are a light sleeper, it is directly next to the Exit stairwell and the elevator lobby. I got little to no sleep between November 26-30, 2019. The next morning, I went to shower, and there was hair in the drain. I used the tissue to remove it. I saw a few pieces of hair in the tub; I avoided it. The view of Camelback Mountain was beautiful. Had the hotel not been booked, I would have moved.

The bartenders at Thirsty Camel Thursday night, one from NY, the other from Chicago, were excellent. It was not too crowded during the Saints game that we could chat just a little bit. They made an excellent recommendation to Craft 64 for pizza and a brewpub. The spa was lovely, and I wish I could remember the women's name that did the facial and pedicure. They were terrific. Frannie (think that was it), who did my nails was attentive not only with my niece who is 5, nails but mine as well.

Thanksgiving Brunch in J&G Steakhouse was phenomenal. The staff was great with my sister's 5, 2, and 1 year old and very family-friendly hotel. The Tavern on Thursday night of the stay was excellent (the fish and chips are what I had - fries were undercooked, but the cod was excellent). The hotel, in general, offered an okay assortment of the local breweries beers. Not a big selection in terms of all the locations one could dine.

reviews.author: R1000AGrichardr
reviews.title: connie reno
reviews.text: i had a beautiful stay it was wonderful the dinners were fabulous i was a aramark ring of stars winner and everything was amazing the spa was fantastic the scenery around the resort was beautiful!!!!!!

reviews.author: Meg
reviews.title: Guaranteed Great Stay in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is my very favourite hotel in AZ - have been multiple times but keep coming back to this one. Yes, it is pricy, but it's a high-end resort & I find the service, amenities, pool area, restaurants on site all to be above-average, so it's worth it!

The entire hotel is beautiful - they had their holiday decorations up when we were there & it was awe-inspiring! The landscaping, cactus garden, etc was gorgeous, you can tell they take pride in the landscape and environment. Rooms are larger than average, tastefully decorated, with beautiful bathtubs & showers. Housekeeping did a great job each day plus turndown service each evening while we were out at dinner. Every staff member I encountered greeted us and was friendly and helpful.

Pool area is really nice - this was my first time back after they renovated the pool area. I loved the separate adult/kid areas. It did get pretty busy on the weekend, but it didn't ever get crazy noisy or loud. The pools are nice & warm (although the locals thought we were crazy for swimming!) and they have lots of nice lounge chairs & towels. 

I have to give a special shout-out to the Kids Club "Funecian" staff. I was travelling with my nephews & they both LOVED going to Kids Club (not always true of other vacations!), in fact one begged to go an extra day! They made it a lot easier to get some adult visiting & meals in. 

Last but not least, the spa! I will go write a separate review, but if you can visit, it's amazing.

reviews.author: Halie C
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text:
Amazing Food with Amazing Service by Morgan.Unique Delicious food made with Love. We will Definitely be coming back again. Excellent Suggestions by our cute server Morgan. The Phoenician was An Amazing way to enjoy a vacation.
Thanks Morgan

reviews.author: Rebe K
reviews.title: Top Notch High End Luxury Resort
reviews.text:
Excellent stay in this beautiful resort, where you are treated like you are the most important person in the place by everyone with whom you come in contact!  The staff is most attentive and accommodating and will do whatever they can to make your stay enjoyable.  
The facilities are excellent also.  The pool is lovely, and faces the beautiful Camelback mountains...  looking at the magnificent hills with cactuses right in front of you as you swim is a sensory treat!

Would certainly recommend this location for your vacation if you are in the Phoenix area.

reviews.author: Sophie7320
reviews.title: Luis is amazing.
reviews.text: Attentive and fun!  You are lucky to have Luis! He was accommodating with our dietary restrictions and made amazing recommendations based on our likes. Delicious menu and great atmosphere we will be back again next year.

reviews.author: stacyb12380
reviews.title: Dinner
reviews.text: Jacqueline was amazing ! Great service I highly recommend Mowry & Cotton. I had a 5 year old and she was great with accommodating her. Food and atmosphere was very good. We stayed at the Phoenician for 5 days and it was the best!

reviews.author: mike79123
reviews.title: High end experience
reviews.text: This property is generally in the higher end of what Scottsdale has to offer. But pricey for what your getting. But safe bet you’ll get what your expecting. The checking in process could use a little work for those frequent travelers and high level reward members.

reviews.author: VaLawGirl
reviews.title: Is this heaven?
reviews.text: This might be the closest you can get to heaven on earth! My husband and I traveled here for a romantic few days. The grounds, hotel, rooms, and service are all impeccable. The spa is amazing. We will be back and next time with our kids b/c there are so many cool things for them to do that I felt badly for not bringing them!

reviews.author: Andrew S
reviews.title: Food and Server were amazing!!!
reviews.text: We are a group of friends from PA and it was our last night and just wanted a nice dinner to end the trip... WELL, we got more than we asked for!!! We were probably louder than most groups that they are used to but never treated us like outcasts! The food was amazing, the server was funny, super patient and playfully put up with our shenanigans! If I ever have the chance to come back, I would do it all over again, no doubts about it! 10/10 would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Amanda B
reviews.title: Everything was amazing!
reviews.text: The food and service was wonderful! Our waiter Luis was great...Even played our crazy game our table was playing. Food was great, nice atmosphere and really good food options! Thank you to the staff for a great final dinner at the Phoenician!

reviews.author: CTinCT01
reviews.title: Exceptional food, drink and service
reviews.text:
On a recent spa weekend in Scottsdale with girlfriends, we decided to have dinner at Mowry + Cotton on our first night. To put it simply, the experience we had was nothing short of exceptional.

Let me begin by saying we were fortunate to have Jacqueline as our server. Never before have my friends and I received that level of customer service! She is everything a company specializing in hospitality could want. She was warm, engaging and beyond helpful. She offered the perfect food and drink recommendations, was attentive and made the dining experience fantastic. 

We only came in for small bites, so we didn’t eat any large meals. However, we ordered several items, and here are the highlights she recommended - the brussel sprouts! The best any of us ever had! We also enjoyed a mojito-like cocktail that was very refreshing. The chocolate cake was perfection! Not to forget her wine recommendations! Love the sparkling white that is reserved solely for the Phoenician. Would highly recommend!

Thank you Jacqueline for such a wonderful dining experience. While my friends and I live in CT, I’m originally from Scottsdale and visit several times a year. I will definitely be back with friends and family on future trips!

reviews.author: Aaron_likes_2_travel
reviews.title: The Phoenician
reviews.text: Was the nicest resort I have been to in the intercontinental united states. Its huge, lots to offer. Multiple bars and places to eat (expensive, but the quality I'd top notch). Waiters/Waitresses address you by name, provide great service. The meeting areas are huge. Everyone was very accommodating. Cozy rooms, and amazing views!!!! Trails galore, pool upon pools, it was great. We will come back and bring the family next time.

reviews.author: Fearless652428
reviews.title: very nice resort
reviews.text: enjoyed our time there. Everyone was very helpful.  The food was excellent and different, nice to have a taste of the south west.  There is a lot of walking here, for anywhere you want to go so for someone who doesn't move so well, that was a challenge.

reviews.author: vernon2088
reviews.title: Relaxing Bliss
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights at the Phoenician during our round trip in the US. We enjoyed the resort at its fullest. The resort is very comfortable and despite it size everything is quickly accessible, our room was fantastic and the 3 of us enjoyed our stay. Most important is the whole staff, from checing in to the service during breakfast and the staff around the pool were outstanding. Very friendly and welcoming atmosphere.

reviews.author: neilmcallister2019
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, and room.  Great place for a  business conference.  I only wish we could have stayed there longer.   I hope we get to go there again. The event evening dinners were spectacular.   Truly a privilege to go there

reviews.author: kimjhatchett
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Wonderful resort . Beautiful grounds. 110 percent costumers service ! Great pools and restaurants.
Call you by name. Wonderful spa! Will come again. Wish they had an additional casual restaurant . ........

reviews.author: Barb M
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds.
reviews.text: Well located.  Well appointed rooms.  The Marketplace was a good place to eat with a nice selection of quick food.  The salesperson in the store area was very helpful, as was everyone on staff we had contact with.

reviews.author: Anne Percell
reviews.title: Our favorite resort in the valley of the sun
reviews.text: You can't go wrong at The Phoenician. It is wonderful. The pools are great, if possible during peak times, try to get a suite near the private pools. Either way, luxury is the name of the game. The Phoenician will always be my favorite resort out of all the resorts in the area.

reviews.author: LJ Z
reviews.title: The absolute best!
reviews.text: The staff at The Phoenician consistently goes above and beyond for their guests. I’ve stayed there over a dozen times and am never disappointed. Breakfast begins the day at Mowry & Cotton with Christine who always starts my day off right with smiles, laughs and great food. Not only that, she remembers my favorite dishes and is never too busy to make sure I’m taken care of. At the bar at Mowry & Cotton, Myron makes the best old fashioned’s and keeps the bar lively. In addition, Paige at the concierge desk always greets me by name and is genuinely interested in making sure my stay never disappoints. Wayne and Ana at the spa’s front desk similarly go above and beyond with service requests and treating guests like they’re one of a kind. Finally, Daniel manages reception and room requests with efficiency and courtesy always striving to accommodate guest requests. The bottom line is I wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else in Phoenix but The Phoenician.

reviews.author: Taylor B
reviews.title: You get what you pay for -- a lot of luxury
reviews.text: The Phoenician in Scottsdale, Arizona, is a luxury resort. If you don't want to pay for it, there are other options in town. In our travels, over the last 40 years, my wife and I choose to live on the road as we live at home. Very comfortably. Located at 6000 East Camelback Road, the Phoenician has six floors, 557 rooms, 28 suites, 24-hour room service, an on-site laundry, barber and beauty shop, florist, concierge, swimming pools, fitness center, business center, spa, golf course and sundry/convenience story. Did I forget anything. Oh, yes. Three restaurants and an indoor/outdoor bar patio. For our three-day stay, we booked a  DeLuxe Guest Room with 600 square feet of space, king-size bed, private balcony, oversized marble bathroom, separate tub and shower, iron and ironing board, coffee maker, fireplace, wet bar, mini-bar, 55-inch HDTV, sofa, work desk and table for two. The staff knew we were coming, well in advance, and treated us like family. Which is the way you like to be treated, even on an out-of-town vacation.

reviews.author: Rivs63
reviews.title: So disappointing
reviews.text: Ah the photos look awesome and the resort is beautiful with nice staff but seriously $500 usd for the room view we had is simply unforgivable. I will not ever come back. It may be difficult to see but our patio had a 7 ft wall and 6 ft past it was a 12 ft wall. They also kindly put in a 2 ft wall from the ceiling effectively providing us with 18 inches of open space to view the 12 ft wall. Ridiculous that this even exists as a room let alone one that is the same price as rooms that overlook the resort.

reviews.author: Robert Sharman
reviews.title: Business
reviews.text:
Awful! 

The staff are lovely but I was first put off by the check in - a $14 charge for Bellman and $6 charge for housekeeping. 

I arrived with roll on carry on - I don’t need a bellman! I don’t like having to pay for something I don’t use.

Next; terrible room assignment - looking at the driveway and where the cars come into the lobby. I have to acknowledge that the switch over to “Bonvoy” has been terrible. I have stayed at numerous Ritz Carltons over the years - I was at their Lisbon property this spring - usually at the club level - but those records seemed to be lost (including my room preferences). 

Clearly I am no longer a valued client of this new mega hotel chain.

Then their “upscale steakhouse”. I arrived without reservation and was told that they only had room at the bar or a series of tables along the window. Ok. The low slung chairs that were less than 5 feet from either area - that looked invited - I was told was only for “drinks”! Why? Why can’t you serve me the food there?

I was told to sit myself at any empty table - so I did. I was then approached by one of the hostess and told that I couldn’t sit at the table! Why? They were promising it for some else! So it’s not first come first served?

I’m here on a conference by a company I do a lot of business with. Neither they nor Marriott are likely to get much more of my patronage?after this experience.

reviews.author: Jackrio3
reviews.title: They have a pet HAWK!
reviews.text:
Wow! What a great place to stay. I will admit it is a bit expensive but completely worth it. There is a little play water park for the kids and a nice private pool for the adults. The restaurants are fantastic and the staff is just phenomenal. I would 100% recommend  this hotel to anyone. Best hotel in Arizona!
P.S. They have a super cool hawk that keeps pests and unwanted birds away!

reviews.author: LGP6868
reviews.title: Lovely resort, great service
reviews.text:
It’s hard to imagine that it could have been better.  The grounds and facilities are beautiful.  The room was spacious, comfortable, spotlessly clean, and the thermostat was actually responsive.  The bed was comfy, with good quality linens.  And since bathtubs are going the way of the dinosaurs, I LOVED having that big soaking tub. 
The staff was courteous and responsive.
The spa — THE SPA — oh my.  One of the most beautiful spas I’ve ever visited.  And my massage might be the best I’ve ever had.  A bit pricey, yes.  But worth the splurge.

reviews.author: ira r
reviews.title: Unwelcomed guest(s)
reviews.text: Upon checking in I was given an inferior room to what was reserved and confirmed via the “customer experience”, I also had the pleasure of sharing my room with some friends (attached is a picture of one).  Horrible service attempting to accommodate, I would have expected this from an econo lodge.....

reviews.author: Dawgsluver
reviews.title: Perfect trip to Arizona
reviews.text: The Phoenician Resort, at the base of Camel Back Mountain, is an amazing resort. Stephanie, the concierge was perfect in setting up activities. A and J and Mallory and Cotton were spectacular. The chef, servers, and bar tenders prepared everything perfectly. Great new flavors, especially the Ginger Tequila Moscow Mule.  Naoti  gave the best Cactus Garden Tour. He is a plethora of knowledge and truly loves his career. Can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Doug R
reviews.title: One of Scottsdale’s Best
reviews.text: Staying in the Canyon suites at the Phoenician is a special experience. You get your own private entrance and all the rooms are well appointed. A private pool and its own workout facility is great. 24 hour concierge service keeps all your needs met.

reviews.author: Joanne
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: This is an expensive hotel but it is awesome.  The grounds are beautiful but definitely spaced out.  It is a little tricky to get around sometimes.  The rooms are beautiful.  The service is outstanding.  Great amenties from spa to fitness to pools and play areas.  Very good food.  We were part of a group and they took care of us very well.

reviews.author: invisione2
reviews.title: The Phoenician is like Heaven!
reviews.text: This place is amazing!  It is located in a great part of town with easy access to everything.  The resort has great amenities:  pool, kids pool, golf, restaurants and a world class gym and spa.  The staff is at the peak of their game in hospitality and everything was handled with the utmost care and respect.  Also, everything is updated with technology and convenience - high speed internet and automation.  I will certainly be back again in the near future.

reviews.author: mitchellh330
reviews.title: Phoenician
reviews.text: Excellent facility and amenities.  Location is really good and near major shopping.  Outstanding service as well as food selection.  This is a must in terms of a resort  vacation and/or meeting place.  The golf course is well-designed, challenging with rewards.  And is well maintained.

reviews.author: Peter S
reviews.title: Classic Scottsdale Resort
reviews.text: The Phoenician offers a beautiful setting at the base of Camelback mountain. It is close to Old Town Scottsdale, but it’s not necessary to leave the resort. They offer everything to ensure a great stay.

reviews.author: Rosa R
reviews.title: Hi tea at the Phoenician Scottsdale resort in Scottsdale Arizona
reviews.text: Amazing resort incredible staff !! Wanda who served us high tea with such professionalism and knowledge was outstanding. Her caring beautiful smile and great presentation of all the types of tea and delicious food was remarkable. On a scale from 1 to 10 I give it a 20. A must do while in Scottsdale Arizona Dr Roman

reviews.author: Anne M
reviews.title: Monty and Cotton
reviews.text:
Totally an amazing experience!!!!

Five stars all the way. Our server Christine at Monty and Cotton at the Phoenician Hotel was excellent and went overboard to treat us in the most special way !!!!

Delicious good and service was extraordinary!!!!

reviews.author: Saxfro
reviews.title: Mowry &Cotton
reviews.text: Just had my first experience at Mowry &Cotton. DELICIOUS! The food was fresh and cooked to perfection. The service from Christine was timely and knowledgeable. I will definitely love to come back and stay longer! Great job.

reviews.author: MananaNoMas
reviews.title: Very Impressed with Great First Impression
reviews.text: This was my first visit to the resort. I loved it. I took my Mountain Bike as the area is full of decent trails to ride. The catering at the event with Chef Carlos was on point and my room was clean. I was amazed to see the workout center - especially before sunrise - huge!

reviews.author: galehiggs
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is extraordinarily just right.  From the ever attentive staff to the spa services, attention to the details of creating a great experience for the traveler is consistent.  The on-site restaurants are definitely delicious.
The rooms are great and the bars a great amenities package.

reviews.author: Allen G
reviews.title: Holiday Love Getaway
reviews.text: Sweet getaway and so relaxing. Pools fantastic, Food was very tasty. Staff exceptional. We visited the nearby mall and old town Scottsdale to make a full day in Scottsdale. Lots to do and see at night

reviews.author: SunandSkiFam
reviews.title: Superb overall experience
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Phoenician.   We had one of the updated rooms overlooking the pool in the main building and it was beautiful.   From service at check-in to drinks by the pool and in the lobby bar, to dinner at Mowry and Cotton, we experienced superb service.   The halibut at dinner was one of my top 3 resort meals ever.   We didn't order dessert but saw the "donuts" delivered next to us with the amazing choices of syrup.  We wished we had ordered dessert!  Only recommendation would be to add table cloths and candles for evening service or something to class it up a bit from the daytime, by the pool look and experience.  Loved the cactus garden, and all the impeccable grounds.   We can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.title: Great resort for a quick weekend getaway to warmer weather.
reviews.text:
We spend a few weekends a year during Chicago's colder months in Scottsdale and have been coming back to the Phoenician in recent years for a few reasons:
