1) The accommodations and room amenities are terrific. The bed are extremely comfortable and the housekeeping staff is top notch. The room sizes are also very generous.

2) The food and beverage offerings are substantial. The breakfast at Mowry and Cotton was probably the best breakfast I've had at any property in the Marriott system. The bartenders in the lobby bar were extremely knowledgeable about mixology and made some great custom drinks for our group. (not to mention the great outdoor firepits and views) 

3) Cabanas by the pool are definitely worth the upgrade. They feature 55" tvs which are great for football game days, and the service was highly attentive - solid staff to guest ratios.

4) The tennis facilities are top notch with knowledgeable staff and plenty of available court times. I was not able to play golf this trip but the course is supposedly very nice after a substantial rehab.

This resort property doesn't skip a beat. Will be back in early 2020.

reviews.author: Kendall Cowden
reviews.title: Fabulous Babymoon/Birthday Weekend
reviews.text: My husband and I had never vacationed together in Scottsdale and were looking for a good resort for a relaxing babymoon getaway. A friend suggested The Phoenician, and we went for it. I am so glad that we did! First of all, the property is gorgeous. It is large, without being ridiculously huge. The flowers and cacti everywhere are meticulously kept, and all of the employees were SO friendly. They made you feel like they genuinely wanted to be your friend. Upon checking in, Lavendar at the front desk gave us a King Pool View w/balcony Casita room. I questioned her and said I didn’t think that’s what we booked. Little did I know, what we got was way better than what I thought we had booked! Our room was fabulous with a gorgeous view of both pools, and the gardens. We were able to just walk right out of the casita to the pool, or head on over to the restaurants and shops. Be sure and eat at Mowry & Cotton for breakfast, and the pool side lunch was really good too. Lastly, the best part of our stay was coming back to our room to find the sweetest note and gifts from Lavendar at the front desk. She had sent up sparkling cider (remember: babymoon), champagne glasses, candy, a little stuffed animal cactus, a “desert babies” baby book, and a happy birthday cannoli! We have never received such a thoughtful and complimentary gift at any hotel ever! Lavendar was so thoughtful, and we cannot wait to return to The Phoenician with our son someday!

reviews.author: Ram L
reviews.title: Poor Value for Money - Disappointing Luxury Resort
reviews.text: Very disappointing!  Great property.  Great facilities.  Spacious and clean rooms.  But poorly trained staff.  Lousy processes - right from hotel check in, restaurant seating to navigation around the hotel.   Poor signage.  Meager amenities in the bathroom.   High room rates and a number of junk fees/surcharges - such as porterage fees, housekeeping charges, resort fees, service surcharge, etc.  The swimming pool is not a lap pool but just a bobbing kids pool.   Lousy table service at the breakfast restaurant Mowry and Cotton.   Terribly understaffed.   Lackadaisical management.    We visited for a College Reunion and had to escalate the issues several times to get the necessary attention.   The hotel services don’t even cross the minimum threshold - let alone match the standards expected of a five star hotel.   Poor value for money!   We do not intend to return to this facility.   Terribly disappointing.

reviews.author: Paige T
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Shelly was a fantastic server and very knowledgeable about the property and history! Our food was delicious and drinks were amazing as well. The brunch menu had great options. Would definitely come back again.

reviews.author: GGR
reviews.title: Best Service
reviews.text: We had the best service at Mowry and Cotton in The Phoenician Hotel. Our server, Christine went out of her way to bring us the perfect breakfast. There should be more wonderful people like her. This is a person who loves her job.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: Breakfast at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: We came to the Phoenician for a quick staycation and dined at Mowry & Cotton for breakfast. Great menu. The buffet was delicious, the setting was beautiful and our server Christian was great! Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: jogbra
reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Great outdoor area and interesting menu with selections to fit most---Brunch was not to pricey--Dj plays on Sat-sun.--Our server Christine went above and beyond--brought a special dessert out for our birthday girl--

reviews.author: KaktusJaque
reviews.title: Lunch
reviews.text: Christian was great, would love to have him serve us again! We will be asking for him next time we visit here. The restaurant was very nice as well. I had the egg tacos which were very tasty too. The wife had the Black Bean burger that she loved as well. Thanks Christian.

reviews.author: Vegas123
reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton breakfast
reviews.text: Christine was awesome for service! Food fantastic. Great views. Best breakfast in Phoenix and Scottsdale Arizona. Good lunch and dinner as well. Near the pools and very scenic views. Make sure to ask for Christine.

reviews.author: Alice
reviews.title: This hotel refused clean room
reviews.text: This hotel’s front desk person Christine Ranken said: they don’t clean room until we check out . We lived this hotel three day . But from day 1 to day 3, we keep requested clean room . But the Christine Ranken said: They don’t provide  room clean service until we check out . So we feel very uncomfortable when we lived the hotel 3 days .

reviews.author: Nahermann
reviews.title: Lunch
reviews.text: Christian gave us exceptional service!!! We just arrived & immediately made us feel we are on vacation 😀 he made my bday special too-we loved our lunch-loved the donuts too-we are excited to be here at Phoeniciam

reviews.author: Rick H
reviews.title: The gem of Scottsdale!
reviews.text:
OK - every year we take our kids (10 & 7) somewhere new to explore a different part of the country.  We just spend 4 nights and 5 days at The Phoeician and it was without a doubt the best trip we've ever take.  Bare with me, i will attempt to do the trip justice :)

First - the staff was world class. Michelle and the concierge team was fantastic - every recommendation from a breakfast spot, to dinner, to our big activities (ATV's in the desert and horseback riding at a legit ranch) were perfect.  She took care of everything went above and beyond for our family.   If you spend ANY time at the pool, seek out Heather - she was so attentive to us and the kids and completely made our 2 days at the pool - and Im pretty sure about 20 other families felt the same way!!!

The food (at all the restaruants) is much better than expected.  the golf course is absolutely gorgeous, and the new athletic club is well done with a kick butt game room downstairs that the kids loved.

Rooms were great, we went with a fire table casita for more space and got a great view of camelback mountain.  Big bathrooms and  walk in closets made it easy to have enough space for the four of us.  Onsite car rental, Fun-icians child care for a date nite out, cabana one day at the pool - im pretty sure we used every service they had and all were above par.  Pair this with incredible views of camelback mountain, perfect weather and being 20 mins from the airport and you have a WIN!

reviews.author: Krista
reviews.title: Best brunch
reviews.text:
Hey there! 

We stopped to have brunch at the Cotton Mowry on Sunday morning and got the lox and bagels! Very good and plenty of salmon! Our server Christine was awesome she got us a refill of our coffee that we had brought from the Marketplace for no extra charge!

reviews.author: bharrison6
reviews.title: Great customer service!
reviews.text: Austen at the Mowry restaurant was a superb server! So friendly, happy. Great food (especially breakfast) and atmosphere. Juices are yummy too. Highly recommend coming to resort both to stay and eat here. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Sparkyxxx
reviews.title: Treated like royalty
reviews.text:
We were asked if we would move from a Hilton hotel to here because of an issue with other people's rooms and it turned out to be an enjoyable switch. The staff were very friendly and the view surrounding the place is magnificent.
Our only issue was with the cocktails we had at the restaurants onsite. For the amount of money they charge for the cocktail, your glass comes out 3/4 full. I said something the first time to the waiter and they fixed it. The second time it happened, we decided we would go to offsite restaurants.

reviews.author: Klcboyd
reviews.title: Would go back but request a room with bigger beds.
reviews.text: Two my girlfriends and I recently stayed at the Phoenician. We enjoyed our visit and would definitely go back but it’s important to be aware that the beds in the Casitas are only doubles. We were quite disappointed but luckily two of us are quite small. From our understanding the resort was completely re-done recently but we still found the main rooms of the casitas a little tired. Bathrooms are very nice. We enjoyed the resort itself and found the food very good. The staff was quite friendly and fairly attentive although a few little things were forgotten such as cutlery by the pool when we ordered food. We loved our services at the spa and felt that the spa was very high end. That being said, we spent the afternoon at the spa pool and were quite disappointed. It was very rowdy considering the Zen atmosphere of the rest of the spa. There was a group of young women who were partying quite heavily at 11:30 in the morning as well as another business group who basically held a conference poolside. We had to listen to the whole strategy of their upcoming business meeting. Given the amount of pools at the Phoenician we really felt that the spa pool should be a quiet relaxing place to enjoy after you’ve had your spa service. Certainly a nice glass of Prosecco or something would be appropriate to enjoy poolside but the two groups we encountered were not what one would expect at a spa.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text:
Beautiful property.  Very well kept with outstanding service; everyone we interacted with was friendly and professional.  Food much better than expected and fairly priced (for a resort).  Food at pool a nice surprise.  Concierge services very helpful.  Some nice touches.  And remember, it is AZ, drink water!

However, I did not notice recycling in most of the property, which should be improved.

reviews.author: Succeed-or-fail
reviews.title: Liars
reviews.text:
They have horrendous customer service and the experience is nowhere near worthy of five stars.
1. They abandon visitors when they visit further away areas of the property for more than 30 minutes.
2. They overcharge for everything.
3. They ignore your concerns both while you’re there and after.
Etc.
Don’t go to this hotel. The JW Marriott is 1000% better.

reviews.author: Tuscany3423
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Have stayed at the Phoenician a few times and this last trip was great as always. Changed rooms at check in and information was not updated which created a couple issues but overall staff resolved. The resort is beautiful and well maintained and having Camelback as a background is amazing. Getting to trailhead to hike up is a short walk from the resort and well worth doing!

reviews.author: Brad R
reviews.title: Fantastic, Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
This resort is amazing!  My wife, 6 month old, and I visited Scottsdale for 5 nights and couldn't have enjoyed the resort more. Service, People, Hotel, Grounds, Room, Pools were SO nice.  Completely updated and very kid friendly - with an adults only pool if you want privacy and quiet. Splash pad and Slide were big hits with kids. Hotel upgraded us to a casita, which was beyond amazing. Nicest hotel room I've stayed in!  Highly, highly recommend this resort... great location near downtown Scottsdale, Camelback Mountain, and everything the area has to explore. Easy 5 star review.   The Falcon and cactus garden were added bonuses and very cool

Only complaints?  no baby changing stations in any of the hotels bathrooms, which we thought was weird.  Also, the menu at the main restaurant (Mowry's) is very limited and we thought the food was so-so. That said - very small issues and would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: victoria s
reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton restaurant
reviews.text: Really enjoyable experience eating outside. Christine was a superb waiter and really looked after us beautifully. great food selection and beautiful surroundings.the hotel really is a treat to stay in.beautiful rooms and facilities and the staff are outstanding.

reviews.author: RobertT
reviews.title: Beyond Perfection!
reviews.text: Everything you could possibly want, expect and dream there have and provide in an atmosphere of true beauty and bliss. Every pampered service has been taken into consideration and delivered by kind and gracious staff. It’s one of my favorite destinations to stay.

reviews.author: Captain Fred
reviews.title: Luxury delivered
reviews.text: Just when I thought that five star service had disappeared from resorts, this property proved me wrong.  From the welcoming bellman to the waitress in J&G Steakhouse, each interaction with staff was remarkable. The property is extremely well maintained and it is clear that service excellence is practiced by all staff.  Gennaro at the pool bar exemplified guest service and made us feel like we were family. Christina in the nail salon delivered one of the best manicure experiences I’ve had. Surprisingly, this is one resort that prices services, especially food, at reasonable prices and makes you want to remain on property for meals. Location is great, less than 10 minutes from Old Town. The property and experience is worth the price.

reviews.author: Mukund A
reviews.title: High Tea
reviews.text: A wonderful place to spend an afternoon. Delicious snacks with world class teas. Very elegant and charming surroundings. The teas were from all over the world. The food kept on coming! Delicious finger sandwiches followed by scrumptious scones and these followed by wonderful deserts. The service was super. Friendly and prompt. Just a great place.

reviews.author: Veezador
reviews.title: 5 Stars All Around, Great Getaway
reviews.text: 5 star service, 5 star food, and 5 amazing pools open 24/7. Beautiful resort and scenery (impressive cactus garden and views of camelback mountain), and all restaurants are top notch and have outdoor seating. Will definitely return.

reviews.author: Timbo23
reviews.title: Very Accomodating;
reviews.text: Room was fantastic!  6th Floor facing East.  View of Golf course; Sunrises every morning and a large deck for chillin'.  Housekeeping was spot on. Hotel services were timely and happy to assist.  Found "The Tavern" to be a great restaurant with big screen sports programming running.  Perfect for the weekend of Sports.

reviews.author: Rsprenk
reviews.title: Very nice in general. A few minor things lacking.
reviews.text: We were here with a group so overall we found the bell service and front desk to be attentive. Only one person at check in desk on a Saturday though which seemed inefficient. We ended up with a very large King room on the mountain/cactus garden side. Based on our experience and other reviews I would avoid this “view” if we visit again. Choose a view of the pool. There were a few little bugs near the door but nothing earth shattering. Bathroom was large but shower portion seemed small. No ledge for a woman to shave her legs. Not even sure I could have bent over. It always surprises me when hotels have a large toilet room and could have used some of that space for the shower.  Especially since everything has been recently remodeled I believe. Towels were large and luxurious. Soap and shampoo had a more manly aroma.  Pillows were thin and flimsy but bed was comfortable. If we kept it turned down the room stayed cool but no sun on our side of the building due to the mountain. Breakfast room service was delicious and very prompt - 30 minutes or less. Pricey though.  I made several calls to reserve a cabana. Only received one return call on my cell. Surprised a message wasn’t left in my room.   Amber the concierge or someone nearer to a phone should manage these reservations. So the day that I wanted one I headed down to the adult pool early.  There was one available. Christine was wonderful and poolside food was good with many healthy choices. .

reviews.author: badassbk13
reviews.title: Phoenician
reviews.text: Started off kind of rocky. We had to change to different room due to bugs and there was a scorpion found when moving out the old room. After that everything was really good. The staff are very friendly and helpful. J&G restaurant was excellent.Very good location. Close to everything. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained.

reviews.author: Ruchi Singh
reviews.title: PATHETIC SAFETY AND MANAGEMENT!!
reviews.text:
There was a SNAKE IN MY ROOM, and I had to deal with the snake myself. The management did not care to change my room, alert other guests or make up for my inconvenience. I sent a written complaint last week and the management does not seem to care at all. Here is the full sequence of events:

- I dealt with the snake myself, while the room-service staff stood dumbfound. On top of that, no hotel staff cared to look for the snake as it escaped! None of my neighbors were alerted about the presence of a snake in that wing.

- I was not offered to change or upgrade the room. I had to ask for a room change. The receptionist replied to my request by saying, "would you come collect the keys from the lobby, or should I send it to you?"

- Hotel management just offered to cover my resort fee for my troubles. This is neither adequate nor helpful.

- at the check-out, the front desk manager asked me, "please do not write any email to customer service, instead reach out to the hotel staff for any further discussion."

- finally, when I reached out to the Marriott Bonvoy customer service, they looped me back to the front desk staff at The Phoenician. (These were the people who didn't care at all in the first place). I have not received any response since then, and it has been about a week since I flagged the concern.

reviews.author: Lovesarahk
reviews.title: DONT STAY HERE! WASTE OF MONEY
reviews.text:
Please turn around and leave and waste your money on any other hotel but this one! It’s not what your expecting when you pay almost $700 for your room for one night! SUPER small room, comparison to a Holiday Inn room size. Not a 5 star room AT ALL! Pictures online worked it up and not honest reviews. 
We couldn’t even stay, wasn’t worth out money.

reviews.author: Rich B
reviews.title: Tried to make reservations and observations from a previous stay as a Marriott Titanium member
reviews.text:
Long and short the Hotel is very nice. The rooms are very nice, up to date, there are stores and very good dining options, the pool and the work our facility is first rate.  The location is very reasonable as well.

So why only 4 stars?  It just feels like the staff in general gets a bad attitude if you are Marriott member with status and ask for an upgrade... it is almost like you have insulted them.  This happened on a recent stay a few months ago and they reluctantly upgraded me, and recently tried to go back and noticed the same attitude when I tried to make a reservation and referenced Marriott status.  

The hotel is very nice, but just get the feeling they do not like being part of the Marriott program.  If you do not care about taking advantage of status accrued then this hotels is hard to beat.

Ended up at Four Seasons this last time and they just upgraded us because they could.  Just saying....

reviews.author: larwilson
reviews.title: Warm and Wonderful
reviews.text:
This was our first time at this hotel, recommended by a family member.  The bell staff and the "O" team went above and beyond our expectations.  The friendliness and attentiveness of the staff was very high.  So often we were greeted by name, on the phone and in the restaurant.  This went a long way to adding to our high level of satisfaction. 

The room was very large/spacious (we had upgraded and were glad we did).  There was a burned out light in the closet that was fixed promptly.  The bathroom was very nice and large but the way the shower door opened onto the sink area was a bit tight.  Would have liked some hooks on the wall in the room.  Furniture was stained in a couple of places.  Carpeting looked good.  Beds were comfortable...would have liked softer pillows (but not a deal breaker).  

Air conditioning struggled a little bit to keep up with the warmth outside (felt a bit humid in the room; but for the most part OK.)  Excellent television.  Decent coffeemaker (could have used more pods of coffee/tea).  Very good bath toiletries.  Turn down service was excellent.  Housekeeping service was excellent.  The large undetached mirror resting on the floor was a bit strange, as it was not totally usable.  Plenty of outlets for recharging cell phones and IPADS--great!  Plenty of storage/closet space for clothing.  Nice large deck for enjoying coffee in the morning.  We had a view of the tennis courts looking south.

The pools and spa are fantastic.  Plenty of comfortable sunbeds and umbrellas.  Excellent service in both facilities (highly recommend the spa). The pool team makes sure you have ice water and other refreshments.  The restaurant Mowery and Cotton is above average; good food; not cheap.  Very attentive and helpful staff.  The Thirsty Camel bar is convenient and attractive.  We had very good service the afternoon we hung out there.  

I was not impressed with the coffee shop.  Went in to get coffee one morning and waited three or four minutes before leaving without being acknowledged by staff.  I wasn’t the only one cooling my heels waiting to be served.    Unfortunate.  Nice range of shops and conveniently linked to reception via a walkway.

We took advantage of the hotel car to the airport.  A great decision.  Very convenient and a very nice driver made our trip to the airport easy and enjoyable.  

The best thing to say about the Phoenician is their dedication and attention to personal service.  We also were treated very well by staff via email before we arrived.  Very caring attention to questions and providing help...

We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Alie C
reviews.title: Gem of PHX
reviews.text: Beautiful, well maintained, high-end resort! Awesome amenities - exceptionally equipped fitness center, with golf & tennis available on-site, beautiful variety of pools with great service staff (especially Heather, who took superb care of us each day at the pool!), great restaurants and amazing view of Camelback Mt from almost everywhere on the resort. Visited for a long weekend getaway with my husband and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Rick Wolf
reviews.title: Phoenician Marriott Scottsdale Arizona
reviews.text: Phoenician Marriott Scottsdale Arizona  was a wonderful resort. The pool area was immaculate and the service was first rate. Special mention to Sam Balad Who went above and beyond and his service to myself and to all the other guests. All of the staff throughout the hotel was extremely courteous and professional. I would go back to the resort again and again and again.

reviews.author: Jonathan P
reviews.title: Extraordinary service
reviews.text: The Phoenician staff are amazing! Sarah from the front desk is an absolute gem and a pleasure to deal with.  I cannot recall a time when staff of any hotel had ever been so kind and treated me so well.  I adore this establishment and all who work there.

reviews.author: Joshua Zaremba
reviews.title: There is something for everyone at this resort no matter what age.
reviews.text: Imagine a Vegas Resort Hotel without the casino. You could easily spend five days here and still not see the entire compound. I can not believe it took me so long to visit this place. The only thing that outshines the facility is the service.

reviews.author: Dudeckj
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Customer Service
reviews.text:
I am a Marriott Titanium Elite loyalty member whose stayed over 500 nights at Marriotts and close to 50 thus far this year.  In late July I inadvertently booked the prepay rate at the Phoenician for December and was then charged $2027 on my credit card.  On August 8, when I realized what I'd done, I went to cancel the reservation and saw that it had to be cancelled within 24 hours.  

I've now spent close to a month since then trying to get my money back and am not even getting a response!  I was told by Marriott that it is a local property decision and after going through the hotel's process, they denied my request.  I subsequently was told by another hotel representative that they would address the situation and have not heard thing in well over a week despite two additional e-mail inquiries. 

I am incredibly disappointed in Marriott and the Phoenician for the following reasons:
1) It is not clear enough on Marriott's website that you are about to be charged for a pre-pay.  It looks too much like a regular reservation. 
2) A 24 hour cancellation window is basically just a money grab, as there isn't anything the hotel is going to do with the room requiring that short a window.
3) It is ridiculous that Marriott would leave their loyalty program in the hands of an individual property.  I've subsequently cancelled 7 additional Marriott reservations I had this year, as I travel over 100,000 air miles and at least 20 weeks per year. 
4) The Marriott customer service people were HORRIBLE!  They acted like I was just a bother, not someone at a premier loyalty level.
5) There is absolutely no reason the Phoenician couldn't give me at least some of the pre-pay back, if not all.  It's not like I cancelled even a month in advance - I cancelled with over FOUR MONTHS for them to book the room, which I'm sure they will during the holiday season.

While the hotel may be nice, Marriott and the hotel's customer service are something to be very concerned about if you are considering staying!

reviews.author: 0727alexandrab
reviews.title: Luxurious resort
reviews.text: I have stayed here twice and loved it each time. The newly renovated spa is one of the best you could find in the entire country. It was pure luxury. The decor has recently been updated in the entire resort and is more modern now which I preferred the older style, however most probably like the updating. Service throughout the entire hotel was good but I felt it was much better the first time back in February 2017. The restaurant choices are a great variety. Room service takes he cake 24-7 and wonderful in-room service. Will be back

reviews.author: Marty
reviews.title: Make sure you review your hotel bill!
reviews.text: The good: property is beautiful, great golf course, and most of the staff helpful.  The Bad: kept getting seated for breakfast with the same obnoxious and sarcastic waiter. We askedk to be seated outside and he’d be assigned.  We’d asked to be seated inside and he’d be assigned.  He thinks he’s making jokes of denying service or the check, but we didn't find it funny.  We had pleasant service at the other restaurants, but this tainted our dining experience overall.   Now for the big reason  we gave this property a 2.  Upon check out we noticed a $174 food and alcohol charge on our bill that we didn’t make.  We brought it up to the front desk and it took 30 minutes to fix. They acted like we were in the wrong.  I asked to speak to a manager but the clerk never got one.  I asked for the copy receipt you sign for room charges and they couldn’t produce it. Just a print out of enough food and drink for 4 people and we are a single couple.  No apology either.  I’ve been a platinum Marriott elite for several years and I’ve never been treated with such disrespect.   They need to educate some of their staff on customer service.  Mistakes happen, but it’s how they handled it that was extremely disappointing.

reviews.author: Married Traveler
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text:
My wife and I travel a lot for both work and pleasure. This time was for 4 nights for pleasure and our first time at the Phoenician. We absolutely loved every second, I hope we get an opportunity to go back. 

Each time we would leave the resort to explore Scottsdale and got back to the Phoenician we were always mesmerized by how well the grounds were maintained. Beautiful property, beautiful golf course, beautiful Mountain View’s. 

Check in was a breeze. Very friendly staff, very informative and knowledgeable as well. Our flight landed early in the morning so we were hoping to only drop our bags off and come back later but our room was ready when we arrived, and they upgraded us to a one bedroom casita suite with a fire table. Now, my wife and I do a lot of research before we book our hotels and have seen mixed reviews about the casitas so we didn’t know what to expect. We got to the room and were amazed how nice it was, I don’t understand the negative reviews. The room was clean, well appointed, comfy bed, really nice bathrooms and showers, awesome patio with the fire table. Very short walk to the pool. Parking was easy. 

The pools were amazing, the service at all the pools were even better. The staff out there were really working hard to make sure everyone was happy. Always made sure we had a full cold pitcher of water, they would adjust the umbrellas for you when the sun shifted throughout the day, they came by often to take food and drink orders, very friendly staff. Food and drinks were pretty delicious too.

The location of the Phoenician is really great too. We did a lot of relaxing at the resort but we also wanted to explore Scottsdale and even did a quick trip out to Sedona as well. Everything was super easy to get to from the hotel, close to a ton of restaurants and stores and Old Town Scottsdale, easy drive to downtown Phoenix, easy drive to the airport, easy drive up to the start of the camelback trailhead etc. 

Definitely would recommend this hotel to anyone! We loved our stay!

reviews.author: Joe H
reviews.title: Simply perfect...
reviews.text: We come every year and there is a reason. Such a lovely property and such great service from Christine at the pool to Kyle in Mowry and Cotton, we love your food too! Diner at J & G was amazing. We love the mother of pearl pool.  Fantastic vacation thank you Phoenician...

reviews.author: Pkellynola
reviews.title: Girls Spa Trip
reviews.text: On our first night we visited Mowry and Cotton restaurant on the property. We were not feeling exceptionally hungry so we sat at the bar and ordered some wine.  Our bartenders Myron and Shelly were so welcoming and friendly. We ordered the tomato flatbread pizza that was excellent!  We then had more wine and dessert!!  So much for not being hungry!! Myron and Shelly were such great hosts! Ask for them when you visit.

reviews.author: Charmaine R
reviews.title: Wanda
reviews.text:
Wonderful tea, Wanda’s Service made the tea FABULOUS!!
Highly recommend.....tea, scones, desserts, champagne!!!! Delicious!
Ask for Wanda!!!!  Wonderful for a group of ladies anytime of year!
Christmas is particularly spectacular.

reviews.author: Moll E
reviews.title: Great service at the Phoenician pool!
reviews.text: It all began on a scorching hot Thursday. Heather Collins was an awesome host at the Phoenician pool!! She made the experience amazing for us. I could say it a million different ways. We’re just very happy about Heather’s service.

reviews.author: kls2291
reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: Heather Collins (and everyone else we encountered) was so welcoming and personable. She took great care of us at the pool and made sure we had a great day. This resort is too notch and so beautiful. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: RaiDoc
reviews.title: Pretty location but well below standard and disinterested service.
reviews.text:
Pretty location nestled into Camelback outcrop. The building and facilities are well designed and appealing. That said the service is what lets these folks down for what is meant to be a 5 star Hotel:
1. Rooms regularly not cleaned properly and serviced very poorly. Clearly no supervision by management.
2. Colleague in wheelchair going to take cab with bags not helped by valets despite them being there and milling around talking.
3. Concierge disinterested and unprofessional...not booking limo despite confirming they had. Also not printing and delivering boarding passes...again confirming they would.
4. Much advertised in-house steak house restaurant had dust clearly showing all around wooden structure.
5. Totally incorrect bill given at check-out
6. When problem arose with concierge not having booked early morning limo for 6.45am - the so called manager on duty simply shruuged his shoulders...really??? Only person to go to as unbeleivably the congierge desk was not mannned until 8.30am.
7. Breakfast Buffet items not being replenished for long periods and extremely ordinary.

reviews.author: marcopolopaloalto
reviews.title: Luxury Resort property, nicely located in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Phoenician

Resort property with pools, golf course, gym complex, and spa. Large, large hotel rooms with sectional couches, ( and large bathrooms with tub and shower) and all quite close to massive pool area with ample lounge chairs and where one can receive towels and a pitcher of ice water, and also receive bar food and drink service.
If you are a Marriott elite member and can get continental breakfast included as an offering... the breakfast near the pool area is worth it: avocado toasts, eggs with quesadillas, yogurt parfaits, and good morning coffee.

Lobby bar area has early nightly live music and tho the bar menu is geared towards meat eaters and long with the complimentary bar snacks are pork rinds ( seriously ?).  Thank you for the lovely cheese plate with sugarized pecans and delicate cheeses . 

Newspapers can be delivered to your room.

Complaints - few, if nil.  The staff Refers to guests as “Mr and Mrs” which seems retro, but others may prefer the formality.  And the country music playlist by the pool and breakfast is atrocious, more in tune with a lower level hotel ! And it takes away from the relaxing nature of reading by the pool !  
Miss the old warmer decor. Hotel seems decorated in cooler grey tones.

Hotel seems to fill up with families on weekends enjoying the pool.

reviews.author: Light1234567
reviews.title: Adventurous. Alone. Attacked. Worst hotel experience as a woman in my lifeRecorded. Should I release it?
reviews.text: The number of female solo travelers has skyrocketed, but amid Instagram-worthy escapades and I never believed I would be one of them in a so called luxury escape...still shaking from my experience of abuse

reviews.author: Janice
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Lovely property, great restaurant, wonderful pool. Nice hotel and loads of fun.  Only issue is that there are a lot of corporate events there and the place can get crazy busy but it was still a lovely experience!

reviews.author: A3411HAjanc
reviews.title: Anniversary vaca
reviews.text: We visited the Phoenician for our anniversary.  We have gone there as a couple, or with family and friends for the past 25 years— if not more.  Always beautiful, and our server Mandy, in the beautifully renovated bar area made our trip more pleasurable due to her exquisite service and contagious smile...

reviews.author: Sarah J
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Excellent Hotel! Loved the pools, rooms, and food. There were 8 girls and we had a great time. Each one of us felt well taken care of. We enjoyed our time there and would look at this hotel for our next stay. Great place for family and friends.

reviews.author: Pam K
reviews.title: Champagne Saturday
reviews.text: Love, Love, Love Champagne Saturday!  This was my second time this year.  My daughter took me on Mother's day weekend and Saturday, I was celebrating birthday month with my best friend as we share the same birthday month.  We decided to stay at the Phoenician so we could both enjoy the champagne and we did!  They do a wonderful job with pairings that really pair well with champagne.  Wanda is delightful!!  She has a way of making you feel very special.  I would reccomend this to everyone, those staying at the hotel and those who live locally.  I'll definely be going again soon!

reviews.author: Brian Lillie
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL RESORT but...
reviews.text:
I just left the Phoenician after staying 2 nights and three days. The resort was lovely, at the foot of a rock formation in Scottsdale, with a well-manicured golf course, perfect tennis courts, a very nice pool and an outstanding athletic facility. The room was really nice but not knock your socks off nice, and the cactus garden behind the bank of rooms we were in is really cool. The breakfast was good, and asking for steak and eggs even though it wasn’t on the menu was a great call because it was delicious (Jorge was a great server). 

The only reasons this wasn’t rated a 5 was the lack of attention to detail in the customer experience. First, room service was only a 4, with the food being messy (I think the plate was sloshed around while being delivered); second, I cancelled a wake up call at the front desk so that my son wasn’t woken up and he said he would take care of it and I found out from my son they called anyway - THREE TIMES - and woke him up; and third, I went to the athletic center and the locker downstairs wasn’t locking and there were no instructions on the lockers, so I called guest services. They said they would send “engineering down to help.” Well...I waited 30 minutes and no one came. Very bad! I ended up bringing my stuff to the athletic center and lugging it around with me. Not a great customer experience.

For a resort that costs this much to stay, I believe these things are unacceptable.

reviews.author: Megan Brock
reviews.title: Afternoon tea
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time at afternoon tea!  We live local but visit at least once a year for birthdays.  Wanda is such a welcoming server we love her! Tea + all three courses tasted great with piano in the background - a Sunday well spent.

reviews.author: Alexis
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea
reviews.text: Afternoon tea is such a fun tradition in my family. I go at least two to three times a year. It is such a joy to see Wanda and Natalie when I am here. Their smile and amazing energy makes the tea time experience so wonderful! It wouldn’t be the same without both of them there. The tea, sandwhiches, scones, and amazing desserts are so fabulous!

reviews.author: Ylesszoe
reviews.title: Amazing Staycation!
reviews.text:
I just had the most amazing staycation at The Phoenician. The entrance to the hotel is grand with a beautiful drive up. The grounds are perfectly manicured. 

Walking in, the lobby is modern and sleek and the front desk staff was so helpful. Daniel checked us in and made feel very welcome. He told us if we needed anything during our stay to reach out. Later in the evening we walked by the desk and asked where we could get deodorant. We spoke with a different agent, who said he would make sure he sent some to our room. Sure enough, when we returned to our room it was there.

One thing I especially liked was that the key packet holder has an insert for their resort map. It’s was placed in there pre-folded and easy to carry around in your pocket. 

Our room was impeccable with modern decor and furnishings. I was very impressed with the bathroom counter space and the deep soaking tubs.

Next we went to the spa, which blew me away. It is brand new with three stories and it has a rooftop pool. It also is rated four stars by Forbes, to give a sense of how luxurious it is. Our check in experience was wonderful with Wayne, who recapped our services and introduced us to someone to show us to the locker room. 

The spa is set up in a way that you don’t have to think about anything. For example in the showers, there was a towel, washcloth, pre packaged razor and shaving cream already there. In the lockers there was a tray for jewelry and a bag for your wet swimsuit. Small touches like those made all the difference. Not to mention, there were plenty of perfectly folded towels available everywhere. 

The relaxation area, sauna, steam room, and whirlpool jacuzzi area were all immaculate and top tier. As a heads up, these facilities are gender specific, not co-ed.

I was lucky to have Suzella as my massage therapist. She was kind and consultative the whole time I was in her care. I got the Sonoran Scrub, Wrap and Massage and it was heavenly. I felt secure and safe with the way I was covered/draped. Not once, did I feel uncomfortable. I fell asleep multiple times, which had never happened to me before. I was 100% relaxed. 

We ate dinner at The Phoenician Tavern later that evening. Giovanna was our server who provided us with great recommendations and service. Make sure to get the tater tots if you go there. They are delicious!!

There are many fine hotels to choose from in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area, but The Phoenician really sets the gold standard. 

Every aspect of the hotel was recently renovated and every person I interacted with was warm and helpful, even during short interactions. All expectations I had were exceeded. If you’re thinking about staying here, just do it. The views and resort itself are gorgeous and you will be so well taken care of.

reviews.author: NPH
reviews.title: Definitely will come back!
reviews.text:
First time in Arizona/Phoenician , definitely won’t be our last. EXCELLENT Service, beautiful property. Stayed on the 4th floor, fantastic room and bathroom (double vanity, oversized bath tub). My husband and I travel often, and this was the best spa resort we’ve ever been to.

Charles at the Spa-best massage I’ve ever had. Jamie Smith, concierge-went above and beyond to make sure our stay was pleasant. Chill staff: Jessica, Nolan, Justin-so hardworking and always smiling, making sure we had what we needed. And Sam, their manager-so genuinely pleasant.

Kudos to the GM: Mark Vinciguerra. TOP NOTCH RESORT. I don’t think l will ever stay at another property outside of The Luxury Collection.

reviews.author: anonymous
reviews.title: CONCIERGE
reviews.text: Connie from concierge is very rude! She does not confirm her information and hangs up the phone before I finished speaking ... This occurred three times in one day! She later called back to fix her mistake... The whole time she was screaming through the phone!

reviews.author: Willa
reviews.title: Tea!
reviews.text: Wanda is lovely! The tea was amazing. Such good food and company. Amazing views. Seriously such a good time! I’ve been to high tea at other venues but this one was truly one of the best places I’ve been to!

reviews.author: Kalei D
reviews.title: Tea time
reviews.text:
Wonderful sandwiches and tea. Wanda is the best! 
She is such a joy and I cannot wait to come back. The piano was fantastic and the deserts were so delicious. Thank you for keeping this great establishment alive

reviews.author: Deacon ggk
reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton @ The Phoenician
reviews.text:
Attended a meet-and-greet for a mortgage company I work with at Mowry and Cotton. Elena Torres was the host and her and her staff were awesome. Elena provided an environment that made the evening enjoyable. Polite, professional and helpful in every way. Lauren was one of the servers that went above and beyond with service and Arturo prepared the best Mac and Cheese I've ever had. My first experience at The Phoenician and it was awesome.  I'll be back. Highly recommend the restaurant.
Gary Kiehlbaugh

reviews.author: George D
reviews.title: It’s not a five star but a strong four star hotel.
reviews.text: The grounds are amazing. The lobby and services are very nice. Where this hotel doesn’t excel is the rooms which are dated in design.  Still it’s a beautiful place to stay and the pool are for the kids is really nice. A strong four star in my book.

reviews.author: Sheryl M
reviews.title: A Fantastic Resort!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a fantastic resort in Scottsdale. It is well located in Scottsdale. Everything on the property is beautiful. The pools are great. They are perfect for adults and children. The staff is warm and friendly. Mowry and Cotton a nice place for breakfast. The Phoenician Crunch ice cream is delicious! I am looking forward to my seventh visit next summer!

reviews.author: louiesanchez
reviews.title: Louie Sanchez Allstate Agency Owner
reviews.text: I had an excellent time.  Beautiful resort.  All of the services were excellent.  Bell and valet really helped when we needed other items from the car.  The room was very clean and we enjoyed having the desert trail next to our room.

reviews.author: lorisack59
reviews.title: Birthday Weekend
reviews.text: Beautiful property. Wonderful spa. Excellent service from all. The rooms are so nice. Everything was great and we'll certainly come back for another staycation at some point. As customer service executive, I pay close attention to these details.

reviews.author: JMO959
reviews.title: simply amazing
reviews.text: Just do it!!  The Phoenician has everything for everyone. Only suggestion is to have free parking and provide shuttle services to area.  The Food is great, pools and spa are excellent.  The fitness is located away from main resort, so it would be nice to have a covered walkway in the future.

reviews.author: james w
reviews.title: Weekend warriors!
reviews.text: Had two rooms  which were very comfortable liked the turn down service in the evening! Pools and outside staff were amazing and very responsive. All the staff were exceptional !! Falcon guy with the Hawk was very informative and a pleasure to talk too! Awesome food great location everyone was very chill and welcoming!

reviews.author: Alma
reviews.title: Relaxing atmosphere
reviews.text:
We stayed here 3 nights
it is close to hiking spot 
Nice restaurants within hotel 👍friendly staff.  Beautiful pools lovely golf course
If you are a golfer 😎the room is spacious and clean👍we changed hotels to be closer to other attractions which was a big mistake 😳loved this hotel

reviews.author: FarAway09928930070
reviews.title: Highly Recommended!!
reviews.text: This is an absolutely beautiful resort. The staff was attentive and personable. Everything you need is right there. The pools were always clean and the room was very comfortable and felt like home. Their conference areas and food service was excellent as well. I really enjoyed my stay and I will choose this resort any time I stay in the area.

reviews.author: Leighton R
reviews.title: There is no better place
reviews.text: The Phoenician and the Canyon Suites have no equal.  We have stayed in many luxury resorts domestically and abroad.  This is the best there is.  The service is perfect.  The grounds are spectacular.  The rooms are large and quiet.

reviews.author: Mary47087
reviews.title: Allstate Honor Ring Trip
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay, the hotel was beautiful with so many amenities.  The room was beautiful and very clean.  Allstate did a great job on choosing that hotel.  The food they had prepared to us was delicious being prepared by the top chefs.  Anywhere we went to ask for directions because the hotel was huge everyone was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Tom85255
reviews.title: Excellent resort and staycation.  However, unresolved self parking issue I reported and no follow up
reviews.text: Excellent visit.  Package included complementary self parking but I had to pay at exit.  A day or two later I asked for assistance via phone and was told there would be an Accounting case.  Never heard back.

reviews.author: Beverly B
reviews.title: Worth the visit
reviews.text: Our niece was here for her first visit to Scottsdale and we wanted to show her a beautiful resort. We chose The Phoenician for its glamour, and decided to have a drink at the Thirsty Camel. Our server, Raul, made our day special with his pleasant personality and attention to our needs. My husband had an excellent Manhattan, and my niece had a Rested Peach that was delicious. Can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Lovetogolf71
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Excellent Customer Service!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful trip to the Phoenician, we always look forward to returning and this last trip was great. We are very familiar with the property and I favor certain rooms. I cannot thank Derek at the front desk enough for his amazing customer service- he went above and beyond working with me to get an awesome room that made our trip so wonderful. We stay in many very nice properties quite often, but it’s customer service that makes me return and recommend a resort to friends and colleagues- I highly recommend the Phoenician. The rooms are large and updated, the pools are very nice and my kids loved the slide, and Christine our server was so nice.  I look forward to returning to the Phoenician!!

reviews.author: A watchful eye
reviews.title: A desert oasis
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful, relaxing, and a very classy complex.  The staff is very well trained and the property features are abundant.  The Steakhouse was remarkable with just outstanding service and the health club is spot on.

reviews.author: Kerry S
reviews.title: Holiday accomodation
reviews.text: As far as location this is ideally situated. Can easily walk to everything. We stayed for 3 weeks and were quite happy although the accomodation is quite old now , could do with a facelift. In saying that , the room has everything you actually need.

reviews.author: Pober_18
reviews.title: Quick Stop with friends
reviews.text: Happen to be in the area: a lot of kids and loud. But, after 8pm the bar area was mostly adults. Great food and music!  The rooms were ok, nothing flashy as i remember in years past. Pool area has a kids and no kids area ... that’s good

reviews.author: PLT
reviews.title: Great location and classic hotel
reviews.text: Very nice location that is minutes from everything.  Rooms are large and the beds are very comfortable.  The staff is attentive and will do whatever they can to make your stay perfect.  It is a large hotel that is spread out over a large area at the base of the mountain.  Views are fantastic. The food is good in all of the restaurants and the cafe.  Valet and bellman staff could not be more helpful.

reviews.author: Troy A
reviews.title: Malory and Chris
reviews.text: Mal and Chris:Two of the friendliest and most charasmatic bartenders ive had the pleasure to recieve a drink from. From their cocktail knowledge to their small talk, were nothing less than top notch. True statesman of their craft. 5 stars, bravo!

reviews.author: Michael Niezgoda
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.text: I was visiting my grandmother in Phoeniz Arizona, and she brought me to the Phoenician to show me around the facility. I am in the hotel industry and have been for many years. I immediately fell in love with the property and I just have to say that the staff is incredible. I walked up to the concierge desk and was greeted by Paige who told me about the property and let me know how to apply online. We bumped into Candy one of the housekeepers on the property and I couldn't believe how friendly she was. She was interacting with the guests and making incredible small talk even though she had many rooms to clean. I spoke with Diane at the Accent store and was pleased with how kind she was even though she was not affiliated with the property. I spoke with Ryan at the front desk and he was able to help us out of the parking structure and was super guest friendly. Even though I only walked around a small section of the property I highly highly recommend staying here. It is such an incredible property and the staff is very guest oriented!

reviews.author: Allie J P
reviews.title: Girls Staycation
reviews.text: Mandy our restaurant server made our visit super special. She was excited and attentive to all our dietary needs. ⭐️ Nice experience overall except the pool is understaffed and needs misters. Thank you.

reviews.author: Rpnielsen
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation!
reviews.text: Took my family here for a long holiday weekend and had an amazing time. Great service, wonderful room and grounds, and my kids loved the pool. Restaurants were also very good and we enjoyed the live music at the lobby bar. We'll be coming back for sure

reviews.author: HMa
reviews.title: Best Afternoon Tea in Arizona
reviews.text: We have been taking our daughter to afternoon tea at the Phoenician since she was two years old. We request Ms. Wanda every time because she’s so friendly, sweet, and caring to our daughter. Wanda makes her feel like a Princess every time and whenever we ask our daughter where to go to celebrate, her number one choice has always been the “Phoenician to see Ms. Wanda”. She’s now six years old and still looks forward to going every time;  now she shares her joy of afternoon tea with her little sister too. Thank you Ms Wanda for making our little girls dream come true and because of people like Wanda, our little girls fell in love with afternoon tea and has been a family tradition ever since.

reviews.author: Jill W
reviews.title: The Best Afternoon Tea
reviews.text: The Phoenician has the best Afternoon Tea in the Valley! Even when I’m in London I find I miss the delicious treats they serve. And Wanda is amazing!! She always makes you feel like family. Tea at the Phoenician is a delightful experience!

reviews.author: Crystal
reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: The Phoenician used to be my favorite resort. Checked in to celebrate our friends upcoming wedding. We booked 5 rooms, it was 8 of us, 2 have gold and 2 platinum status. From beginning to end the front desk and concierge were horrible. Depending who you talked to, they give you different answers and lie. Very disappointed. You wouldn’t expect that from a 5 star resort. Spa was amazing, pool side service and food were horrible, J&G steakhouse experience was also horrible. Had brunch at Mowry and Cotton, food was great. I don’t know if I’ll go back to stay there, I wish we spent our money somewhere else. Was planning to do a staycation with my family soon but I’ll be taking my money somewhere else and definitely avoiding their hotels for business trips. I won’t be recommending this resort anymore until the fix their customer service.

reviews.author: Zurrie
reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL! GREAT STAFF !
reviews.text: I travel all over the world with my wife. This hotel is GREAT ! Stunning views, great staff, pools and Jacuzzis great! Delicious food ! We cannot wait to go back. The concierge sent us on great trips. Hot Air Ballooning over Sedona,  plane ride over the Grand Canyon, All great !

reviews.author: Karen P
reviews.title: High Tea at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Very personable and attentive. Wanda deserves and extra bonus for giving is such excellent service on her birthday! The food and ambiance was excellent and the entire wait staff was fantastic! Would highly recommend for a girls outing!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician Scottsdale
reviews.text: This was my first time having the Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician to celebrate my mother’s birthday. The tea and food were amazing. The service was superb as well. Our hostess Wanda was especially welcoming and made the experience special. Would definitely recommend and go back to!

reviews.author: Hannah S
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Had a super lovely time. The tea selection was diverse. It had three courses (sandwiches, scones, then dessert). It was all so delicious! Our host, Wanda, was amazing and provided amazing service. Definitely going here again!

reviews.author: Brienne M
reviews.title: Tea at the Phoenician - Wanda
reviews.text: Visit/ experience was amazing. Our lovely waitress, Wanda, was amazing! The atmosphere and food are excellent and worth while if you’re celebrating something special. I highly recommend and ask for Wanda!

reviews.author: Michael K
reviews.title: Best Staycation Ever
reviews.text: Funny thing, my wife and I bid against each other unknowingly at a St. Jude Children's Research Hospital benefit event.  So while we won the weekend package at the Phoenician well above what we probably could have, it was worth it in multiple ways.  The best being a donation to St. Jude and thank you Phoenician for being a sponsor and know that your gift provided a positive contribution :).  We will return for another Staycation at the Phoenician as our room was wonderful up against Camelback Mountain, the pools, the dining, the staff were all wonderful and our 3 days at the resort seemed longer allowing us to completely unwind.

reviews.author: Discover102384
reviews.title: Top resort
reviews.text: We have been to this resort multiple times and it never disappoints.  Get a room overlooking pool area.  Don't be intimidated by the golf course - it is a friendly environment.  Restaurants are great!  Several pools to choose from and beautiful grounds for taking walks.  Use the concierge...

reviews.author: SusanProchazka
reviews.title: Nice trip
reviews.text: The property was nice.  The staff was fantastic.  Every single encounter I had with staff was professional, and I felt very well-taken -care-of.  Food was very good.  Smores on a gingerbread graham cracker and a passion fruit fluff I am still dreaming about

reviews.author: skjob
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: Very nice experience with the resort and spa. I was upset of the parking charges, I feel after spending that money to stay there, parking should have been included.  Drink service at the adult pool was very slow due to not enough employees working that area.

reviews.author: sherisperry
reviews.title: Luxury & Stellar Service
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay.   Staff extremely accommodating, grounds were immaculate, pool area with options (kid area, adult areas).     Restaurant for brunch had many options and delicious.  Appreciated the underground parking for this time of year.

reviews.author: BobbyD6363
reviews.title: Great Return Visit!
reviews.text:
I have stayed at the Phoenician previously (December 2017) and had a bad experience since the property was under renovations/construction.  I was in Phoenix once again for a conference and split my stay over two properties.  I spent two days at the Embassy Suites Scottsdale before moving over to the Phoenician.  To say the difference is night and day between the two properties is an understatement!  I was greeted by the valet by name (from the tag placed on my windshield by the security gate) and directed toward check in.

Check-in was efficient although I had to ask about my American Express Fine Hotel and Resorts benefits.  I always book through American Express Platinum travel for the great benefits during my stay ($100 resort food and beverage credit, free premium internet and $80 per day breakfast credit).  I had room 4061 a nicely decorated King Deluxe Guest Room with a Mountain View.  The view off the balcony was really nice and most of all very quiet.  However, it was way too hot to enjoy the balcony with its very nice furnishing.  I found the room to be too quiet and I called for a fan for white noise which arrived in five minutes.  The bathroom was huge and the Le Chemin bath products are quite nice.

I checked out the Thirsty Camel (lobby bar) and started putting my $100 food and beverage credit to good use.  I found the service to be top notch and the selection of wines very good.  After a great night’s sleep, I enjoyed my free breakfast at Mowry and Cotton – since I had a credit to burn, I splurged and had several breakfast items with juice and coffee.  While enjoying breakfast I got to meet the Falconer and his buddy Calvin.  Calvin’s presence keeps the other birds and crows away from the outdoor breakfast venue.  The lack of birds was a great improvement over my previous stay in 2017.
The Phoenician grounds are gorgeous, and the pools are awesome.  I enjoyed the pool early morning (around 9am) and pretty much had it to myself.  I was greeted at my lounger with a pitcher of ice water and fresh towels.  My ice water never ran out! I also really loved to sound system at the pool.  The music was quite relaxing, and the sound system made it sound almost live.

Bottom Line: The Phoenician is a gorgeous property!  I will definitely book The Phoenician again!

reviews.author: Qais Tillawi
reviews.title: True Luxury
reviews.text:
You can't ask for anything more than offered. 

Whatever you need this hotel offers. 

Hotel: great. 

Vibe: great. 

Amenities: great. 

Service: great. 

Food: great. 

Staff: great. 

Rooms: great. 

Location: wonderful. 

Experience: great. 

Honestly, you can't go wrong here...

reviews.author: liro
reviews.title: Luxury
reviews.text: Outstanding facility, food and service.  Golf course is playable and in excellent condition.  All restaurants were very good.  Central location.  Pool staff terrific.  Good for children as well.  Housekeeping very nice.

reviews.author: Joseph P
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: We come to relax, enjoy the view and pools, plus J&G Steakhoiuse is excellent.   The facility and layout is easy to maneuver.   the workout facility is easy to get to and loaded with the correct machines.  We enjoy the short drive into town and old town to browse.

reviews.author: sheaker12019
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: Great property...well kept  grounds and clean rooms. They have a very attentive staff!...Taylor Mercer was particularly helpful and a pleasure to deal with in advance of our stay! Beautiful location and setting. I highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: Salknox
reviews.title: Finest Luxury Hotel!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is at the top of our list of luxury hotels. We stayed at the Canyon Suites last weekend. The accommodations were exquisite! Most importantly, the staff was amazing from the minute we arrived to days after we left. They were personable and went above and beyond for any request. I had left a couple pairs of jeans in a drawer and upon arriving at ur next destination in Sedona, called the Phoenician and they kindly shipped to my home. The water and coffee bar were so appreciated. We travel frequently both domestically and internationally. We have stayed in numerous 5 star hotels....the Phoenician ranks #1 on our list! Thank you!

reviews.author: Wallie A
reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.text: Spacious, nicely decorated, rooms with large luxurious bathrooms; top shelf game room, spa, fitness center, and conference facilities; quiet and comfortable environment, good service; <$300 is a high value bargain proposition.

reviews.author: LynJen1
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful and the service is top notch. My family and I loved our stay here. Great place for kids!  Location is perfect - a short walk to Camelback trail head and short ride to old town.

reviews.author: irsan316
reviews.title: I thought it was a great resort for business and pleasure!
reviews.text: It is definitely a nice resort. The restaurants I would recommend would be the steakhouse and the pool side grill. The rest are just OK. The afternoon tea has an experience value to it, although the food is also just OK. The wait time during check-in was not good, during our visit there.

reviews.author: lcabana2019
reviews.title: They have their A Game Back
reviews.text: Service was exceptional.   all the help staff was friendly helpful and kind.   Room was quiet food excellent! Grounds are spectacular swimming pools are spectacular. We will go back.  This hotel and property has their mojo back

reviews.author: Dave0704
reviews.title: We just love the place
reviews.text: The makeover is lovely with the new bar making the most of the amazing view, great facilities we have been many times over the years and hope to go many more. Rich at the quiet pool always makes us feel so welcome

reviews.author: Marc R
reviews.title: Back for our 23yr anniversary
reviews.text: Even more impressed with this property, 23 years after our honeymoon.  They have added a great exercise facility and the golf course is in even better shape.  Love the restaurant options and the bartenders are top notch.  Never have to leave the resort, unless you want to hike Camelback mountain, which is a must for any active person.

reviews.author: Dreamer06126635216
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: The Phoenician was exotic and relaxing. I felt pampered and comfortable with all the amenities and comfort of the room.  The shopping is fantastic! The food is incredible and the bars quenching.  I’d recommend this property for rest and relaxation.

reviews.author: Gary K
reviews.title: Great place for company event
reviews.text: The facilities are top notch, the staff is polite and professional.   We used the spa and had a couples massage -- it was wonderful.   The roof pool at the spa is very private and you have use of it as long as you want with a spa appointment.

reviews.author: sandymcconnell60
reviews.title: Paradise in the desert
reviews.text:
My daughter and I frequently travel to Scottsdale Az for a long weekend. We always stay at the Phoenician Hotel. 
It’s lovely. There are 3 large pools, excellent spa, great restaurants especially J&G. They are always polite and professional. You feel very special staying there.

reviews.author: Pagaep
reviews.title: Birthday Trip
reviews.text: The trip was very memorable and the accommodations were all great.  From the rooms, the restaurants , the pool, Spa, Golf Course and the exceptional service.  The weather was not too hot but just right for the time of year.

reviews.author: cindyd_theateam
reviews.title: Incredible resort!
reviews.text: Had the pleasure of staying at the resort for 3 days for business and pleasure. Not a golfer, but enjoyed the fitness area, spa, multiple pools and the restaurants were very enjoyable. Loved playing cornhole in the evening! We'll be back...

reviews.author: kenwonc
reviews.title: Can be alot better
reviews.text: When I got there the room wasn’t ready and I had to wait 2 hours before getting a room. I also got sick one night after rating dinner in the hotel. The room was ok but i was placed a room with no view

reviews.author: tj6901
reviews.title: GREAT
reviews.text: Great Service, check in tops. Greeter at door great touch, grounds well kept. Restuarants very good. Great location next to Camel Back mountian. Beautiful golf couse, new fitness center greant , Walking distance to Old Town.

reviews.author: TWB
reviews.title: Restaurant
reviews.text: My server Mandy was AMAZING!!!!!! I can not remember when I had such excellent service. Mandy you made my night! She has made my 1st night in the city all worth while. Great employees really do make an establishment.  Mandy, I appreciate your service, kindness, and sincerity. Great employees make unforgettable memories. You are awesome. Again, thank you again.

reviews.author: Ron P
reviews.title: A great resort
reviews.text: Coming back for our fifth stay. We have nothing but praise for The Phoenician Resort. The resort was always beautiful and in great condition but when we heard it was being refurbished we were blown away. They were also trying to upgrade three excellent restaurants. We missed Relish on our last trip but are looking forward to dining at The Phoenician Tavern. The service at the new restaurant, Mowry & Cotton was disappointing but got better with one waiter. The overall facility and staff are excellent and the grounds are beautiful. The underground parking is very convenient. The hotel is wonderful enough to keep us coming back.

reviews.author: Exploration678511
reviews.title: always great
reviews.text:
Although some of the resort was still under renovation when we were there last summer.  We enjoyed the new tennis courts and fitness facilities.   The new bar area was great.
we look forward to coming back again next year.

reviews.author: Heather R
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Great facility. We had cocktails in the main area and a night down by the old western town which was so fun. The pool area was great and all of the staff was super friendly. Looking forward to coming back again in January 2020.

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.title: Phenomenal Experience
reviews.text: Everything was flawless.  The food was spectacular.  The spa and massage were amazing!  The room was spacious and the staff was better than first class.  I wish I could have stayed a few more days.  3 days just was not enough.

reviews.author: Staycation-for-days
reviews.title: My favorite in AZ
reviews.text:
We had an amazing suite, which was spacious and absolutely beautiful. It had two full bathrooms and 3 patios, which shocked us. They have TVs in the mirror in the bathroom. The pools are so nice. Dinner at Mowry and Cotton was so delicious, I can’t wait to go back.
We went for my friends 40th Birthday and the staff went out of their way to make it extremely special. We had breakfast also at Mowry and Cottons and everything tasted so good, the pancakes were some of the best I have had. I just love this place and it’s my first choice for a staycation or any type of celebration. If your looking for and upscale resort you defiantly have to stay here. The grounds were gorgeous and well kept. The bellman were nice to give us a tour of the entire property in a golf cart. The cactus garden was neat and beautiful in how it’s right next to Camelback Mountain which we wish we had time to hike. I only have one negative thing to say about this place. It was so delightful and everyone was very friendly. The only thing is one time went an it was very expensive to get a late checkout even though they weren’t busy at all. The lady that time was not accommodating and kind of snooty. As a Marriott employee you think they would treat us like they treat elite guests.

reviews.author: JFiggy1990
reviews.title: Best weekend stay
reviews.text: Best romantic getaway ever. Everyone at the Phoenician was amazing. The room that we stayed in was amazing. We would stay there again and again.  It will always be our first choice whenever we plan to stay overnight in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Lucy R
reviews.title: We can't get enough of the Canyon Suites at the Phoenician
reviews.text: We've gone three times this year and have two more trips planned! The staff is incredible.  Kate and Chase go above and beyond to make our stay the best.  We love the rooms and pool! Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: BrianW34
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: The room I stayed was large with the furniture nicely spaced out, so it didn't feel cramped. The bathroom was huge with a big a large bath tub and a nice sized walk in shower. It also has excellent amenities. Excellent fitness center!

reviews.author: DEBORAH C
reviews.title: Great remodel
reviews.text: We have stayed over the years, but really enjoyed our last stay after it was remodeled. The rooms are very well done, and the restaurant has a terrific menu. I didn't get to the spa on our short trip, but it was wonderful before, so I'm sure it's even better now.

reviews.author: root23
reviews.title: Summer Getaway
reviews.text: Excellent resort.  Excellent Service all around.  Canyon Suites was quiet and secluded.  Room faced the mountain and the pool with a large balcony.  Very early morning hike up Camel Back was a highlight of the weekend.  Challenging but rewarding.  Local restaurants that we visited were delicious and we look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Brian M
reviews.title: Fantastic Conference Location
reviews.text:
I held a 2 day conference here. The view from the lobby bar (Thirsty Camel), the lovely piano playing from Allen, great chat from Chris, all pushed me over the edge to pick this place.

Fantastic rooms, gorgeous pools & cabanas, insane spa, and top notch convention center. Smiles and happy greetings for everyone. Our attendees were blown away.

reviews.author: garyl11172019
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: we had a wonderful experience. Staff was very courteous and accommodations were excellent. Very centralized area so we were able to shop close by. We would love to stay again and enjoy the pool during his hot season

reviews.author: Stuart7734
reviews.title: Total garbage
reviews.text: Showed up and got a map to the room which was hard to find. Then entered the hallway to the room which was filled with hundreds of moths. Decor looks old like a 90s casino. Then enter room moths in room beds not made nicely. Pool closed to guests so they could do a photo shoot of the pool.. total crap.

reviews.author: MikuSenpai
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician, A Luxury Collection Resort was an amazing resort and I really had a great time at The Phoenician, A Luxury Collection Resort. If I could go again I definitely would. 

I was incredibly impressed with the # of pools that were available.

reviews.author: michaelaterry2010
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Great staff!!! Always available to assist you with your needs during your stay. Will visit this location again soon. I typically stay there once a year for business and i always enjoy the beautiful setup and friendly people.

reviews.author: tasher2019
reviews.title: Magnificent Resort
reviews.text: First class in every respect. The food, the service and especially the amenities. The tennis center is as good as it gets. Rooms are beautiful, spacious and as comfortable as any we've stayed in. The staff was extremely accommodating with making restaurant recommendations in the community and handling such things as balloon rides.

reviews.author: Lucy Wamsley
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. It was beautiful and we enjoyed ourselves. We are planning coming back in December again this year. The spa experience was amazing and all the staff were extremely nice, thank you!

reviews.author: Julian Cubero
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text:
First time I visit this resort and I have to say that it was wonderful , First class service from hotel staff, Amazing facilities, love the food and the property!!
I will return with my family for an extended weekend. I really love the property!

reviews.author: LynchMob2019
reviews.title: High Class Resort
reviews.text: This resort was very impressive! It had all the amenities of a world class resort. Nice golf course! Rooms were roomy and nice and bar area is very relaxing. I would recommend for a getaway that's a lot closer than the Caribbean or Hawaii.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Birthday fun with friends
reviews.text: Very fun night listening to live music and celebrating my birthday with friends. Our waitress Mandy was amazing! You must request her.,,, you won’t be disappointed 😊Food was delicious and the cocktails were yummy.

reviews.author: CoffeeLunchCoffee
reviews.title: Wonderful Lounge Experience
reviews.text: Spent an amazing afternoon with my best friends from college in the lobby lounge @PhoenicianScottsdale with incredible service from the wonderful Mandy. Pro tip: Order the  "evening" guacamole and bubbles!

reviews.author: TomSheridan
reviews.title: Excellent High End Resort
reviews.text: Great property and excellent customer service.  Room, pool, common areas all met my expectations.  Car valet's excellent too.  Quick and polite.  Only downside was main pool area but not a huge deal.  Apparently, one side of the main pool is an upgrade or private area.  Wasn't marked well or if at all.  Additionally, I couldn't tell what the actual upgrade was other than perhaps a guaranteed seat.  I didn't go during a busy time so not sure why they would have it to begin with.

reviews.author: theratfamily2019
reviews.title: educational meeting
reviews.text: am anxious for a return visit; we arrived for educational purposes, attended meetings, and of course ate and drank well, hope to enjoy a visit in the near future again, many thanks; the cleanliness was spotless, the staff  extremely helpful and courteous; very attentive to satisfy our needs

reviews.author: LJZ
reviews.title: Perfectly pampered
reviews.text: I completed a two week stay at the Pho and was treated to amazing service throughout the resort.  Daniel in front desk management made sure an initial snag in my room request was taken care of, and exceeded my expectations.  Paige in concierge services, as always, greeted me with smiles and genuine interest in my stay activities and with any advice to help.  Myron and Christine in Mowry & Cotton became like family, as well as Amy in JG Steakhouse.  Finally the entire staff at the Phoenician spa, from Ana to Wayne, were always there to accommodate my needs and make sure my spa services were top notch -- which they always are.  I'll be back next month looking forward to my favorite room.

reviews.author: U4303OTkim
reviews.title: Great Renovation!
reviews.text: I have stayed at this property in the past and can tell the difference in upping the level of luxury and updating the property. This has always been a great location and highly recommend it! looking forward to seeing the spa renovations on the next visit.

reviews.author: Montana16
reviews.title: Fabulous Property
reviews.text: WE have been visiting The Phoenician for many years,so they are obviously doing something right. Generally the refurb. has been a success, although I preferred the bar the way it was,much more intimate and friendly. The staff are always brilliant,pleasant and helpful.All in all a pleasure to return every time.

reviews.author: Fatboy145
reviews.title: A gem
reviews.text:
The Phoenician was a great experience , 5 star all around . Spacious , clean, environmentally conscious , excellent service and great location - next to the Camelback mountain.
I would stay there again without hesitation

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: Great relaxing stay
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed a great week at this resort, had a room that overlooked the restaurant and pool area.  we spent each morning at the gym, had a great breakfast at then relaxed by the pool.  this property has such great amenities like the gym, tennis, basketball, bike riding and golf as well as quick access to Camelback mountain for lovely panoramic views of Scottsdale and Phoenix.  the location is great as its close to old town Scottsdale and the entertainment area for shopping and many restaurants.  Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: TavilaSanMarcos
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: everything was lovely, food was great room was clean, staff was helpful, would definitely stay here again.I didn't get a chance to play golf but the course seemed well taken care of. Also they gym seemed like a great place to exercise. The restaurants where a little expensive but the food was great so I won't complain.

reviews.author: BrianMMJr
