reviews.title: Horrible Valet Service.
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel! I used their valet service for parking, once i got back into my car, my driver side mirror was making this loud noise.  I told the valet attendee my car wasn't making this noise when he got it. So i asked for the manager and explained what the situation is about. He gave me attitude and told me that the noise was already there. I told him there was no noise when i gave them my vehicle. Problem wasn't resolved. I had to pay $400 to get the problem fix. Was not happy about the situation.

reviews.author: IPMWeb
reviews.title: Great place - get golf cart
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a luxurious hotel with many of amenities. However, if you are there for a conference you will get your steps in for the day depending on room location and conference room location, you may need a golf cart.

reviews.author: Companion769900
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: We had a sales conference in the hotel, rooms are luxurious and confortable with great views to the desert or the city. food was exceptional, lots to do arroung, close to the historic scottsdale downtown.

reviews.author: Paradise188753
reviews.title: An amazing property, pure luxury!
reviews.text: Great food, service & surroundings. I hope to visit again. That was my second time and after renovations, it was even more beautiful. They aim to please!! The staff are attentive, pleasant and professional.

reviews.author: Cheryl G
reviews.title: We love the Phoenician
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful.   We have stayed in the hotel rooms and the Casitas.  We especially like the Casitas.  The restaurant is good, the pools are wonderful.  The spa is one of the best spas!   It is a great place for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Rebecca B
reviews.title: Love the gym!
reviews.text: I have stayed at this property a few times for work.  In addition to the usual amenities you would expect by this class of hotel, the fitness center is phenomenal!!  Best in the country.   The staff is always pleasant.

reviews.author: emilybeejack
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: The property and service were excellent. We stayed over New Year's Eve and would definitely stay there again. The rooms were quite spacious with luxurious amenities. I recommend requesting a room close to the pool.

reviews.author: Shain Rae
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: This is a very well managed resort, with excellent service, beautifully appointed rooms and high attention to the details. The pools and cabanas offer a luxurious compliment to the intense Arizona sun and poolside food service is delicious. I highly recommend the fish tacos!

reviews.author: Joes1281g
reviews.title: Expensive and dated hotel
reviews.text:
Expensive and dated hotel.  Rooms and bathrooms were rundown.  Carpet in hallway seamed very old and dirty. 

The kids pool area didn’t work, While the main reason we chose that hotel is because of the kids activities that they offered

reviews.author: dam0njeffrey
reviews.title: A Phoenix Icon
reviews.text: The Phoenician is the market standard for resorts.  Their hospitality and service is exceptional.  Their staff is extremely well trained and they really go out of their way to ensure a quality experience.

reviews.author: barbieh842019
reviews.title: Great facility
reviews.text: I loved the facility.  At checkout, I was never told that the garage parking fee was included in the room fee. I used a credit card to get out of the garage and call the front desk right away.  I was told that my invoice had been corrected;however it had not been changed at all.  I made two more phone calls after being home, still no customer service.

reviews.author: MYGreenberg
reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text: Gorgeous resort. The pool is beautiful and there is a fabulous workout facility and spa. The spa is new. Service, rooms, bar and restaurants are all top notch. Excellent location near loads of great restaurants and shopping.

reviews.author: tnuntas
reviews.title: Best stay in Phoenix area
reviews.text: Fairmount Princess who? The Phoenician is a resort style. Everything you need on premise. Great service and plenty of nice restaurants on the property. Oh the on site golf is nice, too. Brand new course

reviews.author: Frank K
reviews.title: Diesel Exhaust
reviews.text: We were attending a Convention for 4 days and 3 nights. Our room was one floor above the loading dock. A diesel refrigeration truck with a high exhaust pipe was parked directly below our room. The diesel motor ran almost 24 hours a day. The noise and exhaust fumes from the diesel truck were unbearable. We were told by the Phoenician manager when we checked in that the hotel had no vacancies. Every day the Phoenician manager told us that there were no vacancies. The Phoenician is located miles from the nearest hotel. We only stayed for the convenience of the Convention meetings.

reviews.author: DP1025
reviews.title: COE Trip
reviews.text: Beautiful place with great service. This was one of my best trips with my spouse. My wife took advantage of the beautiful Spa and we both enjoyed the hospitality and food. The pool was absolutely beautiful and also the weather...I would definitely go back to this place...

reviews.author: Ameet
reviews.title: Fancy place but some aspects of service could be improved
reviews.text: One specific thing stood out for me. I forgot some items in my room. They did find them and stored them. Luckily I went elsewhere in Arizona and went back to Phoenix to catch my flight. I called them and told them that I would be coming by to pick up my items. I called again on my way there. They refused to keep them ready at the reception. I had to go in and wait a long time while they called the person responsible for it. This service was in stark contrast to the welcome they gave when I checked in there initially. I hope they can improve on their service for issues like this that happen after you check out.

reviews.author: Kitchengardener
reviews.title: Luxury in the Valley
reviews.text:
We visited the Phoenician as repeat guests in December. The resort was decorated for the Holidays and also had an event called Christmas Camp, which was nit, as we first thought aimed at kids. The director of guest services coordinated various events with the author  Karen  Schaler that all tied in to her book. There were workshops , including baking and mixology, and special spa events. The newly reopened spa is definitely worth the wait. Plunge pools, a large whirlpool, lounge rooms, steam rooms
All done in a modern southwestern style made it the nicest spa experience ever. The cactus garden was beautifully decorated with lights at night-a mini botanic garden experience. The freindly and accommodating staff made it a great pre holiday experience.

reviews.author: Melanie Collier
reviews.title: Wonderful Tea Time!
reviews.text: We were late for our tea reservation but the Phoenician concierge and the wonderful Wanda were kind enough to seat us. It was an awesome experience. Highly highly recommend. Divine! The tea, the scones, the pastries, all amazing.

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.title: Best hotel/resort EVER
reviews.text: Just a fantastic experience all-around.  Over-the-top service, great rooms, a workout facility second-to-none, pools worthy of royalty....and I haven't even played golf yet!  Also easy access to the trail up Camelback Mountain, world-class shopping minutes away, and the lobby bar is a great people-watching and people-meeting spot.  My favorite place to stay, anywhere.......

reviews.author: Highlandlass38
reviews.title: Spectacular service and food... and spa.
reviews.text: I have been to the Phoenician five or six times.  The hotel and the Canyon suites.  Guests are treated like royalty.  Although  breakfast can be served on the outside verandah, birds that often plague areas like that are kept away by a falconer.  Fascinating!!!  The restaurants are great and the redesigned spa is wonderful.

reviews.author: w0man0fessence
reviews.title: Stellar resort!
reviews.text: My sister and I had a magnificent time here. A very luxurious resort!  The spa is like no other I have experienced!  Room were big and bathrooms grand!  So many pools to choose from.  Nicely landscaped. I can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Jyll H
reviews.title: Afternoon tea at the phoenician
reviews.text: Wanda just made the day! She is so sweet and engaging. Wanda's timing was perfect for every course. You feel like your table is the only one in the room. The tea was amazing as always! The food and tea are the best of any tea I've ever had.

reviews.author: 345arjanh
reviews.title: After the hard work of making a reservation tyhe reward was poor
reviews.text: We were looking for a couple opf romantic days after a convention elsewhere in Phoenix. It took me a long time to find out how to make a reservation for a 'patio deluxe' room with fire pit. Upon arrival we had to drive to our room (poor signing) and when we were trying to lit the fire pit it appeared to be out of order (some parts were missing. In the room next door there was a very loud pre-wedding party going on but Front Office didn't seem to bother. Guest were even using our patio for smoking and drinking. A poor experience and a shame for a Hotel with this kind of reputation.

reviews.author: Bar2nK
reviews.title: Another Great Staycation at The Phoenician
reviews.text: The staff and facilities at The Phoenician make it a great place to come with the family. We live around the corner, but love staying here. The rooms, restaurant, and pool areas are great! A must visit!

reviews.author: LVMaui
reviews.title: Great resort and staff
reviews.text:
We stayed 3 nights and the resort is awesome. We were fortunate to get upgraded to a Casita Suite, which had a kitchen/dining room/living room/2 bathrooms/huge bedroom and 2 balconies, one could have held 10 people easily. The maids were meticulous, other staff were very friendly and everyone was professional. 

The property is huge but worth wandering around. There were at least 4 pools and none of them were ever overcrowded. There is an adults only pool also. 

The sandwiches at the 19th whole were very good and I cannot say enough about The Tavern, please see my review. We ate there all 3 nights and we never do that. 

The only con was the cost of a cabana at the pools, way too much money for them. Since this was the end of our vacation we never left the resort, except to go into town. High recommend and a really quick trip to the airport!

reviews.author: JuliM
reviews.title: Girls birthday High Tea
reviews.text: High Tea at the Phoenician was a treat!  Our girls loved their fancy birthday celebration. Wanda was an excellent hostess and made the girls feel very special. Jaime in the main lobby also made our visit memorable with her warm and friendly greeting. She made us feel at home and not a hint of stuffiness anywhere.

reviews.author: G H
reviews.title: Afternoon tea in the lobby tea court
reviews.text:
The best afternoon tea in the valley bar none. 

My friends and I have been coming to afternoon tea here at least twice a year for the last 15 years. Although we’ve tried every other tea in the valley, we always come back “home”. It is the overall experience that rules over the others. Our service,  from Wanda, is flawless as she makes every effort to make each experience perfect. 

You will never leave hungry or thirsty or feeling rushed in any way. If you need a girls day out, winter, spring or fall, this is the place to be to relax, chat with your friends and have a spot of tea, champagne or both.

reviews.author: mrsjesskraemer
reviews.title: Afternoon tea delight
reviews.text: We always do afternoon tea- it’s a tradition two times a year. Best tea in town, the ambiance, the service and not to mention the delightful piano player! The lobby is so beautiful and the tea is delicious!!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Hubbard
reviews.title: Fantastic Service and Amazing Live MUSIC and Great FOOD!!!!
reviews.text:
I went to this restaurant with my parents for our stay during the Fourth of July weekend. We watched the spectacular Fireworks show from the balcony. It was beautiful! We had a fabulous server named Rebekah Garcia who waited on us. She was very attentive and thoughtful. When I was drinking my Ginger Azul (which was delicious) She had the extra thought to bring a napkin over so my hand wouldn’t get cold from holding the drink. That is real 5 Star Service! Also when my parents and I moved from the balcony to the seating inside, the table we wanted to sit at only had two chairs, and there were three of us. However, Rebekah took the extra effort to pull out a chair from an empty table so my parents and I could sit together at that table. Rebekah really helped make that night worth the money! That night had some awesome live music too, and probably the best live music I have ever seen!!!! There was a band with an electric guitarist/lead singer, a bass player, and a drummer!!! These guys were true professionals and they brought such joy to the atmosphere and people and parents were up dancing with their children! What I liked about it was that it was a soft rock, nothing too hard or too crazy, but not too sleepy or sappy either! They brought the house down in a way I have never seen before in person! 🎵🎸🥁🎸🎤🎤🎤My mom, dad, and I were also dancing! It was so much fun! And this entire experience is my absolute favorite memory so far of going to a restaurant!! Oh.. and the Food was delicious and flavorful! 5 STARS!!!!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
#ThirstyCamel #Phoenician #SummerNightLife
😇😍👍👍👍 👨‍🎤 💃 🕺💃🤳🏼🎸🎹🥁🎸🎼🎤🎤🎤🎤🥁🎸🎸

reviews.author: AShewbert
reviews.title: Fourth of July weekend
reviews.text: The hotel amenities were lovely. The restaurants all have great food served with flair and style. Live music in the lounge was a treat. The gym has a fantastic view with great, clean equipment, an abundance of water options and snacks as well as an attentive and friendly attendant. Sam, the pool Manager is a lovely and accommodating gentleman who keeps the pool area staffed wonderfully as well as clean, nice, and fun!! The pool fare is the best we’ve had anywhere as well. Heather was a fantastic pool attendant, ensuring that ice water was kept in full supply, snacks, food & drinks as needed as well as shade and fresh towels! All with a smile and a lovely attitude. We have enjoyed our time at the resort and look forward to returning, thanks to these wonderful people who make it a wonderful place! Thanks!

reviews.author: NotBobbyFlay
reviews.title: Nice Stay, but Less than Expected
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Phoenician recently for an event I worked on.  I had high expectations prior to arrival having stayed at the Phoenician previously, albeit several years ago.  While the grounds were nice, I found my room and the service to be a bit lackluster.  Despite a recent renovation I found my room to be a bit worn and dirty with stained carpet and (my pet peeve) old, lumpy pillows.  I also had quite a bit of hair in my shower upon check-in.  I requested firm pillows after settling into my room and was delivered more feather pillows.  I called again and had foam pillows delivered while I was at dinner and enjoyed 8 pillows just for myself for the rest of my stay.  Turndown was very inconsistent, and at one point I was without soap or shampoo (I guess it was removed during cleaning and not replaced?). The pool service was terrible - I was there about 4 hours and the server only visited once.  I had to bus myself and get service from the bar.  The bartender comp'd me a beer as an apology - which was nice. The lobby bar tender did make a mean Old Fashioned which was a great treat at the end on some long days.  The spa was amazing - the massage I had was one of the best ever, and the facility was perfect in every way.  I spent half a day there after my massage just relaxing in the hot tub, or laying and reading in the quiet room.  
All in all, the Phoenician is a lovely resort, but it's not the 5 star service that I feel like they are striving for.  A solid 4 stars from this traveler.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.title: Amazing Anniversary Staycation
reviews.text: We had an absolutely amazing 2 day weekend getaway at the Phoenician’s Canyon Suites! All of the staff were so helpful and friendly. Special shoutout to Taylor Mercer who made us feel extremely special and cared for!! We dined at J&G steakhouse(such great food), went out to a baseball game, and enjoyed taking the hotel’s bicycles out around Arcadia. Will HAVE TO come again!

reviews.author: Danna Siumbeli
reviews.title: My review is simply for their reservation
reviews.text:
I checked in with a prepaid reservation, upon check-in they informed me that they will Authorize my card for incidental purpose, which i said no problem, understandable. 
They Authorized $100, next Morning i noticed another Authorization for $622 which i understood (100$ per night) i stayed 5 nights, i didn't question it further, 2 days later there was another authorization for $811, at that point i was annoyed and frustrated . Called the front desk, their excuse was this is a 5star place and the authorizations r higher and they want to ensure that card on file is active just in case people charge things to their room, i go ok ... first of all you've authorized over $1800 and my whole room was prepaid and costed me less then $1300, and i maybe charged $300 total to my room (breakfast ,drinks in the lobby etc.,)  which all is paid upon check up. this inst my first rodeo i stayed at much higher and better resorts, and i didn't deal with half the fees i experienced here at a freaking Marriott franchise . They simply said that was their policy, i said ok fine, any other authorization i should be aware of ? they said no, nothing else should be charged, well i was wrong next morning another Authorization for $543 popped up on my card, at the point i was not only angry but annoyed that they just randomly authorize bizarre amounts, 

Your not the 4 season, Your Marriott

I loved the place but i will never stay here again, these over $2000 fees were unnecessary .

reviews.author: Robin S
reviews.title: Did some things well and some were disappointing
reviews.text:
Phoenician
We have stayed at Enchantment, miraval the Breakers spas in Costa Rica sand Germany
Good:
Beautiful location on Camelback Mountain 
Housekeeping attentive and receptive
Reception attentive and helpful
Bell staff attentive and helpful 
Concierge attentive and helpful
Spa is top drawer. Sharon gave great massage and Shay great manicure 
Exercise classes yoga walk, meditation and yoga flow all good Jessica great yoga teacher. Kari yoga walk was fun 
Locker room attendants helpful 
Sarah, server at Spa pleasant and efficient. 

Bad
Tavern restaurant recommended by bell staff our first night “ our best restaurant” dry chicken and congealed barbecue sauce
J&g. Tasty meal meat over cooked
Mowry and cotton. Bass listed as an entree plate for sharing, very small. Waiter and busboy disappeared permanently in the middle of dinner and we had to flag down another waiter to finish our meal. Lauren very helpful. 
$2.50 banana in Marketplace 
One of the shops looked at Jonathan Adler coaster set. Mismatched. Two tigers instead of a tiger and a zebra. Selling at a higher price than a new complete set on the website $75 vs $81 and salesperson assured me it was discounted because it was mismatched and no longer available from this artist. Made all merchandise suspect. Don’t mind paying but don’t want to be taken advantage of. 
Kalio kabobery by the pool. Salad with chicken kabob, 3 pieces of chicken with tendon and fat through the meat
Went to Elements at the Sanctuary and had a great meal with great service (outside the resort)
No recycling bins around the resort and lots of plastic water bottles 
Need to constantly tip. Prefer one service charge
Weak hairdryer in the room.

reviews.author: Jacqueline C
reviews.title: Perfect stay-cation for our babymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the most amazing stay-cation to celebrate both our 1st wedding anniversary as well as our babymoon before the arrival of our son in August. I was able to use my travel points for the stay and got my room upgraded to this amazing casita. It had a HUGE soaking  tub that my husband and I could both comfortably sit in for a romantic bath, great patios to enjoy a nice glass of wine (husband only) and view if the lagoon and pool. 

We also treated ourselves to some amazing spa services both receiving a massage and facial- the amenities were great- coconut water, tea, plush robes and the best smelling shower amenities. They also had a hot tub, steam room and sauna and pool that you have access to all day for booking a service. 

Food- OMG the good was great! We ate at the tavern the first night- great casual spot- my husband swears the burgers are magic and I loved those sweet potato fries. Breakfast we ordered room service and it was speedy and huge portioned. Lunch we went to Mowrey Cotton at the lobby and then brunch menu was great- they also had a man who trains hawks so that was something to see. Dinner was simply the best though- so plan on making a reservation at JG steakhouse. The view overlooks the entire city and mountain skyline- the serving staff was very knowledgeable and had great recommendations. They also provided a complimentary desert celebrating our anniversary. 

The man who took this trip from good to great though was bellboy/driver/problem solver Joe. Has a great personality and customer service and truly saved the day for us when we had a key issue. Even later that day when he didn’t need to- went above and beyond and offered us a ride back to our room and ensured we had no further key issues. 

We would definitely recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Michael Nguyen
reviews.title: Beautiful property and first class service
reviews.text: My wife, two sons (7 and 9 years old) just stayed at the Phoenician this past week and all I can say was we were very impressed with our stay at this resort.  I would like to give a shout out to Ryan Sudden who checked us in at the front desk.  He was very personable and kind.  He is exactly the type of person who should be working at the front desk of any resort and he was great throughout our entire stay there.  The whole property is beautiful with Camelback Mountain just behind the property.  It was so nice to hike the Cholla trail two times during our stay.  I love working out on vacation, so the gym at the Phoenician is one of the best gyms I've ever seen at a resort.  Gary who works inside of the gym is one of the nicest and coolest guys around too!  I would definitely love to stay here again one day!  Old Town and  The Fashion Square Mall is right down the street and the nightlife in Scottsdale is amazing!

reviews.author: ToomuchsnowTom
reviews.title: Why must all the 5 star resorts charge for wi fi?
reviews.text: very nice place with great grounds but be prepared for the costs. Restaurants were good but not to the standard I'd have expected for such a facility, particularly the steak house. Rooms were nice and employees were attentive and polite. I did appreciate that people could not reserve chairs around the pool. Something all hotels and resorts should practice.

reviews.author: Cheryl M
reviews.title: Forget the Rest and Stay at the Best!
reviews.text: There is nothing like it anywhere in Scottsdale, Arizona!  The rooms are huge and well appointed. My favorite parts of the hotel are the cactus gardens and swimming pools.  The cactus gardens run along the length of the hotel almost backed up to a mountain. Brunch is amazing. Restaurants superb.

reviews.author: Matthew Y
reviews.title: Terrible cancellation fee not consistent with Marriott
reviews.text: Terrible cancellation policy that is not consistent with Marriott Bonvoy Properties.  Sad excuse to cheat people out of money.  I Was not even sent a notification of the charge that happened 20 days later.

reviews.author: PKPOWELL
reviews.title: Memorial Weekend at The Phoenician
reviews.text: We stayed over the Memorail Day weekend and I think the resort was fully booked. The check in was slow with only two associates who were occupied with people vying for better views. The room had "pool view" that was blocked by an event tent. The room was very large with two queen beds and they were so comfortable. The huge bathroom had a bath tub and shower stall. Be careful with the marble floors. It was easy to slip getting out of the shower with wet feet.There was a mini bar and a Keurig machine. The balcony was well furnished and partially shaded.The grounds, pool and golf course are in nearly perfect shape. All of the service people were very friendly. For food we first tried the steak house which has a beauiful view but was too expensive for the quality. The next night we took an Uber to a nice restaurant off property. The Market Place (self serve) may actually take longer than the buffet in the dine all day restaurant. The service in the (new) Tavern at the golf course was excellent. The service at the pool bar was impossibly slow and food not great. The setting for this resort is unique, in the cliifs leading up to Camelback Mountain. There is also a cactus garden that would be great for family photos. It is a short Uber ride from Sky Harbor.  We would easily return to this resort, perhaps on a non-holiday weekend.

reviews.author: Rachel M
reviews.title: Wonderful Romantic Getaway
reviews.text: My husband and I celebrated our wedding anniversary here over Memorial Weekend. The resort is immaculately clean and the service was superb. We ate at nearly every restaurant and loved every meal. I would highly recommend this resort for couples and families alike.

reviews.author: Chandra P
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text: We stayed here over the Memorial Day weekend.  The hotel rooms are large and well appointed.  The staff is very friendly and attentive.  The facilities are too expansive to all be used in one visit.  The spa, gym, and pools are in excellent upkeep. The pools were overly crowded this weekend but it actually was a little cool to get in!   We didn’t even use the golf course or tennis facility.  It has a basketball court also.  It is right next to the Cholla trail up Camelback mountain and in close proximity to numerous other great hikes.  We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: CarlGagnon
reviews.title: Incredible location and service
reviews.text: Stayed here for a client conference this past week and incredible amenities and service from the staff.  My only downgrade was the cleanliness of the room....cobwebs everywhere!    Otherwise, the facilities was spotless if not a bit aged in the carpeting in the hallways and common areas,    Staff was friendly, educated and helpful in all instances.   Great views of Camelback and the surrounding mountains and skylines in the distance.

reviews.author: GetawayTime20
reviews.title: Beautiful Grounds
reviews.text: When you drive up to the hotel your first impression is of the beautiful grounds. The flowers and cacti around the property really stick out. We were greeted promptly by the valet staff upon arrival. Front desk could have been more professional, but they were cordial. Our room had a nice patio with a view of the pools. Rooms had a Ritz Carlton feel, especially the room layout and finishing touches. The first night we did not get turndown service. The spa was just recently renovated and was very nice. The day we went it was very busy, they needed more spa attendants to keep up with the cleanliness of the woman’s facilities.The massage service was truly amazing. I would go back just for the massage therapist I had. The quiet room prior to services is fantastic! I could just lay in there all day, it was very relaxing. The pool area was clean and inviting. I really liked they had an adults only pool. Overall I would go back based on the facilities. I expected more on the service side from this hotel, that was a bit disappointing. Especially with the price of the room.

reviews.author: sammyd73
reviews.title: Families Beware
reviews.text: We carefully chose this resort based on the kids club and night owl program where they offered nightly childcare for parents from 5-9pm. We called on Friday to set up this program for our 2 kids on Saturday and Sunday night and were informed both nights were booked! We’ve traveled extensively with our kids and have never had this happen- especially at a resort known for their kids club and family friendly activities. Super disappointed and won’t be returning!

reviews.author: David Z
reviews.title: SO Dissappointing
reviews.text: I'm not sure where to start with this review.. There were so many things about this hotel that were disappointing. I guess I'll start with the towel in our bathroom that looked like it had a set in blood stain. Then there was the sharp drain in the family pool that both my kids and our friends kid cut their feet on. This drain could potentially be a huge problem for this hotel if anyone lands on it with force. Next, I got a "massage" with my friends, and after 15 mins of this lady trying to massage my kidneys while I attempted to teach her how to do her job, I got up and left. The other ladies were not thrilled with theirs either. One said hers was also terrible. When we arrived at the hotel, we were sent to the wrong room.. with bags and kids trying to figure out how to get in, we were met with suspicion by a worker that luckily happened to be in the hallway.. With no apologies for that, we got in our room finally. $500 plus per night for a basic room with the view of a beige rooftop about a mile down the hallway! I got a room change which was a huge improvement, though with an empty hotel, Im not sure why they wouldn't just put any paying customer in a decent room from the start. Cotton and Mowry was a good restaurant, however the other more casual one was AWFUL! One of the members of our group said "I hate when I order unhealthy food, and it doesn't even taste good" we all agreed. Bartender forgot to bring our drink at the bar as we waited for 25 minutes. I could go on and on, but I don't have time to list every thing that happened during our 5 day stay. It was the worst "luxury" hotel experience we've ever had. We usually stay in Fairmont hotels and have never been disappointed. This hotel was just lame. The front desk were un fazed by my complaints at the end of the stay, wanting me to hang out in the lobby and wait for security to come and take a report for the sharp drain. We had a flight to catch and let them know they can take care of that. My kids were surprised that the water slide doesn't go into the pool and stops at the side of the hotel. Photos are misleading. So if your kids are under 8, you have to hang out and watch them lifeguard style instead of relaxing by the pool. This hotel has NO walkability and the pools are totally unshaded. Prepare to fry in the desert sun regardless of multiple sunblock applications. Also plastic bottles everywhere. They need to get a refillable water machine and cut down on gratuitous plastic waste. Would NEVER stay here again!

reviews.author: Therese K
reviews.title: Luxury.  Quality.  Impressive
reviews.text: So we were pampered to the moon and back.  We’re a member of Hilton and Marriott, have been all over the world and I must say this gem of Scottsdale is great for    a relaxing winter thaw.  May is probably the best time of the year to stay.  We had one day in the 90’s, and the rest was in the 80’s.  Perfect pool weather.  Pack some hiking shoes if you want to hike Camel Back Mountain.  The pools are gorgeous, there’s water slides for kids, the dining  at all the restaurants is chef-level fantastic.  The spa.  Oh mylanta!   Impeccable and the gorgeous brand new facility is breathtaking.  The Phoenician is marble and orchid-type accommodations throughput.  Everyone was prompt and polite, just what you would expect.  Cannot think of anything we didn’t like.

reviews.author: lozdavepage
reviews.title: Let down
reviews.text:
We booked this hotel months ago, via booking.com, to get a email only 2 days prior to our trip to say that our booking.com accommodation had been cancelled as the hotel had over booked ??? 
We are already in the United States after a 10
Flight and from the uk, and this has caused us great stress and anxiety!

Be careful this hotel cancels you last minute, I would think twice before booking with them !!!!

reviews.author: silverbird1776
reviews.title: You won’t be dissappointed
reviews.text: Our casita was large, clean and located at the far end of the property which allowed for privacy. Suggest this area if you don’t want pool traffic.  Enquire if you can park by your casita before selecting valet parking.  We didn’t and had a parking space 50 feet from our entry.  Pet travelers  alert.  The $175 pet fee set an all time high.

reviews.author: wondergirl_il
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
My visit to the Phoenician was one of the best experiences I have ever had at a resort. 
The service wasn't just excellent, the people who work there are so pleasant and helpful, and treat you as if they love what they do and enjoy people. Far different from the robotic obligatory attention at other places.
Everything was sparkling clean.
There is plenty to do here, but if you don't feel like doing any of it you can enjoy some coffee or wine on your private balcony. Mine overlooked a natural area. 
The cactus garden is beautiful, and I enjoyed a wall along the paths on the grounds. 
There was even a falconer walking around, falcon hooded, to keep crows away from guests and food.
The resort is large, it never felt noisy or crowded. There are adult only pools but I did not notice any or many kids. Nighttime was peaceful, no noise to keep me up.
The ambience here invited fun relaxation. 
I will be visiting again soon.

reviews.author: Timothy M
reviews.title: A grand hotel in Scottsdale
reviews.text: This property is enormous and has all of the amenities that you could ever ask for in a four star resort. Perfect 18-hole golf, multiple pools, one of the best spa centers in all of Phoenix, and the food was fantastic. I’ve visited on a business trip and the meeting facilities were large and easy to navigate.   There are two free bottles of water in the room, avoid the seven dollar bottle of Voss water!  It would be nice to get rid of the punitively priced mini fridge and replace it with the fridge you can keep your water cold in.

reviews.author: Mario Gurgueira
reviews.title: Boa opção para famílias
reviews.text:
Ótima infraestrutura para lazer, especialmente para famílias com crianças. Estive hospedado no início de maio e o clima é muito bom nessa época.
Os quartos são grandes e confortáveis e os serviços em geral são ótimos.
Chamou minha atenção um rapaz, que fica num dos restaurantes com espaço aberto, com um falcão para espantar os pássaros que vão nas mesas em busca de comida.

reviews.author: Terri W
reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: If you want luxury this hotel is it.  It is so gorgeous and the staff is amazing,  Be pampered from head to toe.  Stay here and enjoy all of the great amenities that the hotel and Phoenix has to offer.  You will love it

reviews.author: Turpis P
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: If you can’t find something interesting to do in Scottsdale while staying at the Phoenician, you’re not trying hard enough. There’s plenty to do at the resort with golf and the onsite activities and the concierge staff is outstanding and can point you in the direction of many offsite attractions.

reviews.author: Becky A
reviews.title: Gorgeous and clean hotel!
reviews.text: 2nd stay this year! ~ Beautiful facilities, excellent service, clean/quiet rooms ~ I’ll be back again soon!  The health club facilities are wonderful ~ our children really enjoyed the basketball court.

reviews.author: Jo Y
reviews.title: Wow!!! You need to experience to appreciate this hotel
reviews.text: Close to Scottsdale and Phoenix downtown area.  The best hotel I've seen. You should come to experience it yourself. Best spa and very relaxing resort. Behind is the beautiful Mountainback. Beautiful ground that offers golf and waterfloot slide.

reviews.author: maree162016
reviews.title: AMAZING Family Vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed here as the last leg of our Arizona adventure (Phoenix, Jerome, Sedona, Grand Canyon and then Scottsdale).  I wish we stayed here longer!  It was the perfect place to relax after touring this beautiful state.  It was a luxury experience for the adults and the kids were kept busy the whole time.  There was so much to do and unfortunately we only had two days to enjoy it.  We will go back and spend more time there.  Worth the money!

reviews.author: quickbrownfox999
reviews.title: Good for a conference or families with kids
reviews.text:
I spent a few days at The Phoenician in March 2019, for a conference. It was a good venue for the conference - lots of space and not many distractions.

Probably also good for families with kids, as the resort is centred around various swimming pools and it offers various (paid) activities to keep the children busy. There's also a golf course.

I wouldn't recommend it for other travellers. It's a bit soulless, focused on the swimming pools, service wasn't great, the room/apartment I stayed in wasn't great.

If you're an active traveller staying here or just going past, I would recommend hiking the Camelback Mountain trail. It's well signposted, there are a few mildly/moderately difficult parts where you have to climb the rocks. Great views throughout, including on the easy parts. It takes about a couple of hours to do the full return walk.

reviews.author: TropicalBreezeZz
reviews.title: LOVED IT!!
reviews.text:
My husband surprised me with a trip to The Phoenician and what a blast we had.

First, I wanted to set some expectations (because of a few reviews that I read) - this is an upscale property but it isn't a stuffy snobby property.  This is a property that seamlessly combines class and comfort.  After all, we are going to assume, if you are visiting The Phoenician you are going to want to do both, be active and leisure.

The property is beautiful.  The staff is friendly, welcoming and attentive.  The poolside staff and food were amazing.  The gym is top notch.  Walking the property is a must - take advantage of everything they have to offer.  The spa - I am just going to say "WOW" - I've been to many and this ranks at the top.  The food on property was delish!!!  The coffee shop is absolutely delightful and we found ourselves there many times

Our room:  lovely décor, comfortable bed and quiet.  We never heard any hallway noise and the AC was quiet (which is rare for hotels)

Def get out and enjoy the area - there is plenty to do 
Just remember that you are on vacation - take a deep breath - relax - and be kind to those that are there to take care of you

reviews.author: MMCT62
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text:
Spent 5 days at the Phoenician last week and it was of the best resorts I’ve ever stayed at.
Pros.
1. Exceptional service 
2. Ate at every restaurant and each meal was fantastic - especially J&g
3. Drinks and food at pool were always quick. Never more than a 20 min wait after ordering
4. Plenty of pool seating - didn’t have to get done to pool early to get chairs 
5. Lots of kids activities. My 6 year old loved night owls program. 
  
Cons
1. None!

reviews.author: kentkathy1986
reviews.title: Impressive First Time Visit
reviews.text: I attended a conference hosted here and thoroughly enjoyed the hotel, the food and our room.  The food and the service at the restaurants was outstanding as was the service at the front desk.  Our room was spacious and comfortable and the walking path on the back side of the main building was very interesting.  I would highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Peter S.
reviews.title: Probably the best resort in Phoenix area
reviews.text:
So we left the other hotel and came here for a few more days of sunshine, pool, golf, activities and great food.  

Although not cheap, I still think you get the most for your money here.  This time we stayed at the Canyon Suites here at the Phoenician.  They are my favorite as it is much smaller and more private than the main hotel.  If you’re looking for action and a crowd, stay at the Phoenician.  If you like privacy and quiet, do the Canyon Suites. 

Interesting side note, we stay at Marriott properties often (for both business and pleasure) and this trip they upgraded us with an extra bedroom.  I’m more sure if it was due to AMEX or Marriott, but we’re glad we got the little extra. 

Final thought, at the Canyon they have an extensive brunch buffet every morning.  Using perks like that lowered our true cost quite a bit.  If you’ve got a decent size family and a little extra coin, you’ll find great value here.

reviews.author: NELSON W.
reviews.title: excelente hotel
reviews.text: Eu tinha o sonho de ficar neste lindo hotel quando ia a congressos em Phoenix na década de 1990. Ha 2 anos tive a oportunidade de me hospedar la. A experiencia foi ótima. O hotel é lindo, as instalações grandiosas. Este ano voltarei a Phoenix e ficarei la novamente.

reviews.author: Maxwellpants
reviews.title: Pretty much a disaster- at least they were nice
reviews.text: Wow not sure where to begin. Spent a week at the resort for a combination of business and pleasure. First the positives, the adult pool is beautiful and the grounds are well maintained and lovely. The staff tries hard and they are consistently nice when apologizing for everything that goes wrong. The problems: the staff was completely overwhelmed for the duration of our stay. Check in was supposed to be by 4:00 pm. We FINALLY got into  our room at 7:30 pm. My 10 colleagues traveling with me (and more importantly my 9 clients) all got into their rooms late, ranging from 6:00-9:00 pm. The manger of the front desk (who seemed overwhelmed and completely defeated) cited “issues with housekeeping.” He was nice enough to pay for dinner and drinks. The food on the patio took 60 minutes to arrive and my husbands’s chicken was half raw and slightly frozen. When we eventually got into our room other people’s luggage was in it. Then, despite our “do not disturb” sign on the door, we were greeted every night by new paraphernalia with another company’s logo on it (cups, hats,  tee shirts ). People went into our room to leave “gifts” from a convention for a company that was not mine. You can imagine that I slept with one eye open the entire time because the hotel obviously thought I was someone else and perhaps someone else had a key.  What a shame- I do not expect this a a supposed “luxury” resort at $600.00 a night. Will never return.

reviews.author: Dubin115
reviews.title: Still the Best!
reviews.text: My favorite big resort in Phoenix for over 30 years! A very well managed property with excellent service across the property from restaurants to house keeping. Impressive how well maintained everything is from the golf course to the rooms . Only negative that keeps it from getting five stars is the low flow shower heads that are ridiculously low!! Bath tub fills quickly but showers need to be fixed. Ryan Sudden at Front Desk was outstanding great ambassador for the resort.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Super vacances
reviews.text:
L’hôtel  est super mais il y a quelques points a améliorer,on nous charge pour internet 15$ par jours, le parking 20$ par jours, pas de buffet pour le petit déjeuner sauf exceptions et si buffet il y a 25$ ce qui est raisonnable. 
On vous charge de plus du double pour un petit déjeuner à la carte Service en chambre horriblement cher. Il serait préférable d’augmenter  le prix de la chambre de  quelques dollars et d’inclure l’internet et le parking et de faire un buffet chaque jours les clients auraient moins l’impression d’être des vaches à lait.

reviews.author: champagneandcaviar
reviews.title: Top Notch Service
reviews.text:
We just returned from Spring Break with our 7 yr old son, and 4 yr old daughter in Arizona... We did split our trip between Scottsdale and Sedona (see review of the Hilton Bell Rock Resort), and from the minute we arrived at the Phoenician, we wished we had more time there. The service started from the minute we arrived at the gate and checked in (8pm AZ time, 11pm EST), the room was spacious and well appointed. I loved having two closets and the Byredo products. After we put the kids down, we ordered a room service dinner for ourselves, and it was SO GOOD. Our view was not great, but this isn't a beachfront resort, so no biggie. The next day, after the yummy breakfast buffet at Mowry and Cotton (it was delicious and had lots of options for everyone), we did the Camelback Mtn hike and the kids did the scavenger hunt the concierge gave us- cute little touch. the Concierge (Janine I think was her name) was so fabulous and friendly. The kids loved going back and talking to her several times!
We headed to the pool after that... Wonderful full service at the pool.  Only negatives here were there were almost no seats left, which I guess is to be expected at a busy resort during Spring Break. And, although they say the pool is heated, we found it pretty chilly.  Don't need it to be hot, but it was still pretty chilly.  While our daughter napped the boys checked out the golf facilities and played basketball at the fitness facility. The fact that they had left handed junior clubs was pretty impressive. 
My daughter and I went to get our nails done at the Spa afterwards. They don't normally handle little girls, but were very accommodating and did a little manicure for her.  
We had dinner at Mowry and Cotton again- we sat outside and it was really a lovely evening. 
After enjoying the breakfast buffet again, we just tooted around the property... Played on the bocce court, the treehouse/playground, checked out some of the shops before checking out- we were heading to Sedona for the second half of our trip. 
On a final note, we went to Talisan West (Frank Lloyd Wrights winter home) on our way out and it's well worth the visit.

reviews.author: Soopergirl88
reviews.title: Amazing guest-first attitude, caring and friendly staff!
reviews.text:
We’d always wanted to stay at The Phoenician and finally got our chance! Overall, the resort caters to conference attendees & guests of special functions (very spacious conference and ballroom areas). Our room was located very close to a series of these rooms in the main building and while it was in a quiet area of the hotel, it was very odd to walk through the conference/meeting room areas and staff setting up to get to and from our room each day. Seeing all those tables of food for conference attendees was very tempting!!

We felt so cared for by the friendly customer service throughout the entire resort…from check in with the front desk to the gentlemen setting up the conference areas (on the way to our room, of course!), we were always greeted with a hello and a smile. This presence goes a long ways and is definitely noticed by guests—to know that we’re not in your way and respected as patrons of the hotel. Special recognition and a thank you to Ms. Snodgrass in the Funician Kids’ Club. While we don’t have kids ourselves (hey, we ARE the kids stuck in an adult body!), she was very friendly and kind to us when we went to check out the club…and even presented me with my own bunny Phoe Phoe! Thank you!

Facilities
Amazing property and as a personal trainer, I was BLOWN AWAY by the exceptional state-of-the-art and spacious fitness center at The Phoenician. Can I move in now??! The resort features 9 pools and it’s nice there is a specific-adults only pool area. We were very grateful for this especially as we were at the Phoenician during baseball Spring Training and the place was crawling with rugrats!

Time was limited for us otherwise I'd have done it...but did you know that you can learn how to fly like a trapeze performer at The Phoenician? Yup, they offer classes! Lots of fun resort activities offered daily.

Rooms
Spacious, modern and stylish with many extra amenities (we loved the roomy counter space, as well as his and hers sinks in the bathroom). My favorite was the live aloe vera plant in the bathroom, which added a nice touch. How often do you get a hotel room that features a live plant? 

Unfortunately our room, while in a quiet area, did not have a view (see photo). The patio “furniture” looked a bit old. Perhaps because we were in a general population run-of-the-mill room, there also wasn’t a desk in the room, which seemed ironic for a conference oriented hotel. We did like the convenient bedside chargers and haven’t seen anything ever like it in our travels!

As one of my pet peeves, there also wasn’t a recycling bin in the hotel room.

Service
Again, exceptional guest services and as Marriott Gold members, the evening turn-down service and chocolates were a fun treat! 

Overall, a great place to stay and The Phoenician lives up to its hype as a luxury resort. Just be prepared for an overdose of kids, especially during Spring Training and Spring Break (do these kids know how lucky they are to be staying in such an amazing resort?!). We already miss the place and definitely look to returning. "I'll be back!"

reviews.author: Karen M
reviews.title: Awesome Resort! Everything you need to Relax!
reviews.text: My daughter and I wanted to stay one night at The Phoenician to see what it was like. What an awesome place to stay! I booked a spa appointment for my daughter and she said it was so relaxing. The masseuse told her about a great restaurant to go to so we tried it. Great food! The Phoenician has a beautiful cactus garden to walk through. The bellhop took us in a golf cart to the end of the property and told us how to get to Camelback Mountain. It was a ten minute walk. A must do is to climb to the saddle of camelback mountain or to the top! There is an adult pool which is nice and several pools for kids. The food is really good by the pool and the drinks are wonderful!  Love the Phoenician!

reviews.author: Matthew S
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text:
Had a great spring break with the family at the Phoenician.  First time visiting and would definitely come back. 

Only suggestion for mgmt would be you should add a few Peloton bikes to the fitness center.  Other high end resorts such as St Regis and Four Season all have them in their facilities.

reviews.author: coleanole
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: My family spent spring break (3/28 to 4/2) at the Phoenician in a two queen 600 sq ft room on the 4th floor overlooking the pool.  First off, you need to know that we are very picky travelers (including our kids - 16 yr old and 14 yr old).  We like new and clean accommodations.  This resort was both!  Yes, it was a busier time of the year but is spread out so we didn't feel like the service was compromised.  We were always able to get chairs at the pool and the people working around the pools were very helpful finding chairs together and setting out towels.  The pool servers were always near if you needed food or a drink.  We ate at Mowry and Cotton several times.  Breakfast was very good.  We didn't eat the buffet and ordered off the menu.  All very good!  My son ate a burger at the Tavern restaurant and said it was the best he had ever had!  He is a picky eater too!  Pool food - hummus was delicious as well.  My only minor complaint was trying to get coffee at the Marketplace in the mornings. Line was out the door long and took too long so we passed on it.

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience. All the employees were helpful, friendly and knowledgeable.
All the food was delicious and especially the J and G Steakhouse. The service and food were exceptional.  We were not rushed and enjoyed a leisurely evening.
The weekend breakfast buffet was huge and delicious.

reviews.author: mattyrozee
reviews.title: Nice Resort, Yes, But Luxury May Be Too Strong a Word
reviews.text:
I stay in a lot of hotels for work and often for vacations and I have an issue with that word "luxury". It's like "awesome." Awesome used to mean truly unbelievable and god-like. It now means "Really good!" 

The Phoenician hotel is very nice, it's not quite luxury. Luxury is Solage in Calistoga. Luxury is Resort Pedregal in Cabo San Lucas. Luxury is often a Four Seasons. Still the Phoenician is a very good hotel and very comfortable. 

The grounds of the Phoenician are very well- maintained. It's clean and spread out, there are pretty waterfalls, super green grass, new tennis courts and a curated golf course. The spa was modern and huge, and the gym was modern and inviting. We had very good service throughout our stay, and our room was big with 2 queens (for our family of 3) with sofa and desk, and a view of the pool. Nicely comfortable and a big bathroom-similar size bathrooms to those in nice Las Vegas strip hotels like Palazzo and the Wynn. 

I liked the overall architecture of the buildings as well - sorta 70's sorta not. 

Some things worth mentioning:
- The food was very good. Not run of the mill hotel food. Kebabs and hummus by the pool felt homemade. The restaurant food was strong.
- Lots of amenities for little kids that my older kids wouldn't take advantage of, like kids activities, a mini water park and water slide. 
- We were there when it was very busy - Spring Break - and if we didn't get to the pool before noon, we couldn't find 3 pool chairs together. 

Overall, we were pleased with our stay. We would potentially stay here again when in the area.

reviews.author: Lauren H
reviews.title: Nice stay, a few areas for improvement
reviews.text: My family stayed at The Phoenician as part of our spring break trip. We were upgraded to a casita and while I had read mixed reviews of them online, we were happy with the room and liked that it was further away from the main buildings, but close to the pools. Overall we enjoyed our stay—housekeeping was great, my kids loved the pools and game room, the spa was wonderful and and the concierge was very helpful in getting us last minute dining and kids club reservations. However, the food and beverage service at various spots was lacking. At the pools there were never enough service staff, which created long waits to order food and drinks—one afternoon I left the Mother of Pearl pool after trying to get the servers attention for an hour without any luck, heading upstairs to order food and still having service issues there. The next day at the pool I asked the server three times for our check without any luck before I gave up and headed back to our room. The servers we had were nice but were consistently overwhelmed with the amount of customers to deal with. We had similar issues with slow service at Mowry & Cotton and The Tavern. Given how busy the resort is this time of year it would have been great to have a commensurate number of servers to help out.

reviews.author: ZfamilyUSA
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: Well not off to the best start.  90 minutes to get lunch as our tray was supposedly knocked over in the kitchen. They did comp a view drinks. And this is the resort view room. More like a roof top or alleyway view.

reviews.author: Alejandro A
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I booked an executive suite for a family vacation. When I got to my room, I realized it was a lot smaller and completely different compared to the pictures that are posted online or through the Marriott Bonviy app ( pics attached)... I talked to guest services and to the manager, who was condescending and not at all helpful (her name is Christina [--]).. she agreed that our room was a lot different to what’s shown on the pictures and acknowledged that the pictures were misleading, but stated there was nothing she could except to offer us breakfasts (which for the amount of money paid for this suite and did not feel justice in this gesture at all)..  she said there were no better rooms available to fix this problem for the entire length of our stay, but when I checked online or through the app there were other better rooms actually available. When I confronted her about this she lied stating that it was an error of the app and other online booking websites (which is obviously absurd).. What happened to us was inappropriate and really disappointing for a hotel of this caliber. I will never stay here again.

reviews.author: Bradley R
reviews.title: Not nearly up to par for a Luxury Collection property
reviews.text:
Oh, what a shameful disappointment! For a luxury collection property this place falls WAY short of those lofty expectations with its extremely AVERAGE customer service. 

1. No one actually checks to see if you are staying at the hotel which makes the pools completely over crowded and very hard to find a seat. We heard on MULTIPLE occasions people bragging how “we always come here to use the pools because no one ever checks.” When talking to some local friends of ours they concurred that you go to Phoenician to swim because no one checks if you are actually staying there. 

2. The service at the pool restaurant was absolutely abysmal and when we finally got our food (40 minutes after placing the order) it wasn’t entirely cooked!!! What!!?

3. The resort fee covers an hour a day free tennis with equipment....except no one mentioned that you need to pay for tennis balls. We’ve never felt so nickel and dimed. Tennis balls cost $6

4. Service at the main restaurant Mowry and Cotton was such a disappointment and expensive (and food was VERY VERY average) we decided to get off property for every subsequent meal. (Best decision we made). 

5. Some of the nicest service we encountered were from the team members on the grounds crew. They were always polite and tried their best to always help. 

In summary, for the exorbitant amount you spend per night at this hotel, it doesnt matter how nice the property itself is if the customer service doesn’t match. Ad Bonvoy Gold members It was a compete let down and a place we will never return. Too many other phenomenal properties in Scottsdale and the surrounding area to feel under appreciated at Phoenician.

reviews.author: JonathanS
reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I live adjacent to the Phoenician. I was recently driving past the resort on a public roadway when my car was struck and damaged by a golf ball launched from the resort . I contacted the resort immediately and left a message for management. My call was never returned. I called 2 days later and I was placed on hold for an extended period of time. When my call was finally addressed  the manager expressed no concern whatsoever regarding my situation and was not interested in providing any sort of compensation.

reviews.author: Justine and Matthew Metzler
reviews.title: Beautiful and wonderful experience
reviews.text: My husband and I booked a trip to the Phoenician many months ago. Upon our arrival we were told the hotel had overbooked and unfortunately they were going to move us to a different hotel down the street. At first we were obviously not happy because we had planned this trip so far in advanced and came to Scottsdale just to stay at the Phoenician.  The entire staff went above and beyond to make up for the issue.  I am so happy we were able to return for a few days towards the end of our trip and experience the Phoenician experience anyway! The concierge was very helpful in planning all of our excursions prior to the trip and fixing any issues due to moving hotels. The manager really gave us everything she could to make up for the move and the staff could not have been more generous! We will be back, hopefully for our full stay next time!!!

reviews.author: melonhead44
reviews.title: A wonderful getaway
reviews.text:
Beautiful grounds, well maintained property and the staff is professional and courteous.  Everyone is very nice and employees of all levels seem to enjoy their jobs. 

The rooms are a little pricey, but they are very nice, very good size; rarely does something this nice come inexpensively.  

The food was very good from the breakfast buffet, lunch, poolside service and dinner at L&G Steakhouse.  The food pricing is very reasonable, not even close to Hawaii prices. 

The pool area is very nice especially for those with small children, there is a play area that will keep them entertained for hours. 

I would suggest reserving poolside chairs/lounges if you are a group over four; it may be hard to get chairs all together.  

I didn’t play golf but I will next visit

reviews.author: jjder8
reviews.title: Great Renovation But Bring Your Own Lightbulbs
reviews.text: We’ve been staying at the Phoenician almost yearly for about 20 years but stopped going 3 years ago because the rooms were sorely in need of renovation. So we finally returned yesterday for a 10 day stay. The rooms have been wonderfully renovated, but the lighting is abysmal. The lamps on each nightstand have one 7 watt LED bulb which is marked with a brightness of 450 lumens which is the brightness of a 40 watt incandescent bulb! As a result, you cannot read in the room. We spoke to a fellow in reception but nothing has been done. Tomorrow we plan to buy two 100 watt conventional bulbs (the lamp socket is rated for 150 watts) and will bring them home following our stay.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text:
First time here for me - we arrived at 10am and they convinced us to take an "upgrade" to a residence rather than separate rooms. We were hesitant but said okay AS LONG AS it would be ready ASAP (i.e. cleaned immediately upon checkout) because we were already there and brought our dog, I.e. we couldn't go enjoy a lot of the resort spaces until our dog was set up in the room. We made it clear that just getting rooms early was our top priority.

6 HOURS later, and numerous conversations and phone calls later after leaving the property for lunch and then just basically sitting on benches waiting to get rooms and enjoy the resort, we are finally in our villa. Despite their multiple assurances and statements they did not prioritize the room with housekeeping and we weren't able to get in. No apologies, no complimentary drinks or anything to try to make up for making false promises. Basically we took off work and flew in early for nothing. We will likely not be returning. TERRIBLE customer service.

reviews.author: Klmidaho
reviews.title: Great resort but average rooms
reviews.text:
My family had a wonderful time at this resort. The resort itself—pools, grounds, tennis facility, game room, fitness center, hiking trails—absolutely phenomenal. The valet guys—fantastic. For example, my wife and I wanted to hike Camelback and a valet offered to drive us close to the trailhead in a golf cart. That was great service. 

However the rooms are just average at best. I stay 100+ nights/year in a Marriott property and I’ve seen lots of rooms. This one is average and not near what I would expect for the price. 

To reiterate—resort is great. Rooms just average.

reviews.author: globalnavigator
reviews.title: Wonderful Wedding Venue
reviews.text: We had our daughter's wedding at the Phoenician Hotel several months ago and it was spectacular.  Their wedding planning department is superb and very professional.  It was truly the event of a lifetime!

reviews.author: Ngan L
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
Love this hotel.  If you like swimming and relaxing and kids friendly pool -this resort has them.  Three level swimming pools so you have choices.  The water temperature and the nice weather - perfect in March!  Not hot at all.  Just perfect like Hawaii but cooler and no humidity.  The food is delicious and great service everywhere.  The spa is beautiful and relaxing and rooftop swimming pool.  

I really like it and it is not crowded.  Great place to visit again.

reviews.author: JamesL
reviews.title: One Stop Luxury
reviews.text: Upon arrival, I checked in with the gate and was promptly welcomed and invited to proceed. My next encounter was with the Valet Anthony C. Whom may I say was a fantastic ambassador for the property. This place is dripping in class and modern luxury amenities without any of the pompous attitude. I loved the property, the dining choices, the people and the shops. I’ll need to return to play the golf course and enjoy the pool areas. First class all the way. Every staff member was of the highest caliber and very attentive. Loved the Phonecian!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Exceptional Service at an Exceptional Resort!
reviews.text:
OVERVIEW:  

It is rare that the staff makes such a difference for a stay, but the staff at the Phoenician truly enhanced our vacation.  From the front desk to the housekeeping and the restaurant staff to the managers, the service was excellent and friendly.  From moment we arrived we could feel the difference.

The Phoenician Resort is a five star, luxury resort.  It has been recently redone and it appears no expense was spared in making the resort a quality destination with a wonderful ambiance.  The property is spread out and has excellent restaurants, bars and facilities.  It is at the base of Camelback Mountain and has some excellent views.  Although the resort is relatively large (over 600 rooms), it is spacious and doesn’t feel crowded or busy.  There are plenty of areas where you can “get away from it all” and relax.

ROOMS:

The resort has a variety of room types – all with a balcony or patio.  We stayed in a casita.  It was an excellent room with spacious layout and a nice patio slightly away from the main building.  The room had a mini-bar and a separate mini-fridge.  The décor was modern and comfortable.  The room was clean and the staff who serviced the rooms were excellent.  Tip:  Some casitas have a fire-table which would be nice in cooler weather.

RESTAURANT, BAR & FACILITIES:

The resort has several restaurants and bars ranging from the Tavern, a causal restaurant and bar overlooking the golf course, to the J&G Steakhouse with a great view of the property.  We typically had breakfast at Mowry & Cotton where there is a good selection of breakfast entrees and a nice buffet.  Tip:  For a casual light dinner we enjoyed the newly opened Tavern Restaurant at the golf clubhouse.

The resort has multiple pools (both adult and family) and a special area for children with a water slide and splash pad.  Other facilities include a luxurious adult spa, a well-equipped fitness and activity center including tennis and pickle ball courts, and several golf courses.  On the grounds there are quiet spaces for relaxing with a cup of coffee or a cold drink.  We particularly enjoyed our walk through the resort’s cactus garden.

BOTTOM LINE:  

We had a wonderful time at the resort.  The staff and the service were exceptional.  The resort ambiance and facilities were excellent.  Our room was perfect for our needs.

reviews.author: 748deonnah
reviews.title: Phoenician spring break 2019
reviews.text:
My family loved our visit two years ago that we returned again this year. Again we booked on points and had a view of rooftops. It was cloudy/rained for the majority of our stay so not much to see anyway. Property has undergone a huge renovation. The spa has been improved immensely (and so have spa prices). The volleyball net was removed from the pool and a reserved area with chairs that you pay $50 per day have been placed where a pool bar/restaurant was (see USA Today article of 3/13/2019). We were not informed of these charges upon checkin. 

Love the new fitness center!  Just wish there were bathrooms inside for guest use, instead of going outside and downstairs. And don’t forget your room key as it’s needed to enter the restroom.  

Food on property was mediocre. Nothing to exclaim about. Except we did have a pleasant experience in the Tavern (formerly Burger Bistro). Sat in the lounge area as we didn’t have reservations ( it was better area in my opinion). Cora was a great server and comped our drinks as we sat for a bit before it was noticed that we had sat down. 

Need to expand the Marketplace-especially in the am. Line for coffee was out the door for several days.  

Overall a fair experience. Not sure if we would return without using points.

reviews.author: MGM
reviews.title: Treated like a second class citizen on my 13th stay at this hotel
reviews.text: My 4th floor room in the main building smells like Burger King and they would not move me.  Having stayed here since 2003, always using my Starwood points to book my rooms,  have always been in the Casitas and other great rooms.  This trip, I was put into a room that overlooks a drainage ditch and a rooftop, but since I am here on business I decided not to fuss and just close the drapes.  However, my room smells like old grease and meat and that is disgusting.  I called and asked to be moved and a staff member said it smelled because I was below the steakhouse restaurant, so they know that these rooms smell!  However, after another hour of waiting for a front desk call back, I went down again and was told there weren't any rooms to move to.  Great. So, I went to my art show opening and at 10 pm bought scented candles at Walgreens and by midnight, the greasy meat smell was blocked enough for me to sleep.  I spent another hour this morning calling and then waiting in the lobby to talk to a manager. I said I needed something for the terrible smell and bad room and he said he would credit me about $90 in resort fees.  I think that is certainly not enough for not being able to actually hang out in my room because of cooking odors.  But I had to leave for a meeting.  Now it is smelling like meat and grease again.  I feel that I first of all got this terrible room because I am using points and not paying cash, and secondly, I feel like I am not getting any consideration as a 13 year patron.  Maybe it is because it is now owned by Marriott?  Whatever, I can't ever come back here which is a shame because we had many good times at this resort.  I am going to pursue this with guest relations, but this is a pitiful response.  He didn't even give me the free parking I asked for, which is about $20 per day.  I seriously wonder what has happened to the great customer service this resort once had.  And BTW, I had to spend $36,000 on my Starwood Am X in order to say here for 2 nights.  Maybe I need a new AM X card and just forget about this brand from now on.  Shame on you Phoenician for not bothering to care about the room and my unhappiness with this experience.

reviews.author: Charles R
reviews.title: This is My 30th Year Visiting the Phoenician
reviews.text:
This property has always been one of my favorite hotels--despite changes in ownership over the years.  It is a beautifully laid out resort with luxurious public spaces and well appointed, large and tastefully done guest rooms.  While the restaurants have changed themes over the years, the food has remained consistently good.  And this is a terrific venue for corporate meetings--a dimension on which the Phoenician excels.

A recent renovation has only enhanced the property.  While some changes to the lobby have made it less warm and engaging and a LOT noisier, other physical changes are very welcome--including a state of the art, fully equipped 24x7 fitness center and an entirely renovated spa.  The pools, golf course, and other amenities remain strong.  Room renovations have been tastefully done, with higher end finishes throughout.

Hotel bell, wait, and housekeeping staff are unfailingly polite and professional.  Front desk staff, less so.  They seemed to lack any understanding of how special this property is and were not especially skilled at explaining the amenities. 

In terms of value for money, the hotel's rates have skyrocketed.  For the rack rate prices being charged for all the rooms and, especially, at the hotel's ultra lux Canyon Suites, where I've stayed on prior trips, the Phoenician will have to work hard to give its guests a truly 5 star experience--something they are absolutely capable of doing on a good day. 

And still, I worry that hotel is becoming a bit too corporate and losing its ability to provide the deeply personal and highly memorable experiences that I and my family have loved over the years.  This is a big challenge, but they have a lot to work with in a lovely property and a proud history.

reviews.author: Theo Storck
reviews.title: theft at the hotel. no refund, no Feedback . terrible Stay
reviews.text: during a convention, I bought two Apple AirPods online and requested delivery to the hotel. The hotel reception received deliveries on 02/27 to 10:00. goods were not deliveries to the post office at the hotel (fedex). for two days I asked the attendant and manager of the hotel reception for an answer. the reception did not work with the case, did not return the respect, was silent and unwilling to solve the terrible situation. at the end of the stay we were promised reimbursement of expenses with credit by credit card in up to 3 days. credit has not been realized. when questioning the manager by  email, there was no return. terrible experience in a hote that says 5 stars. 1 star hotels are more careful.

reviews.author: Mrs_Ware229
reviews.title: High Tea Please...
reviews.text: We had tea time at the hotel per the request of one of the ladies for our "girls trip."  We had a really nice time... The atmosphere was great! Our serving hostess (Wanda) was outstanding. This was my first experience and because of her thoroughness to explain the process and options no one would have known... This is an excellent opportunity for friends to catch up and make memories...(I would encourage my heavy eaters to have a small snack ahead of time).

reviews.author: sheelaeyy
reviews.title: Wonderful!!
reviews.text: The Phoenician has it all... great rooms with views of the Camelback Mountain, fabulous restaurants, work out area, tennis, pool....  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  We tried arial yoga for the first time.  The service was excellent.

reviews.author: ChrisM
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text: The  Phoenician was a special place to stay.  The staff was wonderful. Very helpful and attentive in every way from making sure we had everything in the room we needed, booking reservations for dinner and the spa, for arranging transportation, giving us ideas of what to do in Scottsdale, etc. The poolside service was above and beyond, as soon as you sit down, a pitcher of ice water and cups is set down and your chair is draped in a fresh towel.  The rooms are beautiful and the bed super comfy.  The bathroom is large and well thought out with a separate toilet area.  The BR is equipped with every thing needed. We had a balcony view of the pool.  The patio off the bar is so delightful especially at sunrise and sunset.  There are beautiful walks and a very pretty, large cactus garden.  Overall, I would say The Phoenician was one of the best Hotel/Resorts I have ever stayed in.  Only down side, was  didn't love the Marketplace, I think they mean well but management is lacking. Service is slow, food is blah, coffee is adequate. On the other hand, the lunch at the Pool side was delicious! Delivered right to our chairs and pool side.  Loved the mint lemonade!

reviews.author: Family5MN
reviews.title: Don't stay near 5085
reviews.text: So the resort is nice. However, our room 5085 is above their conference kitchen area, from 7am until 10 pm there is constant banging and trucks and carts reversing and that beeping that goes with the reverse. And employees yelling at each other. We were told, lucky us, mountain view let me tell you it is not great, especially for the cost.

reviews.author: Jimmy D
reviews.title: Super place to stay
reviews.text:
If you want to reward yourself go for it ...extra money is well worth it. Met so many great people in the lounge and patio. The jg steakhouse on 5th floor is superb.
The room was so luxurious I felt like a king.

reviews.author: Toucheman
reviews.title: A Room Factory Picking Your Pocket
reviews.text: We stay at Luxury Collection or Relais & Chateau all over the world. The Phoenician is awful. The Valets pounce when you pull up. There is zero welcome or explanation at check in. The rooms are average despite the Luxury classification. $30 a night to park. $32 for bad room service coffee with a thimble of milk. (Noplace on-site for just a quick coffee & muffin.) $35 a night “resort fee” for nothing but the pool - which we expect at a Lux Hotel. That’s $100 a night for what are basics anywhere else. They’re extras at this monstrosity. Over six nights that adds up. Stay away. A room factory and a ripoff. Never again. Terrible.

reviews.author: Duane D
reviews.title: A Tale of 2 Resorts
reviews.text: Beautiful Resort and Facilities recently remodeled lovely staff and location. We have been going here of 15 plus years. Then---2 years ago something changed and I believe it is new management of Housekeeping Services!! The Nightmare begins! We request room cleaning between 9am and 1pm while we are out and turn down between 5pm and 8:30pm while we are gone and are assured this is not a problem!! Day 1 does not happen! We call they apologize and say someone will be right up No one comes! 3 calls later a 4pm staff shows up very nice people and does there job! Evening comes we return to room 8:30 pm no turn down we call same song and dance. Long story this went on for 5 days!! Bottom line they make the stay in the room unpleasant at the very least. Get your act together! You were a Class Act not so much and more ! Stay and sleep at another Hotel and visit during the day!!!

reviews.author: Traveler_60540
reviews.title: How lovely is this place!!
reviews.text:
We spent two nights at the Phoenician at the end of February 2019.  The resort has been totally remodeled and is absolutely gorgeous!  The pools are expansive and even have an "adults only" deck for those without children.  Unfortunately for us, the weather was too cool, so we "had" to use the spa.  It has been completely rebuilt.  We enjoyed the services and the facilities very much.  The athletic center is completely new with top of the line workout equipment.   For those traveling with children, they had an outdoor play area near the pool and an indoor "Funicians" Kids Club.

We weren't particularly hungry so ate in the lighter eating venues.  For breakfast, we just picked up egg sandwiches and coffee at the Marketplace.  We lunched at 19th Hole on the Golf Course and we enjoyed appetizers at the Thirsty Camel.  The service and food were very good at all three venues.

Service was impeccable.  My husband joked that the staff was modeled after the TV show "West World" in which everyone exists to service the guests.  We found all of the staff to be gracious and friendly.

Our room overlooked the cactus garden and Camelback Mountain.  Between the view and lack of noise, we thought the room location was great.  

There are many lovely resorts in Scottsdale and I had a difficult time deciding on which one to choose.  We had stayed at the Phoenician for a conference many years ago and had a wonderful time, so we decided to stay again.  It truly lived up to my expectations.
