You DO NOT Get your own food plate.  Everyone eats from the same plate (if I wanted to go to a buffet that everyone ate from I would have).   At a place like this I was also told I was to pour my own tea. (There goes that buffer thing again ). We did see the plates of desserts that we ate from (again a buffet plate )left all over  on several different tables with the flies also got to sample from  and left out  
Sorry for my health I will not be going back 
That night I did spend some time in the bathroom

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Exceptional Vacation Destination, Arizona
reviews.text: It was a last minute destination change and we were not dissapointed. Very clean, rooms are very spacious and nicely updated. Beds were very comfortable, linens were nice, great view of the pool, nice sitting area and large bathroom. Mini fridge that worked well for a few groceries and snacks. Deck is large with nice furniture. We loved the resort ammenities and tried to use them all since we were oaying resort fees. A young active couple in our 50's we used the basketball courts, tennis courts and worked out daily. As we train in cross fit we thought the gym was amazing for a resort and very large and clean, loved it! We used the complimentary bikes and rode around the area through old Scottsdale, Arts District, Entertainment District and canal trail. Since the property is at the base of Camelback mountain we did the hike/climb twice. The pool was great and the pool service included towels, ice, water and of course drinks and food service. We rode the waterslides too. The only dissatisfaction about the pool is they dont allow you to have your own floating chair, if your one of four people in the pool I dont see what the issue is, they should use some descretion. They provide a few pool noodles, most are old and worn out but overall great pools. Lots to do close by, shop, eat, explore. We enjoyed our morning breakfast on site - excellent food, presentations, flavour. Great staff, great service!

reviews.author: Vivet M
reviews.title: Exceptional response to guest feedback
reviews.text: Beautiful property with well-appointed rooms. Good food and service at the bar and restaurants (except Mowry and Cotton restaurant, the younger servers need training). There were some miscommunications at the hotel but after speaking to management corrections were made immediately. They turned a potentially negative situation into a positive. Impressive. Overall, It was expensive, but well worth it.

reviews.author: spike5882
reviews.title: Rather disappointing stay
reviews.text:
Just finishing up a stay here.  Signs of finishing up their remodeling are still showing, but knew this beforehand, so not a surprise or issue at all.  The updated interiors were nicely done and they made some nice choices in their finishes. 

Overall, rather disappointed in the hotel.  Booked a grand deluxe room using Amex FHR (and also have status with spg/marriott).  Not offered (or mentioned) possible upgrade at check-in, which is ok as I know it's not always available.  However, the room we were given had a balcony looking at a concrete patio and a few trees, of which the kids play area is behind.  I paid a bit more for a grand deluxe room which touts view of the pool or golf course.  So, we started off a little disappointed, as I should have just booked a regular room.  What we ended up getting is non-existent view and lots of screaming kids, which made the balcony unusable. 

The room is nice overall.  Bathroom has a large soaking tub, which I am sure many will enjoy.  Finishes are nice.  Room cleaning and turn down have been good and relatively unseen throughout our stay.  

Since booked with FHR, breakfast was included, which includes up to $65 for two at Mowry & Cotton.  Saturday and Sunday they offer a brunch buffet, which we did on Saturday.  It's $25.  Overall, pretty meager selection.  The prices on the menu are actually pretty good; so, I'd recommend the menu options over the buffet.  If getting the free breakfast you can get more options ordering from the menu for the amount allotted.  Have also been ordering from the menu, and the food from the menu is really good overall.  The doughnuts and acai bowls are particularly great.  Service at the restaurant though is really poor.  This was also the case throughout any F&B at the resort.  After being sat, we'd usually wait 15+ minutes before being recognized.  The busser would bring water, but that would be the extent.  Once the waiter would come each day, we would order our food and coffee. Somebody else would bring the food, and then we never would see the waiter until the end again.  So, coffee was never refilled.  We did end up asking a random worker for more coffee, but it was never offered for refills any day.  At the kabob place for lunch, we would be acknowledged right away because we are sitting at the bar, but even then, after finishing eating, we'd sit and sit before things were cleared, asked for more drinks, or a check brought.  Though the pool bar/restaurant had much better service than the breakfasts. 

Most disappointing was the pools.  Granted, we could wake up and get to the pools by 8 am, but the plan of a relaxing few days away didn't include that in our plans.  So far, both days there were no chairs available at the pool when we went out.  There are a number that are by reservation only, which we didn't look into.  But we just found it odd that there are open chairs that could be reserved but they didn't have any others open in general.  This for for all pools...adult pools and family pools.  We went back today around 4pm and did score a chair at the family pool.  Kids were screaming like crazy and after 30 minutes we realized nobody was stopping to get a drink order.  So, we decided to just head back to the room to relax.  

Parking is also charged.  I don't normally care about resort fees.  But when paying $35 for a resort fee, I do expect that pool chairs will be available.  If not, I am really just paying 35 bucks for wifi and another $18 for parking.  

So overall, just a rather disappointing stay where we were wanting to relax but weren't able to.  We ended up generally venturing out, as we love the area and visit regularly.  However, this trip had been intended to relax and ultimately between the balcony that had no view and lots of noise to not being able to use the pool, we mainly felt disappointed either leaving the resort or just staying on the bed to relax.  

I've only had phenomenal stays in Scottsdale up until this point.  I'd heard good things about this hotel, so figured we'd give it a try.  Regretting we didn't stick to one of the others we'd been to and enjoyed -- Four Seasons, Royal Palms, or Andaz. I think most couples will be more happy at those locations.

reviews.author: Natalie C
reviews.title: Dirty Water at the Phoenician, Rude front desk manager
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Phoenician over the Labor Day weekend. Purchased 2 casitas for my family and my sisters family to celebrate the holiday weekend and our recent birthdays. Around 10 pm at night I noticed the water filling the sink and the bath tub were yellow tinted and dirty. Fortunately the front desk was able to move us to another room that was across a parking lot. Needing to rebath my children and myself we packed up our room, and carried our sleeping children to the new room.
When checking out the front desk manager was rude and since we had booked our rooms with Expedia, a third party, he was unable to make any consessions towards our rooms. I am not the type to complain about the few issues we encountered while staying at the property, but I was very surprised by the lack of courtesy the front desk manager had for our dirty water room, late night packing, moving rooms and my daughter becoming very upset that something was wrong with our room that could not be fixed. I am so disgusted by the fact that my family bathed, washed our face, brushed our teeth with dirty water at this resort. Our primary vacation due to my work, is staycation.... there is not a resort in Scottsdale/Phoenix/Tucson that we have not stayed at 5-3 stars.... skip this resort and go to the Hyatt at Gainey Ranch.... same family fun and entertainment.... clean water...

reviews.author: Oceanlvr8
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician for a few days and absolutely loved the hotel. The service was excellent and the pools were perfect for the children. We really enjoyed our breakfast and lunch. The selection for both was great. I would return to this hotel and  would highly recommend it to all my friends.

reviews.author: Clinboca
reviews.title: OUTSTANDING RENOVATION !!!
reviews.text: I love this hotel and they did an amazing job on the renovations.  A must is the Grand deluxe rooms - they are in the main building. Superb bathrooms with soaking tub and separate shower- large double sinks and vanity.  The room service is great  Font desk is spot on.  The Thirsty Camel bar is beautiful and the views are fantastic.  The fitness center has amazing views from its second floor location and the lower level houses the new tennis center and game room equipped with pool table, foosball, video games.  The spa is all new and has its own private rooftop pool with cabanas. The nail salon techs are top of the line.  I miss the free self park but good news is you can swap back and forth between valet and self and they adjust according to your use.  PHOENICIAN IS A STAPLE!!!

reviews.author: LL2007
reviews.title: Casita disappointing
reviews.text: We have stayed in the Canyon Suites previously, and I cannot say enough good things about the room and the service there. This time we decided to try the newly renovated casita and were very disappointed. My primary complaint is that we paid for a “deluxe suite” and the agent at check in informed us we were getting one of the nicest rooms on property - he neglected to mention it is an ADA suite, which to most people’s mindis a compromised room. In this case it means all hooks and closet rods are only 36” high, and ther is nowhere in the room to hang a dress, coat or robe. The shower is barely 36” square, and because there is no threshold the bathroom floor floods when you shower (and your robe gets soaked because it’s hanging in the floor). The room itself we fine, but had a very bad odour. The outdoor area was nice, but very dirty (doesn’t look like it gets cleaned regularly). I was also chased by a giant bug in the bathroom, roughly 1” long “beetle” looking thing. I realize it’s not the hotels fault there was a bug in the room, but it was disgusting nevertheless. Finally, there are only 4 parking spots for 10 Casitas, so I’m not exactly sure how that is supposed to work? Overall, the casita is not an upgrade, and not worth the extra price.

reviews.author: NPC07
reviews.title: Not really impressed with the “Casitas”
reviews.text:
First, I want to say the property is phenomenal!!!
They have many activities for children and adult alike.  
The service outstanding... Trae & Kevin were on the ball. 
Thirsty Camel for drinks very nice.  Really enjoyed the live music.  We rented a cabana for the day and thought it was overpriced for what was offered.  Rich was great though!!!
The property has an adult only pool much appreciated it.  
Breakfast at Mowry & Cotton delicious. Jorge our server was very attentive.  Try the golden elixir for breakfast delicious.  
The avocado toast yummy and so are the pancakes.  
Massages are a must on this property!  
FYI - the steakhouse is being refurbished.  It won’t open until 
sometime in September. 
Then why only three stars? Because while everything else was top notch the Casita felt short.  Although spacious and quiet it was missing the WOW factor the rest of the property offers.  
They feel dated. The shutter door on the patio unhinged.  
They never cleaned the outside chairs.  It didn’t seem inviting just dusty. The sink in the bathroom was clogged most of the time.  The A/C first night was not cooling off properly.  
It was a bit of a let down.  Nonetheless, we will return to this property just NOT to the casitas.

reviews.author: Amanda T
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: of course the room was nice however the service did not match the quality of the room and for suppossivly being a five star resort we did not get that experience during our stay.While staying with my council members we left for breakfast and when we get back they thought we did not belong in this hotel. Apparently you have to "look" like you belong.

reviews.author: Janet R
reviews.title: Wonderful property thru and thru!
reviews.text: Have never stayed here; always wanted to.  Beautiful throughout! Outstanding service, food, and room was awesome!  Was here for a Conference.  Convenient location, friendly staff, great lobby and bar. Didn’t make it to fitness center but was told it’s amazing!

reviews.author: mslcw07
reviews.title: Relaxing Get Away
reviews.text: Perfect location to relax, even with kids!  I broke my foot so our adventurous family vacation was cancelled. We chose the Phoenician as a last minute respite.  Our young son loved the pool and the amazing service. Each morning we had breakfast in the lobby. The kind waitress made him "food art" which was the highlight of his day.  Our room was spectacular and the service was first class upon arrival to departure. We will definitely return again and again.

reviews.author: Mary Jane R
reviews.title: Phenomenal just updated property
reviews.text: Wow!  This property has long been considered a jewel, and its recent update proves that every jewel can be polished. The amenities and decor are first class, as is the staff.  I attended a small gathering there which included several meals, and they were all first class.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Steven H
reviews.title: Platinum members be aware
reviews.text: Had a conference at the hotel and thought it was perfect. First of all my room was located so far from the elevators. They claimed they gave me an upgrade so i was happy but later i found that one of my coworker, a non member got a bigger room with a dining table as well. We made the reservation together. There was no benefit at all, breakfast not included, not even a discount. Being a marriott platinum member i naturally assumed that premium internet was included, but found out that there was no such benefit and was charged everyday. Overall a disappointing stay for me. I guess its the luxury collection and provides no benefit. Thirty something dollars for valet.... in scottsdale?

reviews.author: MD531
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: We absolutely loved the Phoenician.  One of the most amazing places we have ever stayed.  Our room was on the 3rd floor (same as lobby) and convenient to everything. We had a beautiful view overlooking the pool.  The pool was clean and beautiful and service was very attentive.  Drinks were pricey but too be expected at a resort of this caliber.  We used Lyft and Uber multiple times a day and there was always several close by.  The location is perfect for Old Town Scottsdale restaurants and night life.  We will definitely return.  Hoping they offer there summer specials every year!   We also were able to walk to Camelback mountain to hike.

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Long Weekend
reviews.text: I cannot begin to say enough positive things about this resort. From the moment we got out of our car to the moment we left. There were bellhops taking our luggage up to our room and the front desk was so helpful. As we walked to our room there are beautiful shops and a market to grab food

reviews.author: Jeff W
reviews.title: Very nice facility but watch the hidden charges.
reviews.text:
Spent five days here due to a work function. First off, this is a world-class facility. The grounds, the buildings, the appointments...it’s all very well done. Equally as impressive is the staff. Everyone I encountered went out of their way to help me in a very professional manner. Ok, so Housekeeping didn’t make my bed with a top sheet for my last night there. Yeah, it bugged me, but by the time I ended back at my room I simply didn’t want to wait for someone to remedy it. 

My only gripe is the extremely high cost of food. Breakfast items, items in the one grab & go market on-premises, and room service...wow. Just wow. I’m an experienced traveler and am used to paying inflated prices due to the convenience, and the ‘ego’ of the facility because you are trapped, in a sense. There’s nothing else convenient anywhere close. But this was nuts. I’d score this place higher, but the $12 sub sandwiches and $40 room service burgers really didn’t sit well with me. It took much of the luster off my visit. The resort even collects a ‘convenience fee’ from each transaction at the on-site FedEx portal. Add the ridiculous cost of food to that and, well, it’s all just a bit too over the top for me. I was glad my work function ended when it did.

reviews.author: CANADIANOntario
reviews.title: Stayed for 3 nights and was going to score this hotel a 5 out of 5 until the third day :(
reviews.text:
Stayed for 3 nights and was going to score this hotel a 5 out of 5 until the third day :(
Came back to our room at 6 pm after day trip to Sedona to find the AC off and our room not cleaned :( such a disappointment!  And the worse part was that no one seemed to care.  We will not be returning

reviews.author: Sheryl M
reviews.title: The Phoenician is Fabulous!
reviews.text: I love The Phoenician!  The renovations are beautiful!  Everything looks great!  The staff is wonderful.  Everyone is very friendly and accommodating. I stayed for a week and would have stayed longer but vacation has to end at some point.  Mowry and Cotton is a great choice for breakfast and the food is delicious. The pools are beautiful and a nice way to relax in the Arizona heat. I highly recommend staying here while in Scottsdale...it is worth it.  Try the Phoenician crunch ice cream too...I love it!  I will be back!

reviews.author: AvignonVal
reviews.title: Merveilleux
reviews.text:
Magnifique complexe hôtelier qui propose des chambres et des villas splendides.
Notre villa était féerique avec tout l’equipement nécessaire pour se sentir comme chez soi. Les piscines de l’hotel sont spacieuses et le cadre exceptionnel. Seul bémol : les travaux sur le golf

reviews.author: MyaMOMofTwins
reviews.title: SUN ESCAPE from Foggy NorCAL
reviews.text: We did a crazy thing and visited ARIZONA in the summer!  it was AMAZING, not too hot in the upper 90's and this hotel has HEAT under control - they had misters that make it feel like a 70 degree day which allowed us to eat outside, they had a DJ and music to keep it fun and lively and the POOLS at this hotel are THE BEST!  They even had a wonderful HAWK and trainer that kept annoying little birds at bay and provided for an excellent experience for our 5 year olds, as the pet and learned about the Harris Hawk.  Great hotel, wonderful service and fun experience, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sandy
reviews.title: A great place to stay!
reviews.text: I've been here a few times with family and have always had a wonderful experience. The pool area was recently redone and is even friendlier to kids than before. There's a waterslide for the older kids that will keep them busy for hours. The staff here is amazing and will help make your stay as pleasant as possible. The grounds are beautiful and a lot of fun to walk around. The rooms are clean and luxurious. I don't have anything bad to say about this place. Well, it's pricey but it's worth it.

reviews.author: savy-mama97
reviews.title: Family Vacay 2018
reviews.text: Wow what a hotel! . The grounds are beautiful. The staff is SUPER friendly and helpful. The food was amazing ! The pools are open 24/ 7. The Thirsty Camel was 1 of the best hotel bars (outside of Jamaica) Ive been too. The room was spacious and clean. I had no issues with anything. I was even able to check in at 7am without paying an early check in fee.  And checkout is until 12p ! And we ubered  everywhere which was so cheap ($4 to the mall, $6-7 to the zoo). I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: TS&D
reviews.title: Fantastic fitness centre!
reviews.text: Stayed here recently for 5 nights and found the hotel and surroundings beautiful! Pool staff were great and extremely friendly and attentive, rooms spacious and comfortable. Check in nice and easy, and a state of the art new fitness centre which was superb! Hotel was close to Scottsdale Mall which was easily reached by Uber. A lovely relaxing few days.

reviews.author: Guido C
reviews.title: 2 Wochen relaxen
reviews.text:
Dies ist mindestens unser 10. Besuch dieses
Hotels innert Jahren im Sommer.
Luxushotel nach grosser Renovation
unter neuer Leitung.
Leider klappt der Roomservice überhaupt
nicht. Pool Anlage  wie immer super und
nie überfüllt. Schöne Bar mit Aussicht.
Grosse Zimmer

die zwei

reviews.author: COO-TravelGuy
reviews.title: A worthy "staycation"
reviews.text: We have a secondary home in the Phoenix area and like to enjoy a "staycation" a few times a year.  We chose The Phoenician recently.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The cost/value/luxury was about what I would have expected.  The rooms were very nice, not quite as nice as FS Scottsdale Troon, but certainly of high quality.  The spa was very good (recommend you make an appt. before you arrive on property if you have a desired time in mind).  Very nice pool, but the pool service for drinks and food was very slow.  Surprising since the pool was not very busy (maybe they knew that would be the case and didn't have a lot of staff on duty).

reviews.author: Rene B
reviews.title: Family visit
reviews.text: I had family visit me from South Africa and made the right choice to bring them to the Mowry and Cotton restaurant at the Phoenician. Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful. Dora made our experience memorable and the food was exceptional. The chef, Tanny came out and made our visit even more memorable. I would highly recommend anyone to come and experience the great food and service at the Mowry & Cotton restaurant.

reviews.author: gatrgrad
reviews.title: Lovely oasis in the desert
reviews.text: This hotel was recently renovated. Our room was clean and spacious. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Note that there is a resort fee and parking fee that you have to add on to your room rate so that you know the true cost of your stay. The hotel has 5 pools, one of which is an adults only pool.The hotel has a kids play area and splash pad and water slide, However I would not characterize this hotel as a family hotel. There are other resorts in Phoenix that cater more towards families. This is probably a better resort for couples or business retreats. The fitness center is probably the biggest, nicest hotel fitness center I have ever seen.

reviews.author: kathryn m
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with beautiful surroundings.
reviews.text: Excellent hotel for everyone.  Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Very impressed by the restaurants and service in all areas.A large pool and spa area.  Enjoy taking the trek through the cactus garden, and for the hiker, try your skills at climbing camelback mountain.

reviews.author: HellionHenry
reviews.title: It’s time to return to the Phienician
reviews.text: The Phoenician has been my favorite hotel for the last 1/4 century.  Their staff is amazing, their food consistently high quality and the mother of pearl pool my favorite in all the world .  Except, when I visited about four years ago, I was very disappointed.  Not only had they closed my favorite restaurant, Mary Elaine’s, but the whole property just didn’t shine the way it used to.  That’s all changed now!  Everything is being upgraded: the rooms, the pools, the restaurants, even the golf courses.  And, their exceptional service is personified once again in Jordyn at the reception desk.  When she heard about my longtime connection with the Phoenician, she loved hearing about all the wonderful times I’ve had there as much as I loved talking about them.  Thank you, Phoenician, for rising once again from your ashes to be the beautiful, unique and stunning property you were before.  And thank you for hiring Jordyn.  She’s a treasure herself.

reviews.author: christJ9628RL
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: The staff cannot do enough for you to make your trip memorable.  The hotel and property have been updated and except for the odd placement of the pool bar (not near the adult pool) and the fact that the water circulation in the pools has been downgraded due to the removal of the waterfalls that used to exist by the old pool bar, the facility is excellent.  Obviously, without the golf course being open, the trip was not as memorable as it usually is (we have gone every year for the past twenty years), but that is a temporary issue.  We will return next year, although not in July.

reviews.author: Julie L
reviews.title: But it was very hot....
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend visiting in the summer...we had no choice. The property is re-doing the golf course, but I knew that going in-so can't complain. Everything is new and beautiful and the staff is wonderful with every transaction. Our room was the last room #4095 and overlooked the back delivery/recycling area. With the hotel at low occupancy I would have liked to have a room with a view. I am sure there was one available. But we got a good rate, so I am assuming great rate=no pretty view.

reviews.author: ok2goKansas
reviews.title: Impeccable service in a gorgeous setting!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is a breathtaking resort with something for everyone. The most impressive aspect of the resort is the amazing staff. Everyone from the front desk, the concierge desk, housekeeping, the staff who set up meals and beverages for our business meetings, and the gift shops were friendly, welcoming, and professional. 

The multiple pools are perfect for families with young children as well as adults.  The tree house, water slide, and the splash pad kept our friend's son busy all day, every day of our stay.  The water temperature was perfectly refreshing on the 100+ degree days.

The Phoenician has a wonderful Afternoon Tea experience. We were lucky enough to be able to get reservations just after our arrival.  The multiple choices of teas and the finger sandwiches were all delicious. We loved the scones with clotted cream and jam.  When the pastries arrived at the end of our tea, we were almost too full to try all of the choices. 

The spa is world-class luxury. My favorite space was the "quiet room."  It is a cozy, comfortable, series of private spaces that are perfect for reading a good book or taking a nap after your spa treatment.

reviews.author: Latasha B
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Wonderful time. If you want luxury this is the place to go. Had a staycation with my husband and it was so enjoyable everyday. The staff were polite and answered all our questions. The view is amazing. Many shops and relaxing areas to take pictures and enjoy the Arizona sun.

reviews.author: Susanne S
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text: My "besties" from High School did a girls weekend here.  Service was great from start to finish.  They upgraded our room without even asking.  The staff definitely strives for A+ customer service and making it the most enjoyable experience for their guests....we will be back!

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: This is a magical resort. A must see for any visitor.
reviews.text: I have never had so much fun in one place. The food was phenomenal, the pool was exhilarating and the staff was exceptional! The gift shops were amazing and we found several one of a kind unique items. Be sure to book a round of golf with Thomas the concierge as he knows exactly where the good spots are. We golfed at The Camelback Golf Club and were NOT disappointed!

reviews.author: ncinaz
reviews.title: Beautiful renovation but lots of problems.
reviews.text: The Phoenician has never looked better - the rooms and public areas are modern and stylish. However we did have a few unpleasant problems during our stay and the hotel didn't seem terribly interested in correcting them in any way. When we opened the sofa bed we discovered that the sheets were not clean. It was too late at night for my sleepy son to care but I did report the problem the next day (nothing was done other than an apology). Just before leaving we discovered a very lively roach in the room. I reported it to the front desk and again nothing was offered in terms of compensating us for that. I understand these things can happen in a hotel but usually management cares a bit more. The pool area has a ridiculous policy of charging to sit in an enormous area. As a result, there was not a single person sitting in that area and all the paying hotel guests were seated in other areas that weren't quite as pleasant. The kids' splash pad area is absolutely infested with bees and I didn't see any staff members venture near it. The person staffing the water slide definitely did not enforce the height rule of 42". Multiple kids much smaller than that were allowed to go down the slide (and in one case the child had second thoughts at the top and a staff member had to bring the child, who couldn't have been more than 3, down).

reviews.author: bigdaddytvs
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Now this place has it all. What a great renovation. Dedication to service and Forbes rated. It has everything you can ask for. The wife loved lounging around the pool.  I had to try the new workout area. It feels like your at home but just with an army of butlers waiting on your every need before you even knew you needed it. 

If you want to be super seclusive try the Canyon Suites and be happy Julian is back!!

reviews.author: Charles L
reviews.title: Big resort
reviews.text: Came here during a business meeting, the room I was first assigned was horrible with closed walls and no views to anything what so ever. However I was able to request and got a different room the next day, which has one of the best views in the resort. They seem to have a lot of amenities and their gym was great. Has nice view and a stand alone building. The pool was nice and well maintained. Didn’t get a chance to go gold during my stay there, will definitely return during the winter for some golfing. The on-site food is so so, since everything is so far away so the choices was very limited.

reviews.author: Rana K
reviews.title: Relax in Luxury
reviews.text: After going through some recent stress I decided to get away for a few days to decompress on my own. I have never solo tripped before, but I had some goals  - sun, exercise, spa and relax.  Boy did The Phoenician deliver!  All service was warm and friendly.  I loved my mountain view room with view of the Cactus Garden. It was so quiet and so peaceful and so clean and spacious. The bed was so cozy I actually spent a whole evening in it watching movies.  Breakfast at Mowry & Cotton each morning was delicious, all of it!  I also enjoyed dinner there, and drinks and a snack at The Thirsty Camel. The fitness center is the nicest I have ever seen at a hotel and I also had a luxurious spa treatment at the newly renovated spa. The woman who checked me in was great and I am sorry I forgot her name.  But also wanted to shout out to Hannah at the pool, who was so delightfully upretentious and funny. She made my pool day great. If your goal is just to relax and unwind, The Phoenician is a great choice during the off-peak season!

reviews.author: Twintime1
reviews.title: Luxury Staycation
reviews.text: My sis came into town and we stayed here two nights.  This stay could not have been more perfect.  We used the spa, ate breakfast twice at the restaurant by the pool and then at the pool itself twice for lunch.  Their eggs are amazing and the hummus is amazing.  Spa service we did manicure/pedicure and both of our ladies were so sweet and our nails look amazing!  The rooms are gorgeous, every room is quiet.  We had a view of the cactus view last time and this time the pool.  The renovations are just improving on perfection.  The water structures and slide for the kids are nice too.  The best part of this hotel is the CUSTOMER SERVICE.  Everyone we encountered was gracious and you can tell they have a priority to treat the customer right.  Waited limited time or no time for every service from check in and out, eating at the pool.  I will be back for a staycation with my family in August.  Can't wait!  Thank you Phoenician for our amazing stay!

reviews.author: arubadive
reviews.title: The new Phoenician
reviews.text:
First the highpoint: The rooms are beautiful. Very well appointed. High quality linens etc.... 
The pitfalls are as follows: A once elegant hotel, is no more. T.V's EVERYWHERE! CHAISE LOUNGES EVERYWHERE. My husband counted 600 chaises added to the original pool area. Pools made smaller. Bad idea. Music pounding. The new spa pool has really no view. In between 2 buildings and ALOT of concrete. They have a new target customer, and it is not the old money that once enjoyed the tranquility and class. Some very "questionable ladies" scattered about. Overall, will not be back. I think Marriott needs to know the following: Everyone is not a sports bar type person who loves drinking. Just saying. Some come to the desert to relax and yes spend but not in a carnival atmosphere!
Not good pool service either.

reviews.author: Victor L
reviews.title: The epitome of luxury!
reviews.text:
The epitome of luxury!! 

The Phoenician and their amazing Guest Experience Team, specifically Shanielle Tara Jones, set the highest standards of luxury I’ve ever seen. The facilities are BRAND new. The food is greeatttt, and the rooms are super spacious. Belinda from the BRAND NEW fitness center does an outstanding job at making sure everyone is taken care of. Definitely will be back.

reviews.author: Debra Rice
reviews.title: The Phoenician is AMAZING!
reviews.text:
Husband and I were looking to get away for a couple of days for some sun, pool & drinks and boy did The Phoenician deliver. Our AMAZING stay started at check-in when we had the pleasure of meeting Edward who was pleasant, welcoming and helpful. Edward checked us in and found the most fantastic upgrade for us with one of the largest bathrooms I have ever seen and a gorgeous balcony overlooking the resort. 

Lou and the valet crew are some of the hardest workers around and Tony got our luggage up to our room right away. Anytime we left the resort, these gentlemen greeted us with a smile, some conversation, bottle of water and sent us on our way with a smile. 

We were told the pools have just been redone and they look beautiful. We had the pleasure of Mark, Hannah & Kelsey waiting on us for our 3 days by the pool and they made sure we stayed hydrated with our constantly filled water/ice pitcher and saw that all of our cocktails and food needs were met. They were just lovely, polite and so very attentive! We really enjoyed our poolside conversations with these fantastic young people. Hannah gets an extra Gold Star, when during one of our conversations we mentioned we were having dinner at the resort that night. She inquired about reservations and when we told her we did not have any, she made them for us,and then suggested some items on the menu. That my friends is customer service at it's BEST! 

If you need anything, I suggest you stop at the concierge desk and ask for Brandellin. Dinner reservations off property, directions, shopping tips, ANYTHING, she will take care of it for you and again, all with a smile!  

We wanted to eat on site for most of our trip and you can't go wrong with a burger from Relish Burger Bistro, an amazing lunch from Mowry & Cotton and cocktails in the evening at the elegant Thirsty Camel. 

The grounds are beautiful. Camelback Mountain is breathtaking. Loved walking to the Spa every morning for a yoga class. From start to finish, it was just perfection! And you can't put a price on good old fashion Smile & Be Nice! Everyone we came into contact with had a smile, some conversation, and were just the nicest. Already planning the trip for next year! 

Note: some great off property places to eat... Lo Lo's Chicken & Waffles (Sooo Good!) and Roaring Fork (try the fall off the bone Short Ribs)

reviews.author: danfotoman
reviews.title: no stress, great food, great room, easy access, pretty much perfect
reviews.text: I stayed at the Phoenician Resort April/may of this year.  I found the property quite delightful and relaxed.  so easy to find your way around.....beautiful amenities and great staff as well.  I was a bit befuddled upon my arrival, with several buildings to find my way around, but then it was all easy.  the property is set up so well, nothing is too far of a walk, even conference area.  my room was down a hall, then opened into a walkway, with my room right off the walkway.  I loved the feeling of never hearing neighbors' doors slam.  the best?  the beautiful cactus garden right outside my door.  stunning examples of desert life, with a nice walkway up the side of the mountain.  the coffee place was a quick elevator away, even in pajamas, but a bit of education is needed for the elevator use!  :-)  (all good).....I felt very welcome and comfortable there.  understanding and helpful team.  room very large and bed was great.  little things, like the magnifying mirror with a nightlight in the bathroom, I always like that!  food some of the best I have had in a conference/group arena.  all built up the side of a mountain.  it is great!  would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Albert M
reviews.title: 10 star resort!!
reviews.text: I don't know where to star with this resort! Friendly staff always looking to do better, countless amenities, clean pool areas, top notch tennis courts, basketball courts, rooms are clean and huge! View over looking the pool. If I'm ever in Scottsdale again I will ONLY stay at the Phoenician Resort. Looking forward to being back here!

reviews.author: Anayansi Z
reviews.title: Gran hotel
reviews.text: Este hotel tiene, para empezar, una ubicación excelente. Justo detrás de Camelback Mountain, puede apreciarse la montaña en todo su esplendor. Tiene cerca varios lugares importantes. Las habitaciones son espaciosas y muy cómodas. El hotel cuenta con todos los servicios. La gente es muy amable.

reviews.author: Travelflyhome
reviews.title: Now that's what I call a Suite!!
reviews.text:
Was given a king suite and it was AMAZING.  Felt like a true suite.  Suite had 4 closets, and large bathromm with soaking tub and seamless glass shower, sectional couch, ample seating for dining and a HUGE balcony with more room for dining and seating.  If i had friends with me, I totally would have invited them to my room and felf very comfortable.  I loved the modern and clean style, but still felt warm and inviting.

Air conditioning did not get super cold, but i believe it was due to the spaciousness of the room.  Houskeeping sevie was impeccable.  Pool area and check in were great as well.  
Pool was very relaxing in the evening and practically deserted so nice to be out there in the evening.

reviews.author: Mariam K
reviews.title: A nice stay away from home
reviews.text: A wonderful short stay, we loved the resort views, the cactus garden, the luxurious suite and accommodation. We enjoyed the delicious food at the restaurants. We would love to visit again.  It is worth see and enjoy.

reviews.author: Lane G
reviews.title: Peaceful wuth great views
reviews.text:
Very upscale resort with great views of Camelback mountain.  The resort is much larger than the pictures show with many places to eat and have a drink.  There are several pools with ine that is adult only.  Always a nice when you just want to relax.  The bell staff was great about taking us to differant parts of the property via gold carts.  They will pick you up upon request as well.  

The rooms on the Camelback side have a really nice path along the bottom of the mountian with a wide assortment of “plant” life.  Really pretty at night.  

I would recomend for business or pleaseure.  Glad I stayed a couple extra days!

reviews.author: Kmh465
reviews.title: Work conference
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about the staff at this resort.  I interacted with at least 10 staff and all of them went out of their way to make sure I was satisfied.   The resort itself was great too.   Clean up to date.   I would come back

reviews.author: smathena
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: I stayed here in June of 2018.  At the time the golf course was undergoing renovations so I got a great rate!  The lobby bar is an awesome place, and the bartender (I think her name was Murielle) was spectacular. She remembered my drink every time I came in and was very attentive. The food was awesome, especially the green chile pork. I was very impressed with the workout facility, it was really stocked for a hotel gym, dumb bells went all the way to 90lb. I will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: Worth the heat!
reviews.text: Have visited around 4 times with family though often during the Summer. If you can cope with the heat it is worth going! Lovely staff and friendly relaxed atmosphere. Great pool area and golf course. Rooms are lovely and well maintained. Yet to return since all the new changes so keen to go back and see what has happened since I last went!

reviews.author: davrph
reviews.title: Conference
reviews.text: The casita was clean and spacious. We stayed in a casita for a conference that my husband was attending. We loved the quiet and more private setting. Didn’t hear the usual loud people and children that you hear running up and down the halls. The casitas are off away from the main hotel so that is the sacrifice you make if you stay in their casitas then you will be walking a bit to the main building and pools. Personally that didn’t bother me. I loved the quiet in the mornings while I slept in and my husband walked up to the conference. I used the athletic club which was top notch. We didn’t eat at the restaurants since we had a rental car and chose to eat in Scottsdale instead. Only negatives that I have is the ice maker near our casita was broken and I had to walk down a bit to get ice. The other one is not sure why but there was some trash on the ground near our casita that remained there a few days. If you are 5 Star those things are not good to see. Overall though it is a nice hotel, not quite a 5 Star compared to other luxury hotels I’ve stayed in, but very good.

reviews.author: Jerry O
reviews.title: Oasis below Camelback Mountain
reviews.text:
We had two separate nights here and enjoyed them both. The steakhouse was closed for remodeling so we had dinner at Mowry & Cotton twice. And breakfast there also twice. All four meals were great and vegan for her - vegetarian for me. 

Service at the restaurant is resort oriented - so let them know if you are in a hurry. 

Our rooms were very comfortable and recently updated. 

We swam in many of the pools - and did lap swimming early each morning in the oval pool down below the main hotel. 

The cactus garden is great. Check it out when the heat is not too much. 

I like that this hotel is investing in its future.

reviews.author: Wilkinson_1970
reviews.title: Simply stunning!!
reviews.text: We arrived after our flight from the UK to an amazing welcome at reception. Our room was fabulous but it was dark so the surprise was when we opened the blinds the next morning and saw our views. The most amazing four nights in this beautiful hotel. Every single member of staff were so awesome, friendly and welcoming. We really were thoroughly spoilt during our stay. We will definitely be back. You are all doing an amazing job, thank you.

reviews.author: Shivani K
reviews.title: We came for a babymoon but never wanted to leave!
reviews.text:
My husband and I decided to go to the Phoenician for our babymoon and what a wonderful trip it was. We wanted this trip to be very relaxing, just being lazy, laying out by the pool and basically not having to lift a finger. From the moment we arrived at the resort, we had the babymoon of our dreams. 

The staff from the front desk to the pool staff to the bar staff to the bell staff to the restaurant staff were all so kind! I made numerous comments to my husband about just how kind and welcoming everyone was. They made us feel very special and their service itself was fantastic. Ben at the pool was absolutely wonderful and extremely attentive towards us. There was never a moment where my husband and I felt neglected by the staff. 

The room was extremely clean and spacious. The one thing I wish was different that you can't really change is the shower is tight. Extremely tight. And the bench in there is fairly large and ends up taking a lot of room so it wasn't very comfortable. 

My husband and I would have breakfast at Mowry and Cotton every morning and omg, I miss that breakfast so much. Everything was so delicious and being able to wake up and have a peaceful breakfast by the pool - what more could you ask for? That breakfast also kept my husband and I completely full from about 8:30am to 1:30/2ish, which says something for a pregnant person. 

While I gave the resort a full 5 stars, there is one thing that I'd love for them to change if possible. The in-room dining and the menus overall felt very meat-heavy and not very many veggie options. Mind you, the night we arrived, in-room dining was so kind and made me a very delicious pasta with marinara sauce but it wasn't actually ON the menu so I felt bad asking them to make it specially for me. 

Outside of that, an amazing amazing trip at a fantastic resort and if given the opportunity, we'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: LRRAZ
reviews.title: Perfection - Service is world class
reviews.text:
Resort is wonderful- Review is on a few exceptional folks and tips to the rooms and drinks & room service 

Anthony - Doorman: One is the nicest, most professional doormen I have ever encountered at a resort, assisting with my car, luggage and parking.  Anthony- you started my stay off stupendously!

Ryan - Checking in was quick to please getting me in to a room with a beautiful view of the massive multiple level pool.

Edgar- Mowry & Cotton Bartender 
Made a wonderful “Old orchard cocktail ($15, pricy but worth it)- Cucumber vodka, refreshing with a splash of champagne 

Room service: OMG toast! They bring you your OWN TOASTER to toast your bread so it’s hot right when you want to eat. I have never ever had that level of service before, not even at a four seasons has a toaster been brought to me. Well played Phoenician! Greek yogurt and fruit was fresh and wonderful.

Coffee in your room: It’s on a pullout drawer! Fantastic- convenient, yet easy to have out of your way quickly. 

Remodel: It’s beautiful- they have done an exceptional job, modern fixtures, large rooms, huge bath tubes and the cleaning staff leave the rooms absolutely spotless.

reviews.author: Cda212
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful, gorgeous pool, nice rooms unbelievable service. I recommended it. Got a suite with a view of the pool stunning. WOW! I wish they Offered free breakfast if your staying in a suite, but other than that amazing!

reviews.author: susannaa2000
reviews.title: It had been many years but glad we chose the Phoenician for weekend getaway
reviews.text:
Last minute getaway required a nice hotel room and beautiful hotel grounds.  We chose the Phoenician because a friend of mine had stayed here a week before and suggested it to me.   For years we used to drive by, drive thru the resort and have lunch or ice cream, whatever. I decided the summer rates were too good to pass up, plus they have just finished most of a very large remodel.  robert at the front reception was very accommodating to make sure we were in a room that suited all my requests.

we had a nice quiet room which is what I prefer.

the best was very comfortable, the sheets and linens were very nice///the food in all the restarua

reviews.author: goingbeachy
reviews.title: True 5 star property
reviews.text:
Recently stayed for 4 nights at this property and was very impressed. From the grounds to the rooms to the service and even the food, everything was top notch! The rooms are quite large with a big bathroom and extremely comfortable beds.  We had a room with a balcony overlooking the pool area which was nice to have.  
The location is fantastic! Right up against camelback mountain where you can easily access hiking trails.  We hiked the Cholla trail which you can walk to from out on the main road  Be prepared with plenty of water and comfortable shoes. It’s very steep and has lots of spots with loose rocks.
The pools are wonderful and it’s nice to have an adults only pool when you don’t have small children.  The pool attendants are super friendly and helpful as is the bar/food staff.  They stay on top of bringing you fresh pitchers of ice cold water which you need out in the Arizona sun!
The gym has lots of new equipment to choose from and I never had a problem with crowds.  They also have a lot of tennis courts if you’re interested in playing. 
All of the food I tried was very good. Even the sandwiches and salads from the marketplace. There’s also a nice selection of eateries/restaurants and a big lobby bar.
If you want to venture off property, there are a lot of restaurants and a big mall very close by. 
This is definitely a 5 star property and I don’t think you can be disappointed. I would stay again if I find myself in the area.

reviews.author: SRWelch00
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text:
Stayed only one night, but were impressed with the service.  The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and very professional and accommodating. 

Beautiful resort, looks very much like the 1980s but not dated ... has been renovated/updated impeccably.

reviews.author: Megan S
reviews.title: Banquet Staff was Fantastic!!
reviews.text: I was here recently for a conference and I want to give a shout out to Ana and Genevieve (sp?) in the Banquets Department. Ana was so friendly and went out of her way to ensure that I received my dietary restricted meals each day. If it wasn't for Ana I would not have eaten so thank you!! Genevieve was also so sweet and works very hard. Thank you ladies!!!

reviews.author: vegasgirl2016
reviews.title: Desert Oasis
reviews.text: Love everything about this resort. Room and bathroom were lovely, large, comfortable, clean and well appointed.New fitness center is nice and spacious and has lots of equipment. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Ayesha G
reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel
reviews.text: This is a very nice hotel, with great amenities and dedicated staff! The pool area is great and gym is top notch. However they charge a extra $33+ tax fee for each stayed at the resort instead of including it your room charge which is annoying if it’s unexpected.

reviews.author: Bradley B
reviews.title: Great hotel great location great pool
reviews.text: Great hotel. Completely redone. All new pools rooms and restaurants. We spent MDW there. On a busy holiday weekend you need to reserve daybeds or cabanas way in advance or plan to get up early to get loungers. The pool service restaurant sells amazing chicken shawarma kabobs and make sure you get the Phoenician iced tea it’s delicious. Great service and perfectly located 20 minutes from airport and 10 minutes from old town Scottsdale which is where all the bars and restaurants are. Def will stay here again.

reviews.author: francesann01
reviews.title: 24 Hour Staycation with Girlfriends!
reviews.text:
I booked this hotel during the busy Mother's Day weekend to celebrate two of my closest friends Birthday's and as a "Thank You" for being my "older-sisters/substitute-mothers" (my mama passed a few years ago).  

We were unable to participate in the High Tea service on Saturday afternoon as it was fully booked (3 weeks in advance!).  However, I was able to secure tickets to Paint-Nite for Friday evening and High Tea Service (Saturday) about a mile away.

Was pleasantly surprised that we were upgraded to a deluxe room with a view of the pools, a nice seating area with a couch and a lovely balcony.  The room was very welcoming and large enough for three women.  We loved the upcycled bathrobes, comfy beds, pillows, and staff.  The room was quiet and we slept very well.

When we checked in, at 1pm, we were able to get access to the room right away. We had lunch at Mowry & Cotton, which was delish! Dinner was sent to our Paint Nite setting  from the steakhouse.  Be warned, medium rare is more like rare, just go for well done.

The package I purchased included a room-service breakfast for two ($65), which was fantastic.  When we checked out we are gifted the difference for the additional food ordered for the third person, a nice surprise.  Speaking of checking out, we requested a late checkout of 2pm, no problem.  We were able to sleep in and lounge around all we wanted.

This is a hotel that is currently going through a transition of redecorating and re-establishing its profile, service, and amenities. It appears that it is on its way.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Severely disappointing
reviews.text:
You would think that a resort in Arizona would have a usuable pool. Well, think again. Just returned from looking for over a half hour for 1 spot. With no success I had to hunt down an employee to see if they could find 1 open chair. After another long search they were willing to accommodate me in their "last" reserved seat for $50 but the spot was in a "zero sunlight" location. Yesterday was a similar situation.  I do not mind paying resort fees but if you are going to charge them make sure guests can actually use the amenities. Resort fees plus a chair fee is ridiculous to sit at an average pool in the desert.  I am currently sitting on my balcony chair waiting it out another few hours until I can potentially find a spot.

At a five star resort this should not be happening. On vacation I have no desire to wake up at 6 to fight for a spot at a pool.

Service in general here is slow (with the exceptions of the waitress yesterday-she was great as well as the very friendly and helpful employees that checked me in yesterday). I understand that you risk slower service outside of the East coast but I have stayed at several luxury collection properties throughout South America and many other Starwood/Marriott properties in Europe, Asia, the Caribbean and Latin America during peak seasons and have never experienced this level of disorganization and inability to accommodate guests.

SPG gold status acknowledged at checkin but SPG gold gift not received. Hotel is loud. Nighttime is like a frat house with drunk people yelling in the hallways (which you can hear even with earplugs). 

To be fair I am extremely pleased with the room and the bathroom. Both are exceptionally clean. Pillows are amazing. Hopefully this hotel can improve as it has a lot of potential to be great.

reviews.author: christine m
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, but not worthy of luxury title
reviews.text: This is a fantastic resort, and had they not claimed to be 5 star luxury I probably would not have any complaints. But....claiming that requries much more attention to detail. We were surprised to come to the pool and see leftover dishes and towels from the night/day before. They remained for hours. They ran out of towels at the pool more than once. Our room was not cleaned before 4pm several days in a row. Coming back from the pool to shower for dinner and not having clean towels is not great. They also did a lot of noisy maintenance work near our room. One other thing I found surprising was employees not greeting us or saying hello. Outside of trained lobby personnel no one said good morning or hello or anything when passing us. There are a lot more examples, but you get the point. Admittedly these are small things, but if you are a LUXURY resort they matter.

reviews.author: Pat L
reviews.title: Never Disappointed!
reviews.text: We have been to this Luxury Collection several times over a period of several years.  We have not been here since the Marriott has taken over (I still consider it a Starwood) nor since the renovations  took place.  Last time there,  we were told the Phoenician was to undergo a massive renovation.  We didn't see anything wrong with the "old" Phoenician.  However, once there we realized the entire property is much more luxurious.   We did not think that was possible.  The rooms are beautifully updated and the grounds, especially the pools are so refreshing and inviting.  The only thing left to do is the completion of the golf course.  However, the Phoenician has arranged golf close by during the renovation. There is a new fitness center, new spa and new tennis courts.  Just lovely.  We have only 1 disappointment  and that is the removal of the beautiful water fountain in he lobby.  However, we do have to admit the lobby is far more active, has a lobby bar and now has live music daily.  It seem to be more inviting.  Fortunately, they did leave in place the beautiful fountain  out side the entrance to the lobby.  The staff has always been attentive however, the service and attention we received went over and above any we have ever received anywhere!   It amazes me how the staff can get your name right time after time  after meeting  you only once.   All in all, I sincerely doubt you will be disappointed with the "new" Phoenician.

reviews.author: lklugie
reviews.title: Outstanding service and stay
reviews.text: I was most impressed with the customer service and consistency of the professionalism and kindness from all the staff at The Phoenician. The hotel was also extremely clean no matter what part of the hotel we were in. Great views of Camelback mountain and gorgeous swimming pools (all 5 of them).

reviews.author: Runawayblond
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: I stayed at three hotels during a week stay in Arizona and this was by far the nicest one.  Highly recommend.  There are several pools and even great food!  The rooms were large and luxurious, with a patio and an amazing view.

reviews.author: sunsurfseagirl123
reviews.title: Mother’s Day Brunch
reviews.text: The atmosphere was dark and dingy.( I reserved on the first day reservations opened so should have dined  in the nicest room.) The coffee was cold. The waiter did not refill drinks. It cost  $125/per person!

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Pampered
reviews.text:
This hotel and resort is incredible. From the amnesties to the attitude of the staff, everything is A1 quality. The rooms are beautiful, the pools are amazing and I do not want to leave!

I’m here on business but I’ll definitely be back with my family next time around.

reviews.author: JesusS1971
reviews.title: No olvides nada en la habitación
reviews.text: Un excelente hotel, solo que se debe tener cuidado si se olvida algo en la habitación. No regresan nada. Te van a hacer marcarles todos los días y te dirán que te regresan la llamada, nunca lo van a hacer. Que lastima tan buen hotel para tener ese tipo de detalles. Quiero aclarar que el mismo día que salí, reporte el objeto que se me olvidó en la habitación 2036  y me dijeron que ahí lo tenían y que me hablarían para ver como me lo mandaban.

reviews.author: Bill K
reviews.title: Corporate conference
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with lots of amenities.  Rooms are spacious and bathrooms are huge.  Love the outdoor pools and bar service is excellent.  20 minutes from airport.  Love this resort and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Cyle
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician for 3 nights in April! The Hospitality was great, we had a small issue with our reservation when arriving on the type of room we requested. However, the front desk agent was able to accommodate our problem quickly. Hotel property was in great condition and was well maintained. Several pool options, all very nice! We will return.

reviews.author: Corey K
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel
reviews.text: Gorgeous hotel, with impeccable customer service. The grounds are beautiful & the hotel is lovely. Concierge was very helpful in getting us a restaurant reservation on an extremely busy weekend in Phx. Looking forward to staying here again.

reviews.author: Travel Ameniti
reviews.title: The Phoenician shines again
reviews.text:
After a long and needed renovation the Phoenician shines again. The renovation made it a more modern property with very nice touches. The grounds are impeccable and inviting.
This time we stayed in a casita it was absolutely incredible. 

You could still face some house keeping mishaps and lack of service, but overall the service is good. Front desk service is excellent because managers like Amanda. She represents the future for the Phoenician. Excellent people skills, deep knowledge, great smile and overall excellent service.

Food is decent, but the breakfast options are very limited. The best thing at breakfast is the hawk service they have for scaring away the annoying birds. They used to have an amazing breakfast, now is just a shadow of what used to be.

The new spa is impressive, but the service and hospitality is lacking. They do not offer access to platinum members. You need to buy a service in order to use the facilities. This is a first for a property of this caliber.

reviews.author: Ansel C
reviews.title: A Fantastic Resort for a Conference
reviews.text:
Our national trade association signed a contract four years ago for our 2018 conference. The Phoenician was about to begin a renovation and expansion project that would invest over 200M in the resort. It was a great decision on the part of our Site Election Committee. Our group reserved an overwhelming majority of the rooms. Every aspect of our conference was outstanding. There are three pool levels that can accommodate families and adults only. 
I believe that The Phoenician used the construction period to hire and train employees to offer the highest level of service. Every department proved "over the top" service.

reviews.author: tskd
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Friendly Service
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a wonderful resort hotel.  I stayed for a conference and spent more time in meetings than enjoying the beautiful grounds and numerous amenities, but everything you could want is there.  Every staff member was friendly and courteous.  My only complaint is that the grounds are vast and signage is not useful nor is it necessarily walker friendly.

reviews.author: NYinTransit
reviews.title: Great conference experience
reviews.text:
I spent four nights at the hotel for a conference. Overall, I found it a fantastic experience. The room was very comfortably designed and luxurious. The service was top-notch and very attentive. The food was unexpectedly the star of the show. I also enjoyed the new and well-equipped gym, but didn’t use the other facilities. 

The reason I am not giving this hotel five stars is that it seems to have fallen prey to what the airline industry does with hidden fees. In addition to the now-ubiquitous and very annoying added resort fees, they also added on $15 per night for gratuities. I highly doubt they do this to benefit the staff, rather it is a way for guests to unexpectedly subsidize the salaries the hotel should be paying. I have no objection to tipping well, but find these mandatory fees a way to raise rates without transparency. I would not expect this of a Luxury Collection hotel. Just build everything into the room rate and be transparent.

reviews.author: jstark80
reviews.title: Babymoon
reviews.text: My wife and I came out here for a 4 day trip as a babymoon. It was pretty busy at the property due to school break that week and some type of corporate event (possibly a bank's President's Club type trip?). Overall the property is very nice and I enjoyed our stay here. Special shout out to Michelle Caldwell for a welcome bottle of sparkling cider which was a nice touch.

reviews.author: Evan M
reviews.title: Special Anniversary Stay
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Phoenician for 3 nights while we celebrated our anniversary.  We loved everything about our stay.  Concierge was so helpful and friendly.  Room was recently renovated.  Grounds are amazing.  New spa opened the day we were leaving and looked beautiful. My wife took advantage of the yoga classes offered and really enjoyed it. We will definitely be back when we come to Scottsdale again!

reviews.author: Wendy D
reviews.title: Perfect time to visit, fantastic place to stay.
reviews.text: There isn’t much negative to say about the Phoenician.  The rooms are large, the balconies a treat, the added room amenities (slippers, cord wraps, robes, turn down service) while expected, were consistently provided.  Every staff member from housekeeping to front desk to pool service to waiters were friendly and always....always greeted us with a smile and a hello.  We really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Raymond M
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: undergoing renovations at the time of our visit.  Still the best.  Relishes one of the best places to eat. Watching movies at the temporary pool was quite enjoyable.  Able to climb part way up Camel back.

reviews.author: lawrencejg2015
reviews.title: LOBBY BAR IS A WINNER!
reviews.text: For people watching, for a great bar menu, for excellent drinks - and for a spectacular sunset - this place cannot be beat.  Bring a date, bring clients, or go yourself.  This hotel is a 5* first class experience!  Sit on the outside patio - when the weather is not too hot and you can see the gorgeous mountains in the distance.  Enjoy!

reviews.author: denise k
reviews.title: Arizona at its BEST
reviews.text:
Sensational large property OMG this resort is tremendous five swimming pools an adult only pool a children’s area excellent excellent choice for children the food is amazing they accommodate !!!!the top restaurant is outstanding and  its a Michael George  Restsurant . it’s phenomenal good excellent view wonderful !! 
Room service is on time and extremely pleasant !!!rooms are large and well appointed !!!

reviews.author: Lekt33
reviews.title: Great Resort - but CAUTION!
reviews.text:
Been coming here regularly for nearly 20 years. Always loved it, our favorite resort in the USA.  The nearly completed renovation has made the formerly great facilities even better, while the entire staff remains as always—truly outstanding.   Unfortunately, we were unable to enjoy the pools this year—see below.
CAUTION-  the renovations included tearing out the waterfall at the adult pool and replacing it with speakers located nearly every 10-15 feet apart everywhere.  “Everywhere” includes all the pools and much of the surrounding grounds.  Gone are the soothing, relaxing sounds of the waterfall and birds - replaced by cranked up sounds one would find at a mid-priced Las Vegas casino pool or a teen clothing store at a mall.   If you don’t mind, or actually enjoy, being surrounded outdoors by loud pop music all the time- then there is no better resort to be at. If you like to the sounds of waterfalls, splashing children and reading-level ambient sound- as before- you may want to explore the other quality resorts nearby.  They have not gone disco.

reviews.author: Malibugirl64
reviews.title: Absolutely Stunning Hotel
reviews.text: Wow, they have it figured out! We stayed here for a work event and we felt spoiled the entire time. The hotel is beautiful, the pool is amazing (and open 24 hours), food is delicious, and everyone on the staff was incredibly nice. Since it was an event hosted here the amenities were perfect for such special occasions. I was able to book an hair appointment at the Dry Bar next to the spa. The next day i was able to ship a rented dress back at the fedex center in the hotel. Couldn’t have been more convenient, and not to mention all the room I now have in my bag! Location is really close to old town and the mall. Gorgeous views and gardens too. I can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Amber A
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of staying here for 3 nights in one of their king castias and all I can say is wow!

The rooms are large, comfortable and clean. The service was above outstanding, the pool areas are beautiful, and even though the hotel was full there seemed to be enough room for everyone to find lounge chairs. They do have an adults only pool section which was nice. The food was good, a bit on the pricey side though. The hotel is nicely located, very close to Fashion Square and Old Town Scottsdale.

Overall we had a wonderful stay and if we ever come back to Scottsdale we will stay here again.

reviews.author: sldbecker
reviews.title: Spring Break Spectacular
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Arizona and what an amazing impression we received at The Phoenician! Friendly staff, made sure to make us feel right at home the minute we stepped onto the property and its many venues. From valet parking, to the golf/pro shop to the lunch we had at "Relish", and more. The only down side was the current excavation noise/construction they were doing to the lower part of the resort. At times very dusty/noisy, so would recommend your timing of when you plan to stay here and ask well in advance when they will be completed with all construction.

reviews.author: Kip H
reviews.title: Great hotel in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Visited The Phoenician for a corporate event. The hotel is in a nice setting and only a few minutes from Old Scottsdale. 

Our room was well appointed and there were no issues with anything. While we didn’t eat in any of the hotel restaurants there are plenty of options. There is a large lobby bar where you can enjoy a cold drink. 

The pools are nice and we enjoyed sitting by the pool soaking in the sun. The servers were attentive and polite. 

The golf course was closed but I recall it being an enjoyable track when I was here years ago.

reviews.author: lowsiento
reviews.title: Great Stay, Construction is almost done....
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the property, it was peak season and the resort was full...but still had ample room at the pool and ability to drink and dine anywhere on the property without issue.  Easy Uber ride to Old Town and not very far from the airport either.  We didnt rent a car and had no issues.  Its the perfect location if you want to hike camelback.  Go early, bring water...beat the crowds.  The Spa was opening the day we left and the new fitness center was still under construction.  But both look great and the construction was not an issue at all.  The golf course is a work in progress and looks like at least a year out till playable again.  2 things to consider when selecting this hotel.  1) room location is very important.  I dont understand the rooms that face the front entrance and valet....what an awful and noisy location.  We were very happy with our mountain view and chose that over the "resort" view.  We met some folks that complained how loud it was.  You have to really see it to understand why it would be so loud.  2) if you are an SPG traveler with status be weary of your late check out perk.  We were able to get a 2pm after asking multiple times.  They have a same day policy...which isnt helpful if planning a trip and taking a later flight out.  

Other than that the property is outstanding and we will be back.

reviews.author: Algoel
reviews.title: Great place to enjoy the pools and ambience
reviews.text: Family of 4. Spring break getaway. Loved the Phoenician! Perfect getaway from everyday life. Bartenders and housekeeping were great. They have golf carts to take you around the resort. Must stay here!

reviews.author: elizabethcincy
reviews.title: Nice but not typical Luxury Collection Experience
reviews.text: The rooms were large and clean with plenty of room for our family of four. Many pool options although very crowded with many young families.  Lots of onsite restaurant options. Some of the “above and beyond” service, amenities and vibe we’ve gotten at other SPG Luxury Properties such as the St Regis were lacking.

reviews.author: PearlJulie
reviews.title: The Spa on 4th at the Phoenician- Exceeds Expectations!
reviews.text: My visit to the new spa was wonderful.  They created such a memorable experience for my husband and I.   From the minute we walked in I knew it was going to be special.  Stunning views, beautiful architecture and a warm personal welcome.  Patricia gave a me a great hydro facial.  I walked out refreshed and feeling special.  The Spa has paid attention to every detail.     No doubt, I whole heartily recommend the new Spa on 4th at the Phoenician.

reviews.author: amanda d
reviews.title: Elegant Decor, but rushed Construction with mistakes
reviews.text: Visited during the construction and the spa was still incomplete along with their golf course. We visited the JW Marriott spa and golf course because of the lack of spa and gold here. For these things being absent they were not reflected in the $900 a night room price during March. The rooms were clean and nicely decorated, but the wood tile floors in the walk in entry were uneven and I almost cut my foot against them. I then wore slippers after that. That is a poor job of the construction workers and resort that they would not inspect each room before allowing guests to stay in the room. We tried the afternoon tea and were very unimpressed. Overall it seems this resort has the potential to be a 5 star resort but first must get out of construction mode and into a full functioning resort.

reviews.author: Joseph G
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed a wonderful four-day stay at The Phoenician Canyon Suites. The grounds are Immaculate and beautiful and Canyon Suites is very quiet and comfortable. The staff here is absolutely amazing. From the moment we arrived the Bellman ,front desk and all of the other associates could not have given us better service for our entire trip. We both love room service for dining and found it interesting  that  in our beautiful room there was no table to dine at. A simple call to concierge, and a small table with two very comfortable chairs were brought to our room within 30 minutes. Room service was also amazing ,orders were always correct and delivered beautifully and at proper temperature ,and I must say very tasty. We also enjoyed the new restaurant Mowry and cotton, service there was also exceptional and the food very good. We enjoyed the pool area very much and  the service staff there are very friendly, courteous, and prompt. The construction that is going on to make an even better Resort along with a great Golf Course will be completed by November, and we will enjoy another stay at that time. A big thank you to the entire staff who made our stay very delightful. Again thank you all Joe and KC Guzzardi

reviews.author: Susan E
reviews.title: Nice hotel with underwhelming staff
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for 3 days in March.  The resort grounds are very nice, and for the most part, impeccably maintained.  However, the resort was very understaffed considering we were there during spring break -  we waited everywhere!  We waited at check-in, we waited in line for the one concierge, and we waited an extremely long time to get our drinks at the pool.  The employee checking us in was initially pleasant; however, when I went back to ask one additional question, he quickly pointed out that he had already answered my question, "or was I not paying attention?" Wow -- apparently he did not go to customer service 101 training! The room was beautiful and clean, but the carpet in the hallways was bubbly and hard to walk on.  We waited for over 30 minutes for our drinks out by the pool.  I would have been happy to go up to the bar and order my own drink, but we were told we had to order through the waitstaff.  So we waited for about 20 minutes for her to appear and then another 30 minutes to get our drinks -- ridiculous!

reviews.author: LilysMum0723
reviews.title: Wanted it to be so much better
reviews.text: It has been years since I went to the Phoenician so I was excited to return.  Sadly it didn't step up to the norm.  Granted it was busy with spring-break and spring training guests, but I felt that the staff was unconcerned of your needs and felt hurried.  Most of the things were small but after multiple small things they added up. First we waited over two hours for our room, each time being told it was done and that it had to be signed off, which never happened.  We eventually got a different room and passed what should have been ours and it was still being cleaned!! that was after 4:00.  Then the bill from the restaurant was wrong, on several things, I was charged from the market place which we didn't get dinner or breakfast.  I gave them a different card to place my bill on at check out and it was billed to the original card.  First day housekeeping hadn't shown up by noon, and I had work to do so I called after work and then the staff gave it a minimum clean not replenishing shampoo etc which I only discovered later.  When I checked out I was surprised to see a almost $30 resort fee for each day even though no one mentioned it when we checked in.  When I asked what it was for I was told internet (which I already get for free being platinum spg) and a couple of other things which I didn't understand so I not sure what it was for.  It is a beautiful property, but between parking , resort fees cost of rooms it won't necessarily be my first choice again in Phoenix, which is disappointing to say as I have always had fond memories of this property.

reviews.author: Maxwellpants
reviews.title: Like Disneyland...lots of screaming, running kids
reviews.text: Well, I will start with the positives, the staff is wonderful and the grounds are beautiful. But this is supposed to be a “luxury resort”. We  (and the couple who joined us to celebrate their 10th wedding anniversary) will never stay here again in February or March due to the large amount of families with children literally running up and down the halls day and night. One morning there were 3 kids bouncing and throwing basketballs back and forth at the front desk at 8:00 am when I was trying to check out. The parents were no where in sight. My husband and I spent 4 nights there hoping for a quiet, romantic resort vacation, it was impossible. When we complained about the noise in the hallways and at the pool from kids running and screaming (and this was in the “adult” pool area, NOT the kids pool) we were told “yeah, it is Spring break”. OK got it. We won’t be back in February or March for sure. Wow what a disappointment.

reviews.author: Debra B
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician *****
reviews.text: My sister and I enjoyed afternoon tea at the Phoenician.  We sat in the lobby area with a wonderful view to the outdoors and near the piano; the pianist played at just the right volume and had wonderful selections for our listening pleasure.  Our table was beautifully set with china that had a white background with green vines and red flowers.  We started with tea - I recommend the white berry.
