The kind and talented gentleman who once played the beautiful steinway piano is now playing a cheap keyboard in the corner of the room, which can barely be heard. It is degrading to the musician, and makes the tea experience incomplete. PLEASE get the steinway back. It added class to the hotel. The only thing that hasn't changed is the incredible service, including Wanda and Natalie, who are the most wonderful and kind people who take excellent care of their customers. All of the staff are exceptional.

reviews.author: Heidi1999
reviews.title: Amazing customer service and great pools
reviews.text:
I've just returned from Girls' Weekend (Halloween weekend).  We were upgraded to a larger room with a huge patio - very lovely (reserved with SPG points).  The customer service is legendary.  It started before I ever arrived.  I called to make a reservation at the steak house and started talking with Felicia Gasparro who listened to my questions and wish list regarding my upcoming weekend and within a few minutes she emailed me with answers to my questions and had set up 2 other reservations for me within the resort.  Ms. Gasparro also sent me a list of suggested dining off of the resort for the one night we wanted to go out.  Perfection!

On a whim we decided to try Relish out on the golf course!  The bellman drove us there in a golf cart and the whole experience was delightful.  Additionally, at Relish a woman had gotten her gold chain from her Givenchy handbag stuck in the wood of the outdoor dining table.  We watched in awe as the staff practically took the table apart to rescue her bag, all the time assuring the woman that it was no trouble and they were actually enjoying themselves.   The food and atmosphere at Relish were just what we were looking for that night - don't miss it.

It was opening weekend for Mowry & Cotton and we went there.  Our muscles dish was not properly cooked and when we pointed it out the dish was removed with apology, removed from our bill, a fresh complimentary bottle of bubbly was brought out and an additional bottle of bubbly was given to us via coupon.  It was all very nice.  My one issue was with the lighting - a little too bright.

The lower pool (I think it's called the PEARL) was our favorite because the view is best from there.  We had quite a bit of delicious rose' while under umbrellas or wading in that glorious pool.  Service at the pool(s) was top notch.  I do miss the pretty bright yellow cabanas, however.  The new sand color is a miss in my opinion.  

Quick overviews:  Tea in the Thirsty Camel was so delicious!  And they had gluten free options for my friend (we should have called ahead but forgot but they still had options for her).  5 stars!  The Thirsty Camel was marvelous!

J&G Steakhouse.  Great views, good service, (call Felicia), food was great and the bartender made my friend a custom cocktail for her birthday.  Spendy 

Relish - Fun!  Yummy food and a great mini escape.

Mowry and Cotton - We thought our veggie starters were da'bomb!  The potatoes were so good we could have eaten them at every meal.

Spa:  Patricia at the spa was really great.  She listened, she didn't push product on me and she had a nice touch during my facial.  When the new spa opens it should be spectacular.  

I can't wait to go back to the Phoenician!

reviews.author: Jordana G
reviews.title: Beautiful Wedding Weekend - must go back!
reviews.text:
I came for a wedding weekend and would definitely return! The property was still under a bit of construction and even with that, was incredibly beautiful. Our room was just off of the lobby, spacious, clean, and had a great view of the pool. The bed was SUPER comfortable. The staff was friendly, attentive, and accommodating.The food was delightful and the drinks were great! 

I loved sitting by the pool, but would note that the only outdoor bathroom was all the way down by the bottom pool. The pool closest to the main lobby (where we sat) didn't have a bathroom, so it was easier to just go back to the room. Once construction is complete I'm sure that won't be an issue. 

The hotel had wonderful music in the lobby at night and we had a fantastic time at the wedding which was held in one of the ballrooms. I would definitely recommend staying here for a family weekend, or even a romantic getaway.

reviews.author: cmofames
reviews.title: A September Get Away
reviews.text:
While journeying to Hawaii my friends and I decided to spend 3 days in Phoenix for a little pre R & R. The hotel was under renovation so the main pool was closed. We were able to enjoy our selves by a smaller pool that is near the tennis courts. We were provided with a picture of ice water, served beverages and had lunch by the pool. There are bathrooms near by and we were perfectly comfortable visiting them wearing a beach cover-up. We had dinner 2 nights at the Relish Burger Bistro. They had a nice balcony where we were able to have a drink and burger.  

We stayed in the main hotel section of the resort. This place is HUGE so its very nice that the employees will give you a ride anywhere you need to go on-site in the golf cart. 

They have a market place in the main building where you can get coffee or a snack. Prices were a little high but I expected that!

Over all we enjoyed our stay. The beds are super comfortable and the bathrooms are roomy. I liked it so well that I'm bringing my husband there in 20 days. This time the big pool will be open!

reviews.author: Chestertripper
reviews.title: In my opinion - it's the best hotel in Arizona
reviews.text:
This hotel is simply the best I have ever stayed in in Arizona. The rooms are superb, the food excellent and service second to none. Inexpensive it is not but luxurious it is and that's what you pay for.
I look forward to a return visit soon.

reviews.author: lezlieliberty
reviews.title: Couldn't Be More Amazing
reviews.text: We spent three days at the Phoenician Hotel and the level of service was outstanding!  Each and every person that worked for the hotel went out of their way to be welcoming.  Personal attention to every aspect of the stay was amazing, not to mention the thoughtful gestures that we received to help celebrate my birthday!  Rooms are gorgeous and spotless, the new pools are stunning and the bar area, inside and out at the Thirsty Camel is the most relaxing area ever!  Food in all the restaurants was fabulous and the head Chef took the time out to meet us and talk about his menu and his delicious spiced "nuts"!  This is a first class hotel, with first class personal service.  All staff are especially engaging and we obviously enjoyed our stay! Thank you for such a great time!

reviews.author: JA522
reviews.title: Great Visit
reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed her for two nights and I wish I were still there! The room was amazing and the service outstanding. There was construction but we knew about that and it didn't detract from our experience. The breakfast was wonderful as was the food at the Mowry & Cotton Restaurant. We also had tea and they rebooked us so we could go on Friday instead of our original reservation on Sat when our plans changed.

My only issues were with customer service on the phone BEFORE my visit and a surly waiter at the J&G Steakhouse. The food was wonderful at the steakhouse but the waiter was so inattentive I complained. They made it right by taking some things off of our bill. All in all, I would be back and they always made it right. The Mowry&Cotton staff and the room service people were awesome! The maid also did an excellent job cleaning our room. Thanks for a memorable weekend and we will be back!

reviews.author: brotherbkw2017
reviews.title: Cockroach in the bathroom on two consecutive nights!
reviews.text: I am a Starwood Gold member and stayed at the Phoenecian from October 2 to 4th.  On my first night at the hotel, I noticed a cockroach in the shower.  I promptly called housekeeping / front desk to have someone remove it but no one showed up to address the problem.  I have NEVER been to a hotel of any kind, let alone one that charges these rates and found a cockroach in my room.  I included pictures of it.  Upon seeing another cockroach the second night, I called housekeeping again to get it addressed and finally someone came up to the room to remove it and spray insect repellent.

reviews.author: ninety6
reviews.title: Great afternoon
reviews.text:
One of schotsdalle best resorts.
I tried the afternoon tea that they have.
I love how people are friendly.
They had parking with garage which is a good idea due of the weather in phoenix.

Best regards

reviews.author: traceyrn
reviews.title: Pampered perfection!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this hotel. Granted I have never stayed in a 4 star hotel before, but it was beyond my imagination. The rooms are very large and well appointed. I loved the balcony, however, I would recommend a room closer to the center of the hotel if you want a pool view. The rooms near the end have a view of mostly concrete, but you still see the city lights beyond at night and the sunset was beautiful. Not all of the pools were open when we were there, but the pools that were open were great. They greet you when you walk in, put out a towel for you and bring pitchers of ice water. There is also music playing so you don't need headphones. The restaurants serve wonderful food and the staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: nancylenk
reviews.title: What a beautiful property
reviews.text: We had a two night stay this past week.  Rooms have all been totally redone.  Absolutely beautiful.  Staff excellent, friendly, totally five star.  We had an event that was 3 days on property.  Staff attention to detail was amazing.  Looking forward to staying here at a future date.

reviews.author: Webbie69
reviews.title: Always Love It Here’s!
reviews.text:
How can you ask for anything better!! One of the most beautiful hotels and scenery ever! The staff is so accommodating and friendly!
I love the beautiful views and also great food!
There aee a wide range of activities to do here to take advantage of the desert climate!

reviews.author: TravelGirlNashville
reviews.title: Great place despite construction!
reviews.text: Stayed here 4 nights and although we had restricted amenities due to construction, the room was so great I didn’t notice anything else!  Hotel staff was really great-valet especially!  Housekeeping did an excellent job as well.  I’ll stay here again!

reviews.author: parsonnick0
reviews.title: Stunning property. Peaceful and luxurious.
reviews.text: This is an absolutely stunning property in the middle of the desert by not far from downtown Scottsdale. Beautiful rooms. Gorgeous views. I didn't get to spend much time at the hotel during the day as I was working, but I hope to be back again soon.

reviews.author: Tomer K
reviews.title: Nice place to stay at
reviews.text:
Overall a nice stay, comfy big room.
I had a nice view to surrounding desert.
Hospitable crew, very welcoming and helpful
The hotel is a bit far from Scottsdae center, and the nearest mall is 45-60 min walk (so take Uber/cab)
Hotel breakfast was pretty expensive for no reason though

reviews.author: markdeter977
reviews.title: Why didn't anyone tell me about the construction?
reviews.text: This hotel should close during renovations if it's not going disclose to its guests about the renovations when booking.  I stayed here years ago and it was a beautiful resort, but my recent visit was disappointing and could have been avoided if they had simply disclosed the renovations.

reviews.author: trishax40
reviews.title: PARTIALITY & PROHIBITION was experienced at the "FAUX-NICIAN"
reviews.text:
Let me begin by stating that the room were beautifully decorated. However, it was extremely difficult to enjoy the amenities. Not because of the renovations, but because of the restricted use of the amenities.
 If the property automatically charges a "resort fee", there shouldn't be such limited access to the amenities. Upon check-in, ALL guest should be informed of "hours of operation" for use of tennis courts, golf, pool, etc. Doing so allows the guests to plan their activities. 
When we decided to plan golf (Sunday evening around 4:15p), the female at the front desk informed us that the course closes at 5pm. However, when we asked the concierge(5minutes later), he told us the course closes at 6pm.
 We didn't argue, we decided to just go play tennis. But, when we inquired, we were informed that the courts close at 2pm. We're pretty disappointed.at this point and decide to go sit along side the pool. It's now 4:55pm and there were two males playing tennis. Really? We were told the courts closed @ 2pm. We sat by the pool, just long enough to "cool off"(literally and figuratively) and then decided to go to our rooms and heat our meals from earlier. 
When we asked about a microwave, we were told, "there are no microwaves on the entire property". Feeling totally DISPLEASED, we gathered our food to go to a local convenience store. As we were exiting the property, we witnessed a "male" playing golf! (see picture). If we (females) were told the club house closes at 5pm, how is it that this "male" is playing @ 7:02pm???? 
There seems to be a LOT of Inconsistency and Inconsideration at the "Phoney-cian"! All the guests should be allowed to ENJOY the property/amenities...not just the "male" guests. Guests should be informed, PRIOR to arriving, if there is going to be Limited or Restricted Enjoyment!

reviews.author: Klur56
reviews.title: During construction, still great service
reviews.text: We usually visit every year. Knowing they were under construction, we were not planning a trip, but for personal reasons, needed to come to AZ. Of course our stay would be at Phoenician. While more then half of resort was closed due to construction, the staff were extremely accommodating to our needs. We will be visiting again in the next months, looking forward to their updated accommodations. Usually my rating is 5, but due to construction gave a 4.

reviews.author: FamofFive_10
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is a beautiful place and the pools are amazing. The rooms are big, very comfortable beds and well appointed, the bathrooms are fantastic and have large jetted tubs. Worth the extra money for a premium spot in Phoenix.

reviews.author: Tiggerbug
reviews.title: Fabulous place , breathtaking views of Camelback Mountain
reviews.text:
First time to visit this resort and this place is truly beautiful . Set against the backdrop that is  Camelback Mountain- the views are gorgeous if you happen to get a room having that scenery to look on. Even if you don't go hiking up the mountain trails , you can walk thru their Cactus Garden . 

Sadly, the pool and several other areas are under renovation at this time. We have kids with us so they were pretty much disappointed they couldn't go to the pool .

reviews.author: Mrlittell
reviews.title: Do not stay during renovations
reviews.text:
This was my first stay at the Phoenician. In the last 3 years, I have stayed at all but one of the 4.5-5 star resorts in Scottsdale. I knew construction would be going on at the property, but not at this rate.   I would say that probably 85% of common space at the hotel is closed off at this time.

From the start, check in was nothing I had ever seen or experienced before. I stayed on an AMEX Fine Hotels & Resorts rate which includes certain benefits which were not offered (was not given a survey or letter of benefits until the next day upon asking), and was asked if I wanted continental breakfast (upon asking I was told I was actually eligible for $80/day breakfast credit). Also was not offered 4pm checkout as that is also a benefit of AMEX FHR & SPG Platinum.... the list goes on and on. I felt lied to about many benefits during checkin as they were not offered until asking.

The "pool" is placed a far walk from the guest rooms and does not even have a sidewalk for part of the trek. The stones at the pool are scorching and after one day we neglected to return. The staff at the pool were very friendly and accommodating with ice water and the provided limited food/bev service.

Breakfast in the steakhouse was great and I assume the $25 charge is discounted because of construction.

Spa facilities were nonexistent although I believe they still offer services.

This review mostly applies only for a visit during renovations, as staff for the most part were very friendly and accommodating. I feel the renovations should have been spread out into more stages as to not turn this 5 star resort into a war zone with 3 star hotel amenities. 

I wish I had taken my money and business elsewhere and fully regret staying at this property. I stayed 158 nights at this chain of properties in 2016 and have NEVER experienced a stay like this. I hope this is taken to heart as I want the Phoenician to learn from this experience, however I will never return.

reviews.author: Beachlover92253
reviews.title: Very Romantic
reviews.text: This place has it all. Gorgeous, romantic, spacious and just WOW.  We stayed for our anniversary and we were treated like royalty. Rooms are big with beautiful views and the staff is fabulous. Restaurant was delicious and the area offers lots to do at night. Pool is great with a water slide and poolside drinks.

reviews.author: Chimomoftwo
reviews.title: Top Notch and exactly what I was looking for
reviews.text: Went here on a girls trip and it was absolutely perfect, quiet, luxurious, beautiful, clean and fantastic service.  Would definitely recommend and go back in a heartbeat!  Enjoyed the restaurant, the bar, and also had room service - relaxing and loved it.

reviews.author: RossK58
reviews.title: Renovating but well worth a visit
reviews.text:
The Thai wife and I had a one night stay to check the hotel out. We knew it was undergoing quite extensive renovations, hence the price is very low. We were given a top floor room facing the back of the mountain. It was quite a long and convoluted walk from the temporary reception area to the room but the verbal instructions given by the staff proved to be very accurate.

The room was large, well appointed, clean and everything worked. It was also very quiet. We had a wonderful covered balcony however there was a little too much dust and bird droppings to make much use of it or the outdoor seats. We looked at the temporary pool but were not tempted to have a swim.

We had dinner in the Relish Burger Bistro which has great views of the golf course. The food was very good and the beer nice an cold.

We slept well and had breakfast next day. Now here was the best aspect of the stay. The breakfast restaurant has both inside and outside seating, all with great views of Tempe to Phoenix to the south. The breakfast is a real eye opener, the best I've encountered in the US. Lots of juice and coffee options. A wide range of hot and cold sweet and savory options, all well presented and way above average quality.

This hotel is well worth a visit even while the renovations are underway.

reviews.author: peggy b
reviews.title: lovely Spot here during renovation
reviews.text: Great resort with lots of amenities.  Happen to be here during renovation, so a lot of extra navigation required.  Rooms nicely appointed.  Lovely balcony view of the mountain and the cacti.  Nice bed and large bath with walk in shower and lovely clean big tub.  The bath is segmented as well.  There is a small makeup table, but it is too far from natural light.  I do wish hotels like this would splurge a little and put nicer hair dryers in the rooms.  The toy ones just take forever.  As I said, lovely venue and if you golf, you will be very happy.  Hope to come back to see the renovations when they are complete!

reviews.author: Eric E
reviews.title: This is my favorite resort in the United States; first class staff, food, ammenities
reviews.text: The property is beautifully laid out and combines the mountain, desert, grass, and pools to create a serene and tranquil getaway.  I start feeling relaxed and happy the moment I arrive.  We had a two bedroom suite in a casita and walked across to our pool cabana in a few short steps.  We were treated like royalty and enjoyed our days swimming, eating, and drinking right at our lounge chairs.  The entire staff was professional and extremely well-trained.  The food consistently amazed us. We did room service almost exclusively and loved the presentation as much as the delicious meals.  Jaime, the Concierge, and Adam DuBose, the extraordinarily talented massage therapist were the highlights for us.  I love the Phoenician and look forward to returning again and again.

reviews.author: J H
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel in Scottsdale. Great for business or pleasure. Wonderful deck to sit on and have a drink overlooking the pools with a fire burning at night. close enough to mant attractions, but not in a crowded location.

reviews.author: LisaBsTravels
reviews.title: A Beautiful Hideaway Right in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Unfortunately I visited when the resort was under renovations.  The entire spa and pool complex were closed.  The property built a back-up pool over by the tennis courts which was very nice, but they used brick around the pool as a walking surface, and with the temperatures in Scottsdale, the brick held the heat and made the whole area scorching, and it immediately burned your feet to walk on.  I'm guessing the surface was inexpensive for a temporary pool but really? Brick? I think the renovations could have been planned in such a way to allow visitor more access to some of the facilities.  The staff was super friendly and accommodating to make up for all the inconveniences.  I'd probably stay there again when repairs were finished though. Perhaps then it would earn a 5-star review from me.

reviews.author: Randall C
reviews.title: Better than great
reviews.text:
If you look at the pictures online they will not do justice to this property. As soon as you drive up you will feel relaxed by the peaceful surroundings. I have stayed in this hotel for business for the last 5 years and I have never been disappointed. The food, golf, pool and bar areas are all over the top. Your room could overlook the golf course, pool or the cactus garden. There are hiking trails if you want a great workout.
The staff is unbelievably attentive. I would say it just does not get much better than this. This is a must see…..

reviews.author: Alecia S
reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text:
While we only toured the cactus garden and enjoyed a drink on the terrace, it's easy to see why this property is so popular.

Even though we were staying at another hotel, the staff were so attentive to us, it made me jealous we weren't staying (although, I'm not certain I could afford to).

We were welcomed and given tips on which bar, of the 3, that would provide the best views and where to enjoy the sunset.  I would definitely go back to enjoy a light dinner or late night tapas and champagne again!

reviews.author: cbfield
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Best hotel experience I've ever had. EVERY staff member acted pleased to help and went over and above the customary efforts to make guests welcome and comfortable. The room was quiet, clean and well furnished. The breakfasts for the convention (900+ people) were hot and delicious, and varied for each of the three days. The dinner was served hot, which is amazing considering the number of people in attendance. The pool facilities were clean and enticing. The property was attractive and well maintained. Yes, this is an expensive place to stay but it is worth the cost. Kudos to the management for running this resort exceptionally well and to the staff for your courtesy and competency.

reviews.author: Cheryl M
reviews.title: Truly a great resort
reviews.text: If you want to stay at a resort and be treated like a queen and king, this is the place to stay.  We enjoyed walking through the cactus garden. The linens on the beds were soft and silky. My granddaughter immediately ate the chocolate she found on her pillow as soon as we walked in our room.

reviews.author: drocb
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: Stayed here for a full week this spring.  Great location, only 5m to DT Scottsdale, spacious rooms, nice pool areas.  The Staff was very friendly and helpful.  I found the food selection was weak & very expensive.  This would be the only factor which would make me think twice before booking again.

reviews.author: Maureen G
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea
reviews.text: I have been enjoying afternoon tea with friends at The Phoenician for 20 years   Much to our dismay, and without notice when we made our reservation, tea had been moved to the golf course. Needless to say nowhere near the same experience! But it gets worse, the free flowing champagne option had been changed to one glass!!! Again without notice to us. As my Uber driver said "not even close to the same experience " :(. Only reason for the 5 stars is Wanda who is absolutely wonderful. But next time, assuming there will be a next time, I am looking at 2/3 stars, definitely nowhere near 5.

reviews.author: brhendri
reviews.title: High tea Sunday June 11th
reviews.text:
Natalie and was fabulous as was the rest of the staff. Sorry we missed Wanda but she was on her well deserved vacation. 

We have been coming her for over 15 years and always take in tea. It appeared Management was off today as we did not have them hovering over us double checking the staff. Sooo much more relaxing. A word of advise to management, stop micro managing, realize you have a great staff that knows what their doing and let them do their thing.

reviews.author: Elz B
reviews.title: Seriously Hot Thank Goodness for the Pool!
reviews.text:
Lobby was lovely, pool was large and lovely and crowded but still nice. It was summer so H-O-T is an understatement. You'll be i the poo or in the air-conditioned room during the heat of the day. 

Per usual for a 4/5 star hotel great robes. 

Great service and recommendations for staff. No complaints on this place at all.

reviews.author: blessedinlife
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: We decided to take advantage of the low rates due to the renovations at the Phoenician. It is a bit confusing how to get to the redirected entry, but even if you go to the wrong gate there is a guard who gives directions. All of the staff we encountered were very friendly and helpful. We did take advantage of valet for $29 a night because I didn't want to have to figure out the self-park. Valet did offer us bottles of water every time we left and returned. We were given an upgraded room when we checked in that had better views. The lady at the front desk also escorted us to the escalators to get to our room. Room was very clean and there are two complimentary bottles of water that are provided each day.  Internet was also complimentary and ran fast enough for our purposes. We had hoped to have some pool time, but after seeing how far we would have to walk in our swimsuits we decided against it. The entire property is gorgeous and we enjoyed our stay very much!

reviews.author: sreshy
reviews.title: A relaxing business conference
reviews.text: This is my third time staying at The Phoenician in Scottsdale. Every time I've stayed here I received good to great service and have never been disappointed by the food or amenities. The conference area is convenient yet out of the way.  I look forward to my next stay.

reviews.author: AtlHennessy
reviews.title: Nice hotel, too much construction
reviews.text:
The Phoenician looked like a hotel that, when it's not under a major renovation, is quite nice and relaxing. Unfortunately the renovation seemed to leave 80% of the hotel unavailable to the guests. The room was nicely appointed (reminded me of a nicer version of a Westin room). The view was pretty and looked out at Camelback Mountain. The bar and restaurant was a very nice spot for a drink. That said, we were ignored by the bartender for close to ten minutes and only got service when I went and grabbed the manager for help. The view from the bar is very pretty and I highly recommend a sunset drink and, if you are lucky enough for a lightning storm it is quite impressive. The rest of the staff, aside from the abysmal bartender, was competent and friendly. The porters gave excellent directions and recommendations. The gym is tiny and very much undersized for a hotel this size, and this high end (considered to be part of the luxury collection). The gym was not luxury level and I've had much nicer experiences at lower level hotels. The gym was also a very long walk (or short run) away from the only exit. Not a big deal, but was just oddly far away. The convention facilities were very nice, the food was quite delicious and the chairs refreshingly comfortable. The location is terrific for a run and quite close to Camelback Mountain which is terrific and exhilarating hike to the top.

My one big complaint was the golf course. The rate was in excess of $140 for a round and the course was not in top condition. The layout, views and flow were terrific, the quality and maintenance was not. In addition on three of the holes the ground crew was mowing the fairway and rough, something I have yet to experience on any other golf course. Note, we had a noon tee time so it's not like we were there late, it was inexcusable for a rate that high.

Overall a good experience but the construction had a significant impact on the hotel and the rates need to reflect this impact more... they already have them reduced. I would like to come back and stay when the construction is finished and find another course to spend my money.

reviews.author: TravelingFamx
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text:
I had stayed her many years ago and had really forgotten how nice it is

Impeccable grounds, incredible service plus newly remodeled rooms

The breakfast buffet is also sensational

The only issue is our room never got quite cool enough

Highly recommend staying here especially if you love pools and golf!

reviews.author: Patty B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
The Westin Phoenician is a luxury resort located between Phoenix and Scottsdale.  The grounds are beautifully maintained and the views of Camelback Mountain are stunning.  Front desk staff is friendly and efficient.  Check-in was a breeze and our luggage was brought to our room immediately.  
The deluxe double room in the main resort building was clean and very spacious with a private balcony.  The spacious marble bathroom had a separate bathtub and shower. 
The pool area has cabanas available, but if you just want to lounge by the pool, you can enjoy the views of Camelback Mountain.  
The resort is close to shopping malls, restaurants, and Historic Oldtown is about 2 miles away.  Limousine service is available at a reasonable price.  I believe there is self-parking area as well as valet parking.  
Appetizers and cocktails at the Thirsty Camel Lounge were very good.  I believe the lounge is open in the afternoon and evening only.  The view from the outdoor lounge area is stunning in the evening.  
We had a wonderful dinner at J and G Steakhouse. Food was superb and we enjoyed the beautiful view of the valley at night Service was fantastic.  
The Italian Restaurant, Il Terrazzo, has a wonderful Sunday brunch buffet.  There is a nice variety of meats, cheeses, salads, pasta dishes, fresh fruit, and omelets.  
There is a golf course on site, but we did not play golf or dine at the Burger Bistro located in the clubhouse.  The resort has a spa, but we did not visit.  
I would highly recommend the Phoenician for couples or family vacation.

reviews.author: Andrej S
reviews.title: Very attentive staff, well equipped hotel in a beautiful setting. Loved the food!!!
reviews.text:
Hotel has all the bells and whistles you are looking for. Tennis, golf, swimming pools, well setup and equipped gym with machines and free weights + cardio equipment. 
Make sure you visit the beautiful cactus/drought tolerant plant collection/garden behind the hotel itself. Bistro serves a selection of delicious burgers, sandwiches and salads. The hotel offers an afternoon "Tea" style lunch as well in a beautiful setting with gorgeous views. I have to admit that the highlight of the trip was the breakfast buffet. The cost was around $25 per person for the full ride and it was truly outstanding. Even when compared to high end Vegas buffets. The selection was obviously smaller than the Vegas monsters, but the variety and quality of food were top notch! I hope the GM, F&B Director and Chef all read this review! Fresh juice and smoothie shots, chia seed muesli, bread pudding, omelets, waffles, cheeses, meats, fruit cocktail with a hint of mint, yogurt bar, Irish oatmeal station, bread station and many I can't even recall. As a well internationally and domestically traveled person and foodie, this is as good as it gets!!!! Exceptional value!!! If you are in the Area, please visit. Hotel staff was fantastic and very friendly. They offered water to keep you hydrated and frequently asked if they could provide directions, help or answer questions. Thanks!

reviews.author: StaceyHKC
reviews.title: Conference Venue
reviews.text: This hotel is a little dated, but the rooms have recently been refurbished and are very nice. I was there for a conference and those facilities were great, but the hotel-provided dining was not very good. The spa services were great, but the facilities could use an update (I believe that is scheduled in the future). There is a golf course and several pools.

reviews.author: John Warren
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.text: I was a little disappointed when I found that there were renovations being carried out for the next six month and that several amenities would not be available. however the quality of the staff the comfort of the room soon dispelled that anxiety. We had a tremendous seven night stay, beautiful room overlooking Camelback, well appointed and so comfortable. Ate at J&G Steakhouse, a tad expensive but worth every penny from the service to the food and the view. Also ate at the Relish bistro Bar, also excellent and relaxed. Walked the grounds every morning, every member of staff acknowledged me with a smile, a nod or a wave. Maid service and nightime turn down service was also excellent. My wife had a massage, although the Spa is being renovated they massage took place in a group of rooms on the fourth floor at the rear of the building, she was exceptionally happy with the result. Both Concierges that we interacted with (Michelle & Shannon) were delightful and knowledgeable and extremely helpful. Front Desk staff were always very responsive and pleasant. The pool are has been relocated during the renovations, whilst small, totally adequate and again lovely service from pool attendants A thoroughly enjoyable stay, Can't wait to return when renovations are complete.

reviews.author: Erouse
reviews.title: Made business seem like pleasure!
reviews.text:
I loved the accommodations at the Phoenician!  The attention to detail helped make a work trip feel more like a relaxing resort giveaway. 
My room faced their Cactus Garden and I loved the Holiday lights!
The room was huge and the bathroom was exactly what you would expect from a luxury resort. Be sure to ask for the bath salts! 
It's a large resort and some of the room are a hike from the main lobby but it was well worth it!

reviews.author: Renee M
reviews.title: Over charging for the room
reviews.text: The Phoenician, Scottsdale was used for our Corporate Meeting. My when I checked out my bill was 433.34 paid with my card, Today, I see that my card was charged an additional 777.68 After speaking to the day manager that was going to call me back, That never happened, Called back now they say could take 72 hours before they can refund me.  Why ? Should I have to wait, to get my money back, I paid my bill of 433. They stole  777.68 now they say they are checking into it. If you steal you go to jail, right.

reviews.author: Dr. Rodriguez
reviews.title: Such a beautiful property
reviews.text:
Although they plan on remodeling, the property is still gorgeous. Stayed here for a recent conference and had such a nice time. I had a beautified room at the Casedas. The pool was so refreshing. The only issue (if you even want to call it that) I had was on a food order at the pool bar. The drinks were AMAZING but the chicken quesadilla that I ordered tasted as if the chicken was bad. The bartender apologized and offered another order but I was already turned off by the first. He was nice enough to remove it from my bill, thanks Kris. 
Take advantage of the outings that are available. I went rock climbing and had a great time!! 
The golf course here is so beautiful

reviews.author: racquetman_MN
reviews.title: Great great hotel and resort
reviews.text:
This resort hotel is humongous and spreads all over with three 9 hole golf courses. The hotel has everything for a family vacationing or a business person attending a conference. Lots of amenities like gym, pool, restaurants etc.
The staff is cordial.

reviews.author: Joe Leone
reviews.title: The Canyon Suites are spectacular!!
reviews.text: When we went to the Phoenician in April, we stayed in the canyon suites. From our room, we had an amazing view of camelback mountain. The service there was unbelievably good. The foood was fairly expensive, but good. The room was very clean and so was the rest of the property. I would recommend this resort to anyone who loves the southwest, or anywhere else.

reviews.author: UmmaBAtraveller
reviews.title: Serious renovations! Way too much $$ , and definitely not a 5 star stay
reviews.text:
This property is open during the renovation and in my opinion should NOT be open.
For the hefty price of approx $500/n.. to get to the room takes a 15 minute walk, and its way in the corner somewhere.  All the shops are closed , only pool is near tennis and nothing to speak of. Only one restaurant the JG steak house , and check out the review for that. Again over priced and not worth it. With ALL the other amazing properties in Phoenix , I would highly recommend not staying during reno's.

reviews.author: westcoastgal11
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.text:
We stayed over Christmas and had a nice time.  The hotel has beautiful grounds and is close to the Camelback hike trail head.  Our first room had a view of a concrete wall so we had to upgrade but the view over the golf course was really nice and worth it! .  Breakfast was very good and the service was great.  The manager, Arlis, was really accommodating and the definition of a good manager. 

The location is great - we walked to old town many times and it is located across from a nice neighbourhood, great for a nice walk!

Christmas morning breakfast was a bit disorganized, there were a lot of unhappy customers and although we didn't say too much they discounted it 50%.  We couldn't complain about that. 

Christmas dinner at J&G Steakhouse wasn't our favourite, we had a better time at Relish, the golf course restaurant.  We got the wrong wine and when we mentioned it wasn't very good, they tried to argue that it was correct and they would decant it for us.  Once we clarified, they switched it but it wasn't a smooth customer service experience.

Overall, it was a great stay and wouldn't hesitate to return.

reviews.author: Kevin F
reviews.title: A beautiful quiet hotel
reviews.text:
This is a great place to stay will in Phoenix.  There is a great golf course close by and some nice local hikes that give you great views of the city.  

This is a plus hotel with great service and nice pools.

reviews.author: Gilcd85
reviews.title: Nice hotel - not while under construction
reviews.text:
We stayed with Phoenician for four nights. The hotel is nice overall and has a luxury feel to it with specious rooms and nice amenities. 
All that said, the hotel is currently undergoing renovation which is a major source of discomfort. Noise and visuals aside, the lobby of the hotel was moved farther away from the guest rooms and the underground parking compound was closed for valet parking only (valet was in another location previously) and so the guests are forced to park in an outside parking area farther away from the hotel. 
This had us parking roughly 10 minutes walking distance from the room. Bringing in the language on the first day was hell (nobody considered offering complimentary luggage services) and imagine my dismay when I learned that I had forgotten my cell phone in my car one day and had to make a 15-20 minute round trip part of it in scorching heat in order to retrieve it. 
I cannot possibly begin to understand a hotel which forces its guests to part outside just to keep their valet operation in business nor can I understanding why the hotel keeps the farthest buildings open during this renovation. 

One more issue we encountered was receiving packages. We travel internationally and regularly ship packages to our hotel room ahead of our arrival to save time spent shopping. When I came to collect my packages I learned that the hotel uses a FedEx office when dealing with guest packages and charges almost 10 USD (!!) handing fee for each package. I reached out to the staff but was told that this is an external Currier and that they can't help me with it. Needless to say I returned most of my packages to sender. I have been travelling on business in these parts of the US for 15 years and this is the first time I have ever been asked to pay for receiving packages. To me this is unacceptable. 

All in all this is a nice hotel but I would absolutely avoid it until the renovation is complete.

reviews.author: Susan K
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: I went here for a conference.  The facilities were exceptionally good, the food was great, the rooms were spacious and clean, and the staff was well, a bit snooty, but overall good.  The pool area was beautiful and I heard from others that the golfing was wonderful (I don't golf).  Also I had lunch in one of the restaurants and it was great (the Italian one?) with very attentive service and a nice selection of food and drinks.

reviews.author: HighlandBeachFL
reviews.title: New Renovations Are Great.
reviews.text:
The resort has always been beautiful and in a fabulous location; however the last time we stayed here is was a little tired. It is now in the process of renovations. They've done a wonderful job with the rooms and the hallways. They are starting the pool area on May 1. 
With these changes we highly recommend the resort for couples and families.

reviews.author: Bridget H
reviews.title: High Tea at the Phoenician
reviews.text: In case I have neglected to post a review of this amazing Tea experience ...  i've enjoyed high tea at many wonderful places around the Phoenix area, the country and the world.   And honestly and terms of the food quality and the mere quantity nothing can compare to Tea at the Phoenician resort. There used to be a British tea hostess who finally retired a couple of years ago.     She definitely set the bar very high interims of hospitality and setting the tone, but the ladies who are hostessing now are just as kind and always recognize me when I go. I always take family and friends to Tea on Thanksgiving weekend for sure.   Never fails to impress and no one ever goes home hungry. In fact you can't schedule dinner later because you're just simply too full.   They just keep serving and serving until you are done. Their sandwiches are always lovely,  delicious and varied. The tea selection is very nice,  served British style with cream if you wish, and champagne is available as well as coffee if there are members of your party who just do not like tea.     The china service is beautiful. The china that they used to have for high tea was actually the same pattern as the one Princess Diana owned. I went to Tea many times when they used that service and they finally retired it because it was so valuable because pieces were getting broken.    It was spectacularly delicate and beautiful.     The new service  is beautiful also and matches the new carpeting installed at the same time they changed the china service. There are cute little nooks and crannies with beautiful  upholstered sofa is in low chairs with low coffee tables if you wish. as well as regular seating around cozy little tables with upholstered chairs and a lovely view of the city through the floor-to-ceiling glass windows across the room. There's a large patio that you can go out and sightsee from or have a drink etc  if you wish later. Always good for a few photos. You can see the resort spread out below you. Done this for so many years and has become a holiday tradition and I'm never disappointed nor are my guests.  Also had high tea at the Ritz Carlton and at the Biltmore resort and wihile both were very nice they really cannot compare to the Phoenician.  I also had high tea at the Dorchester in London which is incredibly luxurious and ornate, and while incredibly beautiful still cannot compare to the Phoenician.  The Phoenician is my standard and a very high one it is for enjoying afternoon tea anywhere.

reviews.author: Fred L
reviews.title: Golf course review only
reviews.text:
As a reference, I'm a 7 handicap and belong to a couple good courses in the NW. I'm not super picky other than bunkers, greens, and level tees. 
This course is managed by Troon so they do a relatively good job at all their facilities. I was a little disappointed in the maintenance though. The traps clearly need more sand as evidenced by the under netting which was pulled up from the sides and bottom of a few bunkers. Greens rolled true but we're slower than I expected. 
It isn't a walker friendly course because you need to drive some pretty significant distances between green and tee and from the completion of one nine to the next. 
The course is relatively easy at slope ~126 or so from the tips. 
Fairways were well kept although clearly they see much play. Cost at 2:30 in April was ~$90.

reviews.author: 246kab
reviews.title: Exceptional hotel, disappointing food.
reviews.text:
The hotel was lovely.  We did not stay, but met there for dinner.  The food was good, but not remarkable.  Service was good, but a little overkill.  Would we go there again? Yes, but it didn't compare to Rene in Sedona where everything was PERFECT!
The grounds and pool however are remarkable!  I am guessing staying would be better than dining.

reviews.author: marlainemaahs
reviews.title: Great meeting location
reviews.text: We attended a business meeting here and were very pleased! The staff is very friendly and helpful. The pool is relaxing and the pool service was great. Also really appreciate the cafe as a place to grab a quick bite! Another perk of longer stays is that you can choose to have maid service every three days. We still had plenty of towels and supplies, but didn't have to work our schedule around the maid staff.

reviews.author: sile597
reviews.title: OMG! What a stellar Hotel. Grand views.
reviews.text: The views are fantastic. Golfing is really picture perfect. Great dining. Cactus gardens were lovely. Courteous staff. The pools are PERFECTION. This is a lovely stay. Near many fantastic restaurants!

reviews.author: PdotChan
reviews.title: Amazing Property!
reviews.text: Recently stayed here for 3 nights. Staff was amazing, and the property was beautiful. My only complaint was that everything is shut down around 11:30, so the only way to order a drink would've been room service. Other than that, everything was perfect!

reviews.author: VirginiaLuvtogo
reviews.title: stayed here for years...so downhill
reviews.text:
First night and multiple problems ............have stayed here for several years and the attention to detail has deteriorated.  
Tried to discuss needs with housekeeping and none of them could speak English.
Service at the restuarants was lacking and the staff expressed disappointed in their jobs and said were not recognized or paid.
Had to beg for turndown service at 9:30.
So sad......this used to be a top choice for us.

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Not worth the cost, and hazardous too
reviews.text: For the most part, a very nice resort. Beautiful grounds, well maintained, and lots of grounds staff. But I much preferred the Omni, especially for 45% less per night. I had four bad experiences: thrice at breakfast, where it took forever to get coffee, they put cheese on my omelette when I had just told them no cheese, and they cleared my table while I was waiting for my omelette, despite my not having paid and leaving my iPhone on the table. The egregious upsetting experience was that while I was washing my hands in the fitness center restroom, a 3 ft wood panel fell off the vanity (it was missing a clip, it appears) and scraped both my shins, requiring bandages. When I told them about it, they notified maintenance but I didn't even receive a note apologizing for the issue, much less a token like a comped night, which is what I would expect from a 5 Diamond resort.

reviews.author: Megan D
reviews.title: Casitas were beautiful.  Lots to do.  Great service.
reviews.text: This was our second time at the phoenician.  We opted for the Casitas this time.  newly remodeled, they were lovely.  The weather was a bit cold, but the children enjoyed swimming and the staff accommodated them by turning on the water slide/splashpad.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  Food was quite good as well.

reviews.author: Jenny D
reviews.title: Mediocre Place and Luxury Price
reviews.text: Way overpriced for the average accommodations and customer service. We were disappointed in lack of cleanliness and loud construction/jackhammering occurring during peak pool hours.  Hard to find seats by the pool, no attendant for the water slide (not safe with amount of kids) TV in our cabana didn't work and blah salads for $20.

reviews.author: Barbara M
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: Loved it! Beautiful pools and fun atmosphere for families. I loved the kids menu!!! Sounds crazy but it had hummus/ranch veggies dish that I was double ordering everyday so I could have some.  Also fish and grilled chicken selection.  I appreciate a kids selection that is healthy and taste good.  Ate so well everyday - no chicken fingers and fries for us all week so we left feeling healthy and energized.  The breakfast buffet was so visually stunning that I should snapped a pic. Delicious and beautiful.  Room amenities were lovely. Nothing over the top and my view was eh. But we were happy to be on the property, playing tennis, doing the kids activities, swimming and eating that we were rarely in the room.  We will definitely return. Also - great location! 20 minutes from airport. 5 minutes from the best shopping and dining.

reviews.author: sunshine504
reviews.title: Nice hotel, friendly staff
reviews.text: My family and I stayed here during last week of March. We did like the hotel and the staff was very nice and friendly.  It was spring break, so I expected the pool to be crowded and that we'd have to get up early to save chairs.  I did not expect that we'd have to be down at the pool before 6:45am each morning.  Towards the end of our stay, they finally put a sign telling people to that if they were not back at their chairs by 9am, their belongings would be stored in the manager's office.  I really wish they would have posted the sign before!  Also, 4pm is a little late for housekeeping to show up. Overall, it's a nice hotel with great amenities.  Tennis courts are very nice and it was easy to reserve a court.

reviews.author: nwmac
reviews.title: Great Place in Scottsdale beneath Camel Back Mountain
reviews.text:
Loved this place. Had a great room facing the pools and Camel Back. Everything here was 5 Star! I was super impressed with everything at this resort. The pools were great.... I loved that you could walk to the Camel Back Trail entrance. 

Staff, food, location, and everything else was great. I'd love to go back.

Hiking to the top of Camel Back is tougher than I thought it'd be but a huge highlight. Make sure you take enough water on a hot day.

Hope to get back there in the future.

reviews.author: TrapperJohn60
reviews.title: An OK experience at best.
reviews.text: An OK experience at best. Although our room faced the mountain with beautiful views, our kids room faced a gigantic concrete monolith leaving them no view from a very pricey room. The pool was the real disappointment, beat up and cramped, with a minuscule hot tub that was lukewarm. Hanging out at a great pool for a day was the whole point of trying out this resort, and the place was a drag.  Restaurants were excellent, but the place should be avoided until they revamp and rebuild.

reviews.author: cheftod67
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: Celebrating our anniversary at the Phonecian, beautiful property, all the staff have been wonderful. Very quite and relaxing, pools are very nice but are going to get a facelift summer of 2017. Rooms have been renovated and are even more gorgeous than before. Property is so large still looking for the 168ft water slide. Will come back again.

reviews.author: Amyjo911
reviews.title: Girls weekend with 11 year old neice, sister and 72 year old mom.
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about the service we received at this place. I completely felt the staff's genuine intention for our visit to be extraordinary. It was immaculate at all times. Please do book a golf cart safari with Cactus Jack - he was entertaining, jovial, informative and accommodating. You must also experience High Tea on one of your afternoons. They do an impeccable service to such a delightful experience. I look very forward to another opportunity to stay there.

reviews.author: Shelly G
reviews.title: AWESOME PLACE
reviews.text: We stayed at the casitas near Relish Burger.  These rooms were perfect as we were traveling with our daughter so this room gave her privacy.  The rooms were very spacious and well maintained and the turndown service was prompt.  My family never had the feeling that this wasn't a top luxury hotel!  From the front desk to the bar waiters, this place made me feel welcome in a pampering way.  My wife said the next time we are in the Phoenix area, the Phoenician will be our first choice!!!

reviews.author: Calore03
reviews.title: Excellent golf
reviews.text:
Did an early morning round of golf (all 27 holes) at the end of March 2017. Reviews indicated the Desert 9 were the best but we thought the Canyon 9 was tops. Views were amazing.  Course was in excellent shape. Green held great.  Course was in great shape.  

The Oasis 9 appeared to be the oldest 9 and not as nice as the other 2 but there were some nice areas here also.  We booked online and got an affordable price. Would definitely go back.

reviews.author: EricaC01
reviews.title: Undewhelmed by our experience-- wheelchair accessible room lacking
reviews.text:
We visit Scottsdale often and decided to try something different and stay at The Phoenecian because we had heard such great reviews. As a wheelchair user, accessibility is of the utmost importance when we decide where to stay. The overall accessibility of the hotel was pretty good- although the carpeting was very thick there were automatic door openers to the hallway of our room, the entire property is ramped for the most part, they have lifts for the pool. The accessible room itself had no grab bars in the bathroom, the roll in shower was not large enough for my shower chair so my legs stuck out, there was an automatic door opener on the room door but it had been disabled, the bed was extremely low and some of the light switches were obstructed. On the positive side the sink was a roll under, the shades were battery operated. We were told that the rooms had recently been redone but later also found out that, despite telling two managers about the issues, none of our comments had been documented. 
We encountered a few other issues such as dealing with a malfunctioning system to enter/exit the self parking garage and poor housekeeping. The self parking garage issue was ongoing all week and meant that you had to call and wait for someone at the hotel to answer and buzz you in. By Saturday they had at least lifted the arm so you could just get in/out. We ended up speaking with two different managers regarding this issue. 
Housekeeping generally did not get to our room until almost 3pm everyday. On the second to last day I cut myself shaving and there was a very obvious stain of blood on the sheet. We were very surprised to return late that night and find that it had not been changed. 
Lastly, we encountered a mix up with our credit cards and the room charges after check out. The accounting department was prompt in dealing with the issue but when I asked to speak to the General Manager because of all of the issues we had encountered I was given the run around and it was not until I refused payment that I received a call from him. 
Overall, our experience was underwhelming and I left there feeling that while the staff was very attentive and pleasant, the management was sub standard. None of our complaints or concerns had been documented and the upper level of management seem to deflect engaging with their guests.

reviews.author: golfpromo
reviews.title: Very nice hotel, great staff, very large rooms, nice grounds and pools.
reviews.text: We had a great cheeseburger at the Relish Burger Bistro. One night we ordered room service and had a poor experience, the order was incorrect and food was poor. If you are going to the pool get their early to get a lounge chair. Friendly staff from front desk to valets.

reviews.author: A S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort for spring break
reviews.text: The Phoenician is beautiful - from the gorgeous grounds to the pools to the stylish/updated guest rooms. With direct access to hiking and multiple activities on the grounds (tennis, golf, swimming) it has everything needed for a great family vacation.  We had a double queen room with more than enough space for our family of 4.  Beds were comfortable with top of the line linens and duvets.  The marble bath had a large soaker tub, double vanities and a walk in shower. We enjoyed cocktails in the evening next to the fire pit on the balcony overlooking the resort and there was live music in the lobby bar. My only complaint is that they allow guests to leave their stuff on chairs at the pool very early in the morning and not return for hours.  During spring break week we had to go down at 6:00 AM in order to get a chair in a desirable area. I have been to plenty of luxury resorts that don't allow chair saving and suggest that the Phoenician consider this as well. It was super annoying on our first day to sit in a back corner next to a trash can while chairs all around us were occupied only by flips flops and magazines. Despite this small issue, it was a great stay and I highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: MassimilianoG
reviews.title: Fantastico
reviews.text: Ottimo hotel, fantastiche le sale, buonissimo ristorante interno. Hotel incastonato sotto il Camelback, qualcosa di straordinario. Personale molto attento ad ogni esigenza. Ottimo per il relax e il golf. quasi perfetto.

reviews.author: joelU7521RX
reviews.title: Very nice visit until I was refused late checkout. Yes "They just don' care"
reviews.text: I stayed at The Phoenican the last weekend 3/24 and 3/25 for a family wedding.  We had 30 people staying at the resort with a rehearsal dinner on Friday and post wedding Sunday Brunch both on the property for 100 guests.  When I inquired about extended checkout beyond noon since the brunch was still happening the front desk said no.  I spoke with the front desk manager Jordan Schultz and was told that there was nothing he could do about a late checkout.  He did seem to care one bit that our family was spending $50,000 on rooms and meals for the weekend.  This is totally unacceptable treatment!

reviews.author: cjbmf66
reviews.title: They just don't care
reviews.text:
I am in day three if a six day stay at The Phoenician. I have stayed here before and to say that it has slipped is an understatement. I am in agreement with past reviews that claim the property is living off of its past reputation. That seems clear to me. In the last year I have stayed at The Fontainebleau in Miami, Edgewater Beach in Naples, The Wynn in Las Vegas, The Peninsula Chicago and Las Ventanas in Cabo. I only say this to state that I have some reference hotels to measure The Phoenician by.  This place is no where close to a AAA Five Diamond resort. Like past reviews I was screwed over by reservations. I made my reservation for a ground floor two bedroom casita. I only booked it because we have stayed there on previous trips. I made the reservation 10 months in advance and called multiple times over that year to check on my reservation accuracy including three days before I arrived. Guess what, they did not have my room. This is a $2000/night room and they gave us somehting different. Of course I talked to management and they could care less. They tried to appease us with a coupon for ice cream - really? Some additional experiences, no maid service until 5:00pm the first day. Then we requisted earlier service and it's now 4:00pm the next day and still no maid service. We were at the pool both days for 6 hours and no one came to clean the room. Most everything is old and outdated. Margaritas are $20.00 without tip. They called our room at 11:00pm last night trying to deliver room service that we never ordered and woke up all the kids.  They had the wrong room on the delivery ticket. Turns out it was ours room on the wrong ticket...of course. They cannot get out of their own way. 
Saying you are sorry and offering a coupon for ice cream is insulting and condescending. I would never recommend this place. The JW Marriott, The Fairmont and Gainey Ranch are all better.

reviews.author: letsgofire
reviews.title: Classy hotel even better after the upgrades
reviews.text:
I've stayed at the Phoenician many times over the years and it is my favorite hotel in Phoenix. After a gap of maybe two years, I returned in Jan 2017. I felt compelled to write a review after I saw how nice the upgrades have been. The rooms - which looked rather dated - have now been tastefully renovated.

The hotel maintains all of its strengths from before, especially the wall-to-wall great service. I really enjoy this hotel and hope you do too.

reviews.author: HKMomNewYork_NY
reviews.title: looks luxurious, feels inhospitable
reviews.text:
The Phoenician looks like a luxury property and it has lots of luxury details --our rooms were large, the beds comfortable, nice toiletries, fancy pools and grounds. But the whole place feels incredibly corporate and nothing about it seems intended to make guests feel valued as opposed to sucking every last cent out of their pockets.  The staff has clearly been coached to mouth welcoming phrases, but bottom line is there are polices in place and nothing will be changed for individual guests. As an example, when I was checking in, I was asked if the employee could indicate a check out time for me in their system. Which sounds like, when do you want to check out, we can be flexible. It's not.  I asked if it could be a bit later than noon and they said no, so basically this question is designed to look like it is individualizing your experience while getting them information about which rooms they can clean early (helping them, not the guest). There is nothing wrong with adhering to a set check out time, but it’s silly to try to dress it up this way. They charge extra for connecting rooms, which just makes me feel like a profit center to be exploited. If you have connecting rooms available give them to me, if you don't, don't.  It is not more expensive to you to do that.   

The pools are beautiful but the shapes and sizes are such that you can't really swim much, and they were, in 60 degree February weather, heated only to 82 degrees.  That feels cold (by contrast, earlier in the week we stayed at the Arizona Biltmore which heats pools to 86. that’s a big difference).  In the bathrooms, the floor had a drain but was not sloped toward it, so you just have a drain surrounded by puddles, and for some reason the hook for robes is placed in the one part of the wall that means hanging anything makes the light switch inaccessible.  None of these are horrible but at the prices they charge, shouldn’t happen. The minibar, which is an extra cost, is very easy to get to. The coffeemaker, which is free? Its stuck inside a cabinet at floor level so you have to sit on the floor or squat down to use it.  Even the business center – which is free to use  in many hotels – is subcontracted out to Kinko’s/FedEx and charges for anything but printing boarding passes  -- which is especially annoying when you already have to pay for WiFi.  

I would single out the pool attendants as a good thing, very nice people who set up lounges with big soft towels (and enough of them) and drinks.

reviews.author: PaulsonsTravels
reviews.title: Disappointed unfortunately...
reviews.text: Greeted warmly by the receptionist upon arrival. Thought we were off to a good start. SPG room upgrade for platinum membership was unremarkable. Even told to check back daily for late checkout ending up haggling over 30 minutes.  This is the first time I've experienced that!  SPG breakfast credit as the amenity was insufficient to cover the cost of any items on the menu and not well understood by the wait staff. Had dinner at the Jean George resturaunt and served an overdone cold steak. Thankfully it was redone and comped resulting in us not eating at the same time.  The adult pool is full of children and the pool restroom smells like it is full of mold. Not expected for this once belle of Scottsdale. Time for the management team to attend to details.

reviews.author: viktor334
reviews.title: An Excellent Experience
reviews.text:
No question the Phoenician is a five star property, as you turn of Camelback Drive you are greeted by beautiful landscaping , when entering the lobby you have a great view of the surounding area. The service throughout the hotel is extremely friendly and professional, A do not miss is the J G restaurant 

V Weyand

reviews.author: 27Sparky
reviews.title: AFTER THE SHOW
reviews.text: After going to the Shen Yun performance, we spontaneously stopped by the Phoenician for dinner at J&B's Steak and had the most fabulous dinner.  Our waiter, Jeff was exceptional, my filet was the best I've ever tasted and my husband's ribeye couldn't have been better.  We were also impressed by our Lobby hostess Mandy. She went out of her way to secure dinner reservations for us.   This is definitely my favorite place to be in Arizona.

reviews.author: WalnutBaron
reviews.title: Luxury!
reviews.text:
What a great destination. The Phoenician is iconic in the Southwest for good reason: it's elegant, enchanting, and immerses its guests in great service and pure luxury. Every room in the hotel looks out on the beautifully kept grounds, the pools, and the valley beyond, resting in the shadow of Camelback Mountain. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, highlighted by the Heavenly Bed, Starwood's signature bed.

There are four restaurants within the hotel complex at varying price points. Relish Burger was outstanding. 

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jan C
reviews.title: A Grand Old Lady
reviews.text:
The Phoenician has been around for awhile, but she still exudes elegance and luxury. From the fountains and sculptures in the entry to the multiple terraced pools beyond, the hotel envelopes the senses. The grounds are lush with flowers and the greenest grass I have ever seen. Camelback mountain rising behind the hotel is a desert botanical garden. There are pathways to walk among waterfalls and ponds, there are open air restaurants with fire pits for cozy evenings, there are lovely boutique shops, and a fitness center with great yoga classes. And of course, for golfers, there is a beautiful course.
Our room was spacious, with a balcony view of Camelback Mountain. Our bed was remarkably comfortable, and there were both down and synthetic pillows to choose from.
The service was excellent, and the staff friendly. 
It is really a marvelous desert oasis and I will look forward to spending time there again.

reviews.author: Loveit2013
reviews.title: Very surprised at the lacking customer care.
reviews.text:
I was at the hotel for a business conference, and was immediately impressed by the size of the resort.

When I got to my room the A/C did not work, the thermostat read balcony.

I called the front desk, they asked if I had opened the balcony door. No, I had not...ever.

Approx. 30 minutes later a tech arrived, asked if I opened the balcony door, no I have not. 

Pushed a button declared it fixed and left. 

Another 20 or 30 minutes later, it is not fixed, the A/C is off again and it gets warm quickly. Called front desk again, another 20 minutes or so another tech arrives, says he fixed the computer, now it works. Okay, great. All this time I am trying to relax from a long day of travel and shower, but I could not. 

Okay, A/C is fixed now. I come back from dinner and a male employee is in the room, he is doing the turm down service. He leaves two of everything, one is a 100.00 gift card from the company i was working with, and there is another one on the 2nd bed for another guest. 

I call front desk and ask if I have a roommate, no you do not. The next day I discovered they mixed up the names, my first name is Lisa, card should have been in another room with the same last name different first name...sigh okay, I need to shower and relax.

2nd night, I go to dinner, come back at approx 8:15pm, I find the A/C does not work again, call front desk, a tech will be right up...not so much, had to call again, where is the tech it is been 30 minutes, I'm tired and need to get to sleep. Finally he arrives, Did you open the door? NO!! Now, this tech goes up in the attic, in the meantime my co-worker call and ask if I received my gift certificate, no, I do not see one. Call the front desk, when I ask about it, the response is.."Maybe you were not supposed to get one", Yes, I was, "Well, why would we know about it"? Because you guys delivered them. Now I am put on a 10 minute hold, Mamm, the bell hop says it left it, check the mini bar. The mini bar? Why would I have a gift very in there? Sigh, I cannot locate it, and I am too tired an stressed out now, bye.

So, now I am getting ready for bed, I lift up a towel and there is the very, under a towel with my curling iron on top, so I call the front desk and let them know I found it.

This hotel needs to invest in training, customer service is not difficult, but does require thought.

reviews.author: Pijeta10
reviews.title: Very beautiful place
reviews.text: This hotel is top-notch. Everything is very well-kept and everyone we encountered seemed genuinely sincere and kind. The place is HUGE place, you will be walking. I would estimate it took a good 7 minutes to get from my room to the pool. That said, the pools are spacious and very inviting. Pool staff went out of the way to make sure guests were happy and comfortable. Everything is expensive (even a simple snack will cost a lot), so plan accordingly. Just my husband and I went, but I would not hesitate to bring the kids next time.

reviews.author: NewEnglandTraveler54
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, excellent staff
reviews.text: I travel a lot for work, and this hotel probably had the best service of any hotel I have stayed in, anywhere. Housekeeping was amazing, and how often does anyone ever notice the amazing-ness of housekeeping? The place is spotless and the food was excellent. It's very close to the airport, and they have town cars waiting that will take you there ($39). I would not hesitate to go back.

reviews.author: ricardoj894
reviews.title: Desert Getaway
reviews.text: Scottsdale is a posh but lovely city. So much to see in the old town district as well as the other parts of the city and resorts there. I stay at the Phoenician for a leadership conference for my company. 5 star retreat from the rooms, the amenities, the activities and the views.... I was astonished by how beautiful everything was in the valley. I also play a round of golf and got a first class Swedish massage. The highlight of my trip was climbing up Camelback Mountain where I felt a spiritual reawakening!! If you ever seen this mountain, it is shaped like a camel lying down. VERY grueling but adventurous with a true meaning of what we endure in our lifetimes. I will return there in the near future most definitely!!!

reviews.author: Debra F
reviews.title: A Lovely Hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from a business conference at The Phoenician.  The hotel is absolutely lovely-the rooms are spacious, quite comfortable, and spotless, as is the entire hotel.  The shining star of this hotel, however, is its impeccable and attentive staff, all of whom, from housekeeping on (by the way, we left a tip for our housekeeper on the desk, but she never took it, perhaps thinking that it was not meant for her-we should have been clearer in the note, but we appreciate her honesty), provided us with fabulous care and service-never intrusive but always, without exception, warm and available.  In particular, the concierge, Jaime, assisted us in navigating a challenging change in flight because of anticipated snow and travel delays in Charlotte; she did this with unfailing good humor, confidence, and care.  When I mentioned that I was sorry that the hotel did not sell magazines (it does not, please fix this!) to read on the flight (we took the red eye out and all airport stores would be closed), she found magazines for me on her own initiative.  Everyone at the conference was talking about the excellent facility and staff.  While the food in the various restaurants was excellent, the food at the conference, prepared for a large crowd, was uniformly lacking and warrants improvement.  This hotel is indeed lovely and my husband and I look forward to returning for vacation and fun.

reviews.author: MandRSanchez
reviews.title: 4th of July!
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 4th of July 2015!

And it was the best experience I have ever experienced with my 5 children and Fiancé.
From the moment the valet took our car and loaded our bags to the room with a pool view and spa tub and elegant walk in shower! 
The play pad and slide were so much fun for the kids. They have Ramada's set up around so parents can sit and watch their little ones play. 
Our teenagers had a blast in all the pools! At night they gave out glow sticks and served food and drinks for additional price and from our room window we watched the firework show on grounds! 
The Phoenix also was presented at night and they have a kids experience. You can also feed the coy fish early in the morning and enjoy afternoon tea with a reservation.
This is a classy and very well presented Resort! 
We also enjoyed the Resturant on grounds called Relish Burger Bistro we had the Kobe burgers and they were so good and well prepared and the golf view from the Resturant was beautiful! Defiantly a great experience and well worth cost. And definitely will Return!
Happy Travels!!

reviews.author: CassieLA
reviews.title: Lovely but overpriced.
reviews.text: I stayed here 4 nights for a conference.  The staff is exceptional.  However, $400 a night for a 2 bed hotel room in the middle of the desert is ridiculous.  The soaking tub in the bathroom was fabulous - at least a foot taller than a normal tub.  A very nice touch at the end was a town car that met me at my casita, bypassing the lobby.

reviews.author: Patricia J
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel!
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for a conference and it was the best experience!  We have stayed at other hotels in Scottsdale and Phoenix which are quite good, but this one is heads above all the rest.  Even the lowest priced rooms are very spacious with large balconies.  The amenities that you are given in the bathroom and room each day are unique!  The attention to detail in this hotel is amazing. The staff is helpful, friendly and always courteous.  It was a pleasure to stay here , we look forward to returning.

reviews.author: shelbyp9256
reviews.title: Family friendly even for the "non fancy"!!
reviews.text: Our family of six just returned from a five day stay. We stayed on Starwood points otherwise we would have not been able to stay in such a luxury resort.  From the moment you enter the grounds (so beautiful) until the time you crash on your bed...the staff and ambience at The Phoenician are wonderful. The rooms were newly remodeled & very clean and spacious. Our whole family of six stayed in the two bedroom queen with a pull out couch. We all had enough room to spread out and relax. The room cleaning service were on top of their game and even came back at night to bring waters, chocolate, extra towels, and freshen up the room again...which is a huge plus for us with kiddos. The workers at the pool were AMAZING! The waiters, towel staff, and managers around the pool were awesome. We really enoyed Tareka...who immediately called our kiddos by name and made sure we had all we needed during our stay. The manager even tracked down sunscreen for our kiddos when we ran out, along with pool noodles and fresh dry towels. Due to our "big family" eating on site can get expensive, but the pool side food and terrazzo restaurant were affordable. The elevators were so speedy you never had to wait a SECOND! Which is a plus for our crew! The golf courses were exceptional the boys said..the staff treated our 17 year old and 12 year old, just like they would treat any guest. Which made them feel welcome at the course! Overall, I would totally come back to the hotel...when I can get my points back :) Give this resort a shot if your debating. It's way worth it! Enjoy the Sun!

reviews.author: kitha
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: We are here with 2 other couples. The guys golf and go to spring training all day while we lounge by the pool. This Resort is amazing ! The staff have been so friendly and go out of their way to be accommodating.. especially Heather at the pool. We asked for different variations of the wraps and they were so nice and went the extra mile. The Resort is beautiful and has a great atmosphere. There are several beautiful areas to gather outside by fire pits to have drinks and watch the sunsets. Our guys said the golfing was one of their favorite courses. We ate dinner at the J&G steakhouse.. wow! ... it was very good and I'm not a big fan of steak. IL Terrazzo is very good also. A room tip.. we are on the 6th floor in room 6091, it's at the very end ..therefore huge room with a very HUGE patio! I could stay here easy and not leave Resort.. the only reason would be to shop, which is very close.

reviews.author: faurecia
reviews.title: Extremely Relaxing
reviews.text: My friend and I only stayed here for one night.  After landing late in Phoenix all I could have wanted was a relaxing place to stay after a long day of traveling and that is exactly what I got.
