We stayed in a Casita that had the deepest tub I have ever seen.  Our room was so quiet and peaceful that we even kept the balcony door open so we could fall asleep to the sound of the waterfall outside.  We had the most pleasant and restful night of sleep.  While we didn't get to really enjoy the facilities we did walk around a bit and it seemed like there were so many different nooks to relax in.

reviews.author: Y5090GVFLC
reviews.title: Great resort, truly world class afternoon tea.
reviews.text: This resort is very well known for many positive attributes, golf, service, amenities, etc., and based on their reputation we stayed there for two nights to celebrate Valentine's weekend. The resort met our expectations in every way and at every level.  However their Valentine's weekend afternoon tea was truly world class, or better yet world leading.  We had the good fortune of being served by Alicia, who made excellent recommendations, paced the servings to perfection, and paired our food selection superbly with champagne and a variety of teas. Her level of service really put this experience over the top.  I highly recommend this afternoon tea experience at The Phoenician, and I highly recommend you request Alicia when making a reservation.

reviews.author: ChicagoJillo
reviews.title: Work trip with a view!
reviews.text: Our company recently visited the Phoenician for our Company-wide meeting. As part of the events team, I spent most of my time in the conference center. As a whole, we really like the events staff and found them to be very helpful and efficient. Even though the hotel itself has gone thru a renovation, the conference center is still dated. It was very convenient, however, as it was located in the main building where the main lobby is as well as most of the rooms. My guest room was spacious, clean and updated. My particular view was not great as it was overlooking a rooftop, but I could see some mountains in the distance, so wasn't all bad! There was also a nice sized balcony off the room. I ate in a handful of the restaurants on-site as well as ate from the room service menu and our meeting buffets. All of the food was excellent. The little cafe also serves the best tasting coffee. The property was very nice and our group enjoyed the heated pools, the fitness center (somewhat small) and the spa (very overpriced). We also had an outdoor event at the bottom of the road from the resort and it was lovely as well. The sunrise and sunset views from the main lobby restaurant and outdoor patio cannot be topped.

reviews.author: Sunshine
reviews.title: Very good but NOT worth the cost
reviews.text: This is a very lovely hotel, and our group had a wonderful time... but the rooms should be about half the price. We stayed in the main hotel. The rooms/halls/elevators/restaurants/grounds are fine, but absolutely nothing special whatsoever. The pool area is somewhat outdated, as well as the spa. It's all just fine, but for the high prices of everything from the rooms to the spa treatments to the coffee and pastries, you'd think you'd be WOWed with it all. We weren't.

reviews.author: Thomas O
reviews.title: Bait and switch!
reviews.text:
I booked the Phoenician a few weeks back and was obviously competing with the opening of Spring  training for MLB. I wanted a ground floor room so I could have the ability to walk outside and feel the sun each morning. I called back specifically aft originally booking to request this or a casita that I saw on their website. I was assured it would not be a problem getting a ground floor room. 

Upon arrival I was given a 6th floor room with a lovely view of cement, the building behind me and behind that Camelback Mountain. When I expressed my displeasure with the manager Megan, I was told I was in an "entry level room" at least twice. Even though I was paying $525US per night. I was then moved reluctantly by her to a room not very much better and again up against the mountain. 

I did find alternative arrangements at the Montelucia Hotel just down the road, a hotel far more boutique in size and greatly more accommodating, and when I informed the Phoenician I was going to move I did eventually move again to guess what..... a ground floor room! Yippee. What a run around. 

On top of spending $525 x 6 nights I also spent an additional $2000 on spa and restaurant charges. But quite frankly I was not impressed with the way I was treated by the manager and the run around on my room. I would never stay there again. 

Having said all that the staff were very friendly. In particular the Bell Staff were super friendly and accommodating. Lesson learned. 

So much for the Luxury Collection!

reviews.author: freddiecat7
reviews.title: Beautiful place & the staff is amazing!
reviews.text: There are several pools you can sit by if you want quiet or sun or shade or kids. The food poolside is good & great old fashions! We wanted in the main lodge. Make sure you get a higher floor so you have a view. We loved our room. End room huge with really large balcony #4140. I will say it's a walk from the elevators but we love it. Also all the restaurants are fab!

reviews.author: Rdresbac
reviews.title: Ganz Nett
reviews.text: Ich war anlässlich einer Tagung im Phoenecian. Es ist eine sehr grosse Anlage, die vorrangig von Amerikanern genutzt wird. Vieles ist typisch amerikanisch und man zahlt für alles extra. Extra zum Urlauben würde ich jedoch sicher nicht herkommen.

reviews.author: Tanya Q
reviews.title: Winter Getaway
reviews.text: The Phoenician was beyond fabulous!  Views for days from every where on property.  Service service service!  Spa was great and relaxing.   We had couples massage, spent time in steam room and whirlpool.  The weather was sunny and warm enough to lounge by pools rest of the day.  I think we are at every restaurant there, very good!  J&G our last night sunset was beautiful & food was surperb!  Could stay a week here!  Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: jkaHD
reviews.title: A Step Down from Real Luxury
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here years ago and it was the ultimate in a pampering experience.  So, now a family of 5, on a road trip from Los Angeles to Santa Fe, we tried one luxury resort on the way in and went to the Phoenician on the way back -- remembering our trip as a couple.  But honestly, the hotel is a disappointment.  The service was ok, but in no way memorable.  For example, we arrived late and were starving.  Reception told us Il Terrazzo downstairs was open -- but would be closing in 15 minutes.  We raced down -- it was closed.   Came back up to the lobby restaurant.  No one seated us.  No one looked up.  We found a table on our own, sat down.  Waited.  And waited some more until my husband got up and brought someone over.  They brought the kids' food last.  The waitress was ok.  OK is the word for this hotel in general.  Though the rooms are spacious and the bathrooms super-nice -- it's very last decade -- or really more the 90's.  This was even more evident to us as we'd stayed elsewhere in Scottsdale only 10 days earlier.  Perhaps this property is sort of on auto-drive.  It's not a bad hotel, but it needs a bit of a lift, both physically and with respect to service.

reviews.author: Jamie T
reviews.title: Amazing place all around
reviews.text: I will always try and stay at The Phoenician. Beautiful, large rooms and amazingly nice staff. So accommodating. The three pools are perfect, each one a little different and the grounds are massive. Huge workout studio, chilled towels and water provided. I can't say enough good things.

reviews.author: TravelAustralia2011
reviews.title: Fabulous Afternoon Tea!
reviews.text: Enjoyed another great Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician last week.  As usual, Wanda provided the absolute best service and always remembers our group.  The food was wonderful (both regular and gluten free).  Make a reservation in advance and enjoy being pampered.  All three courses (finger sandwiches, scones and desserts) will leave your satisfied and happy.

reviews.author: Ms. Kay
reviews.title: Stunning property with amazing service!
reviews.text: I arrived very late with no luggage. The front desk opened one of the shops so I could buy a gown and toiletries. They cleaned my clothes overnight so I was ready for my meeting the net day. I cannot tell you how wonderful they were my entire stay. The room was great, but the service went above and beyond!!

reviews.author: Lesa W
reviews.title: Relax
reviews.text: This place is beautiful, exceptional service! I cant say enough about the Spa very relaxing! you don't have to leave the property, its all there restaurants shopping  pool! Beds are Great! Defiantly will visit again.

reviews.author: Becswa
reviews.title: First visit, and I was pleased
reviews.text:
I'm currently visiting the property and I'm really enjoying it. Very clean!  Love the room, it's spacious and classy.  While not a room with a view, it's still wonderful!  Staff is friendly and great service we engaged but they aren't in your face so that is nice.  Poolside service is nice as well. I often find poolside service at resorts lacking, so this was a nice surprise. Only negative, food prices are a bit high. I get that it's a high end resort, but what you get for the price isn't extra special to support the price. 

I've enjoyed the stay and look forward to coming back with family!

reviews.author: MarcyBliss
reviews.title: Wonderful destination for business or pleasure
reviews.text: This is my second visit to The Phoenician, and both times I extended a business trip into a vacation trip, too.  Our deluxe room patio overlooked the garden and Camelback mountain.  Beautiful!  The room was spacious and well kept, the restaurants were very good, and the location was central to many good restaurants and hiking.  Massage in the spa was in the top 10% I've had.  Totally enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: J D
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: I have stayed here a few times and I will admit the service lacked a bit the last trip, but it is still a fantastic hotel.  The rooms are spacious and clean.  The grounds are breathtaking and the spa is divine.  It is expensive, but if you want a treat in the desert, stay here.

reviews.author: traxnyc
reviews.title: A few bumps
reviews.text:
Overall this is a very lovely, friendly and. Beautifully maintained  resort. Our room in the main building was renovated and quite spacious. No complaints with anything there although one day after returning from an all day tour, we found our room had not been attended to. Notwithstanding the room was well appointed, had a massive tv that we didn't even turn on, and a huge bathroom with soaking tub. Views to city and mountains beyond.

We ate at the onsite burger bistro,steakhouse, and had afternoon tea. Besides having to wait to be seated for Breakfast, service was good especially at tea and steakhouse, and food well prepared and presented. The spa was also excellent, with a very much appreciated selection of magazines in the relaxation room, a hot tub in locker area,Fully equipped gym and quality services. Just one thing - very limited fitness class schedule. While this may not be A negative during warm weAther, This was an issue during my visit as it was cold and wet- why couldn't the hotel plan for the weather by adding more classes so guests would have  more to do? And add some variety, eg pilates, barre , zumba?

Shout out to the concierge staff who were very helpful with tour suggestions and dining. One last thing - the Phoenician is a beautiful and sprawling property with several pools, a lovely cactus garden,trapeze and a great location - minutes to the waterfront and old town, not to mention hiking trail at camelback.

reviews.author: Jack H
reviews.title: Overall, A Disappointment
reviews.text: I realize that my review here won’t have much, if any, impact on a property that’s as highly acclaimed as The Phoenician. Obviously most people are impressed when they stay here. But for me, I just didn’t see the value. For a room that costs twice what it should, the ambiance, service, amenities, and/or address just didn’t make up the difference or fill the gap. Granted, I stayed in “The Phoenician” and not “The Canyon Suites at The Phoenician” (they are all part of the same property). Perhaps the Canyon Suites are much, much nicer… And if so, I will try staying at The Canyon Suites sometime in the future. Service was OK, but not memorable. Feels to me like this property is resting on its laurels and has lost the passion to excel. That’s expected for regular hotels, but not for a property positioning itself as “...a Luxury Collection Resort”. I didn’t have a single encounter with a staff member that left me feeling like they believe that.

reviews.author: Shachi
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds but .........
reviews.text: We had booked 3 nights at this pricey resort at a discounted rate which was negotiated by the bride and the groom whose wedding we were attending.  My husband did not open his confirmation email and 2 days before we were to go for the trip we realized that the reservation was for 2 nights instead of 3 and the hotel staff did accomadate us though the central reservations told us that they were completely sold out. When we went there we got 2 full size beds instead of a king size bed in our room. For a 5 star resort, the mattresses were not very comfortable and the bidet in our bathroom leaked.  Room size was great but the

reviews.author: Robinkh
reviews.title: Worth a stay
reviews.text:
Beautiful grounds, the building backs right up to Camelback Mountain. There are trails to walk through and enjoy the local cactus gardens. There are tennis courts, pools, a pool slide, golf course, and more.
The only thing to be aware of is the surface around the pool.  It gets very slippery when wet. My husband took a very bad fall on the stairs by the pool, and he was not alone. Other people took spills as well. On women who fell was actually crying.

reviews.author: kimpossible
reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Really beautiful place with stunning rooms & plentiful views. Rooms are spacious, comfortable and inviting. Staff is attentive. Tried a few of the restaurants onsite and were not impressed by the food and was overpriced quite a bit.

reviews.author: gmcnab
reviews.title: Well run luxury resort
reviews.text: You get what you pay for here. I was here on business and everything was fantastic. The TV in the room was huge, ultra modern (it even had a Chromecast on it and could be controlled from my phone). The wife was flawless. The grounds were immaculate. The staff ultra friendly and polite. I can't think of anything to improve on here.

reviews.author: KatieGJD
reviews.title: Wonderfully relaxing experience with top-notch service
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Phoenician again. We were there two nights and I wish we could have stayed longer, as it was an amazing experience and there was still so much to do (the cactus garden, the trapeze, the tennis courts, the playground, etc.). Because we were there such a short time, most of our experience centered around the pool. The service was outstanding. Bryan gave us his 100% attention and kept our towels fresh and our bodies shaded by the umbrellas. Daryn was our super friendly waiter and constantly checked in our us. We felt so pampered and were able to relax (even with twin five year old boys). I also heard from my family that Chloe and Amanda were great, too.  Other service provided at restaurants, in the lobby, etc were all great. Everyone was super friendly and accommodating. There are a lot of beautiful properties and this is one of them, but few properties have both the beauty, service and friendliness of the Phoenician. Keep up the great work! I can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Jagsas
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds and spacious rooms
reviews.text: The good:  Love the grounds and the spacious rooms.  Very relaxing place to be.  The bad:  I am not impressed with the newly decorated rooms.  They are too dark for me.  The coffee is now located halfway to the floor.  Very inconvenient location for coffee placement.  Unfortunately, no matter how many times I have stayed here, I cannot seem to get a room with a view.  Lastly, the prices at the cafe seem to have doubled.  A yogurt with fruit is $9.00.  Quite outrageous.

reviews.author: Elayne S
reviews.title: newly redecorated rooms
reviews.text: We have been coming here many years and were pleasantly surprised to find the boring beige rooms gone.  Deep taupe, taupe, cerulean blue are the new welcome colors. Rooms are generous in size; bathrooms have double sinks; balcony is good size.  Beds nice and firm.

reviews.author: rebeccapregelj
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 4 days in May for an incentive trip. Well, I lucked out on that one! While he was in conference all day I was living the life by the pool! 

Our room was small but modern and comfortable. The resort itself is a jewel in the beautiful Arizona desert. The food was phenomenal and we really felt like royalty when everywhere on the resort. 

I enjoyed the hotel's art collection throughout the property which definitely provided a sense of place. 

Although I did not participate in conference, I am a professional project and event  manager, so I did have to peak into their facilities. Amazing! I would totally recommend this property to meeting professionals. However I do not know how all the participants managed to stay away in their black leather recliners during the presentations!

reviews.author: Mikeshy
reviews.title: Beautiful setting
reviews.text: We stopped at the Phoenician to have a drink and show my sister the grounds. We sat at the outside deck and had a drink during happy hour. The service was excellent and the prices were reasonable. The setting is spectacular. The valet parking was quick and efficient. This is a nice location to enjoy a drink in a spectacular setting.

reviews.author: AB3566
reviews.title: Gorgeous Upscale Resort
reviews.text: We hosted a business trip at The Phoenician and they did not disappoint.  The hotel is beautiful, the staff were all very helpful and made our retreat a huge success.  We personally stayed in one of the larger renovated rooms and it was gorgeous.  The views of the mountains are so awesome.  You are close to Scottsdale and tons of restaurants, although the food on property is very good.  The pools are wondeful and the service is second to none. It would be fun for kids since there is a water slide and splash pad.

reviews.author: 82Woodstock
reviews.title: Not really a 5 star
reviews.text: A bit outdated. Looks like a 1980's getaway resort on the outside. Lots of space to walk around the beautiful grounds. Rooms are large but could use an remodel and step into the 21st century. Staff not as welcoming.

reviews.author: NorcalTraveler_9
reviews.title: Great resort when staying in Scottsdale
reviews.text: My husband and I stay at the Phoenician quite often when visiting family.  Can't say enough good things about the resort.  Even when the resort is full, you don't feel crowded and it is not the "scene" that the AZ Biltmore tends to be. Rooms have all been recently renovated.  Grounds are beautiful. My only complaint was in the past, years ago was when their wi-fi wasn't free, not a problem anymore.  Staff is friendly.  Relish restaurant has great burgers, salads, and sandwiches.  Very nice pool.  Plenty of area to walk/jog on the resort property or surrounding area.  Nice gym.  Enough said.

reviews.author: Maureen A
reviews.title: Get ready for pampering
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort Feb 1-3 for a business meeting for my husband. The room, pools and grounds were beautiful but the intangibles are what set it apart. The staff were all incredibly attentive without being intrusive. Trust me, that's a hard skill to learn. From the waitstaff to the housekeeping staff to the pool attendants - all just really nice people! I wish you could bottle that and sell it to some other high end resorts!

reviews.author: Elena M
reviews.title: The most Amazing Outdoor at the Hotel
reviews.text: It's an incredible place! The Phoenician has Views! Mountain view, Golf Course, the outdoor design is breathtaking! Fire, water & mountains. I'd call it the best location from available hotels in Phoenix/Scottsdale area to re-energize.

reviews.author: Ananda
reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text: First impressions are everything.  The driver made a comment about this being the nicest hotel in AZ!  Then as we approach, you see  the golf course and other amazing greenery.  Get to the front desk and Brittany was so superb!  We were there early, like 10AM, and they actually had us checking in the next day, but she handled it like a pro and got us taken care of. Checked in early and got a great room.  Pool area was dead, maybe because it was so huge and the time of year?  Looked fine to me, but I heard they are remodeling May/June of 2017??  High class, like the Ritz, everyone I had contact with wanted to do everything they could for me to enjoy my stay.  Will come again!

reviews.author: Suzanne D
reviews.title: Good service, great conciere
reviews.text:
We stayed here on a list minute weekend getaway.  We had a large room with a walk out patio to the ground level.  The rooms had just been remodeled and it showed.  Bathrooms were spacious with a giant sunken tub and separate shower.  The property is huge and beautiful with lots of local plant life to admire.  There is a koi pond as well.  My kids loved the pool....a big water slide, a splash pad and several hot tubs.  Everyone was happy.  Pool side service was quick enough.  Room service was also good. We ate at the main restaurant for breakfast - good food.  J& G steakhouse was just okay.  Should have been better for a Jean-Georges restaurant.  
I interacted with two concierge while there - Shannon and Jaime - both were amazing!  

I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.author: Andrew H
reviews.title: Truly belongs in the Luxury Collection
reviews.text: I get the opportunity to stay here through business now and again and am reminded what a truly luxury hotel experience can be.  The grounds are beautiful, from the expansive view off your balcony, to various outside area, to even the motor lobby looking up to the little mountain the hotel backs up to.  The staff is friendly, helpful and always has a smile.  The room as clean, crisp and comfortable.  Truly a unique hotel experience.  If you get the chance, definitely check it out.

reviews.author: AllisonCW
reviews.title: First class destination!
reviews.text: What a treat it was to stay at the Phoenician for a sales incentive trip with my business colleagues. It is an absolutely gorgeous setting with Camelback Mountain right behind you. There's a beautiful golf course, a great spa, several pools, and spectacular Landscaping. They even offer trapeze lessons! There are several bars and restaurants… Steakhouse, burger spot, pool area restaurant... and they were all great. The overall service was outstanding… Edvin with room service and Micheal Mosley with the banquet really offered the quintessential great service. Micheal saw me wandering around the halls looking for a water fountain and offered to get me a glass of ice water while he was busy working.  They have people with golf cart willing to drive you from one side of the property to another if you want them to. Everybody was so polite and wonderful. The housekeeping service couldn't of been any more accommodating. I was very impressed and would recommend this place to anyone and everyone wanting a beautiful desert get away.

reviews.author: Steve B
reviews.title: Beautifully relaxing
reviews.text: We started our 3 week holiday of a lifetime by flying to Pheonix and stayed in this lovely town to shake off the inactivity of the long flight. It was a lovely place sitting having breakfast in the sun was just perfect. After exploring the town we would return in the evening and put our feet up with a drink by the fire pit an absolutely perfect way to recharge our batteries before driving to grand canyon. So tempting to stay longer.

reviews.author: Emily G
reviews.title: A perfect babymoon
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician for three nights recently. The hotel and grounds were beautiful, so warm and inviting. All of the staff was so welcoming and helpful. We loved having high tea, everything served was perfection, and our tea server Alicia was fabulous. She went above and beyond and arranged for a special treat of sparkling cider, candies, a stuffed bunny, and very touching card to be delivered to our room later that night. It was so kind and unexpected and very memorable. She made us feel so special. 
We also had a great day at the pool and our waitress, Heather, really made the day a blast! She helped us pick the perfect spot, was very attentive and entertaining to talk to, and made the day so relaxing and wonderful! 
Top notch service to go along with a wonderful property. They're doing renovations this coming summer, and we can't wait to go back and check it out... next time with our little babe in tow. Thank you, Phoenician, for a wonderful getaway!

reviews.author: Aron S
reviews.title: Amazing for family vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at this resort. From the service to the activities for kids and scenic views, it was absolutely one of the best places I have ever stayed. Definitely lives up to its luxury collection standards.

reviews.author: Jeremy515
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: We stayed here with friends and family and the staff and services were great. Highly recommend this to anyone. Plenty of amenities for everyone to enjoy. The spa is great, tennis was awesome and rooms are really nice.

reviews.author: JW_Cal
reviews.title: Great Location/Grounds
reviews.text:
It had been over five years since we last stayed at the Phoenician resort. Many renovations have occurred since then. The upgrades are significant and the rooms are quite nice.  

The two complaints I have are the hidden fees (parking and resort fees) and the wide grout tile in the hallways.  The fees are always disappointing because they should simply include those in the rate since you're not optional. The problem I have with the wide grouted tile is that when people check-in late at night, or leave early in the morning, their baggage goes "click-clack" all the way down the hall and is easily be heard through the doors.  I was waken at both 3:30am and 4:30 am the first night of my stay.

Other than that, the grounds are spectacular, the rooms newly remodeled and clean, and the restaurants top notch.  A solid 4/5.

reviews.author: Pete D
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: My casita with fire pit was newly refurbished, a great size and had a beautiful view over the lawn, pool, hotel and Camelback mountain. Restaurants, golf, gym all very good and the staff were kind and helpful. I had a great time here.

reviews.author: TheButterflyEffect75
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: It is a gigantic hotel complex, with a number of swimming pools, restaurants and own golf course. I liked it very much – spacious room, comfortable bed, superb amenities, attentive staff, fantastic views. The only cons are limited number of reception desk staff (bearing in mind the size of the hotel and number of guests it is no surprise I had to wait some time before they checked me out) and the fact that some parts of the complex require renovation.

reviews.author: Alejandro G
reviews.title: Maravillosa luz al atardecer
reviews.text: The Phoenician, Scottsdale se encuentra en un lugar maravilloso, enmarcado por Cholla Trailhead, Camelback Mountain, los atardeceres son mágicos, el hotel esta muy bien conservado, excelente servicio, muy tranquilo, ideal para unas vacaciones

reviews.author: SUNandSANDLOVER77
reviews.title: Lives up to its "Luxury Collection" Name!
reviews.text:
Whoa! Let me start by saying that I have stayed in some really nice, fancy pants hotels. So when I say this place blew me away, I am comparing it to some of the top resorts in the world. This place was awesome, let me break it down:

Resort Activities:

You name it they've got it. 
A "Funician" club for kids (note: somewhat pricey at $95/day and only for kids 5 or 6 and up). 
A trapeze class with a complete trapeze set up (yes you read that right, TRAPEZE!)
Tennis courts
Complimentary bikes/helmets/locks
A children's play structure/park (covered so your tots don't get burned)
Pools, Pools and more Pools
A water slide
A kids splash pad/play area
Hot tub
Golf
Hiking trails/popular mountain hike right behind the hotel
Yoga and other fitness classes
Fitness center
SPA - Ahhhhh!
Shops inside the hotel
luxury car rentals (or you can get a Rav4)
Bocce ball
Nature trails around the hotel that are beautifully landscaped
Several restaurants
Coffee shop
the list goes on, and on, and ON!
I was here for several days while my husband was on business and I found it to be so great that I didn't even have to leave the hotel to keep myself busy!

The rooms:

We had a room with a mountain view or should I say mountain touch, it felt like we could reach out and touch the mountain from our balcony it was so cool. The room was VERY spacious and well appointed. I have stayed at some nice places and I always like it when there are little things that they provide, this place provided something I have never seen before - lip balm - among all of the other things one needs. Nice touch! I spent a lot of time in the room since I wanted to relax while my husband worked, so I can honestly say that I got to know the room pretty well and I really enjoyed it. Very calm and relaxing space. The bathroom was huge, separate shower, tub, private toilet area, and double vanity, all in warm, neutral desert tones that felt very serene. I did indulge in room service and found it to only be so so as it was $40 for 2 coffees and some pastries that were pretty bland. I would suggest walking down to the coffee shop and getting lattes there which were great and their pastries much better!

The staff - I felt like the staff here were particularly excellent. We were staying with my husbands company who rented out about 80% of the hotel. Every staff I encountered was friendly, knowledgeable and seemed genuinely interested in making sure guests were comfortable. 

The Spa/Fitness center:

I also indulged in a massage. The spa itself is really nothing special, again, I frequent spas and found this one to be average. The SERVICE is a different story. I got a massage from Gene and he was AMAZING. My only regret about the spa was not doing a longer service. Definitely request Gene! 
I also took a yoga class and wasn't sure what to expect, I do a lot of Yoga in a pretty earthy crunchy yoga town so I was worried it might be superficial or watered down. Wow, I was wrong. Rhonda literally made me feel like I had known her for years and made me feel welcomed and comfortable in a class where most of the people seemed to know each other well and must attend regularly. Her style and her philosophy was intense and deep and really made you contemplate. She has a gift. I am usually not so impressed by services or classes at hotels, the Phoenician hires excellent, knowledgeable staff.

Location:
Excellent. I don't know the area too well but we were a 5 minute uber from old town Scottsdale which has great shops and restaurants. Also less than 2 miles from what looked like a really nice mall. 

I can definitely say I plan to go back at some point and would stay here again!

Also, worth noting, I took a walk up to the canyon suites just because I love checking out everything at a hotel, that area was super private and even more luxurious. They had a morning spread set out that looked incredible. It might be worth staying up there if you are looking for something more private, it had its own private pool also. 

Overall: Impressed!

reviews.author: deleonnp2
reviews.title: Soul touching
reviews.text:
This resort so touched my soul! I was there for business and was checked into a newly decorated room 6168..... the lights twinkling and the view was breathtaking! The staff kind and the room was large with a balcony. The grounds are impeccable and the pools are huge ! The gym was nice and my husband went daily to the sauna and steam room 
One of my favorite resorts ever and we have  been to many ❤

reviews.author: Passenger689113
reviews.title: Girls Vacation
reviews.text: We highly recommend the Phoenician. The resort is breathtaking and huge. There was so much to enjoy on grounds. We enjoyed walking around the trails and bike riding. The staff at the hotel went out of their way to make us feel pampered- top class service. We highly recommend to anyone that appreciates luxurious accommodations and service.

reviews.author: Whofan70
reviews.title: Outstanding Resort!
reviews.text: Stayed in a casita with an outstanding view of Camelback Mountain. The room featured  a very nice bathroom and was very roomy. The grounds were beautiful and enjoyable to walk around. The service was very good and attentive. The Spa was also an enjoyable experience and the staff was very attentive. Unfortunately did not have the time to play golf but the course looks absolutely amazing. I would highly recommend The Phoenician and hopefully we'll be back.

reviews.author: SSWAG Flyer
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort!
reviews.text: We decided to go to the Barrett-Jackson auction in January 2016, but only gave ourselves 3-4 weeks to research the right resort because of a last minute decision. Some were way too expensive and others were too far away. I struggled to find a resort to visit in Scottsdale because it appeared that there were so many really good places. A very hard decision! We settled on the Phoenician based on reviews and the beautiful scenery, which is one of the most important criteria that I was looking for. This was such a great resort and the staff was wonderful. The only hiccup was the valet manager's poor attitude when we were leaving.  I parked my car at the entrance only to track down a porter who I wanted to give a healthy tip to, but the valet staff decided to move my car somewhere else without my knowledge. I wasn't very happy, but we were leaving for the airport so I didn't complain to management.  We would like to return because we had such a relaxing time there.

reviews.author: albertdora
reviews.title: worst housekeeping service
reviews.text: Everything was good except housekeeping service. first I checked in my room found a lot hairs in the bathroom, patio was very dirty, next day i came back to my room found the door was open and the housekeeper inside washing drinking glasses in the bathroom which was disgusting for me. The Phoenician used to be better before and i used to go there every year. this year was the worst experience.

reviews.author: itsgeorges
reviews.title: Quick outing
reviews.text:
Always nice to visit, last time we visited was over 10 years ago. It has not Changed one bit, good service good amenities all around. Christmas / Holiday Deco was beautiful. They say they will be remodeling the whole reception area in 2017. 
Looks good as it is. I hope they don't mess it up.

reviews.author: honorico
reviews.title: Fake insincere and low quality service in beautiful surroundings
reviews.text:
The service is reluctant and fake.  They pretend they care but they don't. 

The food at the lobby / bar area with views is pretty terrible and overpriced. We ordered the octopus which was not fresh. The duck tacos were not that good. The tuna crudo had a weird taste. The salad was the best thing they had. 

I asked for a later check out since I am an SPG gold member in my gym attire, they refused also with an insincere smile. 

In the morning, you wake up with people cutting the grass and blowing the cut grass. This kind of noise can wait til the afternoon. 

Overall, I would avoid this hotel if you really want luxury. If you want fake luxury and insincere people serving you, the views are really beautiful.

The hotel and the style is very dated. Looks like stuck in 80s. They need a major overhaul. Also the balconies and the terrace are not designed for the view. There is a metal blocking the views.

reviews.author: mallory w
reviews.title: Amazing property and even better service!
reviews.text: This past weekend I planned a Bachelorette getaway for my cousin. Every single person I spoke with prior to arriving was extremely helpful and courteous. Taylor in group reservations was a huge help. She made sure all of our rooms were near each other and she really paid attention to detail to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Isiah at the front desk was a delight, from the moment we checked in he made sure all the rooms were checked in at a timely fashion along with sending the bride to be a sweet amenity to the room. Heather at the pool was an amazing server, she made sure our area was all set up and was so helpful all day. The new guest room renovation was great! I loved the theme and all the rooms were very nicely done. Thank you for a great stay and seamless bachelorette weekend. We will be back!

reviews.author: James F
reviews.title: Exceptional service
reviews.text: My husband & I were celebrating my 40th birthday at The Phoenician.  This was our first stay at the property.  We were blown away by many of the staff members but especially, John (Thirsty Camel Bartender).  He truly was the best and went out of his way to make us feel comfortable & well taken care of.  John helped make my birthday extraordinary!  Thank you John & the Phoenician for exceptional service!! We hope to be back with our daughters very soon!

reviews.author: ravindrag2
reviews.title: We stayed there during Christmas
reviews.text: The rooms were spacious and of very high quality.  They were clean and the cleaning service was very good. We had dinner and drinks at the bar and lunch at the golf club Bistro. Food was good and there was a live band playing at the bar at night and we were able to enjoy dancing. Very relaxing and will recommend to any couple wanting to have a relaxing weekend.

reviews.author: Robert-Jan1972
reviews.title: Top resort in the US
reviews.text: If you are looking for a majestic resort in Scottsdale, this is the place to be. Located just under the camelback mountain, this resort offers everything you need to unwind from reality. The size of the property is huge, so be prepared for some long walks, but it is difficult to describe in full. Several restaurants, shops and great pools make you really feeling like a star. The golf course is amazing with 27 holes. The rooms are spacious and have lovely beds. Ask for a camelback mountain view room. The resort is not cheap, but we would love to come back.

reviews.author: Kapil C
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text:
Just came here for the holiday weekend with my family and we all really enjoyed it
Rooms were really nice (recommend staying in the main tower, with the resort view), service was excellent throughout and restaurants were great (we really liked both brunch and dinner at IL Terrazzo) along with property and amenities (golf course, fitness center and pool) overall.  Was awesome to be right next to Camelback Mountain both to hike it and for scenery.
Will definitely come back and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Treacletart
reviews.title: A lovely resort
reviews.text: My family and I only spent one night here over Christmas, but we loved every minute. The pool was heated to the perfect temperature. Comfortable beds. Bathroom to die for. We had a fire pit casita, which was the only disappointment...the fire pit wouldn't light unless a maintenance guy came and started it. It had also rained the previous day and our patio chair cushions were soaked...no dry ones available (so we took piles of towels from the pool and reupholstered the chairs, lol). I complained about this at check out and the hotel did comp our breakfast (which by the way was the best breakfast buffet I've ever had). Don't miss a walk around the grounds...there are hummingbirds everywhere...and the cactus garden is worth seeing. Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Thom T
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.text: I definitely had a nice stay at this resort. It was quite short but worth the money. The resort has a handful of pools and even a waterslide which is great for kids. The service was great. Location was also nice with shops and restaurants close.

reviews.author: Anna B
reviews.title: Casita View Critique/Lovely Staff
reviews.text: We're currently staying at the Phoenician in a Casita with our 11 month old. The room size itself is great and leaves plenty of room for the crib, play area for our baby, changing area etc. The rooms were recently renovated and are overall wonderful! However, we might have the absolute worst view of any Casita. We're on the first floor which I thought would mean we would have access to the lawn (play area for our daughter and somewhere to lay out while she napped), but our room 7162 is directly on the road in front of the golf club. Lots of traffic and people walking in front of our enclosed balcony that gets zero sun no matter what time of day. Every other room seems to have a considerably better view. I thought as an SPG gold when I asked about a different room type, there would have been some sort of enhancement available but maybe the resort is just too packed this weekend to make a change. Everything else here has been great (especially Heather at the Oasis who was literally running from table to table trying to keep everyone happy when it was extra sunny out. She's a rockstar server). We're super impressed with the staff at every level. Our stay would save been a bit more enjoyable if we didn't hear about everyone's golf game as they left the club and could relax outside the room during our daughters naps, but oh well.

reviews.author: 2hotred
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with lots of onsite amenities
reviews.text: My room was located in the main building which was convenient as I was attending a conference.  My view of the mountain was beautiful and it was very quiet. The facilities at this resort are impressive with large banquet spaces, intimate bars, gourmet restaurants, and beautiful pool area.  They took excellent care of us during the convention.

reviews.author: Lawrence W
reviews.title: Casitas and Suites in dire need of upgrading
reviews.text: We spent Christmas Weekend here. I had reserved a Lower Level 1 Bedroom Casita only to find that none were available and were placed in a 2nd Floor Casita. Beware of what is called a "Resort View", if your view of the back Parking Garage is considered a Resort View. The Casita was dark and in bad need of upgrading for the price we paid. It lacked design in style and placement of furniture and lighting. Upon our request we were moved to The Phoenician Suite in the main building. Yet another major disappointment. Sure the grounds are beautiful and nicely decorated for the holidays. The valet and bell staff were excellent. But, upon walking into the suite there was a sense of utter starkness. It seemed that the suite either hadn't been used recently or poorly cleaned. Again the choice of furniture and lighting leaves a lot to be desired. A prior guest had left a Little Black Dress under the sofa, not that hard to see. The terrace was littered with paper and very dirty. The furniture looked to be nearly falling apart and very dirty. The view was wonderful but for the price we paid this did not meet the standard of what is considered a high quality resort. Also, check your bill. Ours had both Valet and Self Parking Fees, the auditor should have caught that error. So hopefully our experience was just a glitch.

reviews.author: Kella141414
reviews.title: Afternoon tea
reviews.text: This was an absolutely amazing experience.   We had royal tea.  It was 3 courses with a pot of tea each and champagne.  The tea sandwiches were incredible, the scones were great paired with lemon curd, and the desserts were decedent.  They even made every course dairy free to accommodate my dietary needs.  The wait staff was extremely kind and responsive.  There was even a person playing the piano.  Plus, the resort is beautiful!   I can't wait to do this again!

reviews.author: Saviotung
reviews.title: Medium hardware but poor software
reviews.text:
We stayed at the very expensive presidential suite but were treated below standard. The room furniture are dated and the kitchen was not properly set up. 
The housekeeping was poor.  They came at 9.30 pm to do room turndown! My kids were sleeping. 
They need to train their staff better. Disappointed at the 5 star hotel. 

The holiday setting was good but I felt that their staff were not approachable.

reviews.author: Malea N
reviews.title: Quick overnight visit
reviews.text: We checked in Friday night, every interaction from front drive, check in, housekeeping and cafe was outstanding. Room seemed recently renovated, clean and comfortable. Nothing was lacking. Kudos to the staff of the Phoenician. Thank you.

reviews.author: Shellseaker100
reviews.title: Thanksgiving - 3 generations
reviews.text: Ok, so here goes.  My 70-something mom and I have frequently visited the Canyon Ranch /  Miraval spa complex many times.  However, for this Thanksgiving, we decided to do a three generation reunion in Phoenix to try to please everyone while being able to visit my nephew's new graduate school layout.  I insisted on The Phoenician in Scottsdale as a good compromise and was wholeheartedly pleased.  Look, you can never please everyone all the time, but The Phoenician did everything they could to please, satisfy, entertain and host my various family members through our long holiday stay as best possible.  A couple of features:  my mom recently had hip replacement, and the hotel offered a complementary wheelchair for her use  the entire time we were there (NB, wheelchairs are first-come-first-served, which was no problem upon our arrival, however, I suggest the hotel do an actual reservation system, so we would have arranged for a rental had it been needed).  The Thanksgiving buffet was a very interesting affair with excellent breakfast / bunch / sushi options - something for everyone with no one going away hungry.  We wanted to go to the Grand Canyon, and my 80-something dad was thinking he needed to exert his patriarchal duties in renting a van / driving the trip, (which I kaboshed).  The concierge recommended David Joachim at My Arizona Guide for a full-day Grand Canyon Tour, which was a tremendous / superlative choice.  David met us at 7 AM with his large accommodating van, and we stopped in Sedona, saw a couple of prehistoric sites we never would have seen on our own, had lunch in the turn-of-the-20th century period El Tovar restaurant (breathtaking original period murals).  During the weekend, we had dinner in the formal steak restaurant, which was excellent, mom, me and sister-in-law did a spa afternoon while the guys went on a hike on Camelback Mountain, had cocktails and high tea, and in short, it was a wonderful weekend for an eclectic family with divergent interests, which I highly recommend.

reviews.author: empm1
reviews.title: Royal treatment!
reviews.text: Sure we like Scottsdale but the Phoenician is our real destination and the reason we go. It's the staffs' attention to detail that puts this property over the top as a 5 star hotel. They are all so courteous, friendly, and accommodating. It really says a lot about a hotel when you feel the warmth from that many staff.

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.title: Rooms need work
reviews.text:
I was extremely disappointed with this hotel when it came to my guest room. First off I emailed the hotel weeks before my arrival requesting a 2pm check in. I got a standard response saying they can't guarantee check in until 4pm but will do their best to accommodate me. As a Platinum Starwood member, a one or two hour early check in is almost always made available to me so I was hopeful they would find a way to make this work. 

When I checked in at 2pm the staff member said "good news we upgraded you to a Deluxe Executive Suite" I responded that, that was the room I had booked and it was not in fact an upgrade, he quickly conceded that I was correct and that I was not getting an upgrade. I found it a little insulting that I spent a lot of extra money for one of their largest suites and instead of acknowledging that, they instead tried to make it look like they were upgrading me. Regardless, I was told my room wasn't ready yet but the room was empty and they just needed a cleaning supervisor to clear the room for check in. 

Long story short over two hours later and a little after 4pm and after about my 4th trip to the front desk my room was ready. Not a great way to start the stay. However, the real problem with my stay was the god awful room. 

I attached pictures of the room and the picture and description They advertise on their website. My room was dark, tiny, with a small step out unfurnished balcony, a tiny love seat and chair and a bathroom in complete disrepair. This was also a no view room. Note the photos of the rusted bath tub with chipped paint. 

The AC did not work and even in mid December with cool days and nights I had the AC set as low as it would go and was constantly hot, I learned it only blew warm air and started sleeping with the balcony door open. 

I complained extensively and spoke to two different managers. The only solution they offered was moving me into a standard room and refunding the difference in the rate. I was unable to ever get an explanation on why a Platinum member was put in such a horrible room or how they justify calling  this room the same category as what they advertise on their website. 

Further complaints: they were doing construction all around the hotel including on my balcony. Nothing like waking up to construction workers standing on your hotel balcony at 6:30am. Jack hammering started each day at 6:45am and didn't end until it was dark. 

Lastly we went to go eat at the hotels Italian restaurant for dinner Monday night and were told it was closed. So we went to the hotels steak house. The steak house was empty and it was almost 7:30, but we were told it was an hour wait. I questioned why such a long wait for a restaurant that is totally empty and they told me they had cut staff to save money and didn't have enough staff to serve all the tables. Real first class place!

reviews.author: MidwestRoadTrips
reviews.title: All Around Lovely
reviews.text: I was here on business and stayed in one of the casitas. The facility is lovely in many ways. Beautiful grounds, magnificent backdrop of Camelback Mountain, nice little amenities such as lip balm to heal your lips from the very dry weather, water each night, turn-down service with chocolates. The room was ideal. I loved the deep tub in the bathroom (although I felt I needed a rescue ladder to exit it because it's so deep that they even place a stool next to it). There is also a bidet in the casita rooms, in case you're interested. The one challenge I had each day was finding the most efficient and direct route back to the main lobby. It takes a couple of days to find your way through the maze of the pools, which are also exquisite. I recommend taking the hike on Cholla Trail. The hotel will take you by golf cart to the street, which is about a 1/2 mile from the trail head. I went early on a Friday and avoided crowds. It wasn't difficult, but I wouldn't call it easy either. The path, although marked, does become unclear at points due to the rocks. Definitely make the time to take this hike, though. You won't be disappointed. And you won't be disappointed staying at this hotel either. Just lovely!

reviews.author: VinceY69
reviews.title: Solid but a bit stale
reviews.text:
This is still a lovely property, and it was decorated beautifully for Christmas. But it feels it's age even with the updated rooms. 

The highlight was dinner at J and G. The Yelp reviews had me nervous, but my steak was perfect and the sampler was inventive and tasty. But the pork belly was the real hit. 

The spa was a disappointment. The facilities are pretty basic and not much different than many local gyms. The oddest part was they ask you to sign your bill with an automatic 20% gratuity included before your services!. Very cheesy for a luxury resort. My massage was just ok, but I paid for 50 minutes and only got 40. Underwhelming for nearly $200. 

The pool is where you really feel the age. They have not updated it like so many other resorts. My kids would be disappointed had I brought them. 

They also charge a silly $29 daily resort fee. I wished they'd just include it in the rate, but it does mean that you can use all the resort without staying there for just the $29 fee.

reviews.author: AmiP
reviews.title: Camelback Mountain on the grounds
reviews.text: Beautiful property with the Camelback Mountain right on the grounds beyond the golf course (no trail access). My room had a balcony looking out on the mountain.. at sunset, the view is gorgeous. Lovely cactus garden. Nice breakfast, dinner quite expensive. Patio with fire pits is a great place to hang out in the evening.

reviews.author: SCB1954
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
Outstanding property. This place is perfect. The resort is beautiful and the rooms have everything you would want. It is near shopping, museums and dining.  Beautiful gardens and views of mountains. 
The staff does all they can to please you.

reviews.author: jammer
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: We stayed five nights at the Phoenician and it exceeded my expectations. It is truly a luxury resort. The staff are well trained, personable, and eager to help. The rooms have all been renovated with an upcoming lobby renovation this year. So many nice touches to mention..:Keurig coffee in the room, nightly turn down service with great chocolates, high thread count sheets, great toiletries, very comfortable mattress, great views. Be advised there is a resort fee as well as a charge for garage parking. No charge for surface parking which is close. Great restaurants and the Thirsty Camel bar is a lot of fun and has nightly music. Keep in mind this is a Starwood Luxury Collection and not a Holiday Inn.

reviews.author: posey266
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Spent a few nights at the Phoenician in early December and had a fantastic stay. The service is truly exceptional - from bellboys to waiters to the front desk - everyone was so genuinely kind and friendly. The room was spacious and well appointed and the grounds were immaculate. Had a fabulous dinner at the J&G Steakhouse and a wonderful spa treatment.

reviews.author: mysange
reviews.title: Nice hotel - for the price the services are lacking.
reviews.text:
The hotel is very expensive with inconsistent service levels. had 3 friends staying at the hotel in different rooms. The service was incredibly inconsistent from room to room and night to night. One night one would receive turn down service and another would not. Each rooms would receive different toiletry items...the more one of my friends complained the better service she received as my services started out great and deteriorated over the next few days. 
The concierge services also inconsistent - some great recommendations and services and another night we went to the restaurant where a reservation had been made and the restaurant was closed. We stopped tipping since service was so inconsistent.

reviews.author: Shan143
reviews.title: High tea never tasted so good!
reviews.text: Sandwiches, mimosas, desserts, tea, live piano playing and amazing views.  Add a few friends and have fun.  It's pricey but worth every dime!  Put on some snazzy clothes and let the staff serve you, they are literally at your beck and call!

reviews.author: Melbrita
reviews.title: Great view if you sit on patio
reviews.text:
A 5 star resort, great lobby, fantastic  rooms. Service very attentive and helpful. We had a steak at J and G, the service and ambiance was great.  
Steak was great, sides orders were great also. The only negative, expensive. Be prepare to pay well over a hundred a person. Remember this a resort that many of their guest are visiting the valley from out of state or out of country and are ok with the high prices.

reviews.author: mike c
reviews.title: Business/Peasure
reviews.text: Awesome place, the folks couldn't be more accommodating. I wanted tickets to the Arizona game, the concierge handled immediately. The restaurants were first class and the food lived up to expectation.

reviews.author: peterwilliams265
reviews.title: One  of my top ten best hotels in the world
reviews.text: Superb location, gorgeous rooms and a gold standard in customer care. Choice of restaurants as good as it gets and fell in love with the golf course too. All in all, one of the finest examples of a luxury hotel in teh world and definitely in my top ten list

reviews.author: Spa seeker
reviews.title: Birthday Weekend
reviews.text:
First let me start by saying that I came to this hotel with high expectations. This hotel is usually rated very high on this site and others and having been to Scottsdale before but stayed at the Hyatt Gainey Ranch I would say that if I came to this area again I would stay at the Hyatt Gainey or Fairmont. Here are the reasons this hotel did not meet expectations:
The cons
1) The interior lobby and common areas are out dated and old style not modern and Contemporary at all. This hotel seems to fit the 65 and up crowd taste best
2) I like coming to Arizona for the spa golf experience, the spa at this hotel lacks everything. The service did not wow me, the amenities are nothing to brag about and there are no common areas or coed areas to enjoy with your significant other
3) While having a drink at a bar I saw a huge cockroach crawling on the ground 
4) The food quality at the restaurants and room service was subpar for the price I paid for the room
6) Everything was over priced, food, drinks parking etc.
7) the pool area was so so.

There are a few pros
1) The golf course was very well kept with beautiful views
2) This resort is backing a mountain with a beautiful hiking trail
3) The bellmen were outstanding
4) Since it was my birthday, I received surprise gifts from the front desk lady and my spa provider which was sweet.
5) the bartender John was super nice !!
That's it in a nutshell. Bottom line- you can find a better hotel than this, don't get caught up in the name or past reputation. This place is going downhill

reviews.author: Bob D
reviews.title: Luxury in a beautiful setting
reviews.text:
The Phoenician has a bit of a sordid past, created by Charles Keating out of money he stole from depositors in the S&L scandals. Today, it's a Starwood "Luxury Collection" hotel.  Located at the base of Camelback Mountain, the hotel has great views of the mountain, a wonderful several acre cactus garden with paved walking trails (walk attentively though; posted sign warns of rattlesnakes, although that is true anywhere in the Arizona deserts). The staff are very polite and attentive, offering free bottled water while waiting for check-in or getting into a taxi, asking if you need help anytime you seem lost in the sprawling hotel and spacious grounds, turn-down service with slippers and chocolates.  Beautiful pool area with several pools and attentive staff to bring out towels for the  comfortable, cushioned lounge chairs--nice little touch, they bring a free pitcher of ice water to your chair; servers check regularly but not intrusively to see if you want food and drink and they return promptly with your order. Rooms are spacious, quiet and well-appointed. Nice cocktail bar with outdoor heated patio. I only had breakfast in one of the hotel's restaurants, service and food were good, and we were entertained by a staff person who had a trained falcon. 

The only minor complaint I have is that there was a line of about 10 people when I checked in and no separate line for Starwood Gold/Marriott Gold status (you can link your points to have reciprocal elite status, e.g my Marriott Gold status qualified me for linked SPG Gold status). Most hotels especially luxury ones have a dedicated and shorter check-in line for Elite status customers. The Phoenician should do the same. 

The hotel is only 10 minutes from downtown Scottsdale/Old Town via Uber, Lyft, taxi or hired town car, or your own wheels.

reviews.author: khanks70471
reviews.title: Great property getting better
reviews.text: We stayed here when it was brand new and fell in love with the Phonecian.  Many years passed until out return visit.  We were given a freshly remodeled room that was very nice.  Our only complaint was with a noisy air conditioner that made an annoying noise when it cycled off.  There were noises coming from the pipes also.  I'm sure this is from the underlying age of the property but I feel it is on it's way back.  I did not like having to pay for wi-fi.  Most properties of this caliber include it in your stay.  We learned while we were there that they had been taken over by Marriott.  I would not hesitate to stay here again  and I would definitely recommend it to others.  It has a beautiful grounds and golf course and is convenient to upscale shopping.  The food and service was top notch and all of the personnel were helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: jdummihan
reviews.title: Fabulous customer service
reviews.text: The Phoenician is delightful- not only is it  in an exquisitely  beautiful setting, but the rooms, newly redecorated are comfortable and beautiful. We have stayed at this luxurious property before but I noticed this time the exceptional customer service, every one we encountered seemed eager to help us with any problem or question. Thank you phoenician

reviews.author: darlene d
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.text: We spent 4 days for our 28th Anniversary. It was a relaxing retreat. The room was comfortable but is ready for some maintenance/updating. The Spa was very enjoyable, with my favorite treatment being a massage. Overall it was a relaxing getaway with great service and beautiful amenities .

reviews.author: beckytowler
reviews.title: Great Luxury Resort with First Class Service, Shame about the Spa
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week and had a wonderful time.  The service from the staff around the pool was excellent and we ate in all three restaurants which not only had a good selection of food but excellent service as well.  When we arrived we upgraded the room to one with a patio which was great for sitting and watching the sunsets.  My husband used the golf course which he found better than the famous Troon.  My only moan is that the spa is very dated and not at all inspiring.  The treatment that I and my daughter had was very good but the facilities are really not what you would expect from a 5 star resort. In order to have a 5 star spa experience you cannot rely on zero gravity chairs which are just posh recliners in a room with a fountain.  Please look at Dormy House in the Cotswolds which has several different seam rooms and saunas and a Verve Cliquot nail bar.

reviews.author: Sean A
reviews.title: Best Business Trip to Date
reviews.text: The resort is top notch. The grounds are perfectly manicured. The service is wonderful and willing to meet your every request. The food was awesome and you have multiple choices. The decor is classic and modern. The rooms were large, 55 in flat screen on the wall, the balcony was huge, two closets, and there is a glass shower stall, double sink & vanity and a separate tub. The drinks at The Thirsty Camel were made to perfection. The golf course is a thing of beauty. I was totally impressed with my experience there.

reviews.author: kickbeth
reviews.title: Best resort and customer service in Scottsdale!!!!!
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful!!  We were there for a family vacation with 17 people and they were more than accommodating in every way possible. Megan Yost helped us get all the rooms figured out and checked-in quickly.  Elena Torres went above and beyond helping us set everything up for our stay-Thank You Elena!!  We celebrated my Mom's birthday at J&G Steakhouse where the staff was wonderful in making sure everything was perfect.  Jen Smith and all of the room service staff were very nice and did a great job.  Charlotte, who I would talk to when I called room service was great and made sure nothing was missed.  The kids loved the water slide and the pools.  My niece did the iFly trapeze and had a blast. Lee Gault and all of the staff at the golf pro shop were fantastic.  The only bad part of the trip is that we had to leave!!  We are counting the days till we can go back!!

reviews.author: Durwood N
reviews.title: True luxury?
reviews.text:
This was the second visit to this luxury hotel. The accoutrements were top notch. The housekeeping staff are some of the best anywhere. Attentive, polite, helpful, and quick all come to mind. The front desk, especially Jordan, was outstanding. What a gentleman. 
The food was really a disappointment. The restaurants are ho-hum and they were exceedingly difficult to get reservations. Really a frustrating occurrence, since one is quite isolated here. Additionally, charging $9.00 for parking like a drive-in motel is usurious. I'm not sure I would stay here if there wasn't a meeting I attended.

reviews.author: Cathy S
reviews.title: Excellent Resort, Friendliest Staff!!!
reviews.text: This is now our favorite resort and we can't wait to stay here again. The resort and the setting is so beautiful and the staff was very friendly and attentive.  There are several pools and private cabanas available to rent.  If you like to hike, the Cholla Trail, that leads up to the top of Camelback Mountain, is within walking distance. The spa is a must and they also have a great gym.

reviews.author: Cpartee85
reviews.title: Awesome hotel horrible customer service
reviews.text: We decided to try out the Phoenician for its amazing golf experience. While our room was very nice the entire experience was tainted with rude employees, misunderstanding with bookings (still don't know how that happened with me having a confirmation email that stated what we had discussed), and a very inhospitable staff. This began with our room keys not working for half our trip and having to beg employees to allow us entrance to our rooms and informed by the same employees this is a frequent issue. On multiple occasions the gentleman that was cleaning our room would just let himself in without knocking. Other times we were unable to get out room cleaned even though we were gone for hours. At one point I found myself politely asking what wines they serve and was explained all white wines were the same and told, "do I want it or not". I believe the final straw for us was being notified by the front desk that you can not request a late check out but instead must call the day of your departure and pray. When we were granted one for an extra two hours for half the room's daily rate only to have a return call 15 mins later to say oops can't do that but please use our facility or locker room if you need and you must have your bags out ASAP. Very disappointed this hotel could be amazing if they would take 5 sec to take a page out of the hospitality books of there 5 star competitors. Would definitely come back for the golf but will definitely stay elsewhere because a 5 star hotel with 1 star service does not equate to 5 star prices.

reviews.author: Urolo
reviews.title: not really a five star resort
reviews.text: The Phoenician appears well kept and pristine when you pull up however their lack of attention to customer care is what is remembered from our recent stay there. Upon checking in at 2:30pm we were told that the room was just about ready for us. We decided to wait in the lobby. We ended up waiting over two hours for our room! We would have used the pool or gone elsewhere if we were told how long it would really take to get our room. While waiting we were never offered even a bottled water, a coffee, or anything. This lack of concern was annoying and frankly insulting when we were paying such a high price for our room. These courtesies seem like a no brainer and expresses a kindness towards the guests. As well, the $32 additional resort fee is annoying. They say it is for the pool and internet and use of the facilities. Aren't these part of the amenities of the hotel that I am already paying for? Why do they say they have "free" internet then when they are charging me $32? The included breakfast was so so. Hard to have coffee when it comes at $6 each as part of the $65 total allowance to cover the breakfast. The grounds are pretty and well kept but The Phoenician just isn't as good as some of the other resorts in the competitive Arizona market.

reviews.author: tiago5
reviews.title: great resort
reviews.text: The is located a few minutes outside Scottsdale downtown, within a pristine golf resort. Although the hotel is not new, you don't feel the age at all. The rooms are huge with comfortable beds and nice bathroom amenities. Great pools but a little too crowded in the weekends. Overall an amazing luxury complex for enjoyment

reviews.author: GerMar60
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
This is a rather lovely resort a short distance from Scottsdale. We were happy that it was self-parking  since we wanted use of the car during our stay. The car park was charged at $12 per night (added to the hotel bill). The room key card allowed access to and from the car park, which made life so easy.

The room itself was lovely and was very well equipped. In fact, the room we were in had recently been refurbished (they seem to have a programme of refurbishment going on at the moment).

Breakfast on the terrace in Il Terrazzo was really nice (service couldn't be better) and dinner at Relish was very good (and the restaurant wasn't too crowded).

reviews.author: vlmodz
reviews.title: Surprise 40th birthday.
reviews.text: We stayed at the villas. We had a 3 bedroom house, hot tub, plunge pool and use of a golf cart. Great entertaining patio, fire pit, gas grill and outdoor kitchen. Service was first rate, toddlers loved the golf cart, special sightseeing rides about the resort. The older toddlers got to go to the kids center and make their own tee shirts. We had a surprise birthday for one of the members of our family.  We hated to eave the villa, extremely relaxing. Would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: faigy r
reviews.title: GREAT EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
The staff was friendly,professional and extremely helpful!!!
There are so many pools and a great sprinkler park for kids! A playground with a sand box and a nearby basketball court is great for the kids as well as a movie theater in the kids activity center!

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: It's the little things that count
reviews.text:
Checking in was a nightmare...wrong keys and then right keys and a dirty room.
In fairness they did their best to make this up to me, but when I checked out there was a mini bar charge on my bill (as well as a phone charge). I used neither and when I checked out I told them that. Of course they took it off my bill and when I got home (the other side of the country they had decided to re charge me....The blatant arrogance to re charge me will cause me to never go back to this property again

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.title: Pleasure and business combined
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel with friendly, attentive and courteous service.  The grounds are spectacular.  The golf course is beautiful and the swimming pools are great.
Out room didn't have a great view but it was very large and well furnished and the bathroom was huge with a separate jacuzzi  tub and walk in shower.  Wonderful cactus garden and a great mountain to hike right behind.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: SarahHTO
reviews.title: Fantastic staff and service, but room had issues
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful resort nestled in the hillside with flowing waterfalls, beautiful grounds and extremely attentive staff. We had some issues with our room which I believe was one of the more recently renovated ones (it was gorgeous but problematic!) - including: luke warm hot water for the first approx 10-15 min - it got only slightly hotter after that (I ran the bath with the hot tap only on max, which was a dribble, for over 20min to fill up the bath), AC faulty (pumping out very warm air when set on lowest possible cold temp - not ideal in Arizona!), broken scales in the room, and a large gap under the door which explained why we were woken early in the morning by the housekeeping staff chatting outside. We flagged all the issues to staff the following morning who were fantastic and called us shortly after to confirm they had 'upgraded' us and changed our room, as well was waived some resort fees for us for the trouble. On our return later that day we were given access to one of the Casita rooms - nice to park right outside but significantly smaller than the original room with less furniture and at the ground floor level (though with a firepit and overlooking the pool). In addition to room specific issues our room keys we were given were not programmed correctly with the self-park entrance and we had to return again to the desk to get this corrected. 

Although we had problems I did feel staff went above and beyond. Rachel organised champagne and truffles to be sent to our room (we were celebrating our honeymoon) which was an incredibly nice and surprise gesture, and we were offered wine on our second night after the issues we had experienced and the room change.

I'm not sure we would return - while the service and staff couldn't be better and I was happy with the resolution, it's still a very expensive stay to experience so many different room problems and the hassle with those (for context this was our last hotel on a road trip staying at several different spots, and although by far the 'nicest', it was also the only one we had to complain at for the issues in the room....).

reviews.author: SunSeeker702
reviews.title: Still my favorite resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text: The upgrade to the Casita was well worth it.  We had a ground floor room with a view of the pool.  The rooms have recently been renovated and they did an amazing job.  The staff was very welcoming and helpful.  Can't wait to return for another visit.

reviews.author: Joseph J
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the staff went out there way to make us feel welcome and comfortable. My wife went to the Spa and Salon and loved it. If you stay request a room with a city/pool view. The 3rd floor mountain views are somewhat limited.

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: This time I stayed at the Casitas, even better than the suite in the main hotel!
reviews.text:
I had a one bedroom suite that opened up to the law behind the pools. What a great experience. I recommend the first floor not the second. The patio is nice plus MOST come with a fire pit. I've included some pictures. Access the all the hotel amenities is actually easier than staying in the main hotel. You can park right at your front door and save some many on a $29/day valet car fee. 

Most of all they are convenient, newly remodeled, and come with great bathrooms with seperat his and hers sinks, a sunken tub, and huge shower.

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Keep It Together
reviews.text: When I read the reviews it was hit or miss so since my husband wanted to stay here I didn't want to spend all 8 days here so I decided to do only 4. Thank God! Now although the grounds at the Phoenician are gorgeous! The staff is amazing. There are a lot of missing components. First big one but you're not gonna notice it is that they're remodeling. Realize this on day two. As I open up the curtains and lie on the bed I hear a noise outside on the deck. It's three guys climbing up a ladder looking inside my room not good. Had to get our newly remodeled room exterminated because I saw a bugs. When golfing make sure you ask them at the door to have someone drive you to the golf area it's pretty far. While playing golf the grounds are very muddy. Elevator broke so we had to use service elevator to go to a restaurant. To get to the gym you have to use all these different gates although it's not explaining that it's OK for you to walk through or not... just started following other people. Gate says staff only?? There are a lot of bumps but I'm glad I got to stay.

reviews.author: Bodean2
reviews.title: Absolutely gorgeous resort, perfection!
reviews.text:
Our room was fantastic, food was great, customer service was top notch. Played tennis with highly skilled tennis Pros. Massage therapist, Maria was outstanding. Dined at 
J & G Steakhouse, steak was grilled to perfection, outside seating beautiful, staff was friendly and attentive. Had visited resort 25 years ago, and its been maintained and updated well.

reviews.author: Shara W
reviews.title: My New Happy Place
reviews.text:
My husband and I were in town for only one night to attend a wedding. I had heard great things about the Phoenician, so even though it was a bit of a drive to the wedding venue, we booked our stay. I could not have been more pleased. The staff and the customer service were impeccable. The grounds were pristine. The rooms are spacious and well maintained. And surprisingly, the food is also delicious. We went to Relish Burger Bar, had breakfast at Il Terrazo, and even squeezed in a quick dinner at J&G, which was absolutely incredible. My husband and I travel a lot and my standards are pretty high - this place is not at the top of my list. The wonderful thing is it's a super quick trip for us coming from the Bay Area and I plan to come back often. 

The only bad thing I have to say is mostly out of the control of the hotel. There seemed to be a lot of guests that were really intoxicated. They asked someone to leave the bar who couldn't stand up or speak on Friday night and there was a very belligerent woman at the pool who was drunk and cursing about politics Saturday afternoon. The hotel staff seemed to address these things, so I'm not sure there's more that can be done.

reviews.author: Syassin
reviews.title: Beautiful and Romantic Resort among the mountains
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician for 3 nights.  When we drove in to the Resort we were very impressed with how beautiful it was.  The grounds were clean and the plants and artwork along the drive are very attractive.  Megan at the front desk was very pleasant and nice to us.  We were assigned a Casita room which was steps away from the pool, the fitness center and the Spa.  The pool itself was very impressive - it had several sections to it.  You can choose to be in a quiet section or near the kid zone with the waterslides and play area etc.  Then enjoy the hot tub in the evening.  If you can afford it this is a luxurious resort to visit.  The staff by the pool make you feel like Royalty.  They put fitted towels on your chairs then bring you extra towels to dry off with.
