They promptly bring you a tall glass of cold water and leave a jug of cold water on your table.  They are always around to take your order for drinks and snacks.  Its a beautiful, peaceful and romantic resort with great service from the staff.   Definitely worth a visit.  I had one of the best massages at the spa on the premises.  My massage therapist was Dawn - she was excellent.

reviews.author: Jamie S
reviews.title: Exceptional Resort
reviews.text:
We expected an upscale, family friendly resort and we got a new favorite vacation spot.  The desert resort setting was exceptionally beautiful.  The design of the hotel and amenities was incredibly well thought out.  There was extensive desert wildlife to be seen on the not to be missed golf cart safari.  The shady cactus garden was phenomenal for a short meander and photo opportunities.  The hotel brought in a bird of prey to keep the nuisance birds from the outdoor seating at breakfast and lunch.  My 10 year old loved the water slide, splash pad, ping pong, tennis courts, playground and the opportunity to feed the koi poolside every morning.  
The main hotel was undergoing extensive renovation, but it was remarkably quiet and did not disturb us.  We stayed in a newly renovated room that was lovely.  Room service the first night was the best room service experience I've seen- like performance art.  What made this hotel was their staff.  From the groundskeepers at the golf course to the front desk, servers and housekeeping staff, everyone we met working at this hotel was genuine, friendly, helpful and true hospitality professionals.  It made every moment we spent there a pleasure.  
Note for those unfamiliar with Arizona- it is extremely hot from May-Nov plan most outdoor activities in the shade or before sunrise- it is too hot to run outside during the heat of the day.

reviews.author: DoctorE88
reviews.title: Prime example of five-star attitude
reviews.text:
Prime example of five-star attitude
Spent four perfect days; within 24 hours most staff are addressing you by name, remembering what you order the next day, and overwhelming attitude of wanting to exceed your expectations in every way.  Equivalent to a Four Seasons service experience but at a significant savings.

reviews.author: NicNac503
reviews.title: An exceptional Starwood property
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is probably the best overall Starwood property I've ever stayed at.  

Rachel, the front desk supervisor, is a star.  She was very friendly, efficient, gracious, and accommodating.  She saved the day after a long car ride down from Sedona.  We had promised our two young children some small toys after a long day of driving.  However, the hotel gift shop was closed for renovations.  Rachel saved the day by scouring the back office and finding the kids some complimentary toys.  Her kindness really made all the difference.  

Check-in.  What else is there to say?  Efficient, friendly and gracious.  We felt very welcome.

Accommodations.  The room was very large, comfortable, and clean.  We stayed in a Grand Deluxe room with a great view of the pool and resort grounds.  All of our preferences (high floor near elevator) were accommodated.  I was a very happy camper.

Grounds.  Beautiful and well maintained.

Pool.  Spacious pool area with great service.  The pool attendant immediately set up lounge chairs for us and brought us a pitcher of ice cold water.

All in all, The Phoenician is an excellent resort property that compares favorably with other luxury resorts like The Four Seasons.  It's certainly the nicest Starwood property I've ever had the pleasure to stay at.

The only negative is that we were charged a few bucks for a mini bar purchase even though we didn't take anything from there.

Overall, two enthusiastic thumbs up!

reviews.author: christinarodriguez8
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Stayed with my husband for out 10th Anniversary and the staff made us feel very special! Concierge made us reservations at great restaurants all week and made it known to all that we were celebrating. Food was fantastic on property at all restaurants. Spa was so relaxing and beautiful. Renovations were going on but we were not affected. Cannot wait to return to see the finished products. Thank you to all the staff for making our trip memorable!

reviews.author: adalbert3
reviews.title: Very nice property
reviews.text: I had been here twice before this last stay for business meetings and really did not have the time to explore or take in the property.  My wife and I stayed in what I think was termed a casita and it was quite relaxing.  Our room looked out at a small waterfall and pond and the bird activity was glorious in the early morning.  On one of those business visits I had a room attached to the main building---it had a view of the side of Saddleback mountain, but you felt as though you were on the other side of the universe in relation to the main part of the hotel itself---we really preferred our casita instead.  The hotel has a fun burger restaurant (Relish Burger Bistro) which is great for lunch or watching a game.  In addition, the J&G Steakhouse is definitely an upscale restaurant that one would be happy to travel to if it were not conveniently located on the property.  Servers in the restaurants and other staff throughout the hotel made a point of getting your last name and referring to you as Mr.or Ms.--a great way to make you feel welcome.  There are numerous pools on the property and Camelback Mountain is right behind---we took a hike up part of the mountain, which was great fun.  I did not realize how long the hike could be, so when I go back, I will plan accordingly and include the full hike to the top as part of my itinerary.  We will definitely go back and stay in a casita.

reviews.author: lovesteak1
reviews.title: Awesone
reviews.text: I"ve stayed at most of the nicest hotels in the u.s. and this is hands down the best. Service is exceptional, rooms are wonderful and quit. Pools are absolutely stunning. Nice tennis courts, great golf. If you like a quiet place to relax and unwind. This is it. The only suggestion for improvement would be to provide some good mountain bikes to ride. They used to have good bikes but recently the quality is pretty bad. Overall, I give this place a 12 out of 10!

reviews.author: TLWhite
reviews.title: Had a great experience at The Phoenician
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful, friendly and efficient staff and great location. We thoroughly enjoyed our 4 night stay here last week.  We stayed in a top floor casita overlooking the fountain and pools. The room was quiet and the view was nice with a large balcony.  With 2 double beds our room was plenty big for our family of 3.  The beds are very comfy with nice pillows and bedding.  We had a fridge and keurig coffee maker.  The bathroom was huge with a large tub, shower, 2 sinks and a walk-in closet.  Being able to park our car right outside of our room was ideal. 

We ate at the terrace restaurant for breakfast every day and had great service and delicious food (loved Toothless the Falcon for scaring away all of the birds on the terrace!).  Lunches at the golf course (Relish) were also delicious!  Our kids participated in the trapeze classes one afternoon and that was the highlight for them.  We used the pool facilities each day and enjoyed it and I used the fitness center and it was large with plenty of equipment, water, etc.  

The location is ideal for access to shopping in Scottsdale and meals out.  The view of Camelback Mountain is stunning from the pool and the walk to the hiking trail on camelback from the hotel isn't too bad at all. I definitely recommend this hotel, especially for golfers and families traveling with children.

reviews.author: Ms. Kay
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: What a marvelous place. It is like an oasis. The service is impeccable, the rooms are first class and the service is exceptional. I arrived late without my bags and they opened the shops so I could get clothes and amenities. Great place

reviews.author: AJ C
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed here the weekend of Oct 7-9 2016.They are currently remodeling many of the rooms.Its hard to notice if your not looking for it.It didn't interrupt any of the operations of the hotel.Nice pool.They have an adults only side of one pool but kids can be on the other side.It also has a bar right there.One thing I thought was very odd was that they never clean my room on Saturday.There are no ice makers either.You have to call room service and they will bring you a bucket.No big deal.I ate at Relish twice.Excellent burgers.

If you are into hiking you can walk out the East gate and walk to the trail for the East trail at Camelback Mountain.Its a thigh burner.I would  stay here in the future.

reviews.author: Luis V
reviews.title: Idilica estancia
reviews.text: Fueron 4 dias de conferencias, en un entorno magnifico. Viviamos en un oaisis dentro del desierto de Arizona. Todo espectacular y a lo grande, tanto en cantidad como en calidad. La habitacion era un bungalow individual, rodeado de cesped y cactus. Me llamo la atencion la coleccion de librillos con cortas historias para su lectura antes de dormir. El servicio fue correcto, asi como la calidad de la comida.

reviews.author: Dan M
reviews.title: Have to admit let down - lots of apologies
reviews.text: I hate to have to write a less than perfect review for this hotel but have no choice.  We stayed here 9/30 - 10/4.    I made my reservations four months in advance and when I made my reservation the resort was wide open.  I gave a credit card to hold the room.  The week before I went I confirmed my reservation and told them we would arrive at night and to make sure they held the room.   I was assured we would have no problem with a late arrival. We arrived to find out the hotel was oversold due to a meeting at the hotel and they could not give us our room.  We could not get our room until the next day.  They put us in some kind of apartment near Camelback Road.  They comped the night but big deal - we had no pool, no restaurant nearby and were totally inconvenienced.  They people behind us also had no room.  The other thing that let us down was the amount of construction going on.  NO WHERE on the website does it tell you this.   If staying in a construction site is your idea of a luxury resort, you're in for a treat.   No retail shops either - all under construction.   Apology after apology.   Also, the food and beverage service at the pool was awful on Monday 10/3, actually non existent.   We were told they were very short staffed.  More apologies.   This hotel truly wants to be a luxury resort but really missed this week.    It was my first and most likely last stay here.  Anyone looking for luxury, The Scottsdale Princess where we usually stay is far superior.   And anyone traveling any time soon, beware - they are not advising of the construction going on.   Luxury starts at how you treat guests, and this week The Phoenician truly missed.    I hate to say these things because I so looked forward to this trip and thought it was going to be incredible - but being turned away after a 5 1/2 hour flight was no way to be greeted.   This is not a luxury property.   Some staff tried to say the right things, but it was really lip service.    To be fair, the cactus garden was enjoyable and the amenities at the spa were nice.   The pool was also pretty.   We enjoyed that.

reviews.author: daproza
reviews.title: Girls Birthday trip
reviews.text: This was our second stay this year at the Phoenician and it was even better than our first stay.   Antonio, the front desk agent, checked us in and was really nice and gracious and acknowledged my friend's birthday by sending a split of champagne and chocolates to our room.  Thank you, Antonio, for making her feel special.  It was a little disappointing to not find our room ready when we arrived close to 11 [did put in a request for early check in] but Antonio told us the previous was sold out and they needed to change out our linens to feather free.  We didn't get to our room till about 2:45 but were given one of the casitas near the pool.  Beautiful upgrade to say the least.  It was newly renovated an modern and still possessed the colors of the southwest.  Overall a great stay except our casita was not linen free despite the wait.  I woke up itchy and my friend sneezing due to the feathers.

reviews.author: AZ911TT
reviews.title: Anniversary staycation to remember
reviews.text:
First off let me say this place is dedicated to service from the second you arrive on the property, you will not be disappointed 
We chose to stay in the villas that had just gone through a total remodel and still had that new home smell AWESOME
Everything is new and I mean everything 
The tv is a 55-60in HD which is important because usually hotel tvs are terrible
 The bathroom is all led lighting with dimming features a huge garden tub and the best rain head and shower wand out there 
These villas are like having your own little apartment on property just a short walk to the beautiful pools and dining 
I love the fact u can park your car right in front of your door too 
We first scheduled a couples massage and my wife had the maternity massage as we are expecting. They can accommodate that if needed which is great 
Then we hit the pools, I believe there are at least 7 or 8 with a swim up bar or just have a server cater to u at your lounge chairs 
Then we had our dinner at the 4 diamond 
J and G steak house 
It was incredible to say the least the food was fantastic and it had a nice view of the lights of phoenix/Scottsdale area
I'd recommend this to anyone looking for a great experience and if they have high expectations they will not be let down 
Enjoy!

reviews.author: DDO89
reviews.title: A+++
reviews.text: I stayed her for three nights while attending a conference. The hotel is wonderful.  Service is outstanding. The staff go the extra mile each time you as a question.  Property is beautiful and wonderfully maintained.   Restaurants and room service is excellent.  Gym is outstanding.   I highly recommend and will stay here again.

reviews.author: Team_Owen
reviews.title: Great staff. Pretty good. Avoid 3092.
reviews.text:
The staff was great.  Brian at the front desk is super nice.  Cameron at Relish also awesome. 

We chose the deluxe suite and got stuck with room 3092.  It faces a concrete wall.  Avoid if possible ... unless you like concrete.

reviews.author: Eric H
reviews.title: Superb Property!
reviews.text:
We felt swept away!  This property feels like your in another country, the views and surroundings are amazing.  So quiet and relaxing.  The service and attention to detail was perfect.  We tried several of their restaurants and loved all of them.
They are in the process of updating parts of the hotel, but you hardly even notice.

We will go back!

reviews.author: Jose D
reviews.title: Excelent facility !
reviews.text: This hotel has excellent facilities,  even I did not used all of them I can tell that the pools, gym & conference rooms are great. I also used a bicycle during 2 hours for free. All the personnel are wonderful and offering kindly attention. The restaurants are very good but not offering (as on 99% in the US) vegan options, this is something I expect from a hotel like this with prices like this. I did a hike into the cammelback mountain, excellent option near the hotel.

reviews.author: HFLenz
reviews.title: Great hotel in a nice area
reviews.text:
This resort is large and classy, located at the bottom of the Camelback Mountain. 
The room was comfortable, spacious and well equipped. Mine had a nice balcony with mountain view. 
One can tell the whole hotel is not new, but I found it to be well maintained. 
Staff was very kind and, all services pretty good. 
I've been to two of the restaurants they have, both pretty good. 
The pool area is ok, not really awesome, and the bar by the pool closes too early (like 5:30pm or so). 
Pretty good overall, a bit expensive when compared to other resorts I've been in other cities in the US.

reviews.author: Nicola R
reviews.title: So horribly disappointing
reviews.text:
We have just arrived and the room is terrible. Not at all what I was expecting and not what the website display!
The room is very old and is in no way reflective of a 5* accommodation. Poor at best and I can't say again how disappointed I am.

reviews.author: walaamaher
reviews.title: A great resort. Wish my family joined
reviews.text:
So the top level review is : Great Place, Perfect crew, Smiling and cheerful help, spacious rooms, clean, comfortable, nice collection of TV channels. Ome bad Drop Food not impressive and expensive like hell. 
I spent 4 days in the place, really wanted my family to join me because the place is "wow" and they would have loved it as well. 
Room is spacious and with very comfortable bed and furniture.
Wifi is great and better coverage in some areas than other. With multiple devices on one pass. 
Hotel it self is HUGE, just moving around made my 10k steps target.
Very famous place in the area so all UBER and taxi were happy to drive u there.
The crew are all with a great smile ans sense of humor, u feel part of the family and genuine smiles all over the place.
Sure I will go there again.
What i did not like ( but did not concern me a lot)
The hotel is costy on the high level ( compared to all 5 stars hotels in Europe and middle east ) 
No open buffet breakfast. 2 boilled eggs and a coffee cost is 15$++.
150$++ for a TBone + mash potato and a coke and was not that mouth watering experience that make me forget the price.
So I took the first Uber and got groceries to manage at least my breakfast and snacks in the room :-). 

Over all 5 stars..

reviews.author: Charles W
reviews.title: Superior service, outstanding staff, and hands down best resort
reviews.text: I have been a long time guest of the Phoenician and its botique property - the Canyon Suites for the last 3 years or so, both as a business traveler and a vacationer. There's a reason I come back time and time again. The experience with the staff is deeply personal and just downright amazing. I'm always greeted by name and the staff here know my preference. From Anthony at valet, to Amanda at the front desk - I can always expect service that caters to my needs and is personalized for me. Even when disaster strikes, such as when my laundry was lost, I received a prompt response and the housekeeping and security staff kept in touch and quickly reimbursed me for anything. That being said, this was the only incident in the 3 years that I've stayed here. I would recommend this to all my friends and family if they're looking to be treated like an old friend.

reviews.author: Nancy B
reviews.title: Tea in the Lobby
reviews.text:
Took a friend there for her birthday.   You couldn't ask for a nicer place to have tea.   Service was the utmost highest level. Wanda was expert in her job and made you feel so welcome.
I asked for a special favor and she came through for us.
The food was heavenly and so delicious.  We will be back!!

reviews.author: Healthfulyogitraveler
reviews.title: The best hotel in the Phoenix / Scottsdale area. Classic, rich dessert luxury.
reviews.text:
This hotel is the place of dreams in the desert and opulence.

Whether you are on business, planning a wedding or trying to revitalize your relationship...

There is nothing that has has the kind of transcendent luxury like the Phoenician.
 

My favorite place to stay in the area.

reviews.author: AspraEbraica
reviews.title: Outstanding visit, Superior service
reviews.text: We hadn't been to the Phoenician in over 15 years and came for a business meeting. They are doing renovations and we got a good rate for the weekend. They have kept up a phenomenal level of service for very picky guests. Huge guest rooms and lovely meeting room with natural light. Great breakfast from catering for the meeting, and the entire staff (events, pool, bar, etc.) were great. Lots of pool areas to choose from and good food for poolside lunch or snacks. Night time "dive in movies" at pool for kids on Labor day weekend nights was great. Our attendees definitely enjoyed their visit and we are likely to rebook. We consider service excellence and amenities above all else when we book. We also ate off-site for dinners and uber rides were usually about $9 or so to get to a lot of the local places. Additional bonus is that while there's no airport shuttle, uber was about $20-25 because it's 15 min away. I assume Lyft would be similar. I think both had deals advertised for free rides if you used the promo code "gophx" but honestly I didn't try it.

reviews.author: PhoenixRising7
reviews.title: Service Overshadowed by treatment of Nursing Mom
reviews.text:
There's eight pools on the property from what my wife and her friend understood, and they were only able to visit one of the pools in our visit.  Each pair of chairs had it's own umbrella.  The pool attendants were very attentive with towels and water.  Only set back with the pool were the family of ducks (Mom, 2 babies, and 6 other ducks) that left the pool area full of duck poop.  Very cute, but definitely needing to clean all the poop.  

The amenities were great with the flavored water, laid out fruit, but definitely noticing that the showers are aging....like the handle was broken in one of the showers.  

The biggest issue with the visit that overshadowed everything was the fact of having my wife having to pump in a STORAGE CLOSET!!  I called the Phoenician ahead of my wife and her friends spa day to let them know my wife will have to pump during her visit.  Well they apparently didn't write down a single word I stated over the phone because when my wife arrived there were no notes in the system.  Then when she said she had to pump, they put her in the closet with the towels, mops, and cleaning supplies.....WTH!!!  Not only was she put in the closet, but she kept getting knocks on the door from staff members needing to refill supplies.  

Just the treatment of my wife with the pumping and putting her in the storage closet is enough for us to never go back to the Phoenician.  If you want someplace that has newer amenities, takes great care of their grounds, and most importantly provides you with a comfortable and luxurious location to pump/nurse then go to the Spa at Sheraton Wildhorse Pass......we've been there before and they were AMAZING with the treatment of my wife having to pump.

reviews.author: JRTwz
reviews.title: Well worth it
reviews.text:
Great resort which made it easy to conduct business. Staff is wonderful and goes above and beyond. Food was great and priced well.
Amenities are in tip top shape. Grounds are immaculate.
Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ashley A
reviews.title: Finally made it here!
reviews.text: I travel to AZ every 6 wks for work and this hotel is always out of my price range...except in the "off season." I really wanted to try it to see if it lived up to all of its glamour! I wasn't overly impressed with the decor, felt like I was in a time warp. The pool area was delightful and food was good. I'm not sure I would ever pay top dollar during peak season to stay here, plenty of other great hotels in the area to try. I would like to go back after the renovations are done to see the upgrades. Overall, great views of the mountain, nice location, and very pleasant employees; worth a visit to try it out during off season.

reviews.author: arubadive
reviews.title: Ruined VACATION. PLEASE READ
reviews.text:
We have been to this resort at least a dozen times over the past ten years. The resort itself has many visual beauties. I.E.  camelback mountain and the landscaping is simply gorgeous. The hotel is under going major renovations at this time so there are numerous shops closed and restaurants are hit and miss on being open etc..... This how ever is the very least as to what we witnessed....... Please  read on.

We experienced the same as the woman that reviewed in April 2016. " Prostitutes everywhere"!!!!  We notified management as to what we were witnessing and there was simply no care to what was going on around the pools!! As long as all guests had wristbands on!! This was their only criteria. There are literally 7 to 10 of these people around the pools. NO place for children or families to vacation in! WILL NEVER BE BACK!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: nikkigfoster
reviews.title: Complete Oasis!!!
reviews.text: Where do I begin? I felt like their most VIP guests the entire stay.  The resort is so relaxing and hospitable I often forgot at times that I wasn't out the country.  I would live here if I could.  It's not too far from the nightlife but nestled away in it's own quiet retreat.  The 7 pools are a site to see and the swim bars have great customer service.  It's views are beautiful as it's located along Camelback Mountain, which I hiked and it was AMAZING!  They also have a beautiful cactus garden and plenty of restaurants on the property.  I loved my stay and will absolutely be back.  I visited during off season so it may be why the experience was so pleasant.  They are renovating a lot on the property so that would be my only con but nothing major.

reviews.author: Sonya H
reviews.title: The Big 5-0 in the Desert
reviews.text: World Class Customer focused service!! Everything from check-in to check-out was STELLAR. This resort answered my prayers for a stress Birthday celebration/vacation.  There was never a need to leave the resort. Jacque, The Concierge Extraordinaire put an extra touch of class on everything's. Robert Porter, The Drink Master worked his magic and our Georgia Peach, Amanda at the front desk brought a little Southern hospitality to the mix. My friends and I enjoyed ourselves so much that we are planning a trip for November! The rooms are spacious and well-appointed. The food was impeccable...every meal....every time. The Lemon Curd Waffles stole my heart and my taste buds. Brunch was phenomenal. Even the pool service was excellent. STELLAR PERFORMANCE! They anticipated our every need and exceeded them. Can't wait til the next trip!

reviews.author: Gbgirl1705
reviews.title: Was a little disappointed
reviews.text: I love to stay st 5 star hotels every few months for a staycation. I finally went to this hotel and was pretty unimpressed. The pools were ok but not anywhere as nice as the fairmont or Hyatt. The room was old and dated and there really wasn't anything that stood out as a 5 star hotel should. The staff was amazing and attentive and parking was easy enough. Wouldn't pay full price at this hotel.  Maybe after renovations it will be more appealing. Under construction too and our room was a mile away from anything. Bummer.

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: Very relaxing resort
reviews.text: The Phoenician is undergoing renovations, which caused minor inconveniences, but the overall hotel experience is still very lovely and relaxing.  The staff were uniformly friendly and helpful.  The rooms are very large, and the bathrooms are huge.  Dinner in the Steakhouse was excellent.  The fitness center is well-equipped, and there is 24-hour access.  Swimming pools were not at all crowded, but I think the overall hotel census was down because of the renovations.  I was there for a conference.  Meeting room facilities were fine, but AC temperatures were on the cold side.  I had to go outside (into 100-plus degree heat) during the breaks to warm up.   Overall I was very pleased and would definitely return.

reviews.author: SaguaroHugger
reviews.title: Expected more from 5-star hotel
reviews.text:
I have ALWAYS wanted to stay at the Phoenician, and an opportunity finally arose! I find myself a bit disappointed. 
First I requested late check-out. The front desk girl said 1pm was the latest I could get. No more than 5 minutes later another agent granted someone else's late check, but at 2pm! We both were gold-level so why the discrepancy?

Room service. The service was great, the food was not. Don't waste your money on the pizzas. Bland, cardboard-like crust..bleh.

Room condition/cleanliness: with the prices these rooms go for (and the 5 star designation) I scrutinize this area. I learned on Hotel Impossible to always check behind the bed AND  the top of armoire. Well, I found a dusty top of armoire. Wallpaper bubbling in some spots as well.

reviews.author: Matt C
reviews.title: Needs renovation
reviews.text:
Its nice. But rooms seem dated from heavy usage.  I walked miles to my room.  Pool was nice.  Had massage at spa. Was good. Just needs face lift to get back to top rating
Staff very nice 
Ill try out a few other places next trip. Not running back

Food was good.  View from steakhouse is best part of dinner

reviews.author: ScottN
reviews.title: Wait for the renovation to be complete
reviews.text:
We checked out of the hotel and did not even stay the first night.

This would have been our second time in the hotel, and we had a great experience during our first stay.  However, the resort is currently undergoing extensive renovation starting with the casitas, and they are not repairing the regular hotel rooms.  The carpet was dusty and buckling. We tried to sit out on the balcony which where the plaster on the walls were being refinished and got dirty from the chairs (which should have been cleaned off in the first place!).  Worst of all, the toilet seat fell off and unmentionable debris and hair from the hinge area fell off onto the toilet rim, yuck!  They had also given us a room near the very end of the hallway of the back building and it was verrrrrry loooooong to walk back to the lobby.

In addition, when I had booked the room, I had asked for a room overlooking the mountain and desert cactus garden in the back of the resort, but was told I would have to book an upgraded room, which I gladly did.  When I checked in, they said that there were none left because of the renovation making rooms tight and was given a city view room.

It did not make sense to stay, so we checked out (at 10PM!) and the hotel was gracious enough to let us do so, apologizing profusely for the experience.  We drove and checked into the Four Seasons Resort further north in the Troons/Pinnacle Peak area and had a wonderful time in Scottsdale...a glamorous property with a real southwest vibe but a 20-30 minute drive back into the main part of Scottsdale.

When the renovations are done, we would consider staying at the Phoenician again, which is very convenient to Scottsdale shopping, Old Scottsdale and the Arts district.  We also appreciated the staff being so understanding. However, the owners should really close the resort down until the renovations are complete.

reviews.author: bes5
reviews.title: Good, but very large resort hotel
reviews.text: Well equipped resort hotel with great sports facilities, but huge and impersonal to stay in. Gym was open ealry for keen fitness folk. Evening meal was fine but nothing exceptional. Our suite was fine but the terrace looked over a concrete roof so not inviting to spend any time on.

reviews.author: TAS
reviews.title: Nice place to stay in Phoenix, scottsdale has other options
reviews.text: The place is lovely. Not my favorite spa tho, the Princess is better. The Phoenician is overpriced, but you won't have any complaints. Gorgeous views on the balcony, and the high tea is famous and the best in town.

reviews.author: Barbara B
reviews.title: An Amazing Stay @ my Bucket List Destination
reviews.text: As a resident of the Valley of the Sun, I've enjoyed the restaurants at the Phoenician, including High Tea on several occasions.  But, until now, I've never enjoyed staying at the Phoenician.  Without exaggeration, the facility and the staff of the Phoenician exceeded my expectations--which were very high walking in the door!

reviews.author: OzCol1981
reviews.title: Beautiful classic property
reviews.text:
I actually stayed here in the Winter before the renovations but most of the outdoor facilities were closed as you would expect due to the weather. My one major complaint was that the rooms (and indeed the whole hotel) felt like a 1990s classic but it seems like the renovations are underway now to fix this.

Pros:
- beautiful property overall 
- great golf courses, driving range and golf instruction
- high quality food at all of the restaurants
- service overall was top quality throughout the hotel
- walking distance to Camelback if you are into hiking
- pools look great with several choices, though not sure what it would be like at full capacity in summer
- Concierge was very helpful remotely before my visit to help organize my golf classes

Cons:
- car park views are a bit disappointing. Particularly as you have to have the blinds drawn for privacy, so you dont really get sunlight
- as mentioned above, property feels old but it is being updated
- food prices are rather high, though quality of food is good.

reviews.author: l n
reviews.title: great resort in scottsdale
reviews.text:
The resort is pretty big between the lands, golf course, pools etc. They are redoing all the rooms and from what i've seen it should be pretty good. Some common areas and elevators are also being worked on, it currently affects the ease of going say from the lobby to your room: Only one elevator was serving a whole aisle of the resort when we were there.
We had a room overlooking the mountain and the cactus garden with a balcony which was nice and quiet. No complaints.

My only slight disappointment is that the main restaurant is a steakhouse (J&G Steakhouse) -something a bit more local would have been a nice touch. Also there's supposed to be a grass tennis court but it wasn't there to be found.

reviews.author: n0rrie04
reviews.title: 30th birthday getaway
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. The service was incredible! My husband and I stayed for a 3 day weekend to celebrate my birthday. The good was great and the spa is wonderful. We were both impressed with the amazing service and helpful staff. The remodeling sidnt impact our trip at all! Great resort, would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Linda K
reviews.title: Exceptional service during a facelift
reviews.text:
Yes, the resort is going through construction and not everything is open all the time HOWEVER......

This is a fine resort property.  The staff is exceptional (I was surprised at how often my name was used) and from the minute we walked in the front door until the minute we checked out, I felt like a treasured guest.  The pool attendants were wonderful, the spa technicians were extremely professional, and the food was delicious, fresh and healthy at every meal.  If you need a small boutique feel and a completely renovated and modern space, this is probably not the resort for you but if you enjoy a classic feel and extraordinary service and food, you cannot go wrong here.

reviews.author: Frank C
reviews.title: The Queen of Scottsdale Lives!
reviews.text: In spite of the ongoing major renovation, the most beautifully situated and elegant world class PHOENECIAN RESORT chose to keep its doors open. Thank you. There is not anything quite as elegant in the greater Phoenix valley than this place. Solid beauty provided by Camelback Mountain, Priceless Saguaros, many different swimming pools, manicured golf course and tennis facilities all punctuated with million$ art by American Southwest sculpture icon, Alan Houser.  A fabulous resort that provides a great pampered immersion in the legendary western desert landscape.

reviews.author: cro63304
reviews.title: Better than expected but not 5 star yet
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician this past weekend. Going in, I was hesitant based on the reviews here. I was happier than expected once we checked out. Yes there are renovations happening but didn't really damper our stay. Check in was easy, were able to get in early, and the room was fine. Bathroom is nice but the room still needed updating. There were a lot of little shops closed during our stay but nothing that affected us. I have to give much praise to Heather, our server at the pool. She stood out from every employee on the property. She was extremely attentive, helpful and accommodating. Even remembering our names throughout the weekend when we would see her! Our drinks were always full and we never had to go looking for her when we needed anything. She was on top of managing her section and seemed to take care of all of her guests. I wish we would have sat in her section all weekend. The remainder of the weekend, the pool service was subpar. In fact, I would swim over to the pool bar and order from the bartender there because our servers were rarely around to check on us. The pool did not appear to be busy so not sure what the hang up was. They need more "Heathers" that's for sure!! The pool is beautiful but also needs a make over....but I hear that is coming. Other than that, things were great. Steak house was great and the golf courses played well. When we visited, we received a great deal on our room so I was ok with the renovations...had they been charging the full price (which I hear is pretty steep) for rooms, I think I would look at other options until it's back to its 5 star status. Once they are done with renos, I'm sure it will be as lovely as it always was.

reviews.author: mmsc40
reviews.title: 5th visit... disappointing
reviews.text:
I realize it is off season- but come on. Very limited indifferent staff. Construction EVERYWHERE. 2 restaurants closed. Only one working elevator. Many children- checking in - In droves.
In the past I have enjoyed mother of pearl pool as an adult pool. It is not. Adult pool is a cramped space connected to the main pool- just roped off. You have to hunt for towels/ service in this location. Beds were comfortable.The room was dated- yet spacious... but we looked at the roof.
Come on- the place is clearly not full. Give a person some kind of view. DISAPPOINTING.

reviews.author: Travellinman26
reviews.title: First Class All The Way
reviews.text: You won't find a classier hotel in Phoenix than the Phoenician.  Excellent location at the base of Camelback Mountain for hiking and golf.  Troon Golf manages the golf - does anybody do it better than Troon - the answer is no.  Nice pool area and Italian brunch on Sundays.  Nice meeting facilities and close to airport.  Not the cheapest room in Phoenix but the nicest surroundings for sure.  Note:  The hotel is going through a major renovation and many areas are closed or will be until 2017 so check before you book.

reviews.author: Marcela S
reviews.title: When you sit on your laurels......
reviews.text:
We booked this hotel 9 months in advance, with a very high expectations having read and heard so much about it..... And it was really lame. First we  tecieve an email 5 days before saying that they will be remodeling the "casitas" so we would not be able to have what we booked so far in advance; really they let us book knowing that it would not be available due to remodeling, that is wrong!!! They of course knew in advance (permits, contractors, etc, that is done well in advance) then we arrive to this ok room nothing really worth up going to. Next day we leave the room at 10 am and when we come back at 2:30 is not done; really is this supposed to be 5 star? I call house keeping and they tell me that I needed to let them know when can they make up the room...... We come back for dinner and the Italian restaurant is closed due to lack of people really! What are we supposed to do? It is Saturday night so we end up in the bar dinning on small plates which were ok, but with a singer that was screaming all the time, im really sorry and understand that practice is needed to master things but that music was impossible to listen to, worst to sit for dinner, we ended up leaving really fast and taking our dessert and drinks to the room. I would never return to this hotel, needless to say recommend it, it was a HUGE DISSATISFACTION AND DISAPPOINTMENT. 
On a good side, the concierge was very nice full of ideas for us to be able to go outside do things to minimize our time inside the hotel. 
Not worth to spend your money or time in this place.

reviews.author: Dianne W
reviews.title: Lovely Resort
reviews.text: My husband's law firm had their Partner's Retreat here. The hotel did a wonderful job on the food and the activities. The spa was a wonderful relaxing place to visit as well.  They also had a hospitality area for us to get drinks and snacks throughout the day. It was our best retreat to date!

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.title: Excellent property
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here recently and it was fantastic.  Great customer service all around.  From the front desk check in to the concierge to poolside attendants, everyone had a smile.  They are currently going through renovations, however it wasn't a bother at all.  It was quite (which we enjoyed) as it was low season for them.   Only negative would be the pillows as they were very flat.

A great property and it takes less than 10 mins to get into Old Town Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Sheryl M
reviews.title: The Best in Scottsdale!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is one of the best resorts in Scottsdale! The grounds, pool area, rooms, restaurants and golf course are all beautifully maintained. The staff is friendly, efficient and accommodating. The location is perfect as well.  It is close to great dining and shopping.  This was my fourth visit to the resort and I am looking forward to my fifth visit!

reviews.author: mjmorris009
reviews.title: Huge disappointment, even for SPG Platinum
reviews.text:
I am a platinum level SPG member, so stay at SPG properties very regularly for business.  Here are my takeaways:
-Nice property, rooms clean and relatively spacious.  Pretty grounds.
-They say they're starwood, but don't get the impression they take this very seriously.  -They refused to give any kind of preferential room assignment based upon status (even though available for purchase online at time of check in)
-Supposedly an executive lounge on property, but no access given
-Pool area is a complete mess.  Large hotel using pool with not enough pool chairs.  If you want a chair you have to stake out your chairs by 8am, otherwise no chairs.  To me, nothing screams luxury like having to scout out a corner or concrete to put your towels on.  One small Jacuzzi (probably 12" diameter) for entire hotel.

Conclusion - there are much better choices in Phoenix.  Try Four Seasons at Troon North, where we stayed the year before.

reviews.author: mettebk
reviews.title: 4th of july treat !
reviews.text: An amazing visit to the Phoenician once again  for the 4th of july holiday. The hotel had a wonderful holiday program planned- crowned by the local Sky hawk sky diving team , who ascended upon the pool w flourescent sky diving suits and American Flag parachutes and great fanfare ! What a treat. Fantastic food and service as always- immaculately kept pools and a fantastic visit overall

reviews.author: DDLMaverick
reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: Excellent service at the salon with Lana and Vicky. Spa is very hard to find no signs readily available for resort guests. salad is very good at the golf course restaurant none not information on off season.  Drinks at the pool a really good and check in is not stressful but not real personable but they did deliver champagne and awesome chocolates to our room last night per my request the night before and they did not get that request but then they did do it later on. California wines  slightly expensive $45 for half a bottle of California chardonnays ZD outrageous!🍾

reviews.author: Unbongout
reviews.title: Great facility, good price!
reviews.text:
This was a good experience.  We were an extended family of seven, adults and children and had a great time even if the temperature was 100°!

 The facility was. very well kept and the pool areas spotless and inviting.  We got any excellent rate through Booking .com!

reviews.author: jbreach
reviews.title: Doesn't Live Up to Expectations
reviews.text: Still a very expensive hotel undergoing renovations while also actively catering to guests which is a recipe for disaster.  Literally workers hanging off the roof onto the side of buildings and walking across your terrace.  The few meals we had at the property restaurant were mediocre at best and one dinner was downright terrible.  F&B service was equally lousy throughout and on one occasion our very expensive meal served as training for a new waiter who clearly had not worked at this level of hotel service.  Staff is semi-pleasant in a sort of casual way which speaks volumes to the fact they mostly don't care.  The room we had was OK on the second floor overlooking the pool indirectly and generally clean and mostly everything worked with the exception of the terrace door which was a disaster opening and closing.  This was our fourth time at this property and not at all enchanted - we will not be returning anytime soon I think we can do much better at other properties in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Jolene D
reviews.title: Do better
reviews.text:
I can certainly deal with the renovations but the service has slipped and not quite sure if they should retain the luxury collection status. Pool service was at times non existent. And I'm writing this sitting here on a Sunday morning when the pool is very quiet. You would think the service would be a bit more up to par since it's not busy at all. Had issues w a room promised to me at check in that was not delivered upon. And one of your pool servers had no interest in taking my lunch order. Very evident as he asked if we needed anything while "walking away."  He clearly was annoyed when we wanted to place our order for lunch. Sorry!  That's what guests expect at the pool. Drinks and food. So for a $100 lunch please treat me a bit better. 

Might give this place a rest next time and try the jw.

reviews.author: debaden_12
reviews.title: The Spa Is divine!
reviews.text: I Came here  for a facial and a massage today and it was so wonderful. The facial with Lauren and the massage with Rhonda was great and very relaxing,I love the waiting area with the fruit and the fruit infused water was perfect.

reviews.author: KatefromCT
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Renovations aren't getting in the way of this beautiful resort. While some areas are being updated, the staff and service continued at a superb rate. The rooms were comfortable and well kept. The meeting spaces were comfortable and meals tasty.

reviews.author: Wayne H
reviews.title: A nice stay at the Phoenician
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is a nice hotel set alongside a scenic desert mountainside in suburban Phoenix. The resort is a bit dated, but renovations were well underway while I stayed there. Overall, the resort was clean and well-kept despite its age. My room was comfortable and the bathroom was rather big for a room that size. The staff was very helpful and friendly throughout my stay. 

I spent a few hours at the pool one afternoon and the pool area was also nice and well taken care of. The pool side staff was very attentive and did a very good job of keeping the cold water refilled in the desert heat. My turkey wrap lunch at the pool was quite decent for that sort of thing. The gym had very good equipment and was also in pretty good shape. The Il Terrazzo restaurant on the property was a nice setting and the food was very good.

The only things that I didn’t care for were the obscenely priced fruit yogurt in the café ($9, really?) and the awful coffee during one of my meetings (use the Keurig coffee maker in your room). It was also noticeably warm in the hallways at times, but that may have been because of the work that was being done on the building.

The hotel is relatively close to some pretty good restaurants in Scottsdale, if you go off property.

reviews.author: TravelMomandCo
reviews.title: Spa-cation!
reviews.text:
We ran away from the craziness of preparations for a wedding in town to this resort. We indulged in spa treatments and room service for a night. The resort itself was impressive and highly enjoyed the views (except from our room), we had booked a mountain view room and ended up with a roof top view. We did not realize this as we checked in and went straight to our spa appointments. We did not go to our room until later in the evening and by that point we were too tired or relaxed to wait in the line we had passed in the lobby and honestly didn't feel like dealing with it. 

I was expecting a little bit more from the room. It was definitely in need of some updating, but not much. The door to the snack bar kept opening on its own and we had to shut it each time we passed it. We found a key in the drawer and we finally locked it shut to keep it from opening. It was quite the opposite with the closet doors. I guess for the price we were expecting a little bit more. Fluffier towels, nicer robes and I guess just a face lift to the room. Something was missing from the over all ambiance and/or comfort of the room. We couldn't quite put our finger on it. 

The hotel staff was very friendly and most helpful when needed. 

The spa was great! The staff was friendly and they never fell behind on our appointments. We enjoyed the tranquility of the waiting area, as we enjoyed the different fruit infused waters they offered.

All in all, it was a great stay. We were looking for peace and quiet and we definitely found that here.

reviews.author: LuvnKanaDan
reviews.title: This place is great, even with the heat!
reviews.text: Friendly poolside attendants, clean, fresh and huge rooms. Relish has some tasty burgers and so many tequila choices! Nice things for kids to do along with a great kid pool area. Adults can get relaxation time in the adult pool - yes, adults only! Make reservations at J&G Steakhouse, beautiful view of the valley. The Phoenician staff pays attention to detail and is friendly and helpful. Great location in Phoenix. Take time to roam around the resort!

reviews.author: Mark M
reviews.title: Nice property in need of some modernization and refresh
reviews.text:
Definitely a beautiful property on camelback mountain with golf and pools and all you could want for a getaway. 

Unfortunately I was there for work so didn't enjoy much of that aspect of the property. 

I was upgraded to a very nice suite on the end of the main building with a large terrace. Great space but obviously in need of some 21st century updates for such a nice property. I am told there is a renovation underway so excited to see the updates!

Steakhouse restaurant was really good but would be nice to have a few options for eating (besides the pool bar) since you're somewhat secluded in the resort from town. I believe one of the restaurants was under renovation so again-will be nice to see this place after the planned updates.

reviews.author: minermanny
reviews.title: Tired and out of date
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is the ultimate in luxury...40 years ago. It is now tired and dated with broken facilities and poor service. There are some amazing resorts in Phoenix and Scottsdale (Westin Kierland, the Princess, the Four Seasons, Sanctuary, etc) and I would urge anyone in management at the Phoenician to stay at one and see what upscale really looks like. 

Half the hotel is undergoing construction-something not noted on the website for obvious--and deceptive--reasons. The rest of the hotel is getting an exterior facelift (meaning construction sounds outside your room and workers on your balcony). We were told that the Casitas and Canyon Suites are being renovated and are shut down until at least Sept 2016. 

Two of the hotel's four elevators were being repaired and were screened off, leading to longer wait times. 

The reception desk experience was like an airport motel reception experience. We arrived at 2 pm to check in since I had requested an early check in and I had received an email from a "concierge" (looking back was probably an automated computer) noting the early check in. We were told by the very young man behind the desk that they "didn't have to" provide a room until their standard check in time of 4 pm but we could wait in the lobby for 2 hours while they made up the room. When I mentioned the early check in he just repeated that they didn't have to give us a room until 4. It was like the scene in the original "Vacation" movie when John Candy pushes up his glasses and says "Well the Moose up front should have told you..."

We decided to leave the property for 2 hours but had to pay for parking to leave since he wouldn't/couldn't give us a room key then. 

We had a large Phoenician Suite, which was a big waste of money. Normally hotel suites are nicer than normal rooms. I'm used to a step up in quality, especially at these high-end Scottsdale resorts. The Phoenician Suite was not luxurious, warm or nicer. No wonder they don't have a lot of pictures or layout diagrams of the rooms on the website. 

It was just more and more mediocre room with uncomfortable furniture and no temperature controls. It has a poorly designed layout including a side room of just cabinets and two mini-fridges. But great news, it has a fax machine for some reason. It is a mediocre suite and poor value for money.  

The room has a million dollar view BUT there was a letter on our bed noting that because of construction there may be workers on our balcony and if we wanted "complete privacy" (!!!) to keep our blinds shut. Even without the construction workers, the bedroom windows and patio are visible from the restaurant patio one floor below so people mingling outside can look into your room. Either way you'll keep the blinds shut. 

The temperature controls are a manual silver box from a 1950s classroom. The only vent blowing air in the bedroom is tiny and screened off from the bed by a half wall, so laying on the bed you feel like you are suffocating. When we called down for a fan I should have taken it as a bad sign that of course they have plenty. Must be a problem throughout the hotel. 

When the worker brought the fans up he actually just walked right into our room. It was the most shocking hotel service experience I have ever had. I was stunned and took the fans from him while he stood there waiting for a tip. 

The bedroom TV is on a swivel that doesn't quite turn all the way toward the bed. No matter, since the hotel only has a handful of oddly selected channels (mostly news). Either the Phoenician doesn't want to pay to provide real channel selection or they figure everyone is watching Netflix. Either way, if you hate the distraction of having a lot on TV to choose from, this is the hotel for you. 

The bottom of the "luxurious" soaking tub was peeling, gross and unusable. 

If you want to get up early and get after it definitely stay in suite 4102. The bedroom appears to be right above  restaurant and hotel service areas and there are endless doors opening and slamming shut starting at 6 am right below your bed to help get you up early. You'll want to get out of bed early anyway (if you can) after a bruising night on an uncomfortable bed that has all the comfort of a Soviet-era gulag. Also there was a half-empty bottle of vodka left in the room from a prior guest. It didn't give me confidence in the cleanliness!

Everything is a little off, mediocre or broken at the Phoenician. Other than that it's fantastic. Good luck!

reviews.author: Boris N
reviews.title: Under EXTENSIVE Renovation -- 3 stars max
reviews.text:
We used to stay here in the hotel's headier days and it was nothing less than perfection back then. Now, it appears that as the hotel undergoes a much needed facelift, the staff training and general environment here could use some freshening up as well. When I made the reservation, there was no notice given that 2/3 of the hotel would be under renovation -- although the staff tell you it's "maintenance." We arrived to find virtually all of the hotel's boutiques virtually empty with 70% off sales going on, elevators and escalators blocked off for renovation, both the Canyon Suites and Casitas all closed and stripped for renovation. 

The grounds and other areas have fallen in disrepair in some places (noticeably the bacci lawn, with huge patches of dead grassy areas contrasting with lush green presenting an eyesore to almost all the main building's guest rooms that overlook the pool area. The rooms smell musty with older, stained furniture and old school fixtures. Our TV strangely didn't work but the technician was kind enough to leave a note saying someone would be by the next day to check it out. No acknowledgement from the front desk for the inconvenience. 

The check in area is located oddly on an open corner so you have people waiting in line in the main passageway as well as what seems to be the main line waiting area, but which oddly has some very large circular sofas right in the middle of it all, clearly intended to be used but upon which no one sits, so everyone is standing all around, not in a line. Front desk staff hardly recognize Starwood Platinum (this despite a call from the SPG Platinum desk to notify the hotel of our special event). No 4PM checkout for Platinum (it's 2PM here). In fact, the hotel wanted us gone so bad, they staged both the housekeeping cart and a rollaway bed outside our door before we'd even left the room! We did receive a $30 breakfast voucher for two, but what isn't stated is that the continental breakfast that it covers doesn't include coffee or OJ, so at $4/$5, respectively, you end up paying essentially the same or more than the coupon is worth after tax and the automatic 18% gratuity are tallied. Additionally, they have a guy walking around in the outside area with a hawk that is allegedly there to scare the birds away. We couldn't figure out why a man AND a hawk walking around were necessary to scare birds away, and not just a man...

We used Starpoints but in all, in its current state and the blasé level of service, the hotel is worth about half of the 20K per night they are charging.  

The pool area is great, but a little convoluted with chairs all over the place. Additionally, the pool deck is scalding hot despite being the "cool deck" material. Cushions on ladder rails are worn away, enticing would be swimmers to further scald their hands on hot metal when climbing in and out of the pool. Pool staff were great, though, very helpful in providing cold water and tending to anything you need. Equally great was the Center for Wellbeing Spa, although the men's side is old school circa '90s and outdated. 

It will be interesting to see how things turn out but the hotel is a long way from returning to its greatness from the days of yore.

reviews.author: Larry W
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Great resort for relaxation!  Staff is outstanding and very friendly.  Everyone treats you like a valued customer.  Many pools to relax and enjoy.  Nice hot tubs and a very nice slide for children and adults.

reviews.author: Joke
reviews.title: Spacious rooms and bathrooms
reviews.text: Very spacious rooms and a huge bathroom. Beds were rather small: 1m40 is on the small side for two people. WiFi is only free in the lobby if you want it in the room it costs 24 dollar a day! Parking also costs 12 dollar a day. Pools are great. We visited in time of renovation so there weren't a lot of people which made it look a bit empty... But when in full operation definitely a place where you can relax!

reviews.author: Scott F
reviews.title: Perfect Stay-Cation
reviews.text:
Me and the GF wanted to get away for a weekend, the Phoenician was the perfect destination to do so.  Everything about this hotel was outstanding.  We had a great room with a desert view that was very spacious, clean, and had a very nice, large bathtub. Our room (6136) was next to what seemed like a storage room for the room service, but it was no different from any other room, EXCEPT, it made our balcony twice as big as it connected on the outside to that room (which didn't have a door out to the balcony, but had a balcony nonetheless.)  Nice lil benefit.  

Service was phenomenal at every point, from parking our car, check in, the staff at the pool, staff at the steakhouse, everyone goes out of their way to make you feel welcomed and appreciated. 

Grounds and pool are spectacular.  There was some construction somewhere on the grounds, we occasionally heard some construction noise, but it was seldom, it was mostly very quiet and serene. 

I was very impressed with this hotel, and will most certainly return.

reviews.author: D M
reviews.title: Spa Day
reviews.text: It had been years since I had last visited the Spa at Phoenician.  I was particularly interested in the guided meditation and it did not disappoint! Be sure to ask about featured specials on treatments.  They directed us to Travelzoo, we booked our services and reserved our spot for guided meditation.  This service is free if you are getting other services. A great way to decompress!  Spots seem to fill quickly, you will not want to miss out!   We enjoyed a relaxing massage and reflexology in between lunch overlooking the golf course.  The spa offers services unlike most spas which really sets it apart.  I was told that they will soon be expanding the spa increasing amenities, services and adding it's own pool and restaurant. The expansion is a much needed improvement to the spa, it's very small and on a busy day can feel crowed versus intimate.  Make no mistake, the quality of the treatments is ever-present, just be clear on what you are needing from your spa experience compared to what other properties currently provide.  All the staff was very helpful and attentive.

reviews.author: Wendy C
reviews.title: Relaxing, fun resort!
reviews.text: We stayed 2 days here for a wind down after a road trip to all the national parks. I wish we had spent all week here! The staff made you feel special every step of the way.  There wasn't a bad moment. The rooms were beautiful(although if you have a family I might request a room looking over pool as its more convenient), room service great, dinner at steak house ...AMAZINGLY  delicious, pools ..excellent,  pool bartenders great (he knew all our names by end of 1st day), food poolside good, Golf delightful, SPA treatments were heavenly!  I had the holistic massge right before we had to leave for our red eye flight back home.....i didnt want to leave. Truly a five star hotel, but not the 5 star price.   We are already planning our next trip back just too stay here. Thank you!

reviews.author: Burgie1381
reviews.title: Mostly good
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Phoenician with my daughter for 4 days. They are in the process of renovations and when I got to my room the furniture on the balcony was piled up and a man was on a ladder at the balcony.  This happened a few times during my visit. I went to open the curtains one morning to find a man on a ladder a few feet from me at eye level. 
The check-in process was great. Very nice staff. I ate at The Relish and that was very good. The hotel seemed empty probably because of the heat this time of year.  I did leave a swimming suit there. I called and they mailed it to me. I very much appreciated this although they said they would send it ground because I was in no hurry. They charged my credit card $22.00 dollars for this.  I did expect the charge to be less and was disappointed. Otherwise, I would go back once the construction is complete.

reviews.author: Anne Marie P
reviews.title: Very lux - cool staff, creative spa, lovely grounds
reviews.text: Always heard about the Phoenician.  About its glam spa.  And I'm a spa girl through and through.  Needed a quickie-break, and the deals were available because it's the dead of summer...110 everyday in Scottsdale.  So I jumped on it.  Upgraded to a pool-view room (a MUST) because the balcony over the pool just makes the experience.  Room was comfy, clean. Bathtub needed an overhaul. No bath salts and girlie perks like that.  Room needs a remodel/refresher (I understand they are in the process of doing this now....)..  Pools were nice.  I somehow felt the pool areas needed a more sleek polished overhaul as well.  Pool staff very cool and accommodating.  Bar staff in lobby super cool, made designer drinks on request for my friends and I.  My rule of thumb is:always be cool to staff, and they will do anything for you.  Spa was great.  I'll be supremely honest - the facial was a facial.  Didn't blow me away.  Chakra balancing treatment was uber cool and surprisingly enlightening and relaxing.  Meeting with intuitive gal who does hypnotherapy and tarot:  LOVED HER.  Love outside the box treatments and services. In this regard, the spa rocks.  Need more healthy snackage in the spa waiting room for people who are at the spa for hours and need to snack along with their custom (amazing) teas. Also - Donna in the hair salon is really fantastic.  (Utilize her for amazing blow outs!) Biggest let down:  They could not accommodate a late check out for me, due to my late night flight out.  Bummer.  I've never stayed at a 5 star hotel once and been turned out of my room when I asked for late check out.  Ever,  Mandarin never has done it, Peninsula, Four Seasons, even the Hyatt.  Use the hotel car service for airport transportation!!  Great vehicles and almost same price as a taxi.  The Phoenician lived up to it's reputation, but I wanted just a little more TLC.  Just a little.  I'm not a snob, pretty low maintenance overall, and perhaps my standards are high.  But this is how a hotel gets better:  with honest, well-intentioned reviews by people who want to see them succeed! Overall, I would return...after their renovation! xo

reviews.author: alex u
reviews.title: Still the best in town
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Phoenician in Scottsdale for a week. This was my 26th visit. I have stayed at the Biltmore, Princess, Sanctuary, 4 Seasons and others. All good hotels but the Phoenician continues to knock it out the park. Excellent service, food, pools, lounge, parking, large rooms etc. Home away from home. The very best news? They are finally remodeling all of the rooms and the spectacular lobby. Its been a long long wait for this but all should be finished in about a year. The ONLY reason I have checked out others properties is because the rooms at the Phoenician are quite tired. Well no more. Can't wait.

reviews.author: maria m
reviews.title: Horrible customer service and theft of credit card
reviews.text: I brought two out of town friends to the Spa here, the Center for Well Being.  We were treated shabbily with the worst customer service.  Maybe because we were using a prepaid groupon.  When the front desk checked us out all was fine. They apparently had trouble later with one of the friends credit card and just charged my card for her service!! They were harassing with annoying phone calls to me and this constitutes theft!   Do not use this place, you will feel great while there, but will leave with added stress and trouble.

reviews.author: greggfi626
reviews.title: Annual 4th of July Trip
reviews.text:
We really had a nice time and the room, staff and facilities were great!  The resort wasn't nearly as crowded as we would have thought it would be.  My only issues were with the restaurant downstairs where we had brunch.  1.  Last year you had an owl that was being shown to customers on the patio and that was great.  My daughter really enjoyed seeing it and learning about it.  So needless to say she was excited to see a hawk until the handler told her the name was Hitman and that he kills birds and luckily for us he isn't flying around at breakfast time because there would be blood and feathers everywhere as he is a messy eater.  Really?  Why would you tell that to a 6 year old?  I think he would be better suited working in a mortuary.  2.  While our server was nice enough to let us know that gratuity was included in the final price of the bill we received, the server who waited on the elderly couple next to us did not tell them.  I overheard them trying to figure out a tip amount and I showed them on their bill where it was included.  I don't think it is appropriate to apply mandatory gratuity to tables of 2, 4 or 6.  Most people assume it is only applied for larger parties and to apply 18-20% automatically is pretty high considering the service really wasn't that great and it was a buffet.

Aside from those two point, great job!  We will look forward to spending our 4th of July at your property for the 4th consecutive year in 2017.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Shelli G
reviews.title: 20 year anniversary weekend
reviews.text: We celebrated our 20 year anniversary at The Phoenician and could not be happier with our choice.  When the staff found out it was our 20 year anniversary they upgraded us to a suite which was unexpected but very appreciated.  The staff goes above and beyond to make sure your stay is enjoyable.  The grounds are beautiful and the room was very comfortable.  We dined on property the entire weekend and enjoyed all of the restaurants.  The views are amazing and we can't wait to return.

reviews.author: samjrg121877
reviews.title: Best High Tea Ever!
reviews.text:
When my wife and I travel, one of our favorite things to do is to search out the highest rated place for High Tea and schedule a time for High Tea. We have been to High Tea all over the country, the Brown Hotel in Denver, The Adolphus in Dallas, The Grand Hotel on Mackinac Island, the Omni William Penn in Pittsburgh, just to name a few, but without a doubt the finest High Tea Experience that we have ever had has been at the Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale, AZ. We were there in March of 2015 and had such an amazing experience that when we were just in Phoenix for business last week, we scheduled a time for High Tea. Once again we were not disappointed!
Wanda and Natalie, the servers were both still there and their attentiveness and service were once again exceptional! The selection, quality and quantity of the food, was the same as before (unparalleled) and the Piano music and vocals provided by Alan Comyns during Tea,  were as delightful as before! Following tea we had a very stimulating and wonderful visit with Jaime Smith, their new Concierge and she was delightful! After this second, fantastic experience at The Phoenician, there is no question at all, that on our next trip to Phoenix, we will be staying at The Phoenician Resort and Spa!

reviews.author: loveandkindness
reviews.title: Service declining, unusual charges, but wonderful grounds
reviews.text: Over the past several years, we take our family to Scottsdale at least once a year for a week and have always stayed at the Phoenician.  We still had a great time as how could you not when you are on vacation but this was the first stay where we have had issues.  For example, our toiletries were not replaced everyday even when we ran out and the daily evening turn down service was provided only twice during our weekly stay. Rooms were also being remodeled and I was told during check in that the renovations would not interfere with our stay.  One morning at 8 am, I heard a lot of construction noise, I open my balcony door and see three workers working on my balcony.  The noise went on until 5 pm but I thought I would let it go since we were going to be out and about and not staying in our room.  Just thought the resort should have let me know about the work rather than finding the workers on my balcony.  It was the surprise element that I did not like.  We were also staying in an executive suite and had requested a roll away bed.  The resort website states that roll away beds are complimentary but upon check out, we were charged $150 for the roll away bed.  I do not mind paying this fee if this fee was expressed upfront but there was no mention of it and I have never been charged previously for a roll away bed.  Again it was an unexpected surprise.  The worst part of it was when I had inquired of the fee with the front desk at check out, this individual was condescending and told me that if I don't want to pay the fee then I should have booked a different level room.  Please note that we were already staying in a deluxe executive suite.  The charge was reversed but the attitude shown was rude and not what you would expect from any resort much less a five star resort.  It is very sad to write this review as I have such great family memories from all our family stays at the Phoenician and we have not had issues in the past.  I felt compelled to write this review based on my experience and I wonder if the negative changes that I experienced at the resort during this stay have anything to do with the sale of the Phoenician that recently occurred. The grounds are still beautiful and there are wonderful people who still work here but unfortunately we will stay at a different resort for our next trip to Scottsdale.

reviews.author: brenda s
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Lo único que tengo que decir es que todo el tiempo hacen que la estadía sea especial , la cena es sencillamente perfecta, los espacios son hermosos y me encanta que el servicio de la zona húmeda sea 24 hrs es el espacio perfecto para la relajación luego de un día de trabajo , esta noche como es costumbre disfrutare de su piscina y de su excelentes cocteles en J&R súper recomendada  la cena en el 5 nivel.

reviews.author: Jonathan R
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: This place is wonderful! We sadly only stayed one night and didn't get to experience all this place has to offer but I already can't wait to go back and I just checked out yesterday.  It's huge and beautiful.   The pools are amazing and there is plenty of room to find a lounge chair.  We were there in July which is considered off season so the place seemed empty and the room price was reasonable. We only ate room service but it was delicious and delivered quick. The Phoenician is great for romance, family or business.  I'm looking forward to spending more time there in the near future.

reviews.author: luv2cruz41_123
reviews.title: The Phoenician Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Hotel needs and is about to undergo major renovations. Kids sprinkler park awesome! Will be Great resort once again when redone.
Loved sitting and having breakfast outside every morning. Suggest wild jeep tour and the zoo as well for family day trips

reviews.author: Patty V
reviews.title: Pretty good place
reviews.text: We did Executive Health thru Mayo Clinic and stayed 2 nights at the Phoenician. The hotel was just fine and the regular rooms were of appropriate size. J&G Steakhouse on 5th floor was so good we ate there both nights. The views were great! The property is large, 250 acres, and has several pools. We noticed the back half of the property was under renovation so try to request those in a few weeks. Uber friendly! We were there in off season, and our room was very reasonable but would not pay high season without the renovations.

reviews.author: Andrew H
reviews.title: Quick Staycation
reviews.text:
This is a great little getaway. My girlfriend and I had never been before and thought we would check it out. Megan and Rachel at the front desk were super helpful in getting us a great room. The pools were large and there were plenty of chairs. The food and drinks by the pool were delicious as well. Relish Burger Bistro was fantastic too. 

*Just a heads up, they are starting to remodel the whole property. So lots of construction, but it didn't bother us at all

Oh also, Wear Sunscreen!

reviews.author: Mindy S
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the The Phoenician for a small weekend getaway.  There is definitely a reason this resort is 5 star!  Service was impeccable from the moment we checked in.  We loved our room which was at the base of Camelback mountain which gave the overall room and patio a very peaceful feel.  Pools were wonderful, and towel and pitchers of ice cold water is brought to you when you chose your "spot".  Besides the water you can order food and cocktails while lazing in the pool.   Amazing experience.  Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Matt F
reviews.title: 10th Anniversary
reviews.text:
My wife and I wanted to get away for a 4 days and had always heard great thinks about this property and it lives up to its reputation.  The concierge Lonni Sommers and Michelle Caldwell really went above and beyond and made everything so great.  From sending a bottle of Procesco and truffles, to handling all our spa and dinner request. Then on top of that the manager (name escapes me) on duty sent up truffles as well the 2nd day.  It was nice special touches.  Rich and Ben at the pool were excellent and attentive.  

The room and bathroom were huge.  It can use a little updating and I know they are I. The process of renovation of the casitas room but there is nothing that takes away from how great the property and rooms are.

We had dinner on property our last night at Relish and it was fantastic.  Service was great.  The friend pickles are incredible.

The spa was Incredible.  Maureen was my therapist and I had an 80 min hot stone massage that was the BEST I had ever had.  Was the most relaxed I had been in a long time.

BIG FAN of this resort and hope to be back again soon.

reviews.author: DoctorVincenzoVonCueBall
reviews.title: Still Great But with an *
reviews.text:
* Been coming here over 25 years, year after year with family of 6 we take 3 rooms or suites and I am a Lifetime Platinum SPG.

Still a great hotel but needs a redo. Some of the furniture in the rooms no longer matches the decor.

Service still wonderful and they try real hard........

Refurbish completely and we will keep coming back.

the Doctor hit me with a helpful vote......

reviews.author: Lynntravels83
reviews.title: Beautiful Setting! Impeccable Property!
reviews.text: We found the Phoenician to be the ideal property in the area.  The spacious grounds, beautiful pools and phenomenal location just can't be beat.  We really enjoyed the great proximity to Old Town Scottsdale.  The pools were delightful.  We also took advantage of the fitness center and water exercise class.  The Camelback Mountain hike was also worth doing for the fit and eager in your group.  The rooms are very spacious, so I was a bit disappointed to see double rather than queen beds.

reviews.author: Regina D
reviews.title: Professionalism is "Top Notch!"
reviews.text:
All I can say is this Resort is a nice resort for kids and family!! It's also good for Adult getaway as well! But we brought our kids here and had a very good time! Service was good and the bell men where right on target the only complaint I had is they parked my Acura where it got wet from Monsoon after I just had it detailed! And when I asked them about it they didn't know how to respond. Next time take the car and wash the dirt off before bringing it back to the guests. The other bell boy told me they probably parked it in an area that the water and wind could come through. Just a thought to keep a traveler happy bring back the vehicle the way you got it!!
Other than that rooms were clean floors clean and we had a good time! Love the view from main lobby overlooking pool.

reviews.author: heatherNkyle0827
reviews.title: Excellent service
