reviews.text: Stayed for a week during a conference. Large comfortable room and bathroom with all the amenities and a view of the cactus garden. The hotel and rooms are looking a bit dated but everything was very clean. Service was excellent from every single team member. Enjoyed their many pools & the service of taking care of fixing up your seating & making sure your pitcher of water was always filled/cold.The hotel did a fabulous job with the conference. Only checked out one restaurant (Relish) which was just ok. Had room service our first evening, which was very good and our server made us feel very special even tho it was only room service. The hotel was great for children as my son traveled with us - they have a children's pool, provided bath supplies and someone gave my son a stuffed animal from the hotel in the lobby.The hotel is conveniently located very close to the center of Scottsdale & not too far from the airport.

reviews.author: Samsaralegend
reviews.title: Luxury in Scottsdale
reviews.text: The phoenician has been here awhile and it's a little outdated but the grounds and pools are amazing.  Rooms aren't bad either just need some updating.  I don't mind paying for luxury but it gets a little silly paying for some of the little things that we all know don't cost that much.  I wish they would keep the slide open longer and even at night.  For some reason it closes at 5 - 6pm.  Location is a plus and the golf is great.  Just wish they didn't overcharge you for every little thing.  Does a candy bar really cost $7 anywhere?  Anyway, it's a nice place to stay, we had fun and would probably go back.

reviews.author: pmc1492
reviews.title: Great Property - The Renovation Will Make it Even Better
reviews.text: Held a multi-day event for 600+ guests and everything went off without a hitch.  The staff couldn't have been any friendlier or more accommodating The property is currently under renovation and I'm looking forward to seeing the changes.

reviews.author: Nick H
reviews.title: Great service, dated decor.
reviews.text: We stayed three nights and had a great time. Service was very good in all aspects, great food. The rooms are dated and look like they are overdue for a make-over, furniture included. That was the only downside that we came away with. It says there are "seven" pools but the way it is laid out it is more like four pools, two up top that almost connect and two lower ones, one of which is "no children". Would prefer a little more separation from the kiddos (we are empty nesters). but the service was stellar so that lessened any negatives we my have felt. We watch for them to get a major remodel and then go back for a return visit for sure!

reviews.author: Trent F
reviews.title: Awesome Resort and Super Staff
reviews.text: We were at this resort last weekend and were completely impressed by the whole resort from the beautiful, comfortable room to the many pools and the food and drinks. Great place! We will be back with more family in the future!

reviews.author: Reasonable50
reviews.title: AMEX Platinum FHR stay
reviews.text: We stayed five nights using the Platinum Amex fine hotels and resorts rate.The FHR rate is always a lot higher than the hotel website rate but it includes breakfast and a nice upgraded room, among other things. However, at The Phoenician we were essentially upgraded to a guest room on a higher floor (3rd)..most likely the same upgrade a gold or platinum SPG guest would get without paying the high FHR rate. We were disappointed with our room, but that said, the resort itself was nice. Yes it was dated, but so are we ; ). The restaurants were very good although a little expensive. The spa was dated but clean and at times too busy. The fitness center had very solid new equipment. And of course the pools were the highlight of the resort. The weekend we were there, many families and couples had a great time in the pools in the hot Arizona sun. On Saturday night the resort showed a movie by the pool for kids to hang on noodles and enjoy. My advice to tripees, don't pay the high FHR rate here if you have SPG status...no bang for the buck.

reviews.author: Patrick1945
reviews.title: First Rate....
reviews.text:
I've read some of the somewhat negative reviews of the Phoenician, and, I wonder whether I stayed at the same place. My room, with a view of camelback mountain was spacious and comfortable. The staff was helpful and friendly in every way. The restaurants were excellent, especially the J&G Steak House. The pool attendants were just that--attentive.

I was there for my son's wedding , and the Phoenician made it a memorable occasion, even though the temperature was torrid. The staff did everything I could imagine to make things comfortable.

reviews.author: SafariSnob
reviews.title: Scottsdale's 'Grand Dame' is Showing Her Age....
reviews.text: To be fair, this hotel is going through renovations and rooms are being updated to the tune of $60 Million.  Rooms will be more contemporary by the end of the year.  The lobby’s famous fountain and chandelier are on the way out and something more contemporary will take their place.  The hotel’s restaurant has one of the best views in the city - you can see for miles!  Pool scene is just that - multiple swimming pools are enjoyed by young and old; all pool space was at  full capacity during our visit.   Visitors next spring will enjoy the facelift that the property is going through, although the lobby will not be done by then.  Phoenician has always been considered one of Scottsdale’s ‘classics’, but I find that despite the renovation, the bones of the property will remain dated and there are  better options / values out there in the same price point (or below).

reviews.author: Linda G
reviews.title: Very compassionate
reviews.text:
I don't need to write what a fantastic resort this is, I'm sure it's in many other reviews.  But what I want to compliment them on is the kind pool attendants and servers at the oasis pool.  Yesterday morning I went for a walk that took longer than expected in the heat and stumbled into the Oasis literally just about to faint from heat stroke.  They all were so kind and provided me with all sorts of assistance.  I'm not sure I recall their names but I think Josh and Samantha were two of them.  They gave me sports drinks and someone even gave me a banana out of her own lunch.  

Any resort can have beautiful facilities but to have such wonderful employees who truly went the extra mile, that's what makes it a world class resort.

reviews.author: CarolJean35
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text:
We had the best time at this resort.  I honestly can't think of one thing we didn't like or have an issue with. I don't understand all the complaints about the place being outdated? We stay only at 4-5 star resorts and this place fits that category. I would call the Phonecian Classic, Classy and Clean. 
We preferred the hotel vs the casitas and they happily let us change rooms. Thank you we will be back for sure.

reviews.author: jkchen1
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: I would definitely stay here again. The grounds are very nice and the hotel is in good shape. The Canyon Suites are closed down for a complete remodel. The only downside is the adult pool. There is no enforcement of the adult pool area so, if you don't mind the screaming kids...

reviews.author: Sandra B
reviews.title: almost perfect
reviews.text: This is an amazing hotel.  And the staff was absolutely exceptional. The only issue with this hotel is they have dated rooms, which they are in the process of working on!  Also the alcohol drinks and the food were expensive, but very good. Therefore I could not rate the overall value as excellent.

reviews.author: lozdavepage
reviews.title: End of our road Trip!
reviews.text:
At the end of our amazing 2 weeks in the States travelling the California cost, we decided to finish with a bang drive into Az and stay at the Phoenician Scottsdale! 
Hotel is brilliantly located and the grounds are stunning, our room was very spacious and the bathroom was HUGE which was fab!! 
We enjoyed the pool areas and the breathtaking views of the mountains. 
How ever after our 1st day at the Phoenician the main biggest pool which you see in most pics was closed for 2 days and parts of both other pools.... This sadden me as we was only staying for 4 nights, and nor was we told about this when we checked in, also I might add we was still charged the resort tax, when really half of the resort for us, was closed. 

Pool service could be a little slow? And can go a good while with out seeing anyone. How ever all staff and so pleasant and  lovely!! 
My boyfriend and I 100% would stay back here, and do plan to do so I just hope it's not when they are refurbishing again.

reviews.author: 27415miles
reviews.title: Forever special
reviews.text: After trying many of the local resorts for our staycations, we came back to the Phoenician. It is still our favorite. The mother-of-pearl pool is as beautiful as ever, the service top notch, and the views are the best in Phoenix. Be sure to enjoy J&G Steakhouse's view for dinner or a drink. Rooms are luxurious with fantastic bedding and amenities.

reviews.author: Ricketee
reviews.title: Final nite
reviews.text: A luxurious way to end an adventurous Arizona family vacation.  Off season rates kept it reasonable and there is plenty to do on site, including a fabulous pool with volleyball.  Breakfast buffet was amazing even for our gluten free crew.   Would get in earlier and play a round of golf if had to do over.

reviews.author: HollyGolightlytravel
reviews.title: Tea with Wanda
reviews.text: I just escaped from reality by having tea at the Phoenician. I do not usually have tea, but have started to come frequently because Wanda is so wonderful!  Every attention to detail is take into account for a luxurious experience.  This is now my go to for birthdays and special occasions. Thank you Wanda!!!

reviews.author: Sparkle162016
reviews.title: Our favorite spot
reviews.text:
We are lucky enough to be able to come here once a year in the spring. It's our favorite vacation of the year. We stay usually 4-5 nights and in the spring the weather is perfect. The views are beautiful as are the grounds. The staff is always top notch, we enjoy seeing Rich at the pool and love that he is there year after year. 
We have always enjoyed the casitas, they were getting a bit dated so hopefully the rumors of them getting renovated are true as they could use it. That's why I only rated it 4 stars. But honestly the whole property is picture perfect and really is a 5 star property. 
Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Todd E
reviews.title: Just Perfect
reviews.text: I travel often and this is my favorite.  Rooms are due for an update but still first class and comfortable without pretentious attitudes.   Just a special place with all amenities one could possibly need or want

reviews.author: liketotravelplaces
reviews.title: Top Notch Service
reviews.text:
We just came back from a 5 day-4 night stay at the Phoenician on the advice of a Friend who stays there every once in a while. We were not disappointed in any way. From the Bellman to the Servers, everyone went above and beyond with taking care of us. After one day, there were quite a few Employees who greeted us by our last name.Always asking if we would like some bottled water, and always asking if there was anything they could do for us.

The restaurants and Food in General was all very tasty, Pool service was also very good.

I would recommend a Pool View Room.

We would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: cindy w
reviews.title: Fun for the whole family
reviews.text:
We were only here for one night on our way to Sedona.  Rooms were big, the pool
was great and the service was very good.  Pull out sofa in King rooms.  Definitely a place we will return to.
Location is right at the base of camelback mountain and very close to a cute retail area.  Only thing we did not care for, was the odor in the area just before going outside to the pool.  Smelled like a sewer issue.

reviews.author: John N
reviews.title: Wonderful Local Resort for us still 5 Stars
reviews.text:
Yes, even being a local we do go out to local 5 star resort properties by us! The hotel major backdrop is right up against Camelback Mountain. All of the views from the hotel looking down towards Camelback road are wonderful along with the spectacular views to the right & left. All the grounds are impeccable with you being able to walk around and enjoy all the beautiful cactus overlooking a wonderful golf course. We have visited this place lots over the years for different events with it being one best one ever. 

The restaurants are second to none, we loved the High tea being offered for many years and has been fantastic. All the resort pools and extra services are always top notch. Always worth a visit to eat, stay or for a meeting!

reviews.author: Helen D
reviews.title: Is it still the best hotel
reviews.text: Just been back to the phoenician hotel for our 10th visit.   Staff still the best.   Very attentive and extremely friendly and helpful and very hardworking.  Hotel was taken over last year and oh how we noticed.   Charged now to park our hire car!  Also resort fees now in place.  Why oh why charge resort fee at end of holiday? Why is it not just included in price then you can decide if you can afford to holiday or not.  Terrible practice.  Why if there is a resort fee do you have to pay EXTRA for golf? Surely that's part of resort as is spa.  Everyone at hotel complaining of changes.   I hope new owners don't keep this constant extra charging up because regulars won't return.  They will spoil  a fabulous hotel because of greed. Paying to park? Please?? Insulting to say the least.  Whether we or our friends return is up to owners and their greed.  Shame.

reviews.author: Alycia S
reviews.title: sub-par linens, don't stay in the casitas, don't take the "green" option
reviews.text:
A bit of a disappointment - I'd stayed at the Canyon Suites before, and am at the Phoenician for business.  I was roomed in a "casita" (make sure you ask to NOT be in a  casita - by room number, I think they are rooms in the 6000 through 8000?  I'm in 71##.)  Although the hotel is nowhere near full, I'm on the first floor, on a road, looking at a wall.  Because it is summer, the walk to the meeting/conference center on campus takes at least 10 minutes through blasting heat.  And the room is set up so oddly - the desk faces the window (which faces a wall) so for us road warriors, you can't watch TV while working.  Room service comes on a tray and the only place to put it is on the desk which, as a I mentioned, looks at a wall.  Perhaps most disappointing, the linens are sub-par - too small for the bed, with one of those horrid diaper-changing-pad things between the sheet and the mattress, and as everything is a little too small, the pad immediately bunches up when you lie on it.  When I checked in, they asked me if I wanted the "green" option, which I'm used to meaning no changing of towels and linens, and that's fine.  In this case, it also means absolutely no maid service, which would also be fine (I'm not messy) except for the fact that the linens are so dreadful that I've had to remake the bed myself everyday - stripped to the mattress - just to try to get a slightly smooth surface.
On the PLUS side, the staff is very nice here, and quite lovely and willing to give you a ride to your cell block, should they have a cart available.  And the water park is super cool.  But this is a rather bad choice for a business meeting.

reviews.author: Ken H
reviews.title: Still the best!
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Phoenician numerous times over the years and the quality of the resort continues to impress. The rooms are spacious and most have awesome views.  Conveniently located in Scottsdale.  The service is old school gracious. Really just a charming place to stay. The golf course is good by resort standards and, like everything else at the Phoenician, incredibly well maintained.  TIP: stay during early off season- rates are significantly lower and the weather is bearable!

reviews.author: Designer_Traveller
reviews.title: Wonderful - however ...
reviews.text:
I hadn't been here for close on 30 years and not much has changed; still quietly elegant, still delightful friendly staff and I would definitely go again. However I would take issue with what can only be described as certain nickel & diming charges, especially considering that the hotel isn't cheap in the first place.
Examples: I arrived by car, as I would guess had the majority of the guest; had I wanted the car parked for me a charge would have been made - fair enough. I didn't but a charge was made anyway for me to park my own vehicle.
I'd been travelling, had a few dirty shirts so sent them to be laundered - at a cost which would have enabled me to buy a couple of new ones. When I received the bill for this $5 had been added for delivery. I was informed that this was an included gratuity.
WiFi has to be paid for, unlike some of the cheaper hotels we had stayed in during our trip.
If they really feel the need to charge for things like this then why not just hide the sums within the total bills. As it is it smacks of penny pinching and gives, I would have thought, totally the wrong impression of the hotel.

reviews.author: Nalyes
reviews.title: Nice but needs some updating
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice but it is looking its age. The room was not what I expected for the price. Our patio needed paint in the worst way and there were areas of the room itself which need some TLC. Staff was outstanding and all the restaurants were wonderful. The pool was wonderful as it was very hot weather. The spa/jacuzzi was a serious disappointment. It was full of kids all of time - even though the sign clearly stated no children under 12 without an adult in attendance.

reviews.author: Chitoman9
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: Wife and I love driving up from Tucson and staying in Phoenix for the weekend to catch some Dback games.  Wife and I stayed at the Phoenician Scottsdale in September of 2015.  We loved everything about it! It is luxury and comfort.  We stayed in one of the casitas , they look more like apartments but they had everything you need and more.  We were maybe 40 yards from the pools and restaurants.  This Resort is magnificent.  We cant wait to return!

reviews.author: lynnt868
reviews.title: Went for a work conference
reviews.text: Lovely hotel with really good facilities . Would have loved more time around the pool but unfortunately we were there to work!! Rooms were lovely and big fantastic bathroom. Food was very good too. Would love to return and relax !! Pool area is spotless and lots of loungers. It even has shops!

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Modern done with maturing style!
reviews.text:
I lived just up the road from here many years ago and it was always fun to dine or enjoy cocktails on the balcony. We used to take friends for their fabulous English style afternoon tea's.
Now staying there, well the service , the food and incredible amenities are just fabulous. Even arriving here by car is an experience, entering by the Palm lined driveway. American service at its best.

reviews.author: Janice S
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text: This is a true 5 star hotel.  The hotel backs onto Camelback mountain.  The views are spectacular.  The grounds are impeccable and huge, you can walk around and enjoy all the beautiful cacti and the golf course views.  I have stayed at a lot of resorts and this is the best one ever.  It is expensive, but you really do get what you pay for.  The restaurants are second to none, the food is fantastic.  The pools and service there are unbelievable.  They make you feel important not matter what.  Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Bryan M
reviews.title: The La Quinta Inn has better wireless service
reviews.text: Business trip review only:  I just ordered chips and salsa and a sandwich for $48.  I can't get any work done because their wireless stinks.  It amazes me that a high-end hotel cannot get its act together on IT.  Seems nice if you want to vacation here.  If you need to get work done - find a Marriott with a good wireless signal.

reviews.author: calbearfan
reviews.title: Great resort, about to undergo major renovation check dates
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property, with wonderful staff. If you can get an upgrade to a fire pit room / casita it is well worth it. 2 complete bathrooms, sunken style tub, comfortable couch, dining room table for 6. Bed is very comfortable.

Staff is very responsive and helpful. Good for kids as well, has kids club, feeding of koi and a scavenger hunt iPad project. 

Everything is pricey, but high quality and service levels. Wonderful place to stay.

reviews.author: ctabstride
reviews.title: Best resort we've stayed at.
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is by far the best hotel/resort we have ever stayed at. This was a trip for just me and my husband and was everything we could have wanted and more. The grounds are gorgeous to just stroll around in the evening. 
The staff was very friendly. Our waitress Heather from the Oasis pool bar was very efficient, friendly and always smiling. She remembered us every day she saw us. 
The pools were fantastic. They had a section for all walks of life. We stuck to the adult pool but can't wait to take our children back for the waterslide and water park. 
Relish burger restaurant located above the club house had the most amazing deep fried pickles. So yummy we went twice. 
The Spa was worth the money. You get access to their jacuzzi, meditation room, eucalyptus steam room and sauna. Deborah was the RMT and I would highly recommend asking for her. 
We considered renting a car but decided to use Uber and it was way cheaper. Our most expensive ride was from the airport to the hotel because you have to ride with one of the more expensive options. Most rides around Scottsdale and downtown Phoenix were between $5-$15. 
This was our first time to Scottsdale and it won't be the last.

reviews.author: I-Explorers
reviews.title: Reminiscent of a fine Las Vegas casino ...
reviews.text:
On entering this grand resort with meticulously manicured grounds at the foot of Camelback Mountain one gets a feel that is reminiscent of a fine Las Vegas casino. 

The Phoenician is a highly rated property and has received many accolades over the years. Our home for a few days was a very nice suite overlooking one of the many pools in this 200+ acre resort. 

The Phoenician has a 27-hole championship course comprised of three nine hole courses. The Desert and Oasis 9s are both stunning courses. Well worth the price. 

Fantastic tennis and spa facilities are also available – unfortunately, neither of which we had the opportunity to experience first-hand. Visiting the facilities, however, there is little doubt that the luxury spa and full-service salon are certain to please. As is the picture perfect, award-winning Tennis Garden. 

Safe travels! 

... Mark & Dana ...

reviews.author: Rhonda K.
reviews.title: Fantastic Property
reviews.text: This is a great hotel for couplez and nd families.  There are so many things to do for all ages.  The tennis courts were a lot of fun in addition to the seven pools with swirling slide, and pond stocked with beautiful fish.  The restaurant at the pool was great for lunch, while the Relish Bistro had great byrgers.  However, the service was less than desirable.  So get carryout. They have an Italian Restaurant with grest breakfast.  So many selections for eating meals.  The cactus garden is the hi- light of this property.  It is truly fantastic and is set against the back drop of CAMELBACK Mountain.  Pay extra for a high floor with a view of the pool. This view is great because you can also see other mountains in the distance, see beautiful sunrises and hear the birds chirping. Otherwise on the other side you are looking at a mountain without much to see.  Great prices here in the summer slow season.  There are flash flood warmings though quite often in the summer.  We stayed here twice, and the location is great especially close to shopping in the downtown area.  It is quite a distance, if you are going to spring training games, but who cares considering all of the amenities.  Best of all the parking is at no cost.  It is better to stay in  the hotel area rather than the casitas as they seemed very desolate at night.

reviews.author: Boris B
reviews.title: A stay in hell! !!!
reviews.text: The only thing that seemed to work is the hotel cash register. Memorial day weekend stay away. Old and run down. Will never come back. Awakened by a construction crew banging on my balcony.  My key did not work. Had to change them 6 or 7 times, walking back and forth from the front desk to the room. Their fix was to leave the doors open to both of my rooms.

reviews.author: buddharaimy
reviews.title: Hot tub was a huge disappointment.  Forget romance.
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed 4 nights over Memorial Day weekend.  I'll start with the good.  The Customer Service was 5-star stellar in every area - everyone was helpful, smiling, gracious and welcoming.  Poolside service was also excellent even though we needed to get to it by 6:00 am to get a couple of chairs in shade.  We were able to leave our chairs and keep them just long enough to get breakfast from the exquisite buffet.  I believe that is appropriate.  There were many claimed chairs with people eating breakfast.  They had to post signs prohibiting saved chairs only because of the people who would claim one and then get in their cars to go shopping, etc.  Maintenance staff were very prompt and friendly.  The grounds are gorgeous!  I love this resort!  The activities provided for the kids were wonderful!  I would definitely bring my family here.  It provides a very safe environment.   There are off-duty police officers hired to keep rowdy locals out.  NOW with the bad:  The beautiful, tiled hot tub I was looking forward to as part of my experience had been changed into a kiddie water park and a very small hot tub added nearby in its place.  TOTALLY INADEQUATE FOR A LARGE RESORT.  The kids swarmed the hot tub and used it as their personal pool, which completely destroyed any chance of romance.  It was overfilled and too unpleasant to stay in.  NEWS FLASH:  The resort is being renovated so be sure and contact it before making reservations.  Again, I love this resort and my husband and I will be back.

reviews.author: MonicaR001
reviews.title: My favorite staycation!
reviews.text:
Phoenician is my favorite staycation and family friendly. I live in town and by far this is my favorite. Lots of activities for the kids and adults. Beautiful property and the service is impeccable! 

Went to Relish for dinner and they accommodated our party even though they were fully committed. 

Property 👍👍

reviews.author: king25
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We stayed 5 nights at The Phoenician this past week/weekend  and absolutely loved it! From the gorgeous lobby and sitting areas to the beautiful pools and lounge areas, we loved everything about this resort. Our room was very nice and spacious but we had an end unit. We ate at every restaurant onsite and all were great! All staff that we encountered went above and beyond to answer a question or provided assistance. The playground was perfect for our 1 1/2 year old. It was a little bit of a walk in the heat so I would recommend going early morning or in the evening during hotter days.
The pools were awesome. We didn't have trouble getting chairs most days but we went to the pool usually by 11am or so. I'd recommend getting out to the pool earlier Friday's and weekends.

I can't say enough about this resort from the exceptional staff (bell hops, front desk, housekeeping, food & beverage staff, pool attendants and more!) to the activities provided daily to the beautiful grounds. We will return again in the future!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Good if not busy
reviews.text:
It's easy to be good when you're not busy.   However,  on Memorial day weekend the Phoenician failed.

The pool staff puts out great signs near almost every chair saying no reserving.   Well every chair has some magazine or something on it with owners nowhere to be found.   After asking the pool staff for assistance,  they can only move things after two hours.  They never do.   The solution is two plastic chairs dragged out of storage.   Let's not forget pool manager "M", walking unknowingly past my daughter, complaining about me because I had the temerity to ask for assistance in finding a chair!

At check-in, "R" promises a room move on the second and remaining days of my stay.   Second day I stop by the front desk to inquire when the room will be ready.   No notes from the previous agent and the promised room is no longer available.  Oh and keys not programed correctly twice. 

My advice is to completely avoid this property on holidays.  The management and staff do not seem to have the systems in place to handle anything approaching full occupancy. In the case of "M", the pool manager,  does not want to hear about it.

reviews.author: PG13LA
reviews.title: Relaxing, Nice .. a bit dated !
reviews.text:
The grounds are well kept and nice. The property is quite relaxing .. Casitas w/ individual fireplaces are great to relax outside while sipping your favorite beverage and the adult pool area is quite nice too... 

Restaurant choices are limited a Steakhouse which is quite nice and an Italian eatery which has a very limited menu. Both restaurants are VERY PRICEY.... but solid good. The rooms require refreshing -- Everything seems old and dated. I could not even plug my laptop to the TV with HDMI cable because they have blocked it off with some clunky contraptions...  

It will be an amazing place to go back should they do some "refreshing" and "modernizing" !

reviews.author: 543nealm
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: I've stayed at this hotel multiple times and this time was my favorite.  Remember to request a pool view.  The room was large and comfortable.  The staff and housekeeping were great. I was here for a conference, so I didn't enjoy the activities as much as if I was traveling with family, but was very pleased with all the amenities and service.

reviews.author: DogDad_68
reviews.title: It is always nice to return to the Phoenician
reviews.text: A timeless beauty that knows how to provide 5 star service and a great venue for business meetings.  Early May in Phoenix is nice but a stay at the Phoenician is the best.  Get a casita overlooking the grounds and pool if you can.

reviews.author: RockinBB
reviews.title: Nice... But...
reviews.text: The grounds are nice, the rooms are comfortable, the staff is very friendly... But... I'm not a fan of being nickel and dime'd at every turn after spending over $400/night on a room.  There's a resort fee of $29 then another resort fee of $3.95 that they don't tell you about. Then you get to pay another $12 per day for parking.  Phoenix is the desert, so when you get to your room you can have a nice bottle of water for another $7.  And forget trying to sleep in or go for a nice peaceful walk in the morning because the leaf blowers and lawn mowers are going full blast.  Honestly, just not impressed.  I hope management can figure out how to give a 5 Star experience for the 5 Star price they charge.

reviews.author: DNDee
reviews.title: An aging beauty
reviews.text: We spent four nights in a ground floor grand deluxe room, which in my opinion was neither grand nor deluxe.  The wallpaper was peeling and the patio was a mess, due to ongoing construction.  The website said we'd have either a view of the pool area or the golf course, not so if you're on the ground floor.  I still give this property a 4 rating because the grounds are beautiful and immaculately maintained.  The employees are all friendly and helpful.  Lonnie Summers, a concierge, is first rate and helped us put together a good four day visit.  Overall, we'll try somewhere else when we return to Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Douglas T
reviews.title: Relaxed with family
reviews.text: We had a wonderful vacation at The Phoenician. We stayed in a suite at the Casitas.  The staff was very friendly and helpful to both the adults and the children.  The rooms were luxurious, we enjoyed reading the paper and having coffee on the balcony each morning. We ate at J&G (separate review), Relish (burgers) and Il Terrazzo (breakfast).   Great service and enjoyable meals.  A wonderful getaway for a family.

reviews.author: Anthony A
reviews.title: Just beautiful!!
reviews.text: We stayed here for a couple days celebrating our first  babymoon . This resort is a example of what heaven is . Everything from the views to the food and staff were just amazing!!! Highly  recommend to come . A touch of paradise. Would be back again  that's a promise.

reviews.author: Travelife22
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Although traveling for business, this setting was very serene.  As an SPG Platinum member, the perks received were wonderful! The italian restaurant on this property was exceptionally good and I absolutely love the gym.  Cant wait to come back!

reviews.author: Peter M
reviews.title: Lovely grounds, sadly threadbare with uninterested service
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is situated on lovely grounds facing the mountain. The lobby area was open and spacious and nicely done. The rooms however were not. We stayed in one of the "casita's" on the 2nd floor facing a car park. The front door was badly worn and chipped at the bottom The carpeting was worn and old, as were the upholstered chairs and ottoman in the room. There are not enough outlets for modern technology. I have been told the rooms are being renovated soon. The staff however is certainly not up to being considered a "luxury" level. We offered a paper each day and did not receive one until almost the last day, we were short sheeted on our beds each day except the last day, we did talk repeatedly with staff members about this. Our air conditioning did not work the first day when it was ear 100 degrees, which they did fix after our call. I found most of the staff except for some of the concierge staff and bellmen to be rather indifferent about helping you. I heard way more no's than yes's? NOT a good sign at a "luxury" property.we even had issues with our car service to return to the airport with the staff who made the reservation.

 The hotel director did get back to me to speak, and was very conciliatory about our experience and gave us a credit for a day. It was appreciated. Hopefully when the renovation is over, and the general manger talks to and works with his staff things will improve enough for us to return. as it is now, i would NOT go back.

reviews.author: NotaPickyGuy
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: It is a luxury resort and it's easy to see why.  Great staff, great rooms, good food.  Nice pool and of course plenty of sunshine.  Set against Camelback Mountain, it is a peaceful, spiritual place.  If you can afford it, I recommend strongly.

reviews.author: Dan S
reviews.title: Excellent accomodations and service
reviews.text: My wife and I spent 3 days at the Phoencian May 2016 while attending a conference there.  Our large end unit 8th floor room was front facing and very clean and comfortable.  Every staff member we met from the door men, valets, reception, cleaning staff, wait staff, bartenders, pool staff, were extremely friendly and helpful, attending to our needs and requests - in many cases anticipating them (poolside for example).  Upon check-in, we selected the "green" option to not have our sheets and towels changed daily, however, the housekeeping staff continually checked back with us to ensure we had everything we needed.  On our last day, I enjoyed a great day at the golf course, while my wife enjoyed her time lounging by the pool.  The conference facilities were outstanding and the food service and break outs were well staffed.

reviews.author: Jessica C
reviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing hotel
reviews.text:
We stayed here for my husband's conference. The hotel was beautiful and the staff was extremely helpful and friendly. I never relax by the pool while on vacation but did on this trip because the pool area was so inviting. But be prepared to fight for a lounge chair. The fitness center was great for an early morning workout. We would definitely stay here again. 

Tip: we used uber to get around town.

reviews.author: Mauna2011
reviews.title: Nice venue for conference
reviews.text:
The rooms are well appointed, and nice amenities. Room service was prompt, but the first night when called to collect my dishes, no one came. The next night was better, as the room service server was prompt delivering and picking up.

Bell desk staff and front desk staff most pleasant. Housekeeping fulfilled special request over and above what I expected, good service there. Selection of shops varied and interesting.

Of other properties I've stayed in the area, I felt the Phoenician was not as warm and homey as I felt at JW Marriott Camelback Inn or Royal Palm. These properties  were very "southwest" decor and finishes, whereas Phoenician was more polished and luxurious. Personal preference on my part only.

reviews.author: Brian_300606
reviews.title: Could have been so much better
reviews.text:
This property is in an outstanding location and ideally suited for a trip to Scottsdale. We had this booked as the first location in a two centre stay and cannot fault the set-up but there a a few niggles which take the sheen off what should be a perfect hotel. To put this in perspective we have spent time in 5 star resorts around the globe and particularly in the states.
Upon arrival the valet took the car, bell boys took the luggage and all was looking good. We then met Brooke on reception. Clearly this lady has not been to charm school and must have fallen asleep and missed the section of her training for front desk duties. Perhaps she just dislikes the English? Her raison d'etre seemed to be to make us feel uneasy. This is an upmarket establishment and we had booked it for this reason, no need to make a point of outlining every additional extra that she felt we should be paying for. The tipping point was when I asked for the Wi-Fi access code. That is only included in the resort fee she demanded. I pointed out the details on our travel agent issued vouchers clearly showing that that ALL relevant payments had been made in advance. Still a resort fee was demanded. Before getting involved in an argument I asked for the key and stopped by the concierge desk to ask for the general mangers name. Brooke must have heard this as she came running over to announce she had waived the resort fee and gave me the access code details. This could and should have been handled do much better to overseas guests.
Rich our bell boy escorted us to the room and he was excellent!
Everything about this establishment is a class act but you just get the feeling they want to extract every last cent out of your pocket. WE were on holiday, we expect to pay for a good time but please try to make us feel good about the experience, don't just make us feel like we have been mugged.
The terrace restaurant is a lovely location for breakfast but again it was an ordeal to just get seated, perhaps we were just not cool enough for the lady to seat us?
This could and should be getting 5 stars from everyone but they just don't make you feel special. Even when spending $400 in the pro shop I could not get any conversation, just a request for the money and goodbye. Every where else we went there were massive helpings of good American charm and manners, the Phoenicians delivery of this product must have gone missing.
My advice, go to Scottsdale, have a great time (we did) but stay somewhere where they will appreciate you.

reviews.author: brett m
reviews.title: 4 Star Hotel with 1 Star Service
reviews.text:
I traveled here a week ago for a business trip and can honestly say I received the worst customer service of any of the 500+ hotel stays I've had over the past 10 years.  

I called to book about 2 months in advance and requested a specific bed setup as I was planning to share a room with a business partner for a conference.  I was told that they could accommodate the request but it would incur an extra $50/night charge which I agreed to.  

When I arrived to check in, I was told that they could no longer accommodate my request.  I asked about other options and was told by the front desk manager that she could "give me some extra sheets and I could sleep on the floor for the 5 nights".  When I told her that this was not an acceptable solution, she told me that there was nothing else they could do.  When I pressed her further she then told me that they had lots of rooms available and that I could book a second room for another $2,500!  

I did not raise my voice or act rude in any manner to any of the front desk staff yet they treated me like absolute garbage and were rude to me the whole time.  As a Starwood Gold member for the past 8 or so years that stays at 15-20 Starwood properties per year, I have NEVER seen such horrible service anywhere else.

reviews.author: mcpmanbeach
reviews.title: Stayed one night on a golf trip, treated like a princess!
reviews.text: Front desk staff was amazing, especially Daniel Uhlry the front desk manager.  We were upgraded to a suite with a wonderful view of the property and the surrounding valley.   I loved the room amenities and the condition of the property was outstanding.  The entire staff, including valet, was so friendly and polite!

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: A Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Stayed at the Phoenician for a business conference. A truly beautiful resort with Camelback mountain in the background.  The Superior room was large, the bathroom spacious and I had a great view.  The pool was perfect, the staff super friendly and for us Canadians the bars know how to make a proper Caesar with Clamato juice.  Plenty to do on the resort, great golf course and recreational facilities. Shopping Centre a few miles away.  Going back for sure.

reviews.author: Rob B
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Imagine an all star team from the Ritz and Four Seasons.  The level of service was exceptional, from the bellman to the front desk.  Even the security people, daughter lost a pair of swimming goggles, security went looking for them.  I thought ultimately to replace them versus time spent, which they did; very Nordstrom.  Sat in an area that had been reserved for pro athlete, although not clear where it began and ended.  Very politely asked to relocate, expressed my desire to be in sight of children in pool, as last time on vacation someone tried to take 9 y.o. daughter (see review of Tradewinds).  Two important things happened, first a smile from manger regarding safety; if you looked around, and you knew what to look for, it was clear that security was present, Second, I said that we would move and that I understood that Mr. V was an important guest, manager looked at me and said "you are an important guest"; wow.  Next thing I know three staff members are moving chairs to a location specifically where I can see kids; problem solved.  Beds are really comfortable, and rooms are large, grounds and pools are off the charts; the only thing this place needs to be heaven is the Carribean Ocean.  Two negatives: First, only one bartender at pool bar, and this person was serving all of the servers, I just walked away.  Second, room service portions are really small, and pool food is average, except fries which are really good.  Definitely would stay again.  Check your Amex card, there are perks. Also, kid friendly, separate area for kids; small water park and slide.  Night time activities include smores and games.  Ask if there is a big conference when you are going to be there, this place has huge conference facilities, and a conference could make pool a little crowded.

reviews.author: melpedreira
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Maravilhoso, super recomendo. O servico ficou um pouco a desejar, achei que faltou um pouco de profissionalismo e excelencia no atendimento ao cliente; nao tem muitas atracoes extras, atividades ou recreadores; mas em compensacao a localizacao eh otima, a piscina eh uma delicia, da para fazer caminhadas e passeios diversos, alem de jogar golfe, para quem gosta eh claro. A academia tambem eh bem equipada. Tem salao e spa, mas nao utilizei os servicos dos mesmos. Os quartos sao imensos e bem luxuosos! Aprovado!!!

reviews.author: KAQ56
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea at The Phoencian
reviews.text: On a recent family trip to Phoenix/Scottsdale, my niece and I opted to visit The Phoenician Resort  for Afternoon Tea in the Lobby Tea Room.  We were promptly seated upon our arrival and were introduced to the plan for the afternoon by Natalie, our excellent hostess.  The sandwiches were: Smoked Salmon, English Cucumber, Lemon and Thyme Chicken Salad, Egg Salad and Asparagus/Garlic Herb Mousse.  Scones, clotted cream and jams were served next and we were offered additional samples of all items.  A delectable assortment of desserts were served as well which we gratefully took home as we would not have done them justice. Music was played on the piano to set a reflective tone for our visit.  A lovely treat, great hospitality and wonderful tastes.  If you are a fan of Afternoon Tea treats, this is a cannot be missed location!

reviews.author: carolyndc452
reviews.title: Absolutely perfect resort for spring getaway with kids
reviews.text: I can't say enough wonderful things about this resort. We had never been to Arizona, and chose it because of the weather and lack of mosquitoes, and we were in desperate need of sunshine after a New England winter. We're Starwood members, and stayed for 5 nights using just 80,000 points, which seems like the deal of the century. Our only hopes were sunshine and pool time with our young kids (2 and 4), and boy did the Phoenician blow us away. The property is just gorgeous and we immediately felt transported to another world. The desert landscape is just stunning and we felt like we were on the grounds of a palace. The lobby was open, airy, luxurious, with incredible views. Our room was very nice and quiet, with a large balcony and a great view overlooking the green space and pools. I can't say enough good things about the housekeeping staff. We were very... needy... when it came to requesting sheets and towels in the middle of the night, and they were always delivered promptly. Our room was always impeccably clean. So many thanks to them. The concierge staff was incredibly helpful and made two perfect recommendations: a stagecoach ride at MacDonald's Ranch and dinner at Rustler's Rooste, two highlights of the trip, so thank you to them as well. The kids loved the playground and sandbox over near the tennis courts, and it turned out to be a lifesaver on early mornings before it warmed up enough for the pool. We were excited to use the splash pad, but unfortunately the weather was just too chilly, but it certainly looked like a blast! We had a very different pool experience from the negative reviewers here, in fact ours couldn't have been more perfect. We spent five days at the resort, and perhaps it was the off season, but we were oftentimes the only ones in the pool, and never had a problem getting chairs, no matter what time we went. We spent all our time at the upper three pools, the far right of which seemed to be heated, which was so welcome considering the overcast weather and the young kids. What a gorgeous setting, truly paradise. The kids had the time of their lives, and we were beyond thrilled. our expectations all exceeded. We have stayed at some incredible Starwood resorts-- the St. Regis in New York and Bal Harbour, Rome and Florence, Luxury Collections in Vienna and Salzburg and Paris. And the Phoenician--and Scottsdale overall--was one of our all-time favorites. I can't imagine a better family spring getaway. We hate to repeat vacation destinations but can't wait to come back to the Phoenician, hopefully next summer.

reviews.author: Shelley E
reviews.title: Super Nice Koi Pond
reviews.text: The pools were a little crowded so I would suggest a cabana if you are planning on spending all day at the pool.  We spent one day at the pool and it was not as relaxing as it could have been only because it was busy.  I thought the service was good.  The room we got was dated but we were last minute and they were at full capacity.  Pricey in my opinion, however having a private patio with a fire pit was nice!

reviews.author: jbug1959
reviews.title: Started off poorly, ended on a great note!
reviews.text:
This trip started off poorly, as the room we reserved was listed as follows: Room Description
Superior Casita Room Non Smok: King Bed
•	530 sq ft/49 sq m
•	Desert View
•	Balcony Or Patio
•	Separate Luxury Shower/bath
•	Marble Bathroom
•	Smoke-free

Unfortunately, the room, on the second floor, was located across from the Golf restaurant, there was no place to park (people parked to go to the restaurant), no elevator to get up the stone stairs to the second floor, and no view of the dessert.  At a rate of over $600 a night, it was very disappointing. (We were staying for 5 nights-Room 7254 section J).  The hotel was full (spring break), and they had no other rooms available of that level.  They put us in another room in the main building, with a view of the front of the hotel, and the balcony overlooked the valet parking. (Room 4154)  Still not what we had reserved (and confirmed the week before).  After two nights, Samantha Boone, the Front Desk Manager, moved us into one of the villas at the front of the property.  It was amazing! Villa # 7704. Two bedrooms, two baths, full kitchen, two balconies and a golf cart to get you to the main hotel.  They were very accommodating and we felt as though we ended on such a positive note, that we had to mention how great many aspects of the hotel really are.  The view from the main hotel is amazing, and there is a great natural garden behind the main hotel rooms. They are doing some renovations over the next 2 years starting with the Casita section.  Be sure to ask about that.

reviews.author: threeunderthree
reviews.title: Poor Pool-Side Service
reviews.text: It comes down to the treatment of your guests by your pool staff.  I was appalled at the treatment we received, and better yet, how all of your customers were treated on a crowded pool day.  The double standard for saving chairs, the length of time it took your management staff to barely resolve our problem (if you can even call it solved), the treatment of a large corporate group (MetLife, which I presume is a nice piece of business to keep).  I am sorry, but your staff need severe re-training.  If you possibly condone the way they deal with a crowded pool, then I will most certainly never stay at a Starwood Resort, anywhere, again.  I watched your staff remove bags of customers who had been out of their seats for no more than 30 minutes, even when friends of those people sitting right next to the chairs said they were watching them and would return.  The best part (or worst part for your reputation) is your pool crew gave away the seats BUT! they would then move the chairs enough to create confusion when the people came back to look for their stuff. This was done by Brittany and other staff as well as your manager, who I personally watched do this, named Jeff.  I watched customer after customer get pissed, yell at other customers, and have a less than stellar day.  Hey it's your brand, we're just living with it.

reviews.author: Jan M
reviews.title: Great for a conference or leisure travel
reviews.text: We were there for a business conference. The conference facilities were very nice. Staff is great. Pool areas are nice with a good selection of lounging options. Setting is beautiful. Golf course is challenging yet very playable. Food options were very good. Our room was in the back overlooking Camelback Mountain. Really looking into the side of the mountain but the birds, cactus, plants were pretty.

reviews.author: Sptaz33
reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: If you're coming to Scottsdale/Phoenix area to sleep in a hotel - go somewhere else. The grounds are beautiful no doubt, but unless you're staying for the golf, it's not worth the $400/night. Nothing is included. The food is delicious but expensive. The rooms are pretty much the standard that you'd get at a Hilton or a Marriott for half the rate. The only difference is the size of the bathroom. It is a huge hotel, especially the conference room areas. The bell hoppers & concierge were super friendly and helpful - I can't say the same for the folks at the check in desk.

reviews.author: MITO 23
reviews.title: Non mi è piaciuto
reviews.text: Sono stato più volte a Scottsdale ed una sola volta ho soggiornato in questo hotel.A me non è piaciuto e sono andato via dall'hotel prima del previsto per andare in quello dove abitualmente vado. il The Phoenician gode di molta fama ed è per questo che una volta lo ho voluto provare ma a mio avviso manca l'atmosfera magica del luogo.E' un grande albergo di lusso ma completamente senza la magia di scottsdale e dell'Arizona.E' un hotel che potrebbe trovarsi ovunque.Anche l'architettura sia dell'hotel che delle camere e l'arredamento interno sono da grande albergo ma senza anima

reviews.author: James O
reviews.title: Top Notch Golf
reviews.text: We were staying at a nearby property and ventured over here to golf.  Everyone from the arrival until the departure was incredibly friendly and helpful.  The golf course is short but beautiful and uniquely challenging.  I would highly recommend it for couples and seniors for the short distances and georgeous views enjoyed by my wife, which helps when I try to golf everyday on vacation and she quickly tires of it.  She took many quick photos and has been sharing them with everyone.  Golf was very reasonable and the pro shop had many great deals that we couldn't pass up.  Be sure to enjoy a drink outside after, incredible scenary.

reviews.author: Guido C
reviews.title: Baden im wunderschönen Arizona
reviews.text:
Seit Jahren sind wir Stammgast in
diesem wunderbaren Resort mit
einer schönen Pool- Anlage.
Die Zimmer sind sehr geräumig.
Die Halle sehr schön. Die Aussicht
traumhaft.
Mann sieht schon, dass der Zahn der
Zeit überall nagt. Es gäbe schon einiges
zu tun. Trotzdem wir kommen wieder!
Familie C.

reviews.author: Bkraiter
reviews.title: Mini Vacation
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a beautiful resort sitting right on Camelback Mountain in Scottsdale. The pools were very nice, the rooms were adequate, the restaurants were all very good but the best thing about the trip was our treatment by the staff. The staff was next to perfect in their friendliness and service. They even have a gentleman with a hawk on his arm monitoring the outdoor seating for the restaurant to keep the birds at bay. Thanks to the Phoenician staff for the wonderful stay. The pictures are from the balcony on our room.

reviews.author: Will J
reviews.title: Business and Pleasure
reviews.text: I recently attended a business conference at The Phoenician and this was my first time. Despite recommendations from others I've passed up opportunities to enjoy this great resort. Excellent service started early after my arrival and continued throughout my stay. I was greeted warmly and given directions to my casita which was set beautifully and privately on the lavishly landscaped grounds (and allowed for free self parking close by). Despite this resort having a long history I thought the casita and business conference rooms and amenities were very up to date and sharp. The pool area is great and you have views of not only the grounds but the mountain its set just below. The grounds have many niche spots to sit and relax in shade and comfort. Given this was a business trip, my meals were part of group catered meals and they were excellent and I witnessed continued good service. While I was hanging around the business clientele - I witnessed many families with children enjoying the resort. April is a beautiful time to enjoy the Valley with moderate temperatures and desert bloom but The Phoenician is a great place to enjoy year round. I'll be back with my family.

reviews.author: Imperial_Eli
reviews.title: Great views - Improved the longer we stayed
reviews.text:
In the defense of the Phoenician, we were there over Easter and they were at max capacity. Our first night was frustrating as we arrived really late and they did not have the extra bed in our room yet. In the AM I did not have the paper I requested because they ran out. Yet I was able to get one myself from the bellman desk where there was a giant stack. My wife was given a tip from another guest that you need to put some erosional items on the charts you want at the pool by 6:00 am or no seats for you. They will not open up again until around 4pm when everyone goes in to get ready for dinner. 
I will say the level of service improved every day. The service at the pool was good. The resutraunts on property were all good overall. The food at the pool is ok. The Easter activities that were offered were great. Go for a hike on camel back mountain behind the property it is worth it. The view is amazing. Overall it was an enjoyable part of our trip. Beds are comfortable. Property does need some repairs but nothing major.

reviews.author: Bigb0007
reviews.title: Not what it looks like
reviews.text: This place is old very old. The entrance of this hotel looks OK but when you enter your room you go way back to 1989. This hotel has so much old furniture me and my wife felt old. We found some bugs in the washroom and the toilet was around 15 years old. Service is very lousy they treat you like your a shopper from Walmart.

reviews.author: TheVagabondChef
reviews.title: Great place to cool off in the summer heat.
reviews.text: This is a local fav to cool off and take a break in the full heat of summer. We go a couple of times a year. Nothing like lounging around the pool with cocktails while the rest of the valley overheats. Lots of summer local specials, even ones for the kiddos. Love the food and service is above and beyond.

reviews.author: SusieNYC03
reviews.title: The Perfect Stay
reviews.text: It had been about 27 years since I have been to this property.  I loved it the first time and was wondering if it would live up to the great memories so many years later.  Well, it did not disappoint.  Yes, there are parts that may look a little dated but the property is immaculately maintained.  The service was excellent.  A special 'shout out' to Myron at Il Terrazzo and the whole team--no request was ever too much and everyone always had a smile on their face. I will not let 27 years pass before my next visit.  Well done.

reviews.author: Richard T
reviews.title: Beautiful surroundings for a business conference
reviews.text:
I was here for 4 days on a firm's global conference and the facilities for the conference itself were perfect.
In terms of my overall experience whilst staying in the hotel, this property is an oasis of calm. The hotel grounds are beautiful.  The rooms are very clean and comfortable, if perhaps a little stuck in the 90s with their décor, but I didn't feel it was too "dated" and notwithstanding this initial impression everything was in very good condition and nothing in my room was looking tatty or tired.  The communal areas of the hotel are very well appointed and the whole property feels and looks like a luxury hotel should.

Every member of staff I encountered during my stay was polite, happy to chat and I got the sense nothing was too much trouble.

reviews.author: Dingle22
reviews.title: Relaxing weekend
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed a long weekend with great weather.  Service was very friendly and resort was clean.  We did have a snafu with reservations and our room however.  We were told a Saturday night stay could not be combined with a previously booked Sunday night stay due to hotel occupancy and a room change was required.  We accepted that and then found the resort basically empty Sunday and Monday.  Not certain why our Saturday room with no view over the car port was needed Sunday but we ended up in a nicer room after all the chaos.  Enjoyed the property.  Lunch at Relish on the deck was a nice break from the pool scene.  Many activities for kids.  I would recommend however they develop an adults only pool area for those who want to get away from the kiddos.  Hiking Camelback from hotel was a great experience, not to be missed.

reviews.author: SunFunSeekerDC
reviews.title: Great Massage with Gavin
reviews.text: I agree with some earlier reviews that parts of the resort feel dated and am happy to hear about the impending refresh. On the other hand, I thought the staff was attentive and generally had a nice attitude. And I very much enjoyed the outdoor spaces on the grounds. I had a great massage with Gavin and would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Timothy P
reviews.title: Great location, great service
reviews.text: The Canyon Suites at the Phoenician are amazing -- we loved being part of the larger resort, but also a bit separated.  The staff provided incredible service.  Beautiful rooms, scenery, pools.  Good spa and workout facility.

reviews.author: joseluisvaleratriat
reviews.title: The "Room"
reviews.text: I went to the Phoenician over a long weekend for internal business meetings of my firm.  My firm must have reserved over 400 rooms. And this is when you find out the little secrets: they have rooms that face a wall so close that you barely get sunlight. I had to turn the lamps on in the middle of the day to see anything. That a "luxury resort" even has rooms like this is appalling. They absolutely don't deserve this designation. The folks at "Luxury Collection" must need the money to let the Phoenician cheapen their brand like this. And to top it all they are unapologetic and arrogant as all get out. My advise to anyone is that if you can't get a guarantee that your room will have a view, don't chance it. Don't go. Don't risk wasting your good money and getting disappointed from the moment you set foot in your room. They will pray on the unsuspecting.  There are many other alternatives. You've been warned.

reviews.author: Harvey K
reviews.title: Good but disappointing
reviews.text: We recently took from a four day vacation in Scottsdale Arizona. We were looking for a luxury hotel since this was a quick getaway. Unfortunately, the Phoenician did not meet this requirement. From the slow check in to the mediocre and outdated room assigned to us, we were underwhelmed by the hotel.  Likewise, the property is extremely pedestrian. I must admit the service and attention  lavished upon us by the staff was admirable, but the serious need for a hotel makeover was always evident.  Next time in Scottsdale, we will probably stay at the Princess

reviews.author: 007steelhorse
reviews.title: The Phoenician in Scottsdale - Amazing Hotel!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful, expansive grounds, well maintained.  Hotel rooms are spacious and well appointed.  Pool is large, with additional areas for adults only.  Service is great - fresh towels brought to you, drinks and food a plenty.  Great restaurants with beautiful views and delicious food.  Would definitely stay here again any time!

reviews.author: amadeusny
reviews.title: Overrated, poorly maintained, understaffed resort. Should have gone to the four seasons.
reviews.text:
Although we arrived after 4, our room was not ready. We noted several other guests frustrated for the sane reason. The lobby was loud and noisy.  More like grand central station than a luxury resort.
Once in our rooms we headed to work out in the gym.. There was no attendant, so we were not able to tell anyone about how warm the room was.
We had massages booked, so went to lockers after workout. As the spa was a "feature" of this facility we were shocked to find the cleanliness below par,  the hot water never got hot. The men's steam room was not functional and the men's locker room was fill of overflowing trash and littered with dirty towels.
The massages were very good.
we heading for a glass of wine trying to determine where on property to have dinner.  Wine was slow in coming. The menus of the other restaurants never arrived. We opted to dine at the Italian restaurant.  Food was "ok". Portions, were very small.
We selected Phoenician because it touted yoga classes. We showed up early the next morning for yoga . It was a disorganized class with no apparent teacher. A substitute alleged , last minute teacher came late. She chewed gum continual. Based on the way she instructed and conducted herself, she certainly was not an accredited yoga teacher. We left before the class was over. 
Our complaints were not taken as meritorius. Regrettably, Based on our spa & yoga experience we chose not to use the facility for the rest of our stay. 
There was no quiet pool area in which to relax. We left and went to our room for quiet relaxing time.
There clearly was not enough staff. What there was had very poor trainied.  I requested to speak to a manager at one point, a young girl cam out of the bac.  Clearly she was faking it, we registered our complaint. It was never escalated, it stopped there, basically ignored.
We had breakfast on the terrace every morning. As we did not trust the service we choose the buffet. Food was good, nothing was hot. On the first day we told our waitress we did not get the juice we requested. She responded by yelling at us we should have ordered it with her, not the hostess or asked if we wanted juice. 
After our first night we discovered our sheets were stains. That is inexcusable in an alleged fine resort.
This is an ok hotel, with nice rooms. However it takes more than that to make a fine resort. Our overall experience was not that of a fine resort.

reviews.author: Kristi B
reviews.title: Excellent Spa, Pool Service and Terrace Bar!
reviews.text:
We just spend the day here after visiting the spa, so can't speak for the hotel rooms. 
Seriously the best massage of my life- Glen (I think that was his name!) was phenomenal. The spa itself could use a little updating, but the actual service was top notch and the waiting area was very peaceful. Extra points because they let you use the pool if you get a treatment, so we spent the day there which was great. The lounge for cocktails upstairs is also wonderful. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sue C
reviews.title: Every year for 5-7 weeks
reviews.text: 7th year going to the Phonecian with my mom who will be 90 in July and has Alzheimer's disease. James, who has always been in the lobby to greet people was not there. Found out they had moved him to the security booth all night. Horrible news!! Who doesn't want to feel welcomed? Then was told we couldn't make reservations for breakfast. I refused to do that because my mom can't stand and wait. Went at 10:00 every morning. Thank God for Christine and Alax!! Some mornings I had to set the table and get the coffee, juice and pray someone would wait on us. Arlis, the GM of Il Terazzo is a pompas jerk. Would not speak to us and many servers quit while we were there. Others are looking for other jobs. He screamed at them in front of customers and said some awful things that I didn't need to hear! Pool was jammed with drunk convention people or spring break people. They said they were doing wristbands for weekends. Ha! 90 percent of the people were not wearing bands and nothing was done. Prostitutes everywhere. No one there cares about the elderly which is really sad to me!! I tried calling the GM of hotel, got his assistant who assured me he would call me. That never happened either! So sad to see such a great place that my mom remembers and loves become a convention resort with no help for people with diseases!

reviews.author: nab_nyc
reviews.title: Definitely not "Luxury Collection"; Tired and Worn Property with Mediocre Service at Best
reviews.text: Just came back from a 7 night stay with my husband and 2 small children, ages 6 and 3. We were there during a peak time period and that was reflected in the service levels at the hotel. It was overrun with families and people in general and clearly the staff wasn't trained to deal with the hotel being at capacity.  I saw disgusting things happen at the pool (e.g. someone brought their dog INTO the Jacuzzi and the staff was too harried to notice, someone cleaned their shoes in the pool).  Pros: large property, centrally located in Scottsdale, good tennis facilities and pros, nice playground for kids (although far), lots of pools but in our case they were overrun with people and I didn't see any adults only pools. On the food front, Relish and J&G were ok. They had some nice kids activities while we were there. Cons: the whole property is very dated and worn, the furniture and fixtures in our room were really dated and not maintained well (but the room was spacious), the Italian restaurant is pretty bad, concierge desk not really helpful, the café on site is totally overpriced and has a very limited selection, and the kids club does not allow you to drop in with your kids and play with them there. The boutique had terrible, cheap merchandise. Overall, it was an ok experience but I don't know that I'd go back - - most definitely not in a peak period - - and in general, I'd probably choose a newer property with higher service levels.

reviews.author: Sandy R
reviews.title: Full service top notch hotel
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay at The Phoenician Scottsdale. The service was attentive and tried to provide their best. The room was large and comfortable although furnishings somewhat plain. Nice large bathroom and pleasant porch overlooking the pool area. Golf,tennis, spa all beautiful. Three pools on different levels that were very busy as it was Easter Weekend. Took a yoga walk through property which includes beautiful cactus garden, good golf lesson, and tennis with a pro. Lots to do at the resort and a variety of dining options.  Nice deck for afternoon cocktails & sunset and great steak house for dinner. Great for families too!

reviews.author: KLwrites
reviews.title: A+ for setting!
reviews.text: We took our daughter to Arizona for spring break because she didn't want a traditional beach vacation. The Phoenician was a perfect compromise: a lush oasis surrounded by desert. Beautiful grounds and views all around. We enjoyed the fact that we could walk around the corner and hike up Camelback mountain, or drive an hour out of town for an ATV tour in the Sonoran Desert, and then kick back at the Phoenician's pretty pools later in the afternoon. Pool service was wonderful by the way! We enjoyed eating and shopping in Old Scottsdale, but we did eat on-property a couple times. Once at Il Terrazzo for breakfast and once at Relish Burger Bistro for appetizers. Both were good experiences. We spent three nights here and then headed to Sedona to round out our trip.

reviews.author: Scott M
reviews.title: 5 Star Resort
reviews.text: Great resort property with easy access to restaurants and entertainment in downtown Scottsdale.  Large bathrooms with large scale rooms that are nicely appointed.  Awesome bar tenders and nice patio views.  Car service on site with inexpensive rides to Scottsdale and the airport.  Pool area is very nice with several options---kids pools and adults only pools.

reviews.author: Rick F
reviews.title: Sun and relaxation
reviews.text: Great experience.  Our 3rd stay at this property.  Wonderful.  Great staff.  Excellent location in a very safe area in Scottsdale.  Rooms were quiet, clean and well appointed.  Food and beverage very good.  Only had one breakfast buffet as we felt that was over priced at $29.

reviews.author: paul
reviews.title: Time for a revamp
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights as part of my company's retreat. This is my fourth time staying on this property in the last 8 years. A sprawling property with lots of rooms. However, it is getting very dated and in my opinion should not feature as part of SPG's Luxury Collection. Service standards and attitude of hotel staff is very good, food is average.

reviews.author: Vegas
reviews.title: Really needs updating
reviews.text: Worn, old and dated furniture, dirty worn carpets, bird pooped deck furniture and oh did I mention it's like a throw back to 1982?  My employer picks this place every year but rumbles hint to that changing. No one was impressed with the rooms, the restaurants or spa. The service is great and the lobby area and main hotel hallways and meeting rooms look great. But it stops there. Old armoire which had an old box 25" TV still in use with newer tv that could not be seen unless laying in bed, and old bar and fridge are just plain worn and sad. Consider elsewhere. Pools are very nice but doesn't overlook old rooms Casitas and overall lackluster place.

reviews.author: Miguel d
reviews.title: Très décevant
reviews.text:
Une grande usine impersonnelle qui pratique des tarifs injustifiés pour un service médiocre et des chambres qui nécessitent des travaux de remise à niveau. 
La piscine est très petite par rapport au nombre de chambre et les clients sont les uns sur les autres comme sur les pires plages espagnoles.
La qualité des serviettes de bain est médiocre(usées et riches), les produits d'hygiène sont de mauvaises qualité et tout cela pour plus de 500$ la nuit et en plus on vous payer pour le wifi et pour le parking, en français cela s'appelle tout simplement du vol.
Un conseil: éviter à tout prix cet hotel.

reviews.author: Jim V
reviews.title: Top shelf everything!
reviews.text:
Escaped the frigid weather in Toronto for this marvellous 4 day stay at The Phoenician. Absolutely stunning grounds/landscaping, professional and attentive staff in all respects, the rooms were spotless and managed very well.  

My wife and I were at the Westin Kierland the previous 5 days and in comparison, not comparable.  Don't misunderstand, The Westin Kierland is also a stunning resort but I wouldn't compare the two as I feel they are not in the same category.

Book the Phoenician and expect top shelf everything!!!

reviews.author: JLight75
reviews.title: Dissapointment
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I were really looking forward to our trip to AZ.  Our son is 16 months old and this was going to be a romantic getaway for us. We booked a room at the hotel that was listed with a desert view. The room was approx. $600 per night.  Imagine our disappointment when we open the curtains to the room and saw a rooftop.  No desert, no mountain view, no native plants. Just a vent on an ugly concrete room.  When we questioned why it was listed a desert view, there was really no good answer given other than "yes, i understand that is deceiving".  The hotel was unable to move us.  The sent some fruit as an apology.  We may have have been able to swallow this if the rest of the experience there was stellar, but it was far from it.  That night we wanted room service, but there was no menu available in the room. They said they'd send one up.  An hour and 15 minutes later, & 3 phone calls later we finally received a menu so we could order.  The hotel was completely jam packed with kids.  Noisy, screaming kids. No adult pool to get away from it.  Apparently to obtain a chair by the pool we needed to get up at 5AM.  By 9AM every chair had a towel on it - no people, just a towel.  Apparently there is no time limit so you can plop a towel down and reserve the chair all day even if you don't actually get to the pool until hours later.   That was the last straw for us.  We packed up our stuff, checked out this resort and into the Four Seasons.  The room was the same price and yet these two resorts are in different solar systems comparatively.   I'm including a photo of the view from our rooms of each of the resorts.  The Four Seasons was outstanding.  Exceeded our expectations in every way.    If you're looking for a romantic getaway, the Phoenician is not the place for it.

reviews.author: AddisonConcierge
reviews.title: Great Service from Front Desk, Bell/Valet
reviews.text:
I came for a Concierge Dinner at J&G Steakhouse (that review is separate). I wanted to take some time to give kudos to a few staff members outside of the restaurant...

Kevin was my Valet on my way in and out of The Resort. He was very polite, courteous, and patient while I was gathering my things from my car. 

Dimitri was kind enough to make small talk with me while I waited for Kevin to bring my car around at the end of the night. He was kind, polite, and nice to chat with.

Michael at the Front Desk was a pleasure to speak with as well. He was able to answer all of my questions about the property. 

I would be pleased to see these three young men still with The Phoenician on my next visit.

reviews.author: seaweed241
reviews.title: Tranquil and beautiful resort!
reviews.text:
This resort provided everything we could have asked for in Scottsdale! 

The resort is conveniently in Scottsdale for those on business travel or hoping to do some shopping in the area. A short drive takes you anywhere in town. I also loved having direct access to Camelback Mountain.

Wonderful amenities, restaurants, and poolside service. Can't complain about any of the food or beverage I encountered on my trip.

The rooms are clean, comfortable, and we had a great view of the desert in the mornings.

reviews.author: Amanda C
reviews.title: Recom. Near Resort....
reviews.text:
This is a huge resort, it's lots of fun exploring the whole place, be sure to ask the hotel concierge for recommendations we found out about a burger place on the resort and they drove us there in a golf cart and picked us up when we were ready, it was really good. There are some great places to eat nearby of course I recommend cowboy ciao (see my cowboy cioa review). If you want something super casual and quick THE STAND has amazing tacos and burgers. For breakfast or great pizza go to le grande orange (LGO). If you like awesome local coffee places go to Cartel Coffee Lab. 
Hope this review helps, I always think finding a place to stay is the easy part and figuring out where to eat is the tough part. My best friend is a local in Scottsdale so it was so great to have someone share these great places. If you have kids or like zoos The Phoenix Zoo is great. You can also hike the Papago Park, find Hunt's tomb (a pyramid at the top of the hill) and you may be lucky enough to see the giraffes from the zoo at that spot.

reviews.author: jarmwr40
reviews.title: "the thirsty camel" for drinks!
