I ordered "steel-cut oatmeal" and was given a bowl of lukewarm oatmeal soup that looked like a serving of instant oatmeal with way too much water added.  And I asked several times for jam to go with my bagel, but didn't get this.  The servers just stared impassively at me with no explanation or apology.  They did give me a cookie later on the house.  The items were all VERY pricey.  But basically, they were not able to deliver the same level of service or quality that I get at the Starbuck's kiosk at our local grocery store.

reviews.author: Hasna229
reviews.title: Beauty and adventure
reviews.text: Love hiking? Love spa resorts? This is the place! In the footstep of Camelback mountain, the Phoenician resort is the perfect destination for an early hike where you can see most of Phoenix and Scottsdale, after your hike get a relaxing massage and meditation class at the center for wellbeing spa, then enjoy the many pools and lunch outdoor at the beautiful natural scenery.. if golf is your thing then you have arrived at the 27 hole heaven. You can spend a special day full of adventure and relaxation. It was my favorite full resort experience!

reviews.author: Patty E
reviews.title: Luzury at its finest!
reviews.text: We attended a wedding here and it is luxury at its finest. The grounds are beautiful the activities are abundant.  The food was delicious with  so many options available! This was a vacation in itself at this magnificent location. So relaxing!

reviews.author: Ken B
reviews.title: The Phoenician suites, a nice getaway
reviews.text: Stayed over Thanksgiving, lots of kids and families.  Property is very well maintained but looking a tad outdated.  Service is knockout tho. Not a lot of dinning options if you stay in the Suites building, but you can walk over to the larger Phoenician.  We had a discounted room at 419.00 night. I had trouble warming up to it, but do try and get a room with a mountain view.  I guess for an adult getaway too many little people for me.

reviews.author: Laurie W
reviews.title: Loved the spa
reviews.text:
Visited the spa for a lovely day of treatment and relaxation.  The staff were friendly and knowledge.  I enjoyed a steam, sauna and hot tub before my treatment.  The jacuzzi had the best jets ever.  Lots of magazines and reading material.  Erin was my Aesthetician and my facial was wonderful.  She applied organic products using skillful methods.  Obviously, Erin takes pride in her work.  She explained her products and made recommendations for my skin type.  Her touch was very nice.  She gave a nice face, hards and arm massage and paid extra attention to my temples.  Ahhhhhh.  The facial was performed gracefully.  No hesitation between products and it was obvious that Erin was focused on giving me her full attention.
The noon meditation class was delightful.  One full hour of guided meditation in a beautiful serene area.  
The experience was more than I could have asked for.  I left feeling clean, relaxed and more thoughtful of the time I want to take care of me.  Excellent reminder of the importance to slow down and enjoy the moment.
 I purchased the organic products used on my face and was shocked at how reasonable priced the items were.

reviews.author: KO2020
reviews.title: Top notch, beautiful back drop for a long weekend
reviews.text: My husband and I, along with my in-laws, stayed here for a long weekend - WOW is all I have to say. We were celebrating two birthdays and an anniversary and everywhere we went on property, we were called by our names and congratulated on our celebrations. The property sits at the base of Camelback Mountain which offers a beautiful back drop as you sit as the pool. The rooms are huge and so is the bathroom. My only comment would be that the decor is dated but it still presented as extreme luxury.

reviews.author: Joy H
reviews.title: Nice place but the pigeons have to go
reviews.text:
Hubby and I stayed in a casita.  This was nice because we had a car and we could go right out to the parking lot.  It was easy access to the room.  We had a nice view of the lagoon which had koi, ducks and geese that we could watch.  Very relaxing.  The pool area is also very nice and large.  Nice view of Camelback Mountain. 

The only bad part is that our balcony had a wire mesh screen up in the corner that two pigeons came and roosted on every night.  They would leave first thing in the morning.  The problem is that they pooped all over the corner and down the walls to the floor.  I did not want to go out and enjoy my coffee on the balcony in the morning.  It was so GROSS.   Sometime during the day while we were out, someone came and hosed out the corner, but you can never get it 100% clean and the corner would be black and disgusting.  

The rooms are a little dated but well appointed.  No ice vending machines, so we had to call for room service every time we wanted ice which was a pain, plus you have to tip whoever brings it.  I would prefer to have ice available.

reviews.author: Lois S
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: The room is large and the water pressure is fabulous!...Bed is super comfortable and so are the pillows...the views off the patio were enjoyable. Just a beautiful environment all the way around; pools were fabulous and service by the pool and otherwise was great. The food at the restaurants were very good.

reviews.author: Brett R
reviews.title: hotel is dated and they're totally inflexible
reviews.text: the hotel charged me for an extra night in the room even though i canceled more than 48 hrs in advance. This hotel is very dated -- looks like it was redone 20 yrs ago. no worth the money or the hassle

reviews.author: jerry m
reviews.title: amazing time
reviews.text: The resort is top notch, with an AMAZING staff.  Upon our arrival we were greeted in a warm and efficient manner.  But than things just got better and better all the way to OUTSTANDING.  I could go on and on about the most friendly staff imaginable, from housekeeping to the room service waiter.   But the BEST person was the concierge Michele Caldwell.  She was so helpful in making our overall experience the best it could be.   The Phoenician far exceeded our expectations by a mile.  My family travels about 4 times a year on vacation and this has been in the Top 2 destinations.  The only one negative was the Wi-Fi was not working ,but there was so much to do it didn't matter. Pools are Great.  Nicklaus at the pool was so attentive, you knew that he loved his job, also he was helpful in recommending restaurants near-by.  We will be back.

reviews.author: 1trueVolfan
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: The outdoor areas and picturesque setting of this resort are hard to beat. The lobby is very nice but nothing spectacular. The restaurants are superb, but very pricey... Expected I suppose. I was there for a busy conference, so I didn't really get a chance to enjoy the many amenities. I would plan a couple of extra days for golf and lounging around the pool next time.

reviews.author: Greeny169
reviews.title: Great family vacation, loved the tennis, golf and nice staff
reviews.text:
We had a four day stay with grandparents, parents, and kids ages 7 to 14 to celebrate Thanksgiving. It was a good trip for all.  Our kids did a lot of tennis which was great.
I do think the rooms can use an update, but they were perfectly fine and Wifi was spotty, but common areas were nice and the pool was great.

reviews.author: Luciadunn
reviews.title: Family gathering
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a beautiful resort with views of Camelback Mountain and activities for everyone in the family.  There is a fun club for little ones and the pools for everyone.  Golf  and hiking and a cactus garden to walk in add to the mix of things to do.  We enjoyed the restaurants and the shops have lovely things for sale.  The room we had had a king sized bed which had a great comforter and pillows. The bathroom had both a show space and a bathtub plus top of the line products for travelers.  The staff was friendly and helpful and they even had a full English tea in the afternoon.  What a wonderful place for family groups to meet up and spend time with each other!

reviews.author: Alex8816
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Rooms are tired, service Is terrible. Everyone has attitudes. I was at the biltmore 2 weeks ago and would highly recommend that for half the price. Staff are undertrained. Breakfast is nice. Pool is nice. Definitely will not stay here again and don't recommend it.

reviews.author: GeordieLass76
reviews.title: 5-Star pristine excellence!
reviews.text:
Unfortunately this was a short, 2 night stay as part of a tour of the south-west.  Everything about the resort is perfect - the resort itself has everything you could possibly need and is beautifully presented, clean and tidy.

It's a large property (818 rooms) so the reception area is always busy but the staff were very quick and efficient checking 9 of us in.

My room was large, light and airy overlooking the gardens with the main pool area off to the right.  Double doors led into a big, bright bathroom with separate shower / tub and the toilet was in a little room off the side.  Loads of lovely fluffy towels of every size!  Double vanity with hairdryer, lighted make up mirror and lots of lovely in-house toiletries.

We had a wonderful first evening dinner hosted by the Leisure Accounts Director in a small private dining area at Relish Burger Bar - the tzatziki chicken burger was divine, along with a few margaritas!!  Service was again, fast and extremely polite.

A great way to end a very busy week, with drinks on the terrace watching the sunset.  Just wish we had been able to stay a little longer!

reviews.author: JKJK6
reviews.title: great 5 star experience
reviews.text:
I just spent 6 days at the Phoenician on a business trip.  The resort is beautiful!  Every area is clean and perfectly manicured.  The housekeeping staff comes into your room at least twice a day to clean and at night does a turn down service.
The staff is amazing and I mean every single person from the front desk, to the pool employees, housekeepers, and even lawn maintenance.  I was asked 100 times if I needed anything.  I have never stayed anywhere that the service was so wonderful!
We had a dinner outside one evening and the Phoenician did a superb job in feeding 700 people and hosting entertainment.  Our business meetings also went very smoothly and the food for the meetings was excellent. I highly recommend this hotel for business meetings and I hope to visit again but next  time on a pleasure trip.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Great Conference and Family Resort
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful.  We attended a conference here and our family were able to hang out at the pool and on the property (two small children) and be completely occupied while we were in meetings.  
The service provided by Alex and Arliss at the breakfast restaurant on the ground level was A+.  
There was a great nightlfe vibe in this hotel as well. The lounge on the 3rd floor and the upstairs steakhouse were great.
My only complaint, is that the hotel Shuttle Service (Infinity SUV) came across as dishonest at times.  The drivers were super nice and friendly but were not consistent in how much it cost to drive us to Old Scottsdale.  Jeff originally quoted $30 to take us to Old Scottsdale, cash only. My group discussed (in front of Jeff) that we only had $20 cash so we would cab.  We asked if we could use our Visas and he said no.  Then, he said he would take $20.  So we agreed.  He told us to call him when we were ready to leave.  We called for a pick up back to the hotel and Jeff had left for the night (only 2 hours later) but someone else came to get us.  He said the price was $15 to Old Scottsdale and $15 back, doesn't matter the time of day.  I asked why Jeff originally quoted us $30 then took $20, and he said he didn't know.
The next day, we went back to Old Scottsdale and it was $15 both ways, and we used the service for a ride to the airport for a quoted price of $57 but was charged $60...and each time they DID take Visa.  So, my recommendation is that they tighten up on the amounts they charge and how they accept payment. Perhaps have a sign outside that lists the prices so it isn't up to the drivers to disclose?  It just confused us all and made us uneasy.  It very well could have just been miscommunication but that shouldn't happen at a nice resort like this.

reviews.author: Scott M
reviews.title: Phoenician vacation
reviews.text: This is a high end resort with a high level of service in all areas.  I play tennis and was hoping for a busy program.  I was disappointed as there are not many players at my level which is 4.5.  I was also disappointed with the restaurants.  The food is very pricey and not as good as the local restaurants.  The concierge service is excellent.  The front desk is very pleasant but should be more helpful.  If you have issues that need to be addressed, they refer you to a telephone to call the appropriate department.  The wifi was also a big disappointment.  It was difficult to connect and the speed was slow

reviews.author: Jim B
reviews.title: Awesome Service
reviews.text: I spent two nights recently and was in awe with the service across the entire spectrum of the resort (bellman, valet, desk, spa, golf course, etc.).  Awesome experience, awesome resort, awesome service!

reviews.author: beacht1me
reviews.title: The definition of great service
reviews.text: Couldn't have asked for better service all around. I had contacted the hotel in advance about our early arrival and having a room ready. It was ready, and beautiful! Love the Casita's!!! Went right to the pool where we were greeting immediately with chair towels and cold water. Ordered a Bloody Mary - probably one of the best we've ever had! Nice and spicy. Kudos to Jesus and Heather at the pool. Thanks for all of the attention and great service. Ate at the burger restaurant for dinner that night and it was great. Nice to have something casual after a long day of travel as we were too tired to leave the property. Other than the coffee shop/ice cream shop, we didn't frequent any of the other restaurants. Just too many great choices in Scottsdale that we had to check out. Property location is hard to beat. This is always my first choice when traveling to Scottsdale. Such a beautiful property. I could stay here forever!

reviews.author: Keary H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: I stayed at the Phoenician for a business event.  It was beautiful of course.  The pools were amazing.  The staff was very friendly.  My room was HUGE.  The bathroom was my favorite part- big tub!  The only negative I noticed was that it took a long time for the water to get hot, and sometimes it didn't get hot at all.

reviews.author: Stockholm2295
reviews.title: Always a treat!
reviews.text: I visit The Phonician a couple of times a year and it never disappoints.  The staff is outstanding, the grounds are beautiful, golf courses well maintained.  And the restaurant and bar options are excellent.  Great for a romantic visit.  You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: theMarce
reviews.title: Excellent Rooms
reviews.text:
room 4197.  Stayed here for a conference.  Room was very large but had 2 double beds. 2 full closets, large bath, separate tub and shower. Balcony is very large.  No view except of trees.  Very far from conference and golf, but worth it for the seclusion.
Great pool and work out facility. A little dated but still great

reviews.author: Katty R
reviews.title: wij waren daar voor conventie van Unigroup
reviews.text:
ongelofelijk leuke ervaring ! Fantastische service. Kamer werd elke dag zorgvuldig 
onderhouden, mini bar bijgevuld.  super vriendelijke en enthousiaste mensen.
Service aan de zwembaden ook top, ligbedden werden voor je opgemaakt met
automatisch een kan ijswater erbij !
zeker voor herhaling vatbaar !

reviews.author: Nickels500
reviews.title: Great staff, beautiful grounds
reviews.text: The pool area layout is very well thought out, with plenty of chairs and umbrellas available.  Everyone on the staff was extremely lovely and helpful.  The rooms were large and clean and the beds were super comfortable.  It's an extremely well run hotel.  We will definitely return.

reviews.author: emptynesters38
reviews.title: Relaxing stay during "off season"
reviews.text: My wife and I and another couple recently spent a few nights at the Phoenician. Each couple had a Casita and the rooms were very nice.  The bath room was luxurious. The pool area is extensive with many pools and plenty of access to lounge chairs and umbrellas. We were there in September so it was not that crowded but I understand that in February the hotel is full and it is difficult to find a place to relax by the pool.  The staff was very attentive and the entire facility was kept in excellent condition.  There seem to be a number of activities for children including a kids club, a water slide (which I could not resist) and daily koi feeding. The gym facility was excellent, we were able to park right in front of our room and the wifi was more than adequate and there was no additional charge. I am not a fan of Resort Charges and they charge $29.00 a night but since I knew about it in advance and made use of the facilities I cannot complain.   Even with the resort charge, they also charge a lot for things like phone calls and computer usage but I guess they have a lot of guests on business who do not care about those kind of charges.   We had an enjoyable time and I would recommend it for any age group but would probably try and avoid it when it is crowded.

reviews.author: Hotelsnobb
reviews.title: Our new favorite!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is our new favorite resort!  Such a peaceful, relaxing, and tranquil place.  I loved the layout that just blends into the surroundings. It is huge and maze-like, so it takes a bit of time to find your way around.  We felt really pampered and well taken care of here.  It is a true resort with everything you need without leaving the property!  Many different pools, bars, and restaurants.  We loved the adult pool (the mother of pearl pool)...very quiet and tranquil.  Great service there with everything.  They bring you a pitcher of water with cups and keep it full.  Top notch service all around the property.

We had an oversized room (I believe Superior) with a nice patio, large bathroom, and plenty of storage with two closets.  The beds were amazingly comfortable...great linens, towels, and pillows.  Nice views, including the cactus garden.

There are many activities going on all over the property to keep entertained.  My favorite was yoga on the lawn.  My one complaint was that the resort fee does not cover the exercise classes.

The Phoenician is even listed as one of the top 1,000 places to see before you die in the North America book!

reviews.author: Elina W
reviews.title: Got Bad Food In The Restaurant
reviews.text:
We stayed there this weekend and really enjoyed our room and the pool, however, we had breakfast there and we got food poising. We ordered different items but both got sick within hours after eating there. We told the server the next day  and he said that he'd tell the manager. We never heard from the manager. If you pay $70 for breakfast you'd expect the best right?
Otherwise service was good and the property is beautiful. It smells in the lobby like an old building but it still looks very nice and glorious.

reviews.author: JuanGonzo123
reviews.title: AMAZING, highly recommended!
reviews.text:
I could go on and on about this property. Amazing golf, beautiful views of Camelback mountain and the valley, everything is clean and perfect.

The staff is also above professional and courteous. They took great care of me and my family, and we CAN NOT wait to get back here!

reviews.author: Houston N
reviews.title: Large clean rooms!
reviews.text: The Phoenician in Scottsdale is a wonderful place to enjoy the great service that one would expect from a top rated resort. The rooms are very large, clean, and well maintained. The service staff is excellent in every way and will pamper you at every turn.

reviews.author: Kevin O
reviews.title: Just another Scottsdale senior citizen
reviews.text: Stayed in main building. Carpet was thin in spots, bathroom was poorly designed (hub too small for normal size adult). Bed was comfortable. Pool area and gym were nice. Overall impression of the resort - room, lobby, restaurant - is that like many others in Scottsdale, it needs some major work.  It simply is too old and dated to be a top hotel.   I have made this comment about other purportedly top hotels - that status requires consistent investment in both public and private areas.  The Phoenician is living on its laurels.  The Primcess is an enormous step up - the rooms and grounds are vastly superior.  Don't make the mistake of staying here when there are much better options nearby.

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel Experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at The Phoenician every week for approximately four months for work during the fall in 2014.  I had an outstanding experience and would recommend that anyone traveling to Phoenix / Scottsdale stay here.

The rooms are large and clean.  The bathrooms are excellent with showers and whirlpool-style tubs.  The restaurants are very good.  The pool and hotel grounds are excellent ... the cactus garden is a very nice touch.  The gym was fantastic.

What left the most lasting impression on me was the quality of the staff.  Kaitlin, one of the supervisors, was extremely helpful and attentive.  She regularly helped me with reservations and day-to-day needs.

reviews.author: travbud1
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: Stayed at the Phoenician over a weekend and it was very nice.  The resort itself is exceedingly large and hosts many conferences.  There are several restaurants on site as well as 27 holes of golf.  Self-parking is free.  The location is excellent.  A few mishaps during our stay including the safe in the room being broken and one of our bags getting lost for about an hour or so upon check-in.  Nevertheless, it is a great resort and certainly worth considering during your stay in the desert.

reviews.author: Adrienne L
reviews.title: Great hotel for large groups
reviews.text: Enjoyed time at this hotel. The pools are nice and the scenery is very beautiful. The hotel is very large so it is a good hotel for large groups. The service was very good overall. The breakfast buffet at J&G Steakhouse for our group was just okay (there was not a large selection and some of the food was cold) but the other meals eaten on the hotel property (two dinners in hotel ballrooms and room service) were delicious.

reviews.author: dog-dadd
reviews.title: Great, but expensive
reviews.text: Stayed here a couple times in the past two years, the location and grounds are amazing.  However for the price point I expect the rooms to be more recently upgraded.  The beds and bedding are standard for the hotel...not home, but close.

reviews.author: Maxine
reviews.title: weekend trip
reviews.text: Very nice resort, we went for a work retreat and it was lovely. Rooms were very spacious and the king bed we had was so comfy I wanted to take it home with us! The food was also good, we didn't get a chance to try all the restaurants. The homemade icecream from their onsite icecream shop is delicious - I loved the mint chocolate chip with real mint leaves. Overall good experience.

reviews.author: Lindsay B
reviews.title: Robert is great! Thank you for his assistance!
reviews.text: Robert, who works with concierge/room service, exceeded expectations in customer service! My boyfriend stayed at the resort for his birthday and Robert helped arrange a gift for him in his room. Thank you Robert for your help!

reviews.author: Parents on an Autism journey
reviews.title: Most Amazing hotel.
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited this hotel in June 2011. Spent 8 days in Scottsdale.

I most say that this hotel is by far the most luxurious hotel we have ever stayed in. The hotel has Camelback Mountain as its backdrop which is simply breathtaking. 

The grounds are simply amazing, I'm not a golfer but the golf course and its surroundings are fantastic.

The rooms are very spacious and have a great outlook. We faced Camelback Mountain. 

The pools are great, with an area for kids with a basketball ring. Sun beds are so comfortable and the staff are so kind in bringing Iced water on a regular basis. It was roughly 38 degrees when we visited.

The restaurant is amazing for both breakfast and evening meal. We experienced some of the best meals we have ever eaten whilst abroad.

Scottsdale is very affluent with lovely restaurants and a great shopping mall close by.

There is a really good gym with assortment of CV equipment and free weights.

This hotel is simply amazing to relax and unwind whilst being pampered with luxury throughout.

reviews.author: santarosabob
reviews.title: Watch the hidden charges
reviews.text: Stayed there October 2015 for four days. Knew the room rate was expensive going in but expected a nicer more modern property for the money. It is a beautiful area but not worth $500 a night. Also when I got my bill there were charges l thought were excessive. $56 portaging charge when I carried my own bag. $114 for a 15 minute call to FL.(I did get them to refund that). The room needs updating and has no USB Ports.Just thought the whole experience was nowhere near the cost.

reviews.author: fourknees
reviews.title: Excellent property.
reviews.text:
Was here for work and it was great.  Several swimming pools (including a basketball hoop and a volleyball net), a hot tub and a water slide and splash pad area.

The layout of the different buildings is not overly complex.  You're right next to camelback mountain if you're up for a hike.

My room was always quiet.

reviews.author: WineNYC
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text:
I traveled here in August 2015 with my wife as part of a business trip. We stayed for 3 nights/4 days. The hotel itself, and the surrounding grounds were vast and beautiful (some may even say "Grand"). Everything is well maintained. The staff was professional and kind. The hotel does a great job attending to your needs, and has every amenity you would expect or need of any luxury hotel. Plenty of outdoor trails, and a beautiful view of Camelback mountain. The hotel has several pools, all of which are well staffed with eager employees, ready to set  up chairs and towels, and provide iced water. 

Location is fantastic, with plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. 

My only negative on the hotel is that some areas felt a little dated (not in bad shape by any means - but rather, just old).  Other than this, no real complaints. 

Included in our room rate, we enjoyed daily breakfast, which I highly recommend (even if not included in your rate), as breakfast was always delicious and had excellent service. The breakfast menu itself is loaded with plenty of very tempting options. I can honestly declare that their breakfast options are so diverse, they make nearly every other breakfast at every other hotel I have ever stayed at, look boring in comparison. It may seem like a small thing, but as they say, breakfast is the most important meal of the day. 

PS - Use the free self parking. Great extra, easy entrance into/out of hotel. Good savings over valet

reviews.author: Erin S
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Phoenician with my boyfriend on labor day weekend to celebrate our 2 year anniversary. Robert the concierge made the experience absolutely amazing! When he found out it was our anniversary he had champagne and chocolate sent up to our room along with a complimentary drink card for the bar downstairs. He also recommended some fantastic restaurants in the area that would be open late and had a great selection of wine. If you are staying the Phoenician I highly recommend asking Robert to help plan your stay!

We also had an amazing experience at the pool. The pool boy quickly found us chairs and re-arranged the tables and umbrellas to our liking. He was very attentive and kept watch over our belongings while we explored the other pools throughout the day.

I would definitely stay at this hotel again and let Robert assist in planning my experience!

reviews.author: bradygalpal
reviews.title: Wow!!
reviews.text: I loved staying at The Phoenician.  The grounds are lush and immaculate.  The second you enter the property it is as if you have been transported to a tropical location.  We stayed in a Casita Guestroom.  We were able to park right outside the door.  The room was larger than expected with a walk-in closet.  The balcony was huge with a beautiful view of a little stream running through the property.  The minibar was well stocked.  The bathroom had a separate walk-in shower and large soaker tub.  We spent most of the time in the pools.  There were many pools to choose from.  The hotel is definitely kid friendly but we were able to find a pool that mostly contained adults and was quiet.  We ate at all the restaurants.  They were all equally good and worth the money.  I did find that the service at the bar in the lobby area was lacking.  The service was so slow that we left and ordered drinks via room service. I absolutely loved walking around the property.  They have some of the fattest and beautiful Koi fish I’ve ever seen.  Don’t miss walking through the cactus garden!!  We originally stayed for 2 nights but we loved our stay so much that we tacked an extra day on.  Staying at The Phoenician was such an amazing experience that I want to change all the other hotel reviews I rated as a 5 star down to a 4 star.

reviews.author: Peter F
reviews.title: Old luxury
reviews.text:
Great choice if looking for a high-end luxury resort and plan to stay onsite for the majority of your stay. I was here for business and it's a big place, so moving in and out of the resort was somewhat of a hassle. The pool is great and I'm sure the golfing is awesome. 

Pros:
- Huge suites!
- Nice towels, turn down service, attention to detail
- Fast check-in and friendly front desk

Cons:
- Weak wifi
- Almost too large, takes a long time to walk from place to place and get to car
- High nightly rate

reviews.author: Dave G
reviews.title: Summer in Scottsdale Pricing
reviews.text: We visited in August to take advantage of the great summer pricing deals at the Phoenician. We were not disappointed by this resort. Beautiful property that allows you to feel like you are isolated from the world and very pampered. The staff was very courteous and helpful. Pricing was reasonable on drinks and food for this quality of a resort. We highly recommend visiting here at least once in your life!

reviews.author: Sandyiam1208
reviews.title: beautiful experience
reviews.text: Beautifully maintained property with fantastic view. The birds of prey project was interesting and innovative and could be expanded in time and locations. You never have to leave the resort for great food and service! Steve, the bartender at the middle pool, is quick with your drink and friendly advice about the resort and area. There's something here for everyone. Nice experience

reviews.author: Richard C
reviews.title: A Slight Disappointment
reviews.text:
For most this is simply a great resort, but while I have to rate it excellent in part because it has been rated by fellow travelers as Scottsdale's 3rd best resort hotel behind #2 Camelback Inn and their top rated Four Seasons North at Tron.

It is glitzy, but not as much as Caesar's Palace or The Greenbrier. But, after rouge felon Keating spared no expense investing billions of dollars of his Lincoln Savings & Loan's saver's money, I expected an American version of the Versailles Palace, and it fell far below that level.

The grounds are nice and rooms and suites elegant, but I do not know if I would even rate it as high as #3.

reviews.author: Steven L
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.text: Over the top service. We stayed for 2 nights and the experience was Amazing! The room was very large with a gorgeous view. All of the staff were "on point" and catered to our every need. Gorgeous pool with great views!

reviews.author: Martin Y
reviews.title: Up for Luxuriating?
reviews.text: I must have stayed at this resort ten times over the years and it's never disappointed.  We opt to stay in the casitas.  The property is beautiful!  There are an option of pools, all of them large.  There is a pond/river where Koi fish are swimming.  It's wonderful to roam the grounds through the meandering pathways.  It sits just at the foot of Camelback Mountain.  Parts of the inside the main hotel look almost like a museum.  Be prepared to spend money, but if you like luxury, this place is for you.

reviews.author: Vicky H
reviews.title: Pure luxury!
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights rest and relaxation after nearly 3 weeks touring the national parks. We wanted a luxury resort and were not disappointed. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left we knew we were in a 5 star resort with 5 star service. The hotel is wonderful, beautifully appointed and truly luxurious. Pool area is large with a number of separate pools, including an adults only area, where we chilled out. Towels and a larger jug of iced water appeared as soon as we arrived! We ate in both restaurants and food and service were first class. The staff were all excellent and highly efficient giving great customer service. Everybody, from the car valet to the front desk, to the concierge, to the waiting staff, could not do enough for you. On the first night, over dinner, I managed to splash balsamic vinegar on my white linen shirt. Housekeeping took it at 10pm and by 8 am it was back in my room spotless. And because it happened in the restaurant they did it as a complementary clean for no charge - now that's great customer service!! We had a grand deluxe room and were not disappointed. It was very large, beautifully appointed and had a lovely balcony overlooking the pool with a lounger to relax on and watch the world go by. Overall a fantastic stay and one of the highlights of our holiday.

reviews.author: Kimiam7790
reviews.title: GET SPOILED HERE!
reviews.text: Omg...this hotel property is BEAUTIFUL!  The hotel is smack right on Camelback mountain!  I could not stop staring at it!  At the back of the hotel, is a very cute 2 acre cactus garden of every imaginable cactus!  (who knew!?)  The pools are just beautiful.  My husband and I stayed at the adults only pool area.  Very nice and quiet.  The pool employees kept us hydrated with a pitcher of ice cold water with LOTS of ice!  Very nice to drink poolside under an umbrella!  Very luxurious hotel!  Beautiful shops too!  Gorgeous grounds to take your daily walk.  Take a walk to the Camelback and take the Cholla trail up to the top.  Warning, this is a DOUBLE BLACK DIAMOND hike!  If you are not in good shape, don't do it.  You might be able to do a short hike, but not all the way to the top.  Very step, and very scary at some spots.  Only enough room for ONE shoe sometimes!  The guest room was gorgeous, with a HUGE bathroom!  Loved the sunken tub, separate toilet, and a nice shower!

reviews.author: Jackie K
reviews.title: Extra charges
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel with a conference and they told me I would be charged for the daily housekeeping.  Since I work for state government, they will not pay for this service (and I agree).  I only had service one day and then not again.  When asked to have the days removed that I did not receive housekeeping, they said that it part of the deal the conference made.  I have no choice but to pay.

reviews.author: TraciS587
reviews.title: Sadly, awful.
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from 1 night at the Canyon Suites and 2 nights at the Phoenician resort. We were traveling with his company (who had 500 people staying at the Phoenician over the weekend) but we came early by one night to stay at the Canyon Suites, which is WAY better than the Phoenician in every way.

When we checked into the Phoenician on Friday we were given a great room (upgraded because of SPG) and all was well. We asked for a humidifier to be delivered- when we got back to our room later they had delivered it, but it had leaked water over the entire dresser, ruining a book of our and soaking everything else. We called for help to clean it up so it didn't ruin the dresser. Someone came eventually and offered no apology or to replace our book that was ruined. 

Later that night, after being asleep for 3 hours, we woke up at 1am to a completely overpowering cigarette smell in our room. We tried to wait it out but eventually had to call because it was so bad. They sent security (who upon opening our door was shocked at how bad it was and super apologetic. They investigated and couldn't find the culprit, but said that because the AC ducts are connected, it was coming through our vents. He said that there was no way he would stay int he room, especially as I am 30 weeks pregnant!)

My husband went to the front desk, and the lady there was annoyed and not very helpful. He basically told her we HAD to get a new room. All they could find was a double bed room with a view of the roof. We moved at 1:30-2:00AM to another room to sleep. A manager came to our first room the next morning (which STILL smelled). She basically offered no apology for our inconvenience, told us there were no other king rooms available, but that she would be in touch if anyone checked out and would relocate us so that we could have a king bed.

We never heard from anyone every again. No apology, no call when people checked out, nothing. We decided to not fight it and stayed int he double room. We had already unpacked twice, it wasn't worth it again. I cannot believe this is a 5 star, $500 a night hotel. I would never pay over $200 to stay here. Besides the complete lack of service, they are understaffed (we were on hold many times trying to call guest services), wifi that barely worked, and the rooms are outdated. Stay at Canyon Suites. You get personal service there instead of being one of the 300+ rooms at the Phoenician that they could care less about.

reviews.author: Beach_Babe_033
reviews.title: Truly Impressed with this Property
reviews.text:
Have stayed at many resorts claiming to be luxury-level properties but was very impressed with this one.  Stayed two nights as part of a 500+ person business function.  

Amazing scenic views and golf course.  Huge and varied pool areas.  Well equipped and air conditioned gym and yoga studio.  Gorgeous manicured lawns, greenery and ponds with ducks, coy, birds and wildlife.  Beautiful spa and wellness center.  Large selection of restaurants.  Spacious, clean rooms with many little extras that made it feel like home away from home.  Excellent air conditioning system (which is a must in Arizona) and the bed was extremely comfortable.  Had an excellent sleep.

Very impressed with the attentive and energetic staff. Called room service several times for random items (such as ice, extra coffee and first aid items), all were attended to within minutes and with unparalleled enthusiasm.  At one point someone who appeared to be a security guard even delivered items to the room.  The politeness and attentiveness of the front door bellman service and room service left us thinking "they must really be enjoying their jobs".

Highly recommended for a relaxing weekend away or group function.  Something for everyone here!

reviews.author: 944brentr
reviews.title: Concierge
reviews.text: The Concierge, Robert Sabori, was absolutely fantastic and worked very hard to help me find the perfect restaurant and arrange transportation for me to the airport.  I felt awful as I didn't have anything to tip him at the time.  He was very gracious and had no problem at all with that

reviews.author: jra802015
reviews.title: Phoenician Resort -Scottsdale, AZ
reviews.text:
One of the finer resorts in the valley of the sun. Rooms with spectacular views. Great dining and well trained staff. Try Relish 
 at the Phoenician Gokf Course for a great lunch and the J & G Steak House in the hotel. Great steaks with a nice wine list and spectacular views.

reviews.author: Natassshika
reviews.title: Отель 6 бриллиантов
reviews.text: Шикарный отель с огромной территорией, поражает своей красотой и ухоженно стою. Бассейны , фонтаны. А ведь это Аризона. На территории много кроликов. Завтраки на террасе отеля прекрасны. Номера большие, так как отель очень большой придется много ходить

reviews.author: lorifromtheatl
reviews.title: Lovely spa. Fun to hang out
reviews.text: I visited the Phoenician with girl friends for a weekend trip and had a blast. The staff are incredibly professional and service-oriented. The spa was amazing. The massage therapists and aestheticians did fantastic jobs. We booked our services out five/six weeks and were limited in availability due to conferences booked. Also, we had reserved spots in the meditation class and people who had not booked in advance were given priority seating before us. One of our group had to sit on the floor. The staff asked for people to relinquish the spots but nobody would. What could they do?  We had a blast. It's an excellent property.

reviews.author: Olle O
reviews.title: Luxurious and relaxing resort.
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I only stayed one night on The Phoenician on my outbound journey from Stockholm, Sweden to the Grand Canyon. I wish that I had stayed longer.
Superb place. Friendly, efficient and profesional staff. Great surroundings. Immaculately kept garden. Amazing pools. Great guestrooms and extremely comfortable beds, superb bathroom, very quiet. Several restaurants in the resort. I only had breakfast here as I only stayed for one night. Great breakfast.

reviews.author: Alan W
reviews.title: Desert Elegance
reviews.text: Right in the middle of Scottsdale Arizona sits an Oasis of Luxury and World Class Service.  Located close to everything Scottsdale has to offer.  Rooms with a view, excellent food and Golf, Golf, Golf!  Bring your suit because the pool and slides are great.  Short hop to Scottsdale Fashion Square and some incredible restaurants.  Pricey but worth it!

reviews.author: Rschagrin
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
What a beautiful hotel on a very beautiful setting.  I call Scottsdale, "The Boca Raton of the West"

The staff is very gracious and accommodating.

Great restaurants and shopping nearby.

I like that when you get your car, there are bottles of cold water in it.

reviews.author: Ted V
reviews.title: Once you get past check-in it is a pleasure
reviews.text:
The Pheonician is a beautiful resort with great amenities and staff. The check-in process was poor. The room was not ready for early check- in and was past the guarantee time. When they took us to the deluxe casita it was not made and there were bottles and trash in the floor. Not a good start however after that was resolved the stay was most enjoyable. The center for wellness is fabulous. The small pool where they have cabanas is extreme we'll run. If you enjoy privacy rent a cabana. The person running the area is named Rich and he could not be more accommodating. He is constantly looking out for your enjoyment and makes the time feel very special. The grounds are immaculate and all of the staff is very friendly. The restaurants are good and they also have a casual dining restaurant named Relish which was very low key and very good in many areas. The service was great and they have an array of burgers, not all meat. Tuna, chicken, salmon, turkey and naturally beef. They also serve it knife and fork style ( no bread) which was just the right size for me.
 I will not hesitate to go back to the Pheonician, the one snafu was not pleasant but did not define the property.

reviews.author: jor679
reviews.title: Environnement féerique
reviews.text:
C'est la 3ème fois que nous revenions au Phoenician avec une crainte d'être déçu.Mais le charme a à nouveau opéré. Le site, la vue, l'Hôtel et l'accueil, la chambre avec vue et la qualité des services ont contribué à entretenir notre souvenir favorable.
D'abord citons la Concierge, Michelle Seamons, qui nous a guidé pendant les 7 jours que nous sommes restés, donnant des conseils sur les visites, réservant les restaurants, bref étant la personne de contact fiable à laquelle se référer. 
A la réception, Mora nous a également été précieuse pour nous conseiller.
Une séjour très familial et personnalisé dans un environnement luxueux,

reviews.author: Swadeshi1
reviews.title: Luxury, relax, quiet, clean and friendly staff... perfect combination.
reviews.text:
We just spent a weekend at the Phoenician in Scottsdale, Arizona. This place is a great place that has a what you need to relax: an excellent pool area (which includes a section just for the kids and another one for adults), games area, trails to walk around, a nice scenic view to the city and the Camelback Mountain. Their staff are knowledgeable, and always provided a smile; this happened not only in the hotel but also the Café were Jane and Sabrina were very nice providing top notch service. We had also the opportunity to eat at the Burger Place (Relish Burger Bistro) and their Italian Restaurant IL Terrazzo, both were excellent. 

Sleep quality: perfect (comfortable beds, very quiet, not noises at all). 
Pool: clean, friendly staff, quick service, plenty of options. 
Bathrooms: spacious, clean, with a tub, shower and private toilette.
Service: excellent; friendly and knowledgeable 
Checkout: quick and easy. 
Parking: self-parking complimentary, valet also available.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: Wonderful concierge!
reviews.text: I just finished speaking with Robert Sabori who was the friendliest and most helpful concierge I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with!  While trying to do this long distance over the phone, his assistance and suggestions are going to make one of our employees and a guest at the hotel very happy!  His professionalism and courteous manner says a lot about this hotel and how much Robert enjoys his job!

reviews.author: Mary L
reviews.title: Lobby Court Tea
reviews.text: My family and friends have been going to the Lobby Tea Court for the last 10 years!  We have always had Wanda attend to our table.  She is a delight.  Friendly, knowledgeable, anticipates your needs without having to ask, detail oriented.  Wanda has become part of the family and makes you feel pampered.  I would highly recommend Afternoon Tea for any occasion or just to go and relax for a few hours.  Wanda will make sure you are well cared for.

reviews.author: Raphael D
reviews.title: Keeps Getting Better Every Year !!
reviews.text:
My first and only previous Trip Advisor review was for our stay at this property 2 years ago. Although we travel frequently, I'm not one to take the time to go online to write reviews of hotels, restaurants, etc..., however, because we just returned from yet another extraordinary stay at The Phoenician, I feel compelled to make the effort to share my thoughts on TA.
`
This time we decided to stay a bit longer and had a truly memorable 10 night stay through Labor Day weekend. We again stayed in a 1 BR Casita suite which was impeccably furnished, incredibly comfortable, and ideally situated on the property. 

We had great meals and exceptional service poolside as well as at Relish & Il Terrazzo restaurants. At Il Terrazzo we had many conversations with their new GM (Arlis Ceretti) who has this place humming like a well-oiled machine. Service was very courteous, fast and food was hot, tasty and well portioned. 

We had several treatments at the spa which has a great steam room and the most comfortable chairs in the serene meditation room. Highly recommend getting a massage from Mary Powell - she is a very experienced and knowledgeable therapist. 

If you need assistance with shopping or dinner reservations, we had wonderful assistance again this year from Michele Seamons. 

I could go on and on, but much of what I would say would duplicate my sentiments from my last review of The Phoenician. We've been coming here annually from Toronto for around 10 years now, but each visit reminds us and reinforces how much we love coming here and how great we feel and enjoy life while we're here. We are fairly discerning travelers and not the easiest guests to please, however, when it comes to the combination of a stunning property, location, accommodations, amenities and service, there is no better place to stay in the Scottsdale area. We hope to be able to continue our tradition and make it back again for many years to come.

reviews.author: Vegasbetsy
reviews.title: Romantic getaway
reviews.text: Top of the line service! The customer service was outstanding and very accommodating. The rooms are spacious and beautiful. Have everything you need and more. The room service food was probably the best I've had when it comes to room service cuisine. Multiple pools to relax at, and also the pool service with food was terrific. The grounds are beautiful, the area is in close proximity to other things of interest. Also, great choices to find on property.

reviews.author: Sharon R
reviews.title: The afternoon Tea is a "must".
reviews.text: This is a nice relaxing way to just spend time with friends, enjoy the lovely view from the  balcony, walk the cactus garden and while away time.  Staff bend over backwards to make your stay pleasant.  The bathrooms are divine, decor is elegant but not over done, and it's quiet!  The pools are a calm oasis in the midst of summer or winter.

reviews.author: infinitylvr
reviews.title: Great escape in the winter
reviews.text:
We took a last minute trip out here last winter and am just writing about it now. For our cold family, the hotel was a welcome antidote to winter. 
The kids lived poolside for 3 days. There was great pool service from constant help with towels, ice water, and room service, so we never had to leave the pool area!
The breakfast was also excellent - both a la carte and the buffet. The local sausage was delicious. 
The bird show was a little underwhelming and you have to get there early to get a good seat. The pool movie night was nice for the kids - they have glow sticks and other pool toys in the water and its a nice way to cuddle up in the evening.

reviews.author: LaulauSF
reviews.title: Be ambitious, but surrender to serenity
reviews.text: Just returned from a wonderful long weekend at the Phoenician. I had plans to see their bird show, attend a yoga class, check out the cactus garden, bike around the property, night swims, check out Scottsdale, etc. etc.  After hours of lounging, drinking, and eating next to their gorgeous pools, plans changed.  It was hard to leave the pools where the staff takes such good care of you.  I hope readers of this review finish my bucket list OR I just need to return here very soon.  Don't forget to ride the water slide (lay flat down).

reviews.author: Burtdol
reviews.title: TRULY FIVE STAR RESORT!
reviews.text:
Overall, this hotel resort deserves a five star rating. We found willingness to accommodate your every wish throughout the resort. Although we were not pleased with our original room arrangement, the hotel immediately made a change to meet our needs. Rooms are beautiful and very clean. The maid service, daily and turn down, was everything one could expect.
We dined for many meals at the hotel during our eight day stay. Service was always top notch and the quality of food was outstanding except for evening dining at the 
II Terrazzo where the food was far below its ratings. The other restaurants, Relish Burger Bistro and J&G Steak House were truly perfect and met every expectation.
This is truly a Five Star Resort for relaxation and if there on a weekend, don't miss the Phoenix Bird Show. Very enjoyable and educational.

reviews.author: DIELLE
reviews.title: Amazing property, amazing staff
reviews.text:
The room was beautiful.  The hotel was beautiful.  The staff went the extra mile -- like if I asked for directions, they physically walked me where I was going.  The spa was lovely -- the massage was great and so was the therapist.

The food was wonderful - the location was spectacular.  Just don't go in the summer!!!  It's unbearably hot.  Otherwise, I'd go back in a heartbeat.  I was there for work but it looked like so much fun for kids/families.

reviews.author: criss994
reviews.title: Absolutly beautiful with outstanding service
reviews.text: I travel a lot and spend a lot of time in hotels.  I have to say this one is in my top 100 for sure.  Every minute of my day I was waited on by staff.  The pool service is outstanding as well as every restaurant we ate at.  They greet you upon arrival and make an every effort to make you feel welcome from the get go.  I can't say enough about this place.  Beautiful resort and our room was amazing.  We arrived with champagne and handmade chocolates and a private message to welcome us.  This will be my number on place to stay when in AZ.

reviews.author: Sequel
reviews.title: Elegance in the desert
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 3 days at the Phoenician Resort!  We went with another couple and had adjoining rooms.  The rooms are large and so is the balcony.  The grounds of the resort are lovely and the lobby is striking, with fountains & huge glass windows & doors.  The service is good; three large pools, with a koi pool and "slide pool"; a nice wing of the hotel with shops and a cafe.  Elegant restaurants too.  The only complaint we voiced to the management is that they closed the pool bar at 5:00pm on a Friday night!  They did extend it to 7pm, but there were a lot of unhappy people........

reviews.author: Lynn M
reviews.title: Lovely Property
reviews.text: My husband I recently stayed at the Phoenician for a two night "staycation," which we do every summer at a different Phoenix/Scottsdale resort. The Phonecian was our favorite resort to date. The property was beautiful, the staff was accommodating, and we would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Bianca O
reviews.title: Not a Five Star Resort
reviews.text:
If you tout yourself to be a FIVE STAR resort, please act like it. This place is straight out of 1995 and the service is subpar. I've only been here one day and I already had to change rooms because of the moldy and musty smell. 

I'm sure in its heyday it was something to write home about, but for the price you pay, you can stay in a better place. Like the Phoenix rose out of its ashes, this places need to be burned down and raised to life again.

reviews.author: j.ambros@icloud.com
reviews.title: Wieder mal in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Im September waren wir wieder mal in Scottsdale, leider diesmal zum Labour Day ! Bei der Ankunft das selbe Problem wie immer........ etwas stimmte nicht mit der Buchung...... Das ist wirklich nervig dass hier am Empfang immer erst mal Ärger droht. Der Aufenthalt danach war in Ordnung, der Service korrekt, aber ich denke es gibt mittlerweile bessere, persönlichere Hotels hier !! 

Das Phoenician leider nur noch Durchschnitt, nur beim Preis immer noch an der Spitze, hier passt es nicht mehr ganz ! 

Josef Ambros

reviews.author: Smlclemons
reviews.title: Anniversary trip back to phoenician
reviews.text: We were married in the cactus garden at the Phonecian 15 years ago. Every time we have been back to celebrate an anniversary, we have been delighted!  We splurged and got a room at the canyon suites section of the resort. The service is wonderful. They give you icy cold towels while at the pool along with ice cold water and whatever else you'd like. My husband loved the wine tasting in the evening. Just wonderful!

reviews.author: PigPen54
reviews.title: Summer Getaway
reviews.text: We made a quick stop at the Phoenician for a short stay and we were very happy we did. The pool complex made the 100 degree plus days easy to take and the other amenities at the hotel were superb. Our two children, 6 and 3 1/2, were welcomed everywhere on the property and I was impressed that every restaurant had a childrens menu and crayons to go with it.We will absolutely consider the Phoenician on our next trip to the valley of the sun.

reviews.author: jeffhar
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: Great property with great service.  F&B service was great.  Golf course was challenging with the views on the elevated tee being spectacular.  Rooms could use a little updating but I understand that is forthcoming.

reviews.author: MLZ405
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel Experience
reviews.text: This is my second time staying at The Phoenician in Scottsdale and I cannot say enough good things about this property. The staff is very friendly and professional. Check in was a special highlight with Mora who did a wonderful job helping us with early check in and arranging a fantastic room for us. All of the rooms are especially nice with great amenities and an excellent bed that provides a great sleeping experience. The property has an ideal location in Scottsdale for guests who would like to explore the surrounding area or stay on the property which I did. I especially like their choice in pools and selection of restaurants on the property. We had a chance to have dinner at the Jean George restaurant which was superb and had a well priced fixed menu starting at $40 for the summer. All in all, The Phoenician is a well run hotel that is my go to place now to stay each time I am in Scottsdale. Be sure to see if you can get a mountain view room which I think is an ideal setting for the hotel.

reviews.author: Garret G
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician was all around amazing. Great rooms, service, and pool. The staff is extremely friendly and knowledgable. Room service was always quick, with the food being fresh and hot. 
Kris, Jarrett, and Casey were the standout employees at the pool. We will definitely be going back very soon.

reviews.author: AnyoneSomeone
reviews.title: Five Star Resort One Star View
reviews.text:
GROUNDS:  First this is an absolutely gorgeous First Class 5 Star Hotel.  It offers a beautiful gated golfing resort complete with security, under ground garage parking, a private cactus walk that is lite up at night with spectacular city views that is nestled at the base of Camel Back Mountain.  Centrally located and only minutes from shopping and restaurants, this is a perfect oasis paradise.  There were no planes flying overhead or traffic noises.  At night the only sound is that of nature and the occasional rescue chopper flying up Camel Back Mountain.    

ROOMS:  The rooms were incredibly large with massive oversized bathrooms.  The beds and linens were equally as comfortable and soft.  Everything was fresh and clean.  Just Perfect!!

POOLS:  There are 5-6 pools that can compete with most of the high end Vegas hotels with everything from a small children's shallow pool to water volley ball, children's slides and private adult's only pool areas.  They even offer early morning yoga and water aquatics classes.  Plenty of chairs and umbrellas with very helpful cabana workers refreshing water pitchers or bringing food/beverage orders from the outdoor water bar/restaurant.   

DOWNSIZE:  The hotel check in staff can not make changes to your rooms upon arrival.  I heard this on numerous occasions even if a customer wants or needs to make an upgrade.  You have to call or go online to make any changes to your reservations.  I mention this since our "Mountain View" was literally a sealed in patio that is reminiscence of prison cells used for solitary confident with a micro small opening for light.  The only mountain view we saw was the other side of a  solid brick wall through a tiny slit in the mortar.  It was extremely hot and humid in there with no air circulation.  When I told the front desk several of the employees seemed shocked to hear of such a room but did nothing.

Room Tips:  Mountain views are in the back of the resort and more quieter since frontal pool views can be noisier since the pools are open 24/7.  If a view is important or this is some special romantic celebration be sure to upgrade to a nicer room and be very specific about your requests since upon your arrival they can not or will not make changes.

Otherwise this is a wonderful place I would recommend when staying in or around the Phoenix/Scottsdale area.  LOVED, LOVED, LOVED, this place!

reviews.author: demtwins
reviews.title: Luxury in the Summer
reviews.text:
Had a business trip in summer and the rates at the property at that time of year are hard to pass up.  What didn't feel like off season was the service.. From checkin to the pool to the restaurants all were top notch. The pool complex is also a highlight.  Great stay if you wanted luxury in the summer in Arizona.

Note.. If you are staying in the Casitas rather than the main hotel it's a little bit of a walk and uphill to the main building and there is only stairs to the second floor suites .. although the service is so good they will help if needed.

reviews.author: jhcks
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea
reviews.text:
We returned to the Phoenician again for the Labor Day weekend and, as always, enjoyed Afternoon Tea.  We appreciate the terrific service by Natalie and Wanda!  Another fabulous  experience!

We never visit the Phoenician without including Afternoon Tea in our itinerary!

reviews.author: Linda G
reviews.title: Afternoon Tea
reviews.text: My husband and I went to 'Grand Royale Tea' last Friday, August 28th.  We have been to many tearooms over the years including the Savoy in London and were delighted with our experience at the Phoenician. The servers, Wanda and Natalie, were friendly, professional and world class.  They rank as two of the best hostesses we have ever had for afternoon tea. We highly recommend enjoying afternoon tea during your stay at the Phoenician.

reviews.author: Irie Traveler
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text:
The property is very nice and the staff is very helpful. I like the summer meals combo specials at the restaurants.
The room was large and comfortable. I had a view of the pool and balcony. I would recommend for business and for a family get away.

reviews.author: Marianne P
reviews.title: Business
reviews.text: We had a business meeting at this location.  We were not in the main hotel but occupied the Canyon Suites.  This is the second time we held our meeting here.  I have to admit that the second time around, the service was not as good.  The suites were beautiful, the grounds were perfect, pools with cabanas were a delight and meeting rooms were accommodating.  Food needed to be prepared at the main hotel and then rolled down to the suites.  If I had an opportunity to come back for a nice weekend, I would gladly stay in the suites.  It is so beautiful and although separate from the main hotel, you can get an attendant to take you there and back or just walk.

reviews.author: Voyager70313
reviews.title: Phoenician with My Sister's
reviews.text: I am currently visiting this wonderful establishment.  The moment we arrived I felt like I was in paradise. The staff were very accommodating to us and our needs. Me and my family experienced a high tea event. One of our servers will stand out more than the others. Wanda is her name and she was just lovely. Our experience with the tea event was heightened with her. She was very personable and informative about the whole event. We leave Wednesday and we will be leaving with wonderful memories of our trip.

reviews.author: Funsista
reviews.title: Recent Empty Nesters
reviews.text:
Check-in was slow due to only having one staff person working. She was great and helpful but the line was getting very long. Bell hops were very welcoming and helpful. Lovely rooms, great pool areas, friendly staff that bring you free ice water!!!!! Poolside service. Restaurants are nice with friendly servers but very expensive and food is just ok. Bring your own snacks.😃Ice cream parlor has a half price happy hour for their ice cream-so that was nice! Turn down service and incredibly nice housekeeping staff, so polite and hard working.
Brooke at the front desk and Dylan at Relish Bistro were awesome!!!

reviews.author: J G
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: I booked a casita room (family of 4) so we would have luxury after a stay in the mountains on our vacation getaway mid August last month.  This was going to be our relaxing last hotel stay of a much needed vacation.  We got to the hotel and the front desk told me that they had overbooked and that our room was no longer available.  He then said that they had put us in a different type room at a $150 discount (all casitas booked up)  but the room would not be ready for another 50 minutes.  I asked if I could see the room to make sure it had the amenities we had asked for and he said not possible since room not ready yet.  I asked to see the manager and he said he was the manager.  He directed us to one of the bars so we could wait.  We went out to the over packed pool area to get lemonades and tried to get the bartender's attention for 15 minutes then two of us together asked "can we please get some service!".  We went back inside to ask about our room and the manager then said they moved us again to a different part of the hotel called the Canyons.  We went up the hill to this property and it was tranquil and beautiful.  We got to the room and it was very pretty and comfortable but did not have the amenities that I originally had asked for and were going to get with the Casita room.    Oh well!!!  The next day we checked out and were promptly charged the original Casita room price with no $150 discount!   By this time we just wanted to get to the airport and be rid of this experience.  Adios Phoenician!

reviews.author: Lauren S
reviews.title: A fabulous 10 days
reviews.text:
Firstly, I have to say that I scratched my head in puzzlement reading some of the negative reviews of this place as they don't match our experience at all.  We (husband, 8-year-old son, myself) just arrived back from a 10-day stay at the Phoenician and had a wonderful time!

We stayed in a grand deluxe room with two king size beds, a table and two lounge chairs with foot stool, a work station with desk, chair, plenty of plug sockets etc, and a good sized patio with table, chairs and sun lounger. Bathroom was huge, with separate shower and toilet, and there was a sunken bath. Plenty of towels, robes, slippers and excellent housekeeping and turn down service (complimentary water, chocolates etc). Housekeeping arranged our toiletries bags so everything was accessible. Well-stocked minibar. Coffee machine. Huge TV, two telephones. Mini-tablet device on desk with info about the resort, weather, news etc. Good wi-fi. Our room was absolutely perfect for the three of us - no tired furnishings, bugs etc. Far from it, it was immaculate. Sure, we encountered a bit of bird poop on the balcony but guess what? Birds fly around and poop as and when they fancy, and no hotel in the world could keep on top of that. Didn't bother us one bit. If we saw a poop, we just cleaned it away ourselves. And in any case, the staff at the Phoenician are so professional and attentive to detail, if we'd told them there was a poop on our balcony/patio, they'd send someone immediately to clear it up! The poolside staff in particular made every effort to shoo birds away from the sun loungers and any mess (minimal in my opinion) was promptly cleaned up.

Communal areas of the hotel are lovely. The lobby is elegant, cool and well furnished. Plenty of restrooms, house phones and information points. We saw a number of groups dressed up to the nines enjoying afternoon tea. Lovely to watch! Thirsty Camel piano player and guitarists / singers were brilliant. The pool areas were clean, tidy and very well attended by staff. There are several pools - one adults only. The main pool is big, separated into three sections with noodles, balls, volleyball, basketball hoop etc. Great for both kids and adults. Splash pad and water slide for kids are brilliant! The water slide is staffed and has CCTV so kids are totally safe. Jugs of iced water were handed out to guests regularly which was fantastic in 105 degree heat! Poolside bar service offered from 10.30, including alcohol and food. Cactus garden is shaded and provides a nice way to spend 30-mins or so. Flight of the Phoenix show on the lobby patio was great! Saturday night movie night by the pool with glow-sticks was something else - everyone was having so much fun!

I've given separate reviews of the restaurants at the Phoenician and I can categorically state that the food and service in all the restaurants we visited (J&G, Il Terrazzo, Oasis, Surge, Relish) were top notch. At the end of our 10-day stay our food/beverage bill (including a few extras such as a couple of purchases at Grain & Grape and in-room films) was just over $3,000. Not cheap but on par with similar resorts we've been to all over the world. We loved all our dining experiences from a bowl of granola in Il Terrazzo to filet mignon at J&G. No complaints whatsoever. Great food, service and staff.

The staff at the Phoenician are a true asset. We didn't encounter a single soul who wasn't friendly, efficient or extremely helpful. Staff said hello all the time and if we were out walking, we'd always get a friendly wave from staff riding around the resort in golf carts. A few times they actually pulled over to ask us if we wanted water or to tell us where to go to get the best views etc. From front desk to concierge to housekeeping to poolside to restaurant servers, the Phoenician offered some of the best staff we've ever met. Even the groundsmen sweeping up leaves and doing odd jobs always stopped what they were doing to say hello as we passed. We really appreciated those kind gestures. What was really nice was that most members of staff knew/remembered our names. In a resort with many rooms/guests, that is impressive.

Ordering taxis? No problem. Getting luggage stored? No problem. Late checkout? No problem. Fully itemised bill? No problem. During our entire stay, nothing was a problem for any member of staff. In fact, on one day I got bothered by bees around my sun lounger and a poolside attendant, Jake, kindly picked up all our towels, bags, water, glasses etc and relocated us somewhere else. On arrival, our son was given a soft toy and an information pack about the resort. Room service was, without doubt, the swiftest I have experienced.

My husband had to work for 4 days in Phoenix during our stay and the TransStyle drivers who serve the Phoenician were fantastic. A couple of times my young son and I went into town by ourselves and we simply called the driver who dropped us off and he came to collect us. No hassle, no fuss, drivers chatty and good for local advice, tips, restaurants, places to go etc. Faultless service. 

All in all, this place is excellent. There were a number of stand-out staff for us including Brian (poolside - so friendly!), Jeremy (blond), Jeremy (brown hair), Kris, Jacque, Robert (concierge), Jake... this list isn't exhaustive; ALL the staff at the Phoenician were unbelievably amazing. 

Thank you all so much for an absolutely amazing stay. We met several well-travelled families during our visit (from both the UK and the US) who stay at the Phoenician for several weeks every year simply because it is so good. That, for me, is a clear indicator of the Phoenician's excellence. We will be back! xxx

reviews.author: msmilah
reviews.title: Exceedingly mediocre in so many ways...
reviews.text:
I wanted this place to be great.  Went for a special occasion.  Everything is there.  The staff was great beginning to end.  All the amenities are there (turn down service, fashionable shops, and huge pools), but it still was just an average experience for a top dollar price.  It just failed to impress over and over again.  The food was mediocre for the price, $45 for an average half bottle of wine in the room, $16 Kobe sliders and $16 crab cake that was dry, $50 Filet Mignon was offered with 4 sauces (bad sign) at their flagship J&G Steakhouse and it needed them, and not even a decent piece of bread.  The kicker of course was that nothing was bad, but there just wasn't anything that was actually that good!

I know the "deluxe" room I received was probably just a basic room, but the wallpaper was bubbling at the crown moulding and there was mildew in the shower.  The tub and fixtures were dated and carpet had stains.  Bed was comfy and consistent with Starwood properties.  The closets and bathroom doors were small louvered double doors stuffed at the entry so they could all be opened in a small space.  Not a luxury feel, it felt more like the efficiency of a ship.

I went to the spa two days.  Both were again ...average.  Women's jacuzzi was small, meditation room was co-ed and had a deadly step that everyone was warned about.  I'm thinking.... why don't you fix it?  LOUD fountain in meditation area and cheap "recliner" type seats that every single guest struggled with.  Hello?  Get some decent chairs.  Treatment rooms were small.  Gym was again adequate but nothing I would describe as deluxe.

Again everything was perfectly adequate, and everything you expected to be there was there, it just failed to impress.  Maybe if I played golf?  I read about the $100 million recently spent on the property, and I am wondering where it went exactly?  In the golf course?  Anyway, I will be coming back to Phoenix but I won't be staying at the Phoenician again, not because it was a bad experience, but simply because I believe that for the money I think I can do better.  At least I hope so.  That may turn out to not be true, but nothing about the experience makes me want to come back to this particular property.

reviews.author: Atanderson
reviews.title: Dated
reviews.text: Hotel is dated. Staff if terribly rude. Expected better. Been to various places on business and had a far better stay at a cheaper resort then here. Bird poop everywhere. Sheets were not changed prior to my stay. Very disappointed in this resort.

reviews.author: desertlover2015
reviews.title: Exceeded our expectations
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is an outstanding resort. 
 
It is surrounded by beautiful mountains and intriguing desert terrain and looks like an oasis of greenery and luxury in that context.  The golf course and tennis and spa facilities are excellent.  The various cuisines – ranging from casual American lunch fare to exquisite gourmet dishes – served at the restaurants on premise are simply awesome.  Other reviewers have noted that some aspects of the resort seem dated, but my family and I appreciated the solid and ornate construction, involving extensive use of marble (probably more associated with an earlier generation than the modern era), of the lobby, ballrooms, and other facilities, the good sound insulation that we enjoyed in our room, and the immaculate condition in which everything was kept.

Most of all, we appreciated the staff at this resort - in almost every instance welcoming, friendly, helpful, and very professional.  One gets the sense that they are very much aligned with a mission to help guests enjoy their stay.  I wasn’t able to keep track of all of the names of staff members with whom we interacted, but did want to mention Jason Purcell, the head tennis pro, and Randy and Justin at the Golf Pro Shop, as having been very helpful and pleasant to deal with.  Kudos are due to management for having recruited and cultivated such a customer-driven crew.

The only nit I can pick is that the golf driving range only goes out to under 200 yards and, consequently, one does not get to hit regular or even high quality range balls on that range; rather, the practice balls available on that range seem to have limited flight distance and, in my experience at least, tendencies to exaggerate hooks or slices.  However, as mentioned, this is just a nit and did not detract from the overall experience.

My family and I are already looking forward to returning to the Phoenician in the not too distant future.

reviews.author: Erik D
reviews.title: Best couples retreat!
reviews.text: I told the front desk that we were celebrating out 1 year anniversary and they sent up complimentary chocolates and champagne! (Chocolates were excellent) the pools are amazing and even though there is plenty to do in old town, you'll find that you won't even have to leave the resort for any reason because the restaurants and activities at the resort are plentiful and fantastic!

reviews.author: Julie P
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Just completed a long weekend at The Phoenician and it was exceptional! From the service, beautiful rooms, pool, scenic trails and dining options, it was a dream! Would recommend it to anyone! Loved the property, luxurious rooms and excellent customer service from the entire staff. Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Tony M
reviews.title: Not worthy of 5 diamonds
reviews.text:
First the good, the grounds were amazing.  Pool staff couldn't have been friendlier or more accommodating.  The bad, the place has become terribly dated, and finishes just aren't wearing well.  The most concerning was the cleanliness of the grounds/patios.  Our patio was covered, I mean covered in bird poop.  To the point we wouldn't let our daughter on the patio due to the unsanitary conditions.  We took one look out and as nice as the view was and how nice it would have been to sit on the upgraded patio we paid for; the doors stayed shut the entire time we were there.  Throw that on top of a bunch of dead koi floating in the their ponds, and overall it was pretty disappointing considering it's "luxury" ratings.

Oh and I filled out their survey talking about the patio and dead fish and heard nothing back so they don't really seem to care.

reviews.author: krawattendino
reviews.title: Schönes Resort mit schöner Golfanlage
reviews.text: Von Kalifornien in Richtung Grand Canyon 2 Nächte übernachtet. Zimmer war sehr sauber. Schönes Bad. Allerdings nach meinem Geschmack könnte mal das Inventar erneuert werden. Sonst sehr angenehmer und guter Service. Poollandschaft ist echt schön und bietet viel. Waren in dem Steakrestaurant . Sehr lecker und schöner Ausblick über Scottsdale und Phoenix. Bis zur nächsten Mall auch nur 2 min mit dem Auto. Für die Durchreise und für Golf-Interessierte durchaus lohnenswert.

reviews.author: Lorilee G
reviews.title: Girls spa weekend
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I just has a little get away at the Phoenician. We had a wonderful room great meals and the best Spa experience. The service at the spa was above and beyond. The staff was friendly, efficient and gave great service.   I had a wonderful papaya wrap and my massage therapist was fantastic. We had time before our treatments to relax in the meditation atrium which was beautiful and so peaceful.  We also had time afterward to hit the spa shop and take advantage of an amazing sale they were having on some clothing. We are looking forward to another girls trip back to the Phoenician to explore some more services at the spa.

reviews.author: ghkava
reviews.title: Ótimo hotel.
