reviews.text: Ótimo hotel resort. A piscina é deslumbrante, ainda mais considerando o clima da região. O verão é um pouco escaldante, mas nas demais estações é muito agradável. Excelente local para compartilhar com a família.

reviews.author: Edward S
reviews.title: Large bugs found in room and bed
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the hotel. I arrived late and upon entering my room I was extremely surprised as their were large insects and bugs throughout my room and on the bed. I called guest services and informed them of the situation. They informed me of two choices. I could either move rooms or they could come and spray the room for bugs and I could spend the night in a room smelling of chemicals. It was so late that I declined both options and spent the night on the couch. I was appalled as when I informed the front desk of the situation in my room they were very unapologetic.

reviews.author: ASingh07
reviews.title: Love the service
reviews.text:
I have stayed at The Phoenician for 3 months in 2015 and i love the place a number of reasons 

1. Service - Excellent (and prompt) service
2. Location - Close to Fashion Square and old Scottsdale restaurants
3. View- Love the pool facing rooms that provide a view of both the city and the 4 or 5 pools

reviews.author: JDB
reviews.title: Looks Old
reviews.text: Very nice place. Was once a very high end place to be. Sadly however, this place is straight out of the 80s. It is a shame, the gardens and the landscaping are beautiful. The pool is average. All in all. The entire place needs a huge, huge upgrade. There are better resorts in the area, for the money, to stay at.

reviews.author: GolfandTravel007
reviews.title: Always relaxing
reviews.text: We relaxed and played a lot of golf. We have stayed here every year July usually but this time September. We never leave for a week until the town car takes us back to airport. Breakfast is awesome, spa and fitness center refreshing. Golf is perfect! Pool is outstanding. Lunch at the golf course is best. Both steak and Italian choices for dinner we enjoyed both. Love it here.

reviews.author: letsgofire
reviews.title: Impressive, stately resort but starting to fade
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel about 15 times between Autumn and Winter '15. This is one of the more visually impressive resorts in Arizona. It certainly has a "wow" factor with all the art and marble and elegant design.

The staff is extremely helpful and polite. There are some great bartenders and waiters at this hotel. There are great (though somewhat pricey) food options on-site, capped by the J&G steakhouse.

The resort has great amenities including a very impressive pool. You are right against the mountain too! A short taxi gets you right into the nightlife of Scottsdale.

There are two downsides of the hotel. First, the hotel is looking dated. It is due for a refurbishment, especially with the hotel rooms. Second, the resort is so large that some of the rooms are so far away from everything else. That's not for everyone.

reviews.author: TJ B
reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.text: This place is incredible!  They have guest service down to a T.  Staff was friendly and eager to help through my entire stay.  A huge shout-out to the concierge staff for some great local recommendations.

reviews.author: TucsonTravelGnome
reviews.title: There are better resorts for the money
reviews.text:
I came here with my family over the 4th of July weekend and was severely disappointed with the experience.  Between poor customer service and a disappointing room I'll probably take my business elsewhere in the future.

The customer service at the Phoenician was all around subpar.  When we first checked in the women behind the desk seemed bothered to have to deal with a customer.  She never acknowledged my preferred status until I brought it up.  My wife had a similar experience with the staff in the lobby when asking direction to a restroom.  Service at the pools was not any better.  The staff seemed frazzled at 10:00 AM in the morning and annoyed by simple requests.  Service was slow no matter where you were.

The room was only marginally better.  I have paid extra for a casita but decided not to upgrade to the nicer versions as the regular casita was describes as having a “desert view”.  This could not have been further from the truth.  Our desert view consisted of the back of a building overlooking the road.  Cars and trucks moving around the resort disturbed us in the morning and woke up our children. I called to ask for a different room when we first arrived but I was told all the casitas were full so we couldn’t be moved.  They did offer a pool view room in the main hotel, but that would have negated the convenience of the casita and required my pregnant wife to walk a lot further to the pools. No other compensation was offered by their staff.

The one bright spot was the splash pad for young children.  It is situated away from the pools so parents can let their children play without worrying they’ll fall into the water.  The slash pad was large and colorful with plenty of things for the kids to interact with.  Seating was limited around all the pools and umbrellas could be hard to come by so you need to get to the pool early if you want a spot.

Based on my experience I’ll probably never go back.  There are just too many better options for the price. They didn't even take the time to respond to my issues when I filled out the survey.  The one big draw was the splash pad, but short of that most resorts I’ve been to offered superior service and a better pool area.  For the same price or even a little less I can stay at the Ritz Carlton at Dove Mountain and be treated like a king.

reviews.author: Mary_from_MA
reviews.title: Fantastic resort for business or pleasure
reviews.text: I adored my trip to this top notch resort. The first half was for work, and the last few nights a friend joined me for fun.  The grounds and amenities were fantastic, as was the staff.  The weather was perfect and we enjoyed almost all of our meals outdoors. How they keep the bugs away, I have no idea. The pools and spa were idyllic and we had fun renting bikes and enjoying the area.  I can't wait to go back with my family.  I'll have to save my pennies -- not cheap.  But you get what you pay for: one of the great ones!!

reviews.author: Foodfuntravel
reviews.title: Villa Rooms are the way to go!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a long weekend away. What a treat! The staff was amazing and very attentive. The room was amazing - we had a view of the golf course and water feature. Tranquil, restful and wonderful. We enjoyed the fire pits at night. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Weekend Get Away At the Phoenician
reviews.text:
Weekend Get Away for my husband and I with daughter, her husband and 2 yr old grandson and Macy the dog.
Parked in underground garage with convenient air conditioned entrance. No parking fee. Handicap parking within steps of entrance. No animal fee.
Stayed in main building with connecting rooms first floor. Easy to take dog out for walk and throughout hotel.
Only negatives were the patio door track was pretty dirty. Seems to be that could be cleaned easily between guests. The rooms are dated and couch seemed dirty, at least appeared that way. There was an older room like dull odor noticeable. The rooms were overall pretty clean though and they were very spacious. The 2 sink bathroom is huge.
The only restaurant we visited on the property was The Relish and had delicious hamburgers for lunch. Great child’s pool.
A resort employee told us that there will be a big renovation next year. I hope so. The grounds are beautiful. The rooms just need to be updated. With some room renovations this resort would be perfect. Location is ideal for shopping and Old Town Scottsdale. Staff was really nice and accommodating. Would definitely stay again esp if rooms are renovated. Thanks for a nice weekend.

reviews.author: Cathy L
reviews.title: Top notch
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived I knew that the Phoenician was a special place.  From check in to check out, no detail was missed.  I was there for a trade show but that didn't matter.  5 stars all the way.  The room was spectacular.  Made me want to stay in rather than go out with the view of the planes landing at the airport.  Outside bar (can't remember name)is now one of my favorite all time places.  Relaxing.  Beautiful views.  This is a venue to remember.

reviews.author: swhite1967
reviews.title: Great service, great hotel, the pools and pool areas are showing their age
reviews.text:
The service at the Phoenician was beyond what I expected, it was great.  From the valet, the bellman to the folks at the bar, the was great - great service.  I especially thought the valet did a great job.  I mentioned that I needed to get my car cleaned and they said they would gladly take care of that for me.  I will be returning to the Phoenician.

The pools are getting a bit dated and need some cosmetic work, nothing too bad, but not up to the standards of the rest of the hotel.

reviews.author: Sam C
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay at Luxury Resort
reviews.text: What a fantastic property!  We thoroughly enjoyed our recent stay at this resort.  The pool amenities were excellent, which was important for staying in the desert in July.  The servers and attendants were always nearby and checking on us, bringing drinks, or refreshing our water.  We never had problems finding lounge chairs and the pool never seemed too crowded...despite many guests and conventions going on at the property.  The food at the resort was good.  We had a car, so we ate elsewhere typically, as the prices are steep for food at the resort (but that is expected and typical in my opinion).  Our room was nice and well cared for.  It was just slightly dated for a resort of this caliber...which is the only thing keeping me from giving 5 stars.  But it was definitely nothing to really complain about. Overall, we enjoyed it and would definitely recommend, especially during the summer when they have great rates.

reviews.author: Trent B
reviews.title: Sets a new standard for luxury
reviews.text: If you want to retreat from it all-in the middle of one of Americas larger metropolitan areas...may I recommend the Phoencian,  It as it all, excellent setting, wonderful southwestern atmosphere, excellent restaurant's, and service that is out of this world. Might be the best resort in my experience, certainly in the top 3.

reviews.author: tylrrtch
reviews.title: Best. Place. Ever.
reviews.text: I was recently at the Phoenician for a trip, and couldn't have asked for a better place place to stay! It's easily the most beautiful resort I've ever stayed at. The rooms are gorgeous and spacious, the food is to DIE for (especially Sunday brunch), and the entire place is extremely well kept. The pool(s) and the Oasis staff were by far the best part though! They were very friendly, and always available. Jake, Kris, Brian, Casey, and Stuart did a wonderful job making our stay both enjoyable and memorable! I will most definitely be back.

reviews.author: Deanna C
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: A great hotel with incredible staff.  The concierge was excellent with his recommendations.  The room was very clean and spacious.  Would recommend it to a friend.  We ate at the Oasis bar by the pool, which has smaller portion sizes but was delicious.  I highly recommend the hike up the mountain close by.

reviews.author: Jodijam
reviews.title: Outstanding resort! Something for everyone!
reviews.text: My visits to the Phoenician have been, by far,  the best resort experience I have ever had!  I have been to many resorts but the Phoenician has everything you'd want in a resort experience and more! You can tell from the moment you step on the property that you will be immersed in luxury! Marble staircases, a mother of the pearl lined pool, gorgeous fountains and chandeliers, and a lush and well manicured grounds that will take your breath away! The service is impeccable. Every single employee is happy, sincere and professional!  There is nothing they can't do for you! The rooms are equally as perfect.  One of my favorite things about the Phoenician is the wide range of activities and other amenities available at the property.  You literally do not have to leave because they have it all - a luxurious spa, one of a kind fitness classes, photography classes, meditation classes, a self guided art tour (there is a multi-million dollar art collection on the Phoenician's grounds), tennis, golf, shopping galore, 4 or 5 fabulous restaurants, and so much more! There are lots of activities for the children too!  The Phoenician Resort is an outstanding resort with something for everyone!

reviews.author: Emily W
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days on a recent trip to Scottsdale and loved it.  The property is gorgeous and the staff are so friendly!  Aside from the resort itself being fabulous, its super close to Scottsdale Fashion Square and Old Town Scottsdale.  Great area to be in!

reviews.author: Jesse M
reviews.title: Perfect end to a great vacation.
reviews.text: After two weeks on the road doing national parks with the family, we wanted to end on a high note and the Phoenician delivered. Kids had a blast in the pools and water slide and the resort was great.  Special thanks to Daniel on the front desk and Joe at the bell hop, they made our stay perfect.

reviews.author: mom24kt
reviews.title: Nice and Not So Nice
reviews.text: This was our first time to AZ and I booked this hotel 4 nights based on reviews and pictures and package deal through United Vacations. It Was very beautiful - like the pictures. The grounds, pool, staff and our room and restaurants we dined at did not disappoint. This hotel is not as exclusive as you might believe. We met a couple from Scottsdale at the pool who said they come there to swim, they do not stay there. Said They walked in through the back I guess by the canyon suites. Then the next day at the pool we met another person with her large family, same situation. They werent guests at the hotel, they just sneak in and come to swim. (Public pool?) There is a guard at the entrance, why not give him a list of daily check-in quests or ask for name/room number to get in? There were also 2 young boys my son was playing with at the pool who were trouble makers. My son left them when he realized they were trouble (he said to us) and played with other kids in the pool but the pool staff kept following him. He was scared they thought he was one of the boys they were looking for...and came and told us how the mgr questioned him about his brothers and asked where they went and how the mgrs kept following him. (He does not have any brothers). He was so upset because adults kept following him and he also thought they didnt believe him. There was a small comotion when the mgr came to talk to us; I was mortified (other guests were listening now) so we packed up and left the pool. Mgr couldve been more apologetic or clearer when he spoke to us (after a few moments i realized they knew my son wasnt trouble, but thought he knew the other boys who gave them fake name and room # or that we were friends) mgr couldve disfused situation with apology and send my son a treat to the room - something. Also on one night we sat on our balcony watching the poolside movie only to smell weed and incense above/near us. My kids and i went inside bc the smell was right on top of us. I called front desk but nobody to my knowledge checked it out. Smell continued. The steakhouse was delicious but seriously overpriced. We did enjoy the breakfast buffet and poolside lunch of sandwhiches, burgers and salad. Will not return because the incident at the pool.

reviews.author: CHIMoe
reviews.title: A great 5-star resort
reviews.text:
I've stayed at the Phoenician about 5 times and I cannot find anything major to complain about.  Resort is well maintained, I typically travel to Scottsdale during winter months and have stayed in several other resorts in Scottsdale.  I think the Phoenician has the best pool area.  Restaurants are nice, J&G steakhouse and the breakfast buffet is usually where I go when i'm there. 

Only con I find is it can be sometimes hard to get a chair in the pool area, even with there being so many pools at the resort. It can be very frustrating sometimes and pool service is very on-and-off.

reviews.author: Talkitup
reviews.title: Luxury at it's best.
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at this beautiful resort. The grounds are beautiful. The main building is made up of wings that surround 7 pools. We were in the north wing on the 6th floor. A wonderful view of the city at night. There are huge crystal chandeliers and marble everywhere. The only word is elegance where ever you turn. The staff is amazing. Your comfort and enjoyment of your stay is there top priority. We want to thank Michelle the concierge who helped us  make our 48th wedding anniversary memorable. while having a drink at the lounge we met Michelle Gonzelas. When she found out it was our anniversary she sent over a delicious chocolate cake with Happy Anniversary written on a piece of chocolate. From the people who clean ypour room to the bell hops and management their goal is to make you as comfortable and happy while staying at this amazing hotel.. The 7 pools are on different levels. We went to the Oasis pool. The staff there is terrific . One stand out was Orlando. He brought towels, water, and explained about the various pools and slide. This was extremely helpful since it was our first time staying there. The Mother of Pearl pool is lovely and across from it is a lake filled with Koi and ducks...The cactus garden is interesting . The paths easy to navigate. I highly recommend the Phoenician a destination I always wanted to visit.

reviews.author: Anne-Marie F
reviews.title: It's all about the service.....with smiles. Oh. And the incredible resort too!
reviews.text: Every single staff member, no matter their role, is genuinely friendly, courteous and smiling. Some of them have been here a long time - that says everything. We were there for a Dance conference. The one downside was initially our room. They overbooked double rooms so we were 'upgraded' to a King. So not really an upgrade as we wanted separate beds. First night I chose the pull-out - big mistake and they really should throw those out! However, they quickly recommended the cot and that was amazing. Real mattress - like sleeping in a cocoon - wonderful. We overlooked the pool area so great vista views beyond that too. The room was very clean, bright and nicely cooled! Big bathroom with two sinks. Coffee station with Starbucks (Keurig). Balcony was lovely but a bit hot to sit out during the day - perfect at night. Lots of excellent restaurant choices, great shops and a really good cafe/ice cream parlour. The pools - all three levels - are incredible.

reviews.author: RayDunkin35
reviews.title: Customer Service like Disney without the Mouse
reviews.text: This place knows service and how to go the extra mile. It was like being at Disney World without the mouse. Everything from check-in to , turn down service, poolside , spa , and many restaurants - this place has it going on! It is nestled in the Camelback mountains , so the views are plentiful.  The rooms were spacious and housekeeping left little treats like water, chocolates and even a eye glass cleaning cloth for my glasses I had on the counter. There was word no was never used and every ask I had was meet with a smile. Poolside was perfect with cabanas, fresh pitchers of ice cold water and delightful beverages. The spa treatments were all phenomenal even the light lunch we had was superb. We ate at all the restaurants on site and they were all culinary treats- even room service! A must do is the mid-day tea. You can dress up or go resort chic. Go hungry there is plenty of tiny sandwiches and desserts. It was as good as Claridge's without flying to England. We hardly left the resort , there was no need. We went as a girls trip and it was the perfect get-a-away. However , I did see plenty of family friendly activities and things for children- one being a water slide and cool kids pool. They also had a kids club. I may bring my little one next time. Drink plenty of water and enjoy the sunshine.

reviews.author: Greg W
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
We are staying at the resort now.  Check in was busy, but staff was very polite.  Actually all of the staff are very polite.  My main complaint is the price and quality of the food at the coffee shop.  We had two salads and two waters for lunch today.  The total cost was $ 32.00.  The waters were $5.00 a piece, and the salads were not worth $10.00 a piece.  

We are going to a near by store to get beverages and food.  

It would be nice not to have to leave the resort to eat and drink, but it is just to expensive and not worth it.

Also, the patio furniture is a little grimmie, but room was nice.

The bathrooms were very nice!!

reviews.author: LCK212
reviews.title: The Perfect Escape!
reviews.text: We recently spent 5 days at the Phoenician (our 2nd visit in 2 years.) It's become one of our favorite family destinations. Our daughter LOVES it there so much- the Funicians Kids Club is absolutely fantastic, and a must-book activity for children. Caitlin & Kristina do an incredible job taking care of the kids and making sure that the kids are having a fun, safe & wonderful time. They really go above & beyond in the service they provide. The recently revamped Surge sprayground & the pools are awesome. Be sure to avail yourself of all the features, like the cactus garden, Flight of the Phoenix and art collection- their website is very helpful for familiarizing yourself with what is on offer. The Phoenician is a very special gem of a place- we really treasure our time & the memories we make there. We look forward to returning often.

reviews.author: PurpleSkies101
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway, What a Treat!
reviews.text: I never take the time to leave reviews, but I was impressed with this resort.  My husband and I stayed for 3 nights for his birthday.  From the minute we checked in, to the minute we checked out, the staff was excellent.  All were very friendly, professional, and made you feel welcomed.  The resort itself was huge with several pools, shops, and restaurants.  Gabe at the bar by the pool was great, again very friendly and ensured I was taken care of.  Our room had a desert (mountain) view with a balcony, it was beautiful.  The room was clean and the bathroom was grand, with double sinks, large bathtub, and separate shower.  We slept well on the comfortable bed and enjoyed the quiet.  I highly recommend this resort for anytime, whether it's a romantic stay or a fun stay with friends or family.

reviews.author: jamie r
reviews.title: Too overpriced for the quality/ambiance of the resort
reviews.text: I was sadly disappointed in the Phoenician considering the extremely high price tag.  We paid $280 a night, including resort fees, in the highest temperature month of Phoenix, so I was expecting something really lovely.  Instead, I found the resort to be dated and in need of renovating.  Either they should put some effort into upgrades, or drop the price.  The carpets were old and sad, the room was decorated with pea green 70s style furniture (that was dirty!), and the grounds were just so so.  Also, I had paid for a private cabana and was told it was exclusively adults, only to find a small sign prohibiting children that was constantly ignored.  We never received the amenities included, had to continually ask server to give us the stuff I had paid for. I had extensively researched where to take my sister for her 40th birthday, realizing that I would pay a hefty rate to get a luxurious experience, and I am really sad that this is where we ended up.  Totally not worth the price.

reviews.author: Larry W
reviews.title: Great Resort for relaxation and fun
reviews.text: An outstanding resort for relaxation and family fun.  One of the finest if not the finest resort in the Phoenix area and i have stayed at many of them.  Great pools for the family for fun.  Staff at resort are the best or one of the best staffs around.  If you want fine dining you can have it and the food and service is the best.  If you want just a snack or burger they have places for that also.  Service and accommodation by the entire staff is first class all the way.  They also a slide for kids and for the young at heart. Summer rates are very reasonable.

reviews.author: VacationsfromTx
reviews.title: Great pleasure trip
reviews.text:
Research a resort in Phoenix area for relaxation and mountains; this place is it! I took a solo trip and found the people of Phoenix very friendly & Hotel staff was wonderful, beautiful grounds I self toured and every inch of this huge property had unique statues, nice pools, quite grounds, a few rabbits, a large variety of cacti. While I was there it sprinkled rain and the people were shocked... It hardly rains in Scottsdale I guess, hot but no humidity...wonderful. No traffic, easy to drive around all the cities. MUST DO-rent a car at the airport, there are $10 a day deals! I rented a Cadillac ATS. 
The room was large, bed extra comfortable best sleep ever. Bathroom top notch. I have a handicap nephew and informed him there was a handicap lift over the pool and hot tub which I thought was very considerate, most hotels don't consider handicap persons might want to enjoy the water with their family. Shopping was the best within close proximity. Food on property very expensive but a great experience. A must see resort

reviews.author: Sue C
reviews.title: Every year for 5-6 weeks
reviews.text: I take my mom here for 4-6 weeks every year, she has Alzheimer's and I keep coming back because it is familiar to her. She just turned 89. Stayed Feb. 28th - May 5th. Chris and chad, bellmen are wonderful. James the greeter is awesome! Front desk is horrid, rooms are old and mine always has cockroaches. They tell me because the mountain is behind us. STOP!  Christine and Alex at ill Tarrazo are the only ones that know what's going on!! I probably will not go back because except for the few people mentioned no one gives a damn. Every year half of the staff has quit. Don't blame them. Becoming a business group destination, they sure don't care about people that have come for 6 years and stay as long as we do!

reviews.author: Lee H
reviews.title: This resort is HUGE, yet so amaxing
reviews.text:
Although I didn't stay at The Phoenician, I spent a couple days here while attending a travel conference.  First off, the resort is beautiful.  The designs and touches exude luxury.

The resort is really large, so bring your walking shoes, or simply take advantage of the gold carts that will whisk you from one location to the next.

There are several dining options on site, which will satisfy your appetite without question.  Of course, being on a resort, the prices are a little inflated, but the food is delicious, so splurge a little.  Your taste buds will thank you.

During the summer months, The Phoenician becomes an even more affordable luxury due to the Arizona heat.  Take advantage of the specials for a great getaway by yourself or with friends and family.

reviews.author: Marlyn S
reviews.title: Wonderful Golfing in Arizona
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort! First time golfing and it was such a wonderful experience. The clubs, the golf cart, the practice greens, and of the course were impeccable. I love the views of the course. I'm from Miami. There are no mountains, so to see them from afar and play gold beside them was memorable. I highly recommend this resort for golfing. It was also very comfortable to play in as it was not very busy.

reviews.author: Dee J
reviews.title: Rest and Relaxation awaits you...
reviews.text: Scenery is impeccable. You have all the major amenities as a 5 star hotel. Wait, this is a 5 star hotel. The staff is very friendly and attentive. The pool is so relaxing. The atmosphere screams nothing, that right!!! This is a peaceful and quiet facility for the whole family.

reviews.author: IrishRover
reviews.title: First class hotel stayed for business wish I was here for vacation
reviews.text: Hotel grounds and staff are first class.  The exercise room is fantastic, pools are great and the grounds are scenic.  I was here for a three day conference and was impressed enough that I would come back in the fall or spring and enjoy the resort.  My only complaint was the wifi in my room was spotty and my cell phone dropped to many calls I beileve it was my room , coupled with the mountain and concrete

reviews.author: KerBearLV
reviews.title: Will definitely be back!
reviews.text:
We are already planning on coming back!!  Customer service was EXCELLENT.  Brian at the pool was always helpful, greeted everyone and took care of everyones needs, and always had a smile on his face. Ice water was constantly refilled for you and the pool was very relaxing.  Happy hour at the Relish Burger Bistro was great! Wish I got the bartenders name as she was friendly as well.  The gym was very nice and spacious.
Our room was in the casita, close to the pools and golf course.  This was very convenient   The room was very clean, bathroom was huge and the shower was amazing!  We sleep very well.  Looking forward to coming back.  Again, great customer service!!!

reviews.author: Gary M
reviews.title: Great Hotel  - July 14th-19th 2015
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 5 nights Midweek through to Sunday.   3 nights were business and the last 2 were more pleasure orientated.  Being the height of summer rates were favourable

The rooms are fitted out to a very high standard, and were very quiet, ensuring a good nights sleep.  The facilities from the conference area, through to the Restaurants, Pools, Bar and Spa are all top quality.

We ate in the il Terrazzo for Breakfast and lunch on a couple of occasions, and was top quality.   The Buffet Breakfast was great value, and of a high standard.  J&G Steakhouse served superb cocktails and Steaks cooked to perfection with a great view over the valley.  For less formal dining is the Relish Burger Bistro, with a choice of 70+ beers a great alternative.  Also the cheapest place on the resort for a 16oz beer at $4  

Wifi Coverage is brilliant, from the pool to the spa and all corners of the hotel, so you can always stay connected at fast speed if that is important to you.

The pools were great and on 3 levels, so you don't feel like its too busy, with lots of staff on hand to sort out towels, iced water and take bar/food orders. The Gym and Spa facilities were also very good.

Throughout the resort, the plentiful staff were always helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: roberto a
reviews.title: Inadequate staff very unfriendly, restaurants poor service food quality terrible
reviews.text: Facilities are very nice. the staff was unfriendly.  The food and service at the Terrace Restaurant was terrible, the manager was responsive to our complaints.  The Steak Restaurant was even worse, the steaks were cold we had to send them back twice and they were still cold, the service was unprofessional and slow. The manager was attentive but did not solve the problems, not what you would expect of a luxury resort. A really bad experience.

reviews.author: SissiSol
reviews.title: Wahnsinns Resort!!!
reviews.text:
Luxushotel zu erstaunlich kleinem Preis!
Wir waren für 2 Nächte während unserer Rundreise in dieser tollen Anlage. Das Hotel wurde uns von unserem Reisebüro empfohlen. Wir haben es bewusst zum Entspannen und für unsere Kinder gewählt. Die Poollandschaft war top, die Zimmer riesengroß mit allem Komfort! Auch die Restaurants lassen nicht zu Wünschen übrig - wir haben im Relish Burger Bistro den besten Burger ever gegesssen! Die anderen Restaurant scheinen eher gehobenerer Klasse. Frühstück kann ich nicht bewerten, wir haben immer in der Stadt gegessen.
Dafür, dass es ein riesen Hotel ist wirkt es aber nicht unpersönlich und der Service war immer top!

reviews.author: valleycritic2015
reviews.title: July 17-19 2015
reviews.text: This last weekend was a terrible visit.  After reading some of these positive reviews I was wondering if I had the right hotel.  I'm only taking the time to write this review so that other people can save their money and stay at much better resorts for less money.  This was a staycation for us and we expected much more than we received based on our past experience from other resorts in the valley.  First of all, our room's shower had mold all over in the grout and it was disgusting.  Who would expect this uncleanliness at a supposed 5 diamond resort?  Disgusting!  Then our cable reception in the room didn't work most of the time and it was frustrating at night when we wanted to settle down and watch tv.  There's no excuse for either of these things.  However, the check in attendant had the excuse that this is an older resort and they would try to have it looked at eventually.  What?  No apology?  Yuck!  There also wasn't any wind storm near this resort during this stay so there's no excuse of cable interruption.  I was also extremely displeased with the pool attendants all around.  We almost had to beg for towels and then staff was slow to get us towels when asked.  The bathrooms were gross and hadn't been cleaned throughout the day.  We didn't experience any friendly or helpful staff besides our darling bell hop who brought our luggage up.  We asked someone about breakfast restaurants around 11am and were told we were out of luck.  Nobody ever offered us the brunch that was available that we later discovered on our own after the fact.  Oh, and the air conditioner in the hallway was leaking water all over the place from the ceiling. We notified some staff members of this after almost falling on the tile floor from it and it wasn't even slightly touched until the next day.  The quality of service REALLY is missing from this place and at this price for our stay we're extremely disappointed.  I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone local let alone to vacationers who don't know any better.  One final touch, we also experienced a couple birthday parties for children at the pool and they played in the supposed "adult" area as well without any pool attendant supervision.  This shouldn't happen.  Why have an "adult" only area when kids are allowed to play in it?  HUGE disappointment all around.

reviews.author: Denise H
reviews.title: Unbelievable
reviews.text: This is one of the most beautiful hotels I have ever stayed at anywhere.  Spectacular views, a great spa, world class golf all in one place.  They have many restaurants at the resort and you can't go wrong with any of them.  My top pick is J&G Steakhouse.  Unbelievable view and steaks as good as a NY steakhouse.

reviews.author: jsmsomerset
reviews.title: Great setting, Excellent Servicce and staff
reviews.text:
We booked our 2 week stay (June-July)at The Phoenician together with our flights with British Airways. We arrived to find they had upgraded our room for the length of our stay.
It is clean, comfortable and friendly even though large. The concierge service (Michelle in particular) is excellent. Great experience on Friday evenings with The Flight of The Phoenix (birds of prey talk, flight etc). Live band and fantastic fireworks display for the 4rth July. Walk around the Cactus Garden is great (if you are quiet you will get the chance to see and photographs lizards and humming birds). Fair choice of restaurants. You can also use their business centre FOC to print your boarding cards. There is also a golf course and swimming pools (4feet depth)

reviews.author: Diane S
reviews.title: Hot in Scottsdale
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Phoenician before an was slightly disappointed this trip. As always the staff was exceptional.  The room was clean. Great big bathroom.  But room was hot.  The  air conditioning just wasn't getting it done.  My coworkers in other rooms on the same floor had the same experience.  For the price, I should be able to sleep without sweating.  It makes all the other fabulous things about this resort not as exciting.

reviews.author: arubadive
reviews.title: check your credit card!!!
reviews.text: I have had this problem before at this lovely resort. They charge your card when you check in for any incidental charges that "might" occur. Then you check out . You pay your bill in full. You check your card a week later and under pending charges  the incidental charges are STILL showing up on your card. I checked out a week ago today and they are still on there. I have called 4 times and get the complete run around!!!! This is not their money. It is a way of holding onto charges recieved and goes against my credit line. This is not to be tolerated. Beware when they run your card at checkin !! you just might be surprised of the huge bill!! still waiting for refund. July 17th 2015.

reviews.author: Stacy275
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: My daughter and I thoroughly enjoyed our recent stay at The Phoenician!  It is a beautiful property with lovely grounds, nice pools and comfortable rooms.  We stayed in a casita which was very nice.  I have stayed at several hotels in the Scottsdale area and would recommend this property.

reviews.author: Snot Finder
reviews.title: Great summer experience
reviews.text: Stayed with a family of six in the middle of July.  Rooms were large, clean, and very comfortable.  All pools were clean and refreshing.  Food was excellent, even the poolside menu was very good.  Afternoon pool service was a bit lacking in attention but was great earlier in the day (started to close down by about 4pm).  One half of the mid level pool, near the Oasis restaurant, was a quiet area for adults only, but the mother of pearl pool at the bottom was for all of the family and was great.  Water slide hours were also a bit limiting.  Staff and service were excellent. The ice cream parlor was great for breakfast and for ice cream in the afternoon (half price from 2-5pm).  We used self parking that was in a garage under the main hotel and was very convenient - minimal walking to the elevator. Our rooms were at the far end and were a bit of a walk.  We did get a breakfast included package, and that basically meant anything we ordered before 11am was covered.

reviews.author: maria a
reviews.title: Шикарное место
reviews.text: Шикарный огромный отель. Поражает территория, система бассейнов и фонтанов. На территории много маленьких кроликов. В баре при бассейне самые демократичные цены на напитки и еду. Все очень чисто. Интересная детская площадка с фонтанчиками. Есть отдельные кабинки

reviews.author: LeahSydney01
reviews.title: I would give this a 6 rating if I could
reviews.text:
I loved the Phoenician.

We (2 adults, 2 children aged 14 and 11) stayed here for 2 nights to recuperate after 2 weeks touring Sedona, the Grand Canyon, Monument Valley and Lake Powell.

The pools are superb.  Huge, clean and picturesque.  Not crowded.  Sublime. A great place to relax.

The resort is ideally situated at the base of Camelback Mountain.  The public areas are beautifully laid out and decorated.

Check out the on- site cactus garden.  There are critters scurrying around everywhere and the garden itself is stunning.

Our room was large and easily accommodated the 4 of us.  We had a balcony.  Huge bathroom.  

The only downside for me was that the aircon throughout the building was a bit cold for me, although this did not seem to bother others.

reviews.author: Kerry22201
reviews.title: Great family resort!
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort last night.  The kids loved the many pools and 160 foot+ slide.  My only suggestion would be to open the slide at 8.30 or 9.00 am, rather than 10.30 am.  The service and food were impeccable.  The room were well-appointed and comfortable.  We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: MBF
reviews.title: Luxurious Environment With Impeccable Service
reviews.text: This hotel certainly earns the status of Luxury Collection.  The staff were attentive and helpful.  Superb customer service.  I really enjoyed the nightly wine tasting and epicurean delights; this was a complimentary service.  I made a few purchases at the hotel shops. I was impressed by the wide selection of clothing and other travel related items. Moreover, the prices were very reasonable (not my typical experience).

reviews.author: Gbaykus
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: Visited this hotel and spa during spring break. Sunset is spectacular. Spa was very relaxing. I got a massage from a lady who was a local and worked for Phonecian for decades. You can judge a place from the way the staff treats you which is often a reflection of how their employer treats them. Since I used the spa, they allow me and my son to use their pools. It was crowded but very well run, clean. Will return to spend couple of nights soon.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: Prepare to be pampered
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician while on a company retreat. This whole resort was beautiful. We were lucky enough to use the spa, go golfing, spend time at the pool and dine at the onsite restaurants. Every single staff member was so friendly it really made this an over the top experience. The catering for our group of about 80 people was delicious. Not your typical banquet hall dining experience! They had us at different parts of the resort grounds each night and the food just got better and better. Rent a cabana at the pool and you won't regret it. It's the perfect spot to relax after spa treatments, morning yoga or golf.

reviews.author: phxnickd
reviews.title: Pleasant staycation
reviews.text: This is the 2nd time we did a staycation at the Phoenician. Always an enjoyable and relaxing time. The front desk staff were very pleasant. The room was well maintained. One of the most memorable experiences was at the Café & Ice Cream Parlor. We stopped in mid-afternoon for a refreshing treat to cool off with and Sabrina was just a pleasure to visit with.

reviews.author: Barry H
reviews.title: Fantastic, even in the heat
reviews.text:
Went here for the long weekend.  This is a fantastic property, very high end.  Enjoyed the 3 levels of pools, service was over the top.  The performance for July 4th was very well done, blanket provided to sit on the lawn, live band, fireworks, food.  We stayed in the casitas overlooking the pool and yard.  
Golf course was very courteous and not stuck up.  Provided clubs, shoes and top notch service here also.  The course was in amazing shape.  
Would suggest this property to anyone.  The reviews are well deserved.

reviews.author: Dirk W
reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.text: Wow. Wow. And Wow again. Get a casita. The pools are devine. The rooms lovely and the service impeccable. Love the jackrabbits running around the grounds.  The bathrooms in the rooms are large and luxurious. The location is fantastic. Close to both Scottsdale and Phoenix. Make sure to visit the cactus garden at sunset.

reviews.author: Elizabeth D
reviews.title: Fantastic 4th of July
reviews.text: I booked this resort through the American Express Fine Hotel and Resorts program.  I stayed Thursday-Sunday over this past 4th of July.  My young daughter and I had a great time.  Several events for kids and families, very well planned and executed to the smallest detail.  The property and rooms were clean and lovely.  The beds were wonderful.  Every staff member we came across asked us if we were having a good time and/or said hello.  This will be out new 4th of July tradition.  It was a vacation for me and my 5 year old.  Thanks for the great get away.

reviews.author: stasiav
reviews.title: The happiest place on earth....for grownups:)
reviews.text: Spectacular, Spectacular, Spectacular.  You pay for everything as you go, but the service is astonishing.  The Spa was lovely, poolside service was unbelievable.  Our husbands enjoyed the golf.  Deciding on the room location was tricky.  in the back you are at the foothill of the mountain.  Quiet, but you are literally yards away from the mountain.  The poolside has great view of the resort.  We really enjoyed the fire pits at night on the terrace. The staff was so accommodating.  We were so happy there, we didn't want to go to dinner, so they brought dinner to us.

reviews.author: gigilum
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This is a late review.  We stayed at The Phoenician during the summer and despite the scorching heat we had a wonderful time.  The staff was attentive and friendly and the grounds were incredible.  The room was clean and spacious and the bathroom was functional.  We would definitely stay here again although not in the summer.

reviews.author: Eyebeach
reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: From the moment we got there to when left we could not felt more pampered! The lobby has different drinks and snacks. We stayed at the canyon suites. Happy hour was 4-5 with 3 different wines and starters. The breakfast was good. We got $40/person credit for breakfast thru our Amex card. The tennis and golf was great! The work out room was cool and with lots of machines and water etc. We love the place and would return in a heart beat. Probably the nicest hotel I've stayed at!

reviews.author: Denise M
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: My first time staying at The Phoenician and I can't believe I waited this long! I stayed in a casita which I kind of expected to be more like a guest house but I was not disappointed with the room. All the amenities and the kind and professional room service staff was amazing! The used my name and so did the front desk. The concierge Robert was impressive! His clear speech and enthusiasm really impressed me! He booked my dinner reservation and even text me the confirmation while I enjoyed myself at the pool. I loved it! Not to mention dinner at the steakhouse was decadent!! Oh my I was in heaven with the Summer Menu and the unique take on Foie Gras. The sommelier Ryan and our server made wonderful wine pairings for me and my guest and we loved it! I miss the Phoenician already :(

reviews.author: Delegal
reviews.title: Still a gem.
reviews.text: She's getting old,Mobutu it doesn't show. The rooms are wonderful and the staff is amazing. Everything is 5 star. The hiking trails nearby are great. The food at the pool was just OK. I would recommend this hotel highly.

reviews.author: FreeholdNewJersey
reviews.title: Dissapointed with check in
reviews.text: Starwood members and we're waiting almost 2 hours for our room, which we reserved  3 months ago. Keep telling us the room is being cleaned. Very dissapointing for a 5 star resort....wasting our time. How difficult is it to clesn a room for almost 2 hours....and we come here once a year too.

reviews.author: FamilyTraveler0978
reviews.title: Perfect Birthday Weekend
reviews.text:
This is one of my favorite places to just arrive at and relax... that was what I was looking for. The Phoenician is not trendy, just relaxing. At the Phoenician, I can simply let all the cares slip away  and let the staff attend to my concerns and wants. The concierge did a great job coordinating our spa appointments, meals, hikes, cabana. We ate at Il Terrazza and the J and G steak house. The chefs and wait staff coordinated the dietary needs of the group seamlessly. The food was excellent.

One thing I understand better, this is a large resort. If ice is needed pronto in a room, it is not going to happen. And where you stay impacts your experience. I enjoy a room in the main building on the second or third floor, closer to the lobby with a resort view. The room placement impacts the ambience of the whole Phoenician experience. Also, I wonder why there are not misters about the cabanas.

reviews.author: Steve O
reviews.title: Versaille-ish...
reviews.text:
As Charles Keating's monument to himself, this hotel is billed as one of the most expensive ever built and you should treat yourself to this exercise in opulence if ever in or around Phoenix... Or Denver, or anywhere, really, wherever you are, you should hop a plane to Phoenix and experience a property that was Charles Keating's monument to himself, and set new lows for financially creative impropriety,and eventually earning him a taste of the good life in prison... 
Don't let a checkered past keep you from enjoying this amazing bender of self-indulgence, though.  Live like a king for a few days...

reviews.author: AMJ92
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: I stayed here for a few nights in June and I loved every minute of it. The pools to the gym are great and the service is very good. I hope to be back soon. One thing that bothered me though was the lack of enforcement of the adults-only policy in one of the pools. There should be at least one pool (out of the 5 or 6 they have) reserved only for adults (as this one I'm discussing was supposed to be) and the pool attendants should enforce that without any comments from swimmers, as who wants to be the one to kick 10 kids out of the pool?.

reviews.author: 1208christine
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing stay
reviews.text: My recent stay at the Phoenician was quite disappointing....the good things 1) the room and bathroom were nice, clean, and had good quality towels and linens. Plenty of space and the ac worked great.  2) the golf course was nice and easy to get a tee time and reasonably priced 3) we stayed in a casita and having self parking close to our room was convenient.  4) the bellman was knowledgeable, friendly and helpful.  The bad things...1) the service at the pool was horrible, there were not enough waiters, no one around to take our drink or food orders, no one to help with pool chairs, towels or umbrellas.  2) the few servers we did find at the pool were too busy and had bad attitudes about serving us, they seemed to hate their jobs! 3) the bathrooms at the pool were not cleaned throughout the day and by mid-day they were gross!  4) there seemed to be quite a few local people at the pool having parties.  The first one we encountered was on Friday and it was for a guy mid-30's and he had about 20 of his friends join him at the pool with lots of pitchers of sangria and buckets of beer.  I was fortunate enough to be sitting right in front of him and his party and got to hear from his friend all about his stay in several maximum security prisons as his excuse for not being able to get in the pool because of his prison ankle bracelet that couldn't get wet.  We moved to a different area of the pool.  The second "party" encounter was on Saturday, a family was there celebrating their sons 12th birthday and invited 15 of his friends and camped out at the adult pool!  They weren't as bothersome as the older party although they were constantly running back and forth and used a lot of the pool chairs.  The third party we found was also on Saturday and it was a 5 year old's birthday and he had 10-15 family and friends all enjoying the pool.  It seemed like the pool was used by local residents as a club house pool rather than for the hotel guests as a resort pool.  I felt like I was at my local YMCA pool not on vacation enjoying a relaxing afternoon at the pool.  I complained to the hotel manager at the front desk (since I couldn't find any sort of pool manager) and he apologized, was surprised about the locals and said someone would be in touch with me.  I haven't heard anything back from the hotel...extremely disappointing and I will not be returning to the Phoenician.

reviews.author: waggers999
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 4 nights in June whilst attending a conference. My room was lovely, spacious and bathroom great (separate bath and shower). Had a balcony on the room but only downside was that it was at the back of the block and overlooked the car-park, would recommend ensuring you have a good view over the pools, lake or golf course. Dependent on where your room is you may have a long walk to the main reception area, so worth noting when booking a room.

Staff were great, very friendly. I eat breakfast one morning in the hotel, the others were laid on as part of the conference and it was amazing, highly recommend. Bar was good and access onto the terrace. 

The pool are is obviously a huge draw given the weather was 115+ but did not get to use much, but lovely.

All in all a great hotel...

reviews.author: Angelina Khalili Azarova
reviews.title: A nice weekend getaway
reviews.text:
This is a great place close to shopping, unique dining and family fun. 
The pool is friendly for all ages, a few bars around the pool to get a drink and hang out. Ramada's are also available for rent. 
Customer service shined high through out the resort. A few names I remember are Catherine from Surge, she was friendly and quick to help you stay cool in the hot AZ weather. Bianca from room service, a nice voice who helped me with my order. Also, Issac, another fellow from room service, he was a nice addition to the start of our morning. 
I would recommend this location for a romantic getaway, with rose petals and wine or a family day at the pool with a water slide and family movies at dusk. There are also kid friendly activities (babysiting), golfing and a full spa.
While your here take a walk to the on site waterfalls, koi ponds, and keep an eye out for the many local bunnies that roam the resort!

reviews.author: PointAfter
reviews.title: Treated Like a King
reviews.text: Stayed here for several nights and had the privilege of staying in a Presidential suite. Amazing! More than any normal person could ask for. Staff was very courteous and always ready to lend assistance. Special "Thanks" to Taylor at the front desk, Joel from in-room dining, Chris from the bell-stand and Christina G. from housekeeping. Each of them remembered us by name and went out of their way to make our stay enjoyable. The grounds are well maintained and the meeting space was practically perfect in size and configuration. I hope to return again one day soon!

reviews.author: Jennys_World
reviews.title: Such a cool place
reviews.text: The ground are super BEAUTIFUL. I can't get over how wonderful this place is. When we arrived, our room wasn't ready, so they gave us drink vouchers for the bar (any drinks).  We waited about 30 minutes, no biggie, we enjoyed our free drinks. The rooms are nice. I didn't spend a lot of time in the room. We were always in the pool swimming or by the garden reading or just napping outside, this property is big. The only thing I didn't like was when we are at the outdoor cafe, the birds would come and eat at the table next to you. And I saw bird poop too which is not a good sight especially in a restaurant. Other than that this hotel is a must.

reviews.author: Santan2020
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: This is my second stay at this resort. I honestly have to say that I was disappointed this time. The people at the front desk asked if I want to join their Green Program. It really did not mater to me. They really did not fully explain to me what to expect from it. I thought they did not replace towels and the sheets. That is fine with me since I'm staying a few days. To my surprise the room attendant does not come to the room at all. Not even to make up my bed?!  I don't know what's green about not making up the bed. I don't care if it is the same sheet. Just make my bed for me. I was asked what news paper I would like and I told them the local paper. I did not receive it on the next morning. I only had one paper cup for the coffee. Used it and put in trash. Did not get anymore since no room attendant around.looks to me green is more like maximize profits.

reviews.author: MGM
reviews.title: Lovely Desert Setting
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Phoenician for about 11 years, arriving in March during the high season.  The hotel is very comfortable and the rooms are often quite lovely.  This year is was undergoing a renovation in the casitas.   In general the casitas are a good place to stay, better than the rooms  in the main hotel.  In the past I stayed in the Canyon Suites which were great but isolated from the main part of the hotel.  I like this location.  If you are doing business in Scottsdale it is great.   The pools are good and the spa is nice, although expensive for a massage, etc.  I find this a good place to stay in the area. I believe that golfers enjoy this hotel very much.  Family orientated.

reviews.author: Eric D
reviews.title: LOVE LOVE LOVE
reviews.text: I love Arizona and Scottsdale, and this hotel was just beautiful. The grounds were well kept, the interior very stylish. The rooms were very clean and we loved the pool. Food was amazing. The hotel is amazing and I 5/5 recommend it.

reviews.author: Alan B
reviews.title: Beautiful setting and very peaceful
reviews.text: My wife and I recently attended a conference in Scottsdale and stayed at the Phoenician.  What a beautiful setting.  We stayed in a casita. The room was wonderful and the beds were amazingly comfortable.  The pools were great and just perfect to cool off on a very hot day.  The staff was so friendly and helpful.  Everyone said Hi and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed.  Be sure to take time to visit the cactus garden.  It was beautiful.  The grounds were immaculate.  It was just a very beautiful and peaceful setting.  We left rejuvenated and relaxed.  The only thing I might recommend is to have self serve ice machines available without having to bug a staff member to constantly be filling it for us. But other than that it was wonderful.

reviews.author: KareninArizona
reviews.title: Second Visit!
reviews.text:
We visited the Phoenician for a second time.  The first was last summer.  Overall, the experience was great.  Pools were not super crowded.  We never had a problem getting a chair.  We had the Grand Deluxe Room which was on the third floor with a view of the pool and mountains.  This year we had to ask for a different room twice.  The first time they tried to put us on the first floor (where you look at bushes) and the second time it was on the west side of the building where we looked at a cement slab.  That's not what we wanted.  It ends up we heard several other people saying the same thing at the pool - they had to keep asking for a different room, but they did end up with the one that made them happy.  The pool service was fantastic - much different than what we have experienced at other pools.  We ate at Relish once which was good and low-key, once at the Oasis at the pool which was fine and we also had Afternoon Tea which was excellent.  Parking is easy and underground so that's nice not to walk out to a hot car.  

The only item that I could recommend is to update the rooms a bit, including the electronics.  I'm not sure why hotels still have those old phones in the toilet area in a bathroom?  I don't think I've ever made a call in there!  

We will hopefully be back!

reviews.author: jsikes17
reviews.title: 5th anniversay stay-June 2015
reviews.text:
The Phoenician sets the standard for customer service.  If you want a first class resort with great pools, decent rooms, plenty of dining options, then the Phoenician is for you.  
Golf courses are very nice.  The pro shop went out of their way to help me get setup.   Steakhouse at Phoenician was great.  Great atmosphere, great cystomer service, and unique meal options.    
We ate going to make this or annual "staycation".

reviews.author: cleverbull77
reviews.title: Fabulous Spa, Golf and Pool
reviews.text: Although not a native Phoenician, I live here now and love the staycations in the sizzling summer months.  Went with another couple, lunched, then the ladies had spa treatments while the guys golfed.  It was fabulous beyond expectation!  The staff reportedly is NOT allowed to say, "No" but rather offer alternatives without saying the word. (Try asking for the obscure and you'll find this is still true!). I had a facial and massage - both treatments were done well with great care and service.   The pools are limitless, but do go early to find your favorite spot.

reviews.author: Serge C
reviews.title: TRES BIEN...
reviews.text: Bon accueil, chambre tres grande, terrasse agreable, lits tres epais et confortables, tres grande salle de bains assez luxueuse. Nous avions deja sejourne dans cet hotel mais dans les chambres villa en bas. La piscine est agreable, le golf tres bien( pas essaye) mais le club house etait sympa et le personnel agreable. Il est evident que les chambre aux extremites qui ne donnent pas sur la piscine sont a deconseiller.Sinon enormement de chambres en bonne position.

reviews.author: Kris D
reviews.title: Don't waste your money on the poolside cabanas.
reviews.text:
I stayed at the hotel at the end of April and reserved a cabana at the adults only pool for Saturday.  I was very underwhelmed by the experience.  I assumed someone would meet us at the cabana and explain the amenities included.  Instead, someone in my party stumbled on the information on the food menu half way through the day.   We only received the fruit and desserts when we asked (it wasn’t proactively offered) and we did not receive the cool face towels, newspaper, wifi, sunscreen kit/lip balm, or misters - all which were supposed to be included in the $350 cost.  Our “dedicated server” was actually taking care of a bunch of people all over the pool – not just in our area.  The service was the same as we had the day before at the other pool sans cabana.  

For $350 – expected to get some sort of VIP treatment.   We were disappointed.  I shared my disappointed via email through their website and never received a response.  

Overall the staff was friendly but slow - especially in the restaurants. The food was delicious - once it finally arrived.  The hotel felt a little outdated but the rooms were fine.

reviews.author: CMahle
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway
reviews.text: I came with 2 of my friends for a relaxing weekend and we weren't disappointed! The check-in was a seamless process & they upgraded us to a beautiful room that had a generously sized balcony with amazing views of the mountains, pool & hotel grounds. Shortly after check-in we went to Relish for happy hour and the food and drinks were reasonably priced, and the service was great. When we returned to the room, we noticed they had delivered a cute welcome note with a bottle of wine and cheese board! How kind! Throughout the rest of our time there we enjoyed the pool, which was the perfect temperature- nice enough for the ducks to join in! There were plenty of chairs, and shortly after finding a few a server promptly brought us chair towels and took our order for drinks. Also, a huge plus is that the pool/jacuzzi are open 24/7! On our last day we enjoyed the Afternoon High Tea which was fantastic and the atmosphere was so fun. We also ordered room service which was delivered quickly and still hot! They even offer follow up service to come take the dishes away. All of the staff was exceptional. Highly recommended on all accounts. The only minor suggestion I have is that I wish their convenience store for sunscreen/beverages was open later than 5PM! 5 stars all the way. Thanks Phoenician!

reviews.author: SFO-PHL-traveler
reviews.title: Great luxurious hotel, with rockstar front desk agent
reviews.text:
Two of my business colleagues and I spent a night at the Phoenician and had a fabulous stay.  The hotel rooms are very comfortable in an old-school luxurious way.  It's clear the rooms are not recently updated, but the decor is relatively timeless.  The beds are comfortable and bathroom well laid out.  Our view was stunning and the pool was great.

We had a brief snafu when checking into the resort.  Jessica at the front desk went out of her way to ensure that it was immediately rectified and treating us in such a hospitable manner.  She offered us a complimentary drink in the hotel bar as an apology.  This was just such a nice touch.  Her genuine kindness was very palpable and she should be celebrated by her team.  

I would definitely recommend this hotel for a relaxing respite in the desert.

reviews.author: d1zzyg1rl1968
reviews.title: Phantastic stay!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician over Memorial Day weekend!  Hotel was beautiful, with live entertainment nightly, albeit a cruise ship lounge act, it was still entertaining.  We loved the outdoor terrace bar.  Our room was on the 3rd floor, which is main floor with a view of the pools and Tempe.  Staff is beyond friendly from front desk to wait staff!  I would most certainly go back and would also recommend it to my friends!  Just LOVELY!

reviews.author: Christina F
reviews.title: A great place to stay.
reviews.text: We live locally and spent the weekend here recently to celebrate our anniversary away from the kiddos.  We've also stayed during the summer for various staycations.  The service is always superb regardless of when you are here.  Regardless, if you are paying 600/night during the high season or less during the summer, you always get the best treatment.  The staff at this hotel is exceptional. even the person who took the reservation.  She made our visit extra special by remembering our anniversary. Spa has excellent services, Restaurants are great. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Julie C
reviews.title: Beautiful pool area
reviews.text: We were only here 2 nights but I could have stayed a week without leaving the property.  A variety of pools and restaurants/bars.  We enjoyed Relish., Thirsty Camel lounge and the bar at the steakhouse.If you require brand new modern rooms this might not be the place for you. But I found it very clean and comfortable.  Staff were all friendly and professional. Parking was free and easy.  It is a short drive to Old Town restaurants.

reviews.author: dailysong
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: The Phoenician is the essence of luxury. I've been two or three times over the years & every visit was excellent. Good delicious in the restaurants. I fell in love with the spa's signature "Lemongrass" lotion & have compared all lotions to it every since. Bummer...they don't ship.

reviews.author: bobbylupo
reviews.title: This place still has it.
reviews.text: We stayed at the residence section as we needed 2 rooms. It was clean and had all the amenities. Private pool, spa, outdoor kitchen, full indoor kitchen, 2 baths etc… We had a private golf cart. The grounds are beautiful. Main pool area is nicely kept. Staff is very friendly and accommodating.

reviews.author: Deneys
reviews.title: Needs some work
reviews.text: The hotel is certainly okay but the service is somewhat impersonal and the rooms need work. We booked a casita or deluxe room and only after complaining were moved to a pool view room-the hotel could not have been full and why they would allocate a room facing the road when they had others and we had paid for a resort view is beyond me. In the room some of the fixtures( toilet roll holder) were literally coming off the wall and the place could do with a lick of paint. Also on our patio there were some 30 cigarette butts which can be observed should anyone take a look - in general it was okay but seems to lack attention to detail

reviews.author: tigerlilykelly
reviews.title: World Class Customer Service
reviews.text: We stay here once a year. We always talk about trying another property in Scottsdale BUT why??? We receive the best service, great accommodations and we love the Mother-of-Pearl pool and Rich who treats us like royalty every time!! The Phoenician is a beautiful property and we don't leave all weekend. Pool, food, golf, drinks - so very nice!!

reviews.author: PrsTrainer
reviews.title: Great Patio Bar
reviews.text: We sat on one of the sofas near a fire pit which made for a very relaxing evening.  The waitress was very knowledgeable about the menu and very attentive to our needs.  There was music playing just inside and we could hear it on the patio.  The Ladies room was clean and nicely decorated and the staff all around was helpful and gracious.  We did not stay at the hotel, just went for drinks.

reviews.author: Laura F
reviews.title: Made work fun
reviews.text: I was there for a work convention but felt like a royal guest. Customer service was amazing and the entire resort was first class. They handled a large convention like it was an intimate party. Could not have been better.

reviews.author: 279guys
reviews.title: First Class property
reviews.text: Best Place in Scottsdale for a break- First class e-v-e-r-y-t-h-i-n-g. From the buffet to the amenities this was first-class experience. Imagine the heat of the day and cool blue swimming pools- are you getting the picture yet-xoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxxooxxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxooxoxoxxoxooxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxxxxxxxxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxo

reviews.author: Joe P
reviews.title: Great Resort, Wish I Got To See More.
reviews.text: I stayed here for a business trip while attending a conference. Now normally I am NOT a fan of Arizona, but this resort was awesome. The rooms were great, spacious, clean, and everything was up to date. The bathroom, the bed and the balcony were top notch. Great grounds, paths and scenery. The food at the conference was great and the food at the restaurants was reasonably priced considering we were in a highend resort and all was very good, plentyful. The pool was nice, wish I had more time to experience it. This staff was very nice and very helpful. I was pleasantly surprised by the small details the cleaning people took care of. For example I left the cleaning solution for my eyeglasses out on the desk and when I came back to my room I had resort branded eyeglass cleaning materials waiting for me. I would have to add that I paid a significantly reduced rate for the room as a conference attendee, I personally would not have paid full retail price for these rooms.

reviews.author: FedericoBergamo
reviews.title: Relax, golf, ed un grande albergo
reviews.text:
Sapevamo di alloggiare in un grande albergo ma non pensavamo di trovare un servizio, una qualità cosi alta.
Tutto e' perfetto, alto prestigio ottimo servizio ed una cucina molto ben impostata.
Colazioni del mattino superbe, servizio in camera dalla cucina di alto livello.
Ogni particolare e' curato al massimo.
Un soggiorno fantastico.
Lo consiglio senza alcun dubbio.
Merita di farsi coccolare !

reviews.author: babs1269
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text: Can't beat the views at the Phoenician.  The property is beautiful and well maintained. Staff is friendly and helpful. Stayed in the casitas which were close to the pools: which there are three and one is an adult only pool.  Can be a bit of a walk to the main hotel.  Clean and all with nice views. Plenty of conference space as well as several ballrooms for larger events. Would recommend Reggie in the planning of your event. Extremely helpful and always willing to answer questions or find the answer.  We were well taken care of at the hotel.and everything has worked smoothly in planning our event.

reviews.author: Hursh M
reviews.title: Stay Here
reviews.text: This was a very, very good resort. The one thing I have to complain about, however, is the Housekeeping. Over all, they were pretty good, but on the first day, they didn't replace the soap, and it'd take them a while to do the room. The first day, they knocked at 5 a.m., waking us all up. The golf was great and the burger place was also good, it made a great spicy black bean patty. The pool facility was a little rundown but overall pretty good, and the highlight of it was a water slide. I would recommend that you stay here.

reviews.author: Williamnagle86
reviews.title: Fantastic Luxury Hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel itself was very sharp. They have done a great job keeping the hotel looking new and maintaining the grounds to exhibit all the beauty the desert has to offer. The staff was very nice and punctual, even for the massive Memorial Day crowd. There were many activities to do on the property for both adults and children, making this a very good get away for families or couples looking for a get away.

My only complaint would be the front desk staff. They were very nice and polite, but they seemed to lack some of the polish and knowledge I would expect from from a hotel such as this. They did not have a very good record of "follow through" us; from not returning multiple calls from my wife to mishandling our house keeping requests.

However, if the front desk is the only complaint, I would say that is a good sign for the hotel as a whole.  I would highly recommend this hotel and my wife and I have already talked about making a return trip.

reviews.author: Cdoajh
reviews.title: Not The Same!
reviews.text:
For years we have come to stay at the Phoenician and Canyon Suites. I would say we have over 20 extended stays over the last 10 years. In the past we found the service to be in line with a 5 star 5 diamond resort. They would pay special attention to the guests trying to notice little details. We have had great memories there but those days are gone. Our stays there have went down hill over the last year or so. They no longer pay attention to detail, there is rude staff around every corner, management in most areas is negligent (this usually means the GM is negligent) and overall the facility has become run down and now gears to packing them in, not special experiences. They have an overwhelming amount of rude locals at the pool and resteraunts to the point it is not enjoyable for those who vacation. You would think that with as many stays as we have had the would pay more attention every time we stay but we found the opposite. After bringing our concerns to the manager and telling them about 3 run ins with rude staff we were told how sorry they were and nothing was done to resolve the problem except saying they would talk to the people.
We left knowing it would be our last stay. I STRONGLY RECOMMEND AAA PULL ITS 5 DIAMOND STATUS FROM THEM AS IT FALLS SHORT.
NOT EVEN A 5 STAR, NOW LIKE A 4 STAR.

reviews.author: EasyRider54
reviews.title: A very lovely and friendly place.
reviews.text: Well anyone used to staying in a five star resort hotel will know the usual basics, but the Phoe takes it one step even higher and I mean from the car jockeys to the the cleaning staff to the management. This is an awesome place. Very expensive, but you get what you pay for, and more. I can only say if you are looking for Golf, tennis or just spoiling yourself this is it. My son and I just 4 of the most fun days anyone can have at a resort that is legal. I would at least put it on your list of places to visit while you are looking around. worth every dime for us. The only thing missing is an ocean view, but this is the desert.

reviews.author: WLSCH
reviews.title: Beautiful setting, great resort
reviews.text: The setting right on the side of Camelback Mountain captures your attention the minute you enter the long driveway and arrive at the Porte Cochere. Pool areas are very nice and well maintained, the separate adult pool a very welcome feature. Service and food quality, especially at the JG steakhouse were . Lobby and public areas represent a 5 star standard, the accomodations in our upgraded ( be careful what you wish for ) casita were fairly large but dated.

reviews.author: Tony M
reviews.title: Top Class, But Important Improvement Needed
reviews.text: The Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale is beautiful, the service is impeccable, love the property. Every night after dinner we would relax on the open air patio and enjoy a drink watching the dusk ease away to night. Great drink selection and service on the patio...We go out on the terrace because it is so natural and has fresh air....Which is why we were astounded that the management allows smoking of cigars and other noxious tobacco products out there. Absolutely ruined the experience for us. Could not get away from the odor so we left...It is quite similar to being at a 5-star restaurant, enjoying the aromas of fine cuisine, and then having the hostess seat a baby with a full diaper next to you. In that case, you'd blame the parents, why do these smokers not see how rude they are and why does management allow it? Take away the 5 diamonds, AAA!

reviews.author: Lisa_VO
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort but the food is pricey
reviews.text: We had a wonderful visit in April amazing weather!  Blue skies everyday.  The sun seems to much stronger than other places I have visited seriously ran out of sunscreen twice.  The staff was great and the hotel is lovely.  The pools were amazing!  My only complaint is that the food is insanely expensive.  Even more than the Ritz Carlton.  Also not that many healthy choices at the pool.  But they did identify gluten free options which was great.

reviews.author: EaBoClipper
reviews.title: The Height of Excellence
reviews.text:
I was expecting a fantastic experience at The Phoenician and they delivered.  From check in to checkout everything was perfect. 

I attended a four day conference at the Hotel in May of 2015.  Everything was perfect.

I had a problem at another Starwood property that the Starwood twitter team took care of and they took care of me here as well.  I had a complimentary upgrade to a pool facing room.  The rooms on this side of the building are a little bigger. 

I also had a great cheese and fruit platter delivered to the room complimentary to welcome me to the property.  A classy touch. 

The food was fantastic, as were the poolside bars. 

I would highly recommend this property to anyone, especially in mid may. 

THe one thing they could work on is the internet reliability.  It dropped out in the room a lot.

reviews.author: Kentoos
reviews.title: Desert Beauty
reviews.text: The best resort hotel in Scottsdale.  Their attention to detail is superb.  Every single staff member is there to make your stay the best experience possible and they sincerely work at it to see that it is the best available in town if not the USA.  Concierge' Gary is the best in the business.  James the "official welcoming host" of the property will greet you upon your arrival in the cool lobby with a bottle of fresh water.  The place is simply amazing but it ain't cheap!  But it's worth every dollar you spend there.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Not nearly as good as expected
reviews.text:
In my opinion if you are spending this much money for a hotel room (over $400/night) they should be doing everything to make it as good a value as possible.  This was not the case at all for the Phoenician.  I would consider it a terrible value.

It all started with the checkin.  Everyone I encountered during checkin was totally lacking personality and was not the least bit friendly.  It should be just the opposite: make sure the first face you see be friendly and inviting.

We had requested an early checkin upon making the reservation.  Not only did we not get an early checkin, they claimed to not have a single room for us until EXACTLY checkin time (4:00)!  Really, my room wasn't ready until the exact minute that is your normal checking time!?  And they never contacted me to let the room was ready; I had to go back to the front desk to claim my room.
