The resort's restaurants Il Terrazzo,J&G Steakhouse, and Relish Burger Bistro were all superb. The Thirsty Camel Lounge, was a great place to go for a quick drink or snack. The patio off of the lobby was simply amazing, the view of the sun rising and setting over the Phoenix skyline was pristine. When you want to leave the resort to go somewhere, the bell staff would have your car waiting for you in minutes, with bottle(s) of water for you in the cup holders. When you arrived back at the Phoenician they would open your doors and valet your car. The bell staff would also give you a lift on a golf cart to any area on the resort. Overall I would definitely stay at the Phoenician next time I am in Arizona.

reviews.author: Vandyguy_12
reviews.title: A fine oasis in the desert
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is still a first class resort even if the rooms are a bit dated. The service is to notch and the amenities are excellent. We were there the last week of December and the nights were a bit chilly. The outdoor fire pits in the Thirsty Camel were just perfect to take in the air and socialize.
The lobby is beautiful and the holiday lights cactus garden walk was a special treat that shouldn't be missed. The Phoenician is so centrally located that you are a short drive to most attractions in Scottsdale area, especially the Fashion Mall.
The rooms are large and the bathrooms are especially big. Maybe some brighter new carpeting would liven the rooms. All in all, THE place to stay while in Scottsdale

reviews.author: Explomondo
reviews.title: Dated but impressive
reviews.text:
After reading nothing but raving reviews, I have to admit the Phoenician was not love at first sight. The building from the outside looks extremely dated to me. Maybe this is because I'm European, where top notch hotels are either classical palaces full of history or modern cutting edge building with the latest gadgets. The Phoenician is neither. Part of the rooms face the steep slope of a mountain and I definitely wouldn't want to spend my holiday there.

But, after taking a walk in the gardens I started changing my mind. I still don't like the building but admittedly it almost disappears in the mountain. The grounds are immaculate and the scenery breathtaking. I was upgraded to pool view upon checkin, SPG status clearly acknowledged and all sorts of charges waived. The room looked dated as well, though on closer look everything seemed replaced recently and of high quality. Might be a matter of taste.

The staff is really friendly, even though my car has nav, they insisted on pointing out the most scenic routes to several places. I love the lobby bar and outdoor terrace. This hotel doesn't come cheap but its setting is clearly one of a kind. Some contemporary twists could truly make this one of a kind.

reviews.author: orange-u-tall
reviews.title: A jewel of the Starwood chain.
reviews.text:
The Phoenician had so many pluses about it that it is hard to figure where to begin. There is an incredible golf course, which also houses a delicious burger bar. The rooms are spacious and modern, and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable. 

It is worth the price, and I cannot wait to stay here again. It is also nicely positioned  in Phoenix right near Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Illinitrav5
reviews.title: Superb Scottsdale
reviews.text: My husband had a conference here, so I decided to join him for a few days. I am so glad I did!  This resort is top notch - grounds, service, location.  We stayed in a casita to be close to the pool, spa, golf course. The room was nice, not unbelievably nice, but the service was spectacular. We used all of the resort amenities and hiked Camelback during our stay. We did not rent a car and found it very easy to get to restaurants with hotel transportation or Über.

reviews.author: MariabelleLouise
reviews.title: Beautifully kept resort, fantastic views, and excellent staff!
reviews.text: My husband and I were there for four days and really enjoyed ourselves. There is plenty of things to do and see on the grounds itself and everything is immaculately kept. Also, Camelback Mtn is beautiful and check out the trail. It is fairly challenging. The concierge gave us great information and check in with us. Our junior suite was great. My only complaint was $20+ breakfasts:/

reviews.author: Christine F
reviews.title: I come for the High Tea!
reviews.text: If you want to experience something new,cespecially if you have little girls, then go to the High Tea at the Phoenician.  It is served daily in the Lobby tea court.  It includes a great selection of fine teas, finger sandwiches, scones, pastries and a fantastic atmosphere.  You'll want to dress appropriately for tea which means leave the jeans and shorts in your room.  My rule of thumb for high tea is to dress like you are going to an afternoon wedding at a high end resort. Don't allow your kids to bring the electronic games, this isn't the place for it.  The last time I went I took my 10 year old neice and we had such a special time. I think she'll remember it for a long time

reviews.author: carolinatravel728
reviews.title: Best sleep ever....great spa..date not correct
reviews.text: Stayed here years before tripadvisor or would have rated then. Actually stayed here over 10 years ago. It was the first time I had ever taken a solo trip. (It was a Mother's Day gift.)  I slept and slept.  Everything was great, from being greeted at gate to check out.  Might not have tipped enough, but there were people everywhere to help or something. Was looking to stay again in January of 2015, but did not remember the place being so pricey.  Usually stay in the Troon area recently, but wanted to go back to Phoenician, but might not be staying there in the new year.

reviews.author: Mcaltom
reviews.title: Here for a conference, great place
reviews.text: We got a great conference rate, so we were excited to stay here.  It was a great hotel.  The people were very nice and the room was great.  I enjoyed the cactus path behind the hotel.  Probably would not have stayed here if we did not get the conference rate, but glad we did because this place was very nice!!!

reviews.author: Donald V
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text: This is just an amazing resort. The hotel and grounds are gorgeous. The rooms are large, quiet and very comfortable. There is something here for everyone from a great golf course to complete spa to walking paths to wonderful restaurants to 9 swimming pools. The staff was extremely helpful and professional and was there when needed. I just doesn't get any better than this.

reviews.author: stevenutah
reviews.title: Beautiful Setting & Grounds
reviews.text:
The setting at the foot of Camelback Mountain and the grounds are just gorgeous.  I love the swimming pools and water slide.  Well heated, clean, great for swimming laps or just for fun.  Wonderful grounds with lots of fountains, palm trees, and flowers.  Truly grand and very relaxing.

As others have mentioned, the hotel is showing its age.  The drapes in our room were a bit worn and the bathroom, while huge and luxurious, was definitely dated.  The bedding was new and very comfortable, though, and we had a great patio off of our room.  

The staff was very friendly, and the food was good.  There were lots of Christmas lights and decorations which created a great holiday feel.  Despite the need for some updating, I really enjoyed my stay at the Phoenician and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Newne53
reviews.title: Simply Awesome
reviews.text:
From the breathtaking views to the excellent accommodations this resort is second to none. The food was great and meeting space (and special touches) was ample and well organized.
Wish I was going back to visit tomorrow.
The staff was extremely friendly and helpful. The turndown service was a nice touch.

reviews.author: Gail O
reviews.title: We felt very pampered in the Canyon Suites
reviews.text: We stayed in the Canyon Suites, great option, much smaller than the main hotel and much quieter. We could go to the main hotel and pools if we wanted to. Large king room overlooking the pool was beautiful. Bathroom could have better lighting, but that seems to be a pet peeve of mine in most hotels. Golf was outstanding, great Spa facility and both had nice boutique shops. We were there for a business meeting and had a lovely reception around the pool. Food and service were excellent. Had a poolside lunch at the main Phoenician pools, again service and food was wonderful. Great if you want to be in a busy bar area. Overall would love to go back.

reviews.author: Jim682
reviews.title: We keep going back
reviews.text: Third year at the Phoenician and still are loving it as a part of our winter get away. We are older and do not golf but love the grounds and cactus walk at this resort. The rooms are nice with comfortable beds and linens. Don't like the "call for ice" routine...so found the location and got our own in very small ice bucket for drinks on our balcony. Still do not understand why Wi-fi is an SPG "perk" or charge when the rest of the world gives you it for free. We love the burger bar with its wonderfull (but overpriced) selection of tequila. Valet parking was wonderful as always!

reviews.author: JJCG
reviews.title: Great for families
reviews.text: We visited as a family for the week of Thanksgiving with our 8 year old. The resort created tons of fun things to do -- tee shirt painting, s'mores, stargazing, sports and games on the lawn, and even a turkey trot 5k on property. It was fabulous to have so much to do right on property -- a few different areas to settle in at the pool and a playroom that had ping pong, every type of sports equipment you could borrow, and even bikes. Very convenient. The location was just down the street from Fashion Circle and old town Scottsdale. The restaurant at the golf club, Relish Burger was casual and delicious. Easy location to everything in Scottsdale, including great run routes and right next to the Cholla Trailhead on Camelback Mountain. Clean, updated rooms and clean resort overall. The concierge staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. Very easy and fun place to stay.

reviews.author: Jmichealr
reviews.title: First time...will be back!
reviews.text:
I was here for a Board meeting, luckily my wife could come along.     Large, beautiful property.   We enjoyed the cactus walking trails.   I agree with the cleanliness comments, very nice!   The rooms are large, impressive bathFrooms.   Great service!

We ate several meals.   All were outstanding!

reviews.author: Nancy S
reviews.title: Fabulous time!
reviews.text: Very clean , which is big with me. I hate staying in a resort that doesn't deep clean rooms and bathrooms. They do a fantastic job here. I like that its family friendly resort so kids of any age are welcome.  Looking forward to staying in the future.  Beautiful place! I highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.title: As Good as it Gets!
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous Thanksgiving in Scottsdale with great friends and family staying at the Phoenician in Scottsdale. Although a few areas appear to be a bit dated, overall the property and grounds are immaculate and worthy of a 5 star rating. Also check out the great burger restaurant on property. Great job Phoenician on making our Thanksgiving memorable!

Steve and Carol P.

reviews.author: will505
reviews.title: Still Classy and Grand!
reviews.text: It has been years since I've been at The Phoenician.  Although the grande dame of mega-resorts in Scottsdale is in need of a little facelift (or at least some design botoxification), it is still first-class in service, ambiance, and graciousness.  The staff is really one of the best in the world.  From front desk (Haley was great) to valets to restaurant staff to managers, everyone was beyond superb and helpful.  They upgraded me to a Villa which was spacious, well-appointed, and, well, awesome.  (See photo of living room!) Again, hope they will start renovating some areas soon (please start with the shops and casual snack/coffee place, and the chandaliers outside the banquet rooms!)  Very much enjoyed my stay.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Ann R
reviews.title: Beautiful surroundings, great room
reviews.text: It was a girls week - our room was spacious with a balcony overlooking the pool area.  The room was clean and well kept for during our stay.  The bed was comfortable.  We used the pool each day, the first few days were busy with the weekend at the last few days were loud with outdoor renovations occurring, jackhammering made it difficult to enjoy.  We had good meals at the restaurants on the property and enjoyed the live music in the foyer a few of the nights.  We used the salon - which was expensive.  We used the car service to go to Mass and the airport, that was convenient.

reviews.author: agg2011
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, large rooms, kid friendly
reviews.text:
We stayed here over the thanksgiving weekend.  It was 12 of us family members in 4 rooms.   

The resort has a lot to offer with expansive pool areas, comprehensive spa services, golf, restaurants, shops, and fitness facility.   The service was excellent and the staff was friendly and helpful.

The rooms are large with nice bathrooms.   The feel is certainly luxurious.   Please be sure to understand what view your room will have.   Our balconies overlooked the roof of the ballroom (I.e. no view).

reviews.author: Katherine K
reviews.title: Classic luxury
reviews.text: If you are looking for a luxury vacation property, The Phoenician offers all of the amenities you could ask for including a wonderful afternoon tea and great service.  The grounds of the property include beautiful landscaping and a fantastic golf course.

reviews.author: Dutchman21
reviews.title: A Little Dated, but Still Nice
reviews.text: This resort is great for golf and family vacations.  If your kids are five or older they can take part in the Funicians club that will keep them entertained with activities the whole day, while the parents can go shopping in the nearby mall, play golf, tennis or swim.  The place does show its age a little bit in the lobby; a lot of dark colors.  The staff is generally well-trained and quite pleasant.  we stayed over Thanksgiving weekend and there were some management mishaps; since the restaurant was closed to prepare for Thanksgivings Day Brunch, all the people looking for breakfast (mostly families with small kids) found that all the other places at the resort were woefully understaffed to cope with the volume, it took more than an hour and fifteen minutes before we had food.

reviews.author: Mary W
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: My husband and I came into town from NC to see a Cardinals game and stayed here.  We stayed in a casita which was beautifully decorated and located in a very quiet spot on the property.  The spa was my "FAV" of course...Sorry Cardinals fans, but you cannot stay here without going to the spa for at least 1 treatment. We will be back!!!!

reviews.author: janastein
reviews.title: Large resort
reviews.text: The resort has a very good location. Rooms are quite  large and the bathrooms even larger with a nice decor. Unfortunately, we did not have enough time to enjoy the pool and golf, having only a couple of days there, but what really stood out was the hotel staff. Very helpful, especially in the restaurants. My husband loves scones, but they serve them only in the afternoon. As we were leaving early, they organised scones, cream, jam and butter to go and even met us in the lobby, so we were not late for our flight. Very thoughtful. And delicious.....

reviews.author: ArielTarantino
reviews.title: Special Place
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed in mid-November 2014 for five days and it exceeded our expectations.  Besides perfect weather, the surroundings and accommodations made it a very relaxing getaway.  The brunch was delicious and pool was inviting with great service all day.  We stayed in a casita which was spacious and in a great location of the property.  My husband enjoyed the golf course.  I used the fitness center every day which has about everything anyone could want. The Phoenician is tucked away in a special place away from the flatlands which is exactly what we love.  We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Posiblonde
reviews.title: Big Disappointment!
reviews.text:
I had one weekend to unwind and treat myself while working in Phoenix, and after much research, I chose The Phoenician. It looked like an upscale, peaceful resort where I could really relax. Well, when I arrived it was chock full of children running around the lobby. Yes, it was Thanksgiving weekend, but it looked more like a Disneyland resort, complete with toy train & sugarland in the lobby entrance to appease the kiddies. I went down to the pool to try to get some sun, but found no empty lounges, and even in the "adult" area, I was bombarded by loud music, and the kids on the levels above & below. Impossible to relax. Also, my attempt to sleep in was ruined by the groundsmen trimming the bushes with chainsaws. The Holiday Inn Express was ten times more peaceful than here.
In fairness, I did have an enjoyable spa treatment, and the spa contained the only place I could find that was quiet, the meditation room. Also, I had a delicious meal at J&G Steakhouse. 
Sorry to say, I cannot recommend this resort if you want a quiet, relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Glenn L
reviews.title: Nice location, love the historical feel.
reviews.text: I liked the feel of a historic hotel.  It was nice, the service was good.  The rooms feel a little dated, but service made up for it.  I was there for a conference and was glad that things were close.  It was great that their limos they contract with are actually cheaper than Super Shuttle.  Next time, I'll call ahead to work something out.

reviews.author: 2boys67
reviews.title: Great food and service, rooms need updating
reviews.text:
Stayed for an extended weekend on a pleasure trip. The grounds at the Phoenician are beautiful. The service was fantastic from beginning to end with lots of attention to the little things that add an extra special touch. The food was excellent (restaurants and room service). 

We had one little service blip during our stay which was a missed wake up call. They didn't call and they didn't send anyone to the room to make sure we woke up. We only missed a scheduled hike so it wasn't the end of the world but it could have been a flight we missed. They apologized but we got the sense they didn't think it was there fault. They said they sent someone to the room to check on us when we didn't answer but that never happened (or we would have woke up). We ended up having a bit of a rushed morning to get our hike in and  have breakfast before our spa treatments. Would have been much more relaxing had we got the wake up call on schedule. 
   
Another disappointment: As noted in other reviews the rooms are a bit outdated...the aesthetics were ok but things like no water pressure in the shower, cold water during peak times, no garbage pail in the toilet room and no full length mirror were annoying.  

One other little thing....we wanted to rent a car for the day to avoid paying a big cab fare to a shopping centrer that was 30 min away from hotel. The concierge sent me to the car rental place on site and the cheapest car they rent is a full size at 140 per day (they never rent economy cars) We had to take a cab from the hotel to a car rental facility that did rent economy cars. I think it's a bit odd that I couldn't rent a cheap vehicle from the Phoenician. It would be great if they could add a few economy cars  to the rental car fleet 

Even with the above issues it was a great stay and wouldn't hesitate to return.

reviews.author: MikeCamel
reviews.title: Beautiful setting, great hotel
reviews.text:
I attended a conference here, and stayed 5 nights.  The rooms were excellent, staff some of the best I've every encountered at any hotel around the world, the setting beautiful, and facilities perfect for our needs.

Highlights:
- very big room
- turn-down service
- efficient laundry
- reliable wifi
- well-equipped gym
- 9 swimming pools, with bar and lounger
- the desert cactus garden
- some excellent places to eat.

Downsides - 
- cost.

It's also an excellent venue for a conference.

Did you know... there's a falconer who comes round the terrace at breakfast with a Barbary falcon on his wrist, to scare aware the other birds.

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: Grass Tennis Court!
reviews.text: I'd been looking for a clay tennis court to play on for my father's bday and could only find private clubs that wouldn't let me in. I saw online that the Phoenician had a grass court (the only one I found in the valley) and called Belinda at the tennis shop at the Phoenician and she set me up for the next day on their grass court. SO much fun! She was an angel and brought us towels and water. It's a beautiful resort and the tennis courts are immaculate. There's only one grass court though so make sure to reserve it and test out your wimbledon skills.

reviews.author: DCY
reviews.title: Generic luxury
reviews.text:
Spent the weekend in a deluxe casita room, overlooking the pond/pool area. Very generic room, no SW character and somewhat dated with blond wood and light tan marble. Il Terrazzo was very good for lunch, disappointed in J and G Steakhouse-- loud, very average steak--?this is prime? 
On the plus side, overwhelmingly great service across the board.
Another downside, this is a very large (650 rooms) and was packed with conventioneer types who were very loud and intoxicated. Tried to escape from them in the bar on Friday night, went outside to the patio and surprise, the patio is where all the smokers congregate.
Overall, not a Four Seasons. I went down the street to the Royal Palms on Sunday morning for breakfast and found the atmosphere I was looking for--- character,quiet, and luxury. Granted no golf or pool scene but perfect for a adult seeking to relax for a weekend.

reviews.author: canarydiamond14
reviews.title: Great Location, Lovely Views
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Phoenician for three nights in September. 

Pros: 
-Our casita was an easy walk to the pools, parking was always available right outside
-Staff were very friendly (some of the friendliest we've seen anywhere)
-Pool service was fantastic, bringing guests ice water is a great touch, pool food was tasty
-Adults only pool was nice and quiet but it would be nice if the staff enforced it a bit better vs. pool patrons having to tell kids to get out (watching one grumpy person yell at kids was amusing, though)
-First night ate at the Italian restaurant, food was tasty
-Bed was very comfortable
-Liked getting the free water in our room each day and two newspapers (maybe because we were Starwood Gold) 
-View of Camelback Mountain was awesome
-The birds of prey talk was a fun touch
-The desert garden is a really nice walk. We saw lots of birds and animals. Beware that at night there are lots of bugs there if you choose to go on a moonlight walk ;) 
-The ice cream shop was fantastic!

Cons:
-The ice bucket in the room is too small to take even one can of drink. This is a problem because with the amount you need to drink in the desert heat, it's nice to be able to bring your own drinks and cool them easily in your room. 
-To find ice was even harder. There are no signs and luckily a nice member of staff showed us the unlocked room where we could find an ice machine. 
-No tea in the room. There's coffee but for people who don't drink coffee, you were SOL.
-Towels at pool - while towels were available on the seat, it was difficult to find extra towels to use after a swim etc. 
-Our room was fairly old and dated - there was an odor of dampness but you get used to it quickly. 

We usually stay at the Fairmont. The Phoenician was a good substitution, but we still prefer the Fairmont overall.

reviews.author: cariski
reviews.title: Great Staff, Great Pool, Good condition
reviews.text: The resort itself is getting a tad bit worn looking, probably ready for updating soon.  Having said that, it was clean and comfortable.  The pool set-up is GREAT for families, also offering a nice adults-only pool besides the kid friendly shallow pool and play area.  Breakfast brunch was just okay for $25.  The highlight was the staff!  Always friendly and helpful.  Also make sure you get a room with a view of the pool and mountains.  LOVELY sunsets from room and spacious balcony.

reviews.author: KCarp
reviews.title: Amazing resort with stunning views!
reviews.text: Only had the chance to spend two nights but had a great time. Big thank you to Chris J. and Kaylee for such a wonderful room - loved the casita! Chris, bellman, drove me over from the main building and gave a great overview of the property and the room. The room was so relaxing my first night I stayed in and ordered room service. Impressively fast given that the casitas are a golf cart ride away from the main building. Food was also very good - had the lasagna and cheesecake. Next morning breakfast on the patio at Relish was great with a gorgeous view of the golf course. Definitely wish I had more time to experience all the resort had but my quick trip was well worth it!

reviews.author: Louanne M
reviews.title: Unbelieveable
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from an extraordinary wonderful vacation at The Phoenician resort.
we stayed in the mountain suites at the back of the property. what a totally first class experience.I would like to thank Justin Beers and his team for making our stay a truly remarkable experience. upon my arrival my back was in pain as a result of injury and the staff where more than helpful.They really care ! The service is excellent, food excellent , staff are more than just attentive, they bend over back words for you! A special thank you to Amanda, who went out of her way to help me and my husband enjoy our experience at the suites. We will definitely be returning to The Phoenician and will only stay there!

reviews.author: Sharon M
reviews.title: A Special Surprise
reviews.text: While on my latest visit to The Phoenician, I was made aware of a special evening that was taking place in the Spa Boutique. It was called "Sip, Shop and Be Merry". First of all, the Spa Boutique is a hidden gem at the resort that you must visit sometime during your stay, and when I found out they were having a special event I made sure I attended. There were areas set up with demos of many of the luxurious facial and body products they sell, along with many great gift ideas for the holidays. There were opportunities to buy spa treatments at a very attractive price. Champagne and appetizers were served. A very fun evening. If you're planning a visit to The Phoenician next holiday season, be sure and ask about this event ... its worth a visit!

reviews.author: Kelley M
reviews.title: Room Elves
reviews.text: Last week my husband and I (in our late 50 early 60's) had the pleasure to stay for 6 nights in a Grand deluxe room. Although prior reviews state the facility needs to be updated I find the marble and decore part of the Phoenician charm. When we arrived we were greated by Andrea at the front desk- we found her to be so friendly & sweet- in fact all the staff at the hotel would always great us with smiles. It was so nice to see those smiles that for once it appeared they really loved their jobs. We were in a room on the 3rd floor which is the hotel lobby floor facing the pool. Loved this room as no elevator to take only to the parking garage, steps down one flight to the pool area. Our room overlooked the pool and lawn which every day we got to see the bunnies come out to play/eat from. The room was big- double doors to the bathroom, the extras - lip balm, shower caps, loofah sponge to the wonderful hair products, lotions & bath salts. We had a king bed with a sofa, coffee table  2 chairs and a work desk. Double closets and a wet bar. Every time we left the room we came back and it was re made- all fresh towels, turn down service was also so nice- they put out slippers by the bed and leave chocolates and fill the ice container- and turn on soft music. I would have loved to catch them but they were like elves- never saw them. I almost thought we were on a cruise ship as we have only had that kind of service on one- never before a hotel. This trip was a  belated 30th anniversary trip and the staff made sure to make our stay special- Thank you Andrea for the bottle of Champange and chocolates- they were wonderful and allowing us to have a late check out for our flight home. We did the self park, only one night we had to park at the far end, you park and then its a short walk to the inside lobby elevator - we found all the elevators to be fast. The 1st day we spent at the top pool area- water was a bit cold, after that we spent  the rest of our pool time at the grand pool where the cabanas are located- water there seemed to be warmer and pool also a little more cleaner. Kudos to Mario and the pool staff - Jeff , Rich  and Roven for also making our stay there so special and fun. We loved the cabana and all the little treats that came with it. Next time we will rent it for the whole week! If you have a family splurge and rent one as it is a great place to hang out for the day and you have your own private wait staff who on our trip far exceeded any other hotel cabanas we have rented from. They have a water slide we used several times- lots of fun! Make sure to check out the cactus garden (located accross from the lobby)- we almost forgot and so glad we did not as so many different types to see- wished we had went sooner as they have lights on them and would have loved to see them at night as well. We ate at the Relish burger place(see seperate review) and our last day had the buffet breakfast. Once again the staff in both restaurants were so nice and made sure we were taken care of. The new manager in the breakfast area was so sweet- she made us feel like we were family - I wish I could remember her name- her's is a very different beautiful name so I am sure someone there will know who we mean.  We went by the Tea Service several times -next time I would like to make reservations as it looked wonderful and fun. If you need to print boarding passes allow plenty of time as we tried and tried and could never get them done- we gave up after 30 minutes -I am sure if we went to the front desk they would have helped. We had a wonderful stay and cannot wait to return. Besides it being a 5 star hotel it is located not far from a mall, old town Scottsdale  and lots of restaurants (within  3 miles) which gave us more pool time instead of driving a long way for dining.  You cannot go wrong by booking a room here.

reviews.author: fishtheboat
reviews.title: Great as usual but........
reviews.text:
We have been to the Phoenician many times. It is my wife's favorite. So we went for a long weekend to celebrate our anniversary. The hotel is great. Wonderful staff, large comfortable rooms, good restaurants, great pools and grounds. I didn't play tennis or golf on this trip, but have in the past and the facilities are first class. Everything you want in a luxury resort. But this time, there were a couple of things that hit a wrong note. Our room overlooked the croquet lawn and the entire time we were there (4 days) they were constructing a large tent for an upcoming conference, which created an enormous amount of noise with the heavy equipment. So even though I had paid more for a room with a balcony and view, we were completely unable to use it. That fact that we weren't bothered by the noise with the balcony door closed is a complement to the quality of the the hotel construction, but didn't help that we couldn't enjoy the balcony. The other issue was at check out: our bill was overcharged by approximately $1400. They had the wrong package and the wrong rate. It got resolved but took about 30 minutes of my time at the counter trying to explain to a manager what was wrong, even though I had a copy of my confirmation. 

All told, still a great place but not as perfect as I have experienced in the past. Hopefully, this was an aberration.

reviews.author: Dolores F
reviews.title: Phoenician first visit, but not the last..
reviews.text:
The Phoenician staff seemed determined to make your stay wonderful.  Waiters were attentive, helpfull and corteous. The food excellent.  The room itself was comfortable, ans the complementary slippers are a great touch.
My two recommendations are:
Improvement on parking space, as is very limitted
pool that is only for adults.

Dolores & JB

reviews.author: Liz L
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text:
Fantastic resort in a great location. Wonderful views from poolside. 
The staff in the ice cream parlour are so friendly and the food is delicious.
Also a golfers paradise.
Love this place and hope to return.

reviews.author: Waterburian973
reviews.title: Wish I could have stayed for weeks!
reviews.text: Absolutely EVERYONE at The Phoenician seemed determined to make our stay wonderful. The young women at the Funician kids club treated my son like a favorite little cousin. Waiters were all attentive and warm. The pros at the tennis facility were World Class -- knowledgeable, fun, insightful, encouraging. The pools were lovely, the food excellent at all restaurants (from a great burger at Relish, to a seared ahi-tuna salad at the pool, to a delicious steak dinner at SG Steakhouse.) The room itself was comfortable, with a large marble-dominated bathroom; most importantly, everything seemed clean and fresh; the linens, the walls, the carpet. My one complaint was that I had asked for a "quiet" room, and while they gave me a room pretty far off the lobby, on the second night we could hear music piped in from a party not far from our balcony. Still, the front desk responded with genuine concern and made an energetic attempt to solve the problem, finally comping our room service dinner as an apology. First class all the way!

reviews.author: sbkimSantaBarbara
reviews.title: Ridiculously Overpriced needs attention to detail and upgrade
reviews.text: I stayed two nights spent 2 days with no phone front desk sent someone out twice. Coffee maker broken. Lamp on desk was so filthy it had cobwebs all over the lamp shade I say probably hadn't been dusted in over a year. My mother stayed in another room and her tv was broken. This hotel is not worth the money it charges! Very disappointed. Would not recommend.

reviews.author: barry w
reviews.title: SIX STARS
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent a great deal of time here last week.  We were at a family wedding.  It's hard to describe this resort.  The trees are actually manicured.  The golf course, amazing.  The size, wow.
The service, none better, the architecture and art, splendid and the wedding, at night and outdoors for 250 guests, unforgettable.  The couple, Remy and Andy, on top of the world.

reviews.author: CraigFloyd
reviews.title: Bravo Phoenician
reviews.text: My wife and I spent the last seven days here.  I write this review from the Phoenix airport depressed that our wonderful vacation had to end.  Starwood nailed it when they added the Phoenician to their Luxury Hotel collection.  I really don't understand some of the less than favorable reviews ....... Yes, it is a big resort but you can't have all of the amenities and services and still expect boutique.  Yes, it is expensive but you have to pay for quality and everything in Scottsdale is expensive.  Yes, they cater to events and conferences but so what - it didn't affect our experience.   Those complaining about the rooms - why are you spending so much time in your room at such a beautiful place?!  We loved the place - the service was impeccable and the resort/grounds are absolutely beautiful.  Great restaurant options, great golf on premises and staff at every turn to help you and make your stay enjoyable.  Kudos to Michael LaManna and Shane Dorn for their excellent golf instruction.  Love you Phoenician - we will be back.

reviews.author: lawrence c
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
The standard expected of a hotel of this caliber is high.
I was continually frustrated by the poor quality of the Internet,
There were serious connection problems and it was very slow.
I could not access certain web sites at all.

The coffee maker had clearly never been cleaned. I ran clear water through it 
half a dozen times and the water was still coming out discoloured.

I wanted to make tea; the tea k- cup had been used and not replaced.

The hotel management sent us some lovely chocolates on a tray.
Housekeeping took the tray away.

There is a lovely bathtub, but no bath suds or salt.

Don't get me wrong, the premises are magnificent and the staff very nice,
but I just stayed at the San Francisco Fairmont and the Enchantment in Sedona 
and this hotel misses the mark in comparison.

Perhaps it is a victim of its own success.

reviews.author: Ken P
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: Great property with high end pool and amenities.  Excellent retaurant choices and decent resort golf course.  Attention to detail by staff and well worth a visit.  However there was one pet peeve that irked me. Of the 6 nights we stayed this past October our keycard to our room did not work 5 times!  If we were out at the pool or health club and went back to our room we were not able to re-enter the room.  Upon walking over to the check-in desk they would not provide another key unless we had proper id, which we clearly did not carry to the pool or health facility.  I understand the need for security, but we went to same desk several times and although they were aware of our identity they insisited on having a bellman enter the room with us to make sure we were the same people from the previous day..  A bit obnoxious.  Also get the locks fixed!!

reviews.author: Dineramic
reviews.title: Lovely & quiet, not a 5 star
reviews.text:
We stayed 2 nights: October 26-27, 2014

Pros:
- beautiful pools and grounds
- every employee is friendly and helpful
- lovely super-large King room with a balcony
- the food was delicious in the Relish bistro ($16 for big Kobe burger), the Oasis pool bar, and in Il Terrazzo for breakfast buffet ($25.00) and expensive but good dinner ($180 for 2 with one glass of wine).

Cons:
- no free WiFi ?!  Really?! Ya, it's free in the lobby, but this is a huge resort and the lobby is far from your room and the pools. On principle, I refuse to pay for wifi when it's available everywhere including McDonald's for FREE. They charge an extra $12.00 for it if you're interested.
- tater tots served with the Kobe burger at a 5 star? Not homemade; the kind from the freezer.
- the room safe is odd. It's vertical. It's only about 3" deep and maybe 1 foot high. Makes it hard to fit things into it.I've never seen a safe like it.
- super quiet surroundings and clientele. Other than enjoying the pools, there is nothing to do except walk the grounds (unless you golf) and eat expensive meals.
- it's too far from Scottsdale to walk, so you have to rent a car or take a $15+tip ride in a gas guzzling Escalade to get there. ($10.50 in a taxi)
- our room faced Camelback Mountain on the 6th floor over the loading dock.we could hear the reversing beeps from the big trucks below, starting before 7a.m.

We had a few problems with our room. The toilet kept running on & on after flushing and the room safe was not working. They fixed both problems when called. But when our room wasn't cleaned at all by 5:00 pm on the second day, I took my complaint to Kaitlin, the supervisor. In 5 star fashion, she made it all better by quickly fixing everything and treating us to a lovely dinner too. 

Watch soon for my better review of FireSky Resort

reviews.author: JBRSTRNTCRTQE
reviews.title: meets other Westin & Starwoods par standards
reviews.text:
Camelback Mountain. In other states you may Not be able to have a Golf tee & pin  cresting the the base camp towards a 2612'  Peak... Awaesome locale to back the main Hotel.. The Phoenician Bellman & Concierge staff will gladly take you out to the road via golf Cart to start your 1/2 mi walk each way just to have an option to trek Up the 1.3 mi Cholla trail. Pack the right shoes, & you can scale vertical to finish the last Leg.
  Back to the Hotel. Chad the Bellman was one of the highlights of the Starwoods Property.the atmosphere tries to Not be affected by "sales & marketing" busy selling Points in their connecting Condo buildings, Conferenences trying Not to affect the atmosphere for $500/Night room occupiers.. let alone to feel like a "timeshare Resort" in its perimeter.  Nice Golf course. Chad & staff will also whisk you away from main Hotel to Clubhouse for a "Cowboy Burger" & the only Happy Hour option on a daily basis.
  The Room. Very Nice. View, C'mon. Large mountain & Skyscapes. Even Westin Quality Mattress toppers like the Westin @ Savannah Ga.. But NOT the Mattress. Oh Well , 1 for 2 Execution.
15 + Pools & an Expanded Kid's Club. Hot tub is is immersed in the kid's Zone, (recently severely downsized as the "Kid's Club" was Upsized)  Spa  used by young Children, not always with Adult Surpervision, adult pool area elsewhere, NO current Hot Tub/Spa  with Any Atmosphere or Quiet.
As you walk to the left of the outdoor pool grille & pools towards the Golf Clubhouse, Plenty of space to remedy the situation.  Chaise lounges with towels clean & rolled  plentiful. Pool F & B  Staff & service very visible.
Overall  the Phoenician  is a good place to camp, & launch yourself into the Phoenix/ Scottsdale Area Exploration. Probably an awesome place for business conferences & serious Golfers too. 
Good Security presence @ the front door with Management staff.

reviews.author: dmadeo
reviews.title: Wonderful luxury resort
reviews.text:
Beautiful location, friendly staff, great rooms.   Whether it's lawn bowling or the man walking around with a red tailed hawk, there's a lot of surprising things here.  

The pools are well laid out, except they could have used some lap lanes.  There's plenty of shade and seating.   They bring over a pitcher of water as soon as you sit down.  

They have excellent and expensive restaurants, but then have a small cafe with reasonable prices and good food as well.

Overall, a really nice relaxing resort.

reviews.author: Louis O
reviews.title: 50th Anniversary could not have been better
reviews.text: Our stay at the Phoenician will go down as one of the best resorts we stayed at.  My husband and I travel 5 to 6 times a year and have stayed at some great places.  The Phoenician is at the top of our list.   Its staff including Michele and Lonnie at the concierge desk, as well as Anthony who greets you at the hotel's entrance, and Cassandra at the pool could not have been more helpful or professional and you could see that they loved their jobs.  Not to leave out anyone the entire staff is amazing.  The room was large and comfortable containing an amazing large bathroom with every amenity.  We can't wait to make another visit to the Phoenician.

reviews.author: Aiden L
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property
They have an excellent pool
The service is impeccable no request us too extreme 
The rooms are nice but the bathrooms could be updated a little but still nice 
It is near a lot of things too!

reviews.author: MichaelG24
reviews.title: 5 Diamond Indeed
reviews.text: Stayed at The Phoenician for a 4 day weekend with the family and I cannot begin to tell you how attentive, serving, polite and absolutly accommodating the staff was. The hotel was clean and so many places to lounge around with or without kids.  The Hotel Staff was truly amazing.  If this was a dump..the Staff would have made you feel otherwise.  Very impressed.  The pools are great, restaurants are perfect.  The views and property are amazing for all ages.

reviews.author: ChefManuelo
reviews.title: FABULOUS RESORT!
reviews.text: We celebrated my BD at this wonderful resort. Our room was a "Casita Suite" overlooking the lake with waterfalls & the Camelback Mountain as a backdrop. Fantastic!  The concierge service was outstanding. Our outdoor patio was very nice & enjoyed some breakfast moments.  We played tennis everyday on the well maintained courts facility. Also a round of golf at the great golf course. Rented some cycles & your around the property & to old Scottsdale. We dined at every restaurant in the property. Superb! The GM was very gracious & treated us to a beautiful bottle of Champagne.  Over all a grand & wonderful experience! Top resort!

reviews.author: ACM
reviews.title: Opulent, Friendly, Fun
reviews.text:
I was here with my girlfriend for a corporate retreat event over a weekend. 

The whole property is indescribably large; you can get exhausted walking from ballroom to ballroom, and this scales down to every part of your experience. We spent most of our time at the pool, which is creatively laid out and with plenty of space and great poolside service, if a little slow at times.

The rooms were great, we were in the 4000s and had a very nice balcony and a huge interior. The bathroom too was huge, of course.

We had two breakfasts at Il Terrazzo, which was a little pricey (be careful of the $7 coffee!), but absolutely delicious.

(This likely won't apply to most, but it's clear these guys know how to put on a corporate event - we were 400+ people total, and they managed to get excellent food, drinks, and friendly service to everyone without a single hitch).

reviews.author: Whitney D
reviews.title: Amazing anniversary
reviews.text: My husband and I celebrated #8 here in June.  We were worried that it would be too hot to enjoy, but it was the perfect long weekend.  The hotel is really nice, but what we loved were the people.  We had great service at breakfast every morning, poolside, in the spa, and in the gym.  We loved the Camelback hike and the loaner bikes.  We are contemplating a return trip this year!

reviews.author: Ujay1002
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Phoenician for our anniversary weekend and were pleased with our choice.  We stayed in a deluxe room overlooking Camelback Mountain.  The rooms were a good size, very comfortable overall. The views were outstanding from anywhere in the resort.  Huge rock formations, a view of the cactus garden and the deep blue sky made it very breath-taking everyday we stayed.  The pool area was very large and had many seating areas (adult only, splash area for kids, general seating etc...). The staff was very friendly and attentive.  The food at the Oasis in the pool area was very good overall.  We also dined at the J & G Steakhouse on site. The food was very good, great service and incredible views from their patio overlooking the Phoenix skyline.  The wine list was a little pricey, but had a lot of variety.  We had a minor issue on our bill, but was immediately corrected by the front desk Manager.  Overall, a very relaxing stay with friendly and professional staff.

reviews.author: Catherine M
reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay for a work conference
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Phoenician many times for an annual industry conference.  I find the grounds to always be beautifully kept and peaceful to walk around.  The pools are spectacular!  I don't golf, so can't opine on that but have heard that all the extras are top notch.  I have visited the spa, and, while it's a little on the smaller side, it is a lovely place.  The rooms are spacious and the beds are extremely comfortable.  Huge bathroom with a giant tub with jets is a nice touch, although I prefer showers and would enjoy a larger shower stall.  I find the staff at the Phoenician to always be friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: superdrew
reviews.title: Awful, an Embarrassment that SPG lets them call this a Luxury Collection Hotel
reviews.text:
The check in experience was awful. Even with Platinum SPG status, I had to fight to get the benefits I have earned.
After getting my key, I was informed my room was in the Casitas, and with all my luggage in hand it would be best to go back to the car, load it all up and drive out there. No offering of having the luggage sent over, nothing.
I could live with this, but the room number written on my card didn't exist. They told me it was in building F, no such room number (again unloading all my luggage). Caught a staff member and they sent me to another buidling... Also no such room number (third time unloading luggage). Called the hotel, no apology, no anything, just verify your identity so I can give you your room number. Finally get the right room number (4 times unloading luggage in 100 plus degree heat).
This put a bad taste in my mouth for the hotel. The service recovery was awful.
Sit down, turn on the TV, nothing. Broken TV. Call, and they finally come and change the TV.
Go to turn on the tv in the bedroom, remote is broken. I give up on this place at this point.
It was a completely ruined stay, and the hotel did nothing to remedy it.
Stay anywhere but this place, it's awful, and they just don't care.

reviews.author: RedKO_13
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice.  Room was great and comfortable.  Pool was refreshing. Service was really great. Meeting rooms very nice.The group lunch in the conference center left a little to be desired. The other meals were good.  I'd certainly go back!

reviews.author: plh66
reviews.title: Another sectacular week
reviews.text: We have been coming to the Phoenician Resort for over 20 years and it never disappoints.  We are residence owners and have the privilege of staying in the beautiful 2 and 3 BR villas.  My husband is a tennis player and there are very few resorts anywhere that compares to this tennis facility.  The tennis shop manager, Belinda, is always so friendly and helpful and always makes us feel so welcome.  We look forward to our annual visits and hope that tennis remains a priority.

reviews.author: Lilianalilian
reviews.title: Luxury
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 4 days in September  and loved it ,We had a room on the ground floor and it had everything we wanted in a room The location of the room was great ,The room was large ,it had very comfortable beds ,large balcony with lounger and table and chairs overlooking the garden and pools ,the bathroom was stunning ,it had double sinks ,with a separate toilet and a walk in good sized shower ,A useful magnifying mirror and a stool ,electronic scales ,just in case you were so inclined ,good toiletries ,and everything was always replenished,. The room also had 2 double wardrobes each with lights ,nice touch with turn down service and chocolate ,.
I would definitely recommend this hotel .it was also close to a very large shopping mall and the old historic district with lots of individual shops .
In the evening there was live music ,the staff in the hotel were all very nice and friendly .

reviews.author: jwjohnson86
reviews.title: Fantastic anniversary getaway!
reviews.text: I had always wanted to stay here having visited the area several times before.  Using an spg.com deal, we got a great rate and enjoyed a spacious, beautiful room with terrace and patio furniture overlooking the main pool area.  We were greeted by name repeatedly and every request we had was met immediately and courteously.  The drinks and food were great; an amazing red and green salsa both came with the chicken quesadilla.  Another couple sitting next to us requested the salsa recipes and the restaurant manager shared them with us.  Steve at the Oasis Bar was amazing, he made some great drinks including a mai tai and mojitos.  I would definitely return and hope to play one of the spectacular looking golf courses next time.

reviews.author: Scott C
reviews.title: Couples retreat.
reviews.text: So many great things to say about the Phoenician. Whether its the great pools, great food or wonderful staff, I recommend this resort to everyone.  Big shout out to Rich at the Mother of Pearl pool and Ben at the Canyon, two great staff members who know how to take care of their guests. Will be revisiting for sure.

reviews.author: h c
reviews.title: Luxurious Service
reviews.text: The Phoenician Resort is luxurious, offers fantastic service and such friendly staff.  We spent one of our days at the Mother of Pearl pool cabanas and it made our whole weekend!  Never was there a time we needed to ask for dry towels, more water or a fresh drink.  Rich, our cabana captain, knew exactly what we needed before we even had to ask.  Simply wonderful!  There's no place I'd rather stay in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: AyliH
reviews.title: Romantic Getaway
reviews.text:
Honestly this hotel is on par with the Westin and not as part of the luxury collection for SPG. Granted the staff was very friendly and courteous in every manner (addresses you by your last name over the phone, provided ice cold water by the pool) BUT the hotel's rooms and hallways need a makeover. I feel like it's stuck in the 80's and there's a stale smell all around. 
When I step into a Luxury Collection hotel, I expect nothing but the best from staff to decor. This hotel did not meet my expectations at all.

reviews.author: North Carolina gal
reviews.title: A bit disappointing
reviews.text: We recently spent 3 nights at the Phoenician.  I must admit that we were a bit disappointed, as our expectations of this 5-star rated hotel were very high.  We found the service at a 5 star level throughout, but felt the facilities in some places were a bit worn.  In our room (5065) the wallpaper was beginning to separate in several places and there were some scuff marks on walls, etc.  The same was true in the hallway leading to our room.  I wouldn't think this would pass the 5 star level if someone were rating.  The entire property is lovely and extensive.

reviews.author: sugarcukie
reviews.title: Phoenician is amazing!  Year after year it never disappoints.
reviews.text: Thank you to Elizabeth Riley, the front desk agent, who made our son's 13th birthday so very special!  We love the Phoenician and this is just another example of excellent service and attention to detail.  We rave about the resort to everyone and love staying there when we can!  The rooms amenities, pools, dinning, music, turn down service at night, and attention to every detail makes us return to the resort for a staycation at least 1-2 times per year. Thank you so very much for such a fabulous experience!

reviews.author: csgoodman
reviews.title: Beautiful Camelback Resort
reviews.text: I took my husband for an overnight stay at The Phoenician.  We asked for an early check in and were accommodated when we checked in and upgraded to a suite.  I had mentioned that it was Scott's birthday and while we were at the pool, they left champagne and chocolates in our room.  We were treated so well and the staff were extremely warm and friendly.  The grounds, multiple pool areas, and lobby area are just beautiful.  Yes, this is an older resort, but beautifully maintained and the views cannot be beat.  We plan to make this an annual get away!

reviews.author: loco4travel
reviews.title: Place to stay in Az on 4th of July
reviews.text:
We decided to spend our 4th of July weekend at the Phoenician, one reason being that we live around the are, we have tried staying at the Phoenician even though we've lived in Az for 15 years. 
Our first thought when we saw our room: OMG we have wasted so much money staying at other hotels buy not staying here. I love the Phoenician. The beds are nice, bathrooms we're clean and designed efficiently with a touch of elegance. My husband and I promised ourselves that we will always stay at the Phoenician every 4th of July. Jean George had good food and is a wonderful setting for watching fireworks. We will be back soon. Promise

reviews.author: MSPPJA
reviews.title: Used to be spectacular.  What happened?
reviews.text: The Phoenician used to be a spectacular hotel with incredible staff, classy amenities, and a luxury culture.  What happened?   New  management?  Back in receivership?  Something happened that has dropped this from a true 5-star to a nice 3-star hotel.   The food in the restaurant is okay... not great, but just okay (if you don't mind paying $ 60 for an orange juice, eggs and sausage breakfast for two people)... the rooms are nice although room service forgot to do our room completely one day and the air conditioner was iffy... the staff was less than polished; it looks like someone fired all the seasoned staff and hired local college kids.  The renovated pool has an addition that looks like a tacky 2nd-hand carnival tent called Splurge.   This plus the uncontrolled flies and the 20-year employee-kids walking around checking their text messages while taking 45-minutes to bring food service is just disappointing.   Yes... I would come back, but without the enthusiasm I had for years.   And yes, I will be looking for my next regular place.   There are a lot of fine options in the Phoenix - Scottsdale area.  The Phoenician just isn't one of them anymore.

reviews.author: philmj1966
reviews.title: Business conference in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Unbelievable venue for a week-long conference a long way away from home. 5* hotel facilities including three 9-hole golf courses, swimming pools, hiking tracks along the Camelback mountain, and much more. I need to find a way to get back next year!

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: I'll be back!
reviews.text: I was lucky enough to stay at The Phoenician last week on a business trip.  My company had some meetings on site.  Upon check in I was upgraded to a casita room.  I'm not sure what the regular rooms are like but I loved my casita room.  I wish I had more time to spend at the pools as they were very impressive.  Most of all, the service was outstanding.  Every hotel employee that I encountered went out of there way to make me feel special.  If it were not for the employees and pools, this would just be another resort hotel.  I can't wait to go back on my own time and enjoy the property.

reviews.author: BeckyOnTheGo
reviews.title: Perfect Location, Perfect Resort
reviews.text: The Phoenician is at the base of the Camelback Mountain (I think that's the name).  There were gorgeous views in all directions.  The staff was all friendly and extremely helpful.  The grounds of the resort were amazing.  We enjoyed hiking and relaxing by the pool.  Oldtown Scottsdale is within minutes of the Phoenician and a great area to explore.  I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

reviews.author: iamjudiSoCal
reviews.title: my favorite, by far
reviews.text: i love the Phoenician. The hospitality is always so warm, the views from the rooms are amazing as you look out at either the Camelback Mountains or the beautiful pools cascading down to the golf courses. They have great activities for the family, awesome restaurants so you never have to leave the premises and it has a magical charm at Christmastime when it's decorated and has all the special activities going on.  love it there.

reviews.author: patriahart
reviews.title: Outstanding hotel fabulous service
reviews.text: This is the first time I have stayed here and will definitely come back soon. From the bellman to the valet to the front desk, to room service to the maid service to the concierge every single person was kind, caring and wanted to make sure my stay was great.  Food at J&G was excellent as was the room service.  Enjoyed it thorougly.

reviews.author: Michael K
reviews.title: Friendly service with a smile
reviews.text: From the time we pulled up at the door til we left the premises 4 days later we could not have asked for a more friendly attentive staff. Everyone was willing to help and serve any way they could.  The Deluxe Room we had was spacious and had a great view of the pool.  We dined at JGs Steakhouse onsite, the food was excellent but I felt the wine list was a bit sparse and disappointing.  We also dined at Il Terrazzo and found the meal very good as well as the wine list.  Not very happy with the automatic gratuities and fees that seem to pop up though.  I am a generous tipper and don't like to be told what i need to leave or be reminded.

reviews.author: GSquared
reviews.title: Visitor beware - extra charges may appear
reviews.text:
I guess it is true - the hotel business is following the airline industry.  Pity.  I have stayed at this property a number of times, but my last visit was more than 10 years ago.  While I really do enjoy the property, this visit was marked by a deep disappointment in the extra fees that the property tacked on to my hotel bill.  After a four night stay for a recent conference, I tried to use the in room check out feature on my TV.  It was not working.  No worries, I would be emailed a final bill.  Once back home, I had the chance to review the emailed receipt.  Each day has an extra $5.00 "Housekeeping Services" added on to my $269 (pre tax) nightly rate.  Hmmm - rather odd that they can't seem to cover a normal expense like keeping the rooms clean within the normal nightly rate.  Perhaps I should expect a discount for three of the four days when I killed bugs in the room myself?  No worries - it is the Arizona desert.  What really set me off was the $14 "Porterage" fee.  I travel all over the world and this is the first time I have run into a "porterage" fee.  In fact, I had to look it up online to fully understand the charge.  To say that The Phoenician has a large, extended footprint would be an understatement.  Therefore, when you check in, if your room is not in the main building, the front desk advises that you should provide your room number to the bell desk and a helpful employee will put you in a golf cart and drive you to your room.  Apparently, at The Phoenecian, helping you find and get to your room is a service worthy of a $14 charge, though they will not tell you that upfront in order to allow you to choose if you would like to purchse said service.  No, it just shows up on your bill at the end of the stay.  So including the tip I provided at the time, it cost me $19 just to get to my room!  In my view, that is inappropriate bordering on unethical.  
I hope that The Phoenecian is pleased with the extra $34 it squeezed out of me with these hidden charges.  I will let others know of my displeasure and will advise the organizers of my meeting, suggesting they look elsewhere for a property to host next years's event.

reviews.author: travelerplus2
reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text:
My family of four (kids 11 and 8) stayed here for 3 nights.  The staff was excellent.  Our room was in a good, central location, on the same floor of the lobby overlooking the pool.  The hallways looked a bit worn with stained carpet and peeling ceiling paint.  We were disappointed to find out our only choice for our room was one king bed or two double beds.  I didn't know hotels still used double beds!  The room was large as was the bathroom with a nice patio with a table, chairs and lounge chair. 

The kids activity center was quite a hike from our room and when we got there (after a full day at the pool), there was no one to help with getting the video game system to work, much to the disappointment of my son.  There was  a ping pong table, foosball table, and some board games to play.  I wish there were more organized activities for older kids.  They do offer a golf cart ride to/from the activity center if the bellman is not busy.

The pools were nice and plenty of towels and pool noodles to go around with attentive staff.  The food and drinks of course were very expensive as at any other resort, but $17 for a bowl of chips and salsa seemed ridiculous to me.  We got breakfast sandwiches from the ice cream café in the morning rather then spend a fortune for a full breakfast.

The internet was very slow and our room door did not close all the way automatically.  It was actually left open after housekeeping left one day. When mentioned all of this to the front desk at checkout they removed the resort fee from our bill, which was nice.

It is a nice resort, but don't think I'd stay there again.

reviews.author: LisaBenz520
reviews.title: Family friendly resort in a luxury setting
reviews.text:
Just wrapped up an amazing Labor Day weekend at The Phoenician with my husband and one and a half year old.  The resort truly is a rare combination of high end amenities that exists while still being very family friendly.  The resort was impeccable and the room spacious and updated (we were upgraded I should note!)  The pools were well kept and the staff was on top of their game (they were available to help you find chairs and would even move them for you if need be).  Ice water at the pool was complimentary and in plentiful supply. 

As we visited the resort over Labor Day, we were able to take advantage of some of the planned activities they provided in the evening.  It was a carnival theme and, honestly, what they put together exceeded my expectations.  They had games, food trucks, and various vendors in a beautiful setting.  It was so festive and a nice thing to do as a family (with other families).  Would absolutely return if our travels took us back to AZ!

reviews.author: seekAdventures
reviews.title: Good, but needs updating
reviews.text:
This hotel is good, but nothing special. Definitely not a 5 star diamond rating in my opinion. 
Maybe an "average 4 star which needs updating". 
Staff is helpful & friendly. 
Rooms are ok, but need updating. Bathroom was nice and very spacious. View from room is great once you look over all the roofs of the hotel. Lots of concrete to look at. See pictures. 
Breakfast is ok and very expensive. One day we had the buffet (Sunday) but it was not an eleborate buffet as one would hope for this kind of hotel. The other days we ordered a la carte. Very pricey. A simple omelette & coffee = $30,-
One needs to be a good walker to stay at this hotel. It is spread out and you have to change elevators / hallways a few times to get where you want to go to. 
Swimming pools are just ok. I was disappointed to be honest about the pools. 
I am sure waaaaaaay back then in the good ol' days the Phoenician was a grand superb hotel. 
It did not impress me at all nowadays.

reviews.author: Archetype
reviews.title: Incredible service!
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights. The room and amenities were fine. All clean and well appointed. What I was impressed by was the service. From the gate guard to the janitorial staff, they were all extremely polite, approachable and very friendly. The staff could not do enough for you. Obviously this is a serious part of their training and it is greatly appreciated. We would definitely return.

reviews.author: LPEssex
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: We stayed here for the first 3 nights of our honeymoon and it was wonderful. Every member of staff we met went above and beyond. Due to jet lag we were in the gym by 6 all 3 mornings, we then had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the pool, as it was early the first day we asked if they minded us being in gym kit as there wasn't anyone else there, they said it was not a problem at all. Whilst everything is 5* there was no pretentiousness to go with it, we both felt totally relaxed. The resort itself is just beautiful, truly stunning grounds. There are a few reviews on here about the fitness/spa facility being a long walk. We were in the main building which is at the back of the resort and it took us 4 minutes to get there. We had massages in the spa and they were great. I cant wait to go back and am already checking out next summer.

reviews.author: Robert S
reviews.title: Weekend of luxury and excellent golf with my wonderful wife.
reviews.text: We just spent a Friday/Saturday at The Phoenician in Scottsdale,AZ and the place is "Over the top" perfect. From the guard at the front gate to the entire staff anywhere you go there is no doubt   every employee is very well trained and proud to work there. I'm not sure if we have ever been anywhere that we were that impressed(we travel six months of the year). The pools are excellent, the food and beverage areas are the best, the golf course and clubhouse is second to none, and our room was a 10.

reviews.author: RealGypsy
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: Get pampered! Plenty of swimming, spas, sights and excellent foods. The suites are spacious and impeccably immaculate. We held seminars there for several hundred people. Everything is excellent! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Dirk W
reviews.title: Simply the Best!
reviews.text: What can I say.  The place is wonderful.  Beautiful.  All the staff smile and are friendly.  Go out to the pool and they lay down a fresh clean towel for you and bring you a pitcher of ice water.  Rooms are large and views are great.  Walk around the grounds and you are in paradise.

reviews.author: lola524
reviews.title: Pretentious overrated Dump!!!
reviews.text:
Never have I been this negative about any place I have stayed. I take in the culture, setting and truly try to find joy wherever I visit. But I would stay away from this resort. Rated 5 stars. I was in disbelief and wondered if it was given that rating due to its upscale Scottdale address. This hotel is HUMONGOUS and NOT in a good way. If you do not valet park you are destined to a very far out of the way lower garage that is compressed with cars and some kind of gadget that looked like it was holding up the parking structure ceiling so It did not collapse on you. But it does not stop there. You are then forced to go trhough two sets of escalaters walk through convention rooms, past the lobby and find the set of elevators to your particular floor. The elevators are in opposite ends of the structure marked floors 1-3 and at a distance another two elevators marked 4-6.

The rest goes downhill. It claims to have 9 pools. well if you consider 1 large pool divided into 8 small pieces, 2 of which are kid pool-water play areas (i guess in their minds it is so1). The other pool is small sits by itself and is surrounded by casitas you rent with shading for a small fortune. Otherwise there is no shade elsewhere and you are destined to burn in dry heat that hovered in 107 degree weather. Inviting I think NOT!!!. The land scapping is barren. There are no trees to offer shade anywhere but cacti are abundant. as a matter of fact that they offer 4 activities on the premises. Ready to  howl??? A walk around their cactus garden (oh yea! it was free so I did it), whole lot of nothing and I like cactus, A walk around their hotel to look at their art collection (also free). Big on lots and lots of  metal scultures that were well different and left up to interpretation!! but art is art right?, a tennis court. I passed on that in fear of heat stroke and finally a health spa that you would have to sell uor first born to partake in even their yoga classes.

There was a tiny exercise room but after waiting 15 minutes for a tread mile and walking 12 minutes to get there in the heat I was done. who designed this place must have been high. Honestly I had never been to a resort where the spa and exercise room is on the outer banks ouside the facility. It made it dangerous due to heat and i would not dream of going there on foot at night sitting in a desolate area near the entrance of the resort where who knows what or whom is lurking in the darkness. Crazy!!!.

Now for the restaurants. Oh boy!!! a bowl of cereal is 7.00 dollars. add fruit two more dollars. I hope it comes with milk because that could be another charge. They have a burger place 17.00 dollars excluding fries and drink , a steak place prohibitive $$$$ and even a tiny facility you can get a scoop, that ie one scoop for $3.85. The bottled water in the room was small fiji water for $6.50. I turned down the mini bar key. They had a Kurig cofee maker and yiu were alloted two small paper cuos of coffee. guess what the machine was broken. After 4 days out of 5 of colpaining I gave it up. The remote did not work that never got fixed. They straightened up but did NOT clean the room. The debrie on the floor when we got there was there when we left and if you wanted ice, THEY had to supply it for a tip of course. We saw no free newspaper they were suppose to deliver daily. The carpet was filthy and I dared not bathe in their tub that had grid marks around it like a race track.

The front desk staff was rude, impatient and very pretentious. They told us we had a golf view. "SURE WE DID" if you cranked your neck to the far left and wore binoculars. Unfortunate for me I lack the genetics of a cheetah to make my neck turn that far. That my friends was the so called Phoenician. by day 3 i was on count down to get back to San Diego, as I whispered the mantra "there's no place like home" over and over.

Unless it is Sedona, Arizona I will not be gong back to the land of where the sun NEVER SETS let alone the RIP OFF called THE PHOENICIAN out of principle I would NOT even stay there for free!!!

reviews.author: osupokes25
reviews.title: Fabulous Labor Day Weekend
reviews.text: We just got back from spending Labor Day weekend at the Phoenician.  We had a great time!  The resort was perfect.  The staff was wonderful and went out of their way to make sure our trip was first class.  The pools and restaurants were great.  We couldn't have asked for a better location with Camelback Mountain running right along the resort.  We really enjoyed our early morning hikes.  We will definitely return!!

reviews.author: KellerMM
reviews.title: Arizona
reviews.text:
Das Phoenician ist eine Super-Hotelanlage in ruhiger Lage an der Camelback Road in Scottsdale. Weitläufige Anlage mit Haupthoteltrakt und Casitas rund um eine schöne Poollandschaft die wunderbar dazu einlädt nach einem 15 Stunden Flug zu relaxen. Das Hotel fügt wunderbar in die Landschaft ein. Die Hotelzimmer sind eine Wucht. Es fehlt an nichts sogar Bügelbrett und Bügeleisen standen im begehbaren Schrank, die Größe der Zimmer entspricht fast einem Appartement. Sehr freundliches hilfsbereites Personal. Tolle Außenanlagen auch der Kakteenweg am Hotel entlang. Beeindruckender Blick von der Hotelterrasse ( Bar ) in Richtung Stadt, besonders bei Nacht. Die Restaurants laden immer wieder zum Verbleiben und Essen ein. Tolles Frühstücksbuffet, wenn auch etwas teuer. Wer der Möglichkeit hat sollte am Sonntagsbrunch teilnehmen.
Mit dem Auto ist man in wenigen Minuten in Old Scottsdale oder in der Scottsdale Mall.

reviews.author: Lovetogolf71
reviews.title: Great Stay at the Phoenician- Certain Staff were very Helpful!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a two night stay, that we thoroughly enjoyed.  Upon arrival our room wasn't ready, so the front desk suggested a casita that would be ready in an hour or so. We returned and were shown to the casita by a very nice bellman Rene. The casita in building D was very dark and looked out on bushes, the room itself was nice but was cavelike.  
We went back up to the desk and this time they did not have the original room, but they did have a room in the main building that was very nice. It took over 3 hours to get the room and this time the front desk wasn't overly helpful. 
The room was spacious and nicely appointed, I was completely happy with the room.
We dined at JG's, food was good and service was very pleasant, I would return here again. We had dessert at The Thirsty Camel and the bartender was so nice, he was so pleasant and it's service like this that will make me return.  
The pool was very nice and the attention from the servers was excellent, always making sure we had water which was so nice since it was so hot. Service at Oasis by the pool was also great- and the food was better than most pool restaurants.
I had to visit the Salon and once again had wonderful service as a walk-in, she was so helpful and I was very impressed.
Also a lady at the front desk helped my husband when there was an issue with business center- she went above and beyond and was very nice. 
Overall I have to say the customer service at this property really stood out especially those individuals that made such a difference.   I look forward to returning to the Phoenician.

reviews.author: mspie1971
reviews.title: Superb!!!
reviews.text: This place is awesome staff went over and beyond!!! The rooms are great with double sinks all the pools are great. View from room was great. Grounds are immaculate. The location of the resort is around everything great location for restaurants and shopping. Self park will work out fine for anyone too.

reviews.author: Hidenori I
reviews.title: とても残念です。
reviews.text: アメリカンリゾートを代表するような超高級ホテル。大通りからゴルフコースを抜けて、ゲートを通過しても、まだホテルの正面玄関には、車で1、2分のアプローチ。どんどん、期待が高まります。今年の夏で10回目の訪問にも、初めて訪れた時と同じ、胸の高まり。ロビーに部屋に、その質感や広さも、何度訪れても、感動です。避寒地のリゾートのお陰で、真夏は、リーズナブルな料金設定。ゴルフコースも日本なら2、3万円でも納得の高級倶楽部級で、真夏は、60ドル前後。朝は、ホテル内のレストランで、フリーのコーヒーサービスと何をとっても満足度ナンバーワン。ただただ残念なのは、誤請求。利用していないレストランやショップの金額が、チェックアウト時に請求書に記載され、スムーズにチェックアウトが出来ないことが何度か。アメリカ旅行では、よくあることなので、仕方ないけど、今年は、事前に、日本で払った部屋代まで、請求書に。旅行代理店のお陰で、誤請求は解消しましたが、それも帰国後。チェックアウト時の交渉は、ホテルのイメージを台無しにするほど、嫌なものでした。来年も利用したいけど、請求に関するトラブルは、海外旅行では、最も避けたい出来事です。日本語なら交渉も何のそのですけどね。

reviews.author: azjoeScottsdale_Az
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text:
My wife and I just spent the past 3 days on a "staycation" at the Phoenician and the resort is amazing.  The pools are great and ask for Sam as she is great!!   
The location is great and you will not be disappointed.  All employees attempt to exceed your expectations

reviews.author: VonKorb
reviews.title: Phoenician Pools
reviews.text: If one is inclined to swim, The Phoenician is fabulous.  There are several pools to choose from while staying at The Phoenician.  Enjoy the  desert botanical setting.  Must not forget a dip in the Jacuzzi under the stars.

reviews.author: Anat50
reviews.title: Very disappointed by my experience
reviews.text:
This was my first trip back to Scottsdale in 10 years. I booked my trip through an Orbitz package so not sure if that's why I ended up overlooking the front door, especially when the hotel was almost empty.
I had stayed at The Phoenician in the past and loved it. This time I was shocked by how "tired" the hotel was. My room was horrible. The carpet was falling apart. The light bulbs were out in the bathroom and the vanity mirror, one of the sinks had a defective plug, the remote batteries didn't work, etc. Bad maintenance or just a one off? The problem continued throughout the hotel. I was at the adult pool where there's a "bridge" you can swim under. The paint is peeling everywhere.
All in all small stuff that ended up giving this guest a bad taste in her month.
Not only were there physical FF&E issues but I'm still waiting for my final bill which was to be e-mailed upon checkout 2 days ago!
The only positive parts of my stay were my experience at the main restaurant and the concierge. 
I understand that the hotel is slated for a renovation next year until then the 5 star rating isn't reflective of the experience.

reviews.author: Tony F
reviews.title: Pretty unbeatable luxury  5 star resort in beautiful surroundings
