reviews.text: I should preface this review with the fact that when you get to the level of 5 star resorts like the Phoenician, they're all pretty good , amazing in fact, so the only differences often come down to things like the proximity of the property to nightlife , landscaping of the garden areas , bars, restaurants and pools .. Which I realise is quite subjective .. This place caters for everyone's needs ! The decor in public areas is an opulent explosion of Italian travertine ,marble and water, fountains , crystal chandeliers ..it's like a palace ,but on the right side of tacky , not the wrong Vegas side! It's got some class .. Great valets help you get wherever you need to go on check in, we were here a week so had both rooms upgraded to beautiful Necklace Lake view rooms which were as big as suites and were very well appointed .. Great housekeeping, fresh towels and room clean ups TWICE a day, and everything clean and beautiful . Lots of food option restaurants  on site from burgers to upscale steak ,catering for every whim and budget . I think for Scottsdale, this place is unbeatable , and bear in mind we checked in from the Four Seasons and are massive fans of that luxury brand which never disappoints . Although we don't play golf, this is a golfers dream too, there's a perfectly manicured golf course surrounding the entire estate and the backdrop of the imposing Camelback mountain adds drama to every tourists photo of the resort. Koi carp in the lake, 9 luxurious pools with cabanas means there's a lounger and space for every guest ..everything you think it's going to be from reading the website ..it is ! in a word it's unbeatable ..try it ..

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: Last year we stayed at the Canyon Suites, we couldn't get a booking this year so booked the Phoenician Hotel itself. I must admit the Canyon was so good last year I was worried the actual hotel wouldn't be as good. It was fantastic it exceeded all of our expectations. Ok the rooms are a little tired but the Canyon are also. Lovely property, the rooms are spacious, bathrooms palatial, the various pools are excellent, the service was 1st class and the room was $100 per night less than the Canyon Suites. The location of the Phoenician is unbeatable, everything is on your doorstep, 2 malls, lots of restaurants and the golf course. I would book the hotel next year over the Canyon Suites, more of a buzz and better value.

reviews.author: RuBear2013
reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: My friend took me for afternoon tea for my birthday.  Stunning hotel,  brilliant service and the champagne afternoon tea was fabulous.  Would definitely return.  Would love to stay next time I visit.  Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Sunworshipper123893
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text:
you can not beat this hotel. Beautiful property, fantastic pools (at least 5) Fantastic service. Worth the price! can't wait to go back. Pool side service was great.
rooms are spacious, very clean. Amenities were great. Enjoyed lunch by the pool. Everything we ordered was very good. Great steak dinner

reviews.author: MrJLphoenix
reviews.title: awesome StayCation !
reviews.text:
first step into the Lobby and we felt transformed !   the front desk is absolutely the friendliest , professional and ALL smiles !  Very helpful to guide us through our wanting to Relax and enjoy the entire property .  The rooms was beautiful clean and filled with great amenities .  
The Spa was absolutely the most Peaceful place that I was looking for on this "staycation" filled with amazing amenities and transformed my body into a state of Heaven !  
The grounds were spectacular and this has to be one of the friendliest well trained Professionally  staffed resorts around the country and I am so happy that it is located right down the street !      
I will be back for more real soon !   
Thank You to the entire Staff , from the Pool staff , to the house keepers , bellmen and the Queens of Heaven at the front desk  for making this one of the much needed restful and peaceful stays !  

Sincerely and with Respect, 
Mr. J. Ric Lopez 
Phoenix, Arizona.

reviews.author: Lise_Messier
reviews.title: A place to relax
reviews.text: had finally the chance to try this property and I must say from arrival to departure..1st class service!!! The room was beautiful, spacious, beautiful bathroom, a little to warm to relax on the balcony but the view of the gardens with the hundreds to cactuses! WOW! Concierge was very attentive and gave us amazing restaurant suggestions for The Apache Trail, Sedona and in Scottsdale!  BRAVO team, hope to be back soon. Oh and now I need to order a Luxury collection bed!! Soooo comfy...zzzzz

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: beautiful property that knows how to treat a guest
reviews.text: the entrace from the parking garage is nicer than many hotels lobbies.  the chandeliers are gorgeous the sculptures amazing, this hotel is impressive.  every single staff member acknowledged us with a greeting or at least a smile to let us know they were there to assist us.  the pool area was quiet and restful.  i would stay here again in a minute.

reviews.author: Jamie Lynn
reviews.title: Gorgeous Hotel
reviews.text: The rooms in this hotel are stunning. The tub in the bathroom is a nice touch, along with the double sinks and walk-in shower. The hotel itself is massive and there is lots to do, including walking around their cactus garden. I have stayed at several resorts in the area and would definitely come back here.

reviews.author: Su Wen C
reviews.title: Phoenician stands by its rating
reviews.text: Had a great weekend at the Phoenician.  Staff were very professional and accommodating.  Had a great time with my friends there!! Rooms are big and the balconies are great!  I would go there again.... Five star resort, without the snobbiness... very courteous and helpful... the view from the steakhouse is wonderful!

reviews.author: geez60763
reviews.title: 5 star all the way
reviews.text: I've been to Scottsdale six times in 6 years and I always choose a different resort to stay at, just to try a new experience. I like Scottsdale as a home base to take day trips, and there is enough to do to keep busy. The Phoenician is a place I will definitely stay at again. Despite a mix up with my room, the manager saw to it that it was rectified in a professional and timely manner.  We were graciously upgraded to a 4th floor room, and our lunch comped as a professional courtesy. The grounds, and staff were all wonderful, especially Derek at the valet, Emily at the front desk, and Mike the manager who followed up with me to be sure that all was well. The pools are better than the photos can ever show, as well as the wonderful poolside service.  We've enjoyed meals at a few of their restaurants, as well as in Old Town and Sedona. The Phoenician is a large property, but that is one of its charms.  I explored today, and found a lovely gazebo with a very cool waterfall!  The cactus garden is beautiful, and the guided tour was amazing. After a long day out on sat, it was so nice to come back to the hotel, and listen to live music, by a great band in the lobby area, overlooking the beautiful resort. The beds are fresh, large flat screen, a fridge you can store your water in, a coffee maker in your room, plus free coffee in one of their restaurants overlooking the pools. The bathrooms are amazing. I think it's a great hotel, with a caring staff.  Thank you all, See you next year  :)

reviews.author: worldisanadventure
reviews.title: Awesome For More than 25 Years!
reviews.text: Wow! Where to begin? Our family has been vacationing at the Phoenician for 25 years. Ellyn in reservations will take care of you! From when our 4 kids were babies to now adults, they look forward every year to return. When our kids were young, they enjoyed the Funicians Kids Club, while my wife and I had recharge time. Now, we all look forward to our Phoenician recharge! Can't go wrong here, whether you want to sit in a cabana at the Mother of Pearl pool, play golf or tennis, work out in the gym, or visit the Spa.Also, Scottsdale is a great spot for activities, food, and shopping. We have vacationed properties all over the world, and this place is #1. Whether you want a romantic getaway or family trip, Go to the Phoenician! The Casitas are special. A must is reserving a Cabana at the Mother of Pearl pool, where Rich W. will spoil you! See you next year!

reviews.author: MissShifta
reviews.title: Great value and good location
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Phonician for 3 nights in July with my bother in law and sister in law and really enjoyed our time here. We had contacted the hotel in advance and requested rooms close together and with mountain views and this was all arranged when we arrived. The hotel is a little dated as mentioned in other reviews however the grounds are beautifully maintained, the loaction is fabulous (close to the Scotsdale River front) and the rooms are huge. The hotel gym was welll equiped and the pools though we didn't use them looked lovely. I would happily return to this hotel.

reviews.author: Sheryl M
reviews.title: A Great Resort!
reviews.text: This is my second time staying at this resort and it was once again a lovely experience.  The rooms, pools and all the amenities are fantastic. Breakfast at Il Terrazzo was wonderful....both food and service.  All the staff are very friendly and efficient.  This is a great resort to stay at when visiting the Scottsdale area.

reviews.author: Luciane B
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text: Hotel mais que cinco estrelas, é puro luxo. Suites muito amplas, serviço e atenção de primeira, café muito bom, boa localização. O hotel oferece atividades dentro e fora da área, enorme. Piscina maravilhosa.

reviews.author: KareninArizona
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text:
We just returned from a five night stay at this hotel.  Overall, the service is superior.  We have stayed at many top hotels and the Phoenician wins the service award hands down.  As an example, we always received a call to make sure that we were okay with the job housekeeping did on a daily basis. 

In August, Phoenix is hot so it's their slow season.  However, we have stayed at the Kierland Westin a few times now and their pool is so crowded in the summer it's crazy.  Not at the Phoenician.  It did pick up by the weekend, but it was not bad at all.  During the week, there were not many guests around.  No problem getting pool chairs and the service around the pool was great (something the Westin has always needed help with in the past).  Love how they just leave nice towels rolled up on each pool recliner and refurbish them during the day.
  
The hotel terrace is a great spot at night for a cocktail.

We also decided to do the Royal Tea which was fun and the food was great.  You must have a reservation for the tea.

Parking can be a challenge at this hotel if it's busy and you want to "self park".  The spots are quite small so when big trucks or SUVs decide to park, it's very tough to get around them.  However, the parking is below the hotel. so the cars stay cool.

We did see a large roach on the first morning we were there.  It ran across the room and freaked me out. We called the front desk and within minutes someone was there to spray the room.  We never saw another bug in the room.  

We stayed in the hotel portion with a pool view.  We were given the casita option but chose to be in the hotel itself and be higher up.  We were glad that we went this route. We had the Grand Deluxe Room so we were on the top floor and the room was quite large for a normal hotel room.

The one thing that I have noticed being mentioned is that the hotel needs to be refurbished.  While the room was still better than most, at the prices they charge during the high season, a guest would expect top notch furnishings.  We were told that the entire hotel will be going through a renovation next year.  

Overall, the location was great with easy access to numerous restaurants, the terrific Scottsdale Fashion Square Mall, Old Town Scottsdale and more.  

People have mentioned the Activity Center. I have no idea where this was located and wish I had known about it.  I didn't see it on the map, but it might have been there.  I think the hotel might want to have a better description of it in the rooms so guests know it's available.

The only other negative I could mention is that one night a company was having a dinner at the pool area so the hotel took away several rows of pool recliners beginning at 4pm to make room for the dinner/reception.  Normally wouldn't be a big deal but since it's so hot, a lot of people don't go to the pool until later in the day and the pool recliners that were removed were at the largest of the pools.  Kind of a bummer but I'm sure this kind of thing happens at all of the big hotels.

I would rate this hotel with 5 stars except for the roach incident (so gross!) and the furnishings just looking a little tired.

reviews.author: 75Jeff
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
It is one of the best hotel in Scottsdale. The view, the gardens, the service, the staff and the saff
are first class. We have been already 5 times and never disapointed. There also kids, but the area
of sweeming (4) are so wide, the you are not disturb by the noise. In the evening, there is a
beautiful terrasse and you have a fantastic view of Scottsdale and Phoenix.

reviews.author: likey2travel
reviews.title: Heaven in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
What an amazing stay, from start to finish!

It was a three night stay for my wife's birthday, and we were greeted by the parking attendant with "I understand that someone is celebrating a birthday!" What a way to feel special.

The rooms are large, and we are glad we chose a casita. It is nice to have more of a garden feel rather than being in the main hotel, and it is great to park right in front. The grounds are beautiful and well manicured. You would never know you are three minutes from Nordstrom.

Great extras for the kids, like Surge, a splash pad that is so well maintained. S'mores night, which was yummy. Half priced meals for the kids at all restaurants, encouraged us to eat on property. Duck and koi feeding daily, the kids loved the interaction.

The activity center was a great place for the kids to escape the heat with a parent. Movies to be projected, pool, ping pong, and board games. The only bummer is both the wiki and Xbox weren't working. Three different employees tried to figure it out, but really needed someone that knew what they were doing. A for attitude, they just weren't trained in the equipment, and neither are we.

The pools were amazing. Clean, quiet, great service, and amazing quality food. What a great touch to have a pitcher of ice water brought over to us without asking. They even refreshed the ice as it melted.

Whenever  we walked throughout the resort, employees from maintenance to bellmen always engaged in conversation and asked about our stay. You do not feel like a number at this resort.

The breakfast buffet was great. Hot omelet bar cooking eggs made to order, fresh fruit and pastries, and just request waffles or pancakes and they will bring them out fresh.

It may be hot as blazes in Scottsdale during the summer, but so were the hotel rates. A great deal that will get us back again.

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.title: Rooms need a makeover.
reviews.text: I used to live in Phoenix for many years and this resort was always the top notch in service and decor. My family and I came back here to visit friends and decided that we would stay here. To be fair,the service is top notch and all the employees were attentive to our needs. However, the rooms are tired and in need of a complete makeover. There was even some gross red stain on the walls and the carpet appeared to being in a need of a deep cleaning. I hope eventually they redo the rooms as this really used to be a beautiful property.

reviews.author: tiwifins
reviews.title: Tired old hotel in need of $100mm + in renovations
reviews.text:
Been here a couple of times in the last 4 years. Some rooms (casitas) are nice, the rest are tired. 

The pools are a joke at the weekends or public holidays. The hotel continues to allow local residents access to the facilities. This made it impossible to enjoy the pool area, gym, bars etc. 

We understand from some of the team there that a large investment was put on hold but may come back soon. Will wait to visit once this happens.

reviews.author: Joycenjesse
reviews.title: Epitome of luxury, attentive staff service!
reviews.text: We were travelling in a family of 10 :6 adults & 4 kids ages ranging between 2-7yrs. The whole hotel & the rooms was very luxurious; the rooms were huge with luxurious bathrooms. The restaurant where we had breakfast was very well based, roomy & extended outdoors. Food fare was regular breakfast type & well presented with good variety. The waiter who attended to us was helpful, delightful & made us feel very welcome; I wish I can recall his name to commend him - this may help : my family had breakfast on 26 July 2014.

reviews.author: Tandtenterprises
reviews.title: Always Consistent, always 5 Stars.
reviews.text:
I have stayed at the Phoenician at least a dozen times over the past 2 years.  The JW Marriott used to be my go to spot in the Phoenix area.  I have not been back there in over 2 years now!  The location of the resort just far enough away to be peaceful, but still only about 3-4 minutes from the heart of Scottsdale (Mall, offsite shopping, other restaurants (although the resort restaurants are awesome)).  

As a SPG Platinum I feel service is good.  I am regularly upgraded to a better room, but only once a suite in as many nights.   Since I am almost always there on a weekend I think this may play into that.  I actually really enjoy the casita rooms!  If you plan to be at the pool, or dine at Relish (the excellent on site burger restaurant) these are ideal!  

Rooms are always clean!
I think I Valet parked once...  It's so unneeded.  Self parking is free, and directly underneath the resort, so you can just park and take the elevator up to the lobby.  

And a review wouldn't be complete without a suggestion...  I like that they have a K Cup coffee maker in the room.  It is a nice touch.  The one thing is I like my coffee sugary and creamy:). They have 4 K cups in the rooms, but only 2 creams and 4 sugars.  It's just not enough for more than 1 serving, so me and my wife split a cup when there.  I always meant to ask the front desk for more, but it's never a big enough deal to bother with.  

I will return here over and over again knowing I always know what I am getting, and that my expectations will be consistently exceeded!

reviews.author: alpal4a
reviews.title: lovely
reviews.text:
We just stayed here for 4 nights. If you are at all able to handle 105 degree summer heat, then there is a tremendous value to be had staying here. I prefer a pool with curves and with shade. There are quite a few pools at this property. There seems to be one for everybody. The movie night at the pool on Saturday nights is for kids. There is a water slide, kind of slow, again for kids. 

The rooms in the main building are very convenient vs staying in the Casitas.

The beds are awesome.

The breakfast buffet on weekends is expensive but full of fresh fruit, croissants, omelets, etc.

reviews.author: mexico1605
reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: Had a wonderful four days staying at the Phoenician Hotel in Scottsdale, Az. The hotel was very accommodating regarding our requests for easy access to pool and restaurants. The entire staff was most professional and friendly. Food was excellent and service in general impeccable. Would definitely go back.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Top notch in virtually every way.....
reviews.text: One of the most relaxing places that we have EVER been.  All services were impeccable--from restaurants to the spa facilities and everything in between. The Sunday brunch is NOT to be missed.  Lounging at the pool for most of the day, with poolside lunch, was nirvana.  Note: The Phoenician has the best in-room showers area of any place that I can think of...and with the heat out in Scottsdale, they are most welcome.  When you need to get away from it all....this is certainly one of the places to go.

reviews.author: Shari H
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text:
It was my second time in the past few years staying at the property. The rooms were nice, grounds well-kept, and facilities perfect for our meeting. every where I went...room, public bathrooms, meeting rooms, lobby spaces...was clean and neat. Not a spec of dirt anywhere!

I did want to commend 1 staff member: Tashonda from banquets. She was our server for breakfast all 3 days of our conference. The first day, I asked for something special to drink. She went and got it for me promptly. The second day, she was there again, but this time already had my special drink ready! Needless to say, she did the same on the third day! Kudos to her for anticipating my needs and reacting accordingly!

reviews.author: Licia Freeman
reviews.title: Spa getaway
reviews.text:
This resort is located on the foothill of Camelback Mountain, and what a backdrop that is. They have a hiking trail behind the hotel, on the Camelback Mountain that offer great views of Scottsdale. You also go through their cactus garden, which is so beautiful. 
The grounds are gorgeous and immaculately kept, so are the facilities. Staff is friendly and professional. The walking yoga is amazing!

reviews.author: greggfi626
reviews.title: Great for Families!
reviews.text:
We decided to visit Scottsdale for the 4th of July.  The property was obviously very crowded but that is fine considering it was a National Holiday.  The main attraction for us was that they were doing their own fireworks show Saturday night at 9pm and a bunch of indoor family activites on the 5th and our 4 year old loves a good fireworks show!

On the 4th we arrived around 5pm and immediately headed down to the pool and found a couple of chairs next to the pool.  Our daughter enjoyed the waterslide and the splash pad.  Later that evening they brought out a movie screen and showed Smurfs 2 in the pool.  We ordered food and had dinner while watching the moving in and out of the pool.  At the end of the night after we signed our check we waited for the server to come back and he never did so I retained my check as to not leave my name and room number for a guest to potentially use to buy food and beverage during the balance of our trip.  I was going to drop it by the front desk when we checked out on the 6th.

On the 5th we had a nice brunch and then hit the pool for the day.  We got out around 4 and wanted to check out the indoor activites in the ballrooms.  We arrived to a crazy number of wild children running around with little to no supervision and at one point one of the large inflatables was deflating on a bunch of little kids.  While the idea was great the execution was poor and could have lead to multiple injuries.  After about 15 minutes we headed back to our Suite to change and to head out for dinner so we could make it back to the hotel for the fireworks at 9pm.  We headed out for dinner and made it back at 8:15 and while we were pulling up we noticed the fireworks going off and rushed to the patio off the lobby only to see the last minute of the show.  Our daughter needless to say was very disappointed that she missed the show.  We were told that they shot them off early due to weather which didn’t make sense to me as it was a nice night out.  Disappointed we went back to the room and called it a night.

On Sunday we again had the brunch downstairs after waiting for nearly an hour for a table and then back to the pool for the afternoon.   At 4pm we had bell services come pick up our bags and proceeded to the front desk to check out.  While at the front desk I presented them with the slip I had signed on the 4th and noticed that they already had charged me for that meal and a nice tip.  I asked the front desk clerk why they would add a tip and she didn’t have an explanation.  I asked her to look into in and revise my bill to reflect the 20% tip I had added to the slip versus the 25% tip it seems was added.  Additionally I told her how disappointed we were over the fireworks show or lack thereof.  At this point I am still waiting for any response from the property as it has been over 2 weeks with no word from them.

To summarize, the property and rooms are great!  The only issue is that I think they were overwhelmed by the number of guests and the fireworks show should have gone off as scheduled as I know we weren’t the only family that was disappointed because we missed the show.  We will likely try and make it back for the 4th again next year.

(I might also add that you should keep the sundries store open later)

reviews.author: Hans H
reviews.title: Luxuriös und wunderschöne Hotel-Anlage, mit kleinen Unschönheiten
reviews.text:
Das Phoenician ist eine weitläufige Hotel-Anlage mit angeschlossenem Golf Course und in ausgezeichnetem Zustand. Diverse Pools, nicht speziell gross, aber für etwas schwimmen langt es knapp. Zuvorkommendes Personal überall. 
Wir hatten eine 49 m2 grosse Casita zu einem eher günstigen Preis. Es war wohl schon Zwischensaison, daher nur 360$ pro Tag, Temperaturen um 40 Grad. 

Das Restaurant, na ja, das war in keiner Art und Weise 5-Stern-würdig, die Speisen eher klein und verkocht oder "verkohlt", d.h. die Küche ist echt schwach. Da nützt auch der beste Service nichts. Vielleicht war grad ein schwacher Tag, da ein Gross-Anlass mit Seminaren und Feuerwerk und rund 300 Personen zur gleichen Zeit im Hause stattfand. 

Und auch das Breakfast ist nicht das, was man sich von einem 5-Stern-Hotel vorstellt. Alles wird extra verrechnet, jede Tasse Kaffee, jedes Glas Orange-Juice etc. 

Und dann noch die Daily Resort Charge von $32.55 pro Tag etc.
Und dann noch die Occupancy Tourism Tax von 36.69 pro Tag etc.

Der Hotelgast wird ein wenig an der Nase herumgeführt. 
Schade!!

reviews.author: Robyn S
reviews.title: True luxury
reviews.text:
Stayed here recently for a stay cation with my hubby to celebrate our 10th anniversary.  

We were so pampered and spoiled by the wonderful staff and setting of The Phoenician.  Check in was fast and we were offered a free upgrade.  Our room was big and immaculate.  And the bathroom!!!  So luxurious.  

We had drinks at the hotel bar and dinner at the steak house.  Both were fantastic.  My filet was cooked to perfection and the tuna tar tar was scrumptious.  The view was beautiful with a panoramic view of the valley.  Upon returning to our room we found a bottle of bubbly on ice compliments of The Phoenician!!! 

We normally stay with a different 5 star brand when we travel or stay cation in Phoenix.  I will be checking from here on out to see if The Luxury Collection has a property in the area and will book there instead. 

Thank you for the wonderful memories!!!!!

reviews.author: Scoobbydoo
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Just finished our second stay at The Phoenician, and can't wait to return.  Ideally located just a very short drive from restaurants and shops, the resort is very peaceful.  We come for the location, and the on-site golf.  Rooms are tastefully decorated, ours had a massive marble bathroom, large shower and bath.  There's art and sculpture everywhere, in the grounds and corridors. If you want to eat in the hotel there's options available, with daily happy hour specials at Relish.  Prices do reflect the resort's status! We used the buffet breakfast once on our first day, preferring to venture into the town to sample cheaper and equally as good alternatives.  Summer desert golf is quite a challenge, rates drop if you can tough it out after 11am. We did, and enjoyed 3 rounds across Desert and Canyon each day, Oasis was being worked on (9 holes each part, joined to make your 18.  Staff are very welcoming and helpful across the resort.  Have tried other locations across the years, this is our favourite.

reviews.author: WarwickshireMonty
reviews.title: beautiful setting
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights recently.  The hotel is set in beautiful grounds which are immaculately looked after. The rooms are largr and comfortable,  as indeed is the bed. With 8 pools to choose from, there is plenty of room to relax.  The staff are friendly and helpful. Relishnand il Terrazzo restaurants are worth a visit, even if they do close rather early. Would recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Kellibaresall
reviews.title: Excellent Service and Great Accomodations
reviews.text:
This hotel is absolutely wonderful!!  First of all I can tell you most of the time the difference between a 4 star hotel and 5 star hotel in my opinion is often the level of service you receive and The Phoenician reminds you that you're in a 5 star hotel from the second you walk through the door.

We went for my friends birthday and we spent a day having cocktails by one of the amazing pools and went back to our room to be surprised with a bottle of champagne to celebrate the occasion.  Called down to the front desk numerous times for requests which were not only granted within minutes but then followed up by a phone call from Janet to make sure we received everything.  The beds were comfortable, our room had a pool view, the bathrooms were large... what more could you ask for.  Am planning on staying here again in a few weeks.

reviews.author: kwman
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
I've recently had a 3 night stay at The Phoenician following a 5 night stay a couple of months ago. There is little I can say about this property that hasn't already been said other than how amazingly we were treated while on holiday there.

As you drive up to the hotel you have to stop at a security post, where they give you a card for your car and take some details, they even wished me a happy birthday, which was the reason for our visit. Then as you arrive at the hotel itself an array of staff start opening doors, welcoming you and taking your luggage. A 5 star welcome. There is a valet option but as self parking is free, we decided to self park but the valet staff took care of our car while we checked in.

The lobby is gorgeous with chandeliers and marble everywhere. There was a short wait to check in and upon check in we were upgraded from a Superior, to a Deluxe room based on my SPG Gold status. While checking in, another member of staff handed us a water bottle each, very welcome on a hot day.

The rooms are large and well appointed and the bathrooms huge. Each room has its own balcony and coffee and tea making machine. It was interesting to note that during our stay in May, the room had more modern furnishings. We actually preferred the classic style rooms.  Not sure if they are actually updating them all or keeping a selection of both.

We loved the turndown service which greeted us after dinner or drinks every evening. We'd come "home" to the bed turned down and all the bed decorations removed, tomorrow's weather forecast, some chocolates on the bed, the TV cabinet opened, slippers by the bed and all our toiletries attentively laid out in the bathroom.

The pools here are numerous and one of our nights here fell on American Independence Day so the pools as expected were busy.  The Phoenician did their best to help with wrist bands for registered guests, lots of staff and extra chairs. The service at the pools was fast and efficient, water was provided without even asking and food and drinks arrived promptly after ordering.

We had breakfast at the hotel restaurant every morning. There was great choice and the food tasty if a little pricy. There was a buffet available on two of the days, then on the Monday, it was a la carte.

The hotel definitely has a feel if refined luxury about it but there are a couple of areas that could do with a little TLC, nothing that takes away from the great experience, but the lifts (called elevators in the US I believe) could do with being replaced. We were trapped in elevator 13 for some time and spoke to the hotel engineer via the lift phone but this was quite a scary experience. No one contacted us from the hotel to find out if we were OK afterwards but this didn't really detract from the whole experience.

I will DEFINITELY be returning to The Phoenician.

reviews.author: SuzanneNJTwinsMom
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL OASIS
reviews.text:
We ended a two week vacation at The Phoenician.  

The Hotel- WOW - gorgous!  From the moment you enter you are greeted by luxury.  We had booked a grand deluxe room.  We were offered an upgrade to the casita (but we loved the feel of the Hotel). We did look at the Casita but it seemed older and not as bright and pretty.  We had an amazing view (4th floor facing the pool) outstanding view of the pools!!  Very spacious room.  Very clean.  Large bathroom.  We had a king bed and our younger children shared the pull out bed.  The ladies at the front desk were super sweet. 

The Pools-  We had a wonderful time at the pools which were not crowded.  And being from NJ- we did not find it too hot.  We had plenty of shade under the umbrellas and stayed cool in the pools.  I Highly suggest - buy the $11 Surge cup and use it all week to refill your drink (ice tea or soda). Well worth the price as one ice tea would be $4.    Loved the poolside service- especially on the kids menu the grilled chicken tacos...grilled chicken, lettuce on a soft tortilla, with a side of salsa and guacomole and tortilla chips.  Everyone in our family loved these.  

The Mother of Pearl pool was gorgous!!    We were disappointed that the "surge" splash area was closed...but the manager was so kind- she sent us up some snacks and a voucher for a free in room movie.  The kids LOVED this!!! Thanks Jen!!!!   

The only downside to the hotel were the bee's.  There was a lot of bees around the pool area.  We stayed in the pool most of the day - only out to go to the bathroom and eat.  I told everyone to watch where they walked so they didn't step on any.  The birds could be annoying too but I was more worried about someone getting stung.

My kids loved the pool side Chocolate and Vanilla Smoothies!

DINING:   We enjoyed all of the restaurants.  El Torazo- breakfast Buffet --- omlets/eggs, delicious muffins (blueberry were the best we have ever had)....  Terrific service.  Dinners at Relish (Casual- amazing Chicken Sandwich)....we wish they had a side traditional salad as an option to the tater tots.....we would have gone back if they had.   J&G Steakhouse- dined there twice. OMG the shrimp cocktail were some of the best we ever had.  The Lobster cocktail was fair- we expected it to be different that what it was.... The Filet Mignon was the BEST... we also had Ribeye (we all enjoyed that but the Filet Mignon was the best).   The asparagus was delicious. Everyone was very kind...Even thought J&G is very upscale, they could not have been more friendly and accommodating, they allowed our kids to walk in from the ice cream shop with their ice cream in hand (we allowed them ice cream before dinner!)- it is vacation.

Cactus Walk - Highly recommend this tour- the hotel had it- it was on property and the kids enjoyed the walk as did we.  No charge, but we did tip the man as it was a fun experience. 

Oldtown Scottsdale- For $30 roundtrip the hotel will take you about 2 miles away.  The kids enjoyed purchasing trinkets for soulveneers.  I had wished they were open later so we could go at night but most of the stores are open from 10am-5pm.  So we went early 10am so that we could spend the rest of the day at the pool.  Highly Recommend Olive and Ivy Restaurant-Fantastic!!! WE had flatbread pizza, bruschetta, Caesar Salad...EXCELLENT food and service....  The stores were just ok.  The kids were happy with their little gifts. 

The Spa at Phoencian- We had visited a few other spa's in Arizona and we felt the spa needed updating.  There should be a much better area for men/women to relax together.  For Example in Sedona Mi Amo Spa has a co-ed indoor/outdoor pool area for guests... would have been great to have an hot tub (co-ed) and a much nicer relaxation room.  The lazy boy leather chairs were kind of cheesy-- we did like the running water feature.  Everyone at the spa was super nice.  Jean gave an AMAZING massage.  Highly recommend him.   We got vouchers from TravelZoo- pre-paid discounted massage.  The spa charged $28 for gratuity which was more than fair! 

Concierge- was super friendly and helpful.  Thank you Michelle!!!  

Overall- My husband said this was his favorite hotel of the three we had stayed in.  He enjoyed the live music in the lobby at night (piano).   He enjoyed the luxury feel.  Everyone was very nice.  Very clean and pretty property.  We would recommend this to our friends.  If you go during busy season rent a cabana at the Mother Of Pearl Pool- well worth it - you get reserved seats in the cabana as well as outside of the cabana in the sun. 

Last thought- they said they are trying to make it more of a family place... would suggest more activities at the pool for the kids (games every few hours run by the kids club).... and maybe an covered outdoor play area like at the Westin Keirland - Outdoor Huge Chess set, fooseball, ping pong etc)....

Thank you for a wonderful end to our vacation!!

reviews.author: mush73
reviews.title: Just shy of perfect !
reviews.text:
We quickly changed our destination from Naples Fla (Impending Tropical storm / hurricane) to Scottsdale to ensure great weather (sun & Heat). With less than 1 week to plan we found the Phoenician and surprisingly they had availability for the busy 4th of July weekend and following days. We were offered a " summer Special" which gave us spectacular savings incentive so we booked. As part of the special the $29 daily room fee ( internet) was waived and wifi was free to use while we stayed. When we checked in we had to call the desk to get the free wifi use we were promised when booking as part of the summer deal.

Every single person at the resort that we encountered was friendly, professional and most of all the were beyond accommodating. The entire staff smiles at you and greets you as you enter / exit / walk thru . We noticed  genuine hospitality and definite desire to ensure that you as the guest are satisfied. The customer service was excellent, and nothing like I had ever experienced in the U.S. ever before. I had asked the front desk the morning of our second day If it were possible to have some " Firm" pillows brought up to our suite. The receptionist said " absolutely, and I am so sorry if you didn't get your routine sleep requirements. I will have them brought up. What is your room number and your last name?" I told her and she then smiled and said, " Mrs. Burger I will have those pillows up to your room. I hope that tonight you will be as comfortable as you are at home."  Again Sincere and a can do professionalism, and that is just the initial request. My husband I made our way to the bakery in the lobby and by the time we finished our breakfast, and returned to our room, the pillows had arrived. We headed out for the day and when we returned, we noticed that the receptionist had left a message on the phone " wanting to make sure that the requested firm pillows arrived and were to our satisfaction". Amazing follow up and polite ?? Not so common but Awesome !
   The rooms are very spacious. We stayed in a Mountain view King. The rooms are clean and well maintained. The décor is up to date and the beds are comfortable. The bathroom is spacious as well. The rooms and the resort are very clean and well maintained. Our room had a great balcony with some furniture and a fantastic view of the " camelback" mountain. 
 My husband raved about the Golf course. He rented clubs at the course and said they were so great he may buy new clubs to match the set he rented. The pools (9) are very nice a bit too much chlorine I think, but there are many children and wildlife around that appearently also like the pool. There were plenty of chairs during the week, but the weekends can be more challenging to find chairs. There is an adult only pool which we truly appreciated. The hotel has many activities for kids and is very kid friendly, however we are not. There are Water yoga and water aerobic classes offered as well. There is a poolside menu of food and drinks which we did have one day, but it is a bit pricey for what you are actually getting. The Iced tea and soda's are $3.50 and they do not offer free refills. We spent $50 for lunch ( no alcoholic beverages)  The wait staff are very friendly and they do bring free ice water and cups to everyone quite frequently. There are a lot of Bees around the pool area, be careful.
   The hotel also has a very nice Fitness room that was very busy but too busy that you had to wait for a machine. They have ellipiticals, treadmills, free weights and machines Cycling machines. There are towels and water available as well. They even offer daily fitness classes.
   My only reasons for not giving this hotel the best rating of " Excellent" are described below. These reasons are minimal in the entire scheme of things. But I do think they could be easily improved upon and should be. The rooms' privacy or " do not disturb" sign is a black leather door hanger. The word  " Privacy" is etched into the hanger and is not obvious at all. In fact I didn't know the room had a privacy sign and as I was in the shower, the mini bar agent had come in after knocking  (loudly). I asked if someone was there and he quickly replied : Just checking the mini bar, " he exited quickly and I was never exposed as bathroom doors were closed. Very awkward for Me and for him but He was totally professional and I was not informed of / did not notice the door hanger until well into our 3rd day there, shortly after this incident. I would suggest that the " Privacy" hanger stand out .   Additionally, the room lights are mostly lamps, the lights are controlled by switches on the lamps not the walls. Different but not terrible.
   We checked out and my husband noticed that our bill had the $29 daily fee for all days we were there on the charges, however as part of the " summer Special"  this daily fee did not apply.So he again had to call to get these removed as promised when we booked. Also we Had incurred some various mini bar charges, but we did not have anything from mini bar, we just used the refrigerator for our own water bottles and iced tea. We are still working on getting to the bottom of these charges, as we are not certain what they are. There is a nightly turn down service and they bring chocolates and water to the bedside, we thought this was free but as it turns out it may have been part of those mini bar charges, although we are not sure and still are trying to figure it out.

reviews.author: Burrelldi
reviews.title: Spring Break with my family....
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician in Scottsdale, Arizona.  It is a beautiful hotel and the staff were very helpful.  The food was excellent and they catered to my grandchildren.  It is located near everywhere we wanted to go.  I walk with a cane and they have golf carts to take you where you have to go. The whole family loved it.

reviews.author: AuntLaLa2014
reviews.title: Fireworks Galore
reviews.text: We were visiting relatives in Phoenix and they suggested driving over to The Phoenician on July 5 to see the fireworks.  What a beautiful hotel!  We were greeted warmly at the gate and told where to park.  A short walk through the well-manicured grounds and we found a wonderful old-fashioned Independence Day party in the works.  There was a live band, children happily running around; lemon water if we were thirsty.  The staff offered a mat if we wanted to sit on the ground (which we were given to take home!) or a chair.  Later they brought everyone glow-sticks for more fun.  The fireworks show was fantastic; early because of a threatening storm - but no one seemed to mind.  Kudos to the hard-working staff  - everything was so well planned and executed.  If this is any indication of the hotel's overall service, we'll be back as guests!

reviews.author: Tennismum916
reviews.title: Best Resort in Scottsdale!!
reviews.text: Absolutely loved staying at this resort! We had a large family vacation and the resort went out of their way to accommodate our needs. Whether it was golfing tee times, restaurant reservations, hot balloon air rides, the hotel went above and beyond to make sure our arrangements went without a hitch! Really enjoyed our visit to Scottsdale. The service at this hotel is exceptional.

reviews.author: ReeceReese
reviews.title: Great 4th of July Staycation
reviews.text:
My family enjoyed our stay at the Phoenician for the 4th of July weekend.  First of all, I must state how surprised I was that this resort was very family friendly.  For the holiday weekend, they had many activities for the kids ranging from t-shirt painting to their own indoor carnival.  I was truly impressed!  
The resort grounds are kept in good shape. Our room was very spacious and clean. We had turndown service every night.  The restaurants on site were good but if you are staying a few nights you may get tired of the same food fairly quickly.  Don't worry, they are quite a few restaurants from the resort within 5 miles if you need variety. 
  This resort had alot to offer...numerous swimming pools, splash pad for kids, activity center(includes a small movie room,xbox games, board games, etc.), golf course, hiking trail, tennis courts,etc.
I was going to give this resort 4 stars.  But I am going to give them 5 stars instead due to the excellent service I experienced from the time I pulled up to the door to the day we checked out.
I can't wait to see what festivities they have planned for next year!

reviews.author: Ustrotter89
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Scottsdale!
reviews.text: I stayed here because my job was holding a training here. The staffs service made my stay as the most unforgettable expirence. Michelle from the concierge planed a free day that I had in the area so I was able to see everything that Phoenix had to offer. Also my first night there I ordered room service and the attendant was so friendly and personable. The bellman also went above and beyond and always offered me a bottle of water. If you need a place to stay in the area this is your best option!

reviews.author: prosticon
reviews.title: Pas mal  mais....
reviews.text:
Globalement The Phoenician est un excellent hôtel mais... Ayant réeservé une chambre accessible en fauteuil roulant mon épouse et moi même se sommes retrouvés avec une terrasse donnant sur... un mur.( Voir les photos). Le lendemain le réceptionniste M Olmo nous a proposé une chambre située loin du bâtiment principal. Au rez de chaussée avec certes un petit jardin mais, sans vue et... sans soleil. Mais bon le plus gênant était le fait que  pour aller prendre son petit déjeune il fallait prendre la voiture... Donc plier le fauteuil, puis le déplier dans le parking... Sinon au niveau accessibilité la salle de bains était adaptée.  La piscine du bas était parfaite ainsi que le restaurant italien .Le personnel était très accueillant et attentionné. Le soir sur la terrasse du bar nous avons eu droit à une présentation de rapaces.
En conclusion il ne manque pas grand chose pour que ce resort figure en bonne place dans le classement des hôtels que nous apprécions.

reviews.author: uachaudh
reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text:
First of all, I would like to applaud the type of service and professionalism that I recently encountered at this lovely establishment.  I have stayed at a fair number of resorts and hotels throughout my career and vacations, and felt the need to write this review due to my personal experience.

1)  The service.  As I mentioned, I have stayed at a fair number of top-notch resorts, but rarely have I come across the type of service that I encountered during my stay at The Phoenician.  I applaud the management for understand that a hotel like this will have many other competitors that offers similar beauty and resources, but what distinguishes one place vs. the other is simply how they treat their guests and also, how they go out of their way to make their guests feel welcomed.  And that is what I encountered with this resort.  Each and every step, anything from a bottle of water to asking how my day was going to anything whatsoever, they were top notch.

2)  Professonalism.  I booked my stay via the in-house reservation and encountered an individual named Nathan Davidson that I find it important to point out.  Beyond being courteous and professional, Nathan spent the time to work with me on my reservation, and when you come across that level of professionalism and someone who actually speaks to you as they want to speak to you and make everything as perfect as it can be, it is very refreshing.  I hope management continues to hire and train people like Nathan because trust me, it is that level of service that distinguishes a resort.

3)  The pool, valet guys, hotel room staff, etc....The pictures and the resort itself speaks for itself.  Just look at the pictures and yes, those pictures are for real and this place is really that breathtaking.  But it was also all the little thing that accumulated that made me appreciate this place even more.  The friendliness, the taste of the Phoenican Crunch ice cream, how they serviced your room not once but twice in a single day, the kindness of the valet guys, and etc...just magnificent.

Again, a great and memorable stay.  I look forward to visiting again.

reviews.author: Theresa M
reviews.title: I didn't want to leave!
reviews.text: It's funny to read what others have to say that stayed during the same time period that we did. We stayed over the 4th of July and our experience went above and beyond.  We arrived on July 3rd and experience a Dust Storm, the manager of the restaurant approached our table to just let us know what might happen and he filled us in on exactly what a dust storm was.  Everyone used our name if they knew.  The pool people hovered close by and delivered pitchers of ice water on a continuous basis.  July 4th the pool was packed, they did the best that they could with the amount of people that were there. Extra chairs were set up on the grass, and even there they were delivering those pitchers of water.  Everyone was as accommodating as possible considering the circumstances of the crowds.  Our room was spotless.  We own a restaurant so I am always looking for dust and those spots that no one remembers to clean and honestly I couldn't find anything to complain about.  Turn down service at night, newspaper at our door in the morning.  Ice delivered quickly when needed.  Check in was very easy and we were able to check in early which was a pleasant surprise, and the Conceirge service was fantastic. They took the time to talk to you and their recommendations were spot on.  The hotel itself provided Infiniti SUV's when we needed transpiration that was close by, and our drivers were courteous and informative on the area.  We had delicious burgers at Relish on the golf course, and the Italian restaurant for dinner was awesome and for breakfast was wonderful.  Didn't want to leave and definitely would stay here again.

reviews.author: GriffinH9
reviews.title: 4th of July weekend
reviews.text:
I probably would have enjoyed this stay more if I didn't have the expectations of a 5 star hotel. I would not call this a 5 star hotel. The room we had was outdated and had an odd smell. It looked out over an ugly roof and had no view unless you leaned way out and looked to the right and you could see a little sky. 

The first night we had turn down service. None the second. The housecleaning crew came while I was still in the room the first morning and I asked them to come later. They never returned and so our room was never cleaned over the two nights and three days. 

The resort fee was pretty outrageous. I get a little bitter when every little thing is added as fees. Drink at the bar was undrinkable. We threw it away and it was $15. I asked for a taxi to downtown, was offered a shuttle service. I wasn't told it would be $15 to go 2.4 miles. 

The pool was very nice but very crowded. We couldn't get chairs for both of us so we shared. The service by the pool was good. 

They had a lot of activities all weekend. Probably best for families with kids. I was interested in a cocktail mixology class and called the number listed to reserve a spot three times. No one ever answered. 

The highlight was fireworks last night on the patio. They were beautiful and we enjoyed the live music too. Service on the patio was good, although the smoking bothered me. 

I appreciated the underground parking to keep the car cool. 

Overall, decent room, nice resort, okay service, not what I would call 5 star based on my experience at other 5 star hotels.

reviews.author: Alex G
reviews.title: Stay over 4th of july 2014
reviews.text:
This is not a 5 star hotel. I would give it 3, 3.5 most. The pictures on the website were photoshopped to look perfect. 
Service is average. Rooms are outdated and not spotless (as you would expect from 5 star hotel). The bathrooms around the pool are dirty, paper towels all over the place. 
The guy near us got a cut in the foot while in pool, he was bleeding when he got out. The staff "cleaned it" with towels, no sanitiser or chlorine.   
Would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Leigh P
reviews.title: Top notch service
reviews.text: I love this resort, grounds are beautiful. I love the pool areas and the service is always amazing. They treat you like royalty here. Eating at the restaurant downstairs for breakfast was so peaceful with great views, blueberry pancakes are a must. Won't stay anywhere else in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Randy S
reviews.title: Superior Service and Genuine Hospitality
reviews.text: From my greeting by Anthony to my check out everything about the Phoenician experience was exceptional.  Being in the business I know how difficult it is to grant early check in requests but even at  my very early arival time Jenn at the front desk never missed a beat and I was in my room in no time.  The room was perfectly prepared and throughout my five day stay housekeeping was flawless!!  I felt pampered,important and most of all relaxed.  On the the first day of my stay I got turned around I had trouble getting back to my room and Tony the bartender at one of the restaurants came out to help me find the right elevator bank !!  That kind of service and hospitality will ensure that I return !

reviews.author: kewsontour
reviews.title: The best customer service ever!
reviews.text:
What a resort/hotel! We have just come back from 5 nights at the fabulous Phoenician and really did not want to leave. The whole resort area is fantastic with great rooms, restaurants, bars, pools, etc. However, it is the staff that truly make this such a fantastic place to be - they have a knack of knowing what you need before you do! Customer service second to none - all without being intrusive in any way. 

We stayed in a basic Casita room with lovely view of the garden and pearl pool - gorgeous room, bed and bathroom with great products and the best shower. We spent time at the Thirsty Camel Bar and Lounge - thank you to Nick for being a barman extraordinaire! We ate at the Oasis Bar several lunchtimes - great salads and burgers and again, lovely staff. We also ate at the Steakhouse on the top floor of the hotel - fabulous views over the hotel grounds and Phoenix - make it up there to see the sun set. The golf club staff were also fabulous and looked after us - good short course with some challenging holes.

All in all, a fantastic stay and we can't wait to go back one day soon!

reviews.author: cessnajockey
reviews.title: Incredible pool slide area with even better pool-side dining
reviews.text: I snuck into the pool area with my 11 year old while my lovely wife pampered herself at the spa.  They've got an AWESOME area next to the pool slide to kick back and relax - it's naturally shaded by the rock slide and trees, which allowed me to just kick back, take it easy, and not worry about the little one who was busy going up and down the slide.  I didn't have to worry mainly because the nice lady at the top of the slide kept all the kiddies in line.  The only disturbance I had was by an attentive waiter who recommended the Mahi Mahi sandwich and a cocktail for lunch - it was absolutely delicious.  I couldn't have asked for a more relaxing afternoon.  Thanks for letting me crash your pool!

reviews.author: Monica D
reviews.title: Would not recommend!
reviews.text: We spent two nights at this resort and were very disappointed.  While the staff was very friendly, the service at the pool area was horrible.  We were ignored constantly and had to wait forever just to get a drink.  When we finally got our lunch order it was incorrect and we then had to wait another 20 minutes for them to correct our order.  They advertise that one of their pools is an "adult only relaxation pool", but this is not the case.  Only half of the pool is adult only and it's anything but relaxing.  They do not stop kids from coming into that side of the pool and we constantly had to tell parents that this was an adult only pool.  There are no signs letting people know this on the other side so i don't blame the parents for this.  It's very confusing and they do not enforce this policy at all.  For a resort of this caliber and the amount of pools they offer they should simply make the entire pool adult only.  It just makes no sense and many other resorts i have visited always have a designated adult only pool.  The pool staff does not pick up your empty glasses and I can't tell you how many times we would just watch them walk by and not pay attention to the trash around the pool.  The other very negative thing is that they allow smoking at the bar area and around the pool.  So besides the obnoxious party people and loud children screaming we were also subject to cigar and cigarette smoke all day.  Not a pleasant and enjoyable experience at all!!!  I would much rather stay at the Westin Kierland or the Four Seasons for the money you pay to stay here.  I will not be back!

reviews.author: Keith M
reviews.title: Scottsdale June 2014
reviews.text: Just returned from eight nights and a fantastic hotel. Regular visitor to Scottsdale area from Scotland and not stayed at this hotel for 15 years. Was fantastic, great buffet breakfast, underground parking great for keeping the car cool and loading/unloading (especially shopping!). Great location and beautiful grounds. I got engaged whilst there and Kaylee Bolger there could not have been more helpful in planning an amazing night. Can't wait to return

reviews.author: 35ishnow
reviews.title: Fabulous place
reviews.text:
Great place for vacation with anyone.  I went with my husband and 20 months daughter.  Good food, great service, and atmosphere.  The only draw back was the J&B steakhouse.  The food was not that good and over price.  Save your money and enjoy the other restaurants in the hotel.  Il Terrazzo had great service and delicious food. 
The pools are awesome. They treated us like VIPs.  I would definitely comeback to stay at hotel again.

reviews.author: Smcbride75
reviews.title: Luxury at it's finest...for a price.
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed for our anniversary. It was luxurious and the staff was kind and welcoming. Our room was upgraded and everyone catered to our every need. The cost of the room was reasonable but if you want anything extra it will cost you. Understandably, since everything is done with perfection. We rented a cabana and received ultimate attention including fruit, dessert, beverages and a sunblock/lip balm kit. I highly recommend getting a cabana during the Summer months.

reviews.author: Gloria L
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Although the weather was about 109 degrees, we totally enjoyed our stay at the Phoenician. The grounds are huge and lovely. Breakfast which was included for us was delicious! Concierges were extremely helpful. Fitness center very nice...watched as all machines were cleaned from top to bottom after each use! Big treat was the singer who entertained by the lobby/bar area. She had such a lovely voice, we ended up sitting and listening to her for quite a while, even though we had intended to make it an early night that evening.

reviews.author: bunnyfeet1
reviews.title: Now this is customer service!
reviews.text: Celebrated our anniversary during the summer taking advantage of their amazingly low  "staycation" off season rates which are fabulous for this 5 star resort. From the moment we entered the property we were greeted by name. Even the security guard knew we were celebrating our anniversary. Beautiful, well kept property with the utmost in customer service by everyone you encounter on your stay. They delivered champagne and chocolates to our room for our celebration and free dessert with our dinner. 8 pools for enjoyment, world class art on the walls, gourmet restaurants. Something for everyone. Oh, did I mention the spa and golf course? Don't miss this grand hotel any time of the year!

reviews.author: Ginut98
reviews.title: The real deal in relaxation!
reviews.text: We spent a long weekend at The Phoenician as the last leg of our trip which included some serious hiking at Antelope Canyon and the Grand Canyon.  We were looking forward to some serious R&R after all the adventure of the earlier trip not to mention all the driving we did!  From the very beginning, the experience was phenomenal!  We weren't certain what exact room we booked so the valet went inside to find out so he could valet our car or direct us to an area where there was plenty of self parking which made valet unnecessary.  As we checked in, we were upgraded to a Casita which was very nice.  The Casita was great with a very large room, great bathroom and balcony area.  The pool area and overall grounds are great.  It is clearly meticulously cared for.  I had every intention of playing some golf but the hiking part of my trip had me too tired to deal with golfing in the heat. I did get myself out there to use their driving range.  While the daily resort fee is a bit steep, i did take advantage of it since it provided for free club rentals at the range.  I think i could have been at the range all day honestly.  The staff continues to fill up the balls at each station which is nice.  At the end of the day, we came to this resort to recharge and the spa center was great for that.  Massages are definitely not cheap but we did really enjoy it.  I made use of all the amenities at the spa including a free meditation class, steam room, etc.  WiFi was also great throughout the resort!  Relaxation does require some good internet!  The wife and I are looking forward to another trip back to the Phoenician where i can take advantage of the golf!

reviews.author: LISA D
reviews.title: Birthday, fizzle
reviews.text: After careful consideration I decided to celebrate a milestone birthday at The Phoenician, certainly didn't receive anything from the hotel like above reviews let alone an upgraded room, now I'm even more disappointed. Casita rooms had dust on walls, headboards, rust ring on ceiling, prior guest hand prints on glass top and old/stained carpet.  I expected a four diamond room and was sadly let down.  I have heard they will be upgrading rooms, sorry I couldn't wait to celebrate my birthday later.

reviews.author: RosaFay1002
reviews.title: Birthday extraordinaire
reviews.text: Four friends gathered to celebrate a milestone birthday - couldn't ask for more. Champagne and strawberries from the hotel on our arrival (thanks, Emily). Top notch service everywhere in the hotel. Hooked up with a great tour guide by Michele C.  Pools and spa were excellent.  Highly recommend, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Shahin
reviews.title: Oasis
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent the weekend at this resort. We arrived in the evening and decided to use their fitness center.  They have an amazing center and the walk to it is pretty nice.  The pool area looks really cool at night.
The hotel in general is very nice and has a nice golf course.
The next day we decided to go to the pool around 11 am. Once we entered the pool area we noticed alot of families and kids. and getting a towel required a wrist band, room key and last name which i found to be kinda lame.

Overall though our stay was pretty nice.

reviews.author: McJacketts
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Just returned from 7 days at hotel for our 17th anniversary.  It's perfectly located for Camelback Mountain, which we hiked at 430am, as coolest part of day. Also great location for old town and huge shopping mall. As we checked in told receptionist celebrating our 17th wedding anniversary on Friday. She upgraded us (7202) which was a casita, which I had already booked after reading reviews on here. However the upgrade was just a better view, which wasn't the case as our room was very dark as view obstructed by a huge tree. However kept it cool along with air con and could park car outside saving on valet charges. Beds very comfortable and room very spacious but the carpet was never vacuumed the whole week. Used gym which was very good and internet was accessible down by the pool however this is all charged in the $32 daily charge which felt was a bit steep. Ate breakfast in hotel on 1st day but they didn't have a buffet which was disappointing & felt the $56 for cereal with yoghurt, fruit plate, omelet and coffee was not good value. Didn't eat in hotel again. Our anniversary day was not acknowledged again which would have been nice so on check out I reminded them, along with the room not being vacuumed. However receptionist Jen redeemed the hotel but taking money off our final bill and leaving a gift for us on our departure. She went well beyond her call of duty by offering excellent customer service. She said if I had told them of room with no view they would have moved us. Scottsdale is a beautiful area and hotel is beautifully looked after by staff and would return again.

reviews.author: notfrequentflier
reviews.title: Lovely and met expectations
reviews.text:
I was recently there with three friends to celebrate a milestone birthday.  The hotel is about 20 minutes from the airport.  We were greeted by professional and friendly front desk staff, who accommodated our request for adjoining rooms.  The rooms are spacious, and very clean.  There is a small Keurig with coffee and supplies.  There was complimentary Starbucks brewed coffee in the Italian restaurant on the first floor every morning.  The bathroom has two sinks, separate water closet and the shower is separate from the tub.  There were plenty of clean, fluffy towels and washcloths.  A hook for your towel would be helpful near the shower.
The shower door is not frosted, so if someone is showering, the bathroom is not really available, which would be a problem if you aren't with a significant other. There is a decent hairdryer provided, as well as the usual toiletries.  There are many different pools, all of which were clean, with plenty of lounge chairs, umbrellas and clean towels.  Someone was always bringing a pitcher of cold water.  There were child friendly and family friendly pools as well as adult only pools.  The spa was lovely and professional, and clean.  Four of us each had 2-3 spa treatments over two days, and all but one were excellent.  The one that wasn't excellent was just an ok massage.  
The concierge was helpful with a private tour guide arrangement to Sedona, and also sent us champagne to celebrate our birthdays.  The restaurant, Relish, was terrific, serving specialty burgers.  We also ate at the Italian restaurant, and it was lovely.  
We all agreed that it was overall a fantastic experience, and we would return, maybe even with our husbands and children.  Top notch.

reviews.author: CLF49
reviews.title: Upscale and fabulous
reviews.text: We were in the Phoenix area in December 2013 for a football bowl game.  We had made reservations at another hotel but decided to change to the Phoenician at the last minute.  I was glad we did.  The grounds are gorgeous, the staff was extremely helpful and accommodating.  They drove us in a golf cart to our room.  Our stay was short, but my sons were able to get a round of golf in and couldn't say enough fabulous things about the course.  We enjoyed the breakfast buffet the last day we were there and it was worth every penny.  This will definitely be on our "return to" list.

reviews.author: Kathy K
reviews.title: Fantastic place to stay
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing in all ways, including all of the staff. It exceeded my expectations and I will definitely return on the future. If you are looking for a beautiful and clean place with lots of amenities I would recommend staying here. From the cactus garden & Camelback Mountain to the beauty of the fountains and pools - it is breathtaking!

reviews.author: Judy S
reviews.title: Sensational Spa Resort
reviews.text:
This property will take your breath away! The grounds are magnificent with six pools including one for children and an "adults only" as well as a splash park. There is a golf course and several tennis courts. The oleanders were in bloom which enhanced the overall appearance of the place.
Our room, a one bedroom suite was truly amazing. It was huge with a bedroom, kitchenette, dining room, living room and two complete baths. 
The service was outstanding. The staff could not do enough to ensure our stay was a wonderful experience.
The food was very good in the restaurant we frequented; there is a choice of several different eating places.
All in all, a wonderful experience - including my massage at the spa!

reviews.author: EmilyinSTL
reviews.title: April Business Trip
reviews.text: Lovely resort.  The pools are beautiful, as are the grounds.  Camelback in the background makes a perfect setting.  Rooms could use a little updating and service by the pool could be more prompt.  Location was great and overall I would recommend.

reviews.author: johnnyobof
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway
reviews.text:
This resort is top notch all around.  Excellent for golf or tennis enthusiasts, couples, families, or babymooners.  My wife and I stayed at The Phoenician for 5 nights for a final warm weather getaway before our baby arrives.  It exceeded our expectations.  The hotel right is next to beautiful Camelback Mountain.  There are plenty of activities (golf, tennis, several pools, several wonderful restaurants, hiking trails, bike rentals, etc) available, but if you're looking to simply relax, you can catch some sun near the pool and enjoy a cocktail or 2. In my wife's case, the staff toyed around with several non-alcoholic "mocktails" which was really appreciated.  

While there is plenty to do on The Phoenician grounds, if you're looking to get away, Old Town Scottsdale is just about a mile or 2 away.  There are several bars, restaurants, and an upscale mall as well.  When we ventured offsite for dinner, we tried Chelsea's Kitchen (southwestern), The Henry (a little of everything), and The Mission (mod Mex).  All three were wonderful, as were all three of the restaurants on The Phoenician property.  I highly suggest a burger from Relish and/or a steak from J&G.  

Now onto the staff/service... One day we rented bikes, and on the way back, my wife got a flat when we were still about 5 miles away.  The hotel had a driver pick us up and return us. Belinda at the tennis shop/bike rental office was so kind to send Phoenician hats to our room later that evening as an unnecessary apology.  Just one example of the staff going above and beyond.  Every night, there were chocolates by our bedside and turndown service several times a day as well.  Last but not least, a special shout out to Sam at the pool bar. She was very accommodating, making different "mocktails" for my wife, engaging us in friendly conversation, and providing candid feedback on things to do/places to see around the area.  

While we came to the resort primarily to relax, I used the gym several times, and the facilities are well above average from what you'd see at other resorts.  My wife had a tennis lesson and was thoroughly impressed as well.

Not a negative, but one note for potential visitors: There is a daily "resort fee" which covers in-room wifi, tennis, bike rentals, etc.  

Overall, a truly relaxing getaway with top notch service, plenty to do, and large, above average rooms most of which have beautiful views and balconies. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking to travel to the PHX/Scottsdale area.  We plan to return at some point in the future.

reviews.author: Craig C
reviews.title: Excellent course and service!
reviews.text: The Director of Golf, Ryan, is the man! He treated us very well and the playing conditions were great! Every time I visit the Phoenician, I am treated as if I am a member. Even the outside service guys are courteous, which is hard to find at many courses. I will keep coming back as long as the service continues.

reviews.author: Lord Belfry
reviews.title: Serving up 90s eleganza!
reviews.text: Just a one night stay here, so not enough time to really try everything. The room was large with a fantastic bed, but I felt like I was staying at my grandparents place - the rich ones with the fancy house on the golf course that they built in the 90s when they retired. I generally avoid these uber-planned resort/spa like resort hotels, so overall I must say it is very nice. Except for a few cases of charming idiocy the staff is great - which says a lot because there are hundreds of staff at this place. Play along and carry tip money everywhere you go. Terrazzo breakfast was really good - but the birds of prey the hotel seems to keep on staff to keep the pesky scavenger birds away was impressive. Every kid I saw was having a great time - I was jealous of them - the pool areas are pretty cool. Fitness center was fine, spa seems great although a few spots seem ready for a facelift --- not unlike the entire place I suspect. One final comment: I like to try to use the stairs in hotels - especially if I use the gyms (seems strange to run 5miles on the treadmill and then ride elevators). But the maze-y layout was baffling and I swear my floor was only accessible by elevator. Everybody I asked was stumped. If you're not good with directions just ask the valet guys for a ride in the golf cart to the gym (seriously). In fact have them drive you around everywhere in a golf cart, it's summer in Arizona, it's 110 degrees outside, who really wants to walk anywhere?

reviews.author: Dana A
reviews.title: So amazing
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived to the last day of our stay this hotel was amazing! GREAT resort we will 100% be back over and over again, my only regret was not staying there longer! Loved J&G steakhouse, probably the best experience I have ever had with a resort! Thank you to all the attentive staff and friendly service, big thank you to the manager of J&G (Ryan) truly a great experience for my first time in Arizona.

reviews.author: ScrapChickTampa_FL
reviews.title: Pampering in the desert
reviews.text: A great resort for golf or R&R.  We stayed a week recently for a company event and were impressed.  Set right up against (Camelback?) mountain – many of the guest room patios allow a lovely view straight up the vista. Other guest rooms look over the resort’s expansive golf course or manicured desert scape. All guest buildings were serene and quiet according to the friends and coworkers travelling with us.  We were on the mountain side and enjoyed watching the iguana and quail each morning.  The facilities themselves were very good.  Although the age of the resort shows through occasionally (like the shiny silver and brass fixtures in our bathroom) – the resort is all about high end, up to date finishes.  Our guestroom was huge, well-equipped and clearly renovated recently (only exception being those faucets and handles – why!?)  Of course with all the resort amenities you’d expect – bathrobes, slippers, etc.  We tried most of the on-site restaurants and liked J&G Steakhouse and the Thirsty Camel Lounge the best.  The Camel has gorgeous views and entertainment after dark – really enjoyed that spot.  My husband golfed and raved about the course. Neither of us got to the spa but we did enjoy the resort pool – or actually pools.  There’s lots of pool/sun decks to choose from – which is a really good thing when it 110° in the desert.  Plentiful umbrellas and tree shade – keep the pool very comfortable even in the middle of the afternoon.  Food and beverage service outside is quick and fairly priced.  Our only criticism would be about the chair cushions.  Most were stained and dirty from ducks and birds.  We were really taken aback to see such a thing at such a highly ranked resort.  Put extra towels down!  The resort is also just a short drive from old town Scottsdale, as well as a very high end mall and more.  Suffice to say that there is lots nearby to keep you busy should you run out of things to do at the Phoenician – but you probably won’t!  We hope to visit again.

reviews.author: Steve K
reviews.title: Left a sour taste
reviews.text: One bad apple can truly spoil the barrel.  I know I am being hypercritical and The Phoenician probably deserves 3 stars but I can only give it one.  For the most part it is a nice resort showing it’s age.  The toilet seat cover fell off when opened, wallpaper was pealing and the ice tongs were sticky (all unacceptable for a first-class resort).  But my biggest complaint comes from the service or lack thereof at the pool.  I was visiting on business but had an hour to spare at the pool and to eat lunch.  I had one of the guys working at the pool set me up with a lounge chair.  I told him I wanted to order lunch and could he please get me a waiter.  20 minutes passed and no service.  I approached Orlando, who worked at the pool but could not take food orders, and asked if he could please get me a waiter.  Another 20 minutes passed and still no service.  I was fed up and approached Orlando and this time asked to see a manager.  10 minutes later Jeff, the pool manager, approached.  I expressed my dissatisfaction and he offered to take my order.  By then I was out of time.  He took my name and room number and thanked me for my input.  The entire event left an extremely sour taste in my mouth.  Someone should have called my room or at the very least left an apology note for when I checked out.  Needless to say there are numerous resorts in Phoenix and Scottsdale who want my business and will provide the 5 star service I expected.

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel and Amazing Staff
reviews.text: I loved this resort:I travelled alone on business.   I checked in at 3pm but my room was only ready around 4:30pm after a 11 hours of travelling.
