While I waited for my room I went to Thirsty Camel Lounge and had a pizza and beer.   Well,  the pizza took over 45 minutes to come,  I didnt say anything as I was waiting  for my room.   Well a big surprise was waiting for me!!  Alex Verkruijsse Director of Thirsty Camel Complex came over to me and said that the pizza was on the house because he found that the service was not acceptable!!!   Wow!    I was so impressed that my stay would start on such a fantastic positive note.   Congrats to you because I was totally impressed and it made my day since my travelling day was long with adventure.     I stayed in a ground-floor Casita with parking right in front so it was easy to come and go and didnt have to pay 29.00$ for overnight parking.   My view was the Camel Back Mountain with the gardens and the lagoon.   It was lovely.   The pool was very busy on Memorial Day weekend visitors and lots of families.   I was very  impressed with the staff who filled my  ice water regularly throughout the day in the heat.  The pool and the activities for  kids looked fantastic and I could see all kids all ages were having fun with kids pool and the pool with water activies/water slides too.   There are 6 pools at this resort and 1 pool is  adults only.   You have the choice to choose a quiet space next to little lagoon or the more busy area.  The rooms need a little updating but they are clean and confortable.    The pool restaurant Oasis Pool Bar & Grill is really nice,  I tried a few plates and they were all very delicious but a bit pricey.    You need to try the fish sandwich OMG was so delicious and the Salad with Shrimp and Feta it was also very good.    The premises of this hotel are so pretty.   I walked the sidewalks near the golf course and it was amazing views with Camel Back Mountain in the background.  Don't forgot to go up to the 5th floor to J & G Steakhouse for dinner or a drink they have fantastic view of premises and a beautiful sunset.  The gym is very nice and the spa too.   There is a trainer  from the gym named Wade who takes guests for a small fee  to hike Camel Back Mountain, it felt safe  and it made it easier since I was alone.     Everybody at this resort is polite, helpful and professional.    I travel a lot and I notice service and I like to point it out when it's there.  Congratulations to all the staff.   It's so appreciated to feel that staff sincerely cares about the guests.

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.title: Best of Scottsdale
reviews.text: This resort was a last minute choice after a planned trip to Cabo was scuttled on the day we left due to a passport problem.  Everything about the resort shows attention to detail and the service was impeccable.  While the food was expensive it was very good and coupled with excellent service made the few times we ate there worth the price.  Make sure to check out the Cactus Garden carved into the mountain at the back of the resort.  Pool attendants were accommodating and checked back often bringing fresh water.  Renting a cabana was a highlight.  We chose one in an area that had only two others close by and it made for more room to spread out.  Underground parking was a breeze and a close walk in to the hotel.  Could hardly have asked for more, we would certainly go back for another stay.

reviews.author: WheretonextBOS
reviews.title: Wouldn't spend my own money to stay here
reviews.text:
My friend's husband used points to book us this hotel for a girls getaway.  We essentially relaxed in our room, the balcony, and the pool.  We were upgraded upon arrival and the room was spacious.  The view of the pool area and also a garden type area where conferences had their breakfasts and lunches. So while sitting on the balcony there were 50 or so people eating prior to the meetings, not a great view!  The pool areas were on the small side and much of it was reserved for specific groups…..I was not impressed. Not that the pool area has to be huge, but it just wasn't set up in a way that made it appealing.  We ate onsite one night and the meal was so unmemorable I can't even remember what I had.

All in all, I believe the hotel has seen its day.  I'm not sure what the fuss is all about?!?! But if you can get a free room, it was certainly a pleasant stay with pleasant staff but no where near what I expected.

reviews.author: TJNE
reviews.title: Beautiful resort backing on Camelback Mountain!
reviews.text: We loved the resort - we stayed in a ground-floor Casita with parking right in front so it was easy to come and go.  The pool was crazy busy with Memorial Day weekend visitors, so the wait staff was a bit slow.  We were super impressed with the staff who replenished our ice water regularly though in the heat.  We had a bit of an issue with the front desk staff mixing up credit card info, but nothing too serious.  Would definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: Kamyar K
reviews.title: Amazing get away .
reviews.text:
I go to this hotel every year And 
I have to say this was one of my best stays at this hotel. 
The service was amazing the staff were polite and very helpful from the pool guys to management . 
I called for an early extra check in since I decided to drive from Los Angeles to Scottsdale because I would be easier fort kids to sleep through the night .The hotel manager called me after I made the request and made sure we get the early check in at 3:00 am.
I have to say we had 3 rooms and they had the 3 rooms ready to go. That's service!!! 
The pool and the activities for the kids very great. We stayed there over memorial weekend and there was a lot to do .
The pool guts check on our water and towel every half hour to make sure we have ice water and enough towels.
The rooms need a little updating but over all nice rooms. 
I also noticed new updates to the hotel .
Over all great place to stay at .
I feel this is the best place to stay at Scottsdale and again I am very happy with the staff and 
The service to make sure me and my family have a good stay!!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Still a champ
reviews.text:
It had been a while since I stayed at the Phoenician and I was wondering if it would live up to my memories. It did, in spades.

First, the grounds are lovely and driving in you seem to leave the arid world of Arizona and find yourself in a lusher, more temperate climate. 

You stay at the Phoenician for the experience and the service and I have to tip my hat to the staff, uniformly they are excellent and very attentive to your needs. This was a business trip for me and I was fortunate to be able to have my wife accompany me so it was fun for both of us.

The only downside is the Phoenician is getting a bit long in tooth and some areas could use a refresh. The rooms, service, grounds and staff are top notch, if you have a chance give it a try a very nice place to stay for a few days.

reviews.author: tigerlilykelly
reviews.title: Pampering extravaganza!
reviews.text: Though this is a large property, the customer service feels like a B&B. They are attentive and accommodating. Our favorite thing is a cabana at the Mother of Pearl Pool (must reserve ahead of time). Rich, who has been the server there our last two visits, is wonderful. The property is beautiful, the accommodations lavish. You feel like a star there!

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Fabulous stay
reviews.text: If you are looking for attention to detail that this is the place to go.  you need not carry cash, all the individuals attending to all of your needs are tipped automatically, included in your room fee.  This is nicer then you think, your bags are carried, your dinner plans are suggested and wait staff is great.  We had high tea in the lobby one afternoon, the view was great and so was the service.  All the food at high tea is unlimited, you will walk away full if you want to.  We had a room that faced Camelback mountain.  I think that is the best side unless you would like to see the resort or the valley.

reviews.author: MonicaR001
reviews.title: Favorite Resort in Phoenix
reviews.text:
My favorite resort in the Phoenix area!!

The property is absolutely beautiful!! I have been to this property several times and it continues to be one the best. Great location!

The staff is very inviting and accommodating to all guests. We checked in and they were very helpful:) 

Amenities, would have loved to stay a few more nights to enjoy more. So much to do on this property. 3 different pools, restaurants, activities, and so much more! They have all that one would want and need plus more.

We stayed on property and didn't have to leave. The food was high quality and outstanding at every outlet! 

We enjoyed our stay and will be back soon! My favorite Resort in Phoenix!

reviews.author: messnerpatricia
reviews.title: First day - checkIn
reviews.text: What can I say but... Wow!  Check-in with Alexa was absolutely wonderful. Instead of talking down to me she talked to me, (Hotwire booked) she was accommodating to our needs (2 dbl beds) and when I requested a cake sent to our room for my daughter's birthday she was quick to respond with the request. She has been very gracious. The wait staff member was attentive and let me say that the cake was absolutely scrumptious (chocolate mousse cake, mmmmmmmmmm). Thank you so much. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful. The grounds and views of camelback, which is in the backyard of the hotel is exquisite. I am just amazed and extremely happy that we have the opportunity to stay here.  Tomorrow we will be partaking of the pool area and will let you know all about it. I can't wait!

reviews.author: Tom T
reviews.title: Great property and service
reviews.text:
Not sure what's up with all the negative reviews and complaints.   I have high standards and expectations and The Phoenician has not disappointed.   Fantastic room... Clean and updated.   

The service has been excellent!  I'm here for memorial day weekend... Off to a great start!   

I'll be back!

reviews.author: LuxeryWorldTraveler
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
We are frequent travelers with high mileage in upscale hotels.
This one is at the top. management is outstanding , on top of every detail.
not a cheap stay , but worth every penny.

Pros: Pools , Atmosphere , Rooms, Management , Service , Food , reasonable pool food prices , activities, Free water, Management ( Again)

Cons: Depreciated Keys , Lack of in-pool Shade (Issue if you travel with babies)..

reviews.author: 183carolines
reviews.title: Perfect Domestic Getaway
reviews.text:
I usually don't count it as a vacation if it's in the US, but this definitely was a vacation!! I stayed her for a week with family, and was sad to leave.  The room was huge, and housekeeping did an amazing job organizing our mess both during the day and evening during turndown service.  There was really something for everyone.  Good food on site, and a variety of pools for both the adults and kids.  We spent a lot of our time in a cabana at the Canyon Suites where we had some people in our party staying.  The pool boy was super attentive and friendly.  Staff remembered us whether it was the hostesses, waiters or really anyone we came across more than once. I'm glad I have family in Scottsdale, and a reason to go back!

I would recommend a room in the Canyon Suites if you are looking for a more quiet environment.

reviews.author: lew48
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort but watch for hidden fees.
reviews.text: My husband I attended a wedding at this beautiful resort. We enjoyed our stay and all was as you would expect in a resort of this caliber.----until checkout.  We had chose not to do the resort fee as we didnot need any ofthe things included. The negotiated price of the room for the wedding guests was quoted and very clear.  However there was no mention in the quote for a PORTAGE fee and a housekeeping fee. We carried our luggage to our room ourselves and we left our maid a tip. It was 3:45 in the morning when we checked out and I did not have the inclination or time to argue and was told it was part of the negotiated price. No where in my confirmation could I find this portage and housekeeping fee. Unless you want to be in the position the airlines are in you need to be up front about hidden fees.  Congress will go after the hotel industry next.  No complaints about anything else.

reviews.author: mhalbi
reviews.title: Needs new management
reviews.text:
Took my daughter there for a spa weekend. The spa services were wonderful, but the layout was confusing, and you had to share the pools with the hotel guests. Chairs were extremely difficult to find, and the pool drinks were outrageous! $47 for two Margaritas! Went to dinner on the property, and again very slow service for the price you're paying
It's a beautiful property that needs some TLC. No bathrobes in our room, when I told the front desk, they weren't surprised. Was there on business and had a totally different experience. Maybe they just want the corporate business.

reviews.author: Taniapaulino
reviews.title: Viagem de sonhos
reviews.text: Maravilhoso, tudo lindo, atendimento excelente, comida, bebida, passeios, indico este hotel, área de lazer maravilhosa, refeições, tudo muitos limpo.também existe um pequeno shopping e uma galeria de arte, jardins maravilhosos, cascata, lago com peixes, além de um excelente spa.

reviews.author: Christian Friedland
reviews.title: Great luxury hotel for Phoenix, pleasant attitude.
reviews.text: Nice luxury resort if you are visiting Phoenix. It is a number of years old so its not sterling, but its contemporary enough, rooms are very spacious, and staff was exceptional. The grounds are well kept, and all the facilities are nice. The pools are a bit confusing, there are so many pools I'm just not clear what is the kids pool vs the adult pool, vs the quiet pool. Outside of that fitness room is nice.. But be ready to WALK if you are in the main hotel.

reviews.author: 625RL
reviews.title: Had much higher expectations!
reviews.text: I really had much higher expectations going with my family to this resort. This resort has been on a lot of top hotel lists over the years. I used my starpoints to stay here and the check in receptionist treated us like vagabonds staying here for free.They were very stressed though at the check in desk. Hey, I earned my starpoints and they should be valued like I was a cash pay customer. Both my wife and I have SPG Gold Status. Ok, we're not platinum but still we've had gold status every year for a decade. Not only did we not get an upgrade, we we placed in one of the worst rooms possible right by the loading dock where we were waken up by 6am every morning. The hotel was crowded during spring break. Pools were crowded. Receptionist very busy. If you anticipate large crowds, please staff accordingly. Rooms were ok. Beautiful grounds though, but we won't be going back. Management was lousy when we stayed here over a year ago.

reviews.author: christy_t619
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and great customer service
reviews.text: My company sent me here for a week for a leaders convention to acknowledge my accomplishment. The resort is beautiful! The staff is wonderful. The bell boys and cleaning staff were extremely friendly and courteous. My first night there the cleaning person (a lady) didn't clean my room. I found out after I was locked out due to my keys being deactivated. Security assisted and had a cleaning person to my room to clean immediately. She came and apologized and asked when she can come back. I said after 6pm since I have an event to attend. The following day I met Mahar Esho. He was very helpful after I explained what happened. He offered to clean my room right there. He was a gentleman. He made sure I was content. He greeted me every time he saw me in the hallway. He had a friendly smile. Thanks for going out of your way to make sure I felt accommodated. I will definitely be returning to stay.

reviews.author: JaneD88655
reviews.title: Perfect Service
reviews.text: I would just like to start by saying that the grounds at the Phoenician are simply amazing. Beautiful landscaping, pools, lobby, restaurants, etc. However, the service is what made my experience at the resort unforgettable and the reason I will be back. From the nice young lady at the front entrance, to the nice lady at the front desk, to the nice waiter at Il Terrazzo I felt like they were all waiting for me and my family to arrive. In particular I would like to praise a young man at the belldesk named Jose. He single-handedly set up our whole Sunday afternoon. He made reservations for us at a wonderful restaurant in old town Scottsdale. He set up our transportation (For 8 people) from the resort to church, back to the resort, out for dinner, and back to the resort. I was telling him the times we needed and he did not write them down, but remembered them all! The driver waited for us outside the lobby with a tablet which read our last name. It was great. What I appreciated the most was his follow up the next day. He left a message in our room noting that he was off the Sunday afternoon after he set it all up, but wanted to ensure that everything went flawless. Unfortunately, I was not able to see him the rest of our trip, but wanted to make sure he received his due praise. Overall, the resort was nice, but the service was perfect!!!!!!

reviews.author: desnudouno
reviews.title: Room issues
reviews.text:
My husband stayed here for four nights on a business related couples vacation. When we arrived at 5pm we were told there were only rooms with double beds available but that we would be in one of the casitas and we could move to a king bed room the next day.
The casita was on the 2nd floor of building F and had a great view of the pool, main building, and mountains. No complaints about the room at all and the bathroom was HUGE. The issue was that we were on a romantic vacation and slept in seperate beds due to the small size of the double.
As promised, we were moved to a room in the main building the next day with a king bed. However, this overlooked the loading dock. The lack of a view (terrible view really) we could live with but there was noise coming from the loading dock all night long and my husband could not sleep.
Finally, we were moved to another room in the main building far from the loading dock. This time it was clearly a room that was used as a smoking room. I'm not sure if smoking is allowed in the hotel but there was no doubt this was a very smokey room with many cleaning agents used to mask the smell. At this point we were in the 3rd room in 3 days so we just stayed put.
I know all hotels have their "bad" rooms but it just stinks (literally) to have to stay in one of them.

On the flip side, every employee we encountered was extremely helpful and friendly. Drinks at the pool were good and not watered down at all. This is a place I would return to but would insist on a specific type of room.

reviews.author: MackGold
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great for conferences
reviews.text: Stayed at the Phoenician for a conference and it was stellar.  Had an extra day to enjoy the lovely pools, spa, etc.  The facilities are lovely, gorgeous pools, nice beautifully appointed rooms.  I hear the golf is terrific, although I don't play.  Proximity to Camelback and Paradise Valley.  Service was excellent. It was an ideal location for a conference.  While I'd enjoy just being able to relax there, I'd not want to be surrounded by conference participants -- something for families or couples on vacation to consider.  Also, the spa was a good notch below the rest of the property and other spas in the area.

reviews.author: Teri10023
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and  great staff
reviews.text: I am a Starwood Gold member and have just stayed at the Phoenician six nights  for a special birthday celebration and Mother's Day weekend. From the moment we arrived , our stay was perfect ! The hotel grounds are beautiful. There are three levels of pools so no matter how busy the hotel is , my husband and I always found a quiet shaded area at one of the pools. The hotel staff is amazing, always going that extra step so make sure that everything is perfect. We took advantage of the gym every morning which had excellent equipment and a beautiful view while working out. Our room was immaculate , very comfortable and very quiet. We has lunch at the pool and the food and service was great. The concierge service is excellent and Natalie at the front desk was extremely helpful. We visit Phoenix quite often and we are looking forward to returning to the Phoenician. A perfect and memorable stay.

reviews.author: Fernanda S
reviews.title: Paraíso!
reviews.text:
É um resort de golf localizado praticamente no meio do deserto. Vá para relaxar e esquecer do resto do mundo, pois não é tão fácil sair do resort para dar uma voltinha em Scottsdale ou Phoenix.
A paisagem é maravilhosa, principalmente ao entardecer, quando o sol bate nas rochas e forma imagens dignas de páginas de revista. 
O quarto em que fiquei, além de ser espaçoso e confortável, tinha uma vista espetacular. 
O banheiro é bem grande, com uma banheira de tamanho razoável.
Fui no inverno e apesar dos dias serem gelados, o sol brilha forte e dá pra aproveitar muito as piscinas enormes e aquecidas. 
Há pistas de corrida, academia, spa e jardins maravilhosos.

reviews.author: Spoon2012
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
The hotel is well managed, clean, service oriented, and well located. 
We enjoyed our stay in a deluxe room with a view of the pool area. My wife enjoyed a day at the spa.  We were at a convention and the hotel handled the meetings and meals with great care and expertise.

reviews.author: piniw
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, grounds and pool area but needs updating
reviews.text:
We just spent 5 nights at the Phoenician and had a wonderful time. The grounds are immaculate and the pool area was fabulous.  We had great service at the pool even when it was busy and loved taking advantage of the tennis, biking, gym.  Location:  perfect for downtown Scottsdale which we visited daily.
Here are my negatives:  
our room was very far from everything so I would ask for a room by the pool next time. 

The rooms are in major need of updating for this price.  We actually had mold growing in our shower, carpet was old, fraying furniture.  At $500 a night I expect a lot more.

There was a day we were at the pool and a couple played Country music on their cell phone very loudly.  Then I think other people were annoyed and started playing their music.  Plus the speaker music of the hotel.  We spoke to an attendant and they said there is no rule against that. There should be!!!  Imagine your relaxing day with all that going on.  And all other chairs were full.  

Overall a great trip. I would come back at a discounted price or when the rooms are redone.  Four Seasons in my opinion was a much nicer hotel but this had a better pool area and is closer to town.

reviews.author: vegasbride07
reviews.title: Why would ANYONE give this place a negative review??
reviews.text:
If I could give the Phoenician more than 5 stars I would!!  Let me start by saying we are SPG Gold members.  At check in they offered to upgrade us to a suite but since we arrived at 11am, and the suite wouldn't be ready until 4:00, AND we were only there for one night, we opted for a standard room which was ready for us right away.  By standard, I mean there was no view (if you call the gorgeous palm trees "no view").  The room (in the main building) was lovely, large and with a huge terrace with a comfy chair and lounge.  The king sized bed was SUPER comfortable and the pillows among the best at any hotel I've ever been too.  The bathroom is large with a lovely sunken tub, separate shower stall and a separate room for the toilet.  I can't for the life of me understand the people who gave the rooms bad reviews.  
Now for the service. Impeccable!
They couldn't do enough for us!!  The bartender (Steve) at the pool bar (one of the several pool bars) made me the best Prickly pear Margarita, and then didn't charge me for it!  He only charged my husband for his.  And it's not like we'd been there for hours or days..it was our first (and it turned out only) drink at that bar!  The young man in the ice cream parlor/snack shop was not only incredibly polite, when I went in to buy just a banana, he told me "No worries, just take it".  Who does that?  And then there are the attendants at the pool.  Ok yes, the pool area is BUSY.  It's Scottsdale and it's 100 degrees out.  If you couldn't get a lounge, get there earlier!  Don't blame the hotel or the attendants!  We explored the hotel and waited until 3:00 because it was so busy and then found a couple of chairs together.  Right away we were brought towels and a pitcher of ice water and two glasses.  The ice water was refilled for us about 45 minutes later.  
We had dinner at the "Thirsty Camel" because the other casual restaurant was filled.  Two fabulous personal pizza's out on the terrace with drinks (two free drinks as our Gold welcome gift from the hotel), a guitarist playing and the gorgeous Scottsdale sunset....I can't gush enough.  Oh yes, and because I had mentioned on our reservation that it was our anniversary, they sent up a bottle of champagne and some chocolates! And by the way, we didn't even PAY for the room, as we did this particular night on starpoints.  We will most DEFINITELY be back.

reviews.author: Mark R
reviews.title: golf, pool. spa
reviews.text:
close to scottsdal foroutings, the best thing here is the oversized rooms. Some of the largest rooms I have stayed in that would be suites in other resorts or hotels. You don't hear your neighbors either with the size of the rooms. Separate soak tub, shower, toilet areas. 
Views are othe the mouton right behind or of the pools. The mountain views are some of the most quiet rooms as the pool areas may host parties.
Steak and service at j&G is OK, if you really want a top steak go spend the bucks and go off campus.
The pool seating is cozy, like "hi where are you from" cozy when the resort is full and seating is a premium. Renting a cabana avoids the cozy close buddy buddy spacing of the deck chairs. Good towel service and deck chairs at the pool, it just needed a little more room. The tile pool was really nice on the feet and ascetically pleasing.

reviews.author: PFH59
reviews.title: Beyond our expectations
reviews.text: we had heard so much over the years about this hotel and they went beyond on all major points. Spacious well designed out marble 'palace' with huge windows everywhere to take advantage of the incredible views.  Service was professional, yet personable--staff very pleasant and attentive. We have stayed at St. Regis in Aspen and New York, and they can't compare to the Phenocian. Every employee we had contact with seemed genuinely interested in making sure we were satisfied---RARE.  Beautiful amenities--four pools, great golf and tennis and don't forget the hike up Camelback Mtn (Cholla Trail). Even the weekend athlete will find it fun and just enough of a challenge before lounging by the pool in the afternoon. Several terraced restaurants with first class menus and the 'Relish' clubhouse as a nice alternative for oversized burgers.  Perfect long weekend stay. We are making a May tradition.

reviews.author: Cathy B
reviews.title: Maybe it was just our room?
reviews.text:
I hate writing negative reviews but I was anticipating this vacation at this hotel for so long and was disappointed to say the least. There is a certain expectation when the rooms cost $500/night. The property itself is beautiful and pool and gardens spectacular. 
It may have been our room specifically (Rm 6156). Walked into the room and the carpet was older and rippled. Anticipating the view because the walk to the room faced a beautiful cactus garden and opened curtains to face the parking lot in main entrance. Wallpaper ripped about 12" long at the desk in the room which did not look nice. Furniture dated. The beds were very comfortable though.We were told the rooms will be renovated next year but unacceptable to let rooms deteriorate while waiting for renovation. Opened coffee maker to find a used coffee kurig filter still in unit. Cleaning crew definitely did not take pride in this room. Really? Again that $500/night expectation. 
During the week, we were woken to the beautiful sound of car alarms going off 3 different times. One night, we had a beeping go off every half hour which we tried to identify (it was the phone) and it took multiple calls to get it fixed the next day. On Saturday, after all day shopping, we came back at 5:00 and our room still untouched. We called housekeeping and the staff member we saw on his cell phone in the hallway 10 minutes before said the manager gave him too many rooms to clean so he was unable to get to ours. 
The girl who did our turn down the last night we were there was awesome. I wish she were there the whole time. She straightened up toiletries, gave fresh towels, music on radio, slippers laid out. People we talked to had that service every day. Guess we had the "cheap" room service. 

The spa: Need to have some positive feedback too. Had a papaya wrap that was wonderful! I would highly recommend. Everyone I encountered was very professional. Pool staff very attentive. Loved the breakfast buffet for $25.00.

reviews.author: James T
reviews.title: Prefect Hotel
reviews.text: This is my third time staying at the Phoenician, Scottsdale.  W elope the location its close to everything you would want to coin the area.  The rooms are spacious and well appointed.  The pool area is great, there is a slide and splash zone for those hot days.  The pickle pear margarita are awesome, if you try them have with their specula tequila.  I would definitely recommend this hotel...fantastic.

reviews.author: Phil G
reviews.title: Great place for families visiting Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this hotel. I will discuss each category separately.

Staff - the front desk of this property including concierges are amazing. I wish I could remember all of their names but I remember Michele S., Emily, Elissa and the other female concierge went out of their way to help. The cleaning staff also did a good job.   

Property - I found it to be lovely. I brought two other families along and one of them felt it was a little dated. Perhaps it is - just a little, but they are planning a multi million dollar facelift in the next year. The grounds are kept clean and the gardens well manicured. Wayne, the grounds manager does a great job and will also take your kids on a very cool tour of the cactus gardens. 
They also have Rob the hawk guy by the pool. He walks around with a hawk from Africa that the kids love and the pesky birds that like to snag food from your tables do not like. In fact there were hardly any of those birds around. I think their experimental venture is a success.

The pool is super kid friendly although their family pool sits empty and would do better as the adult pool. The slide and splash pads were a big hit with the kids. One negative comment about the pool area is the large neon sign above the bar. Not appropriate for this type of property. The staff at the bar/pool are super friendly - Nate was always eager to help with umbrellas and chairs, and the food and drinks were always quick to arrive. 

Our room was in a great location 3102. It was very close to the lobby and close to the restaurant downstairs. The room was well appointed and the mattress and bedding were all very comfortable. We had just come from a Hilton in Sedona and this was a welcome change. 

Food: hotel food was delicious. The kids and I enjoyed everything. The service in the restaurant Il Terrazzo was as good as the service by the pool. I wish I could remember the names of the wait staff but trust me they were all great - as was the floating manager that always made sure guests were happy.

Breakfast is delicious and there is some kind of deal where kids can order from the adult menu at 50%off which I found to be a good value. 

Proximity to town/hiking. This hotel is in a terrific location at the base of camelback. The views are awesome, and your are also close to town and a mall (if that's important to you). 
My son and I hired a guide to go rock climbing up pinnacle peak. The climb was incredible. The guides name was Dave and his website is myarizonaguide.com. 

We golfed while there and the courses are in very good condition and not incredibly challenging. We played Oasis and Desert. I preferred Desert. There are a couple of par 3s that are amazing. 

Here are the negatives - which were probably just bad timing on our part. 
1. When booking originally which we did through Starwood gold, we were told there were only 4 nights available. This forced us to give up a free night and cut our vacation short. When we arrived, there was availability. We also learned there was availability in the suites which if they had informed me at the time of booking I would have reserved even for one night as a place holder. I consider this a forfeit of several thousand Starwood points caused by their staff. 

2. It was convention central at the time we arrived and for most of the duration of out stay. This meant you couldn't walk through the lobby it was so crowded - I mean "PACKED". They decided to park it in the lobby all day. Everywhere. If your kids were with you and stepped away for a second, it became a challenge to find them. 

Also, most of the lawns were off limits to kids because they had reserved them for what is possibly their largest convention of the year.  This hotel is a big convention hotel but they should either do a better job of letting their non-convention guests knowing of upcoming conventions and what it means for their stay. 
This meant, no places to kick a ball around, play bocce ball or the other lawn games they advertise. 
It also meant there were non-guest workers and delivery crews all over the hotel so leaving the kids to roam was not an option. 
There were many adults on the terrace each evening smoking cigars (something they wouldn't do if they were there with kids). 

3. Management (Chris Jennings) decided, after our group complained, to credit us for my wife's spa treatment and a dinner which I think was insufficient. For instance there was day we were there where it was too cold to go in the pool and there were no grassy areas for the kids to play. I don't think the hotel was worth the price that day.  Again, the odds of this happening to the next person are probably slim to none. 

Overall, I think this place is worth the stay. My ratings for service and value are slightly lower below only because of management's response.

reviews.author: Steve C
reviews.title: The Phoenecian of Phoenix, AZ
reviews.text: We had a slight misstep when arriving as we got into Phoenix from NY quite early. I had asked for an early check in but our room which had been upgraded was not ready yet. We went for lunch, still not ready and ended up sitting around for at least 90 minutes or so..not happy... my wife spoke to a manager conveying our frustration. He got us into our room, discounted our bull by $200, gave us a meal and sent over a cheese and fruit board and a bottle of wine. Once in our room, the trip was magical. the hotel, room, service, pool, restaurants and golf courses were all top notch. very close to the airport but was not thrilled with the airports car rental shuttle system. Overall, it was a fantastic vacation with the hotel being the shining star.

reviews.author: kitkat77774
reviews.title: Not worth the money!
reviews.text: I can't believe this hotel charges $600 for a basic room, and that was discounted with a AAA rate otherwise it would have been around $660! I have stayed at many luxury hotels and cannot see how this hotel can justify this rate.  Nothing is actually wrong with the hotel its just that it is way overpriced for what it is.  When we arrived we were told we had been upgraded. Other than a pool view this was a typical standard room. The pool is just so so....no view, no nothing, and the service was very spotty.  On the first day we arrived there were not three lounge chairs together but there were three single ones by themselves.  We asked the staff if they could put three chairs together...the answer was simply "no". We decided to get lunch instead where we sat in the hot sun for about 20 min before anyone acknowledged us.  However, the second day at the pool the service was excellent...always coming around to see what we needed, refreshing our water pitcher, adjusting umbrella etc. It was the same with breakfast service great one day and waiter non existent the next.  As for the bill....when we checked out there was a miscellaneous room charge of $65.  I asked the girl what that was and she said tax.  Well then why was it clearly labeled tax for the second night $75?  She didn't have an answer other than thats what the computer says. She adjusted the bill.  Second, we were supposed to get a AAA credit of $65 per day/breakfast which had not been applied to our account.  When we asked about that she said "yes, that needs to be applied manually." I said well then why don't you apply that manually?!!! Bottom line always check your bill.  Overall, I wouldn't go back.  It wasn't a bad experience but they just should have been charging $2/300ish a night instead.

reviews.author: Gigi1998
reviews.title: First Class and they let us bring our dog!!
reviews.text: We visited with our 2 children and our small dog and they upgraded us to an incredible 2 bedroom casita. We were floored by the generous upgrade and delightful friendly service. The pool with the twisting waterfall and nearby cabana (for the parents) kept the kids happy all day. I loved the cactus garden with its meandering walkway and spots to stop and enjoy the peace and beauty of the majestic rocks and vivid desert coloring. Dinner was outstanding. The kids splurged and had lobster and the staff made sure that it was treated like a special occasion. They couldn't do enough. The comfort,attention to detail and warm and caring attitude from the staff make this a truly spectacular resort. An elegant 5 star feather in Scottsdales cap!!!!

reviews.author: Tom R
reviews.title: " Great experience and first class"
reviews.text: Stayed from 4/21 to 4/26 and it was wonderful. Upon arrival our room was not ready until 5 pm. The reception staff gave us a $250 credit without me asking! This is what I would expect from a five star property. Better yet the following day a manager called and asked how we were doing and gave another $150 credit. Dining in all restaurants was very good. We try to limit our stays to five star properties and found the Phoenician experience to be as good as any. The pool set-up is very family friendly. We had our two grandkids ages 5&7 with us and they loved the place. Quite honestly, there isn't a reason to leave the grounds. It is a busy place with conventions so if you need extreme solitude go to Sedona or try the Four Seasons. This property is only blocks away from Old Scottsdale and Fashion Square Mall which are two very nice areas. During months where the pools can be enjoyed this is the place. Golf was typical Troon managed facility professional but not intimidating. The staff in all areas were attentive and concerned about your pleasure. We will definitely make The Phoenician our go to resort in the Phoenix area.

reviews.author: doccao
reviews.title: First class resort
reviews.text: An oasis in the dessert, the resort had numerous pools filled with guest parked outside.  Jockeying for a spot at the pool can be hard if you don't get out early.  The restaurants are first class, plus the golf & tennis seem nice if you can bear the hot weather.  Just a few miles down the same street is the high end shopping mall to escape the heat.  We had a great couples weekend retreat at the Phoenician.

reviews.author: AroundTheWorldIn80kDays
reviews.title: This Resort Should be #1
reviews.text: I am perplexed how this resort (at the time of me writing this) is not #1 on Trip Advisor. It's impossible to beat. The service, the food, the accommodations are all world-class. It's no wonder why this is one of Starwood's 15 diamond-class resorts in the US. Perhaps the price causes some reviewers not to rate it 5 stars. Anyway, it's spectacular.

reviews.author: Jennyflower_12
reviews.title: Service, Service, Service
reviews.text: The property is beautiful and bountiful.  So large, didn't even get a chance to enjoy the whole grounds.  The staff is so wonderful, everything was done for us to make our stay a memorable one.  It was the most beauiful and well run up-scale hotel we have ever stayed at.

reviews.author: JaneRph
reviews.title: A beautiful place to stay
reviews.text: We spent 5 nights at this beautiful hotel. The rooms are very spacious, comfortable, and quiet. The property features a large pool, plus several smaller ones. The service around the pool was very attentive, with people coming around offering pitchers of ice water. We were there over Easter weekend and it was packed. It was much nicer on Monday when the crowds were gone. The waiters at all the restaurants on site provided great service and were very polite. The only bummer: there was always a wait for breakfast if you wanted the buffet. One day it was 30 minutes, another day it was 20. There's a quick place to get bagels and fruit, but even that was usually very busy due to all the of conferences held there. Otherwise it was a very nice relaxing vacation with the family!

reviews.author: BKP47
reviews.title: One of the best hotels we have stayed in
reviews.text: We stayed for 2 nights at the end of our holiday. First impressions are excellent as all the staff make a real effort to acknowledge you and smile. Our room was large and very comfortable. We agree with an earlier review about the balcony furniture but it was not a big issue for us. The on site facilities are extensive - lots of pools, tennis, golf and a wonderful cactus garden with pathways. The setting against Camelback Mountain is very impressive. We ate in both a restaurant and the terrace bar. Both meals were very good. They seem to have a lot of return travellers based on some people watching in the lobby whilst waiting to go for our flight. We would love to return.

reviews.author: Lekt33
reviews.title: Simply Wonderful
reviews.text:
Our 5th visit in a row  at the end of Spring and it just keeps getting better each time (even though we find it hard to believe it could get any better.)
The service is always outstanding , the location ideal, the rooms and grounds are great-- it's a get-away that is unbeatable. Only the "spa"  is underwhelming. 

We have stayed at several of the other top flight hotels in Scottsdale and Phoenix ( Princess, Marriott Camelback; Biltmore,,, and this tops them all.  
When you are there, check out the Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts  for their wide range of entertainment offerings.  
Most highly recommended

reviews.author: Avid_Travelerz
reviews.title: Huge resort that is starting to show its age
reviews.text: Stayed here on business and was excited to see the property as I had heard great things about it.  The resort is large and sprawling.  My room was quite spacious with fabulous bedding and a nice view. However, the bathroom was looking its age. The shower lacked decent pressure and the drain wasn't working properly so you ended up standing in water up to your ankles after a short shower.  Rooms all come with a balcony, but the furniture is dirty and worn so sitting on it does not seem appealing.  The grounds are lovely with a huge pool complex that children will love. The elevators are slow and a little clunky. I would stay here using Starwood points but would hesitate paying their normal room rate

reviews.author: parismuse
reviews.title: Fairly generic "luxury hotel" in Scottsdale
reviews.text: I was here for a conference.  The hotel is perfectly "fine," but didn't wow me as a luxury resort should. I have stayed in many lovely hotels all over the world, and this one just seemed like it was following a formula (and one which doesn't distinguish it from any other large resort).  My room was comfortable and quiet - no complaints but again, nothing special.  I was initially booked in a casita, but it was not ready when I arrived so I took a room in the main hotel.  Given how hot it was when I was there, I was glad not to have to traipse from a casita to the conference facilities.  I ate "on campus" for most meals.  The food was decent, but again, nothing to write home about.  All in all, it's fine for what it is, but that's it - just "fine."  Staff was helpful and accomodating, and I appreciated that.

reviews.author: yveten
reviews.title: Fun and relaxing
reviews.text: We stayed in one of the casitas on a girls weekend, and we had a wonderful time. Our second floor casita had a great view of the resort grounds, and the separate parking was a bonus. We enjoyed pool time, especially the poolside food and drinks, the gym, the over-sized bathroom, the comfy beds, and good service. This was my second stay at the Phoenician, and is one of my favorites anywhere.

reviews.author: Laurie M
reviews.title: Large resort with conflicting reviews
reviews.text:
I write this from the Phoenician, because when we were researching places I found so many different reviews ranging wildly, so maybe this will help a prospective traveler.

After reading reviews, many of which described the decor as "dated, tired" I contacted the hotel to request a room that had been renovated, which  as far as I can tell is really only the Canyon Suites; the Phoenician informed me a full property renovation is to start within a year. The problem with that was that there were no Canyon suites available, and also, I was told by the hotel that they started at $1,200 per night, which I can't imagine if someone could spend that on one night, why they wouldn't already have a luxury vacation home to stay in or book the Four Seasons. In any event, first we were booked in what was supposedly one of the "better" rooms" in the main hotel, but  at the same time was told that "the decor was the same as all of the other main hotel rooms." Since our trip to Phoenix turned out to be unexpectedly difficult, I called on route and asked for other options. The front desk manager on duty, Tyler, was extremely helpful, and thought our best option given our request would be for a renovated "casita," although from one review I read on TA which stated the travelers were "horrified" at the condition of the casita they were placed in, I balked. Tyler assured me that some of the casitas had been renovated and that we would be placed in one. True to his word, I found the room to be nicely updated, very clean and extremely comfortable with a nice outdoor patio. The casitas had a very southwestern outward appearance which I thought was fine, and are located close to the pool. Out of curiosity, I tried to look at rooms in the main hotel, the supposed "dated" ones but wasn't able to, at least so far, so can't comment on those. The interior of the large main hotel lobby is a mix of marble and statue luxury hotel interior with somewhat worn out rugs and furniture, I guess updating that will be part of the expected renovation.  I have read and heard that the Canyon suites (newly renovated) are very nice, and I can tell you that as an extremely picky traveler, the particular room (casita) we stayed in was very comfortable and pleasant--again emphasizing that if you choose to stay in a casita, ask for a renovated room if you care about the newness of things. The mattress, bedding and furniture were completely new with a updated southwestern decor. In addition,  I was further assured that if we were unhappy with the room they would work to get us something else. Also greeted with a nice welcome note, fresh fruit, chocolates, water.

The grounds are lovely with myriad swimming pools, pool restaurant and poolside service and southwest landscaping and stunning view of Camelback mountain.

The staff overall was extremely nice and accommodating, willing to help with anything, and very friendly. The one and only exception I thought was the concierge desk, who seemed only to want to  tell us what we couldn't do-- with what I am now starting to believe is the standard concierge line of "..it's our busiest time of the year, all the restaurants are booked except at 5:00 or 9:30, we just booked our last (whatever) a few minutes ago, etc., etc."  When I mentioned that I saw many reservations available on OpenTable but I didn't make one because I didn't  know which to choose (there were so many), I was abruptly informed that well, those restaurants aren't close to the resort or in "Old Town," (although I mentioned no restaurant names) ("Old Town" is the Scottsdale downtown area I think) and was never offered a recommendation of any kind. As soon as we left, I was able to book a table at 7:30 (or 7 or 7:15 for that matter) at one of the Phoenician's recommended restaurants (on the list they hand out) in "Old Town" with high YELP and OT reviews, we will see how it is tonight; so I don't know what that was all about, just felt like the concierge wasn't really interested in helping, only denying. Likewise, when I called the day before to inquire about car rentals, I was told it would be NO problem to get a car one we were at the resort, I therefore cancelled our airport car reservation since I thought it would be more convenient to pick up a car onsite at the hotel since we arrived very late, but was now being told by the same concierge, that they were "out of cars," "there MIGHT be ONE left," she would have to look into it, but then made no effort to do so, and also, why would they tell me the day before it would be no problem if this is the busiest time of the year with nothing available?

Other than that, the staff was stellar and professional, and we are enjoying our stay very much.

reviews.author: Jim682
reviews.title: Disneyland in Arizona??
reviews.text:
It has been three years since our last stay and we were really looking forward to our return stay. We drove into the beautiful (that is an understatement) grounds and had a wonderful flashback to our last stay. As we approached the entrance we wondered what was going on...the valet area looked like L.A. During the rush hour. 
We arrived at 3:45 for the 4:00pm check in and were told our room was not ready. We gave the desk our cell number and wondered about....my wife became frustrated in the next two hours and asked about our room twice...the third time they said yes our room was ready. They NEVER called us to let us know our status.
They did give us two free drink tickets ("for selected beverages".....I.e. Nothing we drink) .BTW we still have them.
Bottom Line.
Wonderful motel.
Great rooms...luv the beds...we are SPG members for many years.
Excellent food ...awesome tequila selection (but very $$$)
Beautiful grounds...we are not gofers but the cactus garden, etc are great!
We learned too late that it was Spring break in Arizona...soooo Mom had the kids at the pool while Dad did the golf / tennis thing...
We are semi-old and fans of the adult only resorts ...so the Disneyland feel at a wonderful resort left us a little cold. This is a strong change from three years ago...the beautiful "hot tub" area is now  a kiddy water park. Great if you are a young family looking for a great get away...but for us we will not return during Spring break!!

P.S. Bring $$...even with "free SPG rooms" this resort cost us $250/day.

reviews.author: Patrycia M
reviews.title: Nice pools but room dated
reviews.text: The pools, gym, and grounds of the hotel are very nice but our room wasn't the best. The carpet looks like it needs to be replaced and the decor is very 90s. The service at the pool was slow.  I don't think they checked in with us as much as they should to see if we wanted to order something.  There seemed to be a lot of activities for kids if you come here with some. Overall I liked the grounds of the hotel but for the price I expected a better room.

reviews.author: Michelle D
reviews.title: Outstanding service!
reviews.text: From the scenic setting at the base of Camelback Mountain, to the perfectly maintained landscaping throughout the property, the views here are beautiful. The cactus garden is amazing. The service is simply outstanding, from the maids and concierge to the bellmen and wait staff. Your needs are met and then some. We ate at most of the restaurants and found the food and service to be very good. Our favorite was lunch at Relish, where we ordered several appetizers to share and enjoyed their large selection of beers from the area.If you want to relax, the pool and spa offer relaxation. If you want to be active, there are so many hikes and outdoor activities in the area. Shopping in Scottsdale is a must! We were on a business/pleasure trip, but know our kids (14 & 19) would have loved this place, too.

reviews.author: BancroftCambridge
reviews.title: Great family break
reviews.text: The Phoenician was a great spot for a post Christmas family break in the sun.  A beautifully situated hotel with attractively landscaped grounds.  There was plenty for all of us to do, including golf and tennis, walking and swimming.  Food was good and it was nice to have the coffee shop within the resort.  Breakfast was great and the complimentary takeaway coffee service appreciated.  Another plus is the shuttle bus to the excellent shopping at Scottsdale.  I recommend the Phoenician for families.

reviews.author: CardinalRK
reviews.title: Great hotel in need of a few updates/improvements
reviews.text:
A beautiful location at the base of camelback mountain w multiple golf courses, tennis courts, restaurants, spa, multiple pools and a kids club. 

The hotel is really beautiful and the location cannot be beat. 

The service is generally excellent and they have added some new features. My kids loved the birds of prey exhibit and the funician kids club.  Surge, however, did not live up to its billing as the kids thought it was for toddlers only and no one seamed to use it.  

The hotel has a few things it needs to work on.  The hot tub was not really working during our stay which was a major bummer.  In addition some of the rooms were a bit dated and some downright bad (the bathtub had been a different finish and they had painted over it but the paint was peeking off making the bath tub unusable). Lastly, the breakfast seating was just odd.  They would make people wait or allow them to sit in the bar while they had multiple empty tables that were set.  

All if these minor things preclude me from giving it a 5 star even though I love the hotel.

reviews.author: applegirl78
reviews.title: Very nice property!! Totally Kid friendly!
reviews.text:
We just got back from our amazing stay in Scottsdale, AZ. We traveled with a 10 month old. Overall we had wonderful time, and would probably come back. I would say our least favorite part of the hotel was the front desk. They were no helpful at all and were not friendly at all. Upon checkin I asked if there was any avail to upgrade. As I said we have a baby and was hoping to put him somewhere else other than the bathroom. Nothing was available but to get her to ck was like pulling teeth. This happend on multiple attempts to the front desk. Everytime I asked a question they seemed bothered and irritated to answer. I'm not sure u should have this type of attitude and unhelpfulness when you work at the front desk of a 5 star hotel.
Moving on.. the rooms were spacious as well as the bathrooms. A little outdated but clean and nice. 
The pools--super crowded and the staff does little to regulate all the reserved chairs. I still enjoyed the pools as well as the service was wonderful. I would recommend getting up upwards of 6a to reserve a chair. 
The grounds--gorgeous.. need I say more. Landscape is breathtaking as well as the view.
Food--we only had breakfast once here. The buffet was great. It was quite yummy and it was nice to sit on the porch near the pool. However, they need more than one person cooking omelets. The line was about 10 folks deep each time so I never got an omelet.
Overall I would say this place is really nice minus the front desk. We loved sitting out on the porch by the firepit at night. It was really relaxing and gorgeous. The self park was super easy, This was possibly the easiest hotel self park I've ever experienced. Don't bother with valet. The location is fab. It's super safe and in a great area and super close to the airport. 
ps.. we also were charged with valet although never used valet so ck your bill upon ck out.

reviews.author: sjw125
reviews.title: I can see why this hotel receives such high ratings.
reviews.text:
We've stayed at so many hotels, we are probably in the top 10% of frequent travelers, but this was one of the best. It was full, which means crowded. But the staff were excellent. I've never been at pool-oriented resort where they bring you a pitcher of ice water. As if that wasn't enough, when they see your ice has melted, they bring you a fresh one. That's just the right anecdote to understand that this is a special hotel. 

The night we arrived, the wine shop in the corridor of stores had closed. A staff member saw us looking inside, opened up the shop, and not only let us buy a bottle of wine, he let us taste the wine first. I could tell 5 more stories like this.

Our room had a balcony so close to Camelback Mountain that I could throw a rock and hit it. One could sit on the balcony and marvel at the Saguaro cacti in the setting sun. Who wants to watch TV in a place like this? 

We've stayed at probably 6 or 8 hotels in Scottsdale in our lives, and I would never stay anywhere else if I bring my wife on another business trip here.

reviews.author: Sharon M
reviews.title: Spring Beauty
reviews.text:
There is no place better than the Phoenician to enjoy the beauty of spring in Phoenix! This classic property is manicured to perfection, the varied colors of the flowers, the trees ... its breathtaking. 

The property is spacious. The resort may be a bustle of activity, but you can still find a quiet place amongst the cactus garden, by numerous waterfalls, by the lake, just wandering on the many paths throughout the property, where you'll be joined by the many bunnies that call these beautiful grounds home, the ducks, the geese and the fish.

Of course, if one visits The Phoenician, you must pamper yourself at the Wellness Center. The menu of services provided is so enticing, its hard to decide, but that's where the very helpful staff comes in. Any spa that can keep the same service providers for as many years as they have, has got to be doing the right things for the clientele! Ask anyone of them how long they've been at the Wellness Center, some can boast 25 years. I find that amazing!

And, not to be forgotten is the location of the hotel, nestled at the bottom of Camelback mountain in the heart of the city, close to fabulous shopping, restaurants, the airport, sightseeing.

I consider it a little slice of heaven! I'm sure you will too.

reviews.author: Jeffrey S
reviews.title: Stunning Paradise with a couple small quirks
reviews.text:
Listen this place is the real deal and truly exceptional - beautiful grounds, stunning pools, very good overall service, comfortable rooms and best of all is the weather - I really wanted to give this hotel 5 stars as it's worthy of the designation but there were enough small things that I wanted to take the time to share for cure visitors 

The Good 
- pools are just fabulous 
- my wife and I have 4 kid and love kids and this is a great place with kids or without...some adult only areas and great kids areas too with basketball net in pool and tons of fun 
- plenty of chairs 
- awesome tennis program and head pro Jason was likely the best teacher we have ever had - can't say enough good things about this guy 
- I could go on and on but really this place has it all

What could be improved upon 
- let me start by saying there is not much but a few things that were just plain frustrating; 
- rooms are getting tired but are still very nice but if you are expecting 5 star rooms this is not your place but rooms are beautiful circa 1995 Reno but kept up very well 
- pool gets busy and I feel bad for hotel because when hotel is at 98 percent capacity which it was when we were there they need to add a dozen more staff around the pool....staff are tremendous but clearly not enough of them to go around 
- breakfast is so funny and frustrating...again u can't help but feel bad for hostesses because every person complains...there are dozens of empty tables and 20-35 min waits for outside...similar to pool situations for staff serving lunch and getting drinks there is simply not enough staff to keep up with demand...it's a simple operational issue for hotel where if they came and watched the few bottlenecks it could be easily addressed as it's solely human backlog 

A few interesting facts that I could not find in advance that I think folks will be interested in 
- price for cabana rental by the pool ($300 during the week and $350 on weekend per day 
-  I could not make a reservation at a popular restaurant myself but Beverly the concierge worked magic for us and made a reso at a place that does even take reservations which is very cool 
- I found out last day I waited for no reason for breakfast every morning when u could make a reservation so don't do what everyone else did and gets upset waiting for 20-25 min when u simply can make a reso for breakfast...I didn't know but now you do 
- they sell bottles of water at store and in rooms but there is free bottles at tennis courts and workout room so really no need to waste your money there 
- we stayed in a casita room overlooking the pool in building F on 2nd floor and it's wonderful to hear the fountains and it's central to everything 
- you can order lunch by the pool from any of the on site restaurants which is not obvious as they only brig a menu from the pool side bar and grill and I totally recommend Relish Burger Bistro - wonderful option - just leave an hour from time u order to delivery 

To conclude 
- would we stay again...absolutely without a doubt 
- management needs to watch the couple frustrating bottlenecks I described above as they are easily fixable 
- rooms are getting a little tired but way better than others ha said online it's truly not a problem to me but does need a refresh soon 
- love the tennis, thirsty camel lounge, grounds, pools, ice cream shop and much more 
- excellent service overall 

If you pick The Phoenician you won't be disappointed but hopefully this review helps and ads some additional feedback not found in others

reviews.author: FinCon58
reviews.title: Wonderful service from Bryon!
reviews.text: My wife and I can't say more about how thrilled we were with the service Bryon provided us during our stay at The Phoenician.  No matter the time of day, he always greeted us with a smile and an eagerness to do whatever he could to please us.  Kudos, Bryon!

reviews.author: FRW99
reviews.title: Beautiful Camelback Setting
reviews.text: This is a very nice resort set at the base of Camelback mountain.  We had a wonderful view of the mountain from our balcony.  The rooms are spacious and beautiful.  Service was generally good.  The concierge was very knowledgeable and very helpful.  Our maid was cranky to the point of being rude...surprising for this class of resort.  Also surprising was a $14 charge for bell service...never seen any other hotel charge for that.  Funny sulphur smell out by pool.

reviews.author: Kjell
reviews.title: Holy Cow, This Place Desperately Needs a Facelift
reviews.text:
I checked into the Phoenician Friday close to midnight after a long day of meetings in Tempe.  My wife was flying in the next morning for a night of relaxation away from the kids.  I reserved The Phoenician via American Express Fine Hotels and Resorts, which is what I normally do when I visit someplace new.  And, American Express has never let me down. Until now. 

I checked into one of their "Casitas."  The bellman drove me on a golf cart down through a parking lot to buildings that looked like an old apartment complex or motel.  When I entered my room I was horrified.  The room was dated, tired, and far from what I would consider a "fine hotel or resort."   I headed straight for the front desk to check out.  Now, the girls at the front desk were great.  They offered to change my room.  I declined. I just wanted out.  However, I relented when I couldn’t get into another hotel so late at night in the area.  The girls at the front desk moved me to the Canyon next door, a far better experience overall.  I stayed one night and then moved to the Four Seasons (an awesome property - review to follow).  

So, in the end, I give them credit for properly training their front desk on how to handle a dissatisfied customer.  But I strongly discourage anyone from staying at this hotel unless you don’t mind an outdated, tired room.

reviews.author: Mark D
reviews.title: Outstanding Resort!
reviews.text: Cannot say enough about this magnificent resort.  Here for a work retreat and we were treated like royalty.  Rooms were comfortable, grounds and pool area are gorgeous, but the most outstanding thing about this resort is the service...simply amazing!  Do not miss the prickly pear margaritas, which are deliciously refreshing!  Will be back!  Great for business retreats or family vacations.  Most wonderful location at the foot of Camelback Mountain.

reviews.author: ShahramG
reviews.title: Nice landmarks, old amenities
reviews.text: This a a very good hotel in a great and central area.  The room ammenities were dated. The service was very good.  The restaurant was ok at best.  Don't get talked into the breakfast buffet (an excuse for no service and mediocre food).  Their a la carte menu is great.

reviews.author: kavnsandiego
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: This was a family trip and we had a great time. The service overall was really good, but one person really stood out.  Shant made our entire family feel welcome.  My son really liked the kid's club and hubby liked the golf.  We had the cheapest room that was farthest from the pool, but we still had a nice view and would return again for the great service.

reviews.author: SJD2000
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Gorgeous resort set against Camelback Mountain. Rooms were large and the beds were very comfortable. We were probably at the farthest point from the pool/lobby but we had a wonderful view of the hills and golf course. The staff was very polite and quick to help, our drinks by the pool never got empty, and the food was tasty. They are not giving it away though as our breakfast in bed ran almost $70 for the two of us.

reviews.author: Anthony Z
reviews.title: Very nice hotel excellent staff
reviews.text: Very nice hotel - its a large property and very busy so perfection is hard to achieve with so many guests coming and going - overall a very nice resort experience. Rooms are a little dated but roomy and nice. Bed is comfortable. Meal service a little slow but food was very good and atmosphere relaxing. Brunch was great especially with outside seating. Lots of resort type activities. Spa experience was nice. Overall what made my experience excellent was the hotel staff - everyone I encountered was genuinely friendly and helpful 5 stars to the staff- fantastic job!

reviews.author: MDFreqTvlr
reviews.title: Great service and amenities, but a little tired
reviews.text:
This is an update from my earlier review in January. Let me put right up front that the hotel staff and the amenities are second to none. Every effort is made to make your stay comfortable and memorable.

The one concern I have is that the sleeping rooms, a few of the common areas and some of the meeting space is looking a little tired and worn around the edges. Nothing dramatic, but not up to the traditional high standards of the Phoenician. For instance, the shower and the sink faucet never fully shut off and one of the dresser drawer handles was missing.

In my conversation with the front desk, however, I understand a major renovation is planned over the summer months (off-peak for AZ).  If you are staying during those times and taking advantage of the typically very low rates you should be aware of the renovation plans.

reviews.author: Lesley K
reviews.title: Overall, a wonderful vacation with just a few suggestions!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is at the foot of Camelback Mountain and yet the hotel does nothing to easily get their guests to the opening of La Cholla trail for a beautiful hike. They provide a shuttle to the East gate which is nothing. It is still a long walk to the trail.  No one likes to have to walk before getting to the actual trail.  Even if they got guests to the street the trail is on would be better.  Between 7 and 9 AM, they should simply have a shuttle from  Relish or tennis that makes round trip stops to and from the trail.                                           
The new SURGE signs by the pool are tacky and horrible eyesores!  The Phoenician is a gorgeous resort which blends in beautifully with its surroundings.  And then out of nowhere, worse than a Beaches resort or Disneyland, is this horrible brightly colored plastic looking Surge sign.  It takes away from the upscale feeling of the rest of the resort.                                           We rented a cabana at the lower pool every day (Rich, our cabana server) was SO attentive and completely enhanced our experience.  He anticipated our every need.  HE made our trip!                                                        However, the bathrooms at that lower pool need to be cleaned more frequently.  They were really unsanitary.
They have really improved tennis at the Phoenician.  Jason is amazing! And they fixed the pro shop so now we have access to drinking water and bathrooms when the shop is closed. How about moving the ice machine too?

reviews.author: AJGK
reviews.title: Very Dirty Room
reviews.text:
We had booked a Phoenician Suite. A week before our arrival the hotel called to tell us the room was not available and moved us to a casita suite. This was a downgrade. The room was filthy beyond belief. The couch was covered in many different substances. There was toothpaste sprayed all over the walls of the bathroom. There were stains on every surface of the room. The chairs outside were covered in bird droppings. We could not sit on them it was so bad. They re-cleaned the entire room and it wasn't much better. I have pictures. The manager Mark Bauman made useless gestures after we checked out. 

Our room was not ready until 4pm. We went to have lunch at Il Terrazzo. The waitress was overloaded and complaining about it. Lunch would have taken 2 hours with her.  We left the hotel to go have lunch. 

The Phoenician used to be a fabulous hotel. I have been talking to many people and they all have the same comments. The hotel is run very poorly and it shows. I cannot recommend any out of town guests to stay here. The Fairmont or the Four Seasons is a much better choice.

reviews.author: debbie C
reviews.title: Great hotel and service
reviews.text: The Phoenician hotel is gorgeous. The hotel is very well maintained and the staff is great. It is a wonderful place to stay. Our room was a little dated looking but you couldn't beat the comfort of the mattress , pillows and bed linen. We loved it and would go back again and recommend it highly.

reviews.author: Jon G
reviews.title: 5 diamond?
reviews.text:
this is my first review ever...and was compelled to do so

showed up on a saturday evening.  overbooked and gave my room away.  after an hr they found me a room after a guest checked out.  the rooms are old.  Mine was dirty.  i also had gnats in my room. I usually stay at higher end hotels and this doesn't even compare to a 4 seasons or Ritz.  In my opinion, the Boulders, Westin in Kierland or the Fairmont Princess kicks butt compared to this joint...for $560/nt get real guys.  if its about location, i would seriously consider a super 8 compared to the Phoenician.

reviews.author: Gzowski
reviews.title: A First-class resort
reviews.text:
We spent two nights at The Phoenician and thoroughly enjoyed it.  The room we had was lovely, the food was excellent, and the resort grounds were beautifully kept.  We arrived in time for a Sunday brunch that was excellent--lots of choice, attentive service, and accompanied by top-notch margaritas.  Dinner that night at the J&G Steakhouse was a highlight of our 7-day Arizona trip.  My steak was perfectly done and the mashed potatoes were the best I've had anywhere.  (I realize that mashed potatoes are not normally sufficient to make anyone stand up and shout, but these were really that good.)

We were fortunate that our casita was directly across the street from the golf course, which we played on our second day.  When I say across the street, I mean a 30-second walk from our room to the pro shop.  We hadn't planned that, but it certainly worked out to our advantage.  The course (27 holes: we played the Desert/Canyon 18) is very well maintained with enough challenge for good golfers and enough forgiveness for high-handicappers like us to enjoy it.  The scenery is wonderful.  

Il Terrazzo, where we had dinner on our second night, was almost as good as the steakhouse but didn't seem to be nearly as popular.  For some reason, most diners preferred to be outside, but that option didn't really attract us.  Breakfast was in the same place with most choosing to eat on the patio.  Unfortunately, the patio also attracts some extremely noisy and aggressive blackbirds, which hang around looking for unguarded treats.  The defence against them is a trained falcon, whose handler we chatted with on the morning we left Scottsdale.  Apparently, the falcon doesn't have to fly to keep the blackbirds away.  His mere presence is enough to send them packing.  

The only negative I could add about The Phoenician is that two different sets of elevators take you to different parts of the main building and it's difficult to keep straight which elevator you need.  Coming from our casita, we had to walk around and eventually through the entire pool area to get to the dining room.  Taking the wrong direction can have you trying to enter the restaurant by the backdoor, as it were, and having to retrace your steps to another entrance.  Of course, you can always call for a pickup and have someone drive you in a golf cart to the correct entrance, but we preferred to walk and sometimes get lost.

We tried the spa also, which was very good (not cheap though) and the service was very friendly and efficient.

We would definitely go back to The Phoenician.  It's a lovely place in a great location.  Families of all ages seemed to be having a good time.

reviews.author: Linsey R
reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.text: This was a very nice resort. I guess our room was a little outdated but other than that it was spectacular!! The views of camelback were amazing and the pool's were great!! One tip: Get to the pool early to claim pool chairs!! I would recommend this resort to families & couples!!

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.title: Amazing weekend experience
reviews.text:
This review is long overdue. We stayed here on 11/18/13 for the weekend, and had an amazing time. We were upgraded to a casita and it exceeded our expectations. The staff also knew it was a special weekend and a surprise was sent to our room while we were out. Caitlin, one of the staff members, helped plan our weekend and was able to make it special.

The room was expansive - I wouldn't even consider it a room, as we had a dining room, living room w/fireplace, huge master suite, 2 full bathrooms with tubs and showers, multiple closets, 2 patios and sliding doors. It was furnished exquisitely. The bed was super comfortable.

The property itself was gorgeous. I wish I could stayed longer and enjoyed more of what they had to offer. The pool was great, though I wanted to use the Spa and didn't have time. I definitely will be back!!

reviews.author: TimothyElliott
reviews.title: Fantastic resort experience.  Great service.  Great SPG Platinum benefits.
reviews.text: I could not have more good thing to say about this resort.  I was in town on business, but I was able to enjoy all of the facets of the resort.  The very European service emanates in every area.  The restaurants were all fantastic and the spa is exquisite.   The rooms are beautifully decorated and the staff is unbelievably friendly everywhere.  From the folks in the coffee shop who called me by name, to the bar service on the awesome patio - the team is impeccably trained and courteous.  As an SPG Platinum, I travel frequently.  This resort was very Platinum friendly and my experience there will not soon be forgotten

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: Wonderful Relaxing Oasis
reviews.text: Spent 5 nights at the Phoenician and loved every minute.  Kind of pricey, but really a great oasis in the desert.  The pool complex is wonderful and a perfect spot to enjoy the sun and Scottsdale weather.  Outstanding golf course.  Conveniently located to Old Town Scottsdale and other shopping and galleries, yet far enough away so you are removed from the noise and can really relax.  We hiked up the Cholla Trail to the top of Camelback and would highly recommend it, but be warned it is pretty long and difficult.  Overall a great hotel and location.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.text: Stunningly beautiful location and the resort facilities are first class.  The rooms are showing their age a little however they are large and well appointed and lets be honest why would you want to stay in your room with the amazing outdoors so close.  Also easy walking distance into Scottsdale so a fantastic location

reviews.author: Jamie P
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Stayed at the resort February 28, 2014 for 3 nights. Girl spa weekend. The resort was very nice and the spa was excellent. Book your spa treatments before you go to get the times you wish.  The pool areas were very pretty and you were waited on the minute you sat down. The staff was very cordial and helpful.  The only downside was the hotel seemed to charge for everything, including wireless internet.  We would stay there again for the spa.

reviews.author: Maria do Carmo Véras
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel with excelent value for its quality
reviews.text:
Situated in an enormous area, with a golf club, several swimming pools and magnificently maintained gardens.
The hotel have nice rooms, clean and very spacious.
Staff is very polite and helpful.
Restaurant is very good and service excellent.

reviews.author: frank3355
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text:
This is definitely one of the nicest hotels we've stayed at.  I used an SPG upgrade and we stayed in an awesome casita suite overlooking the pool area.  It had a bedroom, a living room, a large dining table, 2 full bathrooms, and a private patio.  Everything in the room was top quality and new looking.  It was an absolutely perfect room.
