The drive to the entrance and the lobby area is what one would expect from this Luxury Collection Resort. The bell staff were very friendly and efficient helping remove our luggage from the car and loading them on to a cart ready to deliver to our room. The front desk clerk, Jessica, was very friendly, professional and fast getting us into our room. Unfortunately this is were the other cheek is turned. The rooms are outdated with dirty carpets and furniture. Two double beds in a room that could have easily accommodated queens, a very narrow entrance that was impossible to walk through especially with the double bathroom doors open. The bathroom was nice, spacious and had good bath products. The grounds of the resort are beautiful and for the most part well maintained, however, the pool areas need updating. The golf course is nice, some great vistas from the Desert 9 of the entire Valley area. The only complaint is that the course routing is very bizarre and sometimes difficult to navigate. We had a light meal at Il Terrazzo bar which was nice and quaint with a beautiful outdoor seating area. Room service was fast and friendly even bringing us a microwave so we could pop popcorn for the kids while they watched a movie. It was our first time at The Phoenician but probably won't return. I believe there are better choices for value, location and overall better facilities nearby.

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.title: A spectacular experience
reviews.text: I have stayed in the Phoenician many times. My friends stay there as well. If there is a more beautiful hotel and experience, I would like to see it. The hotel is amazing. The location is perfect for Scottsdale and Phoenix. It is the best

reviews.author: Sunshine51_12
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text:
My partner and I have just returned from spending our holiday at the Phoenician Hotel.   In our opinion the staff were helpful and pleasant and overall the service was excellent.

The room we had was spacious and well maintained and had a wonderful view of the pools and the mountains in the distance.   The bed was very comfortable with lovely bed linen.

We hired a cabana at the mother of pearl/mosaic pool.   We felt this was well worth the money.   The food and drinks were excellent throughout our stay.   

We would not hesitate to return to this property for another visit.  The setting is lovely and the cactus garden is well worth a visit or two.

reviews.author: Fares B
reviews.title:
Sleeping with 
Cockroach
reviews.text: Magnificent setting from the outside terrible from the inside arrived evening got the room the carpet has spots then ready to sleep to find all type of insects in the room and on the bed then a big Cockroach in the bathroom next day left 7 am to get back at 5:30 pm to find the room hasn't been serviced I stay 50 days a year in hotels since 20 years this the first time ever occurred to me complaint manager got sorry offers me a free dinner I declined checked out next day I'll never come back

reviews.author: Harris H
reviews.title: Great hotel experience
reviews.text:
As close to perfection as you can find.
Excellent service, staff & rooms.
We did not use most facilities (we were there for a funeral) but everything we did use was excellent. A special touch is the flower on the room service tray.

reviews.author: Elizabeth W
reviews.title: Customer service as breathtaking as the property.
reviews.text:
I came to the Phoenician to recover from a tummy tuck, almost all by myself.   Before I I chose the hotel, I visited the property and a couple of rooms,  So I knew to expect the attractive and comfortable rooms,  the gracious  public spaces, but  I had no idea what was in store during my recovery and why I am now number one fan of The Phoenician Hotel.  You see,  what really made the difference for me (and my ten day stay) was the consistent knock-your-socks-off customer service.  I was shown warmth and thoughtfulness in many small but professional gestures which raised the bar for customer service for me.  I did not know, in today's culture such professionalism and level of service could be so consistently delivered.   

Let me give you a couple of examples ( I hope I don't get anyone in trouble here)...a couple of days after the surgery I got the idea afternoon tea service would be a lovely addition to my painful recovery.  I called room service and was told that unfortunately the tea service was over, but they could make me a tuna sandwich and send up a pot of tea.   I understood, though disappointed.   Fifteen minutes later, with a knock at the door,  a pot of tea and a plateful of all sorts of dainty tea sandwiches obviously from the afternoon tea service arrived.   As I looked at the waiter in disbelief ,  he explained he went directly to the tea room.   Well you'd think that would be enough, but I said "well, if you happen to pass any of the pastries or chocolate covered strawberries bring 'em my way" with a wink and a smile, not really expecting anything.   None arrived,  However, the next afternoon when I returned to my room, waiting for me was a plate of the most delicious petit fours, chocolate strawberries, etc,  Call me crazy, but it brought tears to my eyes.   It was so thoughtful and generous.  

Here's another example,  a bellman noticed I was low on the water I had brought with me.  That afternoon, in my room was who knows how many bottles of Phoenician water.  I don't even know who did it.  Just someone who cared.   I came across the same generous, thoughtful customer service again, again and again, be it the therapist in the spa,  the manicurist ( who does unbelievable eyebrows by the way) or the gentleman who drive the golf carts for guests.  As a person who has always appreciated luxurious hotels, my stay here will be a tough act to follow.    I love you Phoenician, thanks for making my recovery an experience filled with gratitude.  I couldn't have picked a better place!!!!!

reviews.author: Darlene P
reviews.title: Fabulous resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text: I stayed here earlier this year during Spring Training (2013).  The service was everything I had expected from room service, to housekeeping, and the front desk.  Everyone was very helpful and courteous.  I wish I had time to enjoy the pool, but our visit was so short, I didn't get to enjoy all the amenities the resort had to offer.  During Spring Training, shuttle service was available to get to the ball parks, which was another plus!  Loved the ice cream parlor/cafe onsite....I will definitely stay here again next year for Spring Training!

reviews.author: Stephanie W
reviews.title: The Phoenician is an outstanding experience on every level!
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Phoenician for a business meeting and had an outstanding experience.  Most notable was the level of service. I felt cared for and valued on every level. Additionally I am a vegetarian and the food selection was healthy and delicious. I highly recommend the Phoenician for business or pleasure.

reviews.author: MugRug
reviews.title: A few bumps, but ok overall...
reviews.text:
Stayed Aug 8-12/13. Very nice hotel. The room we checked into had a shower that would not shut off, so we were moved to another room. The rooms were a very nice size, very roomy. I did have a couple of concerns, that I am not sure were addressed properly. After breakfast one morning, I went back to our room to change for the pool, and discovered that the room was being serviced, as the cleaning cart was outside our door and the door was open via the bolt stopper holding the door open. So I went and looked around at the hotel shops for awhile. Went back to the room after about 20 minutes, and the cleaning cart was still outside our door, so I went and did more exploring. Checked back and the cart was still there, so I went to the pool and told my husband that the room was still being cleaned. Went back up, this is probably at least an hour after breakfast, and the cart was still there and the door still being held open with the bolt lock. I decided to knock on the door and go in to change. There was no answer....I went in, and there was no maid cleaning,but our door was left open for anyone to come in! I was furious! I changed, closed the door,  and went down to the front desk to let them know what happened, and how our room was left totally unlocked by the maid.The girl at the desk seemed a little concerned and said she would have the cleaning supervisor check into  it.. I was never was told why our room was left unlocked or what had happened to our maid.. 
Another incident: we had cashed about 3 travelers cheques at the front desk over a couple of days, and when I tried to cash another one, I was told that they do not cash travelers cheques ...??? I told her we had already cashed 3, and she seemed so confused. Really? Not impressed.I had complained about the desk clerk to the evening staff, and all they did was apologize. Nothing was done as the next day we again tried to cash a cheque and the same girl again would not cash it....
It is a beautiful hotel, and we will probably stay again, but I certainly was not impressed by the desk clerk that I dealt with on both of my compliant occasions.
No reasons or explanations  for the problems I encountered......
That being said, Steve at the pool bar was the best guy ever. Very friendly and accommodating. Will enjoy seeing him again should we decide to stay again.

reviews.author: Adam F
reviews.title: Wonderful Service!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician's grounds and service are what make it stand apart.  The landscaping is unbelievably beautiful.  Everything is perfectly manicured and a joy to behold.  Each and every employee treated me like a king, going out of their way to ensure I was happy and that all my needs were taken care of.  A prime example is the pool.  I was reading my book on a lounge chair on a typical hot Phoenix afternoon, and an employee brought me a pitcher full of ice water without me asking for it.  This pitcher was refilled numerous times throughout the afternoon, again without my asking.  I've never experienced such care at a hotel before!  Whomever is in charge of training the staff; kudos!

The only issue I have with the property is that the casita rooms are a bit tired.  While the bed and TV were fantastic, the chairs in the room were less so.  The cushion on the lounge chair on the patio had a rip in it, and the wall paper in the room was bubbling toward the bottom near the floor.  Once Starwood updates the rooms, it will deserve a 5 start rating.  Till then, I give the Phoenician 4.75 stars.

reviews.author: cassandra s
reviews.title: Didn't want to go home!
reviews.text: From the minute you enter the property, you are treated wonderfully. Check in was smooth and our room was beautiful. We had a view of the pool on the fourth floor. In mod August the temp is around 105-111. So be prepared for the weather. But even with that, we were outside all the time. Parking is located under ground. Awesome. The 7 pools are great!! Keep and eye out for the rabbits that roam the property. Can't wait to go back again. Will always stay at the Diamond in the Desert!!

reviews.author: Lisa J
reviews.title: The Phoenician Resort is where to be
reviews.text: I saw The Phoenician Resort on an Instagram post from Arizona Foothills Magazine. I knew I was going to Scottsdale in a month so I looked into it. And it was the best thing I ever did. WOW what a resort! I am not impressed easy so believe me when I say BRAVO! The room was beautiful. I have stayed at a lot of hotels and resorts, and have never been to impressed by a bed. But the second I walked in my house I went on a wild hunt for bedding online. The comforter, sheets, and OMG the pillows blew my mind. The cactus walk was gorgeous, but even better at night. The pool areas...amazing. But I will go out of my way to name Jeff Bowden and Patrick (Bartender). We walked in late at night from an exhausting day site seeing and neighborhood seeking. We are thinking of moving there soon, and they could not have been more helpful! They told us of areas to look into and the next day we did. We really enjoyed our time at The Phoenician and are looking forward to staying there again very soon!

reviews.author: DanyL32
reviews.title: Ne vaut pas le coût !
reviews.text: Cet hôtel a une bonne réputation, mais la qualité des chambres laisse vraiment à désirer. C'est plutôt vieux et pas très bien entretenu.  Cependant, le golf est superbe.  Il y a tellement de meilleur choix dans le coin !  Bien sans plus !

reviews.author: Sheryl M
reviews.title: A Wonderful Resort!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a wonderful resort! The rooms, staff and amenities are all terrific. Il Terrazzo is a great place for breakfast.  The food is scrumptious and the staff is very friendly and accommodating.  The Mother of Pearl pool was my favorite pool.  The slide is fun too! I highly recommend this resort if you are traveling to the Scottsdale area.

reviews.author: cisparkle
reviews.title: Not what I expected !
reviews.text:
We stayed a couple of years ago at the Four seasons Troon valley but at the time we had been tempted to stay here I was lucky we stayed at the Four Seasons. The hotel was large and nothing special the rooms average compared to the Four Seasons which had fire places inside and wonderful views over Pinnacle peak . The pools were fine but nothing to special we sat at the bottom pool and the pool service was over all good. The early morning hikes up Camel Back were great one of the things we really enjoy about Arizona but not the prettiness of Pinnacle Peak. This hotel is right in the centre so very easy to go shopping and dinning out but not a feeling of getting away from it all so I guess it depends what sort of trip you are looking for as Four seasons was quite a way out but we preferred that experience. 
The outside fire pits and bar were lovely also there restaurant was really great ,so over all ok but would not go again.

reviews.author: RogerB3770
reviews.title: Definitely Five Star
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel is five star.  The rooms, pool areas, and restaurants are all superb.  Staff members are friendly and helpful.  I had especially good service from a bartender named Jared who works the pool bar and pool bar service areas.  The grounds are beautiful and well maintained.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Colonel8
reviews.title: A little bit of paradise in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We have stayed at The Phoenician several times, visiting from the UK. We have rung the changes on hotels, having tried the Scottsdale Fairmont Princess (nearly as good as The Phoenician), The Hyatt Regency at Gainey Ranch (expensive), the Gainey Suites (good value) and The Cottonwoods (again, good value).
We last visited The Phoenician at the end of May this year - despite there being several large conferences, we were given a room upgrade and a complimentary bottle of Champagne and some chocolates. The Hotel is excellent in all respects - staff (at all levels), accommodation, facilities, food, etc. We can't wait for our next stay!

reviews.author: heavythrottle
reviews.title: The best place to relax!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is where I go to get away for a few days and completely relax.  Once I arrive, I do not have to leave.  The resort has everything!  I can choose to lay out at several different pools, but whichever one I choose, the pool service is impeccable.  The towels are waiting on the lounges, the servers immediately bring you an ice cold pitcher of water and then they are ready to take your drink and food order.  If you prefer to eat at a restaurant, there are several to choose from. From a steak house with a view of the city, to an outdoor patio, pool side restaurant, or a burger and sandwich restaurant on the golf course, there will be something to accommodate you.  After that you can choose to work-out or get a massage or play a round of golf or tennis; the Phoenician has plenty of things to do.  At the activity center, you can also play Ping-Pong, a game of pool, or video games.  In the evening, the turn down service includes chocolate on your pillows and the music in your room will be set to lull you to sleep after your perfect day. All of this awaits you on the 300 + acre property that is the Phoenician Resort.  I have been coming to the resort for years, and will continue to return for years to come.

reviews.author: MagditaB
reviews.title: Lindo lugar y muy buen servicio
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene muchos lugares lindos, actividades varias, piscina, restaurantes, paseos, golf.
Todo el personal ofrece un muy buen servicio.
La piscina tiene un tobogan y un bar.
Hay un restaurant Grill en la terraza con linda vista y exquisita comida. También un café con helados y dulces, un restaurant de hamburguesas y otro general.

reviews.author: travelingannie2013
reviews.title: OMG Died and Gone to Heaven
reviews.text: Spectacular place. Service is superb. The lotion they put in the rooms is so divine. I tried buying some when we got home but they don't sell it. So, (I'm not greedy when it comes to hotel freebies but, get as many as you can). The entrances are gorgeous. The rooms, bathroom, beds are exquisite. The pool are amazing, they are always refreshing and we were there when it was 112 degrees, lots of shade available. Super comfy lounge chairs with cushions. Great poolside service and food. The phoenician ice tea is to die for. Very close to fashion square mall.  The best mall ever!!!!  The food in all the restuarants was beyond camparison. Every afternoon they had something fun going on in the pool or were serving ice cream cones. I want to go back!!!!!

reviews.author: mettebk
reviews.title: Wonderful visit at the Phoenician !
reviews.text: Our family stayed at the Phoenician 22-24th of July ,2013 and had a wonderful visit. The hotel switched rooms for us on request when we arrived and we stayed at the casitas close to the pool with a wonderful view and nice comfortable beds. Wonderful surroundings, accommodating and professional staff both at the pools, restaurant, front desk, valet and bar. We thoroughly enjoyed all the fabulous pools. They are being renovated in the fall so expect them to be even more spectacular shortly. . I also enjoyed both a meditation class and a zumba class against a very small fee in the spa. Fabulous stay. We will be back

reviews.author: FoodSnob4EVER
reviews.title: It doesn't get any better thank this place - HEAVEN in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Folks - in the summer they run specials - and wow! what a place 
the Property is 6 STAR if you can give it more than 5
What place, what room, what service - the Very Best Scottsdale and the world has to offer

reviews.author: Delmara714
reviews.title: amazing hotel experience
reviews.text: My husband and I live in phoenix and celebrated our anniversary with a stay-cation at the Phoenician. The rooms were luxurious and very comfortable. We had a lovely evening in the Thirsty Camel lounge! The manager Matt made sure we were well honored for our anniversary and everyone was very friendly. I had the most amazing Pomegranate acai martini while we were well entertained by fantastic musicians, a great pianist in the early evening and a guitarist later who sounded a lot like Dave Matthews.  The house keeping staff made sure we were well taken care of, they even came in while we were out for the evening and and turned down our beds and put our slippers at the base of the bed. The best thing to do on a Phoenix summer day is hang by the pool, we enjoyed excellent cabana service and had lots of fun in the pools and on the slide. I would recommend a stay at the Phoenician to anyone visiting Phoenix.

reviews.author: Santan2020
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text:
I and my wife stayed at this nice resort for the first time on the July 26-27 weekend. I have lived in this area all of my life and even saw the ground breaking of construction of it being built. We just decided to try a local resort for a weekend and experience what others are saying. We came for their 25th anniversary special.  Once we checked in and checked out our room.  We were very impressed on the size of our room. We had a view right up to Camelback mountain.  Then we hit the pool and checked out the different pools. We liked the pearl pool the best. I also liked that they have underground parking.  Keeps the car cool in the summertime and if raining outside we would not be in it. We also enjoyed some of the nice restaurants on the property. We enjoyed a fixed menu in one restaurant that had the wine pairing.  Very good choice of wine of each course. The last night we enjoyed the J&G steak restaurant.  We had the roasted lobster and we added the filet mignon.  The filet was awesome!  What set it off was the different sauces they give you to put on it. We shared a desert of Cherries Jubilee that had a pistachio Icecream.  They do have nice nice HD TV's in the room also. Finished off with a great movie. Nice coffee makers in room also. 

I would recommend this fine resort to stay at the Phoenician. This is comming from a fellow Phoenician living in Phoenix..

reviews.author: amalpani
reviews.title: Guest for life!! The best hospitality ever!
reviews.text:
Me and my wife visited the Phoenician for her birthday in April - and we couldn't have made a better decision.
What an awesome resort!
We stayed in the Casita and it was just perfect - Neat and clean, pretty balcony views, full of privacy and close to the clubhouse.
But most impressive was the hospitality through out the resort. From the time we checked-in to the time we checked-out. The bell-desk, the check-in staff, the helpers at all the restaurant, pool - everyone was very helpful and very nice.

One of my favorite Starwood property! I highly recommend this resort.
We are guests for life and are already planning to visit again in September :-)

A few must-dos when at the hotel:

1) Drink @ Thirsty camel (twilight/night time)
2) dinner at the J&G steakhouse
3) Hiking Camelback mountain
4) The local flavor ice-cream at the ice-cream parlor

reviews.author: Jason1051
reviews.title: Excellent Stay, Wonderful Service
reviews.text: I stayed here last week for a conference.  This a great 5 star hotel in the desert.  The service was impeccable and always available to help.  The conference went off without a hitch.  The food for all meals was excellent and well marked.  A pet peeve is seeing a buffet and then having no labels regarding what the dish even is.  Everything was labeled and even marked gluten free or not.  Nice touch.  The pool grounds rival the best in Las Vegas with multiple pools and outdoor bars.  The rooms are fantastic with extra large bathrooms and ice cold a/c.  the fitness is center is above and beyond with what you would pay for at a regular gym with free water and ice cold wash cloths.  These small things are really what separates the good from the great!   I would highly recommend staying here.  This will set the new standard for a five star hotel.  Thanks!     One last note... The hotel sits right at the base of Camel Back Mountain which is a great hike!

reviews.author: Elle.M.Dubya
reviews.title: Amazing Luxury Oasis in the Desert
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is one of the nicest, friendliest resorts that I have ever had the opportunity to visit.  The first part of my visit was for business.  The resort handled all aspects of the conference without a hitch.  The conference rooms were always the perfect temperature, the technical needs almost perfect and the food was top notch - yes, buffet food, top notch.  The 2nd part of my visit was personal.  I flew my young son out to spend the weekend with me, and we had the best time ever.

The hotel grounds are simply spectacular.  The facility backs right up to Camelback Mountain, and to see this beautiful landmark from all areas of the resort was simply amazing.  The Cactus Garden is gorgeous - an amazing place to visit.  The buildings are well maintained and absolutely stunning.

The room I stayed in was in one of the casitas - plenty of space.  The hotel housekeeping staff made up the sleeper sofa for my son after his arrival.  He was so impressed that the staff would make up a bed for him AND call him 'Master'.  He thought he was quite hot stuff.  The amenities in the room were the best.  The bed was soooo comfortable; rarely have I slept any better in a hotel.  The bathroom was huuuge complete with big fluffy robes and an awesome soaker tub.  Bliss!

The first day of my son's visit, I had a 1/2 day of work to finish up so I signed him up to experience the Funicians Kids Club.  He had a blast feeding the fish in the Koi pond, riding on golf carts over to the Kids Explorers game room and then hanging out in the Funicians Fun Room playing xBox and Monopoly.  Oh, and he got to choose his lunch AND he got a cool back pack and stuffed desert bunny for the day.  He loved it!!  Laura and her staff took such good care of my son that he wanted to go back the next day!!  The Funicians Kids Club is a bit pricey at $65 for a half day and $85 for a full day, but it does include lunch and the kids get to experience quite a few areas of the resort.  I highly recommend the program - it was perfect for my child.

The pool area was also just "the best".  We spent an entire day lounging around the pool.  My son enjoyed the "lily pads" in the pool and the slide.  We also enjoyed beverages and lunch.  Megan took good care of both of us...we never had to go after any type of refreshments.  During our "pool day", my son had the chance to participate in the Rubber Duck Races and the Frozen T-Shirt contest.  He had the best time competing with the other kids and even won the Frozen T-Shirt contest.  The prize? Free ice cream!

That night we were supposed to have a dive-in movie, but unfortunately inclement weather forced a cancellation.  My son was sooo sad as this was our last "Momma-Son" activity together, but Laura saved the day.  She graciously allowed us to check out the movie and we returned it the next day to the front desk.  She has no idea how special our little movie night was in our room.  We ordered in Room Service and snuggled in to watch the movie complete with Mountain Dew and Chicken Tenders.  What could've been a bummer turned out to be a huge blessing.  My kiddo was literally smiling in his sleep.

In addition to the big activities, we enjoyed playing pool, foosball and Wii at the Explorers Club as well as a round of Monopoly.  We also enjoyed an amazing lunch at Relish complete with a Smores dessert finale.  If you go to Relish, be SURE to save room for dessert, and order the s'mores!!  They bring out a little adobe fire pit that sits on the table and we roasted marshmallows assembled our s'mores AT THE TABLE!!

Overall this hotel is truly one of the best I've ever had the opportunity to visit.  I was kind of concerned about a business meeting and attempting a vacation in Phoenix in the summer (hot!), but the hotel really made the heat pretty much a non-issue.  It was simply amazing for both business and pleasure.  If you are on business and are thinking about bringing out the family, just go ahead and do it! Or, definitely visit it even if just for pleasure.  If I lived closer, this would be my go-to stay cation resort. The kids will have a blast and you will too.  The staff is just the best, the facility is phenomenal and I can't wait to go back at any time of year!

reviews.author: Springercrazy
reviews.title: A great hotel and resort!
reviews.text:
The Phoenician is an amazing resort- my husband and I stayed there in April for our anniversary.  The grounds are beautiful, the pool is sparkling and the lobby has a lovely bar!.  They delivered a bottle of champagne to our room as a gift.  

We played tennis one day, rode the complimentary bikes to downtown Scottsdale and did a lot of relaxing by the pool.  The hotel is quiet, it was full, but it didn't feel like it all.  

Everything is fairly expensive, but what else would you expect with a hotel of this caliber!  

I love this hotel!

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Beautiful & VERY HOT
reviews.text:
After a long flight and a very quick exit from Phoenix airport we arrived at the hotel.
Very picturesque driveways and helpful baggage staff at arrivals.
Stunning reception area and quickly shown to our rooms.

Too late to eat the 1st night so just grabbed a drink at the bar - quite a small bar but well stocked and good service.

I was golfing very early the next day so missed breakfast.

The golf pro shop is very well stocked with a huge range of clothing and equipment. 
Staff very helpful and friendly.

At the starters desk we were efficiently sorted with rental clubs (new Callaways) and a buggy.

We were teamed up with another couple as the course was quite busy.

The course itself was very picturesque although some of the greens were quite patchy on the out nine (Oasis)
The back nine were in much better condition (Canyon)

We ate that night in the hotel restaurant.
We didn't make a reservation but were quickly served and seated.

The porterhouse steak that I had must rank in the top 5 steaks I've ever had..... Properly amazing!

Great service and stunning views.

The pools were very nice if a little busy, but in that heat it's not surprising.

Overall a great resort and I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Stephanie G
reviews.title: Excellent Business Trip
reviews.text:
I traveled to Scottsdale with some customers and the trip was fantastic. From the moment I started planning, the hotel was so easy to work with. Michelle was my concierge contact and she was prompt in all of her email responses during planning and helped me with our entire itinerary. When we arrived she greeted us personally and since all of our rooms were not yet ready, she had a little snack set up in my room for my guests to enjoy while waiting for their individual rooms. Although we were only a group of five, I felt like we were helped as if I'd brought in a much larger group (and more money) to the resort.

The hotel was very comfortable, and I enjoyed the decorating as well. It was classy and a little artsy without feeling too formal. The restaurants were pretty good. I tried the poolside grill, which was nothing to write home about, but fine enough for a casual lunch. Dinner at the J&G was a good experience. It's a beautiful view and from what I could tell everyone's steaks were prepared to their liking. They had some big fire pits outside as well. It was a little pricey, but that's what you expect from a resort steak house. 

We also visited the spa. I thought my hot stone massage was very good, but several of the ladies commented that their massages were one of the best they've received. The tarot card reader was fun and something a little different. My mani/pedi was also good, although I had to rush it a bit to make another appointment.

We did not play any golf during our visit, but we did go on a hike at Camelback Mountain. It was pretty challenging, and some of us made it further than others, but definitely worth checking out if you visit. The views are beautiful and you can make it a decent way up even if you're not into hiking.

If you are visiting I highly recommend looking into a trail ride with Canyon Creek Ranch while you are there. The hotel recommended the excursion and I'm so glad we tried it out - everyone had such a fun time and the staff there was great. 

All in all it was a great trip that everyone complimented, and was extremely easy to plan. I would love to come back and play some golf next time as well as spend more time exploring the town.

reviews.author: Jim C
reviews.title: A Bit Dated, But World-Class
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of staying at The Phoenician in Scottsdale on a recent business trip.  I actually got a great deal on the room by booking it as a package with my airline ticket.  The room came out to around $85 per night vs. the normal rate at that time of year of about $150 +.

The resort is gorgeous, and the location spectacular.  It is literally right up against Camelback Mountain; what a view.  The resort is laid out very well, with vistas that take in the beautiful pools from most levels.  The room was very large, king bed, very comfortable, and the bathroom was huge.  It had a full walk in shower and separate jetted tub.  Flat screen TV in the bedroom with Lodgenet for convenient programming.  The closets were spacious and had a great iron and ironing board, which I used once.  The room had a large desk, complete with Wi-Fi (at additional cost.. When are hotels going to stop this really dumb practice?  It's like stepping over dollars to pick up penny's.  Raise your rate a bit and stop nickle and dimeing us to death).  Housekeeping was good, and towels and linens were the high quality you'd expect at such a nice resort.

I had occasion to eat breakfast and lunch at Il Terrazo, on the first floor, as well as having room service one night.  Both were very good, and highly recommended.

I had occasion to have a document printed and scanned at the front desk, and they were very helpful.  I did not get the chance to explore a lot of the resort as it was work, work, work, but look forward to on a subsequent visit.  Highly recommended, I will be back.

reviews.author: martin k
reviews.title: resort in phoenix
reviews.text: This older resort is gorgeous and never looses its charm. Well kept up with golf course, tennis and everything else. We love the plants around the facility and walked it many time. Next to Camelback mountain trails- a must to do. Just sitting by one the many pools and hottubs( in evenings) is relaxing enough.

reviews.author: Jeff B
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: We try to stay at the Phoenician every 4th of July.  We got a great rate and were treated wonderfully from the minute we arrived.  They upgraded our room and we rekindled relationships with staff that we see every year.  The only low point was that one night a bar tender was rude to us.  However, before we could even leave the bar a manager (matthew) swooped in and immediately offered us comps (which we didn't accept because it wasn't about that).  The next day we attended the afternoon tea and the same manager comped our champagne even though we told him we didn't want comps.  It was just another example of the staff of the Phoenician doing going the extra mile to make sure that our stay was perfect.

reviews.author: Gocanes4
reviews.title: Great holiday stay
reviews.text:
We ended our holiday trip in Scottsdale and found a great deal to stay here.
The hotel is big and busy, but is right next to Camelback mountain which is a wonderful backdrop.
The room was quite big and clean, and the service was excellent.  The food and beverages were a bit pricey, but good nonetheless. 
There is also some great hiking on the property, and you can even venture a hike up Camelback mountain.

reviews.author: David R
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.text: The facilities were phenomenal in all respects.  The room was pristine.  Staff were courteous and friendly.  The food was great.  The pool, spa, and golf facilities were top notch as were the folks staffing them.  I would definitely return for business or pleasure.

reviews.author: Ritchie S
reviews.title: Sustained excellence.
reviews.text: Superb as ever. Casitas have been refurbished to a very high standard. Pearl pool cabana service is first class. Tennis Center faciliies excellent and staff really friendly - they opened early for me before the Summer heat kicked in and kept me stocked with water and towels. This is approx our 10th trip here as a family and we will be back.

reviews.author: Mary R
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: My kids beg me to go back every year. The staff is amazing. The grounds are spotless. The pools are huge and clean! There is a quiet pool! Need I say more. The spa is the nicest spa I've ever been to in the world. This is worth every penny. We will continue to go back here.

reviews.author: smileyeye
reviews.title: Expecting more from "casita"
reviews.text:
When deciding what part of hotel we wanted to stay, we decided to call direct. In was early evening and could only get through to the hotel operators, and we left on hold several times for long periods. Finally when calling back and telling of the long hold times we were connected to a real person. He helped us decide to pay a little more for casita with a resort view . it was to be looking at the necklace lakes. We instead got a very large and nice "casita" room that faced the parking lot. It did take a couple calls to get to someone who would do something. they first implied we booked online with a 3 rd party website , which was not the case. They went out of their way to find a better view of the water the next day, but then the room was not the large room advertised on the website or the first room with no view.. It appears that the end unit casitas are much larger then the 2 in the middle. I also think they should find a bette name, it is more like a motel look than what I would expect from a casita.
The staff were excellent, everyone very helpful. The adult pool was relaxing and I loved that they brought you a pitcher of ice water and had noddles to float on. 
I had no problem that the one side is reserved for those willing to pay for a cabana. 
The food at relish is great, good prices as well. We only had breakfast in the main dining and it was nice to have the option to skip the buffet and Oder off the menu with reasonable prices. You do not always get that at upscale SPG properties. 
The grounds are beautiful. I would stay again aft they took the time to fix our room issue, but would be more aware of what I was getting.

reviews.author: rdkflk
reviews.title: The love  child of Atlantis and the Boulders
reviews.text: This is a large hotel with all the bells and whistles. Looks like a Star Wars creation.   However, I did not find most of it aesthetically pleasing.  I was also in a casita which was nice inside but outside looked like a Motel 8.  There ws a dirty wash cloth in my room when I arrived, no shampoo, a bath tub with no hot water and a broken coffee machine.  The pools are appropriate for kids but I was not interested in spending any time near or in them.  The food was very good and the staff was attentive.  The sheets were superb.

reviews.author: Sonya
reviews.title: Chillaxing
reviews.text: Great spot to just chill out on hot days! The hotel is great and has everything you would need. I was fortunate to spend my days at the pool reading and just to relax. Away from the hustle and bustle. Several pools available to choose from but by noon most of the chairs are filled. Great time with shopping close by (taxi ride). Staff is very friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: Loves_Travel_3_2010
reviews.title: Some Rooms Great, Some Not Worth Time or Money
reviews.text: Do not stay in rooms in Main Building, way too many issues.  Casitas or Canyon Suites are Nice and the only ones worthwhile.  Casitas have great view of lawn and Camelback Mountain.  Breakfast in Casitas can be served on the lawn, which was really nice. The lotion and shampoo are some of the best I have used, loved it.

reviews.author: RU-OK-2
reviews.title: Good but could be better
reviews.text:
We recently returned from a 3-night stay at The Phoenician.  We were traveling with another couple.  The grounds and hotel are very nice upon entering the resort.  Check-in was quick and the staff were very friendly and helpful.  Our rooms weren't ready yet so we went to Relish for lunch.  The food and views were excellent.  The burgers/sandwiches are $16 each but are large enough for 2 people to share.  The service in Relish was extremely poor.  We ate lunch there 2 times during our stay, both times the food/drinks were excellent but the service was awful.  Our other restaurant experiences at the resort with service were good.  Room service was prompt, I ordered a quesadilla and it was so hot I could barely eat it (impressive for room service).
Our room had a view of Camelback mountain.  It was a quiet side of the resort, it was a long walk to the main lobby but we didn't mind.  It was nice to be able to sit on the chaise and read during the quiet mornings.  The rooms were very clean and well appointed.  However, they really need to be updated/remodeled (esp the bathrooms).  The decor is very dated.  The bathrooms need an overhaul of new tile, sinks, bathtub, etc.  
The pool service was good until around 2pm, then they seemed understaffed when the pools got busy.  After 2pm it was hard to find a clean towel, many of the chairs were unoccupied but had dirty, used towels on them and weren' replaced with clean towels.  It was nice to have pitchers of ice water and service was good earlier in the day.  Do not try to sit on a chair in front of an unrented cabana, they would rather you sit on the concrete.  One person in our party of 4 sat in one of the chairs, she told the teenage pool attendant she will gladly leave as soon as it was rented but she had to put her towel on the concrete and sit because you can't sit in front of an unoccupied cabana (this particular cabana remained unoccupied the entire day). The adult pool was dirty and when the breeze came up it smelled of sewage.
The golf course was beautiful, prices were reasonable and they provided bottled water. 
It was nice that transportation was available anywhere you wanted to go, just $15 each way.  However, when we made transportation arrangements to take us back to the airport we were quoted a price of $37.  When we got to the airport the driver told us it was $57 and there was nothing he could do about us being previously given a quote of $37.
We had a good stay but it seems like the hotel was lacking in some areas.  There were many inconsistencies in the service, it was either excellent or terrible.   It's a beautiful resort with good food and drinks.  A lot of the staff did their job well and seemed to be well trained.  Overall it was a good trip but I don't think I would stay at The Phoenician again.  I would recommend staying here only if you got an excellent price.

reviews.author: Ian M
reviews.title: Paradise in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Just back from our fifth holiday at the Phoenician, Scottsdale, AZ and I am delighted to report that this little Garden of Eden is just as spectacular and welcoming as ever.  I simply can't fault the service here: it doesn't matter whether it's the staff at reception, the concierges, housekeeping, poolside, in the bar or in the restaurant - it's five star treatment all the way.  Nothing is too much trouble and everyone is more than willing to help.  Only one downer for overseas visitors - the Broadband/WiFi is not free, it's an extortionate $12.95 a day - plus taxes - and that's nust not on.  I'd recommend this resort without hesitation to anyone who wants a great holiday.  We will be back in 2014!

reviews.author: BernardRene
reviews.title: Incredibly beautiful grounds, lovely rooms, attentive staff...but keep your car nearby!
reviews.text: I have been to Phoenix dozens of times and have heard wonderful stories of the Phoenician, but never stayed there. Now that it is part of the Starwood chain (Westin, Sheraton, W Hotels, etc) and I can get points, I thought I would give them a shot while in Phoenix on business (plus it is June and rates are CHEAP). I was not disappointed. The hotel is gorgeous. The grounds (acres and acres) are gorgeous. The bathroom in the room was FANTASTIC (I'm a sucker for a nice jacuzzi tub with a separate shower. The staff is attentive, attractive, and gracious. There was a beautiful, very talented young jazz singer (Talia) performing in the lounge one evening. She was VERY good (and surprising young - under 25). If I was here for vacation, I might not leave the grounds at all and enjoy everything onsite. However, I was here for business. There is no such thing as "walking around the corner" to Starbucks or a restaurant or bar. Everything is a drive (not terribly far, but it's a mile just to get out of the hotel grounds to the street). For business, I won't stay here again. For pleasure, I probably will stay here again and not leave the hotel grounds.

reviews.author: gfillo
reviews.title: Refreshing
reviews.text: Enjoying a relaxing weekend away. Was here 17 yrs ag o Resort is still beautiful (but showing her age in spots) service is wonderful with smiling staff. Hardest part of trip was getting a shady spot under umbrella or tree by the pool .

reviews.author: Blissfuljoy
reviews.title: Great place to just relax
reviews.text:
We loved staying at the Phoenician in the summer time when it's less crowded, and you don't have to fight for a seat by the pools. The main pool does need re-plastering especially by the basketball hoop area. Your toes can get pretty torn up by the end of a game.

Our room was spacious and clean. But I couldn't really use the balcony because there's a constant hum coming from a giant ventilation or exhaust fan nearby, which was a real shame. The bathroom definitely needs some hangers to hang towels. There were 2 but in the most awkward place - where the toilet is.

The food was fresh and delicious, and price was fairly reasonable for a AAA-5 Diamond resort.
There were a few hiccups during our last stay (a week ago), but the one thing you can always count on from The Phoenician is customer service. The staff, from front desk to restaurant to housekeeping, was always friendly and helpful. Blanca from housekeeping and Jose from Il Terrazo definitely made our stay very pleasant. Thank you. We're already planning the next stay in August!

reviews.author: Karen M
reviews.title: Good hotel but stay at the Phoenician Suites instead
reviews.text: We stayed here for our babymoon/honeymoon. Our first night was at the Suites which is incredible and the next 3 night were at the regular hotel. While we loved the hotel and they were very accommodating I would def recommend the suites first! We keep kosher and the hotel was very accommodating with reheating out food for Shabbat and taking care of us. Thank you Marc and Michelle, managers at Il Terrazo for helping us with our food restrictions and for taking such good care of us, and thank you to the Chef!!! Overall though the hotel is #1 as well as the service. Thanks for a great trip!

reviews.author: Ppiatak
reviews.title: Well worth the time and money
reviews.text: Although one might think this resort too expensive at first glance - it is well worth the time and money.  You may chose to never even leave the grounds.  The meals and service are 5 star and the attention to detail is best in class.

reviews.author: Travel Ameniti
reviews.title: The Queen of the desert getting older
reviews.text:
The Queen of the desert getting older

The Phoenician is always a destination.
Arrived late at night and faced some small problems with the room that was not ready and we got our new room very late and our kids went to bed after 1:00AM.
However, besides this minimal glitch, our stay was outstanding. Chris and Elliott made us feel welcomed and the amenities we received were great.
Our children had a blast.
This is one of our favorite destination in the desert.
Two observations for the Starwood:
1. The property needs a lift up. The tear down is visible from year to year.
2. There is an obvious drop in the quality of service, from housekeeping to public areas and restaurants.
As a conference planner I will like to see improvements in these areas.
However, our stay was excellent

reviews.author: TravelmaniacNewYork
reviews.title: Great service, very relaxing location
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 2 nights for a short get away and it was great. 

First the pro's:
- Grounds are beautiful
- People working at the hotel are super friendly and helpful and appear to be everywhere, so you don't have to go searching for someone to get an answer
- Lots of really nice pools
- Righ near Camelback which is great for hiking
- GYM has the best equipment and is very large, super nice and I stay at hotels often
- Restaurants are great and affordable

The major con is that some of the rooms have really bad views and they charge $50 a night for connecting rooms. Other then that, the hotel is amazing and I would recommend it to anyone for a nice get away. One small thing, if you have a stroller its not that stroller friendly when walking around outside, but they will load it in a golf cart and drive you to your destination...a nice bonus in the heat!

reviews.author: MNBeachL0ver
reviews.title: Relaxation has been found!!
reviews.text:
I had read quite a few reviews prior to selecting this resort for a quick weekend of relaxation.  There are so many great things about this property, but I will start with a quick couple of things that could use a little improvement, but in the end, certainly didn't diminish from my weekend of relaxation! 

When I arrived late at night, there were a couple of people in line ahead of me and only one person to help us.  Normally this would be completely expected at midnight when I arrived, but there appeared to be a conference or wedding just ending and the lobby was really busy.  Something must have been wrong with the first person's reservation, bc it took a good 15 minutes for me to finally get helped.  The staff was very apologetic though and seemed to sense it was taking longer than it should have.  The other times I was in the lobby, there always seemed to be a line at the front desk.  On Sunday when I went to leave the hotel at 12:30 there was a considerable line of people waiting around and again only 2 people to help this time.  I was glad I didn't need to check out at the desk, or I would have certainly been late for my flight.  So, it may have been a busier weekend in off season and they just weren't staffed for it, or their computers could have been slow, as the computer did seem to be slow during my check in.  So, just leave yourself extra time when needing to do something at the front desk.  It certainly didn't ruin my trip at all, but might have been frustrating if my kids had been with me!

I had a room in the main building and was upgraded from a deluxe room to a grand deluxe room by calling prior to my arrival and asking for a room that had a pool view! This was very much appreciated and I would certainly recommend booking the grand deluxe room if you are traveling during high season unless you absolutely don't care about your view.  Some things in my room were a little dated or in need of repair, but I had read this in previous reviews and knew what to expect.  The carpet had a few stains on it places and my patio table had some holes in it, but I have read that they are remodeling the rooms shortly, so I'm sure these things will be replaced then.  Again, did not take away from my trip at all! 

Others have complained about outdated electronics, but my room had a great flat screen TV, iPod docking clock with radio and wireless telephone and keurig coffee machine (loved it!) , so I didn't see that as an issue.  When the remodel does occur, a ceiling fan in the rooms would make a great addition.  The room thermostat was an older model, but it functioned great when I turned the air conditioning up at night and then down during the day! 

The bed in my room was amazing, just as I would expect at any 5 star resort! There were also lots of little things in the room that I really appreciated and that stood out.  There were 4 magazines on the table in the sitting room when I arrived, a copy of Kiplingers and Tennis among them, when I arrived! I hadn't bought any magazines prior to my trip, so this was a great little touch! The full chaise lounger on the deck was also fabulous.  The first morning I didn't feel like getting organized to go down to the pool, so I just laid on my deck for the morning! Yes, it was pretty hot in June, but that is what I was there for!!   

I used the refrigerator for some snacks I brought back to my room and wasn't charged for anything from the minibar, but you do need the key for the minibar in order to use the refrigerator.  I was glad I had taken the key to the minibar when asked if I wanted it upon check in! 

The pools were laid out differently than I might have expected, but by the second day I found the perfect place to sit in my opinion!  The first day I sat up on the top pool west side and that pool had a little action at times bc the volleyball net was there and then was quiet at other times.  The food and drink service was excellent here and I believe that Jeremy was my server that afternoon! He was wonderful! It was actually really nice that they didn't try to scoop my food away right when I stopped to take a break from eating! I was enjoying some chips and salsa for a couple of hours and most places I would have had to tell them 6 times that I was still nibbling on them! The drinks here were amazing as they came from the main pool bar.  I found over the next couple of days, that the drinks that came from the main pool bar were the best.  The next two days I sat down by the mother of pearl pool and the drinks down there were not quite as good, but I needed to stretch my legs at one point and walked up and got one from the main bar and that again was much better.  I found it wonderful to sit on the chairs facing the lake and fountains and then when I got hot I turned around and went for a dip in the mother of pearl pool with the cabanas and mountains in the background!  This gave you 2 different views and I felt like I had more space then had I been squished in the chairs next to the pool.

I used the fitness center one night and your room key lets you in at any hour.  It was great and had better fitness equipment than my gym membership I pay $100 a month for!  Couldn't ask for anything else at a hotel fitness center.  They had cool towels in the lobby with a citrus spa scent! If you get hot at the pool, walk over and grab a couple of those towels! Extremely refreshing! They also had 2 mini fridges packed with water bottles and a basket of apples and oranges!  I grabbed an apple and had one for breakfast the next day and one by the pool! 

The final thing I really enjoyed were the walking paths and all the different things to explore right on property.  I wish I would have made it out to the activities center, but ran out of time.  You had lots of room for walking at night and exploring the gardens by day.  At the pools there were games you could borrow like scrabble or cards.  There were also all the kids water activities like the water slide and floating lilly pads to run across!  I would certainly bring my family also! 

This is an amazing resort that delivered all I needed in my weekend away for some relaxation.  There were lots of people that lived locally that had just come for a couple nights away and I wish we had resorts like this in my hometown!! Great idea for the 100 degree weather! But also a wonderful place to come from far away!  Being in the travel industry, I've visited a lot of resorts,but this one is amazing, so feel free to message me if you have any questions.  It is certainly the little things that add up to make a property like this a shining star in my book!

reviews.author: Maggiesboy
reviews.title: This is a fabulous resort.
reviews.text:
We had 4 nights in June as a couple on a friend's recommendation and loved it.
The welcome was warm and staff could not have been more helpful or attentive during our stay, from being greeted by name at the security booth, to poolside service, all the restaurants on site, and the concierge and front desk staff. 
This is 5 star, and charges accordingly, but anyone booking a 5 star resort expects this, and so long as the service and quality is spot on, it still represents value for money. 
We particularly enjoyed the meal at JG Steakhouse and sitting on the terrace in the evening with a fabulous view across Phoenix to the mountains in the distance was memorable.
I played golf - rented the clubs and rates were good for a decent resort course - 3x 9 hole loops.
Would return without hesitation.

reviews.author: saulsgirls
reviews.title: Can't Wait To Return!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician resort for 3 nights in june with two other couples where we celebrated our 26th wedding anniversary. When we informed the staff member checking us in of the purpose of our vacation she immediately comped our breakfast for the entire stay and sent us a bottle of champagne to our room! We chose to stay at a casita facing the pool and the beautiful gardens. The room was very clean and spacious with a patio. The concierge gave us great dining advise as we are vegetarians and find it difficult to find restaurants that cater to our needs. He sent us to olive and Ivy which was delicious with great service.
 The pool area was huge -- 9 pools in all with plenty of chairs and a nice restaurant poolside. We had dinner one night at JG steakhouse and were a bit disappointed at the slow service plus dining room was so cold - we complained several times to no avail.  The spa was the highlight of our stay. My husband, who hates massages, was thrilled with his deep tissue massage. I did a yoga class and meditation with my friends and used the gym as well. It was the most relaxing , wonderful vacation we have had in years. If you are planning to visit Scottsdale , the Phoenician Resort is the place to stay!

reviews.author: steph444
reviews.title: Amazing few days!
reviews.text: This was our third visit to The Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale Az. My husband attends a conference here and I get an amazing treat. The rooms are beautiful and immaculate. What I love best, and have always loved it the service. Everyone simply cannot do enough for you as a guest! Not only is everyone so nice and friendly, but the service wherever you go in this resort is top notch!!! I love going to the pool and having a pitcher brought to me with water and ice right away. The restaurants are wonderful and the spa is amazing!!! We love it here!!!

reviews.author: SandJbusytravelers
reviews.title: Excellent service, comfortable rooms, great food!
reviews.text: Just returned from a conference at this hotel.  Very welcoming from the minute we arrived, even though they were overrun with attendees - extremely pleasant, everyone was approachable and worked hard to meet any ask.  Even the staff as you walked to and from your room were friendly.  Had a room at the end of the hall with a huge deck facing the golf course which was a very pleasant place to read and get caught up on e-mail.  Room was well appointed.  Bathroom amenities were top notch.  Free coffee in the room.  Turn down service included a refresh of the room, bottles of free water and chocolate -- most appreciated after a long day in meetings.  Walked the beautiful grounds and found waterfalls and gorgeous landscaping.  Exercise room was nice.  Food throughout the event was delicious - I have lots of food allergies and they easily accommodated my every meal.  Highly recommend - would return here in a minute!

reviews.author: bitbytravelbug1
reviews.title: Loved The Phoencian
reviews.text:
Visited the Phoenician for one week as part vacation part business trip. Check in process was efficient, polite and informative.  Our room had a view of Camelback Mountain and the cactus garden.  Found the room to be spacious, clean and comfortable. The grounds were kept in fine form as cleaning was done constantly. We visited the gym which was not huge but had all of the usual equipment you would expect to find. 
The spa was inviting and full service staffed with those who were interested in making sure that you left feeling relaxed. After donning a robe, you may wait for your masseuse to come and get you as you sip any number of naturally flavored water available.  You may wish to wait and relax in the meditation room. Had the Swedish massage which was fantastic.  Had my nails done which began with a neck massage followed by a hot pack placed on my shoulders.  Visited the salon just for an up-do. Enjoyed both my stylist and my hair style.  

Dined in all of the restaurants.  Truly enjoyed the ambiance of JG Steakhouse.  Eat out on the patio as there are open flame fire pits which set a beautiful scene.  Started with oysters and my main was the Dover sole - delectable.  
Relish is the burger place which is located by the golf course.  Visited for lunch twice.  I ordered the same burger on both occasions - True Blue.  Prepared to my liking both times. 
At the Camelback lounge we were able to order food from the II Terazzo menu.  Would seem to have been a bit scaled down from the normal restaurant menu as we were eating in the lounge but was tasty nonetheless.  There is a cafe that also serves breakfast, specialty coffees.  I particularily enjoyed the smoked salmon which I had on a couple of occasions.  Nothing special or unique in presentation, I just would have never thought that they would have offered this item on a limited menu and I appreciated its presence.

We rented a car for our week stay and made a trip to Sedona to the the must-see red rocks.  Michelle - one of the 2 concierge named Michelle was helpful and informative with directions.  She gave us a wonderful lunch selection  - the Enchantment Resort. Taking her advice we ate on the patio at Tii Gavo in full intimate view of a red rock mountain as our backdrop while dining.  I especially enjoyed the sangria of which there was the choice of red and white.  I chose the red = delish.   Returning to the Phoenician was convenient for those who have rented a car as you have the choice of valet or self parking.  The self parking is great as it is located underground.  Ample parking available.

I definitely recommend checking out the Phoenician should you be considering a trip to AZ.  You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: travellinallover
reviews.title: Great service. Felt very welcome
reviews.text: Travelling from the other side of the world to only be here for a few days (visiting a relative), we felt welcome and very comfortable. Rooms were spacious and the surrounds were wonderful. Would love to return here for a more leisurely stay next time around,

reviews.author: Christie K
reviews.title: Great Desert Getaway
reviews.text:
My husband just took me here to celebrate my birthday. He had informed them of my birthday and I was greeted with a happy birthday by everyone, and with a smile also. We received champagne in our lovely room, which was the perfect temp and had lights and music playing when we got there. Our room faced the pool and had a great patio. The service was perfect. The rooms were very quiet and comfortable. I love a hotel that is so friendly and helpful. The location was great in case you ever wanted to leave. I received a special gift from Starwood 
Preferred Guest--a Kate Spade handbag. Thank you Starwood, I love it!!  We also had a great dinner at J&G Steak House.  Thanks, Phoenician, it was a great time!!!

reviews.author: dermgoddess
reviews.title: Fantastic beautiful hotel with ***** staff
reviews.text: What a beautiful hotel. The staff could not be more accommodating. Beautiful large clean rooms with magnificent bathroom and comfy bed! The grounds are magnificent and well groomed. Very quiet room, important for weary travelers. Cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: RikiUSA
reviews.title: Wow, The Phoenician!!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Phoenician. Extremely upscale resort. Phoenix is hot, but not humid, no uncomforable sticky feeling. Love the Southwest US. This is truly a great area. Our room overlooked the back, beautiful cactus garden. Try breakfast on the balcony overlooking this rock/cactus garden. Trails allow walking through this and other garden areas. The  property, while large is easy to navigate. Breezeways are open, airy and offer great views. Loved the large pool and cabanas. Exceptional hotel and pool staff are ready for any request.  The hotel offers a great spa, tennis, golfing, and other outdoor activities can be easily arranged. There is a great patio for dining, cocktails, and dinner overlooking perfectly manicured lawns. Whatever you want,The Phoenician can do it! We can't wait to return for more fun, hiking, horseback riding, cabanas and romance in the sun!

reviews.author: JessicaEdmonton5
reviews.title: Excellent! Best Service Ever:)
reviews.text:
My girlfriends and I decided on Scottsdale for a staggette and we were not disappointed!
This area itself, has the best service that I have ever experienced and our hotel was fantastic.  We were obviously in the area during the off season, for the weather reached the low 40 degrees celcius, but the staff at our hotel made our stay very pleasant!
They never let our ice cold water jugs at the pool go empty and even suprised us all with a bottle of champagne, compliments of them:)
I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting...I mean if the president can stay  here, so can you:)

reviews.author: philpatrick
reviews.title: Summer Spectacular
reviews.text: Early June stay at the amazing Phoenician.  I am a world traveller and have been to many excellent hotels - this is absolutely one of the best!  The service is amazing!  Our room 3138 was an upgrade from desert view - apparently it was a little bigger than most but it was great!  The pools are awesome.  On Monday we rented a cabana and enjoyed great service.  We ate at the J&G steakhouse one night and had an excellent dinner.  This property is all we had hoped for and more!

reviews.author: ROTCA
reviews.title: Simply relaxing!
reviews.text: We had a National Sales Meeting of approximatly 800 people.  This establishment handled it without a hitch! Food, service, billing, cleanliness of rooms was top notch!!!! By far the best and couldn't ask for anything other than cooler weather. Loved it!

reviews.author: SonomaCountyJill
reviews.title: Beautiful property, impressive service but average when it comes to the room
reviews.text: We just returned from a long hot weekend in Scottsdale. We had been looking forward to staying at The Phoenician. The grounds are beautiful - well-tended and a green visual relief against the hot air. We found the staff to be friendly and attentive. Couple of things still bother me. We had family staying in the resort with us and they found a scorpion in their bathroom. We found a cricket in our bathroom but the scorpion find was a little too unsettling. Thorough cleaning may be an issue because we moved out a small piece of furniture to access the plug to charge our phones and there were two pieces of trash. Ugh. We found the electronics to be outdated; our TV was not HD. We also found a design flaw in the bathroom that could be easily remedied. There is no place to hang your towel when showering. We ended up putting one end of the towel through the shower handle but that was not a perfect solution since the towels are too thick to fully go through the handle. Your only other option is to throw it over the glass which is not ideal. So, all in all, I was not overly impressed. However, we travel to Scottsdale frequently and would like to give the Phoenician another shot. I know people rave about it - we just didn't feel it was totally up to all the hoopla.

reviews.author: relaxinto
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text:
This hotel is top notch.  From the amazing front desk staff to the room cleaners to the tennis pros.   I didn't have one complaint about the property.  Well, maybe just one...on my last day, there was a knock on the door at 8am asking if she could clean the room.  I was up and almost packed so I told her to come back, but I thought this was a bit pushy.  

Back to the plus side, the location is great.  The property is huge and gorgeous.  The pool area is clean and very nice.  The conference area is among the nicest I've seen...conference centres are usually beige and bland, but this had some nice character.  The staff at the tennis facility were courteous, helpful and knowledgeable and the facility was impressive.

Also, the upscale nearby mall was only a 20 minute walk away if you cared to walk there.  Old Scottsdale is about a 25 minute walk.  But the hotel was happy to provide cars to transport you there for $15 each way, which was reasonable.

I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: JN2266
reviews.title: Superior service
reviews.text: All of the staff at thus hotel truly strive to and succeed at providing service above and beyond from the front desk personnel to the concierge and especially housekeeping.   Our room attendent, Maher,  was always in anticipating our needs and really trying to our stay wonderful.

reviews.author: GLFCHK228
reviews.title: Tired and Over Rated
reviews.text: I agree that this property is impressive.  However, it is a 5 diamond resort and that carries a higher expectation than average.  The hotel is "tired" and the electronics are outdated.  Cabanas at the pools are dirty and faded.  Upon our early arrival, on Friday, May 31st, we made an attempt just to drop our bags inside to avoid the outside heat.  The lobby was full and there were only two people at the front desk, with a line out to the lobby entrance.  There was no management available to ask questions or anyone else for that matter.  We ended up changing in the bathroom to make a tee time.  Got back that afternoon, checked-in and headed out for dinner.  Upon return, we had a message that we did not receive turn-down service due to a "privacy sign".  I called and let them know that was completely false.  I couldn't even tell you where the sign was located, much less put it on the door.  Room décor is drab and stark.  Played golf at the resort course.  Staff there was much more friendly.  However, the locker rooms are pathetic.  No towels in the lady's, two showers were out of order, steam "out of order" and the hairdryer did not work.  Again, while this property has beautiful grounds, one expects the service level to be above average and the rooms to be elegant.  Sorry, I would not stay here for the money.  There are equally as nice, if not better hotels in the area.  Invest your time and money somewhere else.

reviews.author: Meek
reviews.title: Great service. Love the friendly and helpful staff!
reviews.text: Staff helped me navigate the sprawling property. Beautiful place for a large biz meeting (we were over 600 deep). Maher is a gem!!!!!!!!!!! Why not a 5? Too spread out, outdated electronics, bell staff not super friendly (probably too hot to stay cheerful).

reviews.author: angie54
reviews.title: Unbelievable!
reviews.text: The only reason I would not give this a perfect review is so that it won't be totally booked next time I want to stay here!  This resort could not be better!!  The facilities are impeccable, the staff is incredible, the location is perfect....It is truly paradise.....This was our second time here and without a doubt I will book this vacation for my family once a year every year ..  I cannot say enough great things about this resort.  The only negative about this vacation is having to go home!!

reviews.author: CrzyCdn
reviews.title: Phenominal guest experience!
reviews.text:
Stayed here May 25th - 30th as part of a business conference....and have nothing even close to negative to say about it!

Great location, staff, amenities, pools, etc etc etc

Hoping to return one day to enjoy it all over again....Congrats Phoenician team on your ongoing commitment to creating an unrivaled guest experience.

reviews.author: PJG2224
reviews.title: A true Oasis in the desert!
reviews.text: We were fortunate enough to experience the hotel last week as part of a business conference.  My wife tagged along and enjoyed the resort to its fullest!  He resort is welcoming from the moment you drive up.  The staff pay close attention to detail and are truly eager to ensure you are taken care of.  Our room was very clean and large witha balcony overlooking the extensive pools.  The food as very good, but not spectacular.  Michelle, the concierge, organized a wonderful day trip to the town of Sedona and combined it with a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon.  The only thing they need to do is resurface the pools.  They are beginning to show their age with parts of the pool floor discoloured.  We would go back!

reviews.author: Sassymae1
reviews.title: Indescribable beauty & luxury
reviews.text: Most relaxing place ever!  Beautiful, beautiful scenery, impeccable service & appointments.  Spa and restaurants are 5 star.  You can stay there for a week and never see the same pool twice.  Surrounded by mountains and beauty.  The night sky is mesmerizing.....never saw so many stars in my life!   Incredible restaurants with over-the- top service.  Well worth the cost!  Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: jcm4
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: The Phoenician was an amazing place to stay. Visited May 20-23 for a conference but had the opportunity to relax a little, too. Fantastic food from the poolside sandwiches to J&G Steakhouse. Loved all of the little places to sit and enjoy the views of mountains! The grounds were beautiful and well-kept. Although I didn't have the opportunity to golf I did take a morning run through the course and it looked great, too. Service was outstanding! One evening there was a woman playing piano and singing in the bar which was piped outside as well. She was lovely!

reviews.author: Rozbo
reviews.title: Relax, relax, relax
reviews.text: If you cannot find a way to relax here, then you never will. This resort has every amenity that one could ask for, including amazing restaurants that serve burgers all the way up to an incredible Tomahawk steak. The spa services are great. Did I mention that they have nine swimming pools. Worth the price just for the experience, if nothing else.

reviews.author: portlandlupe
reviews.title: Great stay at the Phoenician
reviews.text: This is our third year staying at the Phoenician for our family reunion.  The place was really incredible.  The service was amazing, each person more friendly and accommodating then the next, lots of fun activities over Memorial Day weekend for the kids to do.  They always love the water slide too.  We took a hike up camelback mtn as its so close, played tennis, swam a ton, ate great food at all of their restaurants.  I think their fitness room is top notch as a trainer myself I found everything I needed to get a great workout in away from home.  Would highly recommend this place for a family reunion or a getaway.

reviews.author: Michelle B
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: I went to graduate school at ASU and always wanted to try The Phoenician, so my expectations going in were pretty high. The Phoenician did not disappoint. We were given a beautiful room with a balcony overlooking the grounds, which included several pools and a slide! We enjoyed our time at the pools and my husband especially enjoyed playing on the slide. The staff was amazing and even sent us a bottle of champagne when they found out we were out there for our anniversary. I loved how centrally-located this hotel was for our long to-do list in the Phoenix area -- visit my old school, go to an ASU football game, visit with friends, explore Scottsdale, etc. We also took a road trip to the Grand Canyon while staying there and came back to their wine shop to find our favorite -- Cakebread Chardonnay! Excellent visit -- we'll be back!

reviews.author: andym123
reviews.title: Even better than a couple years ago!
reviews.text:
We had another visit to the Phoenician over Memorial Day, multiple families and rooms.  If anything I think they have raised their game!

With only one exception (a cranky waitress at the pool side cafe), everyone, and I mean every single person who worked there was fantastic.  From the moment you arrive at the front door all the way through the visit, the staff is friendly, attentive, patient.  

At meals we had to settle bills on multiple rooms from at least 2 tables, and the staff just handled it with grace and expertise.  Except for the one cranky blond waitress at the cafe, wish I remembered her name.  All she could commit to was 'doing the best she could'.

Get the everything omelet at the buffet (killer!), and have Jose be your waiter.  Breakfast couldn't be better.  Get a pool chair under a shade tree.  Don't sit right next to the DJ if you want to talk.  Self park to save yourself a few bucks.

Lots of fun for the kids, great for the grand parents.  Just a great place for a family gathering.

reviews.author: MichaelHinsdale
reviews.title: Relaxing Weekend Getaway at a classy resort!
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent the Memorial Day weekend here- Friday through Sunday. This is truly a 5 star resort. The room was beautiful, clean, and classy. The bed was extremely comfortable with satin sheets and down pillows. The bathroom amenities- first class. We did spend most of our time at the pool, however. The service at the pool was exceptional. There are servers constantly walking around bringing ice water and towels as well as taking drink and food orders. They were also attentive to guests leaving and removed towels from pool chairs that were no longer being used so other people would know the chairs were available. The pools (I think there are 9 total pools on various levels) are beautiful and they even have a "kids" pool with volleyball net, basketball, and floats to walk across. Oh- and a water slide separate from the main pools. All the kids were having a blast, for sure!

We ate breakfast on Sunday at their Sunday Brunch. It was just okay- not the best buffet I ever ate at, but definitely very good. (**One piece of advice- don't eat outside. The birds are constantly hopping on the tables stealing food from plates and are very bold. If someone vacates their spot even for a minute or two, the birds take advantage. They have lost their fear of people)

One little "bump in the road" we experienced- when checking out there was a charge for $90 from the Thirsty Camel bar for the night before charged to our room. The only problem was we weren't at the bar at all the entire time we were there. I happened to mention this my brother-in-law, who also stayed the weekend with us and he said he too had charges on his room that weren't his. Either the hotel needs a more efficient way of charging items to rooms or they "pad" the bill in hopes no one notices. My advice- scrutinize the bill before checkout. It's easy to assume the additional charges are resort fees and taxes- as they don't charge for these until you leave.

reviews.author: John Warren
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: We were lucky enough to spend two nights at this fabulous resort. Exceptional comfort, exceptional rooms and exceptional service. The grouds are in pristine shape and have been kept so as not to spoil the beauty of nature. The pool(s) are also fantastic on several ground levels and poolside service is also very attentive. The restaurants and bars are first rate with a nice selection of dishes and the wait staff professional and knowlegable. I would highly recommend the experience

reviews.author: Molliebclyde
reviews.title: Meh...
reviews.text: I've stayed here several times and still can't understand how this is rated so high.
