Then to add to our comedy of errors, we received three phone calls over the course of two nights AFTER we had gone to sleep, all between midnight and 2:30 AM with no one on the other end of the line, just music. I feel badly I had to explain my disappointment to such a nice young lady at the desk, but though this place is indeed beautiful, it needs a lot of work behind the scenes.

reviews.author: peglegtraveler
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel in a beautiful location with many amenities and lovely service. What's not to like? We really enjoyed our stay here. My only objection is that there is free wi-fi only in the lobby. When even the most budget hotels offer free wi-fi in the guest rooms, you should certainly get the same convenience at a luxury hotel that charges luxury prices.

reviews.author: boja69
reviews.title: Can't Beat This Palace
reviews.text: Great ambiance. Superior accommodations. Excellent food and beverage service. Perfect locale for large group event as well as small group. Convenient to airport. Very friendly staff. Easy drive to Tucson, Sedona or Flagstaff.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Phoenician Never Fails
reviews.text:
We returned to the Phoenician to check out the area in March (having repeatedly stayed there in November).  We were pleased again with the Scottsdale weather (dry, warm) and have to confirm once again that The Phoenician never ceases to please with its variety of services and, most especially, service.  The staff is extremely customer service oriented and went out of their way to accommodate our requests, including a return to a favorite room location.

The grounds are immaculate, rooms are extremely comfortable and well-maintained, pool very comfortable with attentive staff.

Couldn't be more pleased and plan to return when we can.

reviews.author: Lounge-aholic
reviews.title: Wonderful and Luxurious
reviews.text:
I had the opportunity to stay at the Phoenician for a few days while in Phoenix on a business/pleasure trip. I was not sure about the choice of hotel, as I had read conflicting reports on various websites.

I was very happy with everything there. It is a perfect choice for a wedding or conference or a personal vacation! They have a beautiful resort with well-kept grounds and pools and good food. It is a very "old world elegance" kind of resort, so don't expect a modern, sparse feel to it. It has lots of mature vegetation, nice small spaces in their multiple pools and the scale and feel of the grounds is hard to come by these days. 

I dined in both Il Terrazzo and J&G. Both had very good quality food. Had room service for breakfast and the presentation and the quality of the food, again, was good. Try the Phoenician Crunch ice cream at the ice cream parlor!

I also had a great massage and was impressed with the skill of the massage therapist, as sometimes at high end resorts, even deep tissue massages are no more than a gentle back rub.

The staff were great as well. Valet staff, restaurant staff, pool staff, housekeeping, front desk staff all were very polite, professional and accommodating.

All this being said, it is important to put this all into cost perspective. You WILL pay luxury hotel prices to stay in this luxury hotel. I think this is why there are some reviews regarding value. I think it is quite a shock for conference guests when they have dinner on their own at J&G and it is over $250 (not to mention a spa treatment or two). However, if you are choosing a unique, high-end hotel for a function, you get it all here as they are capable of handling the large groups in their various spaces.

This type of mature, well-designed resort is becoming extinct, and this is the only place to find this oasis in Phoenix.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Excellent Experience but shop around
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights on a business conference.  Beautiful hotel, beautiful grounds, great location adjacent to camel back mtn.  Staff was very friendly and helpful. Excellent restaurants.  Pool/golf course and tennis courts outstanding.   Not sure if it represents value.  I would recommend shopping around before you book,  I believe there may be other excellent Scottsdale hotels/resorts that are better value.  I would recommend checking specials that the top hotels have, you may be able to get this quality for less

reviews.author: pclonger
reviews.title: Great resort to visit while in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Have visited before for business so decided it would be good for a quick trip to AZ.  We had some Starwood points to use so decided on this location compared to a couple of other locations we have stayed at in the area over the years.

We had 5th floor room with a garden view of the mountain and catus garden which is always nice and peaceful.  Staff are always great no matter who you are dealing with in the hotel.  Turn down service that includes chocolate and waters. Rooms are large with large baths and showers, and ours had a good size balcony.  My wife tried out the spa and said it was great.  It is a nice complex to walk around as a true resort property should be.

We were there on a Sun and Mon in Feb so it was a little slow which is great to get seating for great views around the patio lounge areas.  Their bar snacks and drinks are always good. We even had a chance to visit the Relish Burger Bistro one night for a good dinner and sunset views.  Do wish the little stores stayed open later but probably do in summer.

Be sure to take a walk around the place because you will find a lot of unique areas.  The resort is convient to most of the Phoenix area and it is very easy to get back to the airport.  Will probably stay there again when we are in the area.  Valet parking is a little high in my opinion since you are already paying a resort fee.

reviews.author: Colin
reviews.title: perfect
reviews.text: Have been to the Phoenician several times for conferences, and every time I am happy I went... grand entrance, service is amazing, close to everything, great golf course and food is spectacular.... also one of the better wine lists I have come across on the west coast

reviews.author: Joe M
reviews.title: Service Perfection
reviews.text: The Hotel is spectacular and well situated to drive to the airport or to activities in and around Phoenix.  Unfortunately, I didn't get to try the golf course or spa but everything about the hotel is 1st class.  The most impressive thing about it is the service.  Their hiring and training practices must be perfect as every encounter with staff from the front desk to the restaurant was enjoyable.  I didn't know employees could be that upbeat, friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: STEVENSNY
reviews.title: Top of The Line In Scottsdale
reviews.text:
My first stay at this grand hotel and you just couldn't go wrong here. It has a defined style and opulence that is reminiscent of the resorts of yesteryear, with the exception that this has been modernized. From your initial drive up the property to being escorted to the main lobby, this hotel will, and does, make you feel special.

I had a room with balcony overlooking the pool complex. The room was well decorated, very nicely equipped bathroom and everything was just top notch down to the caliber of the wait staff, bartenders - everyone polite and well polished.

The outdoor lounge in the evening is a great place to enjoy drinks (they have an extensive beverage selection). You pretty much know going in that your credit card is going to get a work out - bar tab for 2 people for a few hours almost 150.00 - if you use the spa there are packages easily exceeding 500. a treatment. So, you are either used to paying for amenities or if you want to give yourself a real treat just accept that you'll pay - but unlike other places that may just be expensive - this place actually makes you feel good about being here and spending your money! Very novel, yes?

If you enjoy soft feathery pillows on your bed (and I do!) this is the hotel for you!

reviews.author: Laura T
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, stunning Mountain, mixed results
reviews.text:
This was a trip my older son (age 12) picked and he and I went because it was warmer there than most places and the description of the grounds was really stunning.

Outstanding:
-the pool was beautiful-- although it looks like one huge pool,   there are lots of small interconnecting pools making the outdoor area feel intimiate. There is also a slide which  was fun and just the right mix of danger and safety ;-)  Most memorable is the temperature of the water, which was perfect -- warm and felt perfect at all times of day from the cool early morning through the hot afternoon. 

The cactus garden:
Beautiful, so dont miss this (I almost did).  Right behind the hotel, on the bottom of Camelback mountain is the cactus garden. if you don't feel like hiking Camelback, just walk out the back. You can even walk up the mountain a bit, and see the giant cactus, and get a great view.  It is really incredible and well kept and it doesn't seem many people go to the garden, so surprisingly private

The burgers:
Best "deal" were the burgers in the restaurant called "Relish" off the golf course and the private smores stoves. 

Not so great:
-the grounds are beautiful, but they are for golfers. I was asked to "get off" the path (cactus garden is adjacent to the golf course) as a ball might "wack me in the head and kill me"   I wanted to pay to rent a golf cart-- that also wasn't an option.  If you are going to this hotel to see the grounds, you really can only enjoy if you are a golfer. 

-you get charged for everything extra- renting bikes, etc. so just be aware. Its about 30 a day.
Parking is also fairly expensive, but Id recommend renting a car anyway, as the town cars to scottsdale are costly as well.

Check your bill. I was overcharged by hundreds of dollars per night, adding up to almost $1000.  They did credit me when I brought it to their attention but was surprised they'd make such a big error.

reviews.author: Clark W
reviews.title: Another Great Resort in the Phoenix Area
reviews.text: Spent four nights at the Phoenician at a conference.  While the resort is large, it doesn't feel busy or impersonal.  Level of service is high, staff is friendly, setting is beautiful (and only 20 minutes from the airport), and facilities are first rate.  And if you have a car, or even using taxis, there is a lot to see and do in the area.  My room was large with two closets, a large bathroom, and a terrace.  The food at the restaurants was very good although the group meals as part of the conference were so-so.  In fact, the conference facilities were the least impressive part of the stay.  I have been to several of the Phoenix area resorts and I would recommend the Phoenician for families and couples.

reviews.author: tina m
reviews.title: Business and pleasure
reviews.text: We arrived and were greeted by the nicest fellow with a cold bottle of water. From there the check in staff overwhelmed us with "all" the options to our reservations, wish we had know about these e when we made resv and not at checkin with approx 15 people waiting behind us. Anyway, we made the choice to keep our daily housekeeping service and fore go the extra points & declined the resorts fitness, spa options.We found walking the property, visiting the resturants, and hiking camel back a fantastic way to enjoy the Phoenician in just 2 days.Our room faced the mountain, was quiet, very spacious, 2 closets, sitting area in and out, and huge bathroom!!! Great shower, plenty of amentities. Would ask for extra sleeping pillows, the bed has too many decorative pillows, clutters the room at bed time.Great pools, and staff was over the top with professional courtesies, from pool staff to retail, 5 star!! Oh- and check the Starwood web site for great savings for your stay!

reviews.author: Susie C
reviews.title: Great weekend getaway
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the property for a long weekend without kids.  We were not disappointed with the choice we made in resorts.  We enjoyed a phenomenal spa treatment, relaxed by the pool, & ate a great meal at Relish!  People are correct that the prices are high - $7 for a bottle of beer and $9 for a yogurt parfait but we knew that going in so we did not have sticker shock.  The resort is beautiful - very serene.  It is close to great restaurants and hiking so if you want to venture out there is plenty to do.  We will definitely return - maybe even with kids.

reviews.author: Alex H
reviews.title: Relaxing in luxury
reviews.text: Excellent facility with all the modern amenities. Well trained staff ..service with a smile. Top of the mark restaurant and great place to celebrate Valentines Day. We were there years before and happily found the place was better than we remembered.

reviews.author: Wayne B
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: What a nice hotel and more , gorgeous pools , and the food was second to none . The rooms were very nice , enjoyed it very much... There is a beautiful golf course right there , wow, what a place. But , not cheap , you pay here , but it's worth it

reviews.author: IWriteforFooddotcom
reviews.title: Still the Phoenician
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Phoenician for the 7th time in the past decade.  What is surprising is the consistency in standards over that time.  The Phoenician hasn't changed.  It's standard of service remains high, the facilities remain beautiful, the grounds phenomenally well-kept.

While one may debate the value per dollar, there is no doubting the high standards of service and facility provided at the Phoenician.  It remains one of the top hotels in the Southwest, if not the U.S.

It is an expensive facility that delivers a serene, elegant experience.  4.5 stars overall.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Truly wonderful experience
reviews.text: It's been a few years since I have been to the Phoenician and surprisingly the hotel has only gotten better.  The property is well kept, the service is spectacular with restaurants to match.  A real gem.

reviews.author: RIG33388
reviews.title: Not 5 star amenities or service.
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician for a long weekend getaway. We were looking forward to spa days and pampering by the pool. 

The spa: old, outdated, and the nail salon the same. While the grounds were beautiful and the pool lovely, the behind the scene services are lacking.  The pedicure was second rate and the massage during was virtually nonexistent.   

The food: unfortunately the food was not good at the Phoenician and completely overpriced.  We ordered a tuna sandwich at the pool for over $15 and it was more underwhelming than one made at home. All food eaten there- except the french fries was poor. 

Service: at the bar at night it took us 35 minutes to get water and then another 25 to get our other drinks. The server was not on the balk, nor was she very friendly- none of them were.  Service at the pool was friendly,  but again it took 45 minutes for a horrible sandwich (came out wrong) and drinks. Our drinks alone took minimum of a half an hour each time.

The rooms: fine, nothing stellar, bathrooms nice.  We had a leaky pipe under our sink, but not a big deal. The bed was very clean and comfortable.  The hotel layout has little continuity or ease of navigation. It was a very windy and long walk to everything.

Check in: did not provide us with maps, hotel basic introduction,  or any assistance upon arrival. We asked for a king bed and were given a room with two full beds- referred to as "oversized ". We entered the room and the beds looked like fulls. We went back down, asked for a king, and they changed us, but we lost the view. We were now over the driveway.

With all of the luxurious options available today, the Phoenician is simply not worth the money unless you only want a comfortable bed and a wonderful pool- in which case, it's the perfect place. They need a service, food, and amenities makeover.

reviews.author: gerri777
reviews.title: Gorgeous property
reviews.text: The staff, every one has to be the friendliest we've ever encountered.  The property is huge and beautifully landscaped. We were there for a conference.  Luckily we were in the main section near the action.  Friends weren't as fortunate as they had about a ten minute walk to get to the conference.  We were told that our room over-looked  the pool, but instead we looked down on what seemed to be a glass roof of sorts and looked across at another section of the hotel.  Food was excellent no matter where we ate.  The beds were super comfortable. This is a luxury resort and the rates reflect that.

reviews.author: Elcl
reviews.title: Nice hotel not cheap
reviews.text: We stayed here for a meeting and we did not travel from the premises.  It was a very good experience.  The food was good and the group fare was like cruise food.  The staff was very nice.  The pools and exercise rooms were good. My wife had her hair done which was pricey. I would probably go here again depending on the price. My break point would be about 400 a night.

reviews.author: ronald r
reviews.title: tennis at rhe phoenician
reviews.text:
my wife and I have been to many tennis resorts but this facility and the staff have been the most helpful and knowledgeable.The courts are in great shape and the instruction superb.We will return for sure.Must commend specifically Belinda and Jason for running first class operation.
The resort is gorgeous and the food at Relish divine-Best hamburger I have ever eaten.
All of the staff from bellmen to waitstaff couldn't have been better.

reviews.author: 4evertravelors
reviews.title: We love this place
reviews.text:
My husband and I come here at least once a year and have yet to be disappointed. This is our second time to stay in the one bedroom Casitas and they are wonderful. There are two full baths and a formal dining table, not to mention the nice cozy furniture placed around the fireplace. We were only the lower of 2 floors, which I usually request to be on the top floor, however, this was perfect. Our bedroom had a patio with 2  loungers and the living room patio had a table for four as well as a lounger. The grounds are so well maintained, that sitting outside listening to the fountain and watching the family of bunnies and  and smelling the fragrant trees and shrubs was just lovely. The rooms furnishings are still a little dated, but they still feel look much better  than average hotel furniture. The golf course is perfect and there are at least twelve tennis courts. The first hour was free if you paid a daily resort fee. The parking at the hotel, I believe is $26.00. It's free at the Casitas. They have a very nice and busy Wellness Spa and the pools are heated. Be sure and book ahead,if you want to get into the spa. We found a great little find last year at the golf course. Relish, a restaurant and bar. If you go between 4:00-6:00? they have a half price menu for several appetizers and drinks. Try the BBQ Nachos, yummy. The ll Terrazzo is a nice place for dinner and breakfast. There breakfast Buffett is the normal Buffett, but good. We ordered room service for dinner one night and was told it would be 30 minutes. It was exactly 30 minutes. They came in set the table and asked when we would like for them to return. We said,"we would call them" they were there within five minutes after we called for them to pick up our dishes. The service is perfect through out the hotel, except for breakfast, it seemed a little slower. They also have a little wine cellar, which you can go in and sample wine and cheese. They have two wines that  they donate part of the proceeds to certain organizations. One was breast cancer.  The nice thing is, you can stay right there and choose a wine you like without ever having to leave the hotel. We did have rainy weather one day, so we just laid around, read our books, ordered dinner in and sat by the fire place with our glass of wine. Could it get any better? I love this location. Why? Because it isn't in the middle of town, but it is, just  two miles from old town and the Fashion Mall. Old town is great to walk around and there are some great restaurants and neat little art galleries. Make sure you do the Breakfast Club for breakfast. Be prepared to wait in line, but you won't mind once you eat there. The Fashion Mall is also right by old town. I am a shopper so getting to shop a mall with high end stores is a plus. I'm from Oklahoma City so our shopping is minimal. 
This resort  has good food, nice rooms, great golfing,tennis,pools and spa. The service is almost perfect. We will always make this a yearly trip. It reminds me of the Four Seasons in Dallas, but I think the food and resort activities are much better.

reviews.author: WorldTraveler50226
reviews.title: Nice hotel but getting dated. Desperately needs to be renovated.
reviews.text: It is a nice resort but is definately showing its age. The rooms and spa need to be updated. The workout facilities are average for a resort...nothing special. The staff is friendly and professional. The food at the onsight restuarants is excellent but very expensive. Probably would not stay there again.

reviews.author: Al_Dominick
reviews.title: A Camelback Classic
reviews.text: Our team held a big (800 person) conference here this past week -- the service was outstanding & experience, first class.  Unfortunately, it poured for three solid days -- and there isn't much to do when stuck inside.  The roof leaked in the lobby and getting down to the gym/spa required a car ride to stay dry.  But a desert classic that holds its own against the best of Phoenix's resorts.

reviews.author: Tamara87505
reviews.title: Wonderful experience with the friendliest staff
reviews.text: We had a lovely large room that is beautifully decorated with a wonderful bathroom that overlooked the mountain and the cactus garden. The food was great throughout the hotel and every person who works there is so friendly and very helpful.

reviews.author: DizLiz123
reviews.title: beautiful hotel with cool Cactus Garden
reviews.text: This hotel is wonderful with great pools and gardens to wander thru and delicous food (and fast room service).  We just got to stay here 2 nights but found it to be very nice.  All the staff was helpful and I just loved walking around the gardens.  A very luxurious hotel in beautiful Scottsdale Arizona!

reviews.author: MDFreqTvlr
reviews.title: Still going strong after all this time
reviews.text:
This luxury hotel still stands for high standards of amenities, customer service and excellence. Despite several changes in ownership over the years and now a signature Starwood property, the Phoenician never disappoints.

Even the standard rooms seem like most other hotels' suites. They are well appointed with room to move around and very comfortable. The staff does an amazing job of making every guest feel right at home.

One recommendation is to have a drink on the balcony outside J&G Steakhouse on the fourth floor. It is smaller, quieter but just as nice as the main balcony off the lobby. The view takes your breath away.

Another recommendation is to make the time to walk up Camelback Mountain. The trailhead is a short walk out of the Phoenician's East Gate and it will take about 2.5 hours roundtrip. Just be sure to bring good walking shoes and plenty of water.

reviews.author: sfmaria101
reviews.title: The pool area is spectacular (just make sure it's not raining !)But housekeeping needs more staff.
reviews.text:
The pool area , spa and fitness center were terrific (though the fitness center is a little small) with Zumba and yoga clsses for guests. The only drawback is the limited housekeeping staff, which was inconvenient for us in several  ways: 1) We couldn't check in until after 4 pm in our desired room, because it hadn't yet been cleaned ; then 2) the next day housekeeing completely forgot to clean our rooms , so I had to call them when we returned at the end of the day for a quick towel replacement; 3) On Saturday morning (the only day we could sleep in), waddyaknow , housekeeping shows up at 8 a.m. to clean the room!!
I think management is being pennywise and pound foolish by minimizing their room-cleaning staff (Is it because they are limited in whom they can hire, due to Arizona's stringent immigration laws?) . A luxury resort with these steep room prices shoud be able to minimize such inconveniences to their guests. The pool area , though is worth going back for...

reviews.author: DVE11044
reviews.title: classy beautiful resort with excellent service
reviews.text: staff was attentive, professional and pleasantly engaging, food was well above average, shops were were classy and well maintained, all areas were clean and attractive, wonderful location, quiet restful, will definitely return

reviews.author: golfin39
reviews.title: Spectacular Vacation Destination
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed an 8 night stay over the Christmas-New Year holiday. I relaxed at the Spa where the staff was attentive and very professional while my husband golfed---27 holes in all. The large priceless artwork collection was a wonderful surprise as well as the unique cactus garden you can leisurely tour. There are many swimming pools and even a water slide where the kids can have fun. Service was "top-drawer" with staff who were friendly, polite and dedicated to making sure our every need was met. The large lobby gingerbread house all baked and assembled in the hotel was a treat for our granddaughter who enjoyed watching the video showing how it was made from beginning to end. Look forward to a return.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: This once glamorous resort is showing its age.
reviews.text:
We arrived late, because of a error with the hotel we had booked, 1am. We were in town for the auto auctions so rooms are very hard to come by. We were upgraded to a Jr. Suite because that's all they had available 499.00. When we arrived in the room after about a 10 minute walk we we greeted with a room that had 2 light bulbs out and carpet that needed replacing, it was so stretched out it was a trip hazard. We ordered room service and it took so long we called to cancel but they said it was on its way. How many people were ordering at 1:30, I hate to think how long it would take if it was around dinner time . When the food arrived it was cold, just terrible. When we asked for s late check out we were told it was not possible so it cost us almost 500.00 to use the room for 11 hours. I would never consider booking a room there. Beware!
JM

reviews.author: ColonelTJ
reviews.title: Still the premier hotel and resort in Arizona
reviews.text: I first stayed at the Phoenecian in 1990.  It was an amazing place then and just as amazing now. First class accommodations with great service and all the amenities. I am sure there are many first class resorts in AZ but the Phoenecian is hard to beat.

reviews.author: Zeto
reviews.title: great place
reviews.text: We spent 4 days here with our family. The rooms were amazing & a great size especially having 3 children with us. The pools were warm & we all enjoyed being in them every day. The Little Guys loved fish feeding time. There is a hot pool that was enjoyed both shape & temperature. The service around the pools was so attentive. An older gentleman was always looking out for our needs & seemed to really enjoy his job. Unfortunately we didn't get his name but he was a very positive & caring man.

reviews.author: Reneeintheair
reviews.title: A real resort in America.
reviews.text: I've gone to the Center for Well Being several times. However, I didn't stay at the resort until a few weeks ago. The spa is so inviting, I'm glad I made staying at the resort a priority for my birthday. Walking through the pool and across the lawn to my spa day was grand. I couldn't believe the luxury inside the resort. It's worth every penny. Ideal location just a few miles away from Fashion Square mall, the waterfront, and downtown Scottsdale and 20 minutes away from Phoenix and Tempe depending on the direction.

reviews.author: mdmjh
reviews.title: will always go back
reviews.text: I went to the Phoenician 2 years ago.  Used to split time b/t Boulders (casitas) and Biltmore ( in each trip).  Tried Phoenician and (Biltmore) and loved it.  Had a beautiful room and everything about the hotel charmed me. This trip the weather was cold, and the staff, with the exception of the lobby staff, was not as warm.  I think it was bc there were so few guests there.  The lobby was beautifully decorated tho the gingerbread train not my taste.  The fitness room had several broken machines and  the staff just short of rude. My experience last time was the exact opposite in the spa.  Food ranged from reasonable to ridiculous in price, the bar over the golf shop was great whether or not you were there for the early bird or just off the menu ( reasonable and good food tho little variety/vegetables, fresh local beer on tap). None of this was sufficient to take away my pleasure in the simple elegance of the property, Everything about the rooms is tranquil, understated.  Still have nightly turndown service.  I was upgraded to a suite and asked for a mountain view room instead. I was happy with this decision tho the sun on the balcony in the suite would have been wonderful and I would have preferred being in the 4100 than 4000 wing.  Going to the Montleucita in 2 weeks for a conference shall see.  The Four Seasons is beautiful (Troon) the Westin Kierland  nice but something about the Phoenician, "speaks to me".  I love the art gallery.  Never made it to a desert garden tour or the escorted Camelback climb, but next year.  Town car to the airport, wonderful, relaxing and modestly more than a cab.  I was offered either and advised of cost of the town car.

reviews.author: Skip M
reviews.title: Real Luxury
reviews.text: If you are looking for luxury, peace and quiet, and a staff that works to please, this is the place.  Then add lovely grounds, a manicured golf course and seasonal plants.  Our stay was in January, which prevented use of the pool, but it is gorgeous and I can see it used extensively in the right season.  Whether you get a room looking at Camelback Mountain or overlooking the grounds, the view is great for sitting on the balcony to read or enjoy a relaxing drink.  If you are looking for a quiet and elegant place to eat, try the in house restaurant (J&G Steakhouse).  This is almost an annual visit for us.  Summer rates are a bargain.

reviews.author: Jay S
reviews.title: Pleasurable elegant getaway
reviews.text: We were fortunate to spend time here at a conference for work. The property is beautifully landscaped. The buildings are elegant. Several large pools. Staff excessively helpful. Rooms are large and bed is just heavenly. This is a place to really escape to and enjoy.

reviews.author: gordy g
reviews.title: Incredible landmark Scottsdale resort
reviews.text:
This is one of the most impressive resorts in Scottsdale with a great central location and all the facilities and activities you could hope for. There are 27 holes of golf, and array of pools, spa, nice dining choices, wide assortment of room choices and beautiful common areas.

While the rooms and resort are grand in scale it does seem as if they are due for a renovation. The same goes for the spa. While they are still above average they are beginning to show their age. To be sure this is no reason not to go here. This is a top notch albeit expensive luxury resort that has set the standard in Scottsdale for many years.

reviews.author: PenDiM
reviews.title: Beautiful inside and out
reviews.text: I spend at least two weeks per year in Scottsdale and try to visit a different spa each trip with local friends. We spent the afternoon at The Phoenician for spa treatments and lunch, what a joy.  Arrived early afternoon and let early evening felt like I had spent and entire weekend away.

reviews.author: Ladybirdlouise
reviews.title: christmas trip vaction
reviews.text: this was a new adventure for our family to be gone over christmas- the property and staff all gave a wonderful impression- the good was very over priced- we did enjoy the lunch and happy hour at the restaurant in the golf area- it has a smaller warm feel- rooms comfy- the spa services lovely but I think it needs an update in the locker rooms-we also enjoyed the classes offered- a bottle of champagne was left in our room for our daughters 22 birthday- very thoughtful-

reviews.author: DWtravelsalot
reviews.title: Great stay, will be back.
reviews.text:
Stayed in November with the whole family- booked a casita, which was quite spectacular in appointments, decor and size.  With an enormous living/dining room, giant terraces, separate master bedroom and two big baths Plus a full kitchen- perfect for our family of six.  With two kids on the pullout and a couple of rollaways (the room could have fit 10 of them), we still had tons of space to relax and spread out.  

The waterslide was a bit slow for the kids but they didnt seem to mind.  The many pools are beautiful, plenty of quiet spaces if needed.  The property is high end, but not snobby- they were welcoming of kids and had activities for them.  Breakfast buffet on the deck in the main building was beautiful.  Great service tops it all off.  We look forward to staying again.

reviews.author: ANN S
reviews.title: Rough start but GREAT ending
reviews.text: Upon arrival we had some bumps.  I had EXPRESSLY booked 2 rooms in a certain area, been guaranteed by email twice that all was set BUT when we got there, it wasn't all set.  After almost an hour and a half, we got it straight. (Thank you Scott Pate!)  I will say that their resolution turned out to be better then what I had originally booked too!  The grounds are beautiful- the villa we were put in was DELIGHTFUL (will book that next time we go.....and we will go back!) What I was most impressed by though was the service level of the entire resort.  From the restaurants, to the front door guys this is a VERY service oriented place.  The tennis facilities are wonderful.  The spa was WONDERFUL....didn't go golfing BUT it looked wonderful too!  Again, the service level is what blew me away the most- the location is great as well- close to airport and to shopping-dining area BUT with spectacular views so you don't even feel like you are in town.  I just want to say thanks again to Scott (and the front desk clerks who worked with him) for turning the rough start into a SPECTACULAR finish for us!  See you again soon!

reviews.author: Anamika
reviews.title: great location and quite built up.
reviews.text:
We were here from 27th to after new years eve. Clearly very high season for this resort. Despite that, we didn't feel crowded in. Only time I regretted having a full resort was one evening when my family wanted to stay outside near the outdoor firepit. There are four large outside and they were all full. We settled for a room with a fabulous view, lobby live music seating instead. Not a bad compromise but nevertheless we would've preferred the former.

The resort is beautifully kept with clean pool, freshly stocked towels, large koi pond with hundred of fish that you can feed. My daughter thoroughly enjoyed doing this. there is a hiking trail about a mile and half from the property that is quite challenging but beautiful.

My only regret is that food prices are astronomical. Thankfully we rented a car and drove out for breakfast, lunch and dinner but usually we prefer to eat in the resort since we had little kids with us. The spa and gym are also nicely appointed. 

If you have kids keep in mind the resort is quite spread out so be prepared to walk a lot from one part to another. For instance, Relish a restaurant that is open for lunch is clear on the other side of the resort, whilst our room near the cactus garden were one small  lake, three pools, one elevator ride and a short  hike away. whew. I really felt those distances when my daughter forgot her swimming goggles or something she really needed.

reviews.author: Cally B
reviews.title: Lovely Holiday Stay
reviews.text: We checked-in at The Phoenician from Christmas Eve and left the following Saturday. This was our first time away from home/family for the holiday. The resort was decorated just enough for my taste, the smell of evergreen gently filled the lobby air. On Christmas eve Mrs. Claus was reading stories to the children and hot chocolate and decorated sugar cookies were layed out for all to enjoy. Turndown service on Christmas Eve consisted of cookies instead of the usually chocolates. We waited too long to book Christmas brunch and ended up eating off site. Our room was on the 3rd floor over-looking the pools, I agree with other reviewers, the higher the room the better. Room was spacious, bathroom was huge but had poor lighting and cold tile floors. We did have an issue with a lint-filled air vent in the closet, after two calls and cleanings the problem was resolved. However, I was suprised I was the first person to have complained, clearly the vent had been dirty for sometime. Rooms were extremly quite at night. The pool was lovely, but the air-temp was a bit too chilly for us to enjoy it. Instead we visited the huge hot tub, however had to bail several days due to it being over-run with unsupervised kiddos. The other travel compainions golfed and throughly enjoyed the experience. We ate at Il Terrazzo several times for breakfast, the buffet was very good. Ate at Relish once for lunch, good food, but the service was a bit spotty. Self-parking is free and super easy. I really appreciated having this option. The resort is conviently located, we went into Phoenix and Scottsdale quite often. Absolutely would return to The Phoenician.

reviews.author: travelgirl41643
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: We've been dying to try this place for awhile and it was worth the wait.  We had 4th floor rooms in the main building overlooking the pools.  (Note - I paid extra to guarantee connecting rooms, which I've never been charged for before, but did not have connecting rooms when we arrived.  My kids are older so this wasn't a big deal, but would have been with small children.  The check in agent did remove the charge and was very apologetic.)  The room seemed recently renovated, was ample sized with a spacious balcony.  The property was tastefully decorated for Christmas providing some lovely photo ops.  The pool area is beautiful with a restaurant/bar smack in the middle.  Drinks and food at the Oasis were delicious.  We utilized the gym, which was clean and had ample equipment, although the temperature was kept way too warm for a gym.  The spa had plenty of room to relax before/after services, spa, sauna, and I had a great massage from Steve.  The main dining room was very nice, food was very good, but one of my pet peeves is when a dining room is empty and the hostess tells you that she can seat you in a half hour because they are full.  That happened twice.  The lounge off the lobby had a great drink and appetizer offering and live music at night - Tony was a great bartender.  Waitress service in the lobby lounge was very slow.  The hotel was at capacity for football bowl games/New Years so I think they were slightly understaffed.  The waitress recognized this and sent a complimentary round of drinks - kudos for recovery.  There were lots of holiday activities going on and the activity director took us on a tour of the Cactus Garden, which was quite informative, and beautiful at night.  Concierges were spot on with their activity recommendations.  Would absolutely recommend this property and am certain the hiccups were related to the time of year.

reviews.author: Brandon M
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, I can't wait to go back for a longer stay
reviews.text:
I had a one night stay here to celebrate my anniversary and really enjoyed it.  This would have been a 5* review but there were a few small issues which dropped it down to 4*.

We used a suite night upgrade and were upgraded to a beutiful deluxe suite with an eastward view over the valley.  The room was a huge two room suite with two full bathrooms and two large patios with nice chairs, loungers, and table.  Some of the prior reviews complained about dated rooms, but ours was very nicely furnished.  

We were on the 5th floor so the view was nice.  I would strongly reccommend asking to stay on a higher floor because the lower floor rooms on our side were right on the roof line and their view would have been obscured by air conditioning vents, etc.

We loved the free self parking and I would highly reccommend that to anyone.   You can even drive your luggage up to the front and then go park the car.  Unless you love valet, there really is no reason to use it here.  The hotel was pretty busy and we never had to park further than a 1-2 minute walk from the elevators in a covered parking garage.

On the downside, checkin took 15-20 minutes becuase there were only 2 front desk agents and one of them was occupied with an angry guest for the entire time we were there.  I must commend the front desk agent for being so cordial.  The complaints we overheard were silly, but the front desk agent and the manager that eventually came over were very friendly the entire time.  That said, they should have called over another agent because there were several guests waiting to checkin.

We also chose the two continental breakfast vouchers as our platinum amenity which are good for Il Terrazo, but when we went down around 9:30 there was a 30 minute wait for breakfast.  We were in a hurry so we had to skip, but it would have been appreciated if the front desk agent had warned us about how busy breakfast was so we could have made reservations.  Usually hotel breakfasts are never crowded, but this was crazy.  If you're staying in high season, definitely make reservations if you plan on eating breakfast and don't want to wait.

All in all, we had a good stay and I would definitely come back.  The grounds were very well maintained and we loved the room decor.  Hopefully we can stay longer next time to spend more time at the pools, etc.

reviews.author: lgppres
reviews.title: Most Elegant  and  Beautiful
reviews.text:
beautiful  well maintained  spacious rooms ,  gym with  good  equipment(  could use more),   good choice of  restaurants,the  layers of pools on three levels  remind me of a layer  cake  and  an adults only  pool was a  nice  touch
Having a  drink  on   lobby terrace while sun  goes down  is just  seeing the beauty of  what god  has  wrought
A  place  to  return

reviews.author: Claudine D
reviews.title: oasis dans le désert
reviews.text: bel hôtel et magnifiques jardins, séjour d'une semaine dans un cadre professionnel en 2009, qualité des buffets, bel espace fitness et qualité de soins du SPA. trés bon souvenir des excursions organisées alentour, rafting sur Rio Verde, balade à cheval dans le désert, visite d'un ranch, survol du grand canyon

reviews.author: Brett321
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: All aspects of our stay exceeded our expectation. I especially enjoyed taking golf lessons from Mike Lamana, head of their instruction. My family and I had an unbelievably good time here. Headed back again next year for sure.

reviews.author: Michael B
reviews.title: A very nice place to stay...
reviews.text: This is the second time in three years I have stayed at the Phoenician. The facility and grounds are beautiful, the restaurants are very good with varied selection. Personnel is excellent. My only issue is that the rooms are dated. Definitely in need of a facelift, although the room was immaculately clean and the spacious shower did not disappoint.

reviews.author: hrdirsteins
reviews.title: Very Relaxing and Family Oriented
reviews.text: My daughter and I recently stayed at the Phoenician for the 3rd time.  It is such a beautiful property.  The rooms are extremely comfortable, the staff was very helpful, and we love the pool.  It is a great place to stay for all types of occasions, but both of my teenage kids loved it.

reviews.author: CoolAZMom
reviews.title: Ultimate luxury
reviews.text:
I have dined at the Phoenician many times in the past and was always been impressed by the food, opulent dining rooms and service. However, I had never stayed overnight until recently. This is a gorgeous property and the rooms are large, beautifully appointed and lack nothing in terms of amenities (Keurig coffee maker, jacuzzi tub, top of the line toiletries). The pillow top beds are remarkably comfortable and my husband and I had one of our best night sleeps in months. Also, I highly recommend a massage at the spa... although the prices are steep, the masseuses are skilled. 

The location of the Phoenician is also convenient: tucked far enough off Camelback Road in the shadow of Camelback Mountain to feel private and secluded, but still close to Phoenix Sky Harbor, Scottsdale Fashion Square (shopping mall) and fine dining. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: UALDutch
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but service needs a little tweak
reviews.text:
The hotel design is gorgeous. The grounds are well kept (who I wondered had pulled the short string and had to put the christmas lights around the many cacti?). The room was very spacious with a balcony overlooking the pool and a very active bunny. There were no pool noises but there were plenty of lawnmowers and assorted maintenance vehicle noises when outside. 
The food at the italian restaurant was great, although the selection was a bit weak. The brunch food was great. Both dinner and brunch puts a dent in your wallet. Wifi was free and worked good. 
Use selfpark after you check in. It is very convenient and much cheaper. 

In terms of the service, it seems that they try hard but just miss it:
The hotel made a mistake and we were assaulted with numerous phonecalls and visits to the room to clear up the mistake. The maids also come to clean and in the evening for "turndown." The checkin took a long time as there were only 2 people at the desk. The restaurant waiters had to be asked to fill water, get silverware, etc. They could be a lot better trained and more attentive (for that price :).

reviews.author: jennybobenny
reviews.title: all you expect and more
reviews.text: We travel frequently and are frequently dissapointed.  Not so at the Phoenician.  The quality of the room, grounds, restaurant and pools were top notch and so was the service.  I loved sitting by the many pools and having poolside food and drink service.  We stayed in one of the cassitas overlooking the pools and had the afternoon sun and sunset on our own little balcony.  My only issues was that the food is not all that healthy.

reviews.author: Sherry C
reviews.title: Reasonably priced luxury resort, fabulous stay
reviews.text:
While dining onsite can definitely put a burn mark in your wallet, the rack rate we paid for a large, sunrise facing room overlooking the pool was very competitive at just under $200 a night.  Definitely would be a $600 a night room in NYC or Miami (if they had one this large!)  After one night of $6.50 bottles of water, we shamelessly went to a local grocery and stocked up on our snacks and liquids.  No problem and not-so-much as a furrowed forehead or raised brow when we returned with bags in tow.  

The resort is beautiful, inside and out, including a wonderful little garden path and botanical guide on the north side of  the resort facing the mountain, orchids, stone and metal art throughout.  The shops off the lobby are very convenient, the professional tennis courts and swimming pools plentiful and well-maintained.  The spa was outstanding.  Plenty to take in and we slept like babies after our days in the sun. Great linens, comfortable beds.

Ask for a poolside or golf course (very limited number)  room on an upper floor if you are a light lover.  If you prefer the energy of the mountain and shade, you should enjoy the solace and tranquility on the north side with the mountain view.

Also, if you have a vehicle and are jaunting about Scottsdale and Phoenix, you can use the main entrance valet during the day (tipping as appropriate) for no valet charge.  Just move your vehicle into the self-park area yourself by 7-8 pm to avoid a pricey overnight valet parking fee.  This was policy in December 2012.  ;-)  We saved enough on the food and valet to pay for another great round of golf! 

Great conference location, with bonus Starwoods Points.

BTW, many thanks to the great reception, smiles and warm welcomes at the guard house.  Never, anywhere in the world have the "first faces" done such a fabulous job of welcoming us throughout the visit.  The front desk can learn from your examples!
(Adrian.. SMILE.... some of us are having FUN...)

reviews.author: killer_and_the_girl
reviews.title: Relish Bar and Beautiful Pools
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Phoenician for two nights and enjoyed the pools and Relish Bar.  There's around nine pools and the grounds were well maintained and beautiful.  Ate dinner and watched college football at the Relish Bar;  big size TV and excellent appetizers and service. Self park your car to avoid steep vallet parking fees.

The rooms are very large and clean.  Our room had a balcony, large modern bathroom, and comfortable bed.  The room decor could use an upgrade and is getting a little worn.  Downtown Scottsdale is about a 5 mile ( 5-10 minute) ride from the hotel.  We ate downtown at Olive and Ivy's (breakfast) and PF Changs (dinner).  Food at the hotel is somewhat expensive, but the downtown restaurants are close by and have ample parking.

Would reccomend this hotel to anyone visiting the Scottsdale area looking to golf, swim in pools, and relax at a clean beautiful resort.

reviews.author: CherylhHomerGlen_IL
reviews.title: Just Go Here!
reviews.text:
OK, this resort is an absolute must.  If you are looking for elegance and relaxation-this is the place for you.  They have a gorgeous golf course that my husband and his friend played and loved. They also have a large amount of professional tennis courts, that I wish I knew about.  I would have brought my gear.  They do rent everything, but it gets expensive to go that route.  They have I believe, 9 gorgeous pools.  We were lucky to have fantastic sunny weather for the first week of November.  The service at the pool is incredible.  I love that the staff gets along so well and helps each other out at every turn.  The staff at the pool I would like to acknowledge:
Hope, Blair, Brittany, Megan and Marcel.  All were very efficient and helpful to each other.  We were always able to get what we wanted at the pool. Get the nachos and guacamole, it is to die for!!  One thing I would recommend to the hotel, get some music at the pool.  Doesn't have to be loud and annoying-but something would be great.  We heard many people say this.   We had breakfast at the Il Terrazzo every morning.  Now here is where my most Fav employee comes in--Aleksander.  We LOVED him!!  Our first day there, we knew he was going to be our guy everyday.  He is just that ray of sunshine you need in the morning!  He has the absolute best sense of humor and is perfect for his job.  He went the extra nine yards to accommodate my annoying gluten and dairy intolerance and my love of grape jelly which is not normally there but was for me!  Oh, by the way-it is HUGE to me that I could have gluten free toast, or a bagel or a sandwich at this resort!!!!  BIG PLUS!!  Food in this restaurant is fantastic.  We also had a dinner there and we all unanimously agreed it was top notch.  The atmosphere was lovely too.  I love dim lights, table cloths and candles.  It makes for a romantic evening.  I thought this restaurant was absolutely superior in the quality of food to the "famous" steakhouse also in the resort.  Our room was very spacious and lovely.  We were checked in by Kelly, who was very sweet and made sure we got the best room we could based on availability.  We were very satisfied with our accommodations.  Loved the bath soaps and lotions.  Very spa-like!  Loved the evening turn down service with the chocolates, music and bottled water.  We had drinks a few nights in the lobby at the Thirsty camel.  We were kind of turned off the first 2 times by blonde server we had.  She did not have a good attitude, and I felt like we were bothering her just being there.  I will say we went back a third time and had Ashley, who works there part time.  She was the best!  We received wonderful, fast and pleasant service from her.  She is really in her element in this type of work!  She is Very much a people person.  My friend and I signed up for a Pilate's class at the fitness center.  We really liked it.  The class was taught by Grayson, who clearly is passionate about what she does.  She led the class and was very informative.  She made sure that we were using good form and understood what it was that we were doing.  Was worth going to!  There is a package you can purchase that is relatively inexpensive in which you can get all aspects of the fitness center and tennis courts daily.  We weren't going to do this everyday so we did ours ala carte.  If you are a fitness buff, I would definitely buy the package.  It includes the spa amenities, such as the steam room and hot tub, nice perk.  There are some lovely boutiques in the resort.  Items are very pricey, but everything is nicer and fun to look at.  Lastly, I want to mention that this is a great place to walk around and look at.  The grounds are so well kept and esthetically pleasing.  I would go back here in a heartbeat!  Please note that this is not a party place!  It is an upscale place to hang out and relax.  That is what we went for and that is what we got! We will definitely be back to this great resort!

reviews.author: fran1075
reviews.title: Wonderful 5 Star resort - can't wait to go back!
reviews.text: From your arrival at the gate through to check out, the staff can't help you enough.  The grounds are gorgeous and cover everything you could wish for.  We tried the spa and wellness centre and would recommend both.  We loved our visit and would love to return.

reviews.author: Oliver578
reviews.title: Beautiful Grounds
reviews.text:
The landscaping and grounds at the Phoenician are gorgeous! We visited over Thanksgiving and it was still warm enough mid-day to lay by the pools. We also golfed the Desert & Canyon courses which were amazing (especially Desert). Everyone at the golf course was extremely helpful and friendly. Relish, the restaurant by the golf course, served great burgers and salads (although a little pricey, but not more than expected for the resort). 

We were upgraded to a suite and loved the room because it had 3 balconies & beautiful views, but the decor is a bit dated so I could see how if you were in a smaller room it might be disappointing, but there are so many things to do at The Phoenician, you probably won't spend much time inside your room anyway. Overall, we loved it and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Sylvia Hotel Vancouver
reviews.title: worth the money
reviews.text: The course was in great shape, the staff were great, the pace of play was good until the last three holes. we played the desert and canyon course today, would like to play the oasis course next time. the course layout was alittle confusing for the driver of the cart, I thought the signage was fine

reviews.author: Brenton M
reviews.title: Platinum member review
reviews.text: This I the second time I have stayed at this property. On both trips I did not get a platinum member up grade. Their front desk was very helpful, service was also great. However, my platinum status earned our family an amazing view of the roof on both trips. It is a very clean roof and they made some type of design with the required wiring. Room service was great and the kids loved the 9 or so pools. They did wave the resort fee for our platinum membership.

reviews.author: adele08wall
reviews.title: A Desert Oasis
reviews.text: Everything about this resort proves to earn it's 5 star rating. The grounds are breathtaking and so well kept. I enjoyed waking up and watching the sunrise from our balcony overlooking the many pools with the mountains in the background. It was interesting to watch the resort wake up and how well the staff start to set up the grounds for the day. Rolled extra large towels on each lounge chair awake the guests. Poolside service was excellent and as soon as you sit down someone brings you a pitcher of icewater to keep you hydrated. Each pool offers a different view of the resort each one more relaxing than the next. We never wanted to leave so we usually ordered lunch from poolside service and was never disappointed with our selection.The cactus garden is itself amazing with 250 species of cacti. All staff were so friendly and accomodating. I would return in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Zanbenz
reviews.title: Excellence in every way
reviews.text:
I can't say enough about this property. Again, I get really scrambled and can babble on tangents forever if I don't make a list.

Positive-

1. The grounds - are GORGEOUS, it is after all a golf resort so expect the best. Everything from the cactus garden to the green is perfectly manicured.

2. Cleanliness - Can't stress this enough. CLEAN CLEAN CLEAN CLEAN. Our room was spotless and smelled fresh every time we walked in. The hotel itself is sparkling, and the grounds are as well. Honestly I wondered if they secretly have a cleaning crew following guests around with a mop and broom, because the whole place is spotless- even around the pools and outdoor areas.

3. The room - Is huge. It's larger than my room in my house, and quiet a bit cleaner haha. The bathroom had a separate soaking tub and shower with an enclosed room for the toilet. We were in a basic room, viewing Camelback Mountain and the cactus garden but it was beautiful. The best part of the room was the double sliding glass doors, they really open the room up. We turned the air off and opened the glass doors leaving the screen shut for the night, it was really quiet and pleasant. The balcony with chaise lounger and coffee table was excellent.

4. Room Amenities - Two closets, a minibar, coffee and tea facilities, huge bathroom with separate shower and soaking tub, extremely comfortable bed, large thin television with a decent amount of channels, balcony, affordable room service, writing desk. All awesome.

5. Resort amenities - Pools (LOTS), nice hot tub area -pretty quiet and secluded, self guided cactus garden around camelback mountain, easy parking, wifi etc included in the resort fee. Easy access and friendly valet, shops inside the resort, nice restaurant/s, and a cute little ice cream/candy parlor that has some easy breakfast items too. 

6. Staff - The friendliest staff. This is my number one, if a resorts staff treats it's guests like poo they shouldn't be in business. The front desk agent was more than friendly and helpful - from directions around the resort to random questions about our stay. A younger valet agent got snippy with my boyfriend and then apologized profusely for it and asking if we'd like an amenity sent to our room because he was confused (apparently our car didn't receive a valet parking paper upon entering the resort). While walking around the resort we were greeted multiple times by staff and some asked if we needed any assistance. Everyone had a smile on their face and were VERY FRIENDLY. A ++++

Negatives - 

1. Valet price - I can't really complain about this because it's not expensive compared to other cities (NYC $75 p/n) and really this is mine/my traveling companion's own fault. We didnt even check our valet ticket (which has the valet rate on it, $29 per night), we just went to our room and crashed since it was late. Anyhow, valet can get pricey pretty fast but they were excellent gentlemen. If you decide to self park it might seem like the garage is forever away but its right under the lobby area or close to it, so it's not bad! If you can afford the valet for your stay- I'd recommend it, if not no sweat!

Really would recommend this resort to anyone. It's fabulous, and we will definitely be back in the future.

reviews.author: jlu24
reviews.title: A weekend getaway
reviews.text: Just spent 3 wonderful nights and was not disappointed.  The service was excellent food delicious and the grounds were simply exquisite. Would recommend this hotel for a getaway.  Very classy and lovely stay!!!!

reviews.author: Trueblonde03
reviews.title: Nice place- beautiful grounds!
reviews.text: Unfortunately it was a little cool and cloudy during our stay- so we really didn't experience the pools. Food was excellent. Don't miss the chips, salsa, and guacamole! We were here for a business meeting- so no time for spa or golf. We had a very nice reception the night we arrived- with excellent food. The only real negative is that our room had a hallway with open air and tile floor. The staff runs carts up and down the hall all hours of the night. Make sure you don't get one of these rooms!

reviews.author: af77741514
reviews.title: Bad experience!
reviews.text: dont go here! Well, cleaner very rude and waiter very rude. also dont walk around golf area because you will get kicked off. Cleaner didnt want to let me in to my room even i was trying to knock on the door and than start to scream to let me in. Nothing happend and after she finally opened the door she was rude to me and asked me for my ID to get in! than she asked me about my name of my own ID! what she thinks she is FBI or something, than I had to go change my room key because of her....Just so so rude and I also called room service to clean two hours later I came back and she was there...

reviews.author: Raul S
reviews.title: Beautiful spot in the desert
reviews.text: Great Hotel, location, golf, conference rooms and swimming pool. The rooms are nice but nothing special. The service is first class. The surrounding grounds are immaculate. The Golf course is 1st rate.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Our Home Away From Home
reviews.text:
We like to visit Scottsdale in November when the weather is crystal clear and temperature runs in the low 80's in the day and back into the 60's at night.  Dry and comfortable.  

The Phoenician has been our choice since we first stayed there over 15 years ago and we keep returning, especially asking for a room facing the pool.

The facility, including the golf clubhouse and 3 courses, is perfectly maintained and beautiful.  Service is delivered with a smile and there are staff members everywhere ready to assist.  Poolside you are always greeted with a pitcher of ice cold water.  At the front desk registration is welcoming and easy.  Room service is good and the restaurant in the hotel is, by and large pretty good.   Even the engineering staff who came to replace a TV that wasn't working was pleasant to deal with.  Room clealiness can't be beat and the rooms are designed in a very attractive way and have the most comfortable hotel beds we've encountered anywhere.  Sunsets from the balcony overlooking the pool are sensational.

As to golf, the three courses -- Oasis, Canyon, and Desert -- which the staff mixes and matches for you every time you want to play 18 holes, are spectacular though difficult.  Built on the side of a mountain, you can find some interesting and challenging shots that either will always run down the mountain or are hit from so high up on the tee it's difficult to judge your distance.  The grass (if you're lucky to land on it) is soft and very easy to hit from

My only challenge with the Phoenician is pricing in the restaurant.  Yes, it is a high end resort and I expect to pay a premium rate.  However, for the prices on the menu I wasn't that impressed with the restaurant food.  Perhaps it was just my particular selection.

All in all, still our favorite home away from home and we're hoping to visit twice a year from now on.

reviews.author: Travelgirl421
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth!
reviews.text:
Went on a girls getaway to celebrate a birthday and it was the perfect choice! Like Suze says the staff SHINES!! Our room was huge and we loved all the restaurants and also enjoyed the spa!
The only problem i felt was the transportation that they had selected was way too expensive.

reviews.author: Karenmagicaltravler
reviews.title: Staff Shines
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here from Nov 3-10 the weather was perfect!  The property is beautiful and sprawling, we never had trouble finding a lounge chair by the pool and were always greeted within minutes by a staff member bringing us a pitcher of ice water. The chips, salsa and guacamole are delish!  Relish is not to be missed for an incredible burger.  I would split it with someone, it is huge!! Happy Hour on Thursday's at J&G was our favorite, live Jazz and very reasonable priced wine at $6 a glass. Service was perfect.  I forgot his name that waited on us, dark hair and very kind!  The pools are very nice and are kept clean and lot's of places to find a quiet place if that is what you are after.  Yes people talk on their phones at the pools and we find it to be so annoying, but we just moved. We enjoyed the hot tub in the evenings and loved how large it is!  We only wish children were strickly not allowed in it. It would be nice if it was adults only. Our room faced Camel Back Mountain, we actually preferred this view and liked how quiet the location was. We could see the cactus garden below which is beautiful. Yes, it was a walk to the pools but the excercise was welcomed by us.  We hiked the mountain twice and highly reccomend everyone do it.  Be sure to bring bottles of water with you! We loved going to SOL at Scottsdale Quarters, it is a very nice restaraunt and we would highly reccomend it. Try the "taste" of soup for $2.50 so good!!! Some stand out staff members at the Phoenician are Lucy at the spa and Spa Manager Lori, they both provided excellent service and have very compassionate hearts, they are the stars at the Spa.  A very special thank you to Shant, he is one of the most professional, kind, engaging and expert of customer service we have ever had the pleasure of meeting.  He made us feel cared for in a way that I wish everyone could experience.  His efforts and kindness made such an impression on us that I know we will look back on this trip with fond memories for a life time. Management is lucky to have him on staff! We would stay here again in a heart beat, overall for an upscale resort we found the staff to be delightful, approachable and always willing to help. Thank you for a great week.  Blessings-The Wrights

reviews.author: suze_shoes
reviews.title: Fabulous Phoenician!
reviews.text: Enjoyed a haven from the hurricane while here on business last week!  Was able to tour the meeting facilities, use the fitness center and eat at several of the on site restaurants.  From both a business and leisure perspective, this is a lovely property!  Courteous, kind staff who are always ready to assist.

reviews.author: PhoenixFF
reviews.title: Excellent Short stay!
reviews.text:
Stayed one night at this resort. We have stayed several times before. The grounds are beautiful and the service is excellent.
Good dinner at J&G steakhouse. The rooms are getting a bit dated but overall this is an excellent place.

reviews.author: ContestWinner
reviews.title: Beautiful Grounds and Hotel
reviews.text:
I stayed at The Phoenician in Scottsdale for a business conference. My room was in one of the casitas on the other side of the pools from the main hotel. It was nice and secluded, but it was a 5-10 minute walk to the conference rooms.

The whole property was clean and luxurious, the food was good, and the staff was very friendly, even the security people roaming the grounds.

Unfortunately, since I was there on business and my entire day was planned for me, I could not take advantage of the pools, which looked really nice, or any of the spa services.

The conference organizers got a great rate, but the normal rate is way too high.

reviews.author: ivypivy
reviews.title: Conference Hotel with Splash just bring lots of cash
reviews.text: Large and sprawling it has something for everyone . Expensive everything.  Coffee is $6.50 a cup. But the gardens, golf course, hills and red mountains are spectacular.  Ask for a room facing the mountain - it may be a little dark but its glorious.

reviews.author: Mnree7
reviews.title: Treat yourself to this paradise
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician over a 3 day weekend towards the end of October, and were looking for a relaxing time to unwind. This is exactly what we found. The grounds are absolutely gorgeous and the pool(s) are second to none.  We only discovered the enormous hot tub on the last day because it is separate from the pool, but wish we had sooner- be sure to find it!
There is an outdoor deck area off the lobby that has plenty of seating and firepits where you can have a drink (loved the bellinis), eat, and watch the sunset. We had a suite which was huge and beautifully decorated. I recommend the onsite restaurant Il Terrazzo. We went there for my husband's birthday and the food was excellent. We also tried Relish, which is in the golf club house and overlooks the golf course- very good too.
I also tried out the spa facilities which are well worth the price. Overall, a top notch resort with stunning views/amenities and well above average service.

reviews.author: David J
reviews.title: Just Perfect
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Phoenician from Oct. 28 to the 31st and we must say that this is one of the most luxurious resorts in the Phoenix area. Service was top notch throughout the entire stay. The golf course was amazing and the pool area(s) were awesome.  Our room was very large with an oversized bathroom and a good sized balcony.  The bed was extremely comfortable and I just couldn't find any faults with the room.  

With family members living in the metro area, we invited everyone for Sunday brunch at il Terrazzo and the food, ambiance and service were excellent. The price was fairly reasonable as well.  We really enjoyed the easy access to the hiking trail that ascends Cammelback Mountain.  

Old town Scottsdale and the Fashion Mall is a short distance away and if you don't want to walk over there then a fleet of house limo's are ready to go.  The cost was only $14 for the quick trip over compared to about $11 for a cab.  The hotel does not allow cab companies to line up on their property so instead of waiting for a cab to be called by the valet staff, it's best to just take a house car.  I always found cabs to be a bit sketchy in the Scottsdale area and on Sunday night we hailed a cab to go back to the hotel and the driver has never even heard of the Phoenician!! We had to give him directions, even know it's right off of Cammelback Road.  Thought that was quite weird!!  

You can't go wrong with this resort and we highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Turbostang
reviews.title: Beautiful, excellent service
reviews.text: A must stay.... you deserve it!! This resort is an excellent option for a romantic get away. The grounds are well maintained and beautiful. The service was top notch. It's very close to the fashion square mall. It 's not cheap! Two well drinks and 2 glasses of the house red wine was $65. The Relish Burger has great burgers and other items. The BLT Burger is awesome. IL Terazzo has a great menu. I will stay again. There are several activities  (tennis, golf, hiking, and other kid activities)nearby or on property. Watch out for the rattle snakes on the golf course

reviews.author: Scout11258
reviews.title: Relaxing and Luxurious
reviews.text: From the moment we stepped into the lobby we knew we were going to love this place. First the customer service is the best we have encountered in years. Our room, a suite on the fourth floor, was stunningly beautiful and bigger than most city apartments. There were two balconies, one off the living area and one off the bedroom. Both had a wonderful view of the pool area and areas to comfortably sit and relax. The pool area was a big hit. There are separate areas for adults and children. You are greeted by staff with fresh towels and a pitcher of ice water. There is also flavored water ( orange or cucumber or lemon, etc) close by in help your self containers. We ordered lunch pool side and basically relax there for most of the day. We did get up and got refreshed by going down the water slide a few times and enjoyed a warm soak in the jacuzzi/hot tub area. We didn't golf this trip but my husband has played here before and found the course to be challenging yet fun. The grounds are well kept and the shops are fun to poke into. Plus the resort is only minutes away from Old Scottsdale, Fashion Square, and plenty of golf courses and casinos. Surprisingly, the cost for a suite wasn 't any more than you would pay for an average hotel room in a big city. Great value, great customer service and a relaxed environment.

reviews.author: Seychelle77
reviews.title: nice grounds & golf but not much else
reviews.text: Been to the scottsdale area many times and the phoenician was and is one of our favorite places for a round of golf so we thought we would give the hotel a try. We still enjoyed the golf but the hotel and room were sub par. The room may as well of been from 1984 and maybe cleaned in 1990 from the carpet stains and stains on the furniture. The dead cockroach and old bread on the balcony was a nice touch....making the 350 we were paying a night a steal. My advise if you are visiting the scottsdale area....stop by for the golf but stay far away from the hotel until they update and hire a cleaning crew.

reviews.author: Utravelwithme
reviews.title: Totally Agree
reviews.text: with some of the other reviewers - I too especially enjoyed the pool area - fantastic service - and so peaceful and quiet - gardener does a great job with the grounds - will make this a place to come back again and again.

reviews.author: Heather W
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.text: This was our second stay at the Phoenician and, again, it was great! We can not think of one encounter with any staff member that was anything less than friendly and professional. Pool was beautiful and relaxing, lawn bowling was good for some unexpected fun, the room was quiet and the bed was very comfortable. We used our SPG points for our stay and we were given a beautiful room. Some hotel "loyalty" programs are a bit of a rip-off (limited number of rooms, blackout dates, etc.) but the SPG program is fantastic.  Really, the customer service was excellent - we will return!

reviews.author: Experiencedtrav07
reviews.title: Always awesome
reviews.text: The Phoenician is the premier resort in Phoenix.  We've stayed here several times for an adult "staycation".  We love the pool with the small pearl tiles and the service we recieve.  The food and bars in and around the resort are always top notch.  The rooms are always quiet and very well appointed!

reviews.author: CraigsOrganizer
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Just returned home from the most amazing girls' weekend at this resort. The grounds are beautiful, the service was exceptional, the room was spacious and clean-- my only complaint is that we couldn't stay longer.  The spa services are pretty pricey; but, we all agreed worth it.  (not crazy about the showers in the locker room though; the stalls are poorly lit and I couldn't get a consistent water tempurature)  Other highlights: the talented guitar player in the lobby lounge every night for a free concert and the morning yoga class.  Our server at the pool told us that March gets pretty crazy-- they apparently add 700 additional chairs and people still have to get there early to find a seat.  Not sure I would love it as much if the resort were that packed; this time of year seemed perfect on all fronts.

reviews.author: travelgirl6877
reviews.title: Gorgeous, Calm resort
reviews.text: I am a loyal SPG Gold member and went for a girls weekend. It was wonderful! The rooms are tastefully decorated with fantastic bedding. The service was spectacular. Jarrod at the pool was great and we enjoyed meeting the staff at Relish (which had amazing food as well). We took advantage of the spa.. treatments were outstanding. Maggie gave me a phenominal facial. She was so nice and probably the best aesthetician I have ever met with. The Phoenician is a great spot for a relaxing weekend. There's not too, too much activity, but that's what we wanted. We hiked Camelback and relaxed poolside during the day. Downtown Scottsdale isn't far and that's where the action is.

reviews.author: phxtravelguy
reviews.title: STILL an amazing place to stay...
reviews.text: I recently did a Stay-cation here with some friends.  We live in Phoenix, but wanted to treat ourselves to a ncie room and some good pool time.  We had an amazing time.  The rooms are gorgeous!  I don't know whent he last remodel was... but they are sharp, well decorated, clean and current.  Really liked it.  We got a suite and enjoyed the extra space.  The pool is still one of the top 3 in the Valley. what a great place to chill and take in the sights of Camelback Mtn and the crowd.  Great attentive service!  Love this place.

reviews.author: SRfromNY
reviews.title: Lovely Place
reviews.text:
I recently spent a week at The Phoenician on a business trip. My room was very comfortable, a great bed, spacious bathroom with the nice touch of a vanity stool so you can sit to blowdry your hair, comfortable seating options on the balcony,Keuring coffee maker (with room in the minibar for fresh milk which you can buy at the cafe). My view was very mundane- looking over a ballroom rooftop and straight at another wing of the hotel , so if you want a great view be sure to request it. 
Special shout out to the folks at room service who were spot on time with 4:30AM pre-orders.
The property is very attractive, lovely pools and greenery. 
Steak dinner at JG Steakhouse was excellent and pricey - all the dining options are pretty expensive. The Ice Cream Parlor and Cafe staff were great (thanks Shant) and it is an excellent lunchtime option for salads and sandwiches. Relish Burger Bistro was fun - everyone loved their version of tater tots. We also enjoyed evening drinks on the main terrace overlooking the pools.
The hotel staff are uniformly pleasant and helpful and I was thanked for staying by several different employees all week.

reviews.author: Alena
reviews.title: Super beautiful hotel!
reviews.text: We loved the beds, food and amazing rooms here at the Phoenician. It was a really wonderful stay and experience! The little breakfast and ice cream shop was awesome! The staff - not the most friendly, but the hotel and amenities more than compensated for some curt comments by some staff.

reviews.author: Exoticsense
reviews.title: Still a magnificient resort
reviews.text:
In spite of new resorts which were built around camleback mountain, Phoenician has remained  as a remarkable resort in Arizona. 
Staff: Friendly and professional
Room; There have been wide varieties of teh room depending on where they are located. All were big in size, specially  impressive bathrooms.
