reviews.author: sginmd
reviews.title: Beautiful property in Scottsdale!!
reviews.text:
I really loved the Phoenician and will absolutely visit again.  Gorgeous sprawling property, rooms are huge.  The pool was great, restaurant by the pool was also very nice.  Restaurant on the property was great for breakfast.  It didn't seem very crowded when we visited so it was very quiet, which just made you feel relaxed.  Not sure if it would be the same in the winter when its busier.  
Valet is $29 a night.  Self-park is super convenient and free - I would recommend that!!

reviews.author: FranE448
reviews.title: Exquisite service, Beautiful accomodations and great location!
reviews.text:
We spent much of the last month at this wonderful hotel and can only rave about the Excellent service, fine accomodations and wonderfully convenient location.

Every part of our stay was fabulous - from the Reservations (thank you, Deniz), to the Concierge, (many thanks, Michelle), and the perfect Housekeeping staff, too many to mention.

This historic hotel is not the "flashiest" or the newest, but it is quite simply the very best hotel we have ever stayed in, in any country in the world.

Can't wait until we travel to Phoenix again!

reviews.author: Mike F
reviews.title: My Be the Best Resort I Ever Stayed At
reviews.text: From the moment my wife and I arrived we were inpressed with the service.  We were upgraded at a cost of $10 a night to a very spacious room that had everything a suite would have except a wall betwen the bedroom and living roon.  Upon check in I asked for a refrigerator and a coffee maker.  They were delivered in less than 30 minutes.  Everything at the hotel was very well maintained.  The pool area had plenty of lounges available all day long, many in the shade.  There was no need to run down early in the morning to reserve a lounge chair.  The food was a bit expensive but worth it.  We ate in botht the Il Terrazo and the J&G Steakhouse, actually enjoyed Il Terrazo more.  The concierge  service was excellent ,Michelle, Michelle, Jacque, and Beverly were very helpful and made some great suggestions for dinner at nearby restaurants as well as for a few day trips.  I played golf twice during the week, the course was very well maintained and again the service was very good.   Room service was very prompt, They told you when they would arrive, and they were on time or early in the both times we ordered from them.  Valet parking personnel were very helpful and offered water, They also had the car waiting for us in every case when we called down for them to bring the car around.   My wife went to the hair salon and had nothing but good things to say about the service and results.  We had a great time.

reviews.author: onamountaintop
reviews.title: Totally enjoyed our stay!
reviews.text:
Our group of five great friends spent four nights at the Phoenician and were extremely happy with our experiences there.  The property is beautifully manicured and has breathtaking views.  We encountered great service in all areas of the resort.  I requested housekeeping to remove the duvet and down comforter and replace my bed linens with American Style linens (a sheet and blanket).  When I arrived back into my room later in the day following my request, one of the housekeepers came to make sure my bed was dressed as requested.  Each night, the turn down service supplied multiple bottles of water, chocolates and resupplied the bathroom.  I enjoyed room service on serveral occasions and was pleased with the quality and quantity of their offerings.  Several meals were taken in the resorts restaurants and poolside and were also enjoyable. Cocktails were overpriced in the resort's restaurants with a call brand gin martini costing $16 and their speciality house drinks costing $16 to $17 per drink.

Special thanks go to Anthony in the bell services area.  Our group of five asked for transportation to Old Town for a shopping excursion.  Anthony whisked us away in the resort's Mercedes R350 and gave us a fabulous tour of homes on our way.  He was great fun and added a special touch to our day.

reviews.author: bobk1717
reviews.title: Outstanding Again!
reviews.text:
My second visit this year....excellent room, very customer focused staff, and outstanding facility.

Dined in Relish, J&G, and Oasis pool cafe...all were excellent.

Received nice room upgrade.

Not cheap by any means, but they deliver on quality, value, and overall impact.

Str

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Tired. And Living Off A Fast Fading Reputation.....
reviews.text:
I don't have a history of writing poor review's, but this trip warrants one.

I recently finished a business trip to The Phoenician and was surprised to see how the level of excellence that the property was renowned for - and that I have visited roughly 5 times in the last 10 years - has disappeared.  

I had a forward facing pool view room that was not well prepared by housekeeping on arrival in room (the used rubber glove on the floor of the bathroom was an unwelcome gift, as was trash cans with stuff still in them...)

The 5th floor "steakhouse" was OK at best as it releted to my food. Unfortunately, my two business companions chose fish, which left largely uneaten and the comments were poor.   The restaurant on the lower level was less than OK and had issues including hot food served cold and slow service. There were a variety of maintenance items that seemed to reflect poor attention to basic detail and the internet service (which comes with a hefty daily charge) is hopeless.  The golf course is in poor condition due to less than needed maintenance and a variety of the classic value-added services that the hotel once stood for have disappeared.  As one employee told me:  "We've cut back on a lot of things because of the economy". That's easy to see - and not near good enough at the hefty prices that The Phoenician charges.

It's hard to live off a reputation unless you live up to it, and The Phoenician's reputation is fading fast.

reviews.author: brownbrown99
reviews.title: Dirty rooms, cockroaches, beautiful everywhere else - will not return.
reviews.text: We had to switch rooms 3 times upon arrival.  The first room they gave us was so far from the lobby that it didn't make sense with a toddler.  It would have taken us forever every time we wanted to leave the room.  So they gave us a room on the bottom floor, closer to the lobby.  The floor to ceiling windows/patio doors barely let in any light because we were more than half way underground.  There were pieces of trash on the floor which my toddler proceeded to pick up and hand to me.  Then we saw a cockroach in the corner which was the last straw.  I called front desk to have someone come get it, not only was the lady rude on the phone but didn't make it sound like a big deal - apparently it happens all the time.  I had to switch to a higher floor.  The third room was clean enough, at least we didn't see any bugs.  The crib sheet they gave us had nasty stains on it (see picture).  It's not like they gave us the sheet folded up to put on ourselves so they didn't notice the stains.  They had put the sheet on the crib and then rolled the crib into our room!  So whoever did it couldn't have cared less about giving us a clean sheet for our baby!  Basically all three rooms we saw were FAR from luxurious, housekeeping doesn't do even a DECENT job of cleaning, the carpets in the hallways going to the rooms were nasty (see picture, it looks even worse in person).  But the rest of the resort - lobby, restaurants, pools, all the common areas were gorgeous.  The hotel staff can enjoy and work in a beautiful resort, but their guests have to sleep with the bugs.

reviews.author: lizaroo
reviews.title: Great resort, will be back
reviews.text:
Visited this hotel just after the September long weekend. Received upgrade based on Starwood status. Spacious and clean room, good spa, great service from all staff. Overpriced but tasty food, which is par for the course with Starwood.

Pools were clean, grounds well maintained, and plenty of lounge chairs available.  The +40 degree weather was too hot for me so would return at a different time of year.

Rooms were slightly dated but clean and very spacious. The bathroom was huge. Will definately return to this hotel.

reviews.author: CHaslund
reviews.title: Best Concierge Ever
reviews.text: Jacque was a huge help.  She helped me plan a hike and a night out dancing a couple of weeks prior to my arrival and then suggested a fabulous restaurant while I was on site.  She made reservations, revised them when the number in our party changed, and made transportation arrangements.  All part of her job, I know, but she did it with expertise and such a fabulous demeanor.  She really wanted to us to have a great time.  She was very knowledgeable, giving me several options for each activity with high energy and a great smile.  Wanted to take her home with me!

reviews.author: EmmaKatesmom
reviews.title: Great Property, great location, great value
reviews.text:
I stayed here several years ago and it is still one of my most memorable vacations. I'm not from the west, so it was an experience. Hot is an understatement, but there are several very relaxing pools to choose from here. Great pool bars and servers. The on site dining was pretty good too, although, I'd recommend venturing into town for most dining. 
The rooms were great and cleaned often. We were upgraded to a HUGE suite. 3 rooms and 2 bathrooms with 2 balconies overlooking the pool--who could ask for more? 
I want to go back :(

reviews.author: DCTvlr
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text: Enjoyed a 3 night stay at the Phoenician in September. Was traveling with my sister who wanted a nice resort with pools. And the Phoenician provides that! Lots of pools. One tiled in Mother of Pearl. Waterfalls, tiny lakes, streams, Koi pond. Very nice landscaping.  Enjoyed lots of time down at the pool. They are constantly bringing you pitchers of ice cold water.  We also ordered food and drinks poolside.  The rooms are very nice too. We had a basic room facing the cactus garden and Camelback Mountain.  The rooms are large (approx. 600 sqft) with big bathroom, large balcony and comfortable beds.  The resort is big...about 200 acres...so it's a bit of a walk from our room to the pool, which didn't bother me, and it's good exercise.   :)

reviews.author: ray954
reviews.title: best vacation spot ever
reviews.text:
We will be there again, shortly with the whole family. 
emorable in every respect. Hospitality Ritz-carleton style 7+ star really.

reviews.author: Frank C
reviews.title: A Mixed Review
reviews.text:
Altho the staff throughout the hotel were very friendly the management and philosophy of the owners was the worst.  They were 40 to 50% occupied.  We couldn't get an upgrade even if we paid extra.  We couldn't get a mountain view.They said there were booked. Their prices were horrendous. $4. for  a cup
of coffee in a cheap take out place.They couldn't make coffee accessible in the morning. Since they didn't accommodate me on anything I would never ever stay there again.  It was the worst experience at a hotel/resort we have had.
Frank

reviews.author: palapagals
reviews.title: OUTSTANDING
reviews.text: All I can say this was a marvelous experience and the next time I visit the stay will be longer.  The grounds are beautiful.  Our room was on the 4th floor overlooking the pools (many) and the mountains which was very clean with comfy beds.  The afternoon tea is a MUST with the endless champagne.  The servers at the tea were efficient and entertaining.  The presentation of the tea sandwhiches, great and delicious.  Desserts to die for.  We actually were too full to eat these and they glady boxed one of each to go.  This is an expeeience no one should miss,  You feel very pampered. Cannot wait to return!!

reviews.author: JS
reviews.title: beautiful setting
reviews.text: Stayed here for one night on the way to Hawaii. The setting is gorgeous--mountains, cacti, palm trees. Room is big, clean, traditional and MUCH nicer than the Ritz Carlton in town (where I stayed on a previous trip to Hawaii.) Bathroom was huge, marble, separate shower. Food in the restaurant was wonderful, service at the pool area was great. Brought me a cold towel, pitcher of water and often asked if I needed anything. Hallways are pretty dark, and hotel is a little dated in decor. Otherwise a 5 star.

reviews.author: Libby25
reviews.title: Excellent Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician for one night (our wedding anniversary) in a grand deluxe room. The room was very comfortable, with a good-sized bathroom, and had a nice balcony overlooking the pool. The hotel grounds are beautiful – pools, gym, golf courses. It’s a massive place, but as we stayed on a weekday in August, it was pretty empty and at times it almost felt like we had this huge place to our selves. The service was absolutely excellent at all times. We had breakfast and lunch at Il Terrazzo and can truly recommend it. The restaurant staff was very attentive and the food was very good. Another plus (one of the reasons we chose this particular hotel) is that it is very close to the airport, which makes it an excellent choice for anyone that (like us) has to catch a flight.

All in all, I would definitely recommend this hotel. However, it is massive and I can imagine it gets a little overwhelming when full. We stayed in August, which (if you can stand the Arizona heat) is a great time of the year as the prices drop and it is quite empty.

reviews.author: lhaganmich
reviews.title: High Quality of Service, Well Maintained Hotel, Pleasant staff
reviews.text: We stayed here two separate nights. Our first night, our room was near the cactus garden. The room was spacious. The bathroom was huge. I liked how the shower was separate from the bath and the toilet was in its own room. In addition, the room came with a variety of magazines to read other than the standard "where" magazine. The second time we stayed here during our week in Arizona, we got a larger room that was in the main part of the hotel. The room was set up the same way but much larger. Our second room overlooked the pool. The hotel was very nice. However, our first room had a giant cockroach near the couch. It was dead, but still! The pools were nice and I especially liked how the pool attendants would bring you fresh towels and cool water.

reviews.author: familyw5
reviews.title: Amazing Desert Oasis
reviews.text: This was a family leisure weekend at the Phoenician and it was perfect.  The room was huge and the amenties were top notch.  The 7 pools entertained the kids all day and my husband and I enjoyed the lounge in the lobby for cocktails.

reviews.author: TVenturi
reviews.title: Gorgeous property in excellent location.
reviews.text:
Spent Labor Day at the Phoenician on a last minute get away.  It's just as I remember... lovely grounds, friendly people, and great service.

The room we had was in their cheapest category and it was oversized and plush - nothing cheap about it.  The linens, towels, and toiletries were all of high quality. The free coffee in the restaurant was a nice touch. 

We had such an action packed schedule of activities in Scottsdale that we didn't have the opportunity to dine at the Phoenician.

reviews.author: Patty O'Lantern
reviews.title: Interesting site once you get used to it
reviews.text:
Having previously stayed at the Gainey Ranch and Desert Ridge I was accustomed to the lobby and bar area leading out to a central courtyard with pools etc. The Phoenician is different with tiered pools and a more modest lobby area. The "Relish" restaurant in the golf course clubhouse was awesome with some of the most exotic burgers I've ever seen and the largest collection of tequilas in Arizona. The steak house on site left me flat, but I admit to viewing steak houses in general as uninteresting food destinations.
Great hospitality from all staff as is the norm for 5 star hotels.

reviews.author: AngelaS233
reviews.title: Beautiful property and wonderful staff
reviews.text: The grounds of the Phoenician are gorgeous and so well taken care of. The cactus garden is a great place to take a walk and the kids loved trying to find all the lizards in the morning. Everyone is friendly and helpful. From James, the greeter, to bell staff, like Marcus, to front desk staff, like Sara to pool and housekeeping. What a wonderful weekend and we will definately be back.

reviews.author: Jan D
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Stayed here for 1 week and it is an excellent hotel that provides high quality service. There is attention to detail, and all of the staff we encountered were outstanding. Food and alcohol are expensive but that is to be expected at a 5 star resort. If you venture into Scottsdale there are some decent places to eat- the Rusty Spur being one of them- this is authentic and good value for money but they don’t serve evening meals- live music is on throughout the day- certainly worth a visit.

reviews.author: Denise H
reviews.title: COCKROACHES!!!!!
reviews.text: This is supposed to be the nicest hotel Arizona has... I spent one night with no problem..but the second night as I entered the bathroom, I was met by a cockroach the size of a toy chihauhua puppy. All that was missing was a bling collar. It proceeded to charge toward me. I had to jump over it, locked myself in the toilet room and called for help. They sent a woman with a towel instead of a nine iron or shotgun....  They asked if I wanted to switch rooms and expained they "come up through the plumbing"...well...gosh, golly...thank you but no. I had them get me a car that I had to pay for and spent from 10pm to 6am in the airport on a bench seat....but...at least nothing could crawl on me while I was sleeping. The staff is VERY nice and the food is excellent...but by no means is this a five star hotel. It's just the biggest. That's it.

reviews.author: rperls
reviews.title: It could have been better
reviews.text: We have had a mixed experience with this hotel.  It is very convenient so we tend to return but we have found that the rooms have not been  very clean.  This trip we arrived very late and were place in a room very far away even through there were few people at the hotel.  The sheets were dirty and had to be changed.  I mentioned it to the front desk and no one said a thing.

reviews.author: FrankP62
reviews.title: Superb Hotel fantastic staff
reviews.text: We recently returned  from a fatastic stay at The Phoenician .We stayed at a Villa in the resedencies complete with our own pool which was first class. The staff on site are superb from the bell boys who couldnt do enough for you , to the bar staff at Il Terrazzo and the Club House where we had many an enjoyable cocktail and conversation. The food at Il Terrezzo is also excellent with great service.Pride of place goes to a fantastic reservations team and in particular Deinz Bayramoglu who looked after us superbly before and throughout our stay.Nothing was too much for him to do and he will be a significant reason why we will return next year.Great Resort great staff and obviously  first class management

reviews.author: sjg6
reviews.title: Excellent Family Time!
reviews.text: Excellent! Excellent! From the check (painless, accomodated 3 rooms close together), to the restaurants (very good & wonderful staff). All the guys golfed, some for first time. For the seasoned golfers, the course was exceptional, for the novice the servcie was so fun. Loved the citrus cool towels. The ladies enjoyed the spa, 1 for the first time, and the staff was sooo patient with explanations of treatments. The spa area is nice.  We had a cabana at the pool, and Sam our attendant was EXCEPTIONAL!  We also had two toddlers w/us and everyone was accomodating to their needs as well as the parents. This was the end of a two part trip and everyone agreed it was the best part. We will be back. :)

reviews.author: EES_75
reviews.title: Loved the Phoenician
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Phoenician for four nights back in late October for a mini-vacation.  We enjoyed it a lot. The pool is beautiful and weather in Scottsdale that weekend was lovely -sunny and in the low 80s.  We had a very relaxing time at the pool.  

Our room was very nice, spacious with a beautiful bathroom, although we were not totally pleased with the view.  It was in the Deluxe category, part of the large hotel wing, and I think was considered a "garden view" room.  It basically backed up into Camelback Mountain and had a small view of the cactus garden behind the hotel.  But I don't think there are many rooms with great views at this resort.  If you are booking, I would discuss your location with the reservations staff. Many of the rooms are closer to the pool or golf course.  

We hiked Camelback, spent a lot of time at the pool, and drove to Sedona one day.  I also went to the Joya spa at the Intercontinental, which was offering excellent weekday rates at that time. It was heavenly.  I didn't go to the spa at the Phoenician but it looked nice.

reviews.author: Richard H
reviews.title: Absolutely Perfect
reviews.text:
My family (which numbers at seven) had an absolutely wonderful and fun time at the Phoenician.  All of the service was impeccable, and all our needs were taken care of swiftly and professionally.  There are so many wonderful people who helped make this an absolutely perfect stay, but here are the ones I remember: at the concierge desk, Michelle, Michele, Gary, and Beverly; Jared of the pool waitstaff, who really went the extra mile every lunch time; Manager Bill and service members Brian, Karen, and Michael at the restaurant Il Terrazzo; Jill at the Canyon Suites for an amazing guided tour; Rob, Sarah,Carolyn and Kira and so many other greeters who always made us feel welcome; Carlene and the fantastic chef  Whitney at the ice cream shop; and of course the always smiling and helpful housekeeping employees (best ever), bellhops, and valet staff.

If I could list everyone my family encountered there, I would.  Seriously, if you are planning to stop by Scottsdale, make it a point to stay at the Phoenician.  I can't say enough positive things about them and the hotel.

reviews.author: AZSTUMPER
reviews.title: A great weekend retreat to a local gem that strives to luxury and quality
reviews.text:
My wife and I enjoyed a very relaxing and enjoyable weekend stay at The Phoenician.

We are locals from Scottsdale and had not visited The Phoenician for several years.

Everything throughout the weekend was enjoyable in the quiet, serene setting against Camelback Mountain and the well maintained hotel property.

We enjoyed relaxing early morning coffee at the pool and the excellent Italian/American Fare at the IL Terrazzo which the restaurant staff and kitchen, which provided very professional dining service we thoroughly enjoyed.

We took a nature walk that adjoins the pool/hotel that provides a wide array of Arizona plants, trees and foliage.

The hotel is in process of adding a new ballroom and there was minor tweaks of spotting on the hallway carpeting to the rooms, but this did not detract from the overall
enjoyment of our stay.

reviews.author: Ramitl
reviews.title: Pretty decent resort..
reviews.text: Though the rooms and corridors look kind of tired... Very good conference facility and good food

reviews.author: Mav1244
reviews.title: an absolutely fantastic hotel!
reviews.text: we only stayed here 1 night en route to San Diego from the Grand Canyon but wished we had more time.  If we are anywhere near Phoenix again we will definitely return.

reviews.author: alenesc102
reviews.title: What more could you want???
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely fabulous.  250 acres of perfection.  The "entire" staff was exceptionally accomodating and it was easy to see everyone was happy to be employed there.  Property and accomodations were spotlessly clean. Stayed in Canyon Suites overlooking one of the three pools on property.  Food was excellent. Must visit Relish Bistro for a burger and tater tots!!  Resort catered to both families and individuals that wanted privacy.  Golf course was beautiful.  I hope to return for a longer stay here very soon.

reviews.author: Goeres
reviews.title: Top address in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
V Top five star hotel in Scottsdale which also deserve its 5 Star.
I was lucky to have one of the few villas which are very large and space but not close to the pool. Therefor we got a Electric Golf Cart (comes with the villa) and could drive up to the pool (the children loved it). Service is just outstanding and into the smallest details.

reviews.author: rexleo
reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: This hotel is spottless and amazing. Check in was painless and the casita rooms was unexpected but enjoyed it so much. It was very private. POOLS AMAZING and so many to choose from....the beds were awsome. I want one.

reviews.author: emmitacp
reviews.title: Luxury Collection, Scottsdale Arizona
reviews.text: I spend a couple of nights week of July 11-13 on business. My first time in Arizona and coming from Florida was the sandy colors, the buildings in route to the hotel seem very square looking. The property is located next to a mountain that looks like a big stone rising from the ground. The garden and golf course are surrounded by sand and sand dunes, big cactus and other desert plants are beautifully placed. The reception personnel are courteous and knowledgeable. We stayed on a double bed suite. The room was big and clean and the bathroom was impressive. It had a shower a double wide bathtub double sinks and the toilet enclosed with a door, all in marble or stone like material. My understanding is that Arizona is very careful with their water resources so I was impressed by the water conservation shower head that gave a pleasant sensation while feeling good with the environment. High quality beds, towels, linen, toiletries and the room was very clean. I learned later that the hotel was build on 1988 and other than the analog thermostats I didn’t notice the age. I tried the food in different restaurants and the food was good the attention better. We also got to use the convention center and it was spacious with an actual view of the mountain behind. The employees are friendly well trained and very organized. This is by far the best use of space I wave witness in a Hotel. I will go back anytime and I can recommend to anyone for business or recreation.

reviews.author: sandes
reviews.title: Beautiful....Pools incredible!
reviews.text:
Incredible place.  You won't go wrong staying here.  The rooms are immaculate.  Food is great in every restaurant.  Very expensive....prepare for that!  Pools are awesome!!!
We stayed multiple times!

reviews.author: DLBroyles
reviews.title: Nice property but room view was awful
reviews.text: Service and the grounds were beautiful.  The only thing that knocks this property down was the AWFUL view from the room... Which was the roof of the lower building next to us and the room windows across the way. For a property as luxurious and well-known as The Phoenician, I definitely expected more. With so many great hotels in Scottsdale, I would look for another property that can give you everything.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Top grade facility, good food options, top staff.  Next to Camelback mountain for hikers.  I enjoy the view over the pool compared to the  mountainview, but again top quality facilities and staff.

reviews.author: Happyhobo
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Phoenix
reviews.text: My wife, my 8 year old son and I stayed at the hotel for 8 nights whilst we attended a wedding in Scottsdale. The hotel is superbly appointed - the grounds and pools are excellent. We ate in the restaurant every morning and breakfast was great both in terms of choice and quality. We had several dinners at the hotel also and all were excellent. Hotel staff were pleasant and helpful except for some of  the concierge team. Executive/Towncars (ones working with the hotel/concierge staff) will cost you between $13 and $20 for a ride to Scottsdale town centre, whereas normal cabs costs anywhere between $5 and $7. If you're making the odd trip in and out of town its not a big deal, but if you're in and out regularly it gets expensive. Hertz have a car rental office in the hotel - they have a good selection of cars but book online before you travel - its a lot cheaper.

reviews.author: JeremyKingsbury
reviews.title: Still an amazing Resort.
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Phoenician for six nights from June 3rd. It was our second visit and I am sure it will not be our last, the place is truely top quality.
A couple of issues, (not regarded as a problem), at check-in were the result of the reservations manager having put a reserve on a specific room that I had requested, it was not ready when we arrived although a similar room was, the system would not let the front desk deviate from our assigned room until a manager sanctioned it. I appreciate that usually you get what rooms are available at the time of check-in so this was beyond what I expected and I am extremely grateful to Jeffrey Kern for his help in fulfilling my request.
The rooms, grounds, pools and everything else at the Phoenician are fabulous, I would urge anyone to try it for themselves. I believe that all the rooms are of a similar standard and the upgrades are purely down to the outlook/view from the room, we overlooked the pool complex which, in my opinion, was worth the extra cost.
The Terrace bar has a phenominal selection of Vodka's and the drink prices are in keeping with the surroundings, the food available on the terrace is very good and fairly priced. We ate in the top floor Steakhouse on one night but would not recommend it as the choices, especially the starter selection, are a bit limited and the overall standard of the meal was not what we expected. The "Il Terrazzo" restaurant was very good, both food quality and value, we ate Dinner there on two occasions as well as the Sunday Brunch, (which is very good indeed).
There are plenty of dining options, (and places to spend an evening), close by. The resort provides a Limo service should you require it, we used the service to go to one of the restaurants at the fashion square mall and it was only $13.00. The Yard house is good fun, I would also recommend Wildfish and Culinary Drop-out, (for casual dining), there are any number of restaurants to choose from, for good Mexican the "OLD Town Tortilla Factory" is the place to go.
My only real gripe with Phoenician is the fact they have removed the ice machines from each of the floors, I appreciate the fact that this is small issue and it should not deviate from the fact that the Resort is absolutely superb, it is just something I don't think they needed to do and is sometimes an inconvenience to wait for a bucket of Ice to be delivered by room-service.
I would highly recommend this Resort to anyone considering a stay in Scottsdale/Phoenix, my wife and I have stayed at several of the other high end Resorts in the area, and we haven't had a bad one yet, but the Phoenician really is that good,
I have given the value rating a 4* as the Resort website can sometimes be expensive, be aware of occasional offers and, regardless of the "best rate guarantee", check other websites
JWK

reviews.author: AlohaGiselle
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: This is nice hotel but I'm not sure it worth 5 diamonds rating.  The 5 diamonds rating hotel are all superb.  The restaurants were good except the steak house in the hotel was not my favorite, Ruth Chirs"s was better.

reviews.author: AZRPM
reviews.title: Nice but a little tired looking
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Phoenician while visiting our son who lives in Scottsdale. We live in Tucson and we wanted to try this resort. We were " upgraded"  to a casita. We decided to go with that because there was parking at the casitas. Otherwise valet parking was $29.95 a night although there was plenty of free parking available on the periphery of the property. The casita was nothing special. Just a standard looking room set away from the hotel. It was clean and comfortable but the carpet was tired looking and the HVAC was unacceptably noisy. Since we were not in the hotel proper, it's hard to comment on the "vibe"  of the place. The poolside service was attentive and we kept supplied with ice water on a very hot July day. All in all not a bad experience just nothiing special.

reviews.author: sethman
reviews.title: A diamond looking a lot rough these days
reviews.text:
We have been staying @ The Phoenician off and on for 2 decades(yes I am old) During that time we have had some amazing experiences, wonderful meals and met some truly wonderful guests and employees.  The hotel has changed hands multiple times, renovated rooms and restaurants and tried to maintain the luxury brand.  Sadly the shine is off this diamond.  Cost cutting, corner cutting and reduced staffing has left this hotel a pretender in the luxury hotel market in Phoenix.  I have to lay the blame on management(Starwood) a local hotel management group.  The pool area is become rundown and in need of much attention.  Staff @ the pool work in earnest but rarely show any initiative.  The pools are well maintain(they have multiple ones) but the pool accesories need to replaced yesterday.  The decking is slippery when not wet, when wet it is worse that black ice but no signs exist warning people.  One Saturday spent in the pool warning and watching people to the danger of the danger made us wish we had a sign to post.  
Room service was a huge bright spot with very professional and upbeat servers.  Less can be said for the Sunday brunch.  First a 9am reservation for 8 was rejected as too many on such short notice unless we wanted to sit outside which in the summer it gets to be 90 degrees by that time.  When we suggested 2 tables of 4 they said they would "try to fit us in"  inside...When seated they had set up one table which was really very nice of them to accommodate us but with only 2 other tables occupied the entire time we were there we were left wondering why make such a big deal about our request for seating.  The $25 buffet is a mere shell of the glorious times of the past.  Where shrimp cocktail once sat now chaffing dishes of dry french toast, runny eggs and undercooked potatoes sat.  Cost cutting here really shows in the low quality and lack of diversity of food options.  The standout is the ommlete station which is the better choice even to get your eggs cooked properly.  While no one was drinking champagne it would have been nice to be asked..
The worst experience here is front desk management!  Trying to check in when only one person works at the front desk and people are disputing all their charges is frustrating.  There should always be 2 people and/or a manager working such a critical part of the hotel.  When we were given rooms that we did not reserve and called to have the situation fixed was another terrible experience and one that highlights the true problem here. Rude, unprofessional front desk staff and management offered nothing but resistance and insults...really sad and speaks most loudly.  The hotel could not have been 30% occupied if that...We were told there was nothing they could do and even though we confirmed at reservation and at check in.  
Maybe because it is summer, maybe because they are so slow the "B" team is running things on a smaller staff but I would not be in any hurry to suggest or return any time soon.

reviews.author: Chessie3
reviews.title: Lukewarm at Best
reviews.text: I'll skip right to the part you need to know.  The resort apparently sells passes to its pools.  EVEN the "Adult Pool Over 18 Only"  I know this becasue we planned a quiet day there...and ended up next to a dozen pre-teens celebrating a birthday in the next cabana.  Not only was the area NOT quiet, but we had to compete with the group to get a waitress.  We skipped the pools for the remainder of the visit.

reviews.author: finertasteskc
reviews.title: The Phoenician was an Oasis
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Phoenician for 4 nights as a getaway trip.  We were thrilled that it was just a short cab drive from the Phoenix Skyport airport.  We received a complimentary upgrade to a casita, which was really nice.  The room was comfortable, clean and spacious (as was the bathroom) and had an in-room safe.  It had slight wear and tear but nothing to be concerned about.  It was quiet and had a spectacular view of the Mother of Pearl Pool and up Camelback Mountain.  The hotel grounds were lush and lovely and every staff member we met was hospitable.  My husband golfed one day and thought the course was beautiful.  I mostly visited the pools and found them clean and the service good.  Because we visited in August, there were fewer guests than normal, so we never had an issue finding a chair.  And yes, it was hot, but when you're planning to do nothing more than sit at the pool, that is no problem.

We chose to spend our entire vacation there (and didn't venture out into very nearby Scottsdale), including dining, swimming, and relaxing.  We dined at each of the restaurants, and were most impressed with the elegant J&G Steakhouse (we ate there twice).  Their menu is current and creative, filled with fresh ingredients and fun flavors.  It was a fairly pricey meal but on our second visit, we ate from a prix fixe menu and found it to be just as enjoyable.  We also really enjoyed Relish Burger Bistro one evening -- with fantastic free chips and salsa and a fun menu.  We found the Italian Il Terrazzo to be average for dinner, but were disappointed in how expensive it was for breakfast.  After the first day, and an almost $40 breakfast bill, including $6 coffee, we saved our money for fantastic dinners at J&G, instead stopping by the Cafe and Ice Cream Corner for croissants and then by Il Terrazzo for free coffee (free coffee to go for all hotel guests).  I was frustrated that coffee that was free next to the hostess station, was $6 on my breakfast bill, despite being a hotel guest.  We did lunch at the Cafe a couple of times and were pleased with our meals, and the ice cream!  Lunch at the Oasis Poolside Bar & Grill was fine but unremarkable.  It is a poolside grill, after all.

We absolutely can't wait to return and also to visit other hotels in the Luxury Collection.  It was a fantastic experience.

reviews.author: 2009italy
reviews.title: The staff made this trip very special
reviews.text: In town to look at real estate and spent a weekend at the Phoenician earlier this month, so it was a business/pleasure stay.    What made the experience stand out was the excellence of the staff.  From the front desk to the  restaurants to the women's clothing shop (great stuff, by the way) to the tennis center attendant -- everyone was super efficient, friendly and made every effort to enhance our trip.  Based on that alone, we will return to the Phoenician.  The food was excellent, the rooms were attractive and comfortable and the property was lovely.

reviews.author: jollyman45
reviews.title: Totally loved this hotel
reviews.text:
We stayed here on a friend trip and were totally happy with every aspect of the hotel.  From front desk to food service everything was top notch.  Staff was always friendly and helpful and tried to make my stay enjoyable.

Would recommend this hotel to anyone that wants to feel welcome and taken care of.

reviews.author: MikeSap
reviews.title: Magnificent hotel in beautiful surroundings!
reviews.text: There is not much to say here except that this hotel offers every luxury you can imagine. Service and location are impeccable. Rooms are spacious and comfortable, food is top notch.

reviews.author: Debra L
reviews.title: The only place we will stay in Phoenix!
reviews.text: Amazing service and the hotel shows as if it were 6 months old. A phenomenal golf course and horticultural cactus garden like we have never seen. Very classy. The restaurants and bar services were excellent. The myriad of pools, amenities and aesthetic features were exceptional. Great spa services! Our business function tied up the whole hotel with our 600 guests and they continued to dazzle us with great service and food. The beds, rooms and washrooms allowed us to totally relax, since the construction of the hotel is very solid and consequently relatively soundproof.

reviews.author: kaydKnoxville
reviews.title: Outstanding hotel and the service was spectacular.
reviews.text: The Phoenician, Scottsdale was an outstanding hotel. It was beautiful from the front entrance to the expansive, lovely room. The pools were clean and located for convenient use. The restaurants served something for everyone at a variety of prices and the food was top quality. The staff concentrated on meeting the needs of each individual. They were always helpful and friendly. The area surrounding the hotel had many things to offer for families and individuals to explore. It was an outstanding visit and I would gladly stay at the Phoenician again!

reviews.author: Ozarkskid
reviews.title: Off the hook
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying here for a conference and I can't wait to bring the family back. This is without a doubt one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. Great food,great service. Unbelievably clean and the beds were out of this world comfy.

reviews.author: travel3399
reviews.title: First class service!
reviews.text: Outstanding property, beautiful grounds, and most importantly excellent service provided by a willing and caring staff.  AWe were here with over 200 people, and the meals were delicious!

reviews.author: Tybeeslop
reviews.title: Thumbs up. Five diamond property all the way
reviews.text: Beautiful property, over the top service, very comfortable stay!

reviews.author: SchnitzerShapiro
reviews.title: Extremely disappointed
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I were so looking forward to our vacation at The Phornician, but unfortunately it did not live up to all the great things we had heard about if. We were upgraded to a casita, but upon entering the casita it was at least 100 degrees in the room and simply unbearable. We tried to call the front desk from the room but there was no answer, so we trekked back to the front desk and requested a room change. We asked to be given a room with a view and we were told that we would have a view of the golf course. Well they must have meant a view of the parking lot for the golf carts because that is our view from room 2141.  We also had dinner at Relish and were disappointed by the food, my meal was burnt and the young staff cared more about socializing amongst themselves than servicing the customers.    
This entire experience has not been what we were expecting at all.  We booked the Phoenician because of the outstanding customer service but we have not experienced it.  All we wanted was an extremely relaxing vacation and this has not been it.

reviews.author: Carie-girl
reviews.title: Not a great time
reviews.text:
My husband and I travel often, both internationally and locally and I was compelled to write my 1st review.  We stayed the weekend of 7.2.11.  The room and check-in service was wonderful, but on our 1st night we were woke up at 2 am to a small group of loud and obviously drunk people. After being woke up, and 20 minutes of noise I called to complain but the noise didn’t stop until after 4.  The pool is lovely but at 5pm could have used a good cleaning.  (Pool staff was excellent.) 
You will find the best hamburger in Phoenix at Relish’s, and the breakfast buffet was very good but over priced.  The staff at the buffet was perfect!
 On my birthday we went to J & G and were *sorely* disappointed. As my husband said, “It was the worst $100.00 meal I have ever eaten”.  Our waitress was condescending and rude.  (I could give MANY examples of this.) It was way to cold during the whole evening.  The appetizers were ok but the rest of the meal was horrible!!  We decided to eat our dessert in our room and asked for plastic wear to go.   In our room my husband said that it the dessert was awful and they didn’t even put the plastic ware in the bag.  My dessert was just as bad and that was the last straw then I called to complain.  Of course they took the meal off but we still won’t come back.

reviews.author: LISALOO056
reviews.title: Didn't want to leave!!!
reviews.text: The Phoenician was beyond our expectations!  Absolutely beautiful and the service was the best out of all the other resorts we have stayed at during our many years of "stay-vactions" in the valley!! The beds are so comfortable that I didn't want to get out of it in the morning. The many pools are just wonderful!!! From room service to pool side, the Phoenician is THE BEST BY FAR!!!

reviews.author: pat a
reviews.title: Amazing customer service
reviews.text:
If your going to be in the Phoniex, Scottsdale area there is no reason to stay anywhere else.  The staff especially front desk mgr. Robert Christenson went above and beyond to make our stay a HOMERUN.  Great room ,pools the restaurant Il Terrazzo was wonderful.   My overall stay I would rate 10 stars. Bavo Phoenician Bravo :)
PC

reviews.author: arubadive
reviews.title: fabulous resort!!
reviews.text: beautiful grounds! The pools were clean and sparkly.....We have not stayed in a room that large in some time. downside- not much selection of food.....over priced!

reviews.author: bookworm909
reviews.title: This is a fantastic resort!
reviews.text: I wrote a review for the hotel and tried to be as objective as possible.  But I couldn't think of one negative experience we had during our stay.  This is an absolutely wonderful place to relax and get away.  I was treated like an esteemed guest the moment valet took my keys to check-out.  The hotel is gorgeous and well-kept.  Service is exceptional.  The rooms are comfortable and stylish.  The restaurants are generous and accomodating.  This is the second time we've stayed there in 9 months and it was an equally pleanant experience both times.  This is a very well managed property.  Have fun!

reviews.author: TWS34
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Great hotel!  When we arrived we were upgraded to a suite at the same price!  Our suite had 2 beautiful bathrooms, a master bed and a large living area.  We had 2 huge balconies which were nice too.  The room could have used an update, new paint, new rugs and some color...all kind of tan! But it was nice and clean.
The front desk staff were friendly and very accommodating, although we did have to wait close to 2 hours to check in since we arrived a little early.  We had dinner there and it was a fantastic meal.
The pools were nice but a little run down.  Pool service was excellent!
My husband played golf there and enjoyed the course...nice Pro shop too.
I went to the gym and couldn't believe I had to pay to use the exercise equipment.....you would think that at $450/night you could use the gym for free!
Overall, a very nice place to stay and we would go there again!  Great location to downtown Scotsdale!

reviews.author: Dr_Castle
reviews.title: Great Place and Great service
reviews.text: I have been comming here for years with my wife. It is a wonderful and luxurious resort with great staff and service.

reviews.author: ncwriter3
reviews.title: Lovely place! Lovely folks!
reviews.text: We chose the Phoenician for a girls' getaway weekend.  From check in to check out, the service was top notch.  We loved our rooms (especially the big bathrooms & the very comfy beds!)  The grounds were impeccable.  We are not golfers, so can't comment on that, but the day spent in a poolside cabana was a real treat -- not inexpensive-- but worth it.  The spa services were fine, but did feel a bit rushed.  It appeared that for 10 minutes at the top of the hour, patrons were quickly ushered out, while the new group was ushered in.  I prefer a more serene environment.  While the massage and facial were fine, they were not memorable as services have been on other "pampering trips."  The four of left thinking that we would absolutely revisit the Phoenician!

reviews.author: RalphR_11
reviews.title: It's the Phoenician
reviews.text: Even if by some chance something goes wrong, it's ain't terrible to be at the Phoenician.  They will go out of their way to make it right.

reviews.author: mikeandbernie
reviews.title: Best Hotel Ever
reviews.text: In my sixty years of traveling and hotel stays, this was the best experience we have ever had. The staff was attentive, friendly, courteous, helpful, prompt, and the list goes on & on! We stayed here for my daughter's wedding and had high expectations and our expectations were far exceeded! Our stay was amazing! We had out of town guests who stayed and it's been a month and they still talk about how amazing this hotel was. The location was great - if you're considering staying in this area - look no further. You must stay here. Hotels in the area are priced comparably and if you select another, you will not get your money's worth. Top notch hotel in every category.

reviews.author: Hardtopleaseofhk
reviews.title: Nice hotel, great golf course
reviews.text: I stayed for a week at this hotel and have recommended it to others as a consequence.  Many hotels in jthe United States do not live up to the hype but this one certainly does.  Splendid food, a good bar and a vey nice resort style golf course make this an ideal spot to unwind.  A little pricey but for those looking for some desert sun, I strongly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: grammie12
reviews.title: Outstanding Property Especially Customer Service
reviews.text: I am a world traveler.  Have stayed in 4-6 star hotels everywhere.  This property took me by surprise, since I have stayed there once before several years ago.  There were housekeeping people EVERYWHERE, but I hardly knew they were around; except for my soiled cup, napkin or plastic wrap being gone when I turned around.  That's Great management.   Incredible!  I expect great customer service but that was over the top!  The bed, room were very comfortable.  Choices for shopping needs were great.  I had to buy a pair of sunglasses but didn't want to spend $75.  They have a shop for high end and a shop for mid-range needs.  I spent $16 for sunglasses.  In a place like this, it was a bargain.  Cleanliness around the pool, meeting rooms, golf course, clubhouse, and common areas is second to none.  We ate at the golf club restaurant.  The food was very good.  However, the serving pieces are fabulous!  I'd like to know where to purchase them for my daily use!  We at at the steakhouse in the hotel.  I felt like I had my own personal server and no one else was in the room.  He was very attentive to all of my needs and was able to almost read my mind when I was uncertain about something I wanted.  He made suggestions that were spot on.  AMAZING!  The food was spectacular, as well .  This property is a destination!

reviews.author: Nhern
reviews.title: Overall a great hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed for two nights on a business trip.  Overall, I would definitely recommend this hotel.  If you are here for leisure I think the hotel would be an excellent choice due to the grounds, the multiple trails,and the pool area.  For business, the conference facilities are pretty good, but rooms are far from the conference space.

The good:
Very large rooms
Large patio/balcony
Good work desk area
Better than average toiletries
Huge pools - great pool area!  Waterslide for the kids, nice poolside beverage and snack bar.
Grounds are gorgeous and wonderful views
Very friendly staff
Many onsite facilities- ice cream parlor, espresso bar, shopping, etc.

The bad:
Rooms could use a little updating
Very spread out- it is a hike from most rooms to the pool
Not as convenient as other hotels to downtown Scottsdale
Charge for internet on the high side
Air conditioner is loud and takes some time to cool down the room
Ok beds, not the best

reviews.author: goldab
reviews.title: Best of everything--service is amazing, hotel is beautiful!"
reviews.text: My teenage daughter and I stayed at the Phoenician for a week and had a fabulous time.  The hotel itself is quite beautiful without being flashy.  Our room was enormous and beautifully furnished with an equally enormous bathroom and very comfortable beds--everything was first rate.  The pools are fabulous and even though it was Easter week and the pool was very crowded, the pool staff made sure that you had chaises where you wanted them.  The staff at the Mother of Pearl pool (which stays remarkably cool even in 95 degree heat!) was amazing.  They practically turned the page of my book as I was reading.  Our pitcher of water, brought over to us as we arrived at the pool was refilled over and over.  I left my book at the pool one day and an attendant called my room to see if it was mine as she noticed the book on my chair during the day.  She held it for me and brought to me the next day.  The restaurant staff was also excellent and also couldn't do enough for us.  My daughter became ill one evening and the staff couldn't do enough for us and even called to check that she was doing better.  The restaurant offered soup and crackers, the housekeeping brought us a brand new heating pad and the front desk asked if we needed anyone to run to the pharmacy for us.  The service was extra special because the staff made it seem as if they were happiest serving 'you' and it was truly their pleasure to keep you happy.  I can't wait to come back with the rest of our family to enjoy this wonderful resort again.  Any type of group would be happy here--we saw large family reunions, seniors, singles, families with young children and teenagers and all were happy.  I didn't hear anyone complaining about anything at all--very happy group of workers and guests.  My only regret is that we didn't use the spa which looked wonderful too.

reviews.author: Jackfish915
reviews.title: Unauthorized Charges
reviews.text: Enjoyed our room and enjoyed the property. Settled account in full on check out. Received email when we got home that added two extra charges to my Visa that I did not incur. I have left two messages with billing department, I have sent three faxes and two emails. No one has returned my calls. Very dissappointed.

reviews.author: GeorgiaOutdoorsDiva
reviews.title: Great hotel, convenient to local trails
reviews.text: This is not a hotel I would normally stay at, since I like econo hotels, but, hey I was "forced" to stay here for business.  This is an upscale hotel and it doesn't disappoint.  Lots of nice little trails on the property (through the Cactus Garden, for example) and is a short walk to local trails up Camelback Mountain.  Beautiful view of the mountain right outside my room.  It was a good experience, but not a hotel I would pay for out of my own pocket.

reviews.author: Neil C
reviews.title: Great resort hotel
reviews.text:
My first impression wasn't so great but after a few hours I realised that the service at the hotel makes up for the very slightly dated rooms. That said, the rooms were big and bathrooms excellent. The dining in Il Terrazzo was excellent... Poolside snacks good too. The spa was good, not like a European spa but ok.
I didn't golf but colleagues who did raved about the course.

reviews.author: Hous2n
reviews.title: Great Bed!
reviews.text: I visited The Phoenician in May 2011 traveling by myself.  I had always heard about the legendary Phoenician and was anxious to stay there. The grounds are incredible and have all the beauty that a mature garden offers. I had the distinct impression I was traveling back in time to the 60s-70s as I drove up the road to the hotel. But that was OK. The exterior of the hotel buildings themselves are a little disappointing. Lobby is nice-- rooms not so nice. I can't imagine that I could have gotten a worse located room.  No view at all. But I booked at the last minute-- what do you expect. The room smelled musty which is odd considering this is the desert-- a smell more associated with wet climates. The bed was heavenly which is exactly what I needed. Shower incredible. Bath large but dated. The shampoo, bath wash etc were very nice. I loved the idea of the outdoor terrace bar but the food, service and ambiance were less than wonderful. A lot of the problem were the kids ( which is not the responsibility of the hotel) but it is after all a bar. And where I come from, children aren't allowed in bars by law. And certainly not allowed to run, play and scream. The food was bar grub and expensive and wholly underwhelming. The J&G steakhouse was wonderful. And one of the reasons I stayed there. Service and food quality were on par with what I get in New York and San Francisco. The next morning the breakfast was just plain odd. There are 2 locations for breakfast that I could find-- one that is a ice cream shop and the other on the first floor. There were many very unhappy people at the restaurant downstairs-- Il Terrasse? may be I don't recall the name. But you were greated at 9 in the morning with "do you have a reservation?" Duh... no... is that what it takes to get some coffee? There were no fewer than 4 groups who were unhappy when I get there-- unhappy due to seating location, time taken to seat and selection on the menu. The restaurant was empty pretty much and it took 15 minutes to get a table. Once you got in, no one explained the menu or how it worked. There was some sort of convoluted buffet vs brunch that I never figured out. I just told the wait staff what I wanted to eat and let them point out which way to go. There were omlet makers ( good) who had only 3 pans ( bad) with which to cook. A gigantic hotel that offers custom omelets while you wait has only 3 omelet pans? And the chefs are struggling to clean them in front of you while you wait. Pools were beautiful. I could have lived there. Lots of choices and since I swim early or late I missed any kid traffic. The business center was a terrific asset to have-- print your boarding pass etc. I also loved the underground self park. It was very convenient. I don't know if I would return since there are so many 5 star choices in Scottsdale. But overall, I was glad I went and will seek out other hotels in this chain for the beds alone.

reviews.author: andym123
reviews.title: Great place for large family event
reviews.text:
We had a family gathering for Mom's birthday and the Phoenician is a very nice and easy place to gather.  We had 15 people, ate meals together, played some tennis, lots of pool time.  The staff is friendly and attentive, great food, beautiful grounds.

This place isn't cheap but its full service and lots of options for broad range of ages.  The water slide was a huge hit for the kids.  Gym is well equipt, tennis courts are great, golf course looked good (we didn't play).

reviews.author: global84
reviews.title: Luxury hotel w/ great golfing, restaurants, and pools, however, needs to be remodeled.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale. The country club atmosphere was a perfect throwback to my days spent at my grandmothers club in Boca Raton (St. Andrews). The service here is excellent, the many pools beautiful, and the grounds are very well kept. The lobby of the hotel has a wonderful tea service and the golf courses are up to par. I do have one problem with the resort. Like many of the hotel guests the resort is in need of a facelift. Do not get me wrong - the rooms are still very clean and luxurious but they are still stuck in the 90's. If I were in Scottsdale I would not go to the spa at The Phoenician as there are many more luxurious options in the area i.e The Fairmont.

reviews.author: JanetToronto_11
reviews.title: FANTASTIC!
reviews.text: We stayed at The Phoenician for a week in April, 2011. We were a large group of family members and we wanted to stay at a resort that we could all relax at, have fun at and be pampered. Our group had young kids of all ages, teenagers, parents and Grandparents.  The Phoenician was fabulous for each of us. I dealt with Paige Farley, the Executive Meeting Manager, and she helped us plan a wonderful stay and she worked really hard so we had all our needs met. The breakfasts were incredible and eating at the outdoor restaurant was beautiful and elegant and it was a real treat to eat in the perfect blue-sky Scottsdale weather. The pools were wonderful and the water slide was fun for the kids. The pool towel service was completely luxurious and the resort was spotlessly clean. We had a great family time and I would go back for sure with my family or just with my husband.

reviews.author: lily522
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel and great friendly service!
reviews.text:
My girlfriends and I spent 4 wonderful days at this hotel.
This place is beautiful, great food and great service. We were very impressed.
The gentleman at the front desk named Rob was very attentive. 
Thomas, our server at Il Terrazo was very funny and friendly.
We will definitely stay there again.
Thank you for a great weekend.

reviews.author: Pamketnerlind
reviews.title: Beautiful layout and great people
reviews.text: The grounds are gorgeous.  I am glad to hear  that the room decor will be updated this summer.  Right now, the high points of our room are the bed and the shower...both are hard to get out of!  But the rooms need a update...they are clean and comfortable, though.  The pools are great and the attention from the staff, from bell captain to pool attendant was superb...all smiling.  Location is great, too.  Only a few miles to Old Town and shopping and restaurants.  We would love to have the opportunity to return and enjoy the tranquility.

reviews.author: Aclem06
reviews.title: So lovely. What a wonderful place to enjoy cocktail on their awesome veranda.
reviews.text: Veiw of the valley from my balconey was spectacular. My room was spotless and elegant. Had high tea, an event not to be missed. Dinner on the terrace was so yummy. Service was perfect!

reviews.author: abofreeman
reviews.title: Not 5-star, but still a very nice resort
reviews.text: The phoenix area is riddled with beautiful resorts, the Phoenician is no exception.  The grounds are very well kept and the location at the foot of Camelback mountain is breathtaking.  If you are used to staying in 5-star hotels then this hotel might be disappointing to you...If you are used to staying in anything other than 5-star hotels you will find this resort to be more than adequate.  The facilities are dated, but the property is well kept.  We stayed in the casitas and loved how we could conveniently park right in front of our room.  We could walk out of the back of our room and right to the pool.  We didn't have any interested in eating at the overpriced hotel food options, so we rarely ventured further than the pool.  The best part of the resort is exploring the small garden and fountain areas off the sides of the pools.  The cactus garden was also nice to explore, but its not well lit at night.  Our service was great by the pool, but it was not crowded at all when we were there, so I could see how the pool areas might be understaffed if it was crowded.  Overall we had a great experience and would love to come back if the price is right.

reviews.author: shrop
reviews.title: Very Sub Standard Rooms, Excellent Steakhouse
reviews.text:
Don't be fooled by any pictures of rooms you see on the internet, they must have been taken many years ago. We tried three rooms, all of which were the same poor quality with very dated and tiered furnishings. Despite paying for an upgrade the first "view" room faced the side of the resort with a small view of the golf course but mainly  the service area of the resort. The second faced Camelback mountain (nothing else!), finally we went for a Casita room, at least it had a view. All these rooms were similar, the furnishings are outdated and worn, the carpets look clean but have obviously suffered stains through the years. Bathrooms are good sized but very odd and again out of date. 
The only good thing is the bed which is comfortable with quality linens. 

Restaurants are generally expensive, but JG Steakhouse is excellent, great food and service, try the tasting menu, it's superb, it's just a pity it's part of this resort.   

This is NOT a 5 star resort, there are many many better resorts in the area.

reviews.author: fammgr
reviews.title: Big Bad Wow--Gone Downhill
reviews.text:
Our family went to the Phoenician in the 90s, and we are from out of state and had not been back since.  We were very disappointed that it has gone so significantly downhill, especially in terms of service.  It used to be a great place for children, but now they sell buckets of beer and don't hire enough staff to pick up the resulting trash.  This equals dozens and dozens of beer cans along the edge of the pool area for young children to step on throughout the day. One of the few staff members who was there spent almost an hour trying to "hit" on a couple of girls sitting near us.  When we finally went to get our own drinks after failing to get his attention,  we went up the to drink bar where we waited another 15 minutes for another staff member to get off the phone.  The staff member at the drink bar then said gleefully "we are closed! Get dressed and hike up the hill and the restaurant can probably put what you want in a plastic cup for you to bring back down".  This was 5:30 pm (or so) on Saturday of Memorial day weekend so there were still over one hundred people still around the pool and several sitting at the bar still drinking their recently served drinks.  Almost everything--spa, salon etc. at the resort shuts down sharp at 6 pm (or before if the staff can get away with it).

Don't be fooled by the casita marketing as the casitas are essentially regular resort hotel rooms in any other location and NOT worth the upcharge.  They are actually inconveniently located.The poor service was the worst at the bell stand as they are very disorganized and short-staffed.  They leave you standing there while they endlessly valet cars. It is better to arrange your own transport not through them.  Forget about the Hertz on location though as you can't get through because they are on permanent voice mail.

reviews.author: ClevelandPhoenix
reviews.title: Not worth the money for a 5-star resort......
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Phoenician during Memorial Day weekend. They claim to be a 5-star resort, however nothing I experienced or saw was 5-star.  I was able to get a pretty good rate of $159/night, however this hotel runs as high as $500/night.  I've been fortunate to have stayed at a few high end hotels (Ritz Carlton) and The Phoenician doesn't come close to comparing.  The room, while spacious (600 sq ft) was very dated and came with dual 'double' beds. When you're used to sleeping in a King bed downsizing to a Double bed is not luxurious to say the least. For a 5-star resort you would think they could at least upgrade to Queen Beds. 

I'm a huge fan of modern hotels that have been updated and if this is what you look for in a hotel then The Phoenician shouldn't be your choice.  I'm a Starwood Platinum member and so I was upgraded and they informed me all the rooms are the same and that the only 'upgrades' are the views from the room. I was given a 'pool' view. This is an upgrade from the standard 'building' view of the other rooms where you have absolutely no view at all.

Food was very expensive, but is pretty standard at hotels. Quality of the food/drinks was average at best and the pool services was terrible. We got to the pool around 9:00 am both days and had to wait til around 10:30 before a server approached us.  If you want a pool chair make sure you get there by 9:30 as the poolside chairs get taken fast and it's like a cattle call to hold onto them. You cannot reserve chairs.  

On one of the nights I tried to order pizza from a local pizza place. I called down to the front desk to ask for a few places that deliver. I was transferred about 12 times and after 30 minutes of being on hold had one of the bell hops answer my question and tell me that Pizza Hut and Papa Johns deliver (like I couldn't have figured that out). The Concierege (only one of them) was NEVER available to answer questions so unless you planned on waiting 45 minutes to speak to her you were on your own in terms of finding out what's around the resort.  I finally found a pizza place due to my own research and ordered a pizza for the family.  The best part of this is that the resort only allows the deliveryman to go to the guard gate which is 1/2 mile from the lobby/rooms. Therefore you either have to walk the 1/2 mile, get in your car and drive down or find someone to go pick it up for you. I was blown away by this. At the Ritz Carlton you'd have about 5 guys personally assisting you in getting the pizza. 

The grounds and views are really nice and the pool is pretty decent (has a waterslide for the kids), but there is absolutely no way this place is a 5-star resort (maybe back in 1973).

If you're looking for nice resorts in Scottsdale, this would ranke outside my top 10. Take your chances at some others before wasting your money here.

reviews.author: redmcgarry
reviews.title: A Must Stay in Scottsdale
reviews.text: The Phoenician is truly a first class resort.  I stayed there many years ago for a business conference and today, it is still one of my favorites.  We had excellent services, whether it was from the bell staff, concierge, housekeeper and restaurant staff.  We had several excellent meals at the steakhouse and at Relish.  Room Service staff went out of their way to please.  I would definitely recommend this resort for anyone visiting the Phoenix area.

reviews.author: chooch13
reviews.title: Phoenician is a fantastic resort!!
reviews.text: Everything about the Phoenician is top class.  Rooms were beautiful with beautiful views of Camelback Mountain.  We ate in most of the restaurants and were treated great.  Food was wonderful and plentiful.  Pool service was terrific.  Staff was fantastic and did everything they could to make our stay memorable.

reviews.author: golfer92
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: The hotel was gorgeous! the golf course was clean and well maintained as were the rooms and common areas. We went for a golf weekend and everyone we enocountered was friendly and helpful. Definately planning a return trip!!

reviews.author: gotfatcat
reviews.title: Underwhelming and over priced
reviews.text: My husband had to be in Scottsdale for a Monday morning business meeting so we decided to stay some place nice to celebrate our anniversary weekend. We arrived around midnight and were instructed by the guard that room service was available but the restaurants were closed.  It would have been nicer had he told us where we were to park!  It is not clear if you are not familiar with the property.  This was just beginning of the feeling of being fleeced.  A $5 can of Coke from the mini bar ran $7+ by the time taxes, etc were tacked on.  A $9 -4 cup pot of coffee ran almost $20 by the time taxes, svc chg and tip were included. We called the front desk on the first morning of our stay to see how much we would be charged to check out early.  $330 plus all the fees, taxes etc...amount of one nights stay.  We did stay just because of the expense of leaving early.  We did not golf or swim.  We did try to take a walk in the cactus garden they advertise.  It was a small circle of sidewalks that went no where. The decor felt like 1980s Las Vegas.  We were left leaving the property any time we could for meals and entertainment.  There is a great breakfast place nearby called The Breakfast Club. Would not return or recommend to others.

reviews.author: Snoweater
reviews.title: Outdated and overpriced - but great service and food
reviews.text:
I would not normally choose this type of resort to stay at, but I was attending a wedding at the property that was an all-day affair (wedding ceremony, pool/cabana luncheon, cocktails and dinner at the restaurant). I would highly recommend a function at this property - the pools are wonderful. the grounds are beautiful and the food was delicious.  But as far a a destination for some R&R?  Maybe for a family.  Or a golfer.  Not for me

Without exception, employees were a pleasure - and made every effort to accomodate any requests.  With a smile, even!

The rooms - they're OK.  The brass fixtures, shabby towels and 80's vibe takes away from the luxury - but the beds were fabulous.  As were the bath products.

The pool is very crowded on the weekends.  Lots and lots and lots and lots of kids - and long long waits for poolside food and beverage.  

The restaurants were pretty good - from burgers on the golf course to filet at the steakhouse, I was not disappointed.  Meals served poolside were not as good, but not bad.

Overall, good experience - but have had much better 5 star accomodations.  

The reason I would not recommend this hotel to a friend?  There are other more modern hotels in the area that do not cost nearly as much - its just not worth the money.

reviews.author: tifw1
reviews.title: Stay somewhere else if you are SPG Platinum.
reviews.text: Just returned from my second visit here and am very disappointed. I am a long time SPG Platinum member and incredibly loyal to the brand, but it doesn't matter at The Phoenician. I was with a number of colleagues who are not SPG members, yet I was given the worst room in the group (low floor-at the very end of a long hallway, obstructed view).   The front desk didn't seem to care and I asked on multiple days of my stay to move to something nicer if it became available. No one ever got back to me.  I asked for a late checkout and was told i had to check out at noon (despite the SPG policy for 4pm checkout for platinum).   I had to "protest" to get a 2pm checkout and remind them of the policy.  The carpet of the room was dirty and worn and disgusting in the hallways. I ended up leaving a day early.  Go stay at the Westin or W if you want better service. Both these hotels will take better care of you.

reviews.author: Vtoriaholt
reviews.title: Love this resort more than anything in the world
reviews.text: Check in is a breeze, restaurants are wonderful, the pool area and staff are wonderful.  We stayed in a Casita which is always great, with their signature bedding that is above and beyond great.

reviews.author: Travelsal0t1
reviews.title: Wish I had more free time to enjoy
reviews.text: I was here on business and regret that the schedule did not allow more free time to enjoy the property. The room was clean and spacious. The bed was very comfortable and I slept really well. Guard your foodie you set up on the balcony as you may have a couple robbers (birds) try to gain access to the goods.

reviews.author: LyndaSinclair
reviews.title: Mother Daughter Getaway
reviews.text: From Hiking up Camelback with our guide to relaxing by the pool all the service and attention we received was top notch.  The Centre for Well Being lived up to the name and provided fantastic treatments.  The staff are great everywhere and have been with the hotel for a long time.......that speaks volumes.  The Phoenician is a Fine Lady in the Luxury Collection.  Congrats on keeping her in good shape.

reviews.author: JillKil2011
reviews.title: A most wonderful experience!
reviews.text: The Phoenician is beautiful, peaceful and very upscale.  It is the nicest place I have ever stayed and would recommend it to everyone.  The pools are lovely with a gorgeous view of Camelback Mountain.  The hotel is beautifully decorated and our room was exceptional.  The staff was eager to please and assisted with our every need.  Sitting outside by the firepits every evening was my favorite thing to do.  Curling up with my sweetie and a chocolatini - nice!

reviews.author: Debb916
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights on our SPG points. Overall we had a wonderful stay & would def come back again one day. We had a mountain view room which really wasn't a mountain view since you are basically up against the mountain. We had breakfast every morning at the hotel and really enjoyed it. Do note, they give free coffee right in the waiting area near the buffer. No need to purchase it at breakfast. The food at the pool was great! I was shocked at how good it was. All in all, we had a great 3 nights & we will be back again!

reviews.author: jerrydancer
reviews.title: "I am so sorry" Was the common response from this hotel staff!
reviews.text:
Physically stunning with well appointed but 'tired' rooms. From the bellman's non-smiling, contemptuous and aggressive delivery of bags; to the front desk clerk who chose to ignore me without acknowledgement for 5 minutes while he kept his head down in his computer, this was far from a 5 Diamond experience! My internet access was shut off for 12 hours for no explainable reason. I heard "I am so sorry" so many times, I thought it was their motto!

The Hotel closed their three restaurants for two evenings while I was there leaving the exorbitant room service as the only option or leave the property which is about two miles from anything at all. That may have been a blessing as the food prices are unreasonably high for pretty average food. I asked for butter no less than three times from three different waitstaff at lunch and finished my meal without it.

These are the indisputable facts of my experience. There is not enough room here for my 'opinion'. You should make your decision about this property based on the facts, not opinions! It should be easy to find a much better experience for much less money than they over charge for here.

I have stayed at 5 star hotels all over the world. There is something wrong here with the 'culture' of this hotel staff. They define good service as 'slow'! Whether it is the insincere 'script' they must be forced to use to patronize you or just the lack of professional staff, there is definitely something wrong here! The bottom line is this: If the hotel staff does not acknowledge you or give you a smile, they don't deserve your business!

reviews.author: bobk1717
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
Very impressive facility. Clean, well maintained, and well run. Customer service overall was high.

Pools are excellent. Plenty of seating and shade.

J&G Steakhouse, Relish, and Oasis all provided very good meals and service.

Excellent fitness facilty. Spa only about average, but had great massage.

Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Russell N
reviews.title: Great hotel, but service patchy
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a couple of short breaks whilst visiting friends in Phoenix.

Arrival at the hotel is impressive, with nicely landscaped grounds and a backdrop of mountains including the famous Camelback. The lobby lives up to this, as do the rooms, but sadly the service didn't always match the surroundings.

On arrival (the first time), there was only one person manning reception. For a hotel that boats 800 rooms/suites/casitas that's verging on insane. When we eventually reached the front of the line (after waiting maybe 10 minutes having travelled for much of the day), we were told "the other girl is off sick".
